#include "syn_ble_gatt.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_ble_gatt_init(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *table, uint16_t table_len,
                             void *user_data)
{
    if (gatt == NULL || (table == NULL && table_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(gatt, 0, sizeof(*gatt));
    gatt->table = table;
    gatt->table_len = table_len;
    gatt->user_data = user_data;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static uint16_t gatt_get_le16(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint16_t)((uint16_t)p[0] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)p[1] << 8U));
}

static void gatt_put_le16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    p[1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
}

static const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *find_attr(const SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t handle)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        if (gatt->table[i].handle == handle) {
            return &gatt->table[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static uint8_t gatt_cccd_slot(const SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t handle)
{
    uint8_t slot = 0U;
    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        if (gatt->table[i].uuid16 == SYN_BLE_UUID_CCCD) {
            if (gatt->table[i].handle == handle) {
                break;
            }
            if ((uint8_t)(slot + 1U) < SYN_BLE_MAX_CCCDS) {
                slot++;
            }
        }
    }
    return slot;
}

static SYN_Status gatt_read_attr_val(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                     const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr, uint8_t *val, uint16_t max_len,
                                     uint16_t *val_len)
{
    if (attr->read_cb != NULL) {
        SYN_Status st =
            attr->read_cb(gatt, conn_handle, attr->handle, val, val_len, gatt->user_data);
        if (st == SYN_OK && *val_len > max_len) {
            *val_len = max_len;
        }
        return st;
    }
    if (attr->static_val != NULL) {
        uint16_t copy_len = attr->static_val_len;
        if (copy_len > max_len) {
            copy_len = max_len;
        }
        memcpy(val, attr->static_val, copy_len);
        *val_len = copy_len;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (attr->uuid16 == SYN_BLE_UUID_CCCD) {
        uint8_t slot = gatt_cccd_slot(gatt, attr->handle);
        uint16_t cccd = gatt->cccd_vals[conn_handle % SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS][slot];
        gatt_put_le16(val, cccd);
        *val_len = 2U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_read_req(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                       const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len, uint8_t *resp_buf,
                                       uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    if (pdu_len != 3U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, 0x0000U,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_PDU, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    uint16_t handle = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[1]);
    if (handle == 0x0000U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, 0x0000U,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_HANDLE, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = find_attr(gatt, handle);
    if (attr == NULL) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    if ((attr->permissions & SYN_BLE_PROP_READ) == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_READ_NOT_PERMITTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    uint8_t val[SYN_BLE_GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN];
    uint16_t val_len = 0U;
    SYN_Status st =
        gatt_read_attr_val(gatt, conn_handle, attr, val, (uint16_t)sizeof(val), &val_len);
    if (st == SYN_INVALID_PARAM) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_READ_NOT_PERMITTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_UNLIKELY_ERROR, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    if (val_len > (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 1U)) {
        val_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 1U);
    }

    return syn_ble_att_encode_read_rsp(val, val_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_write_req(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                        const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len, uint8_t *resp_buf,
                                        uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    if (pdu_len < 3U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, 0x0000U,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_PDU, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    uint16_t handle = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[1]);
    if (handle == 0x0000U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, 0x0000U,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_HANDLE, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = find_attr(gatt, handle);
    if (attr == NULL) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    if ((attr->permissions & SYN_BLE_PROP_WRITE) == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, handle,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED, resp_buf,
                                            resp_len);
    }

    const uint8_t *val = &att_pdu[3];
    uint16_t val_len = (uint16_t)(pdu_len - 3U);

    if (attr->write_cb != NULL) {
        if (attr->write_cb(gatt, conn_handle, handle, val, val_len, gatt->user_data) != SYN_OK) {
            return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, handle,
                                                SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED, resp_buf,
                                                resp_len);
        }
    } else if (attr->uuid16 == SYN_BLE_UUID_CCCD) {
        if (val_len != 2U) {
            return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ, handle,
                                                SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_ATTR_LEN, resp_buf,
                                                resp_len);
        }
        uint8_t slot = gatt_cccd_slot(gatt, handle);
        gatt->cccd_vals[conn_handle % SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS][slot] = gatt_get_le16(val);
    }

    return syn_ble_att_encode_write_rsp(resp_buf, resp_len);
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_write_cmd(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                        const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len,
                                        uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    *resp_len = 0U;
    if (pdu_len < 3U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    uint16_t handle = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[1]);
    if (handle == 0x0000U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = find_attr(gatt, handle);
    if (attr == NULL || (attr->permissions & SYN_BLE_PROP_WRITE_CMD) == 0U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    const uint8_t *val = &att_pdu[3];
    uint16_t val_len = (uint16_t)(pdu_len - 3U);
    if (attr->write_cb != NULL) {
        (void)attr->write_cb(gatt, conn_handle, handle, val, val_len, gatt->user_data);
    } else if (attr->uuid16 == SYN_BLE_UUID_CCCD && val_len == 2U) {
        uint8_t slot = gatt_cccd_slot(gatt, handle);
        gatt->cccd_vals[conn_handle % SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS][slot] = gatt_get_le16(val);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool gatt_validate_range(uint8_t opcode, const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len,
                                uint16_t expected_len, bool allow_uuid128, uint16_t *start_h,
                                uint16_t *end_h, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    bool len_ok = (pdu_len == expected_len) || (allow_uuid128 && (pdu_len == 21U));
    if (!len_ok) {
        (void)syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(opcode, 0x0000U, SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_PDU, resp_buf,
                                           resp_len);
        return false;
    }

    *start_h = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[1]);
    *end_h = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[3]);
    if (*start_h == 0x0000U || *start_h > *end_h) {
        (void)syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(opcode, *start_h, SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_HANDLE,
                                           resp_buf, resp_len);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool gatt_attr_in_range(const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr, uint16_t start_h, uint16_t end_h)
{
    return (attr->handle != 0x0000U) && (attr->handle >= start_h) && (attr->handle <= end_h);
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_find_info(const SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, const uint8_t *att_pdu,
                                        uint16_t pdu_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint16_t start_h = 0U;
    uint16_t end_h = 0U;
    if (!gatt_validate_range(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_FIND_INFO_REQ, att_pdu, pdu_len, 5U, false, &start_h,
                             &end_h, resp_buf, resp_len)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    uint8_t info_buf[SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT];
    uint16_t info_len = 0U;
    const uint16_t max_info_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 2U);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = &gatt->table[i];
        if (gatt_attr_in_range(attr, start_h, end_h)) {
            if ((uint16_t)(info_len + 4U) > max_info_len) {
                break;
            }
            gatt_put_le16(&info_buf[info_len], attr->handle);
            gatt_put_le16(&info_buf[info_len + 2U], attr->uuid16);
            info_len = (uint16_t)(info_len + 4U);
        }
    }

    if (info_len == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_FIND_INFO_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    return syn_ble_att_encode_find_info_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_FIND_INFO_FMT_UUID16, info_buf, info_len,
                                            resp_buf, resp_len);
}

static uint16_t gatt_service_end_handle(const SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t svc_idx)
{
    uint16_t end_h = gatt->table[svc_idx].handle;
    for (uint16_t j = (uint16_t)(svc_idx + 1U); j < gatt->table_len; j++) {
        uint16_t u = gatt->table[j].uuid16;
        if (u == SYN_BLE_UUID_PRIMARY_SERVICE || u == SYN_BLE_UUID_SECONDARY_SERVICE) {
            break;
        }
        if (gatt->table[j].handle > end_h) {
            end_h = gatt->table[j].handle;
        }
    }
    return end_h;
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_read_by_group(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                            const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len,
                                            uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint16_t start_h = 0U;
    uint16_t end_h = 0U;
    if (!gatt_validate_range(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_GROUP_TYPE_REQ, att_pdu, pdu_len, 7U, true,
                             &start_h, &end_h, resp_buf, resp_len)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (pdu_len == 21U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_GROUP_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_GROUP_TYPE, resp_buf,
                                            resp_len);
    }

    uint16_t group_uuid = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[5]);
    if (group_uuid != SYN_BLE_UUID_PRIMARY_SERVICE &&
        group_uuid != SYN_BLE_UUID_SECONDARY_SERVICE) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_GROUP_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_GROUP_TYPE, resp_buf,
                                            resp_len);
    }

    uint8_t list_buf[SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT];
    uint16_t list_len = 0U;
    uint8_t elem_len = 0U;
    const uint16_t max_list_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 2U);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = &gatt->table[i];
        if (!gatt_attr_in_range(attr, start_h, end_h) || attr->uuid16 != group_uuid) {
            continue;
        }

        uint8_t svc_val[SYN_BLE_GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN];
        uint16_t svc_val_len = 0U;
        if (gatt_read_attr_val(gatt, conn_handle, attr, svc_val, (uint16_t)sizeof(svc_val),
                               &svc_val_len) != SYN_OK ||
            (svc_val_len != 2U && svc_val_len != 16U)) {
            continue;
        }

        uint8_t cur_elem_len = (uint8_t)(4U + svc_val_len);
        if (elem_len == 0U) {
            elem_len = cur_elem_len;
        } else if (cur_elem_len != elem_len) {
            break;
        }

        if ((uint16_t)(list_len + (uint16_t)cur_elem_len) > max_list_len) {
            break;
        }

        uint16_t grp_end = gatt_service_end_handle(gatt, i);
        gatt_put_le16(&list_buf[list_len], attr->handle);
        gatt_put_le16(&list_buf[list_len + 2U], grp_end);
        memcpy(&list_buf[list_len + 4U], svc_val, svc_val_len);
        list_len = (uint16_t)(list_len + (uint16_t)cur_elem_len);
    }

    if (list_len == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_GROUP_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    return syn_ble_att_encode_read_by_group_rsp(elem_len, list_buf, list_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
}

static bool gatt_extract_char_decl(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle, uint16_t idx,
                                   uint8_t decl_val[5])
{
    const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = &gatt->table[idx];
    if (attr->uuid16 != SYN_BLE_UUID_CHARACTERISTIC) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t tmp_val[SYN_BLE_GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN];
    uint16_t vlen = 0U;
    if (gatt_read_attr_val(gatt, conn_handle, attr, tmp_val, (uint16_t)sizeof(tmp_val), &vlen) ==
            SYN_OK &&
        vlen == 5U) {
        if (gatt_get_le16(&tmp_val[1]) <= attr->handle) {
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(decl_val, tmp_val, 5U);
        return true;
    }

    if ((uint16_t)(idx + 1U) < gatt->table_len) {
        const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *val_attr = &gatt->table[idx + 1U];
        if (val_attr->handle <= attr->handle) {
            return false;
        }
        decl_val[0] = val_attr->permissions;
        gatt_put_le16(&decl_val[1], val_attr->handle);
        gatt_put_le16(&decl_val[3], val_attr->uuid16);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static SYN_Status gatt_read_char_decls(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle, uint16_t start_h,
                                       uint16_t end_h, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t list_buf[SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT];
    uint16_t list_len = 0U;
    const uint16_t max_list_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 2U);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = &gatt->table[i];
        uint8_t decl_val[5];
        if (!gatt_attr_in_range(attr, start_h, end_h) ||
            !gatt_extract_char_decl(gatt, conn_handle, i, decl_val)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ((uint16_t)(list_len + 7U) > max_list_len) {
            break;
        }
        gatt_put_le16(&list_buf[list_len], attr->handle);
        memcpy(&list_buf[list_len + 2U], decl_val, 5U);
        list_len = (uint16_t)(list_len + 7U);
    }

    if (list_len == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    return syn_ble_att_encode_read_by_type_rsp(7U, list_buf, list_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
}

static SYN_Status gatt_handle_read_by_type(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                           const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len,
                                           uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint16_t start_h = 0U;
    uint16_t end_h = 0U;
    if (!gatt_validate_range(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ, att_pdu, pdu_len, 7U, true, &start_h,
                             &end_h, resp_buf, resp_len)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (pdu_len == 21U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    uint16_t type_uuid = gatt_get_le16(&att_pdu[5]);
    if (type_uuid == SYN_BLE_UUID_CHARACTERISTIC) {
        return gatt_read_char_decls(gatt, conn_handle, start_h, end_h, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }

    uint8_t list_buf[SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT];
    uint16_t list_len = 0U;
    uint8_t pair_len = 0U;
    const uint16_t max_list_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 2U);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < gatt->table_len; i++) {
        const SYN_BLE_GATT_Attr *attr = &gatt->table[i];
        if (!gatt_attr_in_range(attr, start_h, end_h) || attr->uuid16 != type_uuid) {
            continue;
        }
        if ((attr->permissions & SYN_BLE_PROP_READ) == 0U) {
            if (list_len == 0U) {
                return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ, attr->handle,
                                                    SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_READ_NOT_PERMITTED, resp_buf,
                                                    resp_len);
            }
            break;
        }

        uint8_t val[SYN_BLE_GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN];
        uint16_t val_len = 0U;
        if (gatt_read_attr_val(gatt, conn_handle, attr, val, (uint16_t)sizeof(val), &val_len) !=
                SYN_OK ||
            val_len == 0U) {
            continue;
        }
        if (val_len > (uint16_t)(max_list_len - 2U)) {
            val_len = (uint16_t)(max_list_len - 2U);
        }

        uint8_t cur_pair_len = (uint8_t)(2U + val_len);
        if (pair_len == 0U) {
            pair_len = cur_pair_len;
        } else if (cur_pair_len != pair_len) {
            break;
        }
        if ((uint16_t)(list_len + (uint16_t)cur_pair_len) > max_list_len) {
            break;
        }

        gatt_put_le16(&list_buf[list_len], attr->handle);
        memcpy(&list_buf[list_len + 2U], val, val_len);
        list_len = (uint16_t)(list_len + (uint16_t)cur_pair_len);
    }

    if (list_len == 0U) {
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ, start_h,
                                            SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_ATTR_NOT_FOUND, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
    return syn_ble_att_encode_read_by_type_rsp(pair_len, list_buf, list_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_gatt_process_att_pdu(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                        const uint8_t *att_pdu, uint16_t pdu_len, uint8_t *resp_buf,
                                        uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    if (gatt == NULL || att_pdu == NULL || resp_buf == NULL || resp_len == NULL || pdu_len < 1U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t opcode = att_pdu[0];
    switch (opcode) {
    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_EXCHANGE_MTU_REQ:
        if (pdu_len != 3U) {
            return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(opcode, 0x0000U, SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_INVALID_PDU,
                                                resp_buf, resp_len);
        }
        return syn_ble_att_encode_mtu_rsp(SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_FIND_INFO_REQ:
        return gatt_handle_find_info(gatt, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_TYPE_REQ:
        return gatt_handle_read_by_type(gatt, conn_handle, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_REQ:
        return gatt_handle_read_req(gatt, conn_handle, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_READ_BY_GROUP_TYPE_REQ:
        return gatt_handle_read_by_group(gatt, conn_handle, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_REQ:
        return gatt_handle_write_req(gatt, conn_handle, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_buf, resp_len);

    case SYN_BLE_ATT_OP_WRITE_CMD:
        return gatt_handle_write_cmd(gatt, conn_handle, att_pdu, pdu_len, resp_len);

    default:
        if (((opcode & 0x01U) != 0U) || ((opcode & 0x40U) != 0U) || (opcode == 0x1EU)) {
            *resp_len = 0U;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        return syn_ble_att_encode_error_rsp(opcode, 0x0000U, SYN_BLE_ATT_ERR_REQ_NOT_SUPPORTED,
                                            resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_gatt_notify(SYN_BLE_GATT *gatt, uint16_t conn_handle, uint16_t attr_handle,
                               const uint8_t *val, uint16_t val_len, uint8_t *tx_buf,
                               uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (gatt == NULL || tx_buf == NULL || tx_len == NULL ||
        val_len > (SYN_BLE_ATT_MTU_DEFAULT - 3U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t att_pdu[SYN_BLE_L2CAP_BUF_SIZE];
    uint16_t att_len = 0;
    SYN_Status st = syn_ble_att_encode_notification(attr_handle, val, val_len, att_pdu, &att_len);
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }

    return syn_ble_l2cap_encode_pdu(conn_handle, SYN_BLE_L2CAP_CID_ATT, att_pdu, att_len, tx_buf,
                                    tx_len);
}

#include "syn_ble_hci.h"

#include <string.h>

#define SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE 0U    
#define SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_HDR 1U     
#define SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_PAYLOAD 2U 

SYN_Status syn_ble_hci_init(SYN_BLE_HCI *hci, const SYN_BLE_HCI_Config *cfg)
{
    if (hci == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(hci, 0, sizeof(*hci));
    if (cfg != NULL) {
        hci->cfg = *cfg;
    }
    hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_hci_encode_command(uint16_t opcode, const uint8_t *params, uint8_t param_len,
                                      uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (tx_buf == NULL || tx_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (params == NULL && param_len > 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    tx_buf[0] = SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_CMD;
    tx_buf[1] = (uint8_t)(opcode & 0xFFU);
    tx_buf[2] = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx_buf[3] = param_len;

    if (param_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(&tx_buf[4], params, param_len);
    }

    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(4U + param_len);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_hci_encode_acl(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t pb_flags, uint8_t bc_flags,
                                  const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len, uint8_t *tx_buf,
                                  uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (tx_buf == NULL || tx_len == NULL || data == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t handle_flags = (uint16_t)((conn_handle & 0x0FFFU) | ((pb_flags & 0x03U) << 12U) |
                                       ((bc_flags & 0x03U) << 14U));

    tx_buf[0] = SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_ACL;
    tx_buf[1] = (uint8_t)(handle_flags & 0xFFU);
    tx_buf[2] = (uint8_t)((handle_flags >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx_buf[3] = (uint8_t)(len & 0xFFU);
    tx_buf[4] = (uint8_t)((len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);

    memcpy(&tx_buf[5], data, len);
    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(5U + len);
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void parse_and_dispatch(SYN_BLE_HCI *hci)
{
    if (hci->rx_pkt_type == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_EVT) {
        uint8_t evt_code = hci->rx_buf[0];
        uint8_t param_len = hci->rx_buf[1];
        const uint8_t *payload = &hci->rx_buf[2];

        if (evt_code == SYN_BLE_HCI_EVT_CMD_COMPLETE && param_len >= 3U) {
            hci->last_cmd_opcode = (uint16_t)(payload[1] | (payload[2] << 8U));
            hci->last_cmd_status = (param_len >= 4U) ? payload[3] : 0U;
            hci->cmd_pending = false;
        } else if (evt_code == SYN_BLE_HCI_EVT_CMD_STATUS && param_len >= 4U) {
            hci->last_cmd_status = payload[0];
            hci->last_cmd_opcode = (uint16_t)(payload[2] | (payload[3] << 8U));
            hci->cmd_pending = false;
        }

        if (hci->cfg.evt_cb != NULL) {
            hci->cfg.evt_cb(hci, evt_code, payload, param_len, hci->cfg.user_data);
        }
    } else if (hci->rx_pkt_type == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_ACL) {
        uint16_t handle_flags = (uint16_t)(hci->rx_buf[0] | (hci->rx_buf[1] << 8U));
        uint16_t conn_handle = handle_flags & 0x0FFFU;
        uint8_t pb_bc_flags = (uint8_t)((handle_flags >> 12U) & 0x0FU);
        uint16_t data_len = (uint16_t)(hci->rx_buf[2] | (hci->rx_buf[3] << 8U));
        const uint8_t *data = &hci->rx_buf[4];

        if (hci->cfg.acl_cb != NULL) {
            hci->cfg.acl_cb(hci, conn_handle, pb_bc_flags, data, data_len, hci->cfg.user_data);
        }
    }
}

static SYN_Status hci_rx_hdr_byte(SYN_BLE_HCI *hci, uint8_t byte)
{
    if (hci->rx_idx >= sizeof(hci->rx_buf)) {
        hci->rx_idx = 0U;
        hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    hci->rx_buf[hci->rx_idx++] = byte;
    if (hci->rx_idx < hci->rx_target_len) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    uint32_t payload_len = 0U;
    if (hci->rx_pkt_type == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_EVT) {
        payload_len = (uint32_t)hci->rx_buf[1];
    } else {
        uint16_t data_len =
            (uint16_t)((uint16_t)hci->rx_buf[2] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)hci->rx_buf[3] << 8U));
        payload_len = (uint32_t)data_len;
    }

    uint32_t total_len = (uint32_t)hci->rx_target_len + payload_len;
    if (total_len > (uint32_t)sizeof(hci->rx_buf)) {
        hci->rx_idx = 0U;
        hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    hci->rx_target_len = (uint16_t)total_len;
    if (hci->rx_idx >= hci->rx_target_len) {
        parse_and_dispatch(hci);
        hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
    } else {
        hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_PAYLOAD;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_hci_rx_byte(SYN_BLE_HCI *hci, uint8_t byte)
{
    if (hci == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    switch (hci->rx_state) {
    case SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE:
        if (byte == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_EVT || byte == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_ACL) {
            hci->rx_pkt_type = byte;
            hci->rx_idx = 0U;
            hci->rx_target_len = (byte == SYN_BLE_HCI_PKT_EVT) ? 2U : 4U;
            hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_HDR;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_HDR:
        return hci_rx_hdr_byte(hci, byte);

    case SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_PAYLOAD:
        if (hci->rx_idx < sizeof(hci->rx_buf)) {
            hci->rx_buf[hci->rx_idx++] = byte;
            if (hci->rx_idx >= hci->rx_target_len) {
                parse_and_dispatch(hci);
                hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
            }
        } else {
            hci->rx_idx = 0U;
            hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        break;

    default:
        hci->rx_idx = 0U;
        hci->rx_state = SYN_BLE_HCI_RX_STATE_TYPE;
        break;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_hci_rx_buf(SYN_BLE_HCI *hci, const uint8_t *buf, uint16_t len)
{
    if (hci == NULL || (buf == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        SYN_Status st = syn_ble_hci_rx_byte(hci, buf[i]);
        if (st != SYN_OK) {
            return st;
        }
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

#include "syn_ble_l2cap.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_ble_l2cap_init(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, SYN_BLE_L2CAP_RxCb rx_cb, void *user_data)
{
    if (l2cap == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(l2cap, 0, sizeof(*l2cap));
    l2cap->rx_cb = rx_cb;
    l2cap->user_data = user_data;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_l2cap_connect(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, uint16_t conn_handle)
{
    if (l2cap == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
        if (l2cap->conns[i].active && l2cap->conns[i].conn_handle == conn_handle) {
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
        if (!l2cap->conns[i].active) {
            memset(&l2cap->conns[i], 0, sizeof(l2cap->conns[i]));
            l2cap->conns[i].conn_handle = conn_handle;
            l2cap->conns[i].active = true;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_l2cap_disconnect(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, uint16_t conn_handle)
{
    if (l2cap == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
        if (l2cap->conns[i].active && l2cap->conns[i].conn_handle == conn_handle) {
            memset(&l2cap->conns[i], 0, sizeof(l2cap->conns[i]));
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_BLE_L2CAP_Connection *l2cap_find_conn(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, uint16_t conn_handle)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
        if (l2cap->conns[i].active && (l2cap->conns[i].conn_handle == conn_handle)) {
            return &l2cap->conns[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static SYN_BLE_L2CAP_Connection *l2cap_alloc_conn(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, uint16_t conn_handle)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_BLE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
        if (!l2cap->conns[i].active) {
            memset(&l2cap->conns[i], 0, sizeof(l2cap->conns[i]));
            l2cap->conns[i].conn_handle = conn_handle;
            l2cap->conns[i].active = true;
            return &l2cap->conns[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static SYN_Status l2cap_process_cont(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, SYN_BLE_L2CAP_Connection *conn,
                                     const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    if ((conn == NULL) || !conn->reassembling) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (((uint32_t)conn->rx_len + (uint32_t)len) > (uint32_t)conn->expected_len) {
        conn->reassembling = false;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    memcpy(&conn->rx_buf[conn->rx_len], data, len);
    conn->rx_len = (uint16_t)(conn->rx_len + len);

    if (conn->rx_len == conn->expected_len) {
        conn->reassembling = false;
        if (l2cap->rx_cb != NULL) {
            l2cap->rx_cb(l2cap, conn->conn_handle, conn->cid, conn->rx_buf, conn->expected_len,
                         l2cap->user_data);
        }
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ble_l2cap_process_acl(SYN_BLE_L2CAP *l2cap, uint16_t conn_handle,
                                     uint8_t pb_bc_flags, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    if ((l2cap == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_BLE_L2CAP_Connection *conn = l2cap_find_conn(l2cap, conn_handle);
    uint8_t pb_flags = pb_bc_flags & 0x03U;

    if (pb_flags == 0x01U) {
        return l2cap_process_cont(l2cap, conn, data, len);
    }

    if (((pb_flags != 0x02U) && (pb_flags != 0x00U)) || (len < 4U)) {
        if (conn != NULL) {
            conn->reassembling = false;
        }
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    bool newly_allocated = false;
    if (conn == NULL) {
        conn = l2cap_alloc_conn(l2cap, conn_handle);
        if (conn == NULL) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        newly_allocated = true;
    }

    uint16_t pdu_len = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)data[0] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)data[1] << 8U));
    uint16_t cid = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)data[2] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)data[3] << 8U));
    const uint8_t *pdu_payload = &data[4];
    uint16_t payload_len = (uint16_t)(len - 4U);

    if (((size_t)pdu_len > sizeof(conn->rx_buf)) || (payload_len > pdu_len)) {
        if (newly_allocated) {
            conn->active = false;
        } else {
            conn->reassembling = false;
        }
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (payload_len == pdu_len) {
        conn->reassembling = false;
        if (l2cap->rx_cb != NULL) {
            l2cap->rx_cb(l2cap, conn_handle, cid, pdu_payload, pdu_len, l2cap->user_data);
        }
    } else {
        memcpy(conn->rx_buf, pdu_payload, payload_len);
        conn->rx_len = payload_len;
        conn->expected_len = pdu_len;
        conn->cid = cid;
        conn->reassembling = true;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

#define L2CAP_MAX_TX_PDU                                                                        \
    (((SYN_BLE_HCI_TX_BUF_SIZE - 5U) < SYN_BLE_L2CAP_BUF_SIZE) ? (SYN_BLE_HCI_TX_BUF_SIZE - 5U) \
                                                               : SYN_BLE_L2CAP_BUF_SIZE)

SYN_Status syn_ble_l2cap_encode_pdu(uint16_t conn_handle, uint16_t cid, const uint8_t *payload,
                                    uint16_t len, uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (tx_buf == NULL || tx_len == NULL || (payload == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t l2cap_hdr[4];
    l2cap_hdr[0] = (uint8_t)(len & 0xFFU);
    l2cap_hdr[1] = (uint8_t)((len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    l2cap_hdr[2] = (uint8_t)(cid & 0xFFU);
    l2cap_hdr[3] = (uint8_t)((cid >> 8U) & 0xFFU);

    uint8_t l2cap_pdu[SYN_BLE_L2CAP_BUF_SIZE];
    if ((uint32_t)len + 4U > (uint32_t)L2CAP_MAX_TX_PDU) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    memcpy(&l2cap_pdu[0], l2cap_hdr, 4);
    if (len > 0U) {
        memcpy(&l2cap_pdu[4], payload, len);
    }

    return syn_ble_hci_encode_acl(conn_handle, 0x00U, 0x00U, l2cap_pdu, (uint16_t)(len + 4U),
                                  tx_buf, tx_len);
}

static void cli_puts(const SYN_CLI *cli, const char *str)
{
    (void)cli;
    if (str == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    size_t len = strlen(str);
    if (len > 0U) {
        syn_port_serial_write((const uint8_t *)str, len);
    }
}

static int cli_tokenize(char *line, char *argv[], int max_args)
{
    int argc = 0;
    char *p = line;

    while (*p && argc < max_args) {
        /* Skip whitespace */
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') {
            p++;
        }
        if (*p == '\0') {
            break;
        }

        /* Handle quoted string */
        if (*p == '"') {
            p++; /* skip opening quote */
            argv[argc++] = p;
            while (*p && *p != '"') {
                p++;
            }
            if (*p == '"') {
                *p++ = '\0';
            }
        } else {
            argv[argc++] = p;
            while (*p && *p != ' ' && *p != '\t') {
                p++;
            }
            if (*p) {
                *p++ = '\0';
            }
        }
    }

    return argc;
}

static void cli_print_help(const SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    cli_puts(cli, "Available commands:\r\n");
    cli_puts(cli, "  help           -- Show this help\r\n");
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_VERSION
    cli_puts(cli, "  version        -- Show build info\r\n");
#endif
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_UPTIME
    cli_puts(cli, "  uptime         -- Show system uptime\r\n");
#endif
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_ERRORS
    if (s_cli_errlog != NULL) {
        cli_puts(cli, "  errors         -- Dump error log\r\n");
    }
#endif
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_TASKS
    if (s_cli_sched != NULL) {
        cli_puts(cli, "  tasks          -- Show scheduler tasks\r\n");
    }
#endif

    if (cli->commands == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < cli->command_count; i++) {
        if (cli->commands[i].name == NULL) {
            continue;
        }
        cli_puts(cli, "  ");
        cli_puts(cli, cli->commands[i].name);
        if (cli->commands[i].help != NULL) {
            /* Pad to align with built-in entries (15 chars for name) */
            size_t name_len = strlen(cli->commands[i].name);
            for (size_t p = name_len; p < 15U; p++) {
                cli_putchar(cli, ' ');
            }
            cli_puts(cli, "-- ");
            cli_puts(cli, cli->commands[i].help);
        }
        cli_puts(cli, "\r\n");
    }
}

static bool cli_exec_user_command(SYN_CLI *cli, int argc, char *argv[])
{
    if (cli->commands == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < cli->command_count; i++) {
        if (cli->commands[i].name == NULL) {
            continue;
        }
        if (strcmp(argv[0], cli->commands[i].name) == 0) {
            if (cli->commands[i].handler != NULL) {
                int ret = cli->commands[i].handler(argc, argv);
                if (ret != 0) {
                    char buf[32];
                    const char *parts[] = {"Error: ", NULL, "\r\n"};
                    char num[12];
                    syn_fmt_int(num, sizeof(num), ret);
                    parts[1] = num;
                    syn_fmt_concat(buf, sizeof(buf), parts, 3);
                    cli_puts(cli, buf);
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static void cli_dispatch(SYN_CLI *cli, char *line)
{
    char *argv[SYN_CLI_MAX_ARGS];
    int argc = cli_tokenize(line, argv, SYN_CLI_MAX_ARGS);

    if (argc == 0) {
        return; /* empty line */
    }

    /* Built-in: help */
    if (strcmp(argv[0], "help") == 0 || strcmp(argv[0], "?") == 0) {
        cli_print_help(cli);
        return;
    }

    /* Built-in: version */
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_VERSION
    if (strcmp(argv[0], "version") == 0) {
        cli_builtin_version(cli);
        return;
    }
#endif

    /* Built-in: uptime */
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_UPTIME
    if (strcmp(argv[0], "uptime") == 0) {
        cli_builtin_uptime(cli);
        return;
    }
#endif

    /* Built-in: errors */
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_ERRORS
    if (strcmp(argv[0], "errors") == 0) {
        cli_builtin_errors(cli);
        return;
    }
#endif

    /* Built-in: tasks */
#if SYN_CLI_CMD_TASKS
    if (strcmp(argv[0], "tasks") == 0) {
        cli_builtin_tasks(cli);
        return;
    }
#endif

    if (cli_exec_user_command(cli, argc, argv)) {
        return;
    }

    /* Command not found */
    cli_puts(cli, "Unknown command: ");
    cli_puts(cli, argv[0]);
    cli_puts(cli, "\r\nType 'help' for a list of commands.\r\n");
}

#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
static void cli_history_push(SYN_CLI *cli, const char *line)
{
    const char *p = line;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') {
        p++;
    }
    if (*p == '\0') {
        cli->history_read = 0U;
        return;
    }

    /* Don't store duplicates of the last entry */
    if (cli->history_count > 0U) {
        size_t last = (cli->history_write + SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH - 1U) % SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH;
        if (strcmp(cli->history[last], line) == 0) {
            cli->history_read = 0U;
            return;
        }
    }

    strncpy(cli->history[cli->history_write], line, SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U);
    cli->history[cli->history_write][SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U] = '\0';

    cli->history_write = (cli->history_write + 1U) % SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH;
    if (cli->history_count < SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH) {
        cli->history_count++;
    }
    cli->history_read = 0U;
}
#endif

static bool cli_filter_escape(SYN_CLI *cli, char *ch)
{
    if (cli->escape_state == 1U) {
        cli->escape_state = (*ch == '[') ? 2U : 0U;
        return true;
    }
    if (cli->escape_state == 2U) {
        cli->escape_state = 0U;
        if (*ch == 'A') {
            *ch = 0x10; /* Map Up arrow to Ctrl-P */
            return false;
        }
        return true; /* Ignore other escape sequences */
    }
    if (*ch == 0x1B) {
        cli->escape_state = 1U;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static void cli_erase_line(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    while (cli->line_pos > 0U) {
        cli->line_pos--;
        if (cli->echo) {
            cli_puts(cli, "\b \b");
        }
    }
}

static void cli_backspace(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (cli->line_pos > 0U) {
        cli->line_pos--;
        if (cli->echo) {
            cli_puts(cli, "\b \b");
        }
    }
}

#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
static void cli_recall_history(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (cli->history_count == 0U) {
        return;
    }
    cli_erase_line(cli);
    if (cli->history_read < cli->history_count) {
        cli->history_read++;
    }
    size_t idx =
        (cli->history_write + SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH - cli->history_read) % SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH;
    strncpy(cli->line_buf, cli->history[idx], SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U);
    cli->line_buf[SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U] = '\0';
    cli->line_pos = strlen(cli->line_buf);
    if (cli->echo) {
        cli_puts(cli, cli->line_buf);
    }
}
#endif

static void cli_append_char(SYN_CLI *cli, char ch)
{
    if ((unsigned char)ch < 0x20U && ch != '\t') {
        return;
    }
    if (ch == '\t') {
        ch = ' ';
    }
    if (cli->line_pos < SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U) {
        cli->line_buf[cli->line_pos++] = ch;
        if (cli->echo) {
            cli_putchar(cli, ch);
        }
    }
}

/* ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_cli_init(SYN_CLI *cli, const SYN_CLI_Command *commands, size_t cmd_count,
                  const char *prompt)
{
    if (cli == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memset(cli, 0, sizeof(*cli));
    cli->commands = commands;
    cli->command_count = (commands != NULL) ? cmd_count : 0U;
    cli->prompt = (prompt != NULL) ? prompt : "> ";
    cli->echo = true;
    cli->line_pos = 0U;
}

void syn_cli_set_echo(SYN_CLI *cli, bool echo)
{
    if (cli == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    cli->echo = echo;
}

static void cli_execute_line(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (cli->echo) {
        cli_puts(cli, "\r\n");
    }

    cli->line_buf[cli->line_pos] = '\0';

#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
    cli_history_push(cli, cli->line_buf);
#endif

    cli->prompt_visible = false;
    cli->line_pos = 0U;

    cli_dispatch(cli, cli->line_buf);

    syn_cli_print_prompt(cli);
}

void syn_cli_process_char(SYN_CLI *cli, char ch)
{
    if (cli == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (cli->last_was_cr) {
        cli->last_was_cr = false;
        if (ch == '\n') {
            return;
        }
    }

    if (cli_filter_escape(cli, &ch)) {
        return;
    }

    /* Newline — execute */
    if (ch == '\r' || ch == '\n') {
        cli->last_was_cr = (ch == '\r');
        cli_execute_line(cli);
        return;
    }

    /* Backspace / DEL */
    if (ch == '\b' || ch == 0x7F) {
        cli_backspace(cli);
        return;
    }

    /* Ctrl-C — cancel current line */
    if (ch == 0x03) {
        if (cli->echo) {
            cli_puts(cli, "^C\r\n");
        }
        cli->line_pos = 0U;
#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
        cli->history_read = 0U;
#endif
        syn_cli_print_prompt(cli);
        return;
    }

    /* Ctrl-U — clear line */
    if (ch == 0x15) {
        cli_erase_line(cli);
        return;
    }

#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
    /* Up arrow / Ctrl-P — previous history */
    if (ch == 0x10) {
        cli_recall_history(cli);
        return;
    }
#endif

    cli_append_char(cli, ch);
}

void syn_cli_process_line(SYN_CLI *cli, const char *line)
{
    if (cli == NULL || line == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    /* Copy into the line buffer so we can tokenize in-place */
    strncpy(cli->line_buf, line, SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U);
    cli->line_buf[SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE - 1U] = '\0';
    cli->line_pos = 0U;

#if SYN_CLI_HISTORY_DEPTH > 0
    cli_history_push(cli, cli->line_buf);
#endif

    cli_dispatch(cli, cli->line_buf);
}

void syn_cli_print_prompt(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (cli == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    cli_puts(cli, cli->prompt);
    if (cli->line_pos > 0U) {
        cli->line_buf[cli->line_pos] = '\0';
        cli_puts(cli, cli->line_buf);
    }
    cli->prompt_visible = true;
}

void syn_cli_refresh_prompt(SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    syn_cli_print_prompt(cli);
}

#if !defined(SYN_CLI_USE_PRINTF) || SYN_CLI_USE_PRINTF
void syn_cli_printf(SYN_CLI *cli, const char *fmt, ...)
{
    if (cli == NULL || fmt == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    bool was_prompt_visible = cli->prompt_visible;
    if (was_prompt_visible) {
        /* Clear prompt & active draft line once before outputting text */
        cli_puts(cli, "\r\033[K");
        cli->prompt_visible = false;
    }

    char buf[SYN_CLI_LINE_BUF_SIZE];
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, args);
    va_end(args);

    if (n > 0) {
        buf[sizeof(buf) - 1U] = '\0';
        cli_puts(cli, buf);
    }

    if (was_prompt_visible) {
        /* Redraw prompt & draft text after outputting text */
        syn_cli_print_prompt(cli);
    }
}
#endif

static void cli_builtin_version(const SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    char num[12];
    const SYN_Version *v = syn_version();

    cli_puts(cli, v->app_name);
    cli_puts(cli, " v");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), v->year);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, ".");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), v->month);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, ".");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), v->release);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, " (");
    cli_puts(cli, v->date);
    cli_puts(cli, " ");
    cli_puts(cli, v->time);
    cli_puts(cli, ") git:");
    cli_puts(cli, v->git_hash);
    cli_puts(cli, "\r\n");
}

#if SYN_CLI_CMD_UPTIME
static void cli_builtin_uptime(const SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    char num[12];
    uint32_t ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t secs = ms / 1000;
    uint32_t mins = secs / 60;
    uint32_t hours = mins / 60;
    uint32_t days = hours / 24;

    cli_puts(cli, "Uptime: ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), days);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, "d ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), hours % 24);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, "h ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), mins % 60);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, "m ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), secs % 60);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, "s (");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), ms);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, "ms)\r\n");
}
#endif

#if SYN_CLI_CMD_ERRORS
static void cli_builtin_errors(const SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (s_cli_errlog == NULL) {
        cli_puts(cli, "No error log configured. Call syn_cli_set_errlog().\r\n");
        return;
    }

    char num[12];
    size_t avail = syn_errlog_available(s_cli_errlog);

    cli_puts(cli, "Error log: ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), (uint32_t)syn_errlog_count(s_cli_errlog));
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, " total, ");
    syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), (uint32_t)avail);
    cli_puts(cli, num);
    cli_puts(cli, " stored\r\n");

    if (avail == 0)
        return;

    static const char *const sev_names[] = {"INFO", "WARN", "ERR ", "FATL"};

    SYN_ErrEntry e;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < avail; i++) {
        if (!syn_errlog_read(s_cli_errlog, i, &e))
            continue; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Unreachable guard; loop bound avail is returned by
                         syn_errlog_count */

        cli_puts(cli, "  [");
        syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), e.timestamp);
        cli_puts(cli, num);
        cli_puts(cli, "] ");

        const char *sn = (e.severity <= SYN_ERR_FATAL) ? sev_names[e.severity] : "????";
        cli_puts(cli, sn);

        cli_puts(cli, " code=0x");
        syn_fmt_hex(num, sizeof(num), e.code, 4);
        cli_puts(cli, num);

        cli_puts(cli, " ctx=");
        syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), e.context);
        cli_puts(cli, num);

        cli_puts(cli, " boot=");
        syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), e.boot_count);
        cli_puts(cli, num);

        cli_puts(cli, "\r\n");
    }
}
#endif

#if SYN_CLI_CMD_TASKS
static void cli_builtin_tasks(const SYN_CLI *cli)
{
    if (s_cli_sched == NULL) {
        cli_puts(cli, "No scheduler configured. Call syn_cli_set_scheduler().\r\n");
        return;
    }

    char num[12];
    cli_puts(cli, "Tasks:\r\n");

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s_cli_sched->task_count; i++) {
        const SYN_Task *t = &s_cli_sched->tasks[i];
        cli_puts(cli, "  ");
        cli_puts(cli, t->name ? t->name : "(unnamed)");
        cli_puts(cli, "  prio=");
        syn_fmt_uint(num, sizeof(num), t->priority);
        cli_puts(cli, num);

        static const char *const state_names[] = {"  READY", "  SUSPENDED", "  DEAD", "  BLOCKED"};
        const char *sn = (t->state <= (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) ? state_names[t->state] : "  ???";
        cli_puts(cli, sn);
        cli_puts(cli, "\r\n");
    }
}
#endif

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides a lightweight interactive shell over UART (or any byte stream). Commands are registered as a static table — no dynamic allocation. Input is processed one character at a time, making it easy to feed from a UART ISR or polled loop.

** **

  • Statically-registered command table (name + help + handler)
  • Automatic argc/argv parsing (whitespace-delimited, with quoted strings)
  • Built-in help command
  • Backspace and line editing
  • Configurable prompt
  • Echo control (for terminals that don't echo locally)
  • Command history (optional, configurable depth)

** **

// Define commands
static int cmd_led(int argc, char *argv[]);
static int cmd_reset(int argc, char *argv[]);

static const SYN_CLI_Command commands[] = {
    { "led",   "led <on|off>  — Control the LED",  cmd_led   },
    { "reset", "reset         — System reset",     cmd_reset },
};

// Initialize
static SYN_CLI cli;
syn_cli_init(&cli, commands, 2, "> ");

// In main loop or UART RX ISR:
syn_cli_process_char(&cli, received_byte);

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides acquire/release semantics for lock-free data structures that are shared between CPU cores (AMP multicore) or between ISR and main context.

** **

When SYN_USE_MULTICORE is off (the default), the acquire/release functions compile to plain volatile reads and writes — identical to what the code would do without barriers. Zero overhead.

When SYN_USE_MULTICORE is on, the functions insert hardware memory barriers (via syn_port_memory_barrier()) at the correct points to ensure cross-core visibility.

** **

  • STORE_RELEASE: All prior writes are visible before this store. Use after writing data, before publishing the index.
  • LOAD_ACQUIRE: No subsequent reads can be reordered before this load. Use after reading an index, before accessing the data it guards.

** **

// Producer (core 0):
buf[head] = data;
SYN_STORE_RELEASE(&rb->head, next_head);

// Consumer (core 1):
size_t h = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&rb->head);
if (h != tail) {
    x = buf[tail];  // guaranteed to see data written before head
}

#ifndef SYN_BARRIER_H
#define SYN_BARRIER_H

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#include "syn_compiler.h"
#include "syn_defs.h"

#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Hardware memory barrier (port function) ───────────────────────────── */

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE

void syn_port_memory_barrier(void);

#endif /* SYN_USE_MULTICORE */

/* ── Acquire / Release ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE

#if defined(__SANITIZE_THREAD__)
#define SYN_BARRIER_TSAN 1
#elif defined(__has_feature)
#if __has_feature(thread_sanitizer)
#define SYN_BARRIER_TSAN 1
#endif
#endif

static inline void syn_store_release(volatile size_t *ptr, size_t val)
{
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    __atomic_store_n(ptr, val, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
#else
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    *ptr = val;
#endif
}

static inline size_t syn_load_acquire(const volatile size_t *ptr)
{
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    size_t val = __atomic_load_n(ptr, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    return val;
#else
    size_t val = *ptr;
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    return val;
#endif
}

#else /* !SYN_USE_MULTICORE — single-core: volatile is sufficient */

static inline void syn_store_release(volatile size_t *ptr, size_t val)
{
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    *ptr = val;
}

static inline size_t syn_load_acquire(const volatile size_t *ptr)
{
    size_t val = *ptr;
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    return val;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_MULTICORE */

/* ── Convenience macros ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_STORE_RELEASE(ptr, val) syn_store_release((ptr), (val))

#define SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(ptr) syn_load_acquire((ptr))

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SYN_BARRIER_H */

    const SYN_AutoTune_Limits * limits,
    SYN_AutoTune_Flags flags,

Runs probe → FF identification → braking → relay PID tune → braking as a single self-sequencing state machine. The user only provides physical constraints.

Parameters:

  • at Auto-tuner instance.
  • ctrl Motor controller to tune.
  • limits Physical constraints (track limits, max velocity).
  • flags Feature flags (e.g., SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_ALL).
  • gain_multiplier Safety margin for PID gains (percentage, e.g., 80).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, or error code.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")

/* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static int32_t autotune_clamp_i64(int64_t val)
{
    if (val > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    if (val < (int64_t)INT32_MIN) {
        return INT32_MIN;
    }
    return (int32_t)val;
}

static bool autotune_is_relay_phase(const SYN_AutoTune *at)
{
    return (at->cfg.mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_RELAY) ||
           (at->cfg.mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_AUTO && at->ff_phase_done);
}

static void apply_raw_output(SYN_AutoTune *at, int32_t output)
{
    at->current_output = output;
    if (at->ctrl->cfg.motor.set_output != NULL) {
        at->ctrl->cfg.motor.set_output(at->ctrl->cfg.motor.ctx, output);
    }
}

static void emergency_stop(SYN_AutoTune *at, SYN_AutoTune_AbortReason reason)
{
    if (at == NULL)
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    at->current_output = 0;
    syn_motor_ctrl_stop(at->ctrl);
    at->state = SYN_ATUNE_ABORTED;
    at->abort_reason = reason;
}

static int32_t ramp_output(SYN_AutoTune *at, int32_t target, uint32_t elapsed)
{
    uint32_t ramp = at->cfg.ramp_ms;
    if (ramp == 0 || elapsed >= ramp)
        return target;
    return autotune_clamp_i64(((int64_t)target * (int64_t)elapsed) / (int64_t)ramp);
}

static void write_log(SYN_AutoTune *at)
{
    if (at->cfg.datalog == NULL)
        return;

    SYN_AutoTune_LogFrame frame = {.state = (uint8_t)at->state,
                                   .output = (int16_t)at->current_output,
                                   .position = at->ctrl->measured_position,
                                   .velocity = at->ctrl->measured_velocity};

    syn_datalog_write(at->cfg.datalog, SYN_ATUNE_LOG_ID, &frame, sizeof(frame));
}

static bool safety_ok(SYN_AutoTune *at, int32_t pos, int32_t velocity)
{
    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();

    /* Watchdog: update() must be called regularly */
    uint32_t watchdog = at->cfg.watchdog_ms;
    if (watchdog == 0)
        watchdog = at->cfg.limits.watchdog_ms;
    if (watchdog == 0)
        watchdog = 500;

    if (at->last_update_tick > 0) {
        if ((now - at->last_update_tick) > watchdog) {
            emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_WATCHDOG);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /* Track limits */
    if (at->cfg.limits.position_min != 0 || at->cfg.limits.position_max != 0) {
        if (pos < at->cfg.limits.position_min || pos > at->cfg.limits.position_max) {
            emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_POSITION);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /* Velocity limit */
    if (at->cfg.limits.max_velocity > 0) {
        int64_t abs_vel = (velocity < 0) ? -(int64_t)velocity : (int64_t)velocity;
        if (abs_vel > (int64_t)at->cfg.limits.max_velocity) {
            emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_VELOCITY);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /* Respect motor controller soft limits */
    if (at->ctrl->cfg.position_min != 0 || at->ctrl->cfg.position_max != 0) {
        if (pos <= at->ctrl->cfg.position_min || pos >= at->ctrl->cfg.position_max) {
            emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_SOFT_LIMIT);
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_autotune_init(SYN_AutoTune *at, SYN_MotorCtrl *ctrl, const SYN_AutoTune_Config *cfg)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(at != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(ctrl != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(cfg != NULL);

    memset(at, 0, sizeof(*at));
    at->cfg = *cfg;
    at->ctrl = ctrl;

    /* Apply defaults */
    if (at->cfg.settle_ms == 0)
        at->cfg.settle_ms = 2000;
    if (at->cfg.measure_ms == 0)
        at->cfg.measure_ms = 2000;
    if (at->cfg.relay_cycles == 0)
        at->cfg.relay_cycles = 3;
    if (at->cfg.watchdog_ms == 0)
        at->cfg.watchdog_ms = 500;
    if (at->cfg.ramp_ms == 0)
        at->cfg.ramp_ms = 500;
    if (at->cfg.gain_multiplier_pct == 0)
        at->cfg.gain_multiplier_pct = 100;

    /* Snapshot starting position and set default setpoint if 0 */
    at->start_position = ctrl->measured_position;
    if (at->cfg.setpoint == 0) {
        at->cfg.setpoint = at->start_position;
    }
    at->phase_start_tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    at->last_update_tick = at->phase_start_tick;
    at->result.pid_scale =
        (ctrl->cfg.pid_scale == 0U || ctrl->cfg.pid_scale > 20U) ? 8U : ctrl->cfg.pid_scale;
    at->result.ff_scale =
        (ctrl->cfg.ff_scale == 0U || ctrl->cfg.ff_scale > 24U) ? 8U : ctrl->cfg.ff_scale;

    bool skip_ff = (cfg->mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_RELAY) ||
                   (cfg->mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_AUTO &&
                    (cfg->flags & (SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_IDENT_KV | SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_IDENT_KA)) == 0 &&
                    (cfg->flags & SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_TUNE_PID) != 0);
    if (skip_ff) {
        at->result.ff_kv = ctrl->cfg.ff_kv;
        at->result.ff_ka = ctrl->cfg.ff_ka;
        at->ff_phase_done = true;
    }
    if (cfg->mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_FF_IDENT ||
        (cfg->mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_AUTO && (cfg->flags & SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_TUNE_PID) == 0)) {
        at->result.kp = ctrl->cfg.pid_kp;
        at->result.ki = ctrl->cfg.pid_ki;
        at->result.kd = ctrl->cfg.pid_kd;
    }

    /* Stop the motor controller — we're taking over */
    syn_motor_ctrl_stop(ctrl);

    at->ka_p1_captured = false;
    at->ka_p2_captured = false;
    at->history_v = 0;
    at->last_check_tick = 0;

    if (at->cfg.test_output == 0) {
        at->state = SYN_ATUNE_PROBE;
        at->current_output = 5; /* Start probing at 5% */
    } else {
        at->state = SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_UP;
    }

    if (skip_ff) {
        at->above_setpoint = (ctrl->measured_position >= at->cfg.setpoint);
        at->osc_peak_pos = ctrl->measured_position;
        at->osc_peak_neg = ctrl->measured_position;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void autotune_step_measuring_2(SYN_AutoTune *at, int32_t velocity, uint32_t elapsed,
                                      uint32_t now)
{
    apply_raw_output(at, autotune_clamp_i64(2LL * (int64_t)at->cfg.test_output));
    at->velocity_sum += velocity;
    at->velocity_samples++;

    if (elapsed < at->cfg.measure_ms) {
        return;
    }

    if (at->velocity_samples > 0) {
        at->result.steady_velocity_2 = (int32_t)(at->velocity_sum / (int64_t)at->velocity_samples);

        int32_t v1 = at->result.steady_velocity_1;
        int32_t v2 = at->result.steady_velocity_2;
        int64_t dv = (v2 > v1) ? ((int64_t)v2 - (int64_t)v1) : ((int64_t)v1 - (int64_t)v2);
        int64_t dout = (at->cfg.test_output < 0) ? -(int64_t)at->cfg.test_output
                                                 : (int64_t)at->cfg.test_output;
        if (dv > 2 && dout > 0) {
            uint8_t ff_scale = at->ctrl->cfg.ff_scale;
            if (ff_scale == 0U || ff_scale > 24U) {
                ff_scale = 12U;
            }

            while (ff_scale < 24U && ((dout * (1LL << ff_scale)) / dv) < 100LL) {
                ff_scale++;
            }
            at->result.ff_scale = ff_scale;
            at->result.ff_kv = autotune_clamp_i64((dout * (1LL << ff_scale)) / dv);
        }
    }

    if (at->result.ff_kv > 0 && (at->cfg.flags & SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_IDENT_KA) != 0) {
        if (at->ka_t2 > at->ka_t1) {
            int64_t dt_ms = (int64_t)(at->ka_t2 - at->ka_t1);
            int64_t dv = (int64_t)at->ka_v2 - (int64_t)at->ka_v1;
            int64_t accel = (dt_ms > 0) ? ((dv * 1000LL) / dt_ms) : 0LL;
            if (dv > 10 && accel > 0) {
                int64_t v_avg = ((int64_t)at->ka_v1 + (int64_t)at->ka_v2) / 2LL;
                int64_t kv_out = (v_avg * (int64_t)at->result.ff_kv) >> at->result.ff_scale;
                int64_t accel_out =
                    (int64_t)autotune_clamp_i64((int64_t)at->cfg.test_output - kv_out);

                if (accel_out > 0) {
                    at->result.ff_ka =
                        autotune_clamp_i64((accel_out * (1LL << at->result.ff_scale)) / accel);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    at->ff_phase_done = true;
    at->phase_start_tick = now;
    at->start_output = at->current_output;
    if (at->cfg.mode == SYN_ATUNE_MODE_AUTO && (at->cfg.flags & SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_TUNE_PID) != 0) {
        at->state = SYN_ATUNE_BRAKING;
    } else {
        at->state = SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_DOWN;
    }
}

static void autotune_finish_relay(SYN_AutoTune *at, uint32_t now)
{
    at->phase_start_tick = now;
    at->start_output = at->current_output;
    at->state = SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_DOWN;

    uint32_t Tu = (at->period_count > 0) ? (at->period_sum / at->period_count) : 0U;
    if (Tu == 0U) {
        Tu = 1U;
    }
    int32_t avg_amp = (at->amplitude_count > 0) ? at->amplitude_sum / at->amplitude_count : 1;
    int32_t half_amp = avg_amp / 2;
    if (half_amp == 0) {
        half_amp = 1;
    }

    at->result.Tu_ms = Tu;
    uint8_t scale = at->ctrl->cfg.pid_scale;
    if (scale == 0U || scale > 20U) {
        scale = 8U;
    }

    int64_t amp_out =
        (at->cfg.test_output < 0) ? -(int64_t)at->cfg.test_output : (int64_t)at->cfg.test_output;
    int32_t Ku = 0;
    while (scale < 24U) {
        int64_t Ku_num = 4LL * amp_out * 113LL * (1LL << scale);
        int64_t Ku_den = 355LL * (int64_t)half_amp;
        Ku = autotune_clamp_i64(Ku_num / Ku_den);
        if (Ku >= 100 || scale >= 20U) {
            break;
        }
        scale++;
    }
    at->result.pid_scale = scale;
    at->result.Ku = Ku;

    syn_autotune_calc_relay_gains(Ku, Tu, at->cfg.method, at->cfg.gain_multiplier_pct,
                                  &at->result.kp, &at->result.ki, &at->result.kd);
}

static void autotune_step_relay(SYN_AutoTune *at, int32_t pos, uint32_t now)
{
    int64_t hysteresis = 2LL * (int64_t)at->ctrl->cfg.position_deadband;
    if (hysteresis < 10LL) {
        hysteresis = 10LL;
    }

    bool now_above = at->above_setpoint;
    if (at->above_setpoint) {
        if ((int64_t)pos < (int64_t)at->cfg.setpoint - hysteresis) {
            now_above = false;
        }
    } else if ((int64_t)pos > (int64_t)at->cfg.setpoint + hysteresis) {
        now_above = true;
    }

    if (pos > at->osc_peak_pos) {
        at->osc_peak_pos = pos;
    }
    if (pos < at->osc_peak_neg) {
        at->osc_peak_neg = pos;
    }

    if (now_above != at->above_setpoint) {
        at->half_cycles++;

        if (at->half_cycles >= 2) {
            int64_t amp = (int64_t)at->osc_peak_pos - (int64_t)at->osc_peak_neg;
            at->amplitude_sum = autotune_clamp_i64((int64_t)at->amplitude_sum + amp);
            at->amplitude_count++;
        }

        if ((at->half_cycles & 1) == 0 && at->last_cross_tick > 0) {
            at->period_sum += (now - at->last_cross_tick);
            at->period_count++;
        }
        if ((at->half_cycles & 1) == 0) {
            at->last_cross_tick = now;
        }

        at->osc_peak_pos = pos;
        at->osc_peak_neg = pos;
        at->above_setpoint = now_above;
        at->relay_output =
            now_above ? autotune_clamp_i64(-(int64_t)at->cfg.test_output) : at->cfg.test_output;
    }

    apply_raw_output(at, at->relay_output);

    if (at->period_count >= at->cfg.relay_cycles) {
        autotune_finish_relay(at, now);
    }
}

SYN_AutoTune_State syn_autotune_update(SYN_AutoTune *at)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(at != NULL);

    if (at->state == SYN_ATUNE_DONE || at->state == SYN_ATUNE_ABORTED ||
        at->state == SYN_ATUNE_IDLE) {
        return at->state;
    }

    /* Read feedback manually (we bypassed the controller) */
    int32_t pos = at->ctrl->cfg.read_pos(at->ctrl->cfg.read_pos_ctx);
    int64_t delta64 = (int64_t)pos - (int64_t)at->ctrl->last_position;
    int32_t velocity = autotune_clamp_i64(delta64 * (int64_t)at->ctrl->cfg.update_hz);
    at->ctrl->measured_position = pos;
    at->ctrl->measured_velocity = velocity;
    at->ctrl->last_position = pos;

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();

    /* Safety checks first */
    if (!safety_ok(at, pos, velocity)) {
        write_log(at);
        return at->state; /* already aborted inside safety_ok */
    }
    at->last_update_tick = now;

    write_log(at);

    uint32_t elapsed = now - at->phase_start_tick;

    switch (at->state) {
    /* ── Probe for minimum motion output ────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_PROBE: {
        apply_raw_output(at, at->current_output);
        int64_t drift = (int64_t)pos - (int64_t)at->start_position;
        if (drift < 0)
            drift = -drift;

        if (drift > 50) {
            at->cfg.test_output = (at->current_output * 120) / 100;
            at->state = SYN_ATUNE_BRAKING;
            at->phase_start_tick = now;
        } else if (elapsed >= 300) {
            at->current_output += 1;
            at->phase_start_tick = now;
            if (at->current_output > 50) {
                emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_NO_MOTION);
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    /* ── Braking to stop between phases ────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_BRAKING:
        apply_raw_output(at, 0);
        if (velocity == 0 || elapsed >= 2000) {
            at->state = SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_UP;
            at->phase_start_tick = now;
            at->start_position = pos;
            if (autotune_is_relay_phase(at)) {
                at->cfg.setpoint = pos;
                at->above_setpoint = true;
                at->osc_peak_pos = pos;
                at->osc_peak_neg = pos;
            }
        }
        break;

    /* ── Ramp up to test output ────────────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_UP: {
        bool is_relay = autotune_is_relay_phase(at);
        int32_t target = (is_relay && at->above_setpoint)
                             ? autotune_clamp_i64(-(int64_t)at->cfg.test_output)
                             : at->cfg.test_output;
        int32_t out = ramp_output(at, target, elapsed);
        apply_raw_output(at, out);

        if (elapsed >= at->cfg.ramp_ms) {
            at->phase_start_tick = now;
            if (is_relay) {
                at->state = SYN_ATUNE_RELAY;
                at->relay_output = target;
            } else {
                at->state = SYN_ATUNE_SETTLING;
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    /* ── FF ident: settling phase ──────────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_SETTLING:
        apply_raw_output(at, at->cfg.test_output);

        if (!at->ka_p1_captured) {
            at->ka_t1 = now;
            at->ka_v1 = velocity;
            at->ka_p1_captured = true;
        } else if (!at->ka_p2_captured) {
            int64_t dv = (velocity > at->ka_v1) ? ((int64_t)velocity - (int64_t)at->ka_v1)
                                                : ((int64_t)at->ka_v1 - (int64_t)velocity);
            if (dv > 100 || elapsed >= 1000) {
                at->ka_t2 = now;
                at->ka_v2 = velocity;
                at->ka_p2_captured = true;
                at->last_check_tick = now;
                at->history_v = velocity;
            }
        }

        if (at->ka_p2_captured && (now - at->last_check_tick >= 500)) {
            int64_t dv = (velocity > at->history_v) ? ((int64_t)velocity - (int64_t)at->history_v)
                                                    : ((int64_t)at->history_v - (int64_t)velocity);
            at->history_v = velocity;
            at->last_check_tick = now;

            if (dv < 5 || (uint64_t)elapsed >= (uint64_t)at->cfg.settle_ms * 10ULL) {
                at->state = SYN_ATUNE_MEASURING;
                at->phase_start_tick = now;
                at->velocity_sum = 0;
                at->velocity_samples = 0;
                at->last_check_tick = 0;
            }
        }
        break;

    /* ── FF ident: measuring phase 1 ────────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_MEASURING:
        apply_raw_output(at, at->cfg.test_output);
        at->velocity_sum += velocity;
        at->velocity_samples++;

        if (elapsed >= at->cfg.measure_ms) {
            if (at->velocity_samples > 0) {
                at->result.steady_velocity_1 =
                    (int32_t)(at->velocity_sum / (int64_t)at->velocity_samples);
            }

            at->state = SYN_ATUNE_SETTLING_2;
            at->phase_start_tick = now;
            at->velocity_sum = 0;
            at->velocity_samples = 0;
            at->last_check_tick = now;
            at->history_v = velocity;
        }
        break;

    /* ── FF ident: settling phase 2 (2x output) ────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_SETTLING_2:
        apply_raw_output(at, autotune_clamp_i64(2LL * (int64_t)at->cfg.test_output));
        if (elapsed >= 200 && (now - at->last_check_tick >= 500)) {
            int64_t dv = (velocity > at->history_v) ? ((int64_t)velocity - (int64_t)at->history_v)
                                                    : ((int64_t)at->history_v - (int64_t)velocity);
            at->history_v = velocity;
            at->last_check_tick = now;

            if (dv < 5 || (uint64_t)elapsed >= (uint64_t)at->cfg.settle_ms * 10ULL) {
                at->state = SYN_ATUNE_MEASURING_2;
                at->phase_start_tick = now;
            }
        }
        break;

    /* ── FF ident: measuring phase 2 (2x output) ────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_MEASURING_2:
        autotune_step_measuring_2(at, velocity, elapsed, now);
        break;

    /* ── Relay feedback oscillation ────────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_RELAY:
        autotune_step_relay(at, pos, now);
        break;

    /* ── Ramp down to zero ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    case SYN_ATUNE_RAMP_DOWN: {
        uint32_t ramp = at->cfg.ramp_ms;
        if (ramp == 0) {
            apply_raw_output(at, 0);
            syn_motor_ctrl_stop(at->ctrl);
            at->state = SYN_ATUNE_DONE;
            break;
        }

        uint32_t e = (elapsed > ramp) ? ramp : elapsed;
        int32_t out =
            autotune_clamp_i64(((int64_t)at->start_output * (int64_t)(ramp - e)) / (int64_t)ramp);

        if (elapsed >= ramp || (at->start_output > 0 && out <= 0) ||
            (at->start_output < 0 && out >= 0)) {
            apply_raw_output(at, 0);
            syn_motor_ctrl_stop(at->ctrl);
            at->state = SYN_ATUNE_DONE;
        } else {
            apply_raw_output(at, out);
        }
        break;
    }

    default:
        break;
    }

    return at->state;
}

void syn_autotune_apply(SYN_AutoTune *at)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(at != NULL);
    if (at->state != SYN_ATUNE_DONE) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t pid_scale = (at->result.pid_scale < 31U) ? at->result.pid_scale : 30U;
    uint8_t ff_scale = (at->result.ff_scale < 31U) ? at->result.ff_scale : 30U;

    at->ctrl->cfg.pid_kp = at->result.kp;
    at->ctrl->cfg.pid_ki = at->result.ki;
    at->ctrl->cfg.pid_kd = at->result.kd;
    at->ctrl->cfg.pid_scale = pid_scale;
    at->ctrl->cfg.ff_kv = at->result.ff_kv;
    at->ctrl->cfg.ff_ka = at->result.ff_ka;
    at->ctrl->cfg.ff_scale = ff_scale;

    SYN_PID_Config pid_cfg = at->ctrl->pid.cfg;
    pid_cfg.kp = at->result.kp;
    pid_cfg.ki = at->result.ki;
    pid_cfg.kd = at->result.kd;
    pid_cfg.scale = (int32_t)(1ULL << pid_scale);
    pid_cfg.integral_max = 0;
    syn_pid_init(&at->ctrl->pid, &pid_cfg);
}

void syn_autotune_abort(SYN_AutoTune *at)
{
    if (at == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(at != NULL);
    emergency_stop(at, SYN_ATUNE_ABORT_USER);
}

SYN_Status syn_autotune_start(SYN_AutoTune *at, SYN_MotorCtrl *ctrl,
                              const SYN_AutoTune_Limits *limits, SYN_AutoTune_Flags flags,
                              uint16_t gain_multiplier)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(at != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(ctrl != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(limits != NULL);

    SYN_AutoTune_Config cfg = {
        .mode = SYN_ATUNE_MODE_AUTO,
        .flags = flags,
        .test_output = 0, /* Auto-probe */
        .limits = *limits,
        .relay_cycles = 4,
        .method = SYN_ATUNE_TYREUS_LUYBEN,
        .watchdog_ms = limits->watchdog_ms,
        .gain_multiplier_pct = gain_multiplier,
    };

    return syn_autotune_init(at, ctrl, &cfg);
}

void syn_autotune_calc_relay_gains(int32_t Ku, uint32_t Tu_ms, SYN_AutoTune_Method method,
                                   uint16_t multiplier_pct, int32_t *kp, int32_t *ki, int32_t *kd)
{
    if (kp == NULL || ki == NULL || kd == NULL || Tu_ms == 0U) {
        return;
    }

    int64_t ku = (int64_t)Ku;
    int64_t tu = (int64_t)Tu_ms;
    int64_t p = 0;
    int64_t i = 0;
    int64_t d = 0;

    switch (method) {
    case SYN_ATUNE_ZN_CLASSIC:
        p = (ku * 60LL) / 100LL;
        i = (p * 2000LL) / tu;
        d = (p * tu) / 8000LL;
        break;
    case SYN_ATUNE_TYREUS_LUYBEN:
        p = (ku * 10LL) / 22LL;
        i = (p * 10000LL) / (22LL * tu);
        d = (p * tu) / 6300LL;
        break;
    case SYN_ATUNE_ZN_NO_OVERSHOOT:
    default:
        p = (ku * 20LL) / 100LL;
        i = (p * 2000LL) / tu;
        d = (p * tu) / 3000LL;
        break;
    }

    if (multiplier_pct > 0U && multiplier_pct != 100U) {
        p = (p * (int64_t)multiplier_pct) / 100LL;
        i = (i * (int64_t)multiplier_pct) / 100LL;
        d = (d * (int64_t)multiplier_pct) / 100LL;
    }

    *kp = autotune_clamp_i64(p);
    *ki = autotune_clamp_i64(i);
    *kd = autotune_clamp_i64(d);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_AUTOTUNE */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Safety-first design for heavy machinery: * Hard position limit — abort if displacement exceeds configured bound * Velocity limit — cut power if speed exceeds safe threshold * Motor controller soft limits are respected (checked every update) * Watchdog timeout — auto-abort if update() stops being called * Gradual ramp-up (not a step) to avoid jerking heavy loads

Two layers of API:

  • syn_autotune_start() (recommended) — one-call auto-tune. Runs PROBE → FF identification → braking → relay PID tuning → braking automatically. The user only provides track limits.
  • syn_autotune_init() (advanced) — manual mode selection. The caller configures and runs each phase (FF ident, relay) separately.

Both are non-blocking — call syn_autotune_update() from your main loop.

** **

Step 1: Home the encoder. Zero the encoder at one end of the track. The auto-tuner does NOT require zeroing in the middle — it works with any zero convention.

Step 2: Configure the motor controller. Set position_min/max to your safe operating range (in encoder counts). These are the soft limits the auto-tuner will respect. 

SYN_MotorCtrl_Config cfg = SYN_MOTOR_CTRL_DEFAULTS(
    syn_dc_motor_output(&motor), encoder_read, NULL, 1000, 1000
);
cfg.position_min  = 5000;     // 0.5m from home end (10000 cts/m)
cfg.position_max  = 495000;   // 0.5m from far end
syn_motor_ctrl_init(&ctrl, &cfg);

Step 3: Start auto-tune. 

SYN_AutoTune at;
SYN_AutoTune_Limits limits = {
    .position_min = 5000,
    .position_max = 495000,
    .watchdog_ms  = 1000,    // abort if update() stops for 1s
};
syn_autotune_start(&at, &ctrl, &limits, SYN_ATUNE_FLAG_ALL);

Step 4: Poll from your main loop. 

while (true) {
    SYN_AutoTune_State st = syn_autotune_update(&at);
    if (st == SYN_ATUNE_DONE) {
        syn_autotune_apply(&at); // Copy gains to controller
        break;
    }
    if (st == SYN_ATUNE_ABORTED) {
        // Error handling...
        break;
    }
    syn_port_sleep_ms(1); // or run from 1kHz interrupt
}

#include "syntropic/control/syn_control_stats.h"

#include "syntropic/util/syn_assert.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

void syn_control_stats_reset(SYN_ControlStats *stats)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(stats != NULL);
    memset(stats, 0, sizeof(*stats));
}

void syn_control_stats_update(SYN_ControlStats *stats, int32_t error, int32_t output)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(stats != NULL);

    int32_t abs_err = (error < 0) ? -error : error;

    /* Accumulate error stats */
    stats->sum_sq_err += (int64_t)error * error;
    if (abs_err > stats->max_error) {
        stats->max_error = abs_err;
    }

    /* Accumulate efficiency (effort) stats */
    stats->sum_sq_out += (int64_t)output * output;

    /* Accumulate jitter (stress) stats */
    if (stats->samples > 0) {
        int32_t delta = output - stats->last_output;
        stats->sum_abs_delta += (delta < 0) ? -delta : delta;
    }
    stats->last_output = output;

    /* Accumulate precision (ITAE) stats
     * We use sample index as a proxy for time. */
    stats->sum_itae += (int64_t)stats->samples * abs_err;

    stats->samples++;
}

void syn_control_stats_report(const SYN_ControlStats *stats, SYN_ControlReport *report)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(stats != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(report != NULL);

    if (stats->samples == 0) {
        memset(report, 0, sizeof(*report));
        return;
    }

    report->max_error = stats->max_error;

    /* RMS Error */
    report->rms_error = (int32_t)sqrt((double)stats->sum_sq_err / stats->samples);

    /* Control Effort (scaled to 0-10000 for 0.00% to 100.00%) */
    /* Assumes output is in range -100 to 100. If larger, we scale down. */
    double rms_out = sqrt((double)stats->sum_sq_out / stats->samples);
    report->control_effort = (int32_t)(rms_out * 100.0);

    /* Jitter (Average delta) */
    report->jitter = (int32_t)(stats->sum_abs_delta / stats->samples);

    /* ITAE */
    report->itae = (int32_t)(stats->sum_itae / stats->samples);
}
