    uint32_t borrow = bn_sub_raw(diff, cand, P256_N);
    bn_cmov(cand, diff, t[16] | (1U ^ borrow));
    bn_copy(r, cand);
    syn_secure_zero(t, sizeof(t));
    syn_secure_zero(cand, sizeof(cand));
    syn_secure_zero(diff, sizeof(diff));
}

static void p256_mod_n_mul(bignum256 r, const bignum256 a, const bignum256 b)
{
    bignum256 a_mont;
    p256_mont_mul_n(a_mont, a, P256_R2_MOD_N);
    p256_mont_mul_n(r, a_mont, b);
    syn_secure_zero(a_mont, sizeof(a_mont));
}

static void p256_inv_n_start(bignum256 res, bignum256 base, const bignum256 a)
{
    p256_mont_mul_n(res, BN_ONE, P256_R2_MOD_N);
    p256_mont_mul_n(base, a, P256_R2_MOD_N);
}

static void p256_inv_n_nibble(bignum256 res, bignum256 base, uint16_t nib_ix)
{
    uint32_t limb = (uint32_t)nib_ix >> 3U;
    uint32_t shift = ((uint32_t)nib_ix & 7U) * 4U;
    uint32_t w = (P256_N_MINUS_2[limb] >> shift) & 0xFU;
    for (uint32_t b = 0U; b < 4U; b++) {
        if ((w & 1U) != 0U) {
            p256_mont_mul_n(res, res, base);
        }
        p256_mont_mul_n(base, base, base);
        w >>= 1U;
    }
}

/* ── Jacobian Point Operations ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef SYN_P256_Point P256_Point;

static void point_set_infinity(P256_Point *p)
{
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(P256_Point));
    p->infinity = true;
}

static void point_cmov(P256_Point *dst, const P256_Point *src, uint32_t mask)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        dst->x[i] = (dst->x[i] & ~mask) | (src->x[i] & mask);
        dst->y[i] = (dst->y[i] & ~mask) | (src->y[i] & mask);
        dst->z[i] = (dst->z[i] & ~mask) | (src->z[i] & mask);
    }
    dst->infinity = (((uint32_t)dst->infinity & ~mask) | ((uint32_t)src->infinity & mask)) != 0U;
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
__attribute__((noinline))
#endif
static void
point_double(P256_Point *r, const P256_Point *p)
{
    uint32_t is_inf = ((uint32_t)p->infinity | (uint32_t)bn_is_zero(p->y)) & 1U;

    P256_Point out;
    bignum256 s;
    bignum256 m;
    bignum256 t;
    bignum256 y_sqr;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(y_sqr, p->y);

    /* S = 4 * X * Y^2 */
    p256_mod_p_mul(s, p->x, y_sqr);
    p256_mod_p_add(s, s, s);
    p256_mod_p_add(s, s, s);

    /* M = 3 * (X^2 - Z^4) = 3 * (X - Z^2) * (X + Z^2) (since a = -3) */
    bignum256 z_sqr;
    bignum256 delta;
    bignum256 sum;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(z_sqr, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_sub(delta, p->x, z_sqr);
    p256_mod_p_add(sum, p->x, z_sqr);
    p256_mod_p_mul(m, delta, sum);
    bignum256 m_tmp;
    p256_mod_p_add(m_tmp, m, m);
    p256_mod_p_add(m, m_tmp, m);

    /* X' = M^2 - 2S */
    p256_mod_p_sqr(out.x, m);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, s);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, s);

    /* Z' = 2 * Y * Z */
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.z, p->y, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_add(out.z, out.z, out.z);

    /* Y' = M * (S - X') - 8 * Y^4 */
    p256_mod_p_sub(t, s, out.x);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.y, m, t);
    bignum256 y4;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(y4, y_sqr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        p256_mod_p_add(y4, y4, y4);
    }
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.y, out.y, y4);

    uint32_t keep_mask = 0U - (1U ^ is_inf);
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < 8U; i++) {
        out.x[i] &= keep_mask;
        out.y[i] &= keep_mask;
        out.z[i] &= keep_mask;
    }
    out.infinity = (is_inf != 0U);
    *r = out;
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
__attribute__((noinline))
#endif
static void
point_add_mixed(P256_Point *r, const P256_Point *p, const bignum256 qx, const bignum256 qy)
{
    bignum256 z1_sqr;
    bignum256 u2;
    bignum256 z1_cube;
    bignum256 s2;
    bignum256 h;
    bignum256 rr;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(z1_sqr, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_mul(u2, qx, z1_sqr);

    p256_mod_p_mul(z1_cube, z1_sqr, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_mul(s2, qy, z1_cube);

    p256_mod_p_sub(h, u2, p->x);
    p256_mod_p_sub(rr, s2, p->y);

    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Coincident / Inverse point handling */
    if (bn_is_zero(h)) {
        if (bn_is_zero(rr)) {
            point_double(r, p);
        } else {
            point_set_infinity(r);
        }
        return;
    }
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */

    P256_Point out;
    bignum256 h2;
    bignum256 h3;
    bignum256 u1_h2;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(h2, h);
    p256_mod_p_mul(h3, h2, h);
    p256_mod_p_mul(u1_h2, p->x, h2);

    /* X' = R^2 - H^3 - 2 * U1 * H^2 */
    p256_mod_p_sqr(out.x, rr);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, h3);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, u1_h2);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, u1_h2);

    /* Y' = R * (U1 * H^2 - X') - S1 * H^3 */
    bignum256 t;
    bignum256 s1_h3;
    p256_mod_p_sub(t, u1_h2, out.x);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.y, rr, t);
    p256_mod_p_mul(s1_h3, p->y, h3);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.y, out.y, s1_h3);

    /* Z' = Z1 * H */
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.z, p->z, h);

    out.infinity = false;
    *r = out;
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
__attribute__((noinline))
#endif
static void
point_add(P256_Point *r, const P256_Point *p, const P256_Point *q)
{
    uint32_t p_inf = (uint32_t)p->infinity & 1U;
    uint32_t q_inf = (uint32_t)q->infinity & 1U;

    bignum256 z1_sqr;
    bignum256 z2_sqr;
    bignum256 u1;
    bignum256 u2;
    bignum256 s1;
    bignum256 s2;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(z1_sqr, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_sqr(z2_sqr, q->z);

    p256_mod_p_mul(u1, p->x, z2_sqr);
    p256_mod_p_mul(u2, q->x, z1_sqr);

    bignum256 z1_cube;
    bignum256 z2_cube;
    p256_mod_p_mul(z1_cube, z1_sqr, p->z);
    p256_mod_p_mul(z2_cube, z2_sqr, q->z);

    p256_mod_p_mul(s1, p->y, z2_cube);
    p256_mod_p_mul(s2, q->y, z1_cube);

    bignum256 h;
    bignum256 rr;
    p256_mod_p_sub(h, u2, u1);
    p256_mod_p_sub(rr, s2, s1);

    uint32_t h_zero = (uint32_t)bn_is_zero(h) & 1U;
    uint32_t special = (1U ^ p_inf) & (1U ^ q_inf) & h_zero;

    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Coincident / Inverse finite point handling */
    if (special != 0U) {
        if (bn_is_zero(rr)) {
            point_double(r, p);
        } else {
            point_set_infinity(r);
        }
        return;
    }
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */

    P256_Point out;
    bignum256 h2;
    bignum256 h3;
    bignum256 u1_h2;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(h2, h);
    p256_mod_p_mul(h3, h2, h);
    p256_mod_p_mul(u1_h2, u1, h2);

    /* X' = R^2 - H^3 - 2 * U1 * H^2 */
    p256_mod_p_sqr(out.x, rr);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, h3);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, u1_h2);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.x, out.x, u1_h2);

    /* Y' = R * (U1 * H^2 - X') - S1 * H^3 */
    bignum256 t;
    bignum256 s1_h3;
    p256_mod_p_sub(t, u1_h2, out.x);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.y, rr, t);
    p256_mod_p_mul(s1_h3, s1, h3);
    p256_mod_p_sub(out.y, out.y, s1_h3);

    /* Z' = Z1 * Z2 * H */
    bignum256 z1_z2;
    p256_mod_p_mul(z1_z2, p->z, q->z);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out.z, z1_z2, h);

    out.infinity = false;
    point_cmov(&out, p, 0U - q_inf);
    point_cmov(&out, q, 0U - p_inf);
    *r = out;
}

/* ── Resumable Cooperative Engine ────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef enum { P256_OP_MUL = 1U, P256_OP_SIGN = 2U, P256_OP_VERIFY = 3U } P256_OpKind;

static bool p256_pt_args_ok(const SYN_PT *pt, const SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t expected_op)
{
    return (pt != NULL) && (ctx != NULL) && ctx->active && (ctx->op == expected_op);
}

static bool p256_scalar_in_range(const bignum256 k)
{
    return !bn_is_zero(k) && (bn_cmp(k, P256_N) < 0);
}

static SYN_PT_Status p256_precomp_w2_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].x, ctx->px);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].y, ctx->py);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].z, BN_ONE);
    ctx->table[0].infinity = false;
    point_double(&ctx->table[1], &ctx->table[0]);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    point_add_mixed(&ctx->table[2], &ctx->table[1], ctx->px, ctx->py);
    point_set_infinity(&ctx->acc);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_END(pt);
}

static void p256_scalar_w2_add(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    uint32_t win = 127U - (uint32_t)ctx->idx;
    uint32_t bits = (ctx->k1[win / 16U] >> ((win % 16U) * 2U)) & 0x03U;
    P256_Point term;
    point_set_infinity(&term);
    for (uint32_t v = 1U; v <= 3U; v++) {
        uint32_t mask = 0U - (uint32_t)(bits == v);
        point_cmov(&term, &ctx->table[v - 1U], mask);
    }
    point_add(&ctx->acc, &ctx->acc, &term);
    syn_secure_zero(&term, sizeof(term));
}

static SYN_PT_Status p256_scalar_w2_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 128U; ctx->idx++) {
        point_double(&ctx->acc, &ctx->acc);
        point_double(&ctx->acc, &ctx->acc);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);

        p256_scalar_w2_add(ctx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

static SYN_PT_Status p256_inv_z_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    bn_copy(ctx->inv_res, BN_ONE);
    bn_copy(ctx->inv_base, ctx->acc.z);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 64U; ctx->idx++) {
        p256_inv_p_nibble(ctx->inv_res, ctx->inv_base, ctx->idx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

static SYN_PT_Status p256_inv_n_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 64U; ctx->idx++) {
        p256_inv_n_nibble(ctx->inv_res, ctx->inv_base, ctx->idx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

static void p256_affine_from_inv_z(const SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, bignum256 out_x, bignum256 out_y)
{
    bignum256 z_inv2;
    bignum256 z_inv3;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(z_inv2, ctx->inv_res);
    p256_mod_p_mul(z_inv3, z_inv2, ctx->inv_res);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out_x, ctx->acc.x, z_inv2);
    p256_mod_p_mul(out_y, ctx->acc.y, z_inv3);
    syn_secure_zero(z_inv2, sizeof(z_inv2));
    syn_secure_zero(z_inv3, sizeof(z_inv3));
}

static void p256_mul_finish(const SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t rx[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                            uint8_t ry[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    bignum256 out_x;
    bignum256 out_y;
    p256_affine_from_inv_z(ctx, out_x, out_y);
    bn_to_bytes(rx, out_x);
    if (ry != NULL) {
        bn_to_bytes(ry, out_y);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(out_x, sizeof(out_x));
    syn_secure_zero(out_y, sizeof(out_y));
}

static void p256_drbg_rfc6979_round(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t sep)
{
#if SYN_HMAC_DRBG_ENABLED
    uint8_t priv_bytes[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN];
    uint8_t h1_reduced[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN];
    SYN_HMAC_SHA256 hmac;

    bn_to_bytes(priv_bytes, ctx->k2);
    bn_to_bytes(h1_reduced, ctx->aux);

    if (sep == 0x00U) {
        (void)memset(ctx->drbg.k, 0x00, sizeof(ctx->drbg.k));
        (void)memset(ctx->drbg.v, 0x01, sizeof(ctx->drbg.v));
        ctx->drbg.reseed_interval = SYN_HMAC_DRBG_DEFAULT_RESEED_INTERVAL;
    }

    syn_hmac_sha256_init(&hmac, ctx->drbg.k, sizeof(ctx->drbg.k));
    syn_hmac_sha256_update(&hmac, ctx->drbg.v, sizeof(ctx->drbg.v));
    syn_hmac_sha256_update(&hmac, &sep, 1U);
    syn_hmac_sha256_update(&hmac, priv_bytes, SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN);
    syn_hmac_sha256_update(&hmac, h1_reduced, SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN);
    syn_hmac_sha256_final(&hmac, ctx->drbg.k);
    syn_secure_zero(&hmac, sizeof(hmac));
    syn_secure_zero(priv_bytes, sizeof(priv_bytes));
    syn_secure_zero(h1_reduced, sizeof(h1_reduced));

    syn_hmac_sha256(ctx->drbg.k, sizeof(ctx->drbg.k), ctx->drbg.v, sizeof(ctx->drbg.v),
                    ctx->drbg.v);

    if (sep == 0x01U) {
        ctx->drbg.reseed_counter = 1U;
        ctx->drbg.initialized = true;
    }
#else
    (void)ctx;
    (void)sep;
#endif
}

static void p256_sign_drbg_draw(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
#if SYN_HMAC_DRBG_ENABLED
    uint8_t nonce_bytes[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN];
    (void)syn_hmac_drbg_generate(&ctx->drbg, nonce_bytes, sizeof(nonce_bytes), NULL, 0U);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k1, nonce_bytes);
    syn_secure_zero(nonce_bytes, sizeof(nonce_bytes));
#else
    (void)ctx;
#endif
}

static void p256_sign_prep_inv_n(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    bignum256 rx;
    bignum256 ry;
    p256_affine_from_inv_z(ctx, rx, ry);
    p256_reduce_once_mod_n(rx);
    bn_copy(ctx->py, rx);
    p256_inv_n_start(ctx->inv_res, ctx->inv_base, ctx->k1);
    syn_secure_zero(rx, sizeof(rx));
    syn_secure_zero(ry, sizeof(ry));
}

static void p256_sign_rs_num(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    bignum256 xr;
    bignum256 num_sub;
    p256_mod_n_mul(xr, ctx->k2, ctx->py);
    uint32_t carry = bn_add_raw(ctx->inv_base, ctx->aux, xr);
    uint32_t borrow = bn_sub_raw(num_sub, ctx->inv_base, P256_N);
    bn_cmov(ctx->inv_base, num_sub, carry | (1U ^ borrow));
    syn_secure_zero(xr, sizeof(xr));
    syn_secure_zero(num_sub, sizeof(num_sub));
}

static bool p256_sign_rs_fin(const SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t r_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                             uint8_t s_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    bignum256 k_inv;
    bignum256 s;
    p256_mont_mul_n(k_inv, ctx->inv_res, BN_ONE);
    p256_mod_n_mul(s, k_inv, ctx->inv_base);

    bool ok = (((uint32_t)bn_is_zero(ctx->py) | (uint32_t)bn_is_zero(s)) == 0U);
    if (ok) {
        bn_to_bytes(r_out, ctx->py);
        bn_to_bytes(s_out, s);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(k_inv, sizeof(k_inv));
    syn_secure_zero(s, sizeof(s));
    return ok;
}

static void p256_verify_shamir_scalars(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    bignum256 w;
    p256_mont_mul_n(w, ctx->inv_res, BN_ONE);
    p256_mod_n_mul(ctx->k1, ctx->k1, w);
    p256_mod_n_mul(ctx->k2, ctx->aux, w);
    syn_secure_zero(w, sizeof(w));
}

static void p256_verify_shamir_table(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].x, P256_GX);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].y, P256_GY);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[0].z, BN_ONE);
    ctx->table[0].infinity = false;

    bn_copy(ctx->table[1].x, ctx->px);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[1].y, ctx->py);
    bn_copy(ctx->table[1].z, BN_ONE);
    ctx->table[1].infinity = false;

    point_add(&ctx->table[2], &ctx->table[0], &ctx->table[1]);
    point_set_infinity(&ctx->acc);
}

static void p256_verify_shamir_add(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    uint32_t bit = 255U - (uint32_t)ctx->idx;
    uint32_t b1 = (ctx->k1[bit / 32U] >> (bit % 32U)) & 1U;
    uint32_t b2 = (ctx->k2[bit / 32U] >> (bit % 32U)) & 1U;
    uint32_t sel = b1 | (b2 << 1U);
    if (sel != 0U) {
        point_add(&ctx->acc, &ctx->acc, &ctx->table[sel - 1U]);
    }
}

static SYN_PT_Status p256_verify_shamir_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 256U; ctx->idx++) {
        point_double(&ctx->acc, &ctx->acc);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);

        p256_verify_shamir_add(ctx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

static bool p256_verify_check_r(const SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    bignum256 rx;
    bignum256 ry;
    p256_affine_from_inv_z(ctx, rx, ry);
    p256_reduce_once_mod_n(rx);
    bool valid = (bn_cmp(rx, ctx->aux) == 0);
    syn_secure_zero(rx, sizeof(rx));
    syn_secure_zero(ry, sizeof(ry));
    return valid;
}

/* ── Public API Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_p256_wipe(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx)
{
    if (ctx != NULL) {
        syn_secure_zero(ctx, sizeof(*ctx));
    }
}

bool syn_p256_is_on_curve(const uint8_t px[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], const uint8_t py[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (px == NULL || py == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    bignum256 x;
    bignum256 y;
    bn_from_bytes(x, px);
    bn_from_bytes(y, py);

    if (bn_cmp(x, P256_P) >= 0 || bn_cmp(y, P256_P) >= 0) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Left hand side: y^2 mod p */
    bignum256 lhs;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(lhs, y);

    /* Right hand side: x^3 - 3x + b mod p */
    bignum256 rhs;
    bignum256 x3;
    bignum256 three_x;
    p256_mod_p_sqr(x3, x);
    p256_mod_p_mul(x3, x3, x);

    p256_mod_p_add(three_x, x, x);
    p256_mod_p_add(three_x, three_x, x);

    p256_mod_p_sub(rhs, x3, three_x);
    p256_mod_p_add(rhs, rhs, P256_B);

    return (bn_cmp(lhs, rhs) == 0);
}

bool syn_p256_base_mul_init(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t scalar[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || scalar == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k1, scalar);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k1)) {
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }
    bn_copy(ctx->px, P256_GX);
    bn_copy(ctx->py, P256_GY);
    ctx->op = (uint8_t)P256_OP_MUL;
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_p256_point_mul_init(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t scalar[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                             const uint8_t px[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                             const uint8_t py[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || scalar == NULL || px == NULL || py == NULL ||
        !syn_p256_is_on_curve(px, py)) {
        return false;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k1, scalar);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k1)) {
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->px, px);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->py, py);
    ctx->op = (uint8_t)P256_OP_MUL;
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_p256_mul_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t rx[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                              uint8_t ry[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (!p256_pt_args_ok(pt, ctx, (uint8_t)P256_OP_MUL) || rx == NULL) {
        if (ctx != NULL) {
            syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        }
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_precomp_w2_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_scalar_w2_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_inv_z_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
    p256_mul_finish(ctx, rx, ry);
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);

    PT_END(pt);
}

bool syn_p256_sign_init(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t priv_key[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                        const uint8_t nonce_k[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                        const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || priv_key == NULL || nonce_k == NULL || hash == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k2, priv_key);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k2)) {
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k1, nonce_k);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k1)) {
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->aux, hash);
    p256_reduce_once_mod_n(ctx->aux);
    ctx->op = (uint8_t)P256_OP_SIGN;
    ctx->max_attempts = 1U;
    ctx->use_drbg = false;
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_p256_sign_deterministic_init(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t priv_key[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                                      const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
#if SYN_HMAC_DRBG_ENABLED
    if (ctx == NULL || priv_key == NULL || hash == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k2, priv_key);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k2)) {
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }

    bn_from_bytes(ctx->aux, hash);
    p256_reduce_once_mod_n(ctx->aux);

    ctx->op = (uint8_t)P256_OP_SIGN;
    ctx->max_attempts = 100U;
    ctx->use_drbg = true;
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
#else
    (void)ctx;
    (void)priv_key;
    (void)hash;
    return false;
#endif
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_p256_sign_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t r_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                               uint8_t s_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], bool *out_ok)
{
    if (out_ok != NULL) {
        *out_ok = false;
    }
    if (!p256_pt_args_ok(pt, ctx, (uint8_t)P256_OP_SIGN) || r_out == NULL || s_out == NULL ||
        out_ok == NULL) {
        if (ctx != NULL) {
            syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        }
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    if (ctx->use_drbg) {
        p256_drbg_rfc6979_round(ctx, 0x00U);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        p256_drbg_rfc6979_round(ctx, 0x01U);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }

    while (ctx->attempts < ctx->max_attempts) {
        ctx->attempts++;
        if (ctx->use_drbg) {
            p256_sign_drbg_draw(ctx);
            PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        }
        if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->k1)) {
            continue;
        }

        bn_copy(ctx->px, P256_GX);
        bn_copy(ctx->py, P256_GY);
        PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_precomp_w2_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
        PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_scalar_w2_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
        PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_inv_z_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));

        p256_sign_prep_inv_n(ctx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);

        PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_inv_n_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
        p256_sign_rs_num(ctx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        if (p256_sign_rs_fin(ctx, r_out, s_out)) {
            ctx->ok = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (out_ok != NULL) {
        *out_ok = ctx->ok;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);

    PT_END(pt);
}

bool syn_p256_verify_init(SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                          const uint8_t r[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], const uint8_t s[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                          const uint8_t pub_x[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                          const uint8_t pub_y[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || hash == NULL || r == NULL || s == NULL || pub_x == NULL || pub_y == NULL ||
        !syn_p256_is_on_curve(pub_x, pub_y)) {
        return false;
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
    bignum256 bn_s;
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->aux, r);
    bn_from_bytes(bn_s, s);
    if (!p256_scalar_in_range(ctx->aux) || !p256_scalar_in_range(bn_s)) {
        syn_secure_zero(bn_s, sizeof(bn_s));
        syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        return false;
    }

    bn_from_bytes(ctx->k1, hash);
    p256_reduce_once_mod_n(ctx->k1);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->px, pub_x);
    bn_from_bytes(ctx->py, pub_y);
    p256_inv_n_start(ctx->inv_res, ctx->inv_base, bn_s);
    syn_secure_zero(bn_s, sizeof(bn_s));

    ctx->op = (uint8_t)P256_OP_VERIFY;
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_p256_verify_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_P256_Ctx *ctx, bool *out_valid)
{
    if (out_valid != NULL) {
        *out_valid = false;
    }
    if (!p256_pt_args_ok(pt, ctx, (uint8_t)P256_OP_VERIFY) || out_valid == NULL) {
        if (ctx != NULL) {
            syn_p256_wipe(ctx);
        }
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_inv_n_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));

    p256_verify_shamir_scalars(ctx);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    p256_verify_shamir_table(ctx);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_verify_shamir_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));

    if (ctx->acc.infinity) {
        *out_valid = false;
    } else {
        PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, p256_inv_z_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
        *out_valid = p256_verify_check_r(ctx);
    }
    syn_p256_wipe(ctx);

    PT_END(pt);
}

bool syn_p256_base_mul(const uint8_t scalar[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], uint8_t pub_x[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                       uint8_t pub_y[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (pub_x == NULL || pub_y == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    if (!syn_p256_base_mul_init(&ctx, scalar)) {
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_mul_pt(&pt, &ctx, pub_x, pub_y) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_p256_point_mul(const uint8_t scalar[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                        const uint8_t px[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], const uint8_t py[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                        uint8_t rx[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], uint8_t ry[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (rx == NULL || ry == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    if (!syn_p256_point_mul_init(&ctx, scalar, px, py)) {
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_mul_pt(&pt, &ctx, rx, ry) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_p256_ecdh(const uint8_t priv_key[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                   const uint8_t peer_pub_x[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                   const uint8_t peer_pub_y[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                   uint8_t shared_secret[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (shared_secret == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    if (!syn_p256_point_mul_init(&ctx, priv_key, peer_pub_x, peer_pub_y)) {
        syn_secure_zero(shared_secret, SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN);
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_mul_pt(&pt, &ctx, shared_secret, NULL) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_p256_sign_ecdsa(const uint8_t priv_key[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                         const uint8_t nonce_k[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                         const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], uint8_t r_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                         uint8_t s_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (r_out == NULL || s_out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    bool ok = false;
    if (!syn_p256_sign_init(&ctx, priv_key, nonce_k, hash)) {
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_sign_pt(&pt, &ctx, r_out, s_out, &ok) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return ok;
}

bool syn_p256_sign_ecdsa_deterministic(const uint8_t priv_key[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                                       const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                                       uint8_t r_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                                       uint8_t s_out[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    if (r_out == NULL || s_out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    bool ok = false;
    if (!syn_p256_sign_deterministic_init(&ctx, priv_key, hash)) {
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_sign_pt(&pt, &ctx, r_out, s_out, &ok) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return ok;
}

bool syn_p256_verify_ecdsa(const uint8_t hash[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                           const uint8_t r[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN], const uint8_t s[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                           const uint8_t pub_x[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN],
                           const uint8_t pub_y[SYN_P256_BYTE_LEN])
{
    SYN_P256_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    bool valid = false;
    if (!syn_p256_verify_init(&ctx, hash, r, s, pub_x, pub_y)) {
        return false;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_p256_verify_pt(&pt, &ctx, &valid) == PT_MORE) {
    }
    return valid;
}

/* ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static const uint32_t H_INIT[8] = {0x6a09e667u, 0xbb67ae85u, 0x3c6ef372u, 0xa54ff53au,
                                   0x510e527fu, 0x9b05688cu, 0x1f83d9abu, 0x5be0cd19u};

static const uint32_t K[64] SYN_SHA256_PROGMEM = {
    0x428a2f98u, 0x71374491u, 0xb5c0fbcfu, 0xe9b5dba5u, 0x3956c25bu, 0x59f111f1u, 0x923f82a4u,

    0xc6e00bf3u, 0xd5a79147u, 0x06ca6351u, 0x14292967u, 0x27b70a85u, 0x2e1b2138u, 0x4d2c6dfcu,
    0x53380d13u, 0x650a7354u, 0x766a0abbu, 0x81c2c92eu, 0x92722c85u, 0xa2bfe8a1u, 0xa81a664bu,
    0xc24b8b70u, 0xc76c51a3u, 0xd192e819u, 0xd6990624u, 0xf40e3585u, 0x106aa070u, 0x19a4c116u,
    0x1e376c08u, 0x2748774cu, 0x34b0bcb5u, 0x391c0cb3u, 0x4ed8aa4au, 0x5b9cca4fu, 0x682e6ff3u,
    0x748f82eeu, 0x78a5636fu, 0x84c87814u, 0x8cc70208u, 0x90befffau, 0xa4506cebu, 0xbef9a3f7u,
    0xc67178f2u};

/* ── Bit operations (FIPS 180-4 §4.1.2) ───────────────────────────────── */

static inline uint32_t rotr(uint32_t x, unsigned n)
{
    return (x >> n) | (x << (32u - n));
}

static inline uint32_t ch(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z)
{
    return (x & y) ^ (~x & z);
}

static inline uint32_t maj(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z)
{
    return (x & y) ^ (x & z) ^ (y & z);
}

static inline uint32_t sigma0(uint32_t x)
{
    return rotr(x, 2) ^ rotr(x, 13) ^ rotr(x, 22);
}

static inline uint32_t sigma1(uint32_t x)
{
    return rotr(x, 6) ^ rotr(x, 11) ^ rotr(x, 25);
}

static inline uint32_t gamma0(uint32_t x)
{
    return rotr(x, 7) ^ rotr(x, 18) ^ (x >> 3);
}

static inline uint32_t gamma1(uint32_t x)
{
    return rotr(x, 17) ^ rotr(x, 19) ^ (x >> 10);
}

/* ── Block transform ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void sha256_transform(uint32_t state[8], const uint8_t block[64])
{
    uint32_t W[64];
    uint32_t a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h;
    unsigned i;

    /* Prepare message schedule */
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        W[i] = syn_peek_u32(block, i * 4);
    }
    for (i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
        W[i] = gamma1(W[i - 2]) + W[i - 7] + gamma0(W[i - 15]) + W[i - 16];
    }

    /* Working variables */
    a = state[0];
    b = state[1];
    c = state[2];
    d = state[3];
    e = state[4];
    f = state[5];
    g = state[6];
    h = state[7];

    /* 64 rounds */
    for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t t1 = h + sigma1(e) + ch(e, f, g) + SYN_SHA256_K(i) + W[i];
        uint32_t t2 = sigma0(a) + maj(a, b, c);
        h = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = d + t1;
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = t1 + t2;
    }

    /* Update state */
    state[0] += a;
    state[1] += b;
    state[2] += c;
    state[3] += d;
    state[4] += e;
    state[5] += f;
    state[6] += g;
    state[7] += h;
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_sha256_init(SYN_SHA256 *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ctx != NULL);
    if (ctx == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }
    memcpy(ctx->state, H_INIT, sizeof(H_INIT));
    ctx->buf_len = 0;
    ctx->total_len_lo = 0;
    ctx->total_len_hi = 0;
}

void syn_sha256_update(SYN_SHA256 *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ctx != NULL);
    if (ctx == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0)
        return;

    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)data;

    /* Track total length in bits (split into hi/lo for >4GB messages) */
    uint32_t len_bits_lo = (uint32_t)((uint64_t)len << 3);
    ctx->total_len_lo += len_bits_lo;
    if (ctx->total_len_lo < len_bits_lo) {
        ctx->total_len_hi++; /* carry */
    }
    ctx->total_len_hi += (uint32_t)((uint64_t)len >> 29);

    /* Fill partial buffer first */
    if (ctx->buf_len > 0) {
        uint32_t space = SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE - ctx->buf_len;
        uint32_t fill = (len < space) ? (uint32_t)len : space;
        memcpy(ctx->buf + ctx->buf_len, p, fill);
        ctx->buf_len += fill;
        p += fill;
        len -= fill;

        if (ctx->buf_len == SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE) {
            sha256_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);
            ctx->buf_len = 0;
        }
    }

    /* Process full blocks directly from input */
    while (len >= SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE) {
        sha256_transform(ctx->state, p);
        p += SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE;
        len -= SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    /* Buffer remaining bytes */
    if (len > 0) {
        memcpy(ctx->buf, p, len);
        ctx->buf_len = (uint32_t)len;
    }
}

void syn_sha256_final(SYN_SHA256 *ctx, uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ctx != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(hash != NULL);

    if (ctx == NULL || hash == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    /* Pad: append 0x80, then zeros, then 64-bit big-endian length */
    ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len++] = 0x80;

    if (ctx->buf_len > 56) {
        /* Not enough room for length — fill this block and process */
        memset(ctx->buf + ctx->buf_len, 0, SYN_SHA256_BLOCK_SIZE - ctx->buf_len);
        sha256_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);
        ctx->buf_len = 0;
    }

    /* Pad with zeros up to byte 56 */
    memset(ctx->buf + ctx->buf_len, 0, 56 - ctx->buf_len);

    /* Append 64-bit big-endian total length in bits */
    syn_poke_u32(ctx->total_len_hi, ctx->buf, 56);
    syn_poke_u32(ctx->total_len_lo, ctx->buf, 60);

    sha256_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);

    /* Produce big-endian digest */
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        syn_poke_u32(ctx->state[i], hash, i * 4);
    }
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Follows the same streaming pattern as syn_crc.h: init → update (repeated) → final

The context struct is caller-owned (~112 bytes on 32-bit targets). No heap allocation, no floating point, no external libraries.

** **

// One-shot:
uint8_t hash[32];
syn_sha256("abc", 3, hash);

// Streaming:
SYN_SHA256 ctx;

#define ROTR64(x, n) (((x) >> (n)) | ((x) << (64U - (n))))
#define SHR64(x, n) ((x) >> (n))

#define CH(x, y, z) (((x) & (y)) ^ (~(x) & (z)))
#define MAJ(x, y, z) (((x) & (y)) ^ ((x) & (z)) ^ ((y) & (z)))

#define SIGMA0(x) (ROTR64(x, 28U) ^ ROTR64(x, 34U) ^ ROTR64(x, 39U))
#define SIGMA1(x) (ROTR64(x, 14U) ^ ROTR64(x, 18U) ^ ROTR64(x, 41U))
#define SIGMA_LOWER0(x) (ROTR64(x, 1U) ^ ROTR64(x, 8U) ^ SHR64(x, 7U))
#define SIGMA_LOWER1(x) (ROTR64(x, 19U) ^ ROTR64(x, 61U) ^ SHR64(x, 6U))

static inline uint64_t load_be64(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return ((uint64_t)p[0] << 56U) | ((uint64_t)p[1] << 48U) | ((uint64_t)p[2] << 40U) |
           ((uint64_t)p[3] << 32U) | ((uint64_t)p[4] << 24U) | ((uint64_t)p[5] << 16U) |
           ((uint64_t)p[6] << 8U) | (uint64_t)p[7];
}

static inline void store_be64(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t)((v >> 56U) & 0xFFU);
    p[1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 48U) & 0xFFU);
    p[2] = (uint8_t)((v >> 40U) & 0xFFU);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)((v >> 32U) & 0xFFU);
    p[4] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    p[5] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    p[6] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    p[7] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
}

/* ── Core Block Transform ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void sha512_transform(uint64_t state[8], const uint8_t block[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE])
{
    uint64_t w[80];

    for (size_t t = 0U; t < 16U; t++) {
        w[t] = load_be64(&block[t * 8U]);
    }
    for (size_t t = 16U; t < 80U; t++) {
        w[t] = SIGMA_LOWER1(w[t - 2U]) + w[t - 7U] + SIGMA_LOWER0(w[t - 15U]) + w[t - 16U];
    }

    uint64_t a = state[0];
    uint64_t b = state[1];
    uint64_t c = state[2];
    uint64_t d = state[3];
    uint64_t e = state[4];
    uint64_t f = state[5];
    uint64_t g = state[6];
    uint64_t h = state[7];

    for (size_t t = 0U; t < 80U; t++) {
        uint64_t t1 = h + SIGMA1(e) + CH(e, f, g) + K512[t] + w[t];
        uint64_t t2 = SIGMA0(a) + MAJ(a, b, c);
        h = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = d + t1;
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = t1 + t2;
    }

    state[0] += a;
    state[1] += b;
    state[2] += c;
    state[3] += d;
    state[4] += e;
    state[5] += f;
    state[6] += g;
    state[7] += h;
}

static void sha512_pad_and_finalize(SYN_SHA512 *ctx)
{
    /* Append 0x80 */
    ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len++] = 0x80U;

    if (ctx->buf_len > (SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - 16U)) {
        memset(&ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len], 0, SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - ctx->buf_len);
        sha512_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);
        ctx->buf_len = 0U;
    }

    memset(&ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len], 0, (SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - 16U) - ctx->buf_len);

    /* 128-bit bit length: [total_len_hi * 8 + overflow] || [total_len_lo * 8] */
    uint64_t bit_len_hi = (ctx->total_len_hi << 3U) | (ctx->total_len_lo >> 61U);
    uint64_t bit_len_lo = ctx->total_len_lo << 3U;

    store_be64(&ctx->buf[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - 16U], bit_len_hi);
    store_be64(&ctx->buf[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - 8U], bit_len_lo);

    sha512_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);
}


/* ── Hash API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_sha512_init(SYN_SHA512 *ctx)
{

        return;

    ctx->state[0] = 0x6a09e667f3bcc908ULL;

    ctx->state[7] = 0x5be0cd19137e2179ULL;

    ctx->state[6] = 0xdb0c2e0d64f98fa7ULL;
    ctx->state[7] = 0x47b5481dbefa4fa4ULL;

    ctx->total_len_lo = 0ULL;
    ctx->total_len_hi = 0ULL;

void syn_sha512_update(SYN_SHA512 *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return;
    }

    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)data;

    uint64_t prev_lo = ctx->total_len_lo;
    ctx->total_len_lo += (uint64_t)len;
    if (ctx->total_len_lo < prev_lo) {
        ctx->total_len_hi++;
    }

    if (ctx->buf_len > 0U) {
        size_t needed = SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE - ctx->buf_len;
        if (len < needed) {
            memcpy(&ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len], p, len);
            ctx->buf_len += (uint32_t)len;
            return;
        }
        memcpy(&ctx->buf[ctx->buf_len], p, needed);
        sha512_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buf);
        p += needed;
        len -= needed;
        ctx->buf_len = 0U;
    }

    while (len >= SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE) {
        sha512_transform(ctx->state, p);
        p += SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE;
        len -= SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    if (len > 0U) {
        memcpy(ctx->buf, p, len);
        ctx->buf_len = (uint32_t)len;
    }
}

void syn_sha512_final(SYN_SHA512 *ctx, uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA512_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || hash == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    sha512_pad_and_finalize(ctx);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 8U; i++) {
        store_be64(&hash[i * 8U], ctx->state[i]);
    }
}

void syn_sha384_final(SYN_SHA512 *ctx, uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA384_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || hash == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    sha512_pad_and_finalize(ctx);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 6U; i++) {
        store_be64(&hash[i * 8U], ctx->state[i]);
    }
}

void syn_sha512(const void *data, size_t len, uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA512_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    SYN_SHA512 ctx;
    syn_sha512_init(&ctx);
    syn_sha512_update(&ctx, data, len);
    syn_sha512_final(&ctx, hash);
}

/* ── HMAC API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_hmac_sha512_init(SYN_HMAC_SHA512 *ctx, const void *key, size_t key_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t k_buf[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE];
    memset(k_buf, 0, sizeof(k_buf));

    if (key_len > SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE) {
        syn_sha512(key, key_len, k_buf);
    } else if (key != NULL && key_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(k_buf, key, key_len);
    }

    uint8_t i_pad[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE];
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE; i++) {
        i_pad[i] = (uint8_t)(k_buf[i] ^ 0x36U);
        ctx->o_key_pad[i] = (uint8_t)(k_buf[i] ^ 0x5CU);
    }

    syn_sha512_init(&ctx->inner);
    syn_sha512_update(&ctx->inner, i_pad, sizeof(i_pad));

    syn_secure_zero(k_buf, sizeof(k_buf));
    syn_secure_zero(i_pad, sizeof(i_pad));
}

void syn_hmac_sha512_update(SYN_HMAC_SHA512 *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return;
    }
    syn_sha512_update(&ctx->inner, data, len);
}

void syn_hmac_sha512_final(SYN_HMAC_SHA512 *ctx, uint8_t mac[SYN_SHA512_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || mac == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t inner_hash[SYN_SHA512_DIGEST_SIZE];
    syn_sha512_final(&ctx->inner, inner_hash);

    SYN_SHA512 outer;
    syn_sha512_init(&outer);
    syn_sha512_update(&outer, ctx->o_key_pad, sizeof(ctx->o_key_pad));
    syn_sha512_update(&outer, inner_hash, sizeof(inner_hash));
    syn_sha512_final(&outer, mac);

    syn_secure_zero(inner_hash, sizeof(inner_hash));
    syn_secure_zero(&outer, sizeof(outer));
    syn_secure_zero(ctx, sizeof(*ctx));
}

void syn_hmac_sha384_init(SYN_HMAC_SHA384 *ctx, const void *key, size_t key_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t k_buf[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE];
    memset(k_buf, 0, sizeof(k_buf));

    if (key_len > SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE) {
        syn_sha384(key, key_len, k_buf);
    } else if (key != NULL && key_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(k_buf, key, key_len);
    }

    uint8_t i_pad[SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE];
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE; i++) {
        i_pad[i] = (uint8_t)(k_buf[i] ^ 0x36U);
        ctx->o_key_pad[i] = (uint8_t)(k_buf[i] ^ 0x5CU);
    }

    syn_sha384_init(&ctx->inner);
    syn_sha512_update(&ctx->inner, i_pad, sizeof(i_pad));

    syn_secure_zero(k_buf, sizeof(k_buf));
    syn_secure_zero(i_pad, sizeof(i_pad));
}

void syn_hmac_sha384_update(SYN_HMAC_SHA384 *ctx, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return;
    }
    syn_sha512_update(&ctx->inner, data, len);
}

void syn_hmac_sha384_final(SYN_HMAC_SHA384 *ctx, uint8_t mac[SYN_SHA384_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || mac == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t inner_hash[SYN_SHA384_DIGEST_SIZE];
    syn_sha384_final(&ctx->inner, inner_hash);

    SYN_SHA512 outer;
    syn_sha384_init(&outer);
    syn_sha512_update(&outer, ctx->o_key_pad, sizeof(ctx->o_key_pad));
    syn_sha512_update(&outer, inner_hash, sizeof(inner_hash));
    syn_sha384_final(&outer, mac);

    syn_secure_zero(inner_hash, sizeof(inner_hash));
    syn_secure_zero(&outer, sizeof(outer));
    syn_secure_zero(ctx, sizeof(*ctx));
}

void syn_hmac_sha512(const void *key, size_t key_len, const void *data, size_t data_len,
                     uint8_t mac[SYN_SHA512_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (mac == NULL || (key == NULL && key_len > 0U) || (data == NULL && data_len > 0U)) {
        return;
    }

    SYN_HMAC_SHA512 ctx;
    syn_hmac_sha512_init(&ctx, key, key_len);
    syn_hmac_sha512_update(&ctx, data, data_len);
    syn_hmac_sha512_final(&ctx, mac);
}

void syn_hmac_sha384(const void *key, size_t key_len, const void *data, size_t data_len,
                     uint8_t mac[SYN_SHA384_DIGEST_SIZE])
{
    if (mac == NULL || (key == NULL && key_len > 0U) || (data == NULL && data_len > 0U)) {
        return;
    }

    SYN_HMAC_SHA384 ctx;
    syn_hmac_sha384_init(&ctx, key, key_len);
    syn_hmac_sha384_update(&ctx, data, data_len);
    syn_hmac_sha384_final(&ctx, mac);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SHA512 */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements FIPS 180-4 compliant SHA-512 and SHA-384 secure hash algorithms and RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA512 / HMAC-SHA384 message authentication.

Follows the streaming pattern: init → update (repeated) → final

The context struct is caller-owned (~216 bytes on 32-bit/64-bit targets). Zero heap allocation, zero floating point.

** **

// One-shot SHA-512:
uint8_t hash512[64];
syn_sha512("abc", 3, hash512);

// One-shot SHA-384:
uint8_t hash384[48];
syn_sha384("abc", 3, hash384);

// Streaming SHA-512:
SYN_SHA512 ctx;
syn_sha512_init(&ctx);
syn_sha512_update(&ctx, chunk1, len1);
syn_sha512_update(&ctx, chunk2, len2);
syn_sha512_final(&ctx, hash512);

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"

#define TPM2_ALG_RSASSA 0x0014U
#define TPM2_ALG_RSAPSS 0x0016U
#define TPM2_ALG_ECDSA 0x0018U

/* ── Internal Big-Endian Marshalling Helpers ─────────────────────────────── */

static bool tpm2_write_u16(uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, uint16_t v)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || (max_len - *pos) < 2U) {
        return false;
    }
    buf[*pos] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    buf[*pos + 1U] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    *pos += 2U;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_write_u32(uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, uint32_t v)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || (max_len - *pos) < 4U) {
        return false;
    }
    buf[*pos] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    buf[*pos + 1U] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    buf[*pos + 2U] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    buf[*pos + 3U] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    *pos += 4U;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_write_bytes(uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, const uint8_t *data,
                             size_t len)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || len > (max_len - *pos)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (len > 0U && data != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(&buf[*pos], data, len);
    }
    *pos += len;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_read_u16(const uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, uint16_t *out_v)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || (max_len - *pos) < 2U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (out_v != NULL) {
        *out_v = ((uint16_t)buf[*pos] << 8U) | (uint16_t)buf[*pos + 1U];
    }
    *pos += 2U;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_read_u32(const uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, uint32_t *out_v)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || (max_len - *pos) < 4U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (out_v != NULL) {
        *out_v = ((uint32_t)buf[*pos] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)buf[*pos + 1U] << 16U) |
                 ((uint32_t)buf[*pos + 2U] << 8U) | (uint32_t)buf[*pos + 3U];
    }
    *pos += 4U;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_read_bytes(const uint8_t *buf, size_t *pos, size_t max_len, uint8_t *out_data,
                            size_t len)
{
    if (*pos > max_len || len > (max_len - *pos)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (len > 0U && out_data != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(out_data, &buf[*pos], len);
    }
    *pos += len;
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status tpm2_execute_command(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, size_t cmd_len, size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    /* Patch paramSize in command header (bytes 2..5) */
    uint32_t ulen = (uint32_t)cmd_len;
    ctx->cfg.tx_buf[2] = (uint8_t)((ulen >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    ctx->cfg.tx_buf[3] = (uint8_t)((ulen >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    ctx->cfg.tx_buf[4] = (uint8_t)((ulen >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    ctx->cfg.tx_buf[5] = (uint8_t)(ulen & 0xFFU);

    if (!syn_transport_send(ctx->cfg.transport, ctx->cfg.tx_buf, cmd_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_transport_recv(ctx->cfg.transport, ctx->cfg.rx_buf, ctx->cfg.rx_buf_size, &rx_len) ||
        rx_len < 10U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rpos = 0U;
    uint16_t tag = 0U;
    uint32_t param_size = 0U;
    uint32_t rc = 0U;

    (void)tpm2_read_u16(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, rx_len, &tag);
    (void)tpm2_read_u32(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, rx_len, &param_size);
    (void)tpm2_read_u32(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, rx_len, &rc);

    ctx->last_rc = rc;
    if ((tag != SYN_TPM2_ST_NO_SESSIONS && tag != SYN_TPM2_ST_SESSIONS) ||
        rc != SYN_TPM2_RC_SUCCESS || param_size < 10U || (size_t)param_size > rx_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (out_resp_len != NULL) {
        *out_resp_len = (size_t)param_size;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool tpm2_write_pw_auth_session(uint8_t *tx, size_t *pos, size_t max_len)
{
    /* Auth area size = 9 bytes (Handle 4 + Nonce 2 + Attr 1 + Password 2) */
    if (!tpm2_write_u32(tx, pos, max_len, 9U)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!tpm2_write_u32(tx, pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_RS_PW)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!tpm2_write_u16(tx, pos, max_len, 0U)) { /* Empty nonce */
        return false;
    }
    if (*pos >= max_len) {
        return false;
    }
    tx[(*pos)++] = 0U;                           /* Session attributes */
    return tpm2_write_u16(tx, pos, max_len, 0U); /* Empty password */
}

/* ── Public API Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_init(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, const SYN_TPM2_Config *cfg)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->transport == NULL || cfg->rx_buf == NULL || cfg->tx_buf == NULL ||
        cfg->rx_buf_size < 256U || cfg->tx_buf_size < 256U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(ctx, 0, sizeof(*ctx));
    ctx->cfg = *cfg;
    ctx->initialized = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_startup(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint16_t startup_type)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_NO_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U); /* Placeholder for paramSize */
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_STARTUP);
    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, startup_type);

    return tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, NULL);
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_self_test(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, bool full_test)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_NO_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_SELFTEST);
    if (pos >= max_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    tx[pos++] = full_test ? 1U : 0U;

    return tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, NULL);
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_get_random(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint16_t num_bytes, uint8_t *out_random,
                               uint16_t *out_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || out_random == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_NO_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_GETRANDOM);
    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, num_bytes);

    size_t resp_len = 0U;
    if (tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, &resp_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rpos = 10U; /* Skip Tag, Size, RC */
    uint16_t rand_len = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, &rand_len) || rand_len > num_bytes ||
        !tpm2_read_bytes(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, out_random, rand_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (out_len != NULL) {
        *out_len = rand_len;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool tpm2_skip_pcr_selections(const uint8_t *rx, size_t *rpos, size_t resp_len)
{
    uint32_t sel_count = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u32(rx, rpos, resp_len, &sel_count)) {
        return false;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < sel_count; i++) {
        uint16_t alg = 0U;
        if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, rpos, resp_len, &alg) || *rpos >= resp_len) {
            return false;
        }
        uint8_t sz = rx[(*rpos)++];
        if ((size_t)sz > (resp_len - *rpos)) {
            return false;
        }
        *rpos += sz;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_build_pcr_read_cmd(uint8_t *tx, size_t max_len, uint32_t pcr_index,
                                    uint16_t hash_alg, size_t *out_pos)
{
    size_t pos = 0U;
    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_NO_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_PCR_READ);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 1U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, hash_alg);
    if ((max_len - pos) < 4U) {
        return false;
    }
    tx[pos++] = 3U;
    tx[pos++] = (uint8_t)((1U << (pcr_index & 7U)) * (pcr_index < 8U ? 1U : 0U));
    tx[pos++] =
        (uint8_t)((1U << (pcr_index & 7U)) * ((pcr_index >= 8U && pcr_index < 16U) ? 1U : 0U));
    tx[pos++] = (uint8_t)((1U << (pcr_index & 7U)) * (pcr_index >= 16U ? 1U : 0U));
    *out_pos = pos;
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status tpm2_parse_pcr_read_resp(const uint8_t *rx, size_t resp_len, uint16_t hash_alg,
                                           uint8_t *out_digest, size_t *out_digest_len)
{
    size_t rpos = 10U;
    uint32_t pcr_update_counter = 0U;
    uint32_t digest_count = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u32(rx, &rpos, resp_len, &pcr_update_counter) ||
        !tpm2_skip_pcr_selections(rx, &rpos, resp_len) ||
        !tpm2_read_u32(rx, &rpos, resp_len, &digest_count) || digest_count == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t digest_cap = (hash_alg == SYN_TPM2_ALG_SHA256) ? 32U : SYN_TPM2_MAX_DIGEST_LEN;
    uint16_t dlen = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, &rpos, resp_len, &dlen) || dlen == 0U || (size_t)dlen > digest_cap ||
        !tpm2_read_bytes(rx, &rpos, resp_len, out_digest, dlen)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (out_digest_len != NULL) {
        *out_digest_len = dlen;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_pcr_read(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint32_t pcr_index, uint16_t hash_alg,
                             uint8_t *out_digest, size_t *out_digest_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || out_digest == NULL || pcr_index > 23U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t resp_len = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_build_pcr_read_cmd(ctx->cfg.tx_buf, ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size, pcr_index, hash_alg,
                                 &pos) ||
        tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, &resp_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return tpm2_parse_pcr_read_resp(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, resp_len, hash_alg, out_digest,
                                    out_digest_len);
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_pcr_extend(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint32_t pcr_index, uint16_t hash_alg,
                               const uint8_t *in_digest, size_t digest_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || in_digest == NULL || pcr_index > 23U ||
        digest_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_PCR_EXTEND);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, pcr_index);

    /* Session area */
    if (!tpm2_write_pw_auth_session(tx, &pos, max_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* TPML_DIGEST_VALUES: count = 1, TPMT_HA (hashAlg, digest) */
    if (!tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 1U) || !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, hash_alg) ||
        !tpm2_write_bytes(tx, &pos, max_len, in_digest, digest_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, NULL);
}

static bool tpm2_read_sized_blob(const uint8_t *rx, size_t *rpos, size_t resp_len, uint8_t *dst,
                                 size_t dst_cap, uint16_t *out_len)
{
    uint16_t blen = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, rpos, resp_len, &blen) || (size_t)blen > dst_cap ||
        !tpm2_read_bytes(rx, rpos, resp_len, dst, blen)) {
        return false;
    }
    *out_len = blen;
    return true;
}

static bool tpm2_read_ecdsa_coord(const uint8_t *rx, size_t *rpos, size_t resp_len,
                                  uint8_t dst32[32])
{
    uint16_t clen = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, rpos, resp_len, &clen) || clen == 0U || clen > 32U) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)memset(dst32, 0, 32U);
    return tpm2_read_bytes(rx, rpos, resp_len, &dst32[32U - clen], clen);
}

static bool tpm2_unmarshal_signature(const uint8_t *rx, size_t *rpos, size_t resp_len,
                                     SYN_TPM2_QuoteResult *out_quote)
{
    uint16_t sig_alg = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, rpos, resp_len, &sig_alg) || sig_alg == SYN_TPM2_ALG_NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    uint16_t hash_alg = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u16(rx, rpos, resp_len, &hash_alg)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (sig_alg == TPM2_ALG_RSASSA || sig_alg == TPM2_ALG_RSAPSS) {
        return tpm2_read_sized_blob(rx, rpos, resp_len, out_quote->signature,
                                    SYN_TPM2_MAX_QUOTE_LEN, &out_quote->signature_len);
    }

    if (sig_alg == TPM2_ALG_ECDSA) {
        if (!tpm2_read_ecdsa_coord(rx, rpos, resp_len, &out_quote->signature[0]) ||
            !tpm2_read_ecdsa_coord(rx, rpos, resp_len, &out_quote->signature[32])) {
            return false;
        }
        out_quote->signature_len = 64U;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool tpm2_build_quote_cmd(uint8_t *tx, size_t max_len, uint32_t key_handle,
                                 const uint8_t *qualifying_data, size_t qual_len, uint32_t pcr_mask,
                                 size_t *out_pos)
{
    size_t pos = 0U;
    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_QUOTE);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, key_handle);

    if (!tpm2_write_pw_auth_session(tx, &pos, max_len) ||
        !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, (uint16_t)qual_len) ||
        !tpm2_write_bytes(tx, &pos, max_len, qualifying_data, qual_len) ||
        !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ALG_NULL) ||
        !tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 1U) ||
        !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ALG_SHA256) || ((max_len - pos) < 4U)) {
        return false;
    }

    tx[pos++] = 3U;
    tx[pos++] = (uint8_t)(pcr_mask & 0xFFU);
    tx[pos++] = (uint8_t)((pcr_mask >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[pos++] = (uint8_t)((pcr_mask >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    *out_pos = pos;
    return true;
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_quote(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint32_t key_handle,
                          const uint8_t *qualifying_data, size_t qual_len, uint32_t pcr_mask,
                          SYN_TPM2_QuoteResult *out_quote)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || out_quote == NULL || qual_len > 64U ||
        (qualifying_data == NULL && qual_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t resp_len = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_build_quote_cmd(ctx->cfg.tx_buf, ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size, key_handle, qualifying_data,
                              qual_len, pcr_mask, &pos) ||
        tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, &resp_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rpos = 10U;
    uint32_t param_sz = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u32(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, &param_sz) ||
        !tpm2_read_sized_blob(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, out_quote->attest_data,
                              SYN_TPM2_MAX_QUOTE_LEN, &out_quote->attest_len) ||
        !tpm2_unmarshal_signature(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, out_quote)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_nv_read(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint32_t auth_handle, uint32_t nv_index,
                            uint16_t offset, uint16_t size, uint8_t *out_data, uint16_t *out_len)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || out_data == NULL || size == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_NV_READ);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, auth_handle);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, nv_index);

    if (!tpm2_write_pw_auth_session(tx, &pos, max_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (!tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, size) || !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, offset)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t resp_len = 0U;
    if (tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, &resp_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rpos = 10U;
    uint32_t param_sz = 0U;
    uint16_t read_len = 0U;
    if (!tpm2_read_u32(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, &param_sz) ||
        !tpm2_read_sized_blob(ctx->cfg.rx_buf, &rpos, resp_len, out_data, size, &read_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (out_len != NULL) {
        *out_len = read_len;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_tpm2_nv_write(SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx, uint32_t auth_handle, uint32_t nv_index,
                             uint16_t offset, const uint8_t *in_data, uint16_t size)
{
    if (ctx == NULL || !ctx->initialized || in_data == NULL || size == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = ctx->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    size_t max_len = ctx->cfg.tx_buf_size;

    (void)tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_ST_SESSIONS);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, 0U);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, SYN_TPM2_CC_NV_WRITE);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, auth_handle);
    (void)tpm2_write_u32(tx, &pos, max_len, nv_index);

    if (!tpm2_write_pw_auth_session(tx, &pos, max_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* TPM2B_MAX_NV_BUFFER */
    if (!tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, size) ||
        !tpm2_write_bytes(tx, &pos, max_len, in_data, size) ||
        !tpm2_write_u16(tx, &pos, max_len, offset)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return tpm2_execute_command(ctx, pos, NULL);
}

uint32_t syn_tpm2_get_last_rc(const SYN_TPM2_Context *ctx)
{
    return (ctx != NULL) ? ctx->last_rc : 0U;
}

#endif /* !defined(SYN_USE_TPM2) || SYN_USE_TPM2 */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic TCG TPM 2.0 command serializer and response parser: * Direct interface over SPI / I2C / LPC TCG FIFO hardware interface (SYN_Transport). * Measured Boot PCR Operations (TPM2_PCR_Read, TPM2_PCR_Extend for SHA-256 / SHA-384). * Hardware Cryptographic Entropy (TPM2_GetRandom). * Hardware Identity & Remote Attestation Quotes (TPM2_Quote). * Tamper-Proof Non-Volatile Storage (TPM2_NV_Read, TPM2_NV_Write). * Power & Self-Test Lifecycle (TPM2_Startup, TPM2_SelfTest).

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Based on the TweetNaCl approach: 16 × int64_t limbs (16 bits each). Simpler and more auditable than 10-limb donna at the cost of some speed. The entire scalar multiplication takes ~10M multiplies.

On Cortex-M4 @ 64 MHz this is ~2-4 seconds — acceptable since handshakes only happen every ~2 minutes.

docs.title: function syn_x25519
docs.text:
X25519 scalar multiplication. 

void syn_x25519 (
    uint8_t shared_out,
    const uint8_t scalar,
    const uint8_t point
)

Computes shared = scalar * point on Curve25519. Callers invoking syn_x25519() directly in Diffie-Hellman protocols MUST verify in constant time that shared_out is not all-zero (RFC 7748 Section 6.1) to reject low-order input points.

Parameters:

  • shared_out Output: 32-byte shared secret.
  • scalar 32-byte private scalar (clamped internally per RFC 7748).
  • point 32-byte public point (peer's public key).

docs.title: function syn_x25519_pt
docs.text:
Cooperative protothread for sliced X25519 scalar multiplication. 

SYN_PT_Status syn_x25519_pt (
    SYN_PT * pt,
    SYN_X25519_Ctx * ctx,
    uint8_t shared_out
)

Executes one Montgomery ladder or field inversion step per slice and yields PT_MORE via PT_CONTINUE(pt). Automatically wipes ctx before completing with PT_ENDED. Composes with PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED(pt, task, child, syn_x25519_pt(...)) for demand-driven yielding.

Parameters:

  • pt Protothread control block.
  • ctx Initialized X25519 context.
  • shared_out [out] 32-byte output buffer populated on PT_ENDED.

Returns:

PT_MORE while in progress, PT_ENDED on completion, or PT_EXITED on invalid args.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_X25519) || SYN_USE_X25519


#include "../util/syn_pack.h"
#include "syn_x25519.h"

#include <string.h>

static void syn_secure_zero(void *v, size_t n)
{
    volatile uint8_t *p = (volatile uint8_t *)v;
    while (n-- > 0U) {
        *p++ = 0U;
    }
}

typedef int32_t gf[16];

static const gf gf0 = {0};
static const gf gf1 = {1};
static const gf _121665 = {0xDB41, 1};

/* ── Field Arithmetic (GF(2^255 - 19), 16 × 16-bit limbs) ──────────── */

static void car25519_64(int64_t o[16])
{
    int64_t c;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] += (1LL << 16);
        c = o[i] >> 16;
        o[(i + 1) * (i < 15)] += c - 1 + 37 * (c - 1) * (i == 15);
        o[i] -= (int64_t)((uint64_t)c << 16);
    }
}

static void sel25519(gf p, gf q, int b)
{
    uint32_t mask = 0U - (uint32_t)(b & 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint32_t t = mask & ((uint32_t)p[i] ^ (uint32_t)q[i]);
        p[i] = (int32_t)((uint32_t)p[i] ^ t);
        q[i] = (int32_t)((uint32_t)q[i] ^ t);
    }
}

static void sel25519_64(int64_t p[16], int64_t q[16], int b)
{
    uint64_t mask = 0ULL - (uint64_t)(b & 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        uint64_t t = mask & ((uint64_t)p[i] ^ (uint64_t)q[i]);
        p[i] = (int64_t)((uint64_t)p[i] ^ t);
        q[i] = (int64_t)((uint64_t)q[i] ^ t);
    }
}

static void pack25519(uint8_t o[32], const gf n)
{
    int i;
    int j;
    int64_t b;
    int64_t m[16];
    int64_t t[16];
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        t[i] = (int64_t)n[i];
    }
    car25519_64(t);
    car25519_64(t);
    car25519_64(t);
    for (j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
        m[0] = t[0] - 0xFFED;
        for (i = 1; i < 15; i++) {
            m[i] = t[i] - 0xFFFF - ((m[i - 1] >> 16) & 1);
            m[i - 1] &= 0xFFFF;
        }
        m[15] = t[15] - 0x7FFF - ((m[14] >> 16) & 1);
        b = (m[15] >> 16) & 1;
        m[14] &= 0xFFFF;
        sel25519_64(t, m, (int)(1 - b));
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        syn_poke_u16_le((uint16_t)t[i], o, 2 * i);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(m, sizeof(m));
    syn_secure_zero(t, sizeof(t));
}

static void unpack25519(gf o, const uint8_t n[32])
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] = (int32_t)syn_peek_u16_le(n, 2 * i);
    }
    o[15] &= 0x7FFF;
}

static void A(gf o, const gf a, const gf b)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] = a[i] + b[i];
    }
}

static void Z(gf o, const gf a, const gf b)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] = a[i] - b[i];
    }
}

static void M(gf o, const gf a, const gf b)
{
    int64_t t[31] = {0};
    int i;
    int j;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        int64_t ai = (int64_t)a[i];
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
            t[i + j] += ai * (int64_t)b[j];
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        t[i] += 38LL * t[i + 16];
    }
    car25519_64(t);
    car25519_64(t);
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] = (int32_t)t[i];
    }
}

static void S(gf o, const gf a)
{
    int64_t t[31] = {0};
    int i;
    int j;
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        int64_t ai = (int64_t)a[i];
        t[2 * i] += ai * ai;
        int64_t ai2 = ai * 2;
        for (j = i + 1; j < 16; j++) {
            t[i + j] += ai2 * (int64_t)a[j];
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        t[i] += 38LL * t[i + 16];
    }
    car25519_64(t);
    car25519_64(t);
    for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        o[i] = (int32_t)t[i];
    }
}

static void x25519_ladder_step(SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx)
{
    gf e;
    gf f;
    uint16_t bit = (uint16_t)(254U - ctx->idx);
    int r = (int)((ctx->z[bit >> 3U] >> (bit & 7U)) & 1U);

    sel25519(ctx->a, ctx->b, r);
    sel25519(ctx->c, ctx->d, r);
    A(e, ctx->a, ctx->c);
    Z(ctx->a, ctx->a, ctx->c);
    A(ctx->c, ctx->b, ctx->d);
    Z(ctx->b, ctx->b, ctx->d);
    S(ctx->d, e);
    S(f, ctx->a);
    M(ctx->a, ctx->c, ctx->a);
    M(ctx->c, ctx->b, e);
    A(e, ctx->a, ctx->c);
    Z(ctx->a, ctx->a, ctx->c);
    S(ctx->b, ctx->a);
    Z(ctx->c, ctx->d, f);
    M(ctx->a, ctx->c, _121665);
    A(ctx->a, ctx->a, ctx->d);
    M(ctx->c, ctx->c, ctx->a);
    M(ctx->a, ctx->d, f);
    M(ctx->d, ctx->b, ctx->x);
    S(ctx->b, e);
    sel25519(ctx->a, ctx->b, r);
    sel25519(ctx->c, ctx->d, r);

    syn_secure_zero(e, sizeof(e));
    syn_secure_zero(f, sizeof(f));
}

static SYN_PT_Status x25519_ladder_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 255U; ctx->idx++) {
        x25519_ladder_step(ctx);
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

static SYN_PT_Status x25519_inv_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx)
{
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    for (ctx->idx = 0U; ctx->idx < 254U; ctx->idx++) {
        uint16_t inv_i = (uint16_t)(253U - ctx->idx);
        S(ctx->c, ctx->c);
        if (inv_i != 2U && inv_i != 4U) {
            M(ctx->c, ctx->c, ctx->d);
        }
        PT_CONTINUE(pt);
    }
    PT_END(pt);
}

/* ── X25519 scalar multiplication (Montgomery ladder) ───────────────── */

bool syn_x25519_init(SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t scalar[32], const uint8_t point[32])
{
    if (ctx == NULL || scalar == NULL || point == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    syn_secure_zero(ctx, sizeof(*ctx));
    memcpy(ctx->z, scalar, 32U);
    ctx->z[31] = (uint8_t)((ctx->z[31] & 127U) | 64U);
    ctx->z[0] &= 248U;

    unpack25519(ctx->x, point);

    memcpy(ctx->b, ctx->x, sizeof(gf));
    memcpy(ctx->a, gf1, sizeof(gf));
    memcpy(ctx->d, gf1, sizeof(gf));
    memcpy(ctx->c, gf0, sizeof(gf));
    ctx->active = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_x25519_pubkey_init(SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t private_key[32])
{
    static const uint8_t basepoint[32] = {9U};
    return syn_x25519_init(ctx, private_key, basepoint);
}

void syn_x25519_wipe(SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx)
{
    if (ctx != NULL) {
        syn_secure_zero(ctx, sizeof(*ctx));
    }
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_x25519_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_X25519_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t shared_out[32])
{
    if (pt == NULL || ctx == NULL || shared_out == NULL || !ctx->active) {
        if (ctx != NULL) {
            syn_x25519_wipe(ctx);
        }
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, x25519_ladder_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));
    memcpy(ctx->d, ctx->c, sizeof(gf));
    PT_SPAWN(pt, &ctx->sub_pt, x25519_inv_pt(&ctx->sub_pt, ctx));

    M(ctx->a, ctx->a, ctx->c);
    pack25519(shared_out, ctx->a);
    syn_x25519_wipe(ctx);

    PT_END(pt);
}

void syn_x25519(uint8_t shared_out[32], const uint8_t scalar[32], const uint8_t point[32])
{
    SYN_X25519_Ctx ctx;
    SYN_PT pt;
    if (shared_out == NULL || !syn_x25519_init(&ctx, scalar, point)) {
        return;
    }
    PT_INIT(&pt);
    while (syn_x25519_pt(&pt, &ctx, shared_out) == PT_MORE) {
    }
}

void syn_x25519_pubkey(uint8_t public_out[32], const uint8_t private_key[32])
{
    static const uint8_t basepoint[32] = {9};
    syn_x25519(public_out, private_key, basepoint);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_X25519 */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman on Curve25519 using the Montgomery ladder. Provides shared-secret computation and public-key derivation.

This is the most computationally expensive WireGuard operation (~1–2 seconds on Cortex-M4 @ 64 MHz) but only runs during handshake, not on every packet.

** **

uint8_t my_priv[32], my_pub[32], shared[32];

// Generate keypair (private key = 32 random bytes, then clamp):
fill_random(my_priv, 32);
syn_x25519_clamp(my_priv);
syn_x25519_pubkey(my_pub, my_priv);

// Compute shared secret with peer's public key:
syn_x25519(shared, my_priv, peer_pub);

X25519 scalar multiplication. 

void syn_x25519 (
    uint8_t shared_out,
    const uint8_t scalar,
    const uint8_t point

Computes shared = scalar * point on Curve25519. Callers invoking syn_x25519() directly in Diffie-Hellman protocols MUST verify in constant time that shared_out is not all-zero (RFC 7748 Section 6.1) to reject low-order input points.

Parameters:

  • shared_out Output: 32-byte shared secret.
  • scalar 32-byte private scalar (clamped internally per RFC 7748).
  • point 32-byte public point (peer's public key).

Executes one Montgomery ladder or field inversion step per slice and yields PT_MORE via PT_CONTINUE(pt). Automatically wipes ctx before completing with PT_ENDED. Composes with PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED(pt, task, child, syn_x25519_pt(...)) for demand-driven yielding.

typedef struct {
    uint8_t z[32]; 
    int32_t x[16]; 
    int32_t a[16]; 
    int32_t b[16]; 
    int32_t c[16]; 
    int32_t d[16]; 
    SYN_PT sub_pt; 
    uint16_t idx;  
    bool active;   
} SYN_X25519_Ctx;

void syn_x25519(uint8_t shared_out[32], const uint8_t scalar[32], const uint8_t point[32]);

void syn_x25519_pubkey(uint8_t public_out[32], const uint8_t private_key[32]);

static inline void syn_x25519_clamp(uint8_t key[32])
{
    key[0] &= 248U;  /* Clear low 3 bits (multiple of 8) */
    key[31] &= 127U; /* Clear high bit */
    key[31] |= 64U;  /* Set second-highest bit */
}

static inline bool syn_x25519_is_nonzero(const uint8_t secret[32])
{
    uint8_t acc = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 32U; i++) {
        acc |= secret[i];
    }
    return acc != 0U;
}
