#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_gpio.h"
#include "syn_soft_spi.h"

static void spi_delay(const SYN_SoftSPI *spi)
{
    for (volatile uint32_t i = 0; i < spi->delay_loops; i++) {
        // NOP loop
    }
}

void syn_soft_spi_init(SYN_SoftSPI *spi, SYN_GPIO_Pin sck, SYN_GPIO_Pin mosi, SYN_GPIO_Pin miso,
                       SYN_SPIMode mode, uint32_t delay_loops)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(spi != NULL);
    spi->sck = sck;
    spi->mosi = mosi;
    spi->miso = miso;
    spi->mode = mode;
    spi->delay_loops = delay_loops;

    syn_gpio_init(spi->sck, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);
    syn_gpio_init(spi->mosi, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);
    syn_gpio_init(spi->miso, SYN_GPIO_INPUT);

    bool cpol = (spi->mode == SYN_SPI_MODE_2 || spi->mode == SYN_SPI_MODE_3);
    spi->cpha = (spi->mode == SYN_SPI_MODE_1 || spi->mode == SYN_SPI_MODE_3);

    spi->idle_state = cpol ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW;
    spi->active_state = cpol ? SYN_GPIO_LOW : SYN_GPIO_HIGH;

    // Set idle clock state based on CPOL
    syn_gpio_write(spi->sck, spi->idle_state);

    syn_gpio_write(spi->mosi, SYN_GPIO_LOW);

    spi->cs_pin = (SYN_GPIO_Pin)-1; /* No CS by default */
}

uint8_t syn_soft_spi_transfer(const SYN_SoftSPI *spi, uint8_t data)
{
    uint8_t rx_data = 0;

    SYN_GPIO_State idle = spi->idle_state;
    SYN_GPIO_State active = spi->active_state;

    for (uint8_t mask = 0x80; mask != 0; mask >>= 1) {
        if (!spi->cpha) {
            // Mode 0 or 2: Set data on idle-to-active edge
            syn_gpio_write(spi->mosi, (data & mask) ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW);
            spi_delay(spi);
            syn_gpio_write(spi->sck, active);
            spi_delay(spi);
            if (syn_gpio_read(spi->miso) == SYN_GPIO_HIGH) {
                rx_data |= mask;
            }
            syn_gpio_write(spi->sck, idle);
            spi_delay(spi);
        } else {
            // Mode 1 or 3: Set data on active-to-idle edge
            syn_gpio_write(spi->sck, active);
            syn_gpio_write(spi->mosi, (data & mask) ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW);
            spi_delay(spi);
            syn_gpio_write(spi->sck, idle);
            spi_delay(spi);
            if (syn_gpio_read(spi->miso) == SYN_GPIO_HIGH) {
                rx_data |= mask;
            }
            spi_delay(spi);
        }
    }
    return rx_data;
}

void syn_soft_spi_transfer_bulk(SYN_SoftSPI *spi, const uint8_t *tx, uint8_t *rx, size_t len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(spi != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(tx != NULL || rx != NULL);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        uint8_t tx_byte = tx ? tx[i] : 0xFF;
        uint8_t rx_byte = syn_soft_spi_transfer(spi, tx_byte);
        if (rx) {
            rx[i] = rx_byte;
        }
    }
}

void syn_soft_spi_set_cs(SYN_SoftSPI *spi, SYN_GPIO_Pin cs_pin, bool active_low)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(spi != NULL);
    spi->cs_pin = cs_pin;
    spi->cs_active_low = active_low;
    syn_gpio_init(cs_pin, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);
    /* Start deasserted */
    syn_gpio_write(cs_pin, active_low ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW);
}

void syn_soft_spi_select(SYN_SoftSPI *spi)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(spi != NULL);
    if (spi->cs_pin == (SYN_GPIO_Pin)-1)
        return;
    syn_gpio_write(spi->cs_pin, spi->cs_active_low ? SYN_GPIO_LOW : SYN_GPIO_HIGH);
}

void syn_soft_spi_deselect(SYN_SoftSPI *spi)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(spi != NULL);
    if (spi->cs_pin == (SYN_GPIO_Pin)-1)
        return;
    syn_gpio_write(spi->cs_pin, spi->cs_active_low ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SOFT_SPI */

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SPI) || SYN_USE_SPI


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_spi.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_spi_init(SYN_SPI *spi, const SYN_SPI_Config *cfg)
{
    if (spi == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(spi, 0, sizeof(*spi));
    spi->cfg = *cfg;

    if (spi->cfg.baudrate_hz == 0) {
        spi->cfg.baudrate_hz = 1000000; /* Default 1 MHz */
    }

    SYN_Status status =
        syn_port_spi_init(cfg->spi_id, cfg->baudrate_hz, (uint8_t)cfg->mode, (uint8_t)cfg->role);
    if (status != SYN_OK) {
        return status;
    }

    spi->initialized = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_deinit(SYN_SPI *spi)
{
    if (spi == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (!spi->initialized) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    SYN_Status status = syn_port_spi_deinit(spi->cfg.spi_id);
    spi->initialized = false;
    return status;
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_transfer(SYN_SPI *spi, const uint8_t *tx, uint8_t *rx, size_t len)
{
    if (spi == NULL || !spi->initialized || len == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    return syn_port_spi_transfer(spi->cfg.spi_id, tx, rx, len);
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_write(SYN_SPI *spi, const uint8_t *tx, size_t len)
{
    return syn_spi_transfer(spi, tx, NULL, len);
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_read(SYN_SPI *spi, uint8_t *rx, size_t len)
{
    return syn_spi_transfer(spi, NULL, rx, len);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SPI */

#ifndef SYN_SPI_DEV_H
#define SYN_SPI_DEV_H

#include "../common/syn_defs.h"
#include "../port/syn_port_gpio.h"
#include "../port/syn_port_spi.h"

#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Device descriptor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint8_t bus;      
    SYN_GPIO_Pin cs;  
    uint8_t read_bit; 
} SYN_SPIDev;

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static inline void syn_spi_dev_init(SYN_SPIDev *dev, uint8_t bus, SYN_GPIO_Pin cs, uint8_t read_bit)
{
    dev->bus = bus;
    dev->cs = cs;
    dev->read_bit = read_bit;
}

static inline uint8_t syn_spi_dev_read8(const SYN_SPIDev *dev, uint8_t reg)
{
    uint8_t tx[2] = {(uint8_t)(reg | dev->read_bit), 0x00};
    uint8_t rx[2] = {0, 0};

    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
    (void)syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, tx, rx, 2U);
    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_HIGH);

    return rx[1];
}

static inline SYN_Status syn_spi_dev_write8(const SYN_SPIDev *dev, uint8_t reg, uint8_t val)
{
    uint8_t tx[2] = {reg, val};

    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
    SYN_Status st = syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, tx, NULL, 2U);
    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_HIGH);

    return st;
}

static inline SYN_Status syn_spi_dev_read_burst(const SYN_SPIDev *dev, uint8_t reg, uint8_t *buf,
                                                size_t len)
{
    uint8_t tx_reg = (uint8_t)(reg | dev->read_bit);

    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
    SYN_Status st = syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, &tx_reg, NULL, 1U);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        /* Subsequent clocks to read data */
        uint8_t zeros[32];
        memset(zeros, 0, sizeof(zeros));
        while (len > 0U) {
            size_t chunk = (len > 32U) ? 32U : len;
            st = syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, zeros, buf, chunk);
            if (st != SYN_OK) {
                break;
            }
            buf += chunk;
            len -= chunk;
        }
    }

    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_HIGH);
    return st;
}

static inline SYN_Status syn_spi_dev_write_burst(const SYN_SPIDev *dev, uint8_t reg,
                                                 const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
    SYN_Status st = syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, &reg, NULL, 1U);
    if (st == SYN_OK && len > 0U) {
        st = syn_port_spi_transfer(dev->bus, data, NULL, len);
    }
    (void)syn_port_gpio_write(dev->cs, SYN_GPIO_HIGH);

    return st;
}

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SYN_SPI_DEV_H */

#include "syn_spi_queue.h"

#include "../port/syn_port_gpio.h"
#include "../port/syn_port_spi.h"

#include <string.h>

#define SYN_SPI_QUEUE_DEFAULT_BAUD_HZ 1000000U

SYN_Status syn_spi_queue_init(SYN_SPI_Queue *q, uint8_t bus)
{
    if (q == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(q, 0, sizeof(*q));
    q->bus = bus;
    q->initialized = true;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_queue_enqueue(SYN_SPI_Queue *q, const SYN_SPI_Transaction *tx)
{
    if ((q == NULL) || !q->initialized || (tx == NULL) || ((uint8_t)tx->mode > 3U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (q->count >= SYN_SPI_QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    q->ring[q->tail] = *tx;
    q->tail = (uint16_t)((q->tail + 1U) % SYN_SPI_QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH);
    q->count++;

    return syn_spi_queue_process(q);
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_queue_process(SYN_SPI_Queue *q)
{
    if ((q == NULL) || !q->initialized) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (q->active) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    while ((q->count > 0U) && !q->active) {
        SYN_SPI_Transaction tx = q->ring[q->head];
        q->head = (uint16_t)((q->head + 1U) % SYN_SPI_QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH);
        q->count--;
        q->active = true;

        uint8_t target_bus = (tx.bus != 0U) ? tx.bus : q->bus;
        uint32_t baud = (tx.baudrate_hz != 0U) ? tx.baudrate_hz : SYN_SPI_QUEUE_DEFAULT_BAUD_HZ;
        uint8_t mode = (uint8_t)tx.mode;

        SYN_Status status = SYN_OK;
        if (!q->bus_configured || (target_bus != q->configured_bus) ||
            (baud != q->configured_baud_hz) || (mode != q->configured_mode)) {
            status = syn_port_spi_init(target_bus, baud, mode, 0U);
            if (status == SYN_OK) {
                q->bus_configured = true;
                q->configured_bus = target_bus;
                q->configured_baud_hz = baud;
                q->configured_mode = mode;
            }
        }

        if (status == SYN_OK) {
            syn_port_gpio_write(tx.cs_pin, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
            status = syn_port_spi_transfer(target_bus, tx.tx_data, tx.rx_data, tx.len);
            if (!tx.keep_cs_active) {
                syn_port_gpio_write(tx.cs_pin, SYN_GPIO_HIGH);
            }
        }

        q->active = false;

        if (tx.callback != NULL) {
            tx.callback(target_bus, status, tx.user_data);
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_spi_queue_cancel_all(SYN_SPI_Queue *q)
{
    if ((q == NULL) || !q->initialized) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q->head = 0U;
    q->tail = 0U;
    q->count = 0U;
    q->active = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

size_t syn_spi_queue_count(const SYN_SPI_Queue *q)
{
    if ((q == NULL) || !q->initialized) {
        return 0U;
    }

    return (size_t)q->count;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_TIMESYNC) || SYN_USE_TIMESYNC


#include "syn_timesync.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_timesync_init(SYN_TimeSync *tsync)
{
    if (tsync == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memset(tsync, 0, sizeof(SYN_TimeSync));
    tsync->base_jitter_ns = SYN_TIMESYNC_DEFAULT_JITTER_NS;
    tsync->max_holdover_s = SYN_TIMESYNC_DEFAULT_HOLDOVER_S;

#if SYN_TIMESYNC_HAS_RTC
    /* If hardware RTC is configured and valid, mark RTC as available */
    SYN_RTC_DateTime dt;
    if (syn_rtc_get(&dt) == SYN_OK && syn_rtc_is_valid(&dt)) {
        tsync->rtc_synced = true;
    }
#endif
}

/* ── Bind PPS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_timesync_bind_pps(SYN_TimeSync *tsync, const SYN_HPTimestamp *pps_ts,
                                 uint64_t utc_sec)
{
    if (tsync == NULL || pps_ts == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint64_t curr_ticks = syn_hpclock_resolve(pps_ts);
    uint32_t nominal_freq = syn_port_hpclock_freq_hz();

    if (tsync->has_pps_lock && tsync->pps_count > 0U && nominal_freq > 0U &&
        utc_sec == (tsync->last_utc_sec + 1ULL) && curr_ticks >= tsync->last_pps_ticks) {
        /*
         * Measure actual ticks elapsed between consecutive 1-second PPS pulses.
         * Calculate crystal drift PPM = ((actual - expected) * 1,000,000) / expected.
         */
        uint64_t actual_ticks = curr_ticks - tsync->last_pps_ticks;
        if (actual_ticks <= ((uint64_t)nominal_freq * 2ULL)) {
            int64_t diff_ticks = (int64_t)actual_ticks - (int64_t)nominal_freq;
            int32_t new_ppm = (int32_t)((diff_ticks * 1000000LL) / (int64_t)nominal_freq);

            if (tsync->pps_count == 1U || tsync->drift_ppm == 0) {
                tsync->drift_ppm = new_ppm;
            } else {
                /* 8-sample Exponential Moving Average (EMA) to smooth out PPS jitter */
                tsync->drift_ppm = (int32_t)(((int64_t)tsync->drift_ppm * 7LL + new_ppm) / 8LL);
            }
        }
    }

    /* Update anchors */
    tsync->prev_pps_ticks = tsync->last_pps_ticks;
    tsync->last_pps_ts = *pps_ts;
    tsync->last_pps_ticks = curr_ticks;
    tsync->last_utc_sec = utc_sec;
    tsync->pps_count++;
    tsync->has_pps_lock = true;

#if SYN_TIMESYNC_HAS_RTC
    /* Discipline hardware RTC to GPS time if RTC is enabled */
    SYN_RTC_DateTime dt;
    syn_rtc_from_epoch((uint32_t)utc_sec, &dt);
    if (syn_rtc_set(&dt) == SYN_OK) {
        tsync->rtc_synced = true;
    }
#endif

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Resolve UTC ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_timesync_resolve_utc(const SYN_TimeSync *tsync, const SYN_HPTimestamp *event_ts,
                                    SYN_UTCTimestamp *out_utc)
{
    if (tsync == NULL || event_ts == NULL || out_utc == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint64_t event_ticks = syn_hpclock_resolve(event_ts);
    uint32_t freq_hz = syn_port_hpclock_freq_hz();

    if (!tsync->has_pps_lock || freq_hz == 0) {
        /*
         * Tier 4 / Tier 3 Fallback: No active PPS lock ever acquired.
         */
#if SYN_TIMESYNC_HAS_RTC
        if (tsync->rtc_synced) {
            SYN_RTC_DateTime dt;
            if (syn_rtc_get(&dt) == SYN_OK) {
                out_utc->sec = syn_rtc_to_epoch(&dt);
                out_utc->nsec = 0;
                out_utc->uncertainty_ns = 1000000000U; /* ±1 second RTC precision */
                out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_RTC_SYNCED;
                return SYN_OK;
            }
        }
#endif
        /* Unsynced fallback: Monotonic ticks converted to nanoseconds */
        uint64_t total_ns = syn_hpclock_ticks_to_ns(event_ticks);
        out_utc->sec = total_ns / 1000000000ULL;
        out_utc->nsec = (uint32_t)(total_ns % 1000000000ULL);
        out_utc->uncertainty_ns = 0xFFFFFFFFU; /* Infinite / undefined error */
        out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_UNSYNCED;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    /* Compute tick offset relative to last PPS anchor */
    int64_t tick_delta = (int64_t)event_ticks - (int64_t)tsync->last_pps_ticks;
    int64_t ns_delta;

    if (tick_delta >= 0) {
        ns_delta = (int64_t)syn_hpclock_ticks_to_ns((uint64_t)tick_delta);
    } else {
        ns_delta = -(int64_t)syn_hpclock_ticks_to_ns((uint64_t)(-tick_delta));
    }

    /* Compute total seconds and sub-second nanoseconds */
    int64_t sec_offset = ns_delta / 1000000000LL;
    int64_t nsec_rem = ns_delta % 1000000000LL;

    if (nsec_rem < 0) {
        sec_offset -= 1;
        nsec_rem += 1000000000LL;
    }

    out_utc->sec = (uint64_t)((int64_t)tsync->last_utc_sec + sec_offset);
    out_utc->nsec = (uint32_t)nsec_rem;

    /*
     * Quality Tier & Uncertainty Evaluation
     */
    uint64_t elapsed_s = (tick_delta >= 0) ? (uint64_t)tick_delta / freq_hz : 0;

    if (elapsed_s <= 1) {
        /* Tier 1: Active PPS lock within 1 second */
        out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_GPS_PPS;
        out_utc->uncertainty_ns = tsync->base_jitter_ns;
    } else if (elapsed_s <= tsync->max_holdover_s) {
        /* Tier 2: PPS holdover — error accumulates with drift */
        out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_GPS_HOLDOVER;
        uint64_t abs_drift = (tsync->drift_ppm < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)tsync->drift_ppm)
                                                    : (uint64_t)tsync->drift_ppm;
        uint64_t drift_us = abs_drift * elapsed_s;
        if (drift_us > (uint64_t)(UINT32_MAX / 1000U)) {
            out_utc->uncertainty_ns = UINT32_MAX;
        } else {
            uint64_t uncert = (uint64_t)tsync->base_jitter_ns + (drift_us * 1000ULL);
            out_utc->uncertainty_ns = (uncert > UINT32_MAX) ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)uncert;
        }
    } else {
        /* Tier 3 or 4: Holdover expired */
#if SYN_TIMESYNC_HAS_RTC
        if (tsync->rtc_synced) {
            out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_RTC_SYNCED;
            out_utc->uncertainty_ns = 1000000000U;
        } else {
            out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_UNSYNCED;
            out_utc->uncertainty_ns = 0xFFFFFFFFU;
        }
#else
        out_utc->source = SYN_TIME_SOURCE_UNSYNCED;
        out_utc->uncertainty_ns = 0xFFFFFFFFU;
#endif
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Epoch Nanoseconds Helper ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

uint64_t syn_timesync_to_epoch_ns(const SYN_TimeSync *tsync, const SYN_HPTimestamp *event_ts)
{
    SYN_UTCTimestamp utc;
    if (syn_timesync_resolve_utc(tsync, event_ts, &utc) != SYN_OK) {
        return 0;
    }
    return utc.sec * 1000000000ULL + (uint64_t)utc.nsec;
}

/* ── PPS Lock Check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

bool syn_timesync_is_pps_locked(const SYN_TimeSync *tsync)
{
    if (tsync == NULL || !tsync->has_pps_lock) {
        return false;
    }
    /* Simple sanity check: has at least one PPS been bound */
    return true;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_TIMESYNC */

    SYN_TimeSync * tsync,
    const SYN_HPTimestamp * pps_ts,
    uint64_t utc_sec
)

Call this when an asynchronous epoch time sentence (e.g. NMEA $GPZDA) is received, pairing the integer UTC second with the PPS timestamp captured at the top of that second.

Measures crystal drift PPM against nominal syn_port_hpclock_freq_hz().

Parameters:

  • tsync TimeSync context. Must not be NULL.
  • pps_ts Timestamp snapshot captured by ISR at PPS rising edge.
  • utc_sec Universal UTC epoch second corresponding to this PPS pulse.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM if pps_ts is NULL.

)

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_transport_usb_cdc.h"

#include <string.h>

static bool cdc_transport_send(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U) || (len > sizeof(cdc->tx_buf))) {
        return false;
    }
    return (syn_usb_cdc_write(cdc, data, len) == SYN_OK);
}

static bool cdc_transport_recv(uint8_t *data, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (out_len == NULL)) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_cdc_read(cdc, data, max_len, out_len);
    return (st == SYN_OK) && (*out_len > 0U);
}

static bool cdc_transport_has_data(const void *ctx)
{
    return syn_usb_cdc_rx_available((const SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx);
}

void syn_transport_from_usb_cdc(SYN_Transport *t, SYN_USB_CDC *cdc)
{
    if (t == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    memset(t, 0, sizeof(*t));
    if (cdc != NULL) {
        t->send = cdc_transport_send;
        t->recv = cdc_transport_recv;
        t->has_data = cdc_transport_has_data;
        t->ctx = cdc;
    }
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_UART) || SYN_USE_UART


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_uart.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_uart_init(SYN_UART *uart, SYN_UARTInstance instance, uint32_t baudrate)
{
    SYN_UART_Config cfg = {.instance = instance, .baudrate = baudrate, .use_dma = false};
    return syn_uart_init_config(uart, &cfg);
}

SYN_Status syn_uart_init_config(SYN_UART *uart, const SYN_UART_Config *cfg)
{
    if (uart == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(uart, 0, sizeof(*uart));
    uart->instance = cfg->instance;
    uart->initialized = false;
    uart->use_dma = cfg->use_dma;

    syn_ringbuf_init(&uart->tx_rb, uart->tx_buf, sizeof(uart->tx_buf));
    syn_ringbuf_init(&uart->rx_rb, uart->rx_buf, sizeof(uart->rx_buf));

    SYN_Status status = syn_port_uart_init(cfg->instance, cfg->baudrate);
    if (status != SYN_OK) {
        return status;
    }

#if defined(SYN_USE_DMA) && SYN_USE_DMA
    if (cfg->use_dma) {
        SYN_DMA_Config dma_cfg = {.channel_id = cfg->dma_channel_rx,
                                  .dir = SYN_DMA_DIR_PERIPH_TO_MEM,
                                  .data_size = SYN_DMA_SIZE_8BIT,
                                  .src_inc = false,
                                  .dst_inc = true,
                                  .callback = NULL,
                                  .user_ctx = NULL};
        (void)syn_dma_init(&uart->dma_rx, &dma_cfg);
        (void)syn_dma_ringbuf_init(&uart->dma_ring_rx, &uart->dma_rx, uart->rx_buf,
                                   sizeof(uart->rx_buf));

        status = syn_dma_ringbuf_start(&uart->dma_ring_rx, cfg->periph_rx_reg);
        if (status != SYN_OK) {
            syn_port_uart_deinit(cfg->instance);
            return status;
        }
    }
#endif

    uart->initialized = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_uart_deinit(SYN_UART *uart)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);

    if (!uart->initialized) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

#if defined(SYN_USE_DMA) && SYN_USE_DMA
    if (uart->use_dma) {
        syn_dma_stop(&uart->dma_rx);
    }
#endif

    SYN_Status status = syn_port_uart_deinit(uart->instance);
    uart->initialized = false;
    syn_ringbuf_reset(&uart->tx_rb);
    syn_ringbuf_reset(&uart->rx_rb);

    return status;
}

SYN_Status syn_uart_write_str(const SYN_UART *uart, const char *str, uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(str != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(uart->initialized);

    size_t len = strlen(str);
    if (len == 0) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return syn_port_uart_transmit(uart->instance, (const uint8_t *)str, len, timeout_ms);
}

SYN_Status syn_uart_write(const SYN_UART *uart, const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                          uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(data != NULL || len == 0);
    SYN_ASSERT(uart->initialized);

    if (len == 0) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return syn_port_uart_transmit(uart->instance, data, len, timeout_ms);
}

size_t syn_uart_read(SYN_UART *uart, uint8_t *data, size_t max_len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(data != NULL || max_len == 0);

#if defined(SYN_USE_DMA) && SYN_USE_DMA
    if (uart->use_dma) {
        return syn_dma_ringbuf_read(&uart->dma_ring_rx, data, max_len);
    }
#endif

    size_t count = 0;
    while (count < max_len) {
        uint8_t byte;
        if (!syn_ringbuf_get(&uart->rx_rb, &byte)) {
            break;
        }
        data[count++] = byte;
    }
    return count;
}

bool syn_uart_rx_isr_feed(SYN_UART *uart, uint8_t byte)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);
    return syn_ringbuf_put(&uart->rx_rb, byte);
}

SYN_Status syn_uart_write_async(SYN_UART *uart, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(data != NULL || len == 0);

    if (uart == NULL || (!uart->initialized)) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive fallback */
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;               /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE */
    }

    if (len == 0) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    /* All-or-nothing atomic check: reject write if insufficient free buffer space */
    if (syn_ringbuf_free(&uart->tx_rb) < len) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    /* Bulk copy data into TX ring buffer */
    (void)syn_ringbuf_write(&uart->tx_rb, data, len);

    /* Kickstart hardware TX interrupt chain */
    syn_port_uart_enable_txe_irq(uart->instance);
    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_uart_tx_isr_flush(SYN_UART *uart)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);

    if (uart == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive fallback */
        return false;   /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE */
    }

    uint8_t byte;
    if (syn_ringbuf_get(&uart->tx_rb, &byte)) {
        syn_port_uart_write_dr(uart->instance, byte);
        return true;
    }

    /* Ring buffer empty — disable TXE interrupt */
    syn_port_uart_disable_txe_irq(uart->instance);
    return false;
}

bool syn_uart_tx_complete(const SYN_UART *uart)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(uart != NULL);

    if (uart == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive fallback */
        return true;    /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE */
    }

    /* Complete ONLY when software tx_rb is empty AND hardware shift register is clear */
    return syn_ringbuf_empty(&uart->tx_rb) && syn_port_uart_is_tc_set(uart->instance);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_UART */

docs.text: Provides interrupt-driven buffered UART on top of the port layer. Each UART instance gets a TX and RX ring buffer. The buffer sizes are configurable in syn_config.h.

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb.h"

#include <string.h>

static const uint8_t CONFIG_HEADER_TEMPLATE[9] = {
    0x09U,        /* bLength */
    0x02U,        /* bDescriptorType = Configuration */
    0x09U, 0x00U, /* wTotalLength (updated dynamically) */
    0x00U,        /* bNumInterfaces (updated dynamically) */
    0x01U,        /* bConfigurationValue = 1 */
    0x00U,        /* iConfiguration = 0 */
    0xC0U,        /* bmAttributes = Self-Powered */
    0x32U         /* bMaxPower = 100mA */
};

static void usb_patch_cs_iface(uint8_t *d, uint8_t b_len, uint8_t cur_class, int16_t delta)
{
    if ((cur_class == 0x02U) && (b_len >= 5U)) {
        if (d[2] == 0x01U) {
            d[4] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[4] + delta);
        } else if (d[2] == 0x06U) {
            d[3] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[3] + delta);
            d[4] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[4] + delta);
        }
    } else if ((cur_class == 0x01U) && (b_len >= 9U) && (d[2] == 0x01U)) {
        d[8] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[8] + delta);
    }
}

static SYN_Status usb_patch_single_desc(SYN_USB_Device *dev, uint8_t *d, uint8_t b_len,
                                        int16_t delta, uint8_t *cur_class)
{
    uint8_t b_type = d[1];

    if ((b_type == 0x0BU) && (b_len >= 8U)) {
        d[2] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[2] + delta);
    } else if ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_INTERFACE) && (b_len >= 9U)) {
        d[2] = (uint8_t)((int16_t)d[2] + delta);
        *cur_class = d[5];
    } else if (b_type == 0x24U) {
        usb_patch_cs_iface(d, b_len, *cur_class, delta);
    } else if ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_ENDPOINT) && (b_len >= 7U)) {
        return syn_usb_alloc_ep(dev, d[2], &d[2]);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status usb_patch_class_desc(SYN_USB_Device *dev, uint8_t *buf, uint16_t len,
                                       uint8_t base_iface)
{
    bool have_base = false;
    int16_t delta = 0;
    uint8_t cur_class = 0U;
    uint16_t pos = 0U;

    while ((pos + 2U) <= len) {
        uint8_t b_len = buf[pos];
        uint8_t b_type = buf[pos + 1U];
        if ((b_len < 2U) || ((pos + b_len) > len)) {
            break;
        }
        if (!have_base && (((b_type == 0x0BU) && (b_len >= 8U)) ||
                           ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_INTERFACE) && (b_len >= 9U)))) {
            delta = (int16_t)base_iface - (int16_t)buf[pos + 2U];
            have_base = true;
        }
        if (usb_patch_single_desc(dev, &buf[pos], b_len, delta, &cur_class) != SYN_OK) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        pos = (uint16_t)(pos + b_len);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status usb_write_resp(uint8_t *resp, uint16_t resp_cap, const uint8_t *src, uint16_t len,
                                 uint16_t *rlen)
{
    if (len > resp_cap) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    memcpy(resp, src, len);
    *rlen = len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status usb_route_class_setup(SYN_USB_Device *dev, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt,
                                        uint8_t *resp, uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen,
                                        bool *handled)
{
    uint8_t iface = (uint8_t)(pkt->wIndex & 0xFFU);
    *handled = false;

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < dev->class_count; i++) {
        SYN_USB_ClassDriver *cls = &dev->classes[i];
        if ((iface >= cls->iface_start) &&
            (iface < (uint8_t)(cls->iface_start + cls->iface_count)) && (cls->setup != NULL)) {
            *handled = true;
            return cls->setup(cls->ctx, pkt, resp, resp_cap, rlen);
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status usb_handle_get_descriptor(const SYN_USB_Device *dev,
                                            const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                            uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    uint8_t desc_type = (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue >> 8);
    uint8_t desc_idx = (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue & 0xFFU);

    if (desc_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_DEVICE) {
        uint16_t len = (pkt->wLength < 18U) ? pkt->wLength : 18U;
        return usb_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, dev->device_desc, len, rlen);
    }

    if (desc_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_CONFIGURATION) {
        uint16_t len = (pkt->wLength < dev->config_desc_len) ? pkt->wLength : dev->config_desc_len;
        return usb_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, dev->config_desc, len, rlen);
    }

    if ((desc_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_STRING) && (desc_idx < SYN_USB_MAX_STRING_DESCS) &&
        (dev->string_descs[desc_idx] != NULL)) {
        const uint8_t *sdesc = dev->string_descs[desc_idx];
        uint16_t slen = (pkt->wLength < sdesc[0]) ? pkt->wLength : (uint16_t)sdesc[0];
        return usb_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, sdesc, slen, rlen);
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_init(SYN_USB_Device *dev, const uint8_t *device_desc)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (device_desc == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(dev, 0, sizeof(*dev));
    dev->state = SYN_USB_STATE_DEFAULT;
    dev->device_desc = device_desc;

    memcpy(dev->config_buf, CONFIG_HEADER_TEMPLATE, sizeof(CONFIG_HEADER_TEMPLATE));
    dev->config_buf_used = (uint16_t)sizeof(CONFIG_HEADER_TEMPLATE);
    dev->config_desc = dev->config_buf;
    dev->config_desc_len = dev->config_buf_used;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_alloc_ep(SYN_USB_Device *dev, uint8_t preferred_ep, uint8_t *assigned_ep)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (assigned_ep == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t dir = (uint8_t)(preferred_ep & 0x80U);
    uint8_t num = (uint8_t)(preferred_ep & 0x0FU);
    uint16_t *mask = (dir != 0U) ? &dev->ep_in_mask : &dev->ep_out_mask;

    if ((num >= 1U) && (num <= 15U) && ((*mask & (uint16_t)(1U << num)) == 0U)) {
        *mask |= (uint16_t)(1U << num);
        *assigned_ep = (uint8_t)(dir | num);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    for (uint8_t n = 1U; n <= 15U; n++) {
        if ((*mask & (uint16_t)(1U << n)) == 0U) {
            *mask |= (uint16_t)(1U << n);
            *assigned_ep = (uint8_t)(dir | n);
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_register_class(SYN_USB_Device *dev, const SYN_USB_ClassDriver *cls,
                                  const uint8_t *iface_desc, uint16_t iface_desc_len)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (cls == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (dev->class_count >= SYN_USB_MAX_CLASSES) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t base_iface =
        (cls->iface_start > dev->iface_count) ? cls->iface_start : dev->iface_count;

    if ((iface_desc != NULL) && (iface_desc_len > 0U) && !dev->raw_config_override) {
        if (((uint32_t)dev->config_buf_used + (uint32_t)iface_desc_len) > SYN_USB_MAX_CONFIG_DESC) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }

        uint16_t saved_in = dev->ep_in_mask;
        uint16_t saved_out = dev->ep_out_mask;
        uint8_t *dst = &dev->config_buf[dev->config_buf_used];
        memcpy(dst, iface_desc, iface_desc_len);

        if (usb_patch_class_desc(dev, dst, iface_desc_len, base_iface) != SYN_OK) {
            dev->ep_in_mask = saved_in;
            dev->ep_out_mask = saved_out;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }

        dev->config_buf_used = (uint16_t)(dev->config_buf_used + iface_desc_len);
        dev->config_buf[2] = (uint8_t)(dev->config_buf_used & 0xFFU);
        dev->config_buf[3] = (uint8_t)((dev->config_buf_used >> 8) & 0xFFU);
        dev->config_buf[4] = (uint8_t)(dev->config_buf[4] + cls->iface_count);
        dev->config_desc_len = dev->config_buf_used;
    }

    dev->classes[dev->class_count] = *cls;
    dev->classes[dev->class_count].iface_start = base_iface;
    dev->class_count++;
    dev->iface_count = (uint8_t)(base_iface + cls->iface_count);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_set_string_desc(SYN_USB_Device *dev, uint8_t index, const uint8_t *desc)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (desc == NULL) || (index >= SYN_USB_MAX_STRING_DESCS)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    dev->string_descs[index] = desc;
    if (index >= dev->string_desc_count) {
        dev->string_desc_count = (uint8_t)(index + 1U);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_set_raw_config_desc(SYN_USB_Device *dev, const uint8_t *desc, uint16_t len)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (desc == NULL) || (len < 9U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    dev->config_desc = desc;
    dev->config_desc_len = len;
    dev->raw_config_override = true;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool usb_is_class_routed_setup(const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt)
{
    uint8_t req_type = (uint8_t)(pkt->bmRequestType & 0x60U);
    uint8_t recipient = (uint8_t)(pkt->bmRequestType & 0x1FU);
    if (req_type == 0x20U) {
        return true;
    }
    return (req_type == 0x00U) && (recipient == 0x01U) &&
           (pkt->bRequest == SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR);
}

static void usb_apply_configuration(SYN_USB_Device *dev, uint8_t config_val)
{
    dev->config_value = config_val;
    dev->state = (config_val != 0U) ? SYN_USB_STATE_CONFIGURED : SYN_USB_STATE_ADDRESS;
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < dev->class_count; i++) {
        if (dev->classes[i].configured != NULL) {
            (void)dev->classes[i].configured(dev->classes[i].ctx, config_val);
        }
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_process_setup(SYN_USB_Device *dev, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                 uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (pkt == NULL) || (resp == NULL) || (rlen == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *rlen = 0U;
    uint8_t recipient = (uint8_t)(pkt->bmRequestType & 0x1FU);

    if (usb_is_class_routed_setup(pkt)) {
        bool handled = false;
        SYN_Status cls_st = usb_route_class_setup(dev, pkt, resp, resp_cap, rlen, &handled);
        if (handled) {
            return cls_st;
        }
    }

    if ((pkt->bmRequestType & 0x60U) != 0x00U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    switch (pkt->bRequest) {
    case SYN_USB_REQ_SET_ADDRESS:
        dev->dev_address = (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue & 0x7FU);
        dev->state = (dev->dev_address != 0U) ? SYN_USB_STATE_ADDRESS : SYN_USB_STATE_DEFAULT;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_REQ_SET_CONFIGURATION:
        usb_apply_configuration(dev, (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue & 0xFFU));
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_REQ_GET_CONFIGURATION:
        return usb_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, &dev->config_value, 1U, rlen);

    case SYN_USB_REQ_GET_STATUS: {
        uint8_t status_bytes[2] = {(recipient == 0x00U) ? 0x01U : 0x00U, 0x00U};
        return usb_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, status_bytes, 2U, rlen);
    }

    case SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR:
        return usb_handle_get_descriptor(dev, pkt, resp, resp_cap, rlen);

    default:
        return SYN_OK;
    }
}

bool syn_usb_is_configured(const SYN_USB_Device *dev)
{
    return (dev != NULL) && (dev->state == SYN_USB_STATE_CONFIGURED);
}

Note:

Port-decoupled staging contract: copies up to sizeof(cdc->tx_buf) (128 B) into cdc->tx_buf and sets cdc->tx_len. The platform USB ISR or polling loop transmits cdc->tx_buf on cdc->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon hardware completion to clear cdc->tx_len. Callers requiring atomic whole-frame rejection above 128 B should use SYN_Transport via syn_transport_from_usb_cdc().

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_cdc.h"

#include "syntropic/port/syn_port_system.h"

#include <string.h>

static const uint8_t CDC_INTERFACE_DESC[66] = {
    /* Interface Association Descriptor (IAD) */
    0x08U, 0x0BU, 0x00U, 0x02U, 0x02U, 0x02U, 0x01U, 0x00U,

    /* Interface 0: Communication Interface Class */
    0x09U, 0x04U, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x02U, 0x02U, 0x01U, 0x00U,
    /* Header Functional Descriptor */
    0x05U, 0x24U, 0x00U, 0x10U, 0x01U,
    /* Call Management Functional Descriptor */
    0x05U, 0x24U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x01U,
    /* ACM Functional Descriptor */
    0x04U, 0x24U, 0x02U, 0x02U,
    /* Union Functional Descriptor */
    0x05U, 0x24U, 0x06U, 0x00U, 0x01U,
    /* Endpoint 0x82: Interrupt IN */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x82U, 0x03U, 0x08U, 0x00U, 0x10U,

    /* Interface 1: Data Interface Class */
    0x09U, 0x04U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x02U, 0x0AU, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* Endpoint 0x01: Bulk OUT */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x01U, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* Endpoint 0x81: Bulk IN */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x81U, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U};

static SYN_Status cdc_class_setup(void *ctx, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                  uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    size_t size_rlen = 0U;
    SYN_Status st =
        ((pkt != NULL) && (pkt->bRequest == SYN_USB_CDC_GET_LINE_CODING) && (resp_cap < 7U))
            ? SYN_ERROR
            : syn_usb_cdc_handle_setup(cdc, pkt, resp, &size_rlen);
    if (rlen != NULL) {
        *rlen = (uint16_t)size_rlen;
    }
    return st;
}

static void cdc_class_data_out(void *ctx, uint8_t ep, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U) || (ep != cdc->ep_out)) {
        return;
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint16_t space = (uint16_t)(sizeof(cdc->rx_buf) - cdc->rx_len);
    uint16_t copy = (len < space) ? len : space;
    if (copy > 0U) {
        memcpy(&cdc->rx_buf[cdc->rx_len], data, copy);
        cdc->rx_len = (uint16_t)(cdc->rx_len + copy);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static void cdc_class_data_in(void *ctx, uint8_t ep)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    if ((cdc != NULL) && (ep == cdc->ep_in)) {
        cdc->tx_len = 0U;
    }
}

static SYN_Status cdc_class_configured(void *ctx, uint8_t config)
{
    SYN_USB_CDC *cdc = (SYN_USB_CDC *)ctx;
    if (cdc != NULL) {
        cdc->configured = (config != 0U);
        cdc->tx_len = 0U;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_init(SYN_USB_CDC *cdc)
{
    if (cdc == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(cdc, 0, sizeof(*cdc));

    cdc->ep_in = 0x81U;
    cdc->ep_out = 0x01U;
    cdc->ep_cmd = 0x82U;
    cdc->configured = false;

    cdc->line_coding.baudrate = 115200U;
    cdc->line_coding.stop_bits = 0U;
    cdc->line_coding.parity = 0U;
    cdc->line_coding.data_bits = 8U;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_register(SYN_USB_Device *dev, SYN_USB_CDC *cdc)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (cdc == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t desc_buf[sizeof(CDC_INTERFACE_DESC)];
    memcpy(desc_buf, CDC_INTERFACE_DESC, sizeof(CDC_INTERFACE_DESC));
    desc_buf[38] = cdc->ep_cmd;
    desc_buf[54] = cdc->ep_out;
    desc_buf[61] = cdc->ep_in;

    SYN_USB_ClassDriver cls;
    memset(&cls, 0, sizeof(cls));
    cls.iface_start = cdc->iface_num;
    cls.iface_count = 2U;
    cls.ctx = cdc;
    cls.setup = cdc_class_setup;
    cls.data_out = cdc_class_data_out;
    cls.data_in = cdc_class_data_in;
    cls.configured = cdc_class_configured;

    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_register_class(dev, &cls, desc_buf, (uint16_t)sizeof(desc_buf));
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        cdc->iface_num = dev->classes[dev->class_count - 1U].iface_start;
        if (!dev->raw_config_override) {
            uint16_t base = (uint16_t)(dev->config_buf_used - sizeof(desc_buf));
            cdc->ep_cmd = dev->config_buf[base + 38U];
            cdc->ep_out = dev->config_buf[base + 54U];
            cdc->ep_in = dev->config_buf[base + 61U];
        }
    }
    return st;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_handle_setup(SYN_USB_CDC *cdc, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *setup,
                                    uint8_t *resp, size_t *rlen)
{
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (setup == NULL) || (resp == NULL) || (rlen == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *rlen = 0U;

    switch (setup->bRequest) {
    case SYN_USB_REQ_SET_ADDRESS:
        cdc->dev_address = (uint8_t)(setup->wValue & 0x7FU);
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_REQ_SET_CONFIGURATION:
        cdc->configured = (setup->wValue != 0U);
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_CDC_SET_LINE_CODING:
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_CDC_GET_LINE_CODING:
        resp[0] = (uint8_t)(cdc->line_coding.baudrate & 0xFFU);
        resp[1] = (uint8_t)((cdc->line_coding.baudrate >> 8) & 0xFFU);
        resp[2] = (uint8_t)((cdc->line_coding.baudrate >> 16) & 0xFFU);
        resp[3] = (uint8_t)((cdc->line_coding.baudrate >> 24) & 0xFFU);
        resp[4] = cdc->line_coding.stop_bits;
        resp[5] = cdc->line_coding.parity;
        resp[6] = cdc->line_coding.data_bits;
        *rlen = 7U;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_CDC_SET_CONTROL_LINE_STATE:
        return SYN_OK;

    default:
        return SYN_OK;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_write(SYN_USB_CDC *cdc, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (cdc->tx_len > 0U) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    if (len > sizeof(cdc->tx_buf)) {
        len = sizeof(cdc->tx_buf);
    }

    memcpy(cdc->tx_buf, data, len);
    cdc->tx_len = (uint16_t)len;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_read(SYN_USB_CDC *cdc, void *buf, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if ((cdc == NULL) || (buf == NULL) || (out_len == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint16_t available = cdc->rx_len;
    if (available == 0U) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        *out_len = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (max_len < available) {
        available = (uint16_t)max_len;
    }

    memcpy(buf, cdc->rx_buf, available);
    if (available < cdc->rx_len) {
        memmove(cdc->rx_buf, &cdc->rx_buf[available], (size_t)(cdc->rx_len - available));
        cdc->rx_len = (uint16_t)(cdc->rx_len - available);
    } else {
        cdc->rx_len = 0U;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    *out_len = available;
    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_usb_cdc_rx_available(const SYN_USB_CDC *cdc)
{
    return (cdc != NULL) && (cdc->rx_len > 0U);
}

bool syn_usb_cdc_tx_ready(const SYN_USB_CDC *cdc)
{
    return (cdc != NULL) && (cdc->tx_len == 0U);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_cdc_write (

    size_t len
)

Note:

Port-decoupled staging contract: copies up to sizeof(cdc->tx_buf) (128 B) into cdc->tx_buf and sets cdc->tx_len. The platform USB ISR or polling loop transmits cdc->tx_buf on cdc->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon hardware completion to clear cdc->tx_len. Callers requiring atomic whole-frame rejection above 128 B should use SYN_Transport via syn_transport_from_usb_cdc().

  • data Pointer to data bytes.
  • len Byte length.

SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if a staged packet is still pending.

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_hid.h"

#include <string.h>

static const uint8_t HID_INTERFACE_DESC[25] = {
    /* Interface 0: HID Class */
    0x09U, 0x04U, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x03U, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* HID Descriptor */
    0x09U, 0x21U, 0x11U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x22U, 0x34U, 0x00U,
    /* Endpoint 0x83: Interrupt IN */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x83U, 0x03U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x0AU};

static SYN_Status hid_write_resp(uint8_t *resp, uint16_t resp_cap, const uint8_t *src, uint16_t len,
                                 uint16_t *rlen)
{
    if (len > resp_cap) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    memcpy(resp, src, len);
    *rlen = len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status hid_handle_get_descriptor(const SYN_USB_HID *hid, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt,
                                            uint8_t *resp, uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    if (((uint8_t)(pkt->wValue >> 8) == 0x22U) && (hid->report_desc != NULL)) {
        uint16_t len = (pkt->wLength < hid->report_desc_len) ? pkt->wLength : hid->report_desc_len;
        return hid_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, hid->report_desc, len, rlen);
    }
    return SYN_ERROR;
}

static SYN_Status hid_class_setup(void *ctx, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                  uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    SYN_USB_HID *hid = (SYN_USB_HID *)ctx;
    if ((hid == NULL) || (pkt == NULL) || (resp == NULL) || (rlen == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *rlen = 0U;

    switch (pkt->bRequest) {
    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_GET_REPORT:
        if (hid->tx_len > 0U) {
            uint16_t copy_len = (pkt->wLength < hid->tx_len) ? pkt->wLength : hid->tx_len;
            return hid_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, hid->tx_buf, copy_len, rlen);
        }
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_SET_REPORT:
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_GET_IDLE:
        return hid_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, &hid->idle_rate, 1U, rlen);

    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_SET_IDLE:
        hid->idle_rate = (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue >> 8);
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_GET_PROTOCOL:
        return hid_write_resp(resp, resp_cap, &hid->active_protocol, 1U, rlen);

    case SYN_USB_HID_REQ_SET_PROTOCOL:
        hid->active_protocol = (uint8_t)(pkt->wValue & 0xFFU);
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR:
        return hid_handle_get_descriptor(hid, pkt, resp, resp_cap, rlen);

    default:
        return SYN_OK;
    }
}

static void hid_class_data_in(void *ctx, uint8_t ep)
{
    SYN_USB_HID *hid = (SYN_USB_HID *)ctx;
    if ((hid != NULL) && (ep == hid->ep_in)) {
        if (hid->release_pending) {
            memset(hid->tx_buf, 0, 4U);
            hid->tx_len = 4U;
            hid->release_pending = false;
        } else {
            hid->tx_len = 0U;
        }
    }
}

static SYN_Status hid_class_configured(void *ctx, uint8_t config_val)
{
    (void)config_val;
    SYN_USB_HID *hid = (SYN_USB_HID *)ctx;
    if (hid != NULL) {
        hid->tx_len = 0U;
        hid->release_pending = false;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_init(SYN_USB_HID *hid)
{
    if (hid == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(hid, 0, sizeof(*hid));
    hid->ep_in = 0x83U;
    hid->idle_rate = 0U;
    hid->active_protocol = 1U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_register(SYN_USB_Device *dev, SYN_USB_HID *hid, const uint8_t *report_desc,
                                uint16_t report_desc_len)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (hid == NULL) || (report_desc == NULL) || (report_desc_len == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    hid->report_desc = report_desc;
    hid->report_desc_len = report_desc_len;

    uint8_t desc_buf[sizeof(HID_INTERFACE_DESC)];
    memcpy(desc_buf, HID_INTERFACE_DESC, sizeof(HID_INTERFACE_DESC));
    desc_buf[6] = (hid->protocol != 0U) ? 0x01U : 0x00U;
    desc_buf[7] = hid->protocol;
    desc_buf[16] = (uint8_t)(report_desc_len & 0xFFU);
    desc_buf[17] = (uint8_t)((report_desc_len >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    desc_buf[20] = hid->ep_in;

    SYN_USB_ClassDriver cls;
    memset(&cls, 0, sizeof(cls));
    cls.iface_start = hid->iface_num;
    cls.iface_count = 1U;
    cls.ctx = hid;
    cls.configured = hid_class_configured;
    cls.setup = hid_class_setup;
    cls.data_in = hid_class_data_in;

    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_register_class(dev, &cls, desc_buf, (uint16_t)sizeof(desc_buf));
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        hid->iface_num = dev->classes[dev->class_count - 1U].iface_start;
        if (!dev->raw_config_override) {
            uint16_t base = (uint16_t)(dev->config_buf_used - sizeof(desc_buf));
            hid->ep_in = dev->config_buf[base + 20U];
        }
    }
    return st;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_send_report(SYN_USB_HID *hid, const void *report, size_t len)
{
    if ((hid == NULL) || (report == NULL) || (len == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (hid->tx_len > 0U) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    if (len > sizeof(hid->tx_buf)) {
        len = sizeof(hid->tx_buf);
    }

    memcpy(hid->tx_buf, report, len);
    hid->tx_len = (uint16_t)len;
    hid->release_pending = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_read_report(SYN_USB_HID *hid, void *buf, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if ((hid == NULL) || (buf == NULL) || (out_len == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (hid->rx_len == 0U) {
        *out_len = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    size_t copy_len = (hid->rx_len < max_len) ? hid->rx_len : max_len;
    memcpy(buf, hid->rx_buf, copy_len);
    *out_len = copy_len;

    if (copy_len < hid->rx_len) {
        memmove(hid->rx_buf, &hid->rx_buf[copy_len], (size_t)hid->rx_len - copy_len);
        hid->rx_len = (uint16_t)(hid->rx_len - (uint16_t)copy_len);
    } else {
        hid->rx_len = 0U;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_usb_hid_report_available(const SYN_USB_HID *hid)
{
    return (hid != NULL) && (hid->rx_len > 0U);
}

bool syn_usb_hid_tx_ready(const SYN_USB_HID *hid)
{
    return (hid != NULL) && (hid->tx_len == 0U);
}

Stage an IN report in the HID Interrupt IN transmit buffer. 

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_send_report (
    SYN_USB_HID * hid,
    const void * report,
    size_t len
)

Note:

Port-decoupled staging contract: copies up to SYN_USB_HID_MAX_REPORT_SIZE (64 B) into hid->tx_buf and sets hid->tx_len. The platform USB ISR transmits hid->tx_buf on hid->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon completion to clear hid->tx_len (or advance a queued auto-release report).

Parameters:

  • hid Pointer to USB HID instance.
  • report Pointer to report data.
  • len Report byte length.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if a staged report is still pending.

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_hid_keyboard.h"

#include <string.h>

const uint8_t SYN_USB_HID_KEYBOARD_REPORT_DESC[63] = {
    0x05, 0x01, /* Usage Page (Generic Desktop Ctrls) */
    0x09, 0x06, /* Usage (Keyboard) */
    0xA1, 0x01, /* Collection (Application) */
    0x05, 0x07, /*   Usage Page (Kbrd/Keypad) */
    0x19, 0xE0, /*   Usage Minimum (0xE0 - LeftControl) */
    0x29, 0xE7, /*   Usage Maximum (0xE7 - Right GUI) */
    0x15, 0x00, /*   Logical Minimum (0) */
    0x25, 0x01, /*   Logical Maximum (1) */
    0x75, 0x01, /*   Report Size (1 bit) */
    0x95, 0x08, /*   Report Count (8 bits for modifier keys) */
    0x81, 0x02, /*   Input (Data,Var,Abs) */
    0x95, 0x01, /*   Report Count (1 byte for reserved padding) */
    0x75, 0x08, /*   Report Size (8 bits) */
    0x81, 0x03, /*   Input (Cnst,Var,Abs) */
    0x95, 0x05, /*   Report Count (5 LED status indicator bits) */
    0x75, 0x01, /*   Report Size (1 bit) */
    0x05, 0x08, /*   Usage Page (LEDs) */
    0x19, 0x01, /*   Usage Minimum (Num Lock) */
    0x29, 0x05, /*   Usage Maximum (Kana) */
    0x91, 0x02, /*   Output (Data,Var,Abs) */
    0x95, 0x01, /*   Report Count (1 padding byte for LED alignment) */
    0x75, 0x03, /*   Report Size (3 bits) */
    0x91, 0x03, /*   Output (Cnst,Var,Abs) */
    0x95, 0x06, /*   Report Count (6 simultaneous keycodes) */
    0x75, 0x08, /*   Report Size (8 bits) */
    0x15, 0x00, /*   Logical Minimum (0) */
    0x25, 0x65, /*   Logical Maximum (101 keys) */
    0x05, 0x07, /*   Usage Page (Kbrd/Keypad) */
    0x19, 0x00, /*   Usage Minimum (0) */
    0x29, 0x65, /*   Usage Maximum (101) */
    0x81, 0x00, /*   Input (Data,Array,Abs) */
    0xC0        /* End Collection */
};

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_keyboard_send(SYN_USB_HID *hid, uint8_t modifier, const uint8_t keycodes[6])
{
    if (!hid) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_USB_HID_KeyboardReport report;
    memset(&report, 0, sizeof(report));
    report.modifier = modifier;

    if (keycodes) {
        memcpy(report.keycode, keycodes, sizeof(report.keycode));
    }

    return syn_usb_hid_send_report(hid, &report, sizeof(report));
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_keyboard_press(SYN_USB_HID *hid, uint8_t modifier, uint8_t keycode)
{
    uint8_t keycodes[6] = {keycode, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    return syn_usb_hid_keyboard_send(hid, modifier, keycodes);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_keyboard_release(SYN_USB_HID *hid)
{
    return syn_usb_hid_keyboard_send(hid, 0x00, NULL);
}

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_hid_mouse.h"

#include <string.h>

const uint8_t SYN_USB_HID_MOUSE_REPORT_DESC[54] = {
    0x05, 0x01, /* Usage Page (Generic Desktop) */
    0x09, 0x02, /* Usage (Mouse) */
    0xA1, 0x01, /* Collection (Application) */
    0x09, 0x01, /*   Usage (Pointer) */
    0xA1, 0x00, /*   Collection (Physical) */
    0x05, 0x09, /*     Usage Page (Buttons) */
    0x19, 0x01, /*     Usage Minimum (1) */
    0x29, 0x03, /*     Usage Maximum (3) */
    0x15, 0x00, /*     Logical Minimum (0) */
    0x25, 0x01, /*     Logical Maximum (1) */
    0x95, 0x03, /*     Report Count (3 buttons) */
    0x75, 0x01, /*     Report Size (1 bit) */
    0x81, 0x02, /*     Input (Data, Variable, Absolute) */
    0x95, 0x01, /*     Report Count (1 padding byte) */
    0x75, 0x05, /*     Report Size (5 bits) */
    0x81, 0x01, /*     Input (Constant) */
    0x05, 0x01, /*     Usage Page (Generic Desktop) */
    0x09, 0x30, /*     Usage (X) */
    0x09, 0x31, /*     Usage (Y) */
    0x09, 0x38, /*     Usage (Wheel) */
    0x15, 0x81, /*     Logical Minimum (-127) */
    0x25, 0x7F, /*     Logical Maximum (+127) */
    0x75, 0x08, /*     Report Size (8 bits) */
    0x95, 0x03, /*     Report Count (3 fields: X, Y, Wheel) */
    0x81, 0x06, /*     Input (Data, Variable, Relative) */
    0xC0,       /*   End Collection */
    0xC0        /* End Collection */
};

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_mouse_send(SYN_USB_HID *hid, uint8_t buttons, int8_t x, int8_t y,
                                  int8_t wheel)
{
    if (!hid) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_USB_HID_MouseReport report;
    report.buttons = buttons;
    report.x = x;
    report.y = y;
    report.wheel = wheel;

    return syn_usb_hid_send_report(hid, &report, sizeof(report));
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_mouse_move(SYN_USB_HID *hid, int8_t x, int8_t y)
{
    return syn_usb_hid_mouse_send(hid, 0x00, x, y, 0);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_hid_mouse_click(SYN_USB_HID *hid, uint8_t buttons)
{
    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_hid_mouse_send(hid, buttons, 0, 0, 0);
    if ((st == SYN_OK) && (buttons != 0U)) {
        hid->release_pending = true;
    }
    return st;
}

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_host.h"

#include "port/syn_port_usb.h"
#include "port/syn_port_usb_host.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void build_setup(SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t bmRequestType, uint8_t bRequest,
                        uint16_t wValue, uint16_t wIndex, uint16_t wLength)
{
    pkt->bmRequestType = bmRequestType;
    pkt->bRequest = bRequest;
    pkt->wValue = wValue;
    pkt->wIndex = wIndex;
    pkt->wLength = wLength;
}

static uint16_t calc_iface_span(const uint8_t *buf, uint16_t total, uint16_t iface_start)
{
    uint8_t iface_class = buf[iface_start + 5U];
    uint16_t next = (uint16_t)(iface_start + buf[iface_start]);

    while ((next + 2U) <= total) {
        uint8_t n_len = buf[next];
        uint8_t n_type = buf[next + 1U];
        if ((n_len < 2U) || ((next + n_len) > total)) {
            break;
        }
        if (n_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_INTERFACE) {
            bool is_sub_cdc_data =
                (iface_class == 0x02U) && (n_len >= 9U) && (buf[next + 5U] == 0x0AU);
            if (!is_sub_cdc_data) {
                break;
            }
        }
        next = (uint16_t)(next + n_len);
    }

    return (uint16_t)(next - iface_start);
}

static void match_iface_drivers(SYN_USB_Host *host, const uint8_t *iface_desc, uint16_t iface_len)
{
    uint8_t iface_class = iface_desc[5];
    uint8_t iface_sub = iface_desc[6];
    uint8_t iface_proto = iface_desc[7];

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < host->class_count; i++) {
        SYN_USB_HostClassDriver *cls = &host->classes[i];
        if (cls->matched || (cls->probe == NULL)) {
            continue;
        }
        bool class_ok = (cls->class_code == 0xFFU) || (cls->class_code == iface_class);
        bool sub_ok = (cls->subclass_code == 0xFFU) || (cls->subclass_code == iface_sub);
        bool proto_ok = (cls->protocol_code == 0xFFU) || (cls->protocol_code == iface_proto);

        if (class_ok && sub_ok && proto_ok &&
            (cls->probe(cls->ctx, host->dev_info.dev_addr, iface_desc, iface_len) == SYN_OK)) {
            cls->matched = true;
            break;
        }
    }
}

static void probe_class_drivers(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    const uint8_t *buf = host->enum_buf;
    uint16_t total = host->enum_buf_len;
    uint16_t pos = 0U;

    while ((pos + 2U) <= total) {
        uint8_t b_len = buf[pos];
        uint8_t b_type = buf[pos + 1U];

        if ((b_len < 2U) || ((pos + b_len) > total)) {
            break;
        }

        if ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_INTERFACE) && (b_len >= 9U)) {
            uint16_t span = calc_iface_span(buf, total, pos);
            match_iface_drivers(host, &buf[pos], span);
        }

        pos = (uint16_t)(pos + b_len);
    }
}

static SYN_Status enum_poll_xfer(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    if (!host->xfer_pending) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (!syn_port_usb_host_xfer_done(0U)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    host->xfer_pending = false;
    uint16_t actual = 0U;
    if (syn_port_usb_host_xfer_result(0U, &actual) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if ((host->enum_step != SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_DEV_FULL) &&
        (host->enum_step != SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_CLASS_PROBE)) {
        host->enum_buf_len = actual;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status enumerate_step(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    SYN_Status poll_st = enum_poll_xfer(host);
    if (poll_st != SYN_OK) {
        return poll_st;
    }

    SYN_USB_SetupPacket pkt;

    switch (host->enum_step) {
    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_DEV8:
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_open(0U, 0U, 0x00U, SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_CONTROL, 8U);
        build_setup(&pkt, 0x80U, SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR,
                    (uint16_t)(SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_DEVICE << 8), 0U, 8U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_setup(0U, &pkt);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(0U, host->enum_buf, 8U, true);
        host->xfer_pending = true;
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_SET_ADDR;
        return SYN_BUSY;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_SET_ADDR: {
        uint8_t max_pkt0 = (host->enum_buf[7] == 0U) ? 8U : host->enum_buf[7];
        host->dev_info.max_pkt_ep0 = max_pkt0;
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(0U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_open(0U, 0U, 0x00U, SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_CONTROL, max_pkt0);

        uint8_t addr = (host->next_addr > 127U) ? 1U : host->next_addr;
        host->next_addr = (uint8_t)(addr + 1U);
        host->dev_info.dev_addr = addr;

        build_setup(&pkt, 0x00U, SYN_USB_REQ_SET_ADDRESS, addr, 0U, 0U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_setup(0U, &pkt);
        host->xfer_pending = true;
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_DEV_FULL;
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_DEV_FULL:
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(0U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_open(0U, host->dev_info.dev_addr, 0x00U,
                                          SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_CONTROL, host->dev_info.max_pkt_ep0);
        build_setup(&pkt, 0x80U, SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR,
                    (uint16_t)(SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_DEVICE << 8), 0U, 18U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_setup(0U, &pkt);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(0U, host->enum_buf, 18U, true);
        host->xfer_pending = true;
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_CFG;
        return SYN_BUSY;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_CFG: {
        const uint8_t *d = host->enum_buf;
        host->dev_info.vid = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)d[9] << 8) | d[8]);
        host->dev_info.pid = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)d[11] << 8) | d[10]);
        host->dev_info.dev_class = d[4];
        host->dev_info.dev_subclass = d[5];
        host->dev_info.dev_protocol = d[6];
        host->dev_info.num_configs = d[17];

        build_setup(&pkt, 0x80U, SYN_USB_REQ_GET_DESCRIPTOR,
                    (uint16_t)(SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_CONFIGURATION << 8), 0U,
                    SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_BUF_SIZE);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_setup(0U, &pkt);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(0U, host->enum_buf, SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_BUF_SIZE, true);
        host->xfer_pending = true;
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_SET_CFG;
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_SET_CFG: {
        uint8_t cfg_val = (host->enum_buf_len >= 6U) ? host->enum_buf[5] : 1U;
        build_setup(&pkt, 0x00U, SYN_USB_REQ_SET_CONFIGURATION, cfg_val, 0U, 0U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_setup(0U, &pkt);
        host->xfer_pending = true;
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_CLASS_PROBE;
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_CLASS_PROBE:
        probe_class_drivers(host);
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_DONE;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_DONE:
        return SYN_OK;

    default:
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
}

static void host_process_ready(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    if (!syn_port_usb_host_device_attached()) {
        for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < host->class_count; i++) {
            if (host->classes[i].matched && (host->classes[i].disconnected != NULL)) {
                host->classes[i].disconnected(host->classes[i].ctx);
            }
            host->classes[i].matched = false;
        }
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(0U);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_vbus(false);
        host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
        return;
    }

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < host->class_count; i++) {
        if (host->classes[i].matched && (host->classes[i].process != NULL)) {
            host->classes[i].process(host->classes[i].ctx);
        }
    }
}

/* ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_init(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    if (host == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(host, 0, sizeof(*host));
    host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
    host->next_addr = 1U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_register_class(SYN_USB_Host *host, const SYN_USB_HostClassDriver *cls)
{
    if ((host == NULL) || (cls == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (host->class_count >= SYN_USB_HOST_MAX_CLASSES) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    host->classes[host->class_count] = *cls;
    host->classes[host->class_count].matched = false;
    host->class_count++;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_process(SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    if (host == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    switch (host->state) {
    case SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_DISCONNECTED:
        if (syn_port_usb_host_device_attached()) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_vbus(true);
            host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ATTACHED;
        }
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ATTACHED:
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_vbus(true);
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_bus_reset();
        host->enum_step = SYN_USB_HOST_ENUM_GET_DEV8;
        host->xfer_pending = false;
        host->enum_buf_len = 0U;
        memset(&host->dev_info, 0, sizeof(host->dev_info));
        for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < host->class_count; i++) {
            host->classes[i].matched = false;
        }
        host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ENUMERATING;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ENUMERATING: {
        SYN_Status st = enumerate_step(host);
        if (st == SYN_OK) {
            host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_READY;
        } else if (st == SYN_ERROR) {
            host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ERROR;
        }
        return st;
    }

    case SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_READY:
        host_process_ready(host);
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_ERROR:
        if (!syn_port_usb_host_device_attached()) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_vbus(false);
            host->state = SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
        }
        return SYN_ERROR;

    default:
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
}

bool syn_usb_host_is_ready(const SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    return (host != NULL) && (host->state == SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_READY);
}

const SYN_USB_HostDevInfo *syn_usb_host_get_dev_info(const SYN_USB_Host *host)
{
    if ((host == NULL) || (host->state < SYN_USB_HOST_STATE_READY)) {
        return NULL;
    }
    return &host->dev_info;
}

#include "syntropic/drivers/syn_usb_host_cdc.h"

#include "port/syn_port_usb.h"
#include "port/syn_port_usb_host.h"

#include <string.h>

static void host_cdc_scan_endpoints(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc, uint8_t dev_addr, const uint8_t *buf,
                                    uint16_t len)
{
    uint16_t pos = 0U;
    while ((pos + 2U) <= len) {
        uint8_t b_len = buf[pos];
        uint8_t b_type = buf[pos + 1U];
        if ((b_len < 2U) || ((pos + b_len) > len)) {
            break;
        }

        if ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_ENDPOINT) && (b_len >= 7U) &&
            ((buf[pos + 3U] & 0x03U) == SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_BULK)) {
            uint8_t ep_addr = buf[pos + 2U];
            uint16_t max_pkt = (uint16_t)buf[pos + 4U] | ((uint16_t)buf[pos + 5U] << 8);
            if ((ep_addr & 0x80U) != 0U) {
                hcdc->ep_bulk_in = ep_addr;
                hcdc->pipe_bulk_in = 1U;
                (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_open(1U, dev_addr, ep_addr, SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_BULK,
                                                  max_pkt);
            } else {
                hcdc->ep_bulk_out = ep_addr;
                hcdc->pipe_bulk_out = 2U;
                (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_open(2U, dev_addr, ep_addr, SYN_USB_EP_TYPE_BULK,
                                                  max_pkt);
            }
        }
        pos = (uint16_t)(pos + b_len);
    }
}

static void host_cdc_scan_data_ifaces(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc, uint8_t dev_addr)
{
    const uint8_t *buf = hcdc->host->enum_buf;
    uint16_t total = hcdc->host->enum_buf_len;
    uint16_t pos = 0U;
    bool in_cdc_data = false;

    while ((pos + 2U) <= total) {
        uint8_t b_len = buf[pos];
        uint8_t b_type = buf[pos + 1U];
        if ((b_len < 2U) || ((pos + b_len) > total)) {
            break;
        }
        if ((b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_INTERFACE) && (b_len >= 9U)) {
            in_cdc_data = (buf[pos + 5U] == 0x0AU);
        } else if (in_cdc_data && (b_type == SYN_USB_DESC_TYPE_ENDPOINT) && (b_len >= 7U)) {
            host_cdc_scan_endpoints(hcdc, dev_addr, &buf[pos], b_len);
        }
        pos = (uint16_t)(pos + b_len);
    }
}

static SYN_Status host_cdc_probe(void *ctx, uint8_t dev_addr, const uint8_t *iface_desc,
                                 uint16_t len)
{
    SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc = (SYN_USB_HostCDC *)ctx;
    if ((hcdc == NULL) || (iface_desc == NULL) || (len < 9U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    hcdc->dev_addr = dev_addr;
    hcdc->ep_bulk_in = 0U;
    hcdc->ep_bulk_out = 0U;
    hcdc->pipe_bulk_in = 0U;
    hcdc->pipe_bulk_out = 0U;
    hcdc->connected = false;

    host_cdc_scan_endpoints(hcdc, dev_addr, iface_desc, len);
    if (((hcdc->pipe_bulk_in == 0U) || (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out == 0U)) && (hcdc->host != NULL)) {
        host_cdc_scan_data_ifaces(hcdc, dev_addr);
    }

    if ((hcdc->pipe_bulk_in == 0U) || (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out == 0U)) {
        if (hcdc->pipe_bulk_in != 0U) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in);
            hcdc->pipe_bulk_in = 0U;
        }
        if (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out != 0U) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(hcdc->pipe_bulk_out);
            hcdc->pipe_bulk_out = 0U;
        }
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    hcdc->connected = true;
    (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in, hcdc->rx_buf,
                                        (uint16_t)sizeof(hcdc->rx_buf), true);
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void host_cdc_disconnected(void *ctx)
{
    SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc = (SYN_USB_HostCDC *)ctx;
    if (hcdc != NULL) {
        if (hcdc->pipe_bulk_in != 0U) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in);
            hcdc->pipe_bulk_in = 0U;
        }
        if (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out != 0U) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_host_pipe_close(hcdc->pipe_bulk_out);
            hcdc->pipe_bulk_out = 0U;
        }
        hcdc->connected = false;
        hcdc->rx_len = 0U;
        hcdc->tx_len = 0U;
    }
}

static void host_cdc_process_rx(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc)
{
    if ((hcdc->rx_len != 0U) || (hcdc->pipe_bulk_in == 0U) ||
        !syn_port_usb_host_xfer_done(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in)) {
        return;
    }

    uint16_t read_bytes = 0U;
    if ((syn_port_usb_host_xfer_result(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in, &read_bytes) == SYN_OK) &&
        (read_bytes > 0U)) {
        hcdc->rx_len =
            (read_bytes < sizeof(hcdc->rx_buf)) ? read_bytes : (uint16_t)sizeof(hcdc->rx_buf);
    } else {
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(hcdc->pipe_bulk_in, hcdc->rx_buf,
                                            (uint16_t)sizeof(hcdc->rx_buf), true);
    }
}

static void host_cdc_process(void *ctx)
{
    SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc = (SYN_USB_HostCDC *)ctx;
    if ((hcdc == NULL) || !hcdc->connected) {
        return;
    }

    if ((hcdc->tx_len > 0U) && (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out != 0U) &&
        syn_port_usb_host_xfer_done(hcdc->pipe_bulk_out)) {
        (void)syn_port_usb_host_submit_data(hcdc->pipe_bulk_out, hcdc->tx_buf, hcdc->tx_len, false);
        hcdc->tx_len = 0U;
    }

    host_cdc_process_rx(hcdc);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_cdc_init(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc)
{
    if (hcdc == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(hcdc, 0, sizeof(*hcdc));
    hcdc->line_coding.baudrate = 115200U;
    hcdc->line_coding.stop_bits = 0U;
    hcdc->line_coding.parity = 0U;
    hcdc->line_coding.data_bits = 8U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_cdc_register(SYN_USB_Host *host, SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc)
{
    if ((host == NULL) || (hcdc == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    hcdc->host = host;

    SYN_USB_HostClassDriver cls;
    memset(&cls, 0, sizeof(cls));
    cls.class_code = 0x02U;
    cls.subclass_code = 0xFFU;
    cls.protocol_code = 0xFFU;
    cls.ctx = hcdc;
    cls.probe = host_cdc_probe;
    cls.disconnected = host_cdc_disconnected;
    cls.process = host_cdc_process;

    return syn_usb_host_register_class(host, &cls);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_cdc_write(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if ((hcdc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (!syn_usb_host_cdc_tx_ready(hcdc)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    if (len > sizeof(hcdc->tx_buf)) {
        len = sizeof(hcdc->tx_buf);
    }

    memcpy(hcdc->tx_buf, data, len);
    hcdc->tx_len = (uint16_t)len;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_host_cdc_read(SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc, void *buf, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if ((hcdc == NULL) || (buf == NULL) || (out_len == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t available = hcdc->rx_len;
    if (available == 0U) {
        *out_len = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (max_len < available) {
        available = (uint16_t)max_len;
    }

    memcpy(buf, hcdc->rx_buf, available);
    *out_len = available;

    if (available < hcdc->rx_len) {
        memmove(hcdc->rx_buf, &hcdc->rx_buf[available], (size_t)(hcdc->rx_len - available));
        hcdc->rx_len = (uint16_t)(hcdc->rx_len - available);
    } else {
        hcdc->rx_len = 0U;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_usb_host_cdc_rx_available(const SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc)
{
    return (hcdc != NULL) && (hcdc->rx_len > 0U);
}

bool syn_usb_host_cdc_tx_ready(const SYN_USB_HostCDC *hcdc)
{
    if ((hcdc == NULL) || (hcdc->tx_len != 0U)) {
        return false;
    }
    return (hcdc->pipe_bulk_out == 0U) || syn_port_usb_host_xfer_done(hcdc->pipe_bulk_out);
}
