#include "syn_usb_midi.h"

#include "syntropic/port/syn_port_system.h"

#include <string.h>

static const uint8_t MIDI_INTERFACE_DESC[SYN_USB_MIDI_DESC_SIZE] = {
    /* Interface 0: Standard Audio Control Interface (0 endpoints) */
    0x09U, 0x04U, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* CS_INTERFACE: Audio Control Header (Streaming interface = 1) */
    0x09U, 0x24U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x09U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x01U,
    /* Interface 1: Standard MIDI Streaming Interface (2 endpoints) */
    0x09U, 0x04U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x02U, 0x01U, 0x03U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* CS_INTERFACE: MIDI Streaming Header (wTotalLength = 22) */
    0x07U, 0x24U, 0x01U, 0x00U, 0x01U, 0x16U, 0x00U,
    /* MIDI IN Jack Descriptor (Embedded, Jack ID 1) */
    0x06U, 0x24U, 0x02U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x00U,
    /* MIDI OUT Jack Descriptor (Embedded, Jack ID 2, Source = 1) */
    0x09U, 0x24U, 0x03U, 0x01U, 0x02U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x00U,
    /* Bulk OUT Endpoint Descriptor (offset 49, bEndpointAddress at 51) */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x01U, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* CS_ENDPOINT: MS General (1 Embedded MIDI IN Jack = ID 1) */
    0x05U, 0x25U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x01U,
    /* Bulk IN Endpoint Descriptor (offset 61, bEndpointAddress at 63) */
    0x07U, 0x05U, 0x81U, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
    /* CS_ENDPOINT: MS General (1 Embedded MIDI OUT Jack = ID 2) */
    0x05U, 0x25U, 0x01U, 0x01U, 0x02U};

static SYN_Status usb_midi_setup_handler(void *ctx, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                         uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    (void)ctx;
    (void)pkt;
    (void)resp;
    (void)resp_cap;
    if (rlen != NULL) {
        *rlen = 0U;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void usb_midi_data_out_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t ep, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    SYN_USB_MIDI *midi = (SYN_USB_MIDI *)ctx;
    if ((midi == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U) || (ep != midi->ep_out)) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint16_t space = (uint16_t)(sizeof(midi->rx_buf) - midi->rx_len);
    uint16_t copy_len = (len < space) ? len : space;
    if (copy_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(&midi->rx_buf[midi->rx_len], data, copy_len);
        midi->rx_len = (uint16_t)(midi->rx_len + copy_len);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static void usb_midi_data_in_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t ep)
{
    SYN_USB_MIDI *midi = (SYN_USB_MIDI *)ctx;
    if (midi == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    if (ep == midi->ep_in) {
        midi->tx_len = 0U;
    }
}

static SYN_Status usb_midi_configured_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t config)
{
    SYN_USB_MIDI *midi = (SYN_USB_MIDI *)ctx;
    (void)config;
    if (midi != NULL) {
        midi->tx_len = 0U;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_init(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi)
{
    if (midi == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(midi, 0, sizeof(*midi));
    midi->ep_in = 0x81U;
    midi->ep_out = 0x01U;
    midi->iface_num = 0U;
    midi->cable_num = 0U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_register(SYN_USB_Device *dev, SYN_USB_MIDI *midi)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (midi == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t desc_buf[SYN_USB_MIDI_DESC_SIZE];
    memcpy(desc_buf, MIDI_INTERFACE_DESC, sizeof(MIDI_INTERFACE_DESC));
    desc_buf[51] = midi->ep_out;
    desc_buf[63] = midi->ep_in;

    SYN_USB_ClassDriver driver;
    memset(&driver, 0, sizeof(driver));
    driver.iface_start = midi->iface_num;
    driver.iface_count = 2U;
    driver.ctx = midi;
    driver.setup = usb_midi_setup_handler;
    driver.data_out = usb_midi_data_out_handler;
    driver.data_in = usb_midi_data_in_handler;
    driver.configured = usb_midi_configured_handler;

    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_register_class(dev, &driver, desc_buf, SYN_USB_MIDI_DESC_SIZE);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        midi->iface_num = dev->classes[dev->class_count - 1U].iface_start;
        if (!dev->raw_config_override) {
            uint16_t base = (uint16_t)(dev->config_buf_used - SYN_USB_MIDI_DESC_SIZE);
            midi->ep_out = dev->config_buf[base + 51U];
            midi->ep_in = dev->config_buf[base + 63U];
        }
    }
    return st;
}

static SYN_Status queue_midi_packet(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, uint8_t cin, uint8_t status, uint8_t param1,
                                    uint8_t param2)
{
    if (midi == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((midi->tx_len + 4U) > SYN_USB_MIDI_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    uint8_t header = (uint8_t)(((midi->cable_num & 0x0FU) << 4) | (cin & 0x0FU));
    midi->tx_buf[midi->tx_len++] = header;
    midi->tx_buf[midi->tx_len++] = status;
    midi->tx_buf[midi->tx_len++] = param1;
    midi->tx_buf[midi->tx_len++] = param2;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_send_note_on(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, uint8_t channel, uint8_t note,
                                     uint8_t velocity)
{
    if ((channel > 15U) || (note > 127U) || (velocity > 127U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint8_t status = (uint8_t)(0x90U | channel);
    return queue_midi_packet(midi, SYN_USB_MIDI_CIN_NOTE_ON, status, note, velocity);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_send_note_off(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, uint8_t channel, uint8_t note,
                                      uint8_t velocity)
{
    if ((channel > 15U) || (note > 127U) || (velocity > 127U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint8_t status = (uint8_t)(0x80U | channel);
    return queue_midi_packet(midi, SYN_USB_MIDI_CIN_NOTE_OFF, status, note, velocity);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_send_cc(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, uint8_t channel, uint8_t controller,
                                uint8_t value)
{
    if ((channel > 15U) || (controller > 127U) || (value > 127U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint8_t status = (uint8_t)(0xB0U | channel);
    return queue_midi_packet(midi, SYN_USB_MIDI_CIN_CONTROL_CHANGE, status, controller, value);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_send_pitch_bend(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, uint8_t channel, int16_t value)
{
    if ((channel > 15U) || (value < -8192) || (value > 8191)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint16_t unsigned_val = (uint16_t)(value + 8192);
    uint8_t lsb = (uint8_t)(unsigned_val & 0x7FU);
    uint8_t msb = (uint8_t)((unsigned_val >> 7) & 0x7FU);
    uint8_t status = (uint8_t)(0xE0U | channel);

    return queue_midi_packet(midi, SYN_USB_MIDI_CIN_PITCH_BEND, status, lsb, msb);
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_parse_packet(const uint8_t raw_bytes[4], SYN_USB_MIDI_Packet *packet)
{
    if ((raw_bytes == NULL) || (packet == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    packet->header = raw_bytes[0];
    packet->midi0 = raw_bytes[1];
    packet->midi1 = raw_bytes[2];
    packet->midi2 = raw_bytes[3];
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_midi_read(SYN_USB_MIDI *midi, void *buf, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if ((midi == NULL) || (buf == NULL) || (out_len == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint16_t available = midi->rx_len;
    if (available == 0U) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        *out_len = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (max_len < available) {
        available = (uint16_t)max_len;
    }

    memcpy(buf, midi->rx_buf, available);
    if (available < midi->rx_len) {
        memmove(midi->rx_buf, &midi->rx_buf[available], (size_t)(midi->rx_len - available));
        midi->rx_len = (uint16_t)(midi->rx_len - available);
    } else {
        midi->rx_len = 0U;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    *out_len = available;
    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_usb_midi_rx_available(const SYN_USB_MIDI *midi)
{
    return (midi != NULL) && (midi->rx_len > 0U);
}

    uint8_t velocity

Note:

Port-decoupled staging contract: appends a 4-byte USB-MIDI Event Packet into midi->tx_buf (midi->tx_len up to 64 B so up to 16 events batch per packet). The platform USB ISR transmits midi->tx_buf on midi->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon completion to clear midi->tx_len.

  • channel MIDI Channel (0..15).

  • velocity Note Velocity (0..127).

#include "syn_usb_msc.h"

#include "port/syn_port_usb.h"

#include <string.h>

#define SYN_USB_MSC_CBW_SIGNATURE 0x43425355U 
#define SYN_USB_MSC_CSW_SIGNATURE 0x53425355U 
#define SYN_USB_MSC_CSW_SIZE 13U              

static void msc_put_le32(uint8_t dst[4], uint32_t val)
{
    dst[0] = (uint8_t)(val & 0xFFU);
    dst[1] = (uint8_t)((val >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    dst[2] = (uint8_t)((val >> 16) & 0xFFU);
    dst[3] = (uint8_t)((val >> 24) & 0xFFU);
}

static uint32_t msc_get_be32(const uint8_t src[4])
{
    return ((uint32_t)src[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)src[1] << 16) | ((uint32_t)src[2] << 8) |
           (uint32_t)src[3];
}

static void msc_stage_csw(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, uint8_t status, uint32_t residue)
{
    msc->csw.dCSWSignature = SYN_USB_MSC_CSW_SIGNATURE;
    msc->csw.dCSWTag = msc->cbw.dCBWTag;
    msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue = residue;
    msc->csw.bCSWStatus = status;

    msc_put_le32(&msc->tx_buf[0], msc->csw.dCSWSignature);
    msc_put_le32(&msc->tx_buf[4], msc->csw.dCSWTag);
    msc_put_le32(&msc->tx_buf[8], msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue);
    msc->tx_buf[12] = msc->csw.bCSWStatus;
    msc->tx_len = SYN_USB_MSC_CSW_SIZE;
    msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_CSW;
    (void)syn_port_usb_ep_write(msc->ep_in, msc->tx_buf, msc->tx_len);
}

static void msc_stall_cbw_pipe(const SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    if (msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength > 0U) {
        uint8_t ep = ((msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags & 0x80U) != 0U) ? msc->ep_in : msc->ep_out;
        (void)syn_port_usb_ep_stall(ep);
    }
}

static void msc_fail_cbw(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, uint8_t csw_status, uint8_t sense_key, uint8_t sense_asc)
{
    msc->sense_key = sense_key;
    msc->sense_asc = sense_asc;
    msc_stall_cbw_pipe(msc);
    msc_stage_csw(msc, csw_status, msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength);
}

static void msc_stage_next_in(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    if (msc->sector_offset >= msc->data_in_len) {
        if (msc->xfer_blocks_rem == 0U) {
            if (msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue > 0U) {
                (void)syn_port_usb_ep_stall(msc->ep_in);
            }
            msc_stage_csw(msc, msc->csw.bCSWStatus, msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue);
            return;
        }
        if (msc->media.read_blocks(msc->xfer_lba, msc->sector_buf, 1U) != SYN_OK) {
            uint32_t rem_bytes = (uint32_t)msc->xfer_blocks_rem * SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
            msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_MEDIUM_ERROR;
            msc->sense_asc = 0x11U;
            msc->xfer_blocks_rem = 0U;
            (void)syn_port_usb_ep_stall(msc->ep_in);
            msc_stage_csw(msc, 1U, msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue + rem_bytes);
            return;
        }
        msc->xfer_lba++;
        msc->xfer_blocks_rem--;
        msc->sector_offset = 0U;
        msc->data_in_len = SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
    }

    uint16_t rem = (uint16_t)(msc->data_in_len - msc->sector_offset);
    uint16_t chunk = (rem > SYN_USB_MSC_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) ? SYN_USB_MSC_MAX_PACKET_SIZE : rem;
    memcpy(msc->tx_buf, &msc->sector_buf[msc->sector_offset], chunk);
    msc->tx_len = chunk;
    msc->sector_offset = (uint16_t)(msc->sector_offset + chunk);
    msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_DATA_IN;
    (void)syn_port_usb_ep_write(msc->ep_in, msc->tx_buf, msc->tx_len);
}

static void msc_start_short_in(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, uint16_t resp_len)
{
    uint32_t host_len = msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength;
    if (host_len == 0U) {
        msc_stage_csw(msc, 0U, 0U);
        return;
    }
    if ((msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags & 0x80U) == 0U) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 2U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x20U);
        return;
    }

    uint16_t send_len = (host_len < (uint32_t)resp_len) ? (uint16_t)host_len : resp_len;
    msc->csw.bCSWStatus = 0U;
    msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue = host_len - (uint32_t)send_len;
    msc->xfer_blocks_rem = 0U;
    msc->sector_offset = 0U;
    msc->data_in_len = send_len;
    msc_stage_next_in(msc);
}

static bool msc_lba_range_valid(const SYN_USB_MSC *msc, uint32_t lba, uint16_t blocks)
{
    return (lba < msc->media.block_count) && ((uint32_t)blocks <= (msc->media.block_count - lba));
}

static void msc_handle_read10(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    uint32_t lba = msc_get_be32(&msc->cbw.CBWCB[2]);
    uint16_t blocks = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)msc->cbw.CBWCB[7] << 8) | msc->cbw.CBWCB[8]);
    uint32_t host_len = msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength;
    bool dir_in = (msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags & 0x80U) != 0U;

    if (blocks == 0U) {
        uint8_t csw_st = ((host_len > 0U) && !dir_in) ? 2U : 0U;
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, csw_st, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE, 0x00U);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t expected = (uint32_t)blocks * SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
    if ((host_len < expected) || !dir_in) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 2U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x20U);
        return;
    }

    if ((msc->media.read_blocks == NULL) || !msc_lba_range_valid(msc, lba, blocks)) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 1U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x21U);
        return;
    }

    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc->csw.bCSWStatus = 0U;
    msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue = host_len - expected;
    msc->xfer_lba = lba;
    msc->xfer_blocks_rem = blocks;
    msc->sector_offset = 0U;
    msc->data_in_len = 0U;
    msc_stage_next_in(msc);
}

static void msc_handle_write10(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    uint32_t lba = msc_get_be32(&msc->cbw.CBWCB[2]);
    uint16_t blocks = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)msc->cbw.CBWCB[7] << 8) | msc->cbw.CBWCB[8]);
    uint32_t host_len = msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength;
    bool dir_in = (msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags & 0x80U) != 0U;

    if (blocks == 0U) {
        uint8_t csw_st = ((host_len > 0U) && dir_in) ? 2U : 0U;
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, csw_st, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE, 0x00U);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t expected = (uint32_t)blocks * SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
    if ((host_len < expected) || dir_in) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 2U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x20U);
        return;
    }

    if ((msc->media.write_blocks == NULL) || !msc_lba_range_valid(msc, lba, blocks)) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 1U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x21U);
        return;
    }

    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc->csw.bCSWStatus = 0U;
    msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue = host_len - expected;
    msc->xfer_lba = lba;
    msc->xfer_blocks_rem = blocks;
    msc->sector_offset = 0U;
    msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_DATA_OUT;
}

static void msc_handle_request_sense(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    uint16_t alloc_len = msc->cbw.CBWCB[4];
    uint16_t resp_len = (alloc_len < 18U) ? alloc_len : 18U;
    memset(msc->sector_buf, 0, 18U);
    msc->sector_buf[0] = 0x70U;
    msc->sector_buf[2] = msc->sense_key;
    msc->sector_buf[7] = 10U;
    msc->sector_buf[12] = msc->sense_asc;
    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc_start_short_in(msc, resp_len);
}

static void msc_handle_inquiry(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    if (((msc->cbw.CBWCB[1] & 0x01U) != 0U) || (msc->cbw.CBWCB[2] != 0U)) {
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 1U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x24U);
        return;
    }

    uint16_t alloc_len = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)msc->cbw.CBWCB[3] << 8) | msc->cbw.CBWCB[4]);
    uint16_t resp_len = (alloc_len < 36U) ? alloc_len : 36U;
    memset(msc->sector_buf, 0, 36U);
    msc->sector_buf[1] = 0x80U;
    msc->sector_buf[2] = 0x04U;
    msc->sector_buf[3] = 0x02U;
    msc->sector_buf[4] = 31U;
    memcpy(&msc->sector_buf[8], "SYNTROPI", 8U);
    memcpy(&msc->sector_buf[16], "USB MSC STORAGE ", 16U);
    memcpy(&msc->sector_buf[32], "1.00", 4U);
    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc_start_short_in(msc, resp_len);
}

static void msc_handle_mode_sense6(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    uint16_t alloc_len = msc->cbw.CBWCB[4];
    uint16_t resp_len = (alloc_len < 4U) ? alloc_len : 4U;
    msc->sector_buf[0] = 0x03U;
    msc->sector_buf[1] = 0x00U;
    msc->sector_buf[2] = (msc->media.write_blocks == NULL) ? 0x80U : 0x00U;
    msc->sector_buf[3] = 0x00U;
    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc_start_short_in(msc, resp_len);
}

static void msc_handle_read_capacity10(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    uint32_t last_lba = (msc->media.block_count > 0U) ? (msc->media.block_count - 1U) : 0U;
    uint32_t blk_sz = (msc->media.block_size > 0U) ? (uint32_t)msc->media.block_size : 512U;
    msc->sector_buf[0] = (uint8_t)((last_lba >> 24) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[1] = (uint8_t)((last_lba >> 16) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[2] = (uint8_t)((last_lba >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[3] = (uint8_t)(last_lba & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[4] = (uint8_t)((blk_sz >> 24) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[5] = (uint8_t)((blk_sz >> 16) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[6] = (uint8_t)((blk_sz >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    msc->sector_buf[7] = (uint8_t)(blk_sz & 0xFFU);
    msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE;
    msc->sense_asc = 0x00U;
    msc_start_short_in(msc, 8U);
}

static void msc_handle_data_out_stream(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    uint16_t pos = 0U;

    while ((pos < len) && (msc->xfer_blocks_rem > 0U)) {
        uint16_t space = (uint16_t)(SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE - msc->sector_offset);
        uint16_t rem = (uint16_t)(len - pos);
        uint16_t copy = (rem < space) ? rem : space;

        memcpy(&msc->sector_buf[msc->sector_offset], &data[pos], copy);
        msc->sector_offset = (uint16_t)(msc->sector_offset + copy);
        pos = (uint16_t)(pos + copy);

        if (msc->sector_offset == SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE) {
            msc->sector_offset = 0U;
            if (msc->media.write_blocks(msc->xfer_lba, msc->sector_buf, 1U) != SYN_OK) {
                uint32_t rem_bytes = (uint32_t)msc->xfer_blocks_rem * SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
                msc->sense_key = SYN_SCSI_SENSE_MEDIUM_ERROR;
                msc->sense_asc = 0x0CU;
                msc->xfer_blocks_rem = 0U;
                (void)syn_port_usb_ep_stall(msc->ep_out);
                msc_stage_csw(msc, 1U, msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue + rem_bytes);
                return;
            }
            msc->xfer_lba++;
            msc->xfer_blocks_rem--;
        }
    }

    if (msc->xfer_blocks_rem == 0U) {
        if (msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue > 0U) {
            (void)syn_port_usb_ep_stall(msc->ep_out);
        }
        msc_stage_csw(msc, 0U, msc->csw.dCSWDataResidue);
    }
}

static SYN_Status usb_msc_setup_handler(void *ctx, const SYN_USB_SetupPacket *pkt, uint8_t *resp,
                                        uint16_t resp_cap, uint16_t *rlen)
{
    SYN_USB_MSC *msc = (SYN_USB_MSC *)ctx;
    if ((msc == NULL) || (pkt == NULL) || (resp == NULL) || (rlen == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *rlen = 0U;
    if (pkt->bRequest == 0xFEU) {
        if (resp_cap < 1U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        resp[0] = 0U;
        *rlen = 1U;
    } else if (pkt->bRequest == 0xFFU) {
        msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_IDLE;
        msc->tx_len = 0U;
        msc->xfer_blocks_rem = 0U;
        msc->sector_offset = 0U;
        msc->data_in_len = 0U;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void usb_msc_data_out_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t ep, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    SYN_USB_MSC *msc = (SYN_USB_MSC *)ctx;
    if ((msc == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (ep != msc->ep_out)) {
        return;
    }

    if (msc->bot_state == SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_DATA_OUT) {
        msc_handle_data_out_stream(msc, data, len);
        return;
    }

    if (len >= 31U) {
        (void)syn_usb_msc_process_cbw(msc, data);
    }
}

static void usb_msc_data_in_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t ep)
{
    SYN_USB_MSC *msc = (SYN_USB_MSC *)ctx;
    if ((msc == NULL) || (ep != msc->ep_in)) {
        return;
    }

    msc->tx_len = 0U;
    if (msc->bot_state == SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_DATA_IN) {
        msc_stage_next_in(msc);
    } else {
        msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_IDLE;
    }
}

static SYN_Status usb_msc_configured_handler(void *ctx, uint8_t config)
{
    SYN_USB_MSC *msc = (SYN_USB_MSC *)ctx;
    (void)config;
    if (msc != NULL) {
        msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_IDLE;
        msc->tx_len = 0U;
        msc->xfer_blocks_rem = 0U;
        msc->sector_offset = 0U;
        msc->data_in_len = 0U;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_msc_init(SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    if (msc == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(msc, 0, sizeof(*msc));
    msc->ep_in = 0x82U;
    msc->ep_out = 0x02U;
    msc->iface_num = 0U;
    msc->bot_state = SYN_USB_MSC_BOT_IDLE;
    msc->media.block_size = SYN_USB_MSC_BLOCK_SIZE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_msc_get_config_desc(const SYN_USB_MSC *msc,
                                       uint8_t desc_out[SYN_USB_MSC_DESC_SIZE])
{
    if ((msc == NULL) || (desc_out == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t tmpl[SYN_USB_MSC_DESC_SIZE] = {
        /* Interface Descriptor (9B): Mass Storage, SCSI Transparent, Bulk-Only */
        0x09U, 0x04U, msc->iface_num, 0x00U, 0x02U, 0x08U, 0x06U, 0x50U, 0x00U,
        /* Bulk IN Endpoint Descriptor (7B) */
        0x07U, 0x05U, msc->ep_in, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U,
        /* Bulk OUT Endpoint Descriptor (7B) */
        0x07U, 0x05U, msc->ep_out, 0x02U, 0x40U, 0x00U, 0x00U};

    memcpy(desc_out, tmpl, sizeof(tmpl));
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_msc_register(SYN_USB_Device *dev, SYN_USB_MSC *msc)
{
    if ((dev == NULL) || (msc == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t msc_desc[SYN_USB_MSC_DESC_SIZE];
    (void)syn_usb_msc_get_config_desc(msc, msc_desc);

    SYN_USB_ClassDriver driver;
    memset(&driver, 0, sizeof(driver));
    driver.iface_start = msc->iface_num;
    driver.iface_count = 1U;
    driver.ctx = msc;
    driver.setup = usb_msc_setup_handler;
    driver.data_out = usb_msc_data_out_handler;
    driver.data_in = usb_msc_data_in_handler;
    driver.configured = usb_msc_configured_handler;

    SYN_Status st = syn_usb_register_class(dev, &driver, msc_desc, SYN_USB_MSC_DESC_SIZE);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        msc->iface_num = dev->classes[dev->class_count - 1U].iface_start;
        if (!dev->raw_config_override) {
            uint16_t base = (uint16_t)(dev->config_buf_used - SYN_USB_MSC_DESC_SIZE);
            msc->ep_in = dev->config_buf[base + 11U];
            msc->ep_out = dev->config_buf[base + 18U];
        }
    }
    return st;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_msc_set_media(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, const SYN_USB_MSC_Media *media)
{
    if ((msc == NULL) || (media == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    msc->media = *media;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_usb_msc_process_cbw(SYN_USB_MSC *msc, const uint8_t cbw_raw[31])
{
    if ((msc == NULL) || (cbw_raw == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t sig = ((uint32_t)cbw_raw[0]) | (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[1]) << 8) |
                   (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[2]) << 16) | (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[3]) << 24);
    if (sig != SYN_USB_MSC_CBW_SIGNATURE) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    msc->cbw.dCBWSignature = sig;
    msc->cbw.dCBWTag = ((uint32_t)cbw_raw[4]) | (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[5]) << 8) |
                       (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[6]) << 16) | (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[7]) << 24);
    msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength = ((uint32_t)cbw_raw[8]) | (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[9]) << 8) |
                                      (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[10]) << 16) |
                                      (((uint32_t)cbw_raw[11]) << 24);
    msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags = cbw_raw[12];
    msc->cbw.bCBWLUN = cbw_raw[13];
    msc->cbw.bCBWCBLength = cbw_raw[14];
    memcpy(msc->cbw.CBWCB, &cbw_raw[15], 16U);

    switch (msc->cbw.CBWCB[0]) {
    case SYN_SCSI_TEST_UNIT_READY: {
        bool bad_dir =
            (msc->cbw.dCBWDataTransferLength > 0U) && ((msc->cbw.bmCBWFlags & 0x80U) == 0U);
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, bad_dir ? 2U : 0U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_NONE, 0x00U);
        break;
    }

    case SYN_SCSI_REQUEST_SENSE:
        msc_handle_request_sense(msc);
        break;

    case SYN_SCSI_INQUIRY:
        msc_handle_inquiry(msc);
        break;

    case SYN_SCSI_MODE_SENSE_6:
        msc_handle_mode_sense6(msc);
        break;

    case SYN_SCSI_READ_CAPACITY_10:
        msc_handle_read_capacity10(msc);
        break;

    case SYN_SCSI_READ_10:
        msc_handle_read10(msc);
        break;

    case SYN_SCSI_WRITE_10:
        msc_handle_write10(msc);
        break;

    default:
        msc_fail_cbw(msc, 1U, SYN_SCSI_SENSE_ILLEGAL_REQUEST, 0x20U);
        break;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_BIQUAD) || SYN_USE_BIQUAD

#include <string.h>

/* ── Biquad Filter API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_filter_biquad_init(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t b0, q16_t b1, q16_t b2, q16_t a1, q16_t a2)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    f->b0 = b0;
    f->b1 = b1;
    f->b2 = b2;
    f->a1 = a1;
    f->a2 = a2;
    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_reset(SYN_FilterBiquad *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    if (f == NULL)
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    f->x1 = 0;
    f->x2 = 0;
    f->y1 = 0;
    f->y2 = 0;
}

static inline q16_t biquad_sat_q16(int64_t acc)
{
    int64_t shifted = acc >> 16;
    if (shifted > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    if (shifted < (int64_t)INT32_MIN) {
        return INT32_MIN;
    }
    return (q16_t)shifted;
}

q16_t syn_filter_biquad_update(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t sample)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);

    /* y[n] = b0*x[n] + b1*x[n-1] + b2*x[n-2] - a1*y[n-1] - a2*y[n-2] */
    int64_t acc = ((int64_t)f->b0 * sample) + ((int64_t)f->b1 * f->x1) + ((int64_t)f->b2 * f->x2) -
                  ((int64_t)f->a1 * f->y1) - ((int64_t)f->a2 * f->y2);

    /* Shift back to Q16.16 with saturation */
    q16_t output = biquad_sat_q16(acc);

    /* Update history */
    f->x2 = f->x1;
    f->x1 = sample;
    f->y2 = f->y1;
    f->y1 = output;

    return output;
}

void syn_filter_biquad_process_block(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, const q16_t *in, q16_t *out,
                                     uint16_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL && in != NULL && out != NULL);
    q16_t b0 = f->b0, b1 = f->b1, b2 = f->b2;
    q16_t a1 = f->a1, a2 = f->a2;
    q16_t x1 = f->x1, x2 = f->x2;
    q16_t y1 = f->y1, y2 = f->y2;

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        q16_t sample = in[i];
        int64_t acc = ((int64_t)b0 * sample) + ((int64_t)b1 * x1) + ((int64_t)b2 * x2) -
                      ((int64_t)a1 * y1) - ((int64_t)a2 * y2);
        q16_t output = biquad_sat_q16(acc);
        x2 = x1;
        x1 = sample;
        y2 = y1;
        y1 = output;
        out[i] = output;
    }

    f->x1 = x1;
    f->x2 = x2;
    f->y1 = y1;
    f->y2 = y2;
}

static bool biquad_prepare_omega(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs, q16_t *omega_out)
{
    if (fs <= 3) {
        syn_filter_biquad_init(f, Q16_ONE, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        return false;
    }
    q16_t nyq_max = (fs >> 1) - 1;
    q16_t clamped_fc = fc;
    if (clamped_fc < 1) {
        clamped_fc = 1;
    } else if (clamped_fc > nyq_max) {
        clamped_fc = nyq_max;
    }
    *omega_out = (q16_t)(((int64_t)Q16_2_PI * (int64_t)clamped_fc) / (int64_t)fs);
    return true;
}

void syn_filter_biquad_lowpass(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }

    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    /* Butterworth Q = 1/sqrt(2) ≈ 0.707107 */
    q16_t q_val = 46341; /* 0.70710678 in Q16.16 */
    q16_t alpha = q16_mul(sin_w, q_val);

    q16_t a0 = Q16_ONE + alpha;
    q16_t b0 = q16_div(Q16_ONE - cos_w, Q16_FROM_INT(2));
    q16_t b1 = Q16_ONE - cos_w;
    q16_t b2 = b0;
    q16_t a1 = -q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), cos_w);
    q16_t a2 = Q16_ONE - alpha;

    /* Normalize by a0 */
    f->b0 = q16_div(b0, a0);
    f->b1 = q16_div(b1, a0);
    f->b2 = q16_div(b2, a0);
    f->a1 = q16_div(a1, a0);
    f->a2 = q16_div(a2, a0);

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_highpass(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }
    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    /* Butterworth Q = 1/sqrt(2) */
    q16_t q_val = 46341; /* 0.70710678 in Q16.16 */
    q16_t alpha = q16_mul(sin_w, q_val);

    q16_t a0 = Q16_ONE + alpha;
    q16_t one_plus_cos = Q16_ONE + cos_w;
    q16_t b0 = q16_div(one_plus_cos, Q16_FROM_INT(2));
    q16_t b1 = -(Q16_ONE + cos_w);
    q16_t b2 = b0;
    q16_t a1 = -q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), cos_w);
    q16_t a2 = Q16_ONE - alpha;

    f->b0 = q16_div(b0, a0);
    f->b1 = q16_div(b1, a0);
    f->b2 = q16_div(b2, a0);
    f->a1 = q16_div(a1, a0);
    f->a2 = q16_div(a2, a0);

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

static inline q16_t biquad_div_a0(int64_t num, int64_t a0)
{
    return (q16_t)((num * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / a0);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_bandpass(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs, q16_t q)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(q > 0);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }
    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    int64_t alpha = ((int64_t)sin_w * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * (int64_t)q);
    int64_t a0 = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + alpha;

    f->b0 = biquad_div_a0(alpha, a0);
    f->b1 = 0;
    f->b2 = -f->b0;
    f->a1 = biquad_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w, a0);
    f->a2 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha, a0);

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_notch(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs, q16_t q)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(q > 0);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }
    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    int64_t alpha = ((int64_t)sin_w * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * (int64_t)q);
    int64_t a0 = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + alpha;

    f->b0 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE, a0);
    f->b1 = biquad_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w, a0);
    f->b2 = f->b0;
    f->a1 = f->b1;
    f->a2 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha, a0);

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_allpass(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs, q16_t q)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(q > 0);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }
    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    int64_t alpha = ((int64_t)sin_w * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * (int64_t)q);
    int64_t a0 = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + alpha;

    f->b0 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha, a0);
    f->b1 = biquad_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w, a0);
    f->b2 = Q16_ONE;
    f->a1 = f->b1;
    f->a2 = f->b0;

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

void syn_filter_biquad_peaking_eq(SYN_FilterBiquad *f, q16_t fc, q16_t fs, q16_t gain_db, q16_t q)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(q > 0);
    q16_t omega = 0;
    if (!biquad_prepare_omega(f, fc, fs, &omega)) {
        return;
    }
    q16_t sin_w = q16_sin(omega);
    q16_t cos_w = q16_cos(omega);

    /* A = 10^(gain_db / 40) ≈ 1 + gain_db / 35 (clamped to [0.1, 64.0]) */
    int64_t a_gain =
        (int64_t)Q16_ONE + (((int64_t)gain_db * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)Q16_FROM_INT(35));
    if (a_gain < (int64_t)Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 10)) {
        a_gain = (int64_t)Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 10);
    } else if (a_gain > (int64_t)Q16_FROM_INT(64)) {
        a_gain = (int64_t)Q16_FROM_INT(64);
    }

    int64_t alpha = ((int64_t)sin_w * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * (int64_t)q);
    int64_t alpha_a = (alpha * a_gain) >> Q16_SHIFT;
    int64_t alpha_div_a = (alpha * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / a_gain;
    int64_t a0 = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + alpha_div_a;

    f->b0 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE + alpha_a, a0);
    f->b1 = biquad_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w, a0);
    f->b2 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha_a, a0);
    f->a1 = f->b1;
    f->a2 = biquad_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha_div_a, a0);

    syn_filter_biquad_reset(f);
}

/* ── Cascaded Biquad Filter Bank ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_filter_biquad_cascade_init(SYN_FilterBiquadCascade *c, uint8_t num_stages)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(c != NULL);
    if (num_stages == 0 || num_stages > SYN_BIQUAD_CASCADE_MAX_STAGES) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(c, 0, sizeof(*c));
    c->num_stages = num_stages;

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < num_stages; i++) {
        c->stages[i].b0 = Q16_ONE; /* Passthrough by default */
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_filter_biquad_cascade_reset(SYN_FilterBiquadCascade *c)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(c != NULL);
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < c->num_stages; i++) {
        syn_filter_biquad_reset(&c->stages[i]);
    }
}

q16_t syn_filter_biquad_cascade_update(SYN_FilterBiquadCascade *c, q16_t sample)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(c != NULL);
    q16_t s = sample;
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < c->num_stages; i++) {
        s = syn_filter_biquad_update(&c->stages[i], s);
    }
    return s;
}

void syn_filter_biquad_cascade_process_block(SYN_FilterBiquadCascade *c, const q16_t *in,
                                             q16_t *out, uint16_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(c != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(in != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(out != NULL);

    for (uint16_t n = 0; n < count; n++) {
        out[n] = syn_filter_biquad_cascade_update(c, in[n]);
    }
}

#include "syn_dds.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

static uint32_t dds_xorshift32(SYN_DDS *dds)
{
    uint32_t x = dds->rand_state;
    if (x == 0U) {
        x = 0xA5A5A5A5U;
    }
    x ^= x << 13U;
    x ^= x >> 17U;
    x ^= x << 5U;
    dds->rand_state = x;
    return x;
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_init(SYN_DDS *dds, SYN_DDS_Waveform type, uint32_t freq_hz,
                        uint32_t sample_rate_hz)
{
    if (!dds || sample_rate_hz == 0U || freq_hz >= sample_rate_hz)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    memset(dds, 0, sizeof(*dds));
    dds->type = type;
    dds->amplitude = Q16_ONE;
    dds->offset = 0;
    dds->duty_q16 = 32768U; /* 50% default duty cycle */
    dds->rand_state = 0x12345678U;

    return syn_dds_set_freq(dds, freq_hz, sample_rate_hz);
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_set_freq(SYN_DDS *dds, uint32_t freq_hz, uint32_t sample_rate_hz)
{
    if (!dds || sample_rate_hz == 0U || freq_hz >= sample_rate_hz)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    /* phase_step = (freq_hz * 2^32) / sample_rate_hz */
    uint64_t step = ((uint64_t)freq_hz << 32) / (uint64_t)sample_rate_hz;
    dds->phase_step = (uint32_t)step;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_set_gain(SYN_DDS *dds, q16_t amplitude, q16_t offset)
{
    if (!dds)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    dds->amplitude = amplitude;
    dds->offset = offset;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_set_duty(SYN_DDS *dds, float duty_pct)
{
    if (!dds || !isfinite(duty_pct))
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    float duty = duty_pct;
    if (duty < 0.0f)
        duty = 0.0f;
    if (duty > 100.0f)
        duty = 100.0f;

    dds->duty_q16 = (uint32_t)((duty / 100.0f) * 65536.0f + 0.5f);

    return SYN_OK;
}

q16_t syn_dds_step(SYN_DDS *dds)
{
    if (!dds)
        return 0;

    q16_t raw_sample = 0;
    uint32_t phase = dds->phase;

    switch (dds->type) {
    case SYN_DDS_SINE: {
        /* Convert 32-bit phase (0..2^32-1) to Q16.16 angle (0 to 2*PI), then wrap to -PI..+PI */
        int64_t norm_phase = (int64_t)(phase >> 16);                   /* 0..65535 */
        q16_t angle = (q16_t)((norm_phase * (int64_t)Q16_2_PI) >> 16); /* 0 to 6.28318 */
        if (angle > Q16_PI) {
            angle -= Q16_2_PI;
        }
        raw_sample = q16_sin(angle);
        break;
    }
    case SYN_DDS_TRIANGLE: {
        /* Phase 0..2^31-1 ramps up, 2^31..2^32-1 ramps down */
        if (phase < 0x80000000U) {
            raw_sample = (q16_t)(((int64_t)phase * 131072LL) >> 31) - Q16_ONE;
        } else {
            uint32_t rem = phase - 0x80000000U;
            raw_sample = Q16_ONE - (q16_t)(((int64_t)rem * 131072LL) >> 31);
        }
        break;
    }
    case SYN_DDS_SAWTOOTH: {
        /* Full ramp from -1.0 to +1.0 */
        raw_sample = (q16_t)(((int64_t)phase * 131072LL) >> 32) - Q16_ONE;
        break;
    }
    case SYN_DDS_SQUARE: {
        /* Compare top 16 bits of phase against duty threshold [0..65536] */
        uint32_t top_phase = phase >> 16U;
        if (top_phase < dds->duty_q16) {
            raw_sample = Q16_ONE;
        } else {
            raw_sample = -Q16_ONE;
        }
        break;
    }
    case SYN_DDS_NOISE: {
        uint32_t rnd = dds_xorshift32(dds);
        int32_t signed_val = (int32_t)(rnd & 0xFFFFU) - 32768;
        raw_sample = (q16_t)(signed_val * 2);
        break;
    }
    default:
        break;
    }

    dds->phase += dds->phase_step;

    /* Apply amplitude gain and DC offset with saturation */
    return q16_add_sat(q16_mul_sat(raw_sample, dds->amplitude), dds->offset);
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_fill_q16(SYN_DDS *dds, q16_t *buf, size_t count)
{
    if (!dds || !buf)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        buf[i] = syn_dds_step(dds);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_dds_fill_u16(SYN_DDS *dds, uint16_t *buf, size_t count, uint16_t dac_center,
                            uint16_t dac_span)
{
    if (!dds || !buf)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        q16_t sample = syn_dds_step(dds); /* normalized roughly -1.0 to +1.0 */
        int64_t val = (int64_t)dac_center + (((int64_t)sample * (int64_t)dac_span) >> Q16_SHIFT);
        if (val < 0)
            val = 0;
        if (val > 65535)
            val = 65535;
        buf[i] = (uint16_t)val;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#include "syn_dsp.h"

static q7_t dsp_q16_to_q7_trunc(int64_t val_q16)
{
    int64_t scaled = val_q16 / 512LL;
    if (scaled > 127LL) {
        return (q7_t)127;
    }
    if (scaled < -128LL) {
        return (q7_t)-128;
    }
    return (q7_t)scaled;
}

SYN_Status syn_dsp_dct2_q7(const q7_t *time_series, size_t num_samples, q7_t *dct_coeffs,
                           size_t num_coeffs)
{
    if (!time_series || !dct_coeffs || num_samples == 0U || num_coeffs == 0U ||
        num_coeffs > num_samples) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint64_t n_u64 = (uint64_t)num_samples;
    q16_t inv_n = (q16_t)(((uint64_t)Q16_ONE) / n_u64);
    q16_t two_inv_n = (q16_t)((2ULL * (uint64_t)Q16_ONE) / n_u64);
    q16_t scale_dc = q16_sqrt(inv_n);
    q16_t scale_ac = q16_sqrt(two_inv_n);
    uint64_t two_n = 2ULL * n_u64;
    uint64_t four_n = 4ULL * n_u64;

    for (size_t k = 0U; k < num_coeffs; k++) {
        int64_t acc_q16 = 0;
        q16_t scale = (k == 0U) ? scale_dc : scale_ac;
        uint64_t k_mod = (uint64_t)k % four_n;

        for (size_t n = 0U; n < num_samples; n++) {
            uint64_t step_mod = (2ULL * (uint64_t)n + 1ULL) % four_n;
            uint64_t phase_idx = (k_mod * step_mod) % four_n;
            q16_t angle = (q16_t)(((uint64_t)Q16_PI * phase_idx) / two_n);
            q16_t cos_val = q16_cos(angle);
            acc_q16 += ((int64_t)time_series[n] * (int64_t)cos_val) >> 7;
        }

        int64_t scaled_q16 = (acc_q16 * (int64_t)scale) >> Q16_SHIFT;
        dct_coeffs[k] = dsp_q16_to_q7_trunc(scaled_q16);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

Computes the in-place Radix-2 Decimation-in-Time FFT. 

SYN_Status syn_dsp_fft (
    q16_t * real,
    q16_t * imag,
    uint16_t n
)

n must be a power of 2 in [2, 256] (e.g., 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256).

Note:

Butterfly stages are unscaled (coherent gain = N; DC/bin magnitudes scale by n). Maintain input amplitude headroom |x[k]| < 32768 / n in Q16.16 (e.g., |x[k]| < 128.0 for n = 256) to avoid int32_t overflow.

Parameters:

  • real Array of real parts (size n).
  • imag Array of imaginary parts (size n).
  • n Size of the FFT (must be power of 2).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERROR on invalid parameters (e.g. not power of 2).

docs.text:
Cooperative stage-sliced Radix-2 Decimation-in-Time FFT protothread. 

SYN_PT_Status syn_dsp_fft_pt (
    SYN_PT * pt,
    q16_t * real,
    q16_t * imag,
    uint16_t n,
    uint16_t * current_stage
)

Performs bit-reversal sorting on the initial slice and executes one butterfly stage (1 .. log2(n)) per resumption, yielding PT_MORE via PT_CONTINUE(pt) between stages. Composes with PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED(pt, task, child, syn_dsp_fft_pt(...)) so uncontended FFTs execute back-to-back in a single dispatch while contended runs yield between butterfly stages.

Parameters:

  • pt Child protothread control block.
  • real Array of real parts (size n).
  • imag Array of imaginary parts (size n).
  • n FFT size (power of 2 in [2, 256]).
  • current_stage Caller-owned stage cursor (persistent across yields).

Returns:

PT_MORE while stages remain, PT_ENDED on completion, or PT_EXITED on invalid params.

/* Quarter-sine lookup table for N=256. Covers i=0..64 (0 to PI/2 radians). */
static const q16_t g_sin_table[65] = {
    0x00000000, 0x00000648, 0x00000C90, 0x000012D5, 0x00001918, 0x00001F56, 0x00002590, 0x00002BC4,
    0x000031F1, 0x00003817, 0x00003E34, 0x00004447, 0x00004A50, 0x0000504D, 0x0000563E, 0x00005C22,
    0x000061F8, 0x000067BE, 0x00006D74, 0x0000731A, 0x000078AD, 0x00007E2F, 0x0000839C, 0x000088F6,
    0x00008E3A, 0x00009368, 0x00009880, 0x00009D80, 0x0000A268, 0x0000A736, 0x0000ABEB, 0x0000B086,
    0x0000B505, 0x0000B968, 0x0000BDAF, 0x0000C1D8, 0x0000C5E4, 0x0000C9D1, 0x0000CD9F, 0x0000D14D,
    0x0000D4DB, 0x0000D848, 0x0000DB94, 0x0000DEBE, 0x0000E1C6, 0x0000E4AA, 0x0000E76C, 0x0000EA0A,
    0x0000EC83, 0x0000EED9, 0x0000F109, 0x0000F314, 0x0000F4FA, 0x0000F6BA, 0x0000F854, 0x0000F9C8,
    0x0000FB15, 0x0000FC3B, 0x0000FD3B, 0x0000FE13, 0x0000FEC4, 0x0000FF4E, 0x0000FFB1, 0x0000FFEC,
    0x00010000,
};

static uint16_t reverse_bits(uint16_t x, uint16_t stages)
{
    uint16_t rev = 0;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < stages; i++) {
        rev = (rev << 1) | (x & 1);
        x >>= 1;
    }
    return rev;
}

static void bit_reverse_sort(q16_t *real, q16_t *imag, uint16_t n, uint16_t stages)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint16_t rev = reverse_bits(i, stages);
        if (i < rev) {
            /* Swap real */
            q16_t temp = real[i];
            real[i] = real[rev];
            real[rev] = temp;
            /* Swap imaginary */
            temp = imag[i];
            imag[i] = imag[rev];
            imag[rev] = temp;
        }
    }
}

static void get_twiddle(uint16_t k, uint16_t stage, q16_t *wr, q16_t *wi)
{
    uint16_t idx = (uint16_t)((256u * k) >> stage);
    uint16_t theta = idx & 0x3F;       /* idx % 64 */
    uint16_t quad = (idx >> 6) & 0x03; /* idx / 64 */

    SYN_ASSERT(quad <= 1); /* k < m/2 guarantees idx < 128 */

    q16_t s, c;
    if (quad == 0) {
        s = g_sin_table[theta];
        c = g_sin_table[64 - theta];
    } else {
        s = g_sin_table[64 - theta];
        c = -g_sin_table[theta];
    }

    *wr = c;
    *wi = -s; /* e^(-i*theta) = cos(theta) - i*sin(theta) */
}

static uint16_t fft_log2_stages(uint16_t n)
{
    if (n < 2U || n > 256U || (n & (uint16_t)(n - 1U)) != 0U) {
        return 0U;
    }
    uint16_t stages = 0U;
    uint16_t temp = n;
    while (temp > 1U) {
        temp >>= 1U;
        stages++;
    }
    return stages;
}

static void fft_butterfly_stage(q16_t *real, q16_t *imag, uint16_t n, uint16_t stage)
{
    uint16_t m = (uint16_t)(1U << stage);
    uint16_t m2 = (uint16_t)(m >> 1U);

    for (uint16_t k = 0U; k < m2; k++) {
        q16_t wr, wi;
        get_twiddle(k, stage, &wr, &wi);

        for (uint16_t j = 0U; j < n; j = (uint16_t)(j + m)) {
            uint16_t i = (uint16_t)(j + k);
            uint16_t ip = (uint16_t)(i + m2);

            q16_t tr = q16_mul(wr, real[ip]) - q16_mul(wi, imag[ip]);
            q16_t ti = q16_mul(wr, imag[ip]) + q16_mul(wi, real[ip]);

            real[ip] = real[i] - tr;
            imag[ip] = imag[i] - ti;
            real[i] = real[i] + tr;
            imag[i] = imag[i] + ti;
        }
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_dsp_fft(q16_t *real, q16_t *imag, uint16_t n)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(real != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(imag != NULL);

    uint16_t stages = fft_log2_stages(n);
    if (stages == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    bit_reverse_sort(real, imag, n, stages);

    for (uint16_t stage = 1U; stage <= stages; stage++) {
        fft_butterfly_stage(real, imag, n, stage);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_dsp_fft_pt(SYN_PT *pt, q16_t *real, q16_t *imag, uint16_t n,
                             uint16_t *current_stage)
{
    if (pt == NULL || real == NULL || imag == NULL || current_stage == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    uint16_t stages = fft_log2_stages(n);
    if (stages == 0U) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    *current_stage = 1U;
    bit_reverse_sort(real, imag, n, stages);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    while (*current_stage <= stages) {
        fft_butterfly_stage(real, imag, n, *current_stage);
        (*current_stage)++;
        if (*current_stage <= stages) {
            PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

static inline q16_t fft_window_angle(uint16_t i, uint16_t n)
{
    return (q16_t)(((int64_t)Q16_2_PI * (int64_t)i) / (int64_t)((uint32_t)n - 1U));
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_window_hanning(q16_t *out, uint16_t n)
{
    if ((out == NULL) || (n <= 1U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
        q16_t theta = fft_window_angle(i, n);
        q16_t cos_t = q16_cos_fast(theta);
        out[i] = q16_mul(Q16_HALF, Q16_ONE - cos_t);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_window_hamming(q16_t *out, uint16_t n)
{
    if ((out == NULL) || (n <= 1U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t a0 = Q16_FROM_FRAC(54, 100);
    q16_t a1 = Q16_FROM_FRAC(46, 100);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
        q16_t theta = fft_window_angle(i, n);
        q16_t cos_t = q16_cos_fast(theta);
        out[i] = a0 - q16_mul(a1, cos_t);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_window_blackman(q16_t *out, uint16_t n)
{
    if ((out == NULL) || (n <= 1U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t a0 = Q16_FROM_FRAC(42, 100);
    q16_t a1 = Q16_FROM_FRAC(50, 100);
    q16_t a2 = Q16_FROM_FRAC(8, 100);

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
        q16_t theta = fft_window_angle(i, n);
        q16_t cos_t1 = q16_cos_fast(theta);
        q16_t cos_t2 = q16_cos_fast((q16_t)((int64_t)theta * 2LL));
        out[i] = a0 - q16_mul(a1, cos_t1) + q16_mul(a2, cos_t2);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_magnitude_spectrum(const q16_t *real, const q16_t *imag, q16_t *mag, uint16_t n)
{
    if (real == NULL || imag == NULL || mag == NULL || n == 0)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    uint16_t n_bins = (n >> 1) + 1;
    for (uint16_t k = 0; k < n_bins; k++) {
        mag[k] = q16_hypot(real[k], imag[k]);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void fft_insert_peak(SYN_FFTPeak *peaks, uint8_t max_peaks, uint8_t *count, SYN_FFTPeak cand)
{
    uint8_t pos = 0U;
    while ((pos < *count) && (peaks[pos].magnitude >= cand.magnitude)) {
        pos++;
    }
    if (pos < max_peaks) {
        if (*count < max_peaks) {
            (*count)++;
        }
        for (uint8_t j = (uint8_t)(*count - 1U); j > pos; j--) {
            peaks[j] = peaks[j - 1U];
        }
        peaks[pos] = cand;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_find_peaks(const q16_t *mag, uint16_t n_bins, q16_t sample_rate_hz,
                              SYN_FFTPeak *peaks, uint8_t max_peaks, uint8_t *num_peaks_found)
{
    if (mag == NULL || peaks == NULL || num_peaks_found == NULL || n_bins <= 2U ||
        max_peaks == 0U || sample_rate_hz <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t count = 0U;
    uint32_t fft_size = ((uint32_t)n_bins - 1U) * 2U;

    for (uint16_t k = 1U; k < (uint16_t)(n_bins - 1U); k++) {
        if ((mag[k] > mag[k - 1U]) && (mag[k] > mag[k + 1U])) {
            SYN_FFTPeak cand;
            cand.bin = k;
            cand.magnitude = mag[k];
            cand.freq_hz = (q16_t)(((int64_t)sample_rate_hz * (int64_t)k) / (int64_t)fft_size);
            fft_insert_peak(peaks, max_peaks, &count, cand);
        }
    }

    *num_peaks_found = count;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_fft_thd(const q16_t *mag, uint16_t n_bins, uint16_t fundamental_bin,
                       uint8_t max_harmonics, q16_t *thd_pct)
{
    if (mag == NULL || thd_pct == NULL || fundamental_bin == 0U || fundamental_bin >= n_bins ||
        max_harmonics == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t v1 = mag[fundamental_bin];
    if (v1 <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint64_t sum_sq_q32 = 0ULL;
    for (uint16_t h = 2U; h <= (uint16_t)max_harmonics + 1U; h++) {
        uint32_t h_bin = (uint32_t)fundamental_bin * (uint32_t)h;
        if ((h_bin < n_bins) && (mag[h_bin] > 0)) {
            uint64_t v_h = (uint64_t)mag[h_bin];
            uint64_t term = v_h * v_h;
            sum_sq_q32 = (UINT64_MAX - sum_sq_q32 < term) ? UINT64_MAX : (sum_sq_q32 + term);
        }
    }

    uint64_t harmonic_rms = syn_isqrt64(sum_sq_q32);
    uint64_t pct_u64 = (harmonic_rms * (uint64_t)Q16_FROM_INT(100)) / (uint64_t)v1;
    *thd_pct = (pct_u64 > (uint64_t)INT32_MAX) ? INT32_MAX : (q16_t)pct_u64;

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_FFT */

docs.title: function syn_dsp_fft
docs.text:
Computes the in-place Radix-2 Decimation-in-Time FFT. 

SYN_Status syn_dsp_fft (
    q16_t * real,
    q16_t * imag,
    uint16_t n
)

n must be a power of 2 in [2, 256] (e.g., 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256).

Note:

Butterfly stages are unscaled (coherent gain = N; DC/bin magnitudes scale by n). Maintain input amplitude headroom |x[k]| < 32768 / n in Q16.16 (e.g., |x[k]| < 128.0 for n = 256) to avoid int32_t overflow.

Parameters:

  • real Array of real parts (size n).
  • imag Array of imaginary parts (size n).
  • n Size of the FFT (must be power of 2).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERROR on invalid parameters (e.g. not power of 2).

docs.title: function syn_dsp_fft_pt
docs.text:
Cooperative stage-sliced Radix-2 Decimation-in-Time FFT protothread. 

SYN_PT_Status syn_dsp_fft_pt (
    SYN_PT * pt,
    q16_t * real,
    q16_t * imag,
    uint16_t n,
    uint16_t * current_stage
)

Performs bit-reversal sorting on the initial slice and executes one butterfly stage (1 .. log2(n)) per resumption, yielding PT_MORE via PT_CONTINUE(pt) between stages. Composes with PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED(pt, task, child, syn_dsp_fft_pt(...)) so uncontended FFTs execute back-to-back in a single dispatch while contended runs yield between butterfly stages.

Parameters:

  • pt Child protothread control block.
  • real Array of real parts (size n).
  • imag Array of imaginary parts (size n).
  • n FFT size (power of 2 in [2, 256]).
  • current_stage Caller-owned stage cursor (persistent across yields).

Returns:

PT_MORE while stages remain, PT_ENDED on completion, or PT_EXITED on invalid params.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_filter.h"

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/*  Moving Average                                                         */
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

void syn_filter_ma_init(SYN_FilterMA *f, uint8_t window)
{
    if (f == NULL || window == 0 || window > SYN_FILTER_MAX_WINDOW) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL/window check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(window > 0 && window <= SYN_FILTER_MAX_WINDOW);

    memset(f, 0, sizeof(*f));
    f->window = window;
}

int16_t syn_filter_ma_update(SYN_FilterMA *f, int16_t sample)
{
    if (f == NULL || f->window == 0) {
        return sample; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL/window check after SYN_ASSERT
                        */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);

    if (f->count >= f->window) {
        /* Remove oldest sample from running sum */
        f->sum -= f->buf[f->idx];
    } else {
        f->count++;
    }

    /* Insert new sample */
    f->buf[f->idx] = sample;
    f->sum += sample;
    f->idx = (uint8_t)((f->idx + 1) % f->window);

    return (int16_t)(f->sum / f->count);
}

void syn_filter_ma_reset(SYN_FilterMA *f)
{
    if (f == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    uint8_t w = f->window;
    memset(f, 0, sizeof(*f));
    f->window = w;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/*  Exponential Moving Average                                             */
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

void syn_filter_ema_init(SYN_FilterEMA *f, uint8_t alpha)
{
    if (f == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);

    f->value = 0;
    f->alpha = alpha;
    f->primed = false;
}

int16_t syn_filter_ema_update(SYN_FilterEMA *f, int16_t sample)
{
    if (f == NULL) {
        return sample; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);

    if (!f->primed) {
        /* First sample — initialize directly */
        f->value = (int32_t)sample * 256;
        f->primed = true;
        return sample;
    }

    /* EMA: out = alpha * sample + (256 - alpha) * prev, all in Q8 */
    int32_t sample_q8 = (int32_t)sample * 256;
    int64_t diff = (int64_t)sample_q8 - (int64_t)f->value;
    f->value += (int32_t)(((int64_t)f->alpha * diff) >> 8);

    return (int16_t)(f->value >> 8);
}

void syn_filter_ema_reset(SYN_FilterEMA *f)
{
    if (f == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    uint8_t a = f->alpha;
    f->value = 0;
    f->primed = false;
    f->alpha = a;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/*  Median Filter                                                          */
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

void syn_filter_median_init(SYN_FilterMedian *f, uint8_t window)
{
    if (f == NULL || window == 0 || window > SYN_FILTER_MAX_WINDOW) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL/window check after SYN_ASSERT */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(window > 0 && window <= SYN_FILTER_MAX_WINDOW);

    memset(f, 0, sizeof(*f));
    f->window = window;
}

int16_t syn_filter_median_update(SYN_FilterMedian *f, int16_t sample)
{
    if (f == NULL || f->window == 0) {
        return sample; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Release-mode defensive NULL/window check after SYN_ASSERT
                        */
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);

    /* Insert into circular buffer */
    f->buf[f->idx] = sample;
    f->idx = (uint8_t)((f->idx + 1) % f->window);
    if (f->count < f->window) {
        f->count++;
    }

    /* Sort a copy to find median (insertion sort — fine for small windows) */
    int16_t sorted[SYN_FILTER_MAX_WINDOW];
    uint8_t n = f->count;
    memcpy(sorted, f->buf, (size_t)n * sizeof(int16_t));

    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int16_t key = sorted[i];
        uint8_t j = i;
        while (j > 0 && sorted[j - 1] > key) {
            sorted[j] = sorted[j - 1];
            j--;
        }
        sorted[j] = key;
    }

    return sorted[n / 2];
}

void syn_filter_median_reset(SYN_FilterMedian *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    uint8_t w = f->window;
    memset(f, 0, sizeof(*f));
    f->window = w;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/*  FIR Filter                                                             */
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

void syn_filter_fir_init(SYN_FilterFIR *f, const q16_t *taps, q16_t *history, uint16_t num_taps)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL && taps != NULL && history != NULL && num_taps > 0);

    f->taps = taps;
    f->history = history;
    f->num_taps = num_taps;
    f->head = 0;
    memset(history, 0, (size_t)num_taps * sizeof(q16_t));
}

q16_t syn_filter_fir_update(SYN_FilterFIR *f, q16_t sample)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL && f->taps != NULL && f->history != NULL);

    /* Insert new sample into circular history */
    f->history[f->head] = sample;

    int64_t acc = 0;
    uint16_t idx = f->head;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < f->num_taps; i++) {
        acc += (int64_t)f->taps[i] * f->history[idx];
        if (idx == 0) {
            idx = f->num_taps - 1;
        } else {
            idx--;
        }
    }

    if (f->num_taps > 0) {
        f->head = (uint16_t)((f->head + 1) % f->num_taps);
    }
    int64_t shifted = acc >> Q16_SHIFT;
    if (shifted > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    if (shifted < (int64_t)INT32_MIN) {
        return INT32_MIN;
    }
    return (q16_t)shifted;
}

void syn_filter_fir_reset(SYN_FilterFIR *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL && f->history != NULL);
    memset(f->history, 0, (size_t)f->num_taps * sizeof(q16_t));
    f->head = 0;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_FILTER */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
All filters operate on int16_t values and use no floating-point math. Window backing buffers are caller-provided (no malloc).

** **

  • Moving Average (MA): Smooth noise, configurable window
  • Exponential Moving Average (EMA): Low-pass, single coefficient
  • Median: Impulse noise rejection, small windows only

#include "syn_filter_design.h"

#include <string.h>

static inline q16_t filter_design_div_a0(int64_t num, int64_t a0)
{
    return (q16_t)((num * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / a0);
}

static SYN_Status compute_intermediate_vars(q16_t fc_hz, q16_t fs_hz, q16_t Q, q16_t *cos_w0,
                                            int64_t *alpha64, int64_t *a0)
{
    if (fc_hz <= 0 || fs_hz <= 0 || Q <= 0 || fc_hz >= (fs_hz >> 1)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t omega0 = (q16_t)(((int64_t)Q16_2_PI * (int64_t)fc_hz) / (int64_t)fs_hz);
    if (omega0 <= 0) {
        omega0 = 1;
    }
    q16_t sin_w0 = q16_sin(omega0);
    *cos_w0 = q16_cos(omega0);

    *alpha64 = ((int64_t)sin_w0 * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * (int64_t)Q);
    *a0 = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + *alpha64;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_filter_design_lowpass(q16_t fc_hz, q16_t fs_hz, q16_t Q, SYN_BiquadCoeffs *out)
{
    if (out == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t cos_w0;
    int64_t alpha64, a0;
    SYN_Status status = compute_intermediate_vars(fc_hz, fs_hz, Q, &cos_w0, &alpha64, &a0);
    if (status != SYN_OK)
        return status;

    int64_t num = (int64_t)Q16_ONE - (int64_t)cos_w0;
    out->b0 = filter_design_div_a0(num >> 1, a0);
    out->b1 = filter_design_div_a0(num, a0);
    out->b2 = out->b0;
    out->a1 = filter_design_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w0, a0);
    out->a2 = filter_design_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha64, a0);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_filter_design_highpass(q16_t fc_hz, q16_t fs_hz, q16_t Q, SYN_BiquadCoeffs *out)
{
    if (out == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t cos_w0;
    int64_t alpha64, a0;
    SYN_Status status = compute_intermediate_vars(fc_hz, fs_hz, Q, &cos_w0, &alpha64, &a0);
    if (status != SYN_OK)
        return status;

    int64_t num = (int64_t)Q16_ONE + (int64_t)cos_w0;
    out->b0 = filter_design_div_a0(num >> 1, a0);
    out->b1 = -filter_design_div_a0(num, a0);
    out->b2 = out->b0;
    out->a1 = filter_design_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w0, a0);
    out->a2 = filter_design_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha64, a0);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_filter_design_bandpass(q16_t fc_hz, q16_t fs_hz, q16_t Q, SYN_BiquadCoeffs *out)
{
    if (out == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t cos_w0;
    int64_t alpha64, a0;
    SYN_Status status = compute_intermediate_vars(fc_hz, fs_hz, Q, &cos_w0, &alpha64, &a0);
    if (status != SYN_OK)
        return status;

    out->b0 = filter_design_div_a0(alpha64, a0);
    out->b1 = 0;
    out->b2 = -out->b0;
    out->a1 = filter_design_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w0, a0);
    out->a2 = filter_design_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha64, a0);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_filter_design_notch(q16_t fc_hz, q16_t fs_hz, q16_t Q, SYN_BiquadCoeffs *out)
{
    if (out == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t cos_w0;
    int64_t alpha64, a0;
    SYN_Status status = compute_intermediate_vars(fc_hz, fs_hz, Q, &cos_w0, &alpha64, &a0);
    if (status != SYN_OK)
        return status;

    out->b0 = filter_design_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE, a0);
    out->b1 = filter_design_div_a0(-2LL * (int64_t)cos_w0, a0);
    out->b2 = out->b0;
    out->a1 = out->b1;
    out->a2 = filter_design_div_a0((int64_t)Q16_ONE - alpha64, a0);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_filter_design_apply_to_biquad(const SYN_BiquadCoeffs *coeffs,
                                             SYN_FilterBiquad *biquad)
{
    if (coeffs == NULL || biquad == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    biquad->b0 = coeffs->b0;
    biquad->b1 = coeffs->b1;
    biquad->b2 = coeffs->b2;
    biquad->a1 = coeffs->a1;
    biquad->a2 = coeffs->a2;
    biquad->x1 = 0;
    biquad->x2 = 0;
    biquad->y1 = 0;
    biquad->y2 = 0;

    return SYN_OK;
}

#include "syn_goertzel.h"

#include "../util/syn_qmath.h"

#include <string.h>

#define Q14_ONE 16384L 

SYN_Status syn_goertzel_init(SYN_Goertzel *g, uint32_t sample_rate_hz, uint32_t target_freq_hz,
                             size_t block_size)
{
    if ((g == NULL) || (sample_rate_hz == 0U) || (target_freq_hz == 0U) || (block_size == 0U) ||
        (target_freq_hz >= sample_rate_hz / 2U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(g, 0, sizeof(SYN_Goertzel));
    g->n_total = block_size;

    /* Calculate bin index k = round(N * f_target / f_s) */
    uint32_t k = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)block_size * target_freq_hz + (sample_rate_hz / 2U)) /
                            sample_rate_hz);

    /* Angle omega = 2 * pi * k / N in Q16 format (2 * pi = 411775 Q16) */
    q16_t omega = (q16_t)(((uint64_t)411775U * k) / block_size);

    /* Cosine in Q16 format */
    q16_t cos_val = q16_cos(omega);

    /* Goertzel coeff = 2 * cos(omega) in Q14 format (16384 = 1.0) */
    g->coeff_q15 = (int32_t)(cos_val >> 1);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_goertzel_reset(SYN_Goertzel *g)
{
    if (g == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    g->s1 = 0;
    g->s2 = 0;
    g->n_count = 0U;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_goertzel_process_sample(SYN_Goertzel *g, int16_t sample)
{
    if (g == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    int64_t fb = ((int64_t)g->coeff_q15 * (int64_t)g->s1) >> 14;
    int64_t s0 = (int64_t)sample + fb - (int64_t)g->s2;
    if (s0 > 2147483647LL) {
        s0 = 2147483647LL;
    } else if (s0 < -2147483647LL) {
        s0 = -2147483647LL;
    }
    g->s2 = g->s1;
    g->s1 = (int32_t)s0;
    g->n_count++;

    return SYN_OK;
}

size_t syn_goertzel_process_block(SYN_Goertzel *g, const int16_t *samples, size_t count)
{
    if ((g == NULL) || (samples == NULL) || (count == 0U)) {
        return 0U;
    }

    size_t processed = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        if (syn_goertzel_process_sample(g, samples[i]) == SYN_OK) {
            processed++;
        }
    }

    return processed;
}

uint64_t syn_goertzel_get_magnitude_sq(const SYN_Goertzel *g)
{
    if (g == NULL) {
        return 0ULL;
    }

    int64_t s1 = (g->s1 == INT32_MIN) ? -2147483647LL : (int64_t)g->s1;
    int64_t s2 = (g->s2 == INT32_MIN) ? -2147483647LL : (int64_t)g->s2;
    int64_t scaled_s1 = ((int64_t)g->coeff_q15 * s1) >> 14;
    int64_t prod = scaled_s1 * s2;
    uint64_t sq_sum = (uint64_t)(s1 * s1) + (uint64_t)(s2 * s2);

    if (prod < 0) {
        return sq_sum + (uint64_t)(-prod);
    }
    if ((uint64_t)prod >= sq_sum) {
        return 0ULL;
    }
    return sq_sum - (uint64_t)prod;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_KALMAN) || SYN_USE_KALMAN


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_kalman.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_kalman_init(SYN_Kalman *kf, const SYN_Kalman_Config *cfg)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(kf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(cfg != NULL);

    uint8_t ns = cfg->n_state;
    uint8_t nm = cfg->n_meas;

    if (ns == 0 || ns > SYN_KALMAN_MAX_STATE || nm == 0 || nm > SYN_KALMAN_MAX_MEAS) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (cfg->x == NULL || cfg->P == NULL || cfg->F == NULL || cfg->Q == NULL || cfg->H == NULL ||
        cfg->R == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Validate dimensions */
    if (cfg->x->rows != ns || cfg->x->cols != 1)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->P->rows != ns || cfg->P->cols != ns)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->F->rows != ns || cfg->F->cols != ns)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->Q->rows != ns || cfg->Q->cols != ns)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->H->rows != nm || cfg->H->cols != ns)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->R->rows != nm || cfg->R->cols != nm)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    kf->cfg = cfg;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool kalman_mat_matches(const SYN_Matrix *m, uint8_t rows, uint8_t cols)
{
    return (m != NULL) && (m->data != NULL) && (m->rows == rows) && (m->cols == cols);
}

static bool kalman_cfg_ready(const SYN_Kalman *kf)
{
    if ((kf == NULL) || (kf->cfg == NULL)) {
        return false;
    }
    const SYN_Kalman_Config *c = kf->cfg;
    if ((c->n_state == 0U) || (c->n_state > SYN_KALMAN_MAX_STATE) || (c->n_meas == 0U) ||
        (c->n_meas > SYN_KALMAN_MAX_MEAS)) {
        return false;
    }
    return kalman_mat_matches(c->x, c->n_state, 1U) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(c->P, c->n_state, c->n_state) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(c->F, c->n_state, c->n_state) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(c->Q, c->n_state, c->n_state);
}

static bool kalman_predict_valid(const SYN_Kalman *kf)
{
    if (!kalman_cfg_ready(kf)) {
        return false;
    }
    uint8_t ns = kf->cfg->n_state;
    return kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_n1, ns, 1U) && kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_nn_1, ns, ns) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_nn_2, ns, ns);
}

static bool kalman_update_valid(const SYN_Kalman *kf, const SYN_Matrix *z)
{
    if (!kalman_predict_valid(kf)) {
        return false;
    }
    const SYN_Kalman_Config *c = kf->cfg;
    uint8_t ns = c->n_state;
    uint8_t nm = c->n_meas;
    if (!kalman_mat_matches(z, nm, 1U) || !kalman_mat_matches(c->H, nm, ns) ||
        !kalman_mat_matches(c->R, nm, nm)) {
        return false;
    }
    return kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_nm, ns, nm) && kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_mn, nm, ns) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_mm, nm, nm) && kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_mm_2, nm, nm) &&
           kalman_mat_matches(kf->temp_m1, nm, 1U);
}

void syn_kalman_predict(SYN_Kalman *kf)
{
    if (!kalman_predict_valid(kf)) {
        return;
    }

    const SYN_Kalman_Config *c = kf->cfg;

    /* x̂⁻ = F · x̂ */
    syn_matrix_mul(c->F, c->x, kf->temp_n1);
    syn_matrix_copy(c->x, kf->temp_n1);

    /* P⁻ = F · P · Fᵀ + Q */
    syn_matrix_mul(c->F, c->P, kf->temp_nn_1);          /* F·P */
    syn_matrix_transpose(c->F, kf->temp_nn_2);          /* Fᵀ */
    syn_matrix_mul(kf->temp_nn_1, kf->temp_nn_2, c->P); /* F·P·Fᵀ → P */
    syn_matrix_add(c->P, c->Q, kf->temp_nn_1);          /* P + Q */
    syn_matrix_copy(c->P, kf->temp_nn_1);
}

SYN_Status syn_kalman_update(SYN_Kalman *kf, const SYN_Matrix *z)
{
    if (!kalman_update_valid(kf, z)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const SYN_Kalman_Config *c = kf->cfg;
    uint8_t ns = c->n_state;
    uint8_t nm = c->n_meas;

    /* ── Innovation: y = z − H·x̂⁻ ────────────────────────────────────── */
    syn_matrix_mul(c->H, c->x, kf->temp_m1);     /* H·x → temp_m1 */
    syn_matrix_sub(z, kf->temp_m1, kf->temp_m1); /* y = z - H·x   */

    /* ── Innovation covariance: S = H·P⁻·Hᵀ + R ──────────────────────── */
    syn_matrix_mul(c->H, c->P, kf->temp_mn);               /* H·P  (nm×ns)   */
    syn_matrix_transpose(c->H, kf->temp_nm);               /* Hᵀ   (ns×nm)   */
    syn_matrix_mul(kf->temp_mn, kf->temp_nm, kf->temp_mm); /* H·P·Hᵀ (nm×nm) */
    syn_matrix_add(kf->temp_mm, c->R, kf->temp_mm_2);      /* S = HPHᵀ + R    */

    /* ── S⁻¹ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    SYN_Status inv_st = syn_matrix_inv(kf->temp_mm_2, kf->temp_mm);
    if (inv_st != SYN_OK)
        return SYN_ERROR;
    /* temp_mm = S⁻¹ (nm × nm) */

    /* ── Kalman gain: K = P·Hᵀ·S⁻¹ ────────────────────────────────────
     *
     * temp_nm already holds Hᵀ (ns × nm).
     * We compute K in two steps to avoid aliasing:
     *   1. Hᵀ·S⁻¹ → (ns×nm)(nm×nm) = (ns×nm), store on stack as K
     *   2. K_final = P · K_partial → (ns×ns)(ns×nm) = (ns×nm)
     *
     * K is at most SYN_KALMAN_MAX_STATE × SYN_KALMAN_MAX_MEAS
     * elements. For a 6-state 4-measurement filter this is 24 × 4 = 96 bytes.
     */
    q16_t k_buf[SYN_KALMAN_MAX_STATE * SYN_KALMAN_MAX_MEAS];
    SYN_Matrix K = {k_buf, ns, nm};

    syn_matrix_mul(kf->temp_nm, kf->temp_mm, &K); /* Hᵀ·S⁻¹ */
    syn_matrix_mul(c->P, &K, kf->temp_nm);        /* P·Hᵀ·S⁻¹ */
    syn_matrix_copy(&K, kf->temp_nm);             /* K final  */

    /* ── State update: x̂ = x̂⁻ + K·y ──────────────────────────────────── */
    syn_matrix_mul(&K, kf->temp_m1, kf->temp_n1); /* K·y */
    syn_matrix_add(c->x, kf->temp_n1, c->x);      /* x += K·y */

    /* ── Covariance update: P = (I − K·H)·P⁻ ─────────────────────────── */
    syn_matrix_copy(kf->temp_nn_2, c->P);    /* Save P⁻ into temp_nn_2 */
    syn_matrix_mul(&K, c->H, kf->temp_nn_1); /* K·H (ns×ns) */

    /* Construct (I - K·H) in temp_nn_1 */
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        for (uint8_t j = 0; j < ns; j++) {
            q16_t eye = (i == j) ? Q16_ONE : 0;
            SYN_MAT_AT(kf->temp_nn_1, i, j) = eye - SYN_MAT_AT(kf->temp_nn_1, i, j);
        }
    }

    syn_matrix_mul(kf->temp_nn_1, kf->temp_nn_2, c->P); /* (I-K·H)·P⁻ → P */

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_KALMAN */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements a discrete-time linear Kalman filter using Q16.16 matrix operations. Supports arbitrary state and measurement dimensions (compile-time determined, no heap allocation).

** **

Predict: * x̂⁻ = F · x̂ * P⁻ = F · P · Fᵀ + Q

Update: * y = z − H · x̂⁻ (innovation) * S = H · P⁻ · Hᵀ + R (innovation covariance) * K = P⁻ · Hᵀ · S⁻¹ (Kalman gain) * x̂ = x̂⁻ + K · y (state update) * P = (I − K · H) · P⁻ (covariance update)

** **

// State: [position, velocity] → 2×1
// Measurement: [position]    → 1×1
#define N_STATE 2
#define N_MEAS  1

SYN_Kalman kf;
SYN_Kalman_Config cfg;

// Allocate all matrices on the stack
SYN_MAT_DECL(x,  N_STATE, 1);       // State vector
SYN_MAT_DECL(P,  N_STATE, N_STATE); // Error covariance
SYN_MAT_DECL(F,  N_STATE, N_STATE); // State transition
SYN_MAT_DECL(Q,  N_STATE, N_STATE); // Process noise
SYN_MAT_DECL(H,  N_MEAS,  N_STATE); // Measurement model
SYN_MAT_DECL(R,  N_MEAS,  N_MEAS);  // Measurement noise
SYN_MAT_DECL(z,  N_MEAS,  1);       // Measurement vector
SYN_KALMAN_SCRATCH_DECL(scratch, N_STATE, N_MEAS);

cfg.x = &x;  cfg.P = &P;  cfg.F = &F;
cfg.Q = &Q;  cfg.H = &H;  cfg.R = &R;
cfg.n_state = N_STATE;
cfg.n_meas  = N_MEAS;

// Set up F = [[1, dt], [0, 1]] for constant-velocity model
syn_matrix_identity(&F);
SYN_MAT_AT(&F, 0, 1) = Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 100); // dt = 10ms

// H = [[1, 0]] — we only measure position
syn_matrix_zero(&H);
SYN_MAT_AT(&H, 0, 0) = Q16_ONE;

syn_kalman_init(&kf, &cfg);
SYN_KALMAN_SCRATCH_ASSIGN(&kf, scratch);

// In control loop:
z.data[0] = sensor_reading;
syn_kalman_predict(&kf);
syn_kalman_update(&kf, &z);
q16_t filtered_pos = kf.cfg->x->data[0];

#include "syn_mfcc.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_mfcc_init(SYN_MFCC *mfcc, uint16_t sample_rate_hz, uint16_t fft_size)
{
    if (mfcc == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((fft_size != 64U) && (fft_size != 128U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (sample_rate_hz == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(mfcc, 0, sizeof(*mfcc));
    mfcc->sample_rate_hz = sample_rate_hz;
    mfcc->fft_size = fft_size;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static q16_t mfcc_log2_u64_q16(uint64_t x)
{
    uint32_t msb = 0U;
    uint64_t tmp = x;
    while (tmp > 1ULL) {
        tmp >>= 1U;
        msb++;
    }

    uint32_t m_q16 = (msb >= 16U) ? (uint32_t)(x >> (msb - 16U)) : (uint32_t)(x << (16U - msb));
    int64_t f = (int64_t)(m_q16 - 65536U);
    q16_t frac = (q16_t)((f * (93238LL - ((27702LL * f) >> 16))) >> 16);
    return Q16_FROM_INT((int32_t)msb) + frac;
}

static void mfcc_compute_mel_edges(uint16_t sample_rate_hz, uint16_t fft_size,
                                   q16_t edges[SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS + 2U])
{
    q16_t x_max = Q16_ONE + (q16_t)(((int64_t)sample_rate_hz << (Q16_SHIFT - 1)) / 700LL);
    q16_t ln_max = q16_log(x_max);

    for (uint16_t p = 0U; p < (SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS + 2U); p++) {
        q16_t ln_p =
            (q16_t)(((int64_t)ln_max * (int64_t)p) / (int64_t)(SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS + 1U));
        q16_t exp_m1 = q16_exp(ln_p) - Q16_ONE;
        edges[p] = (q16_t)(((int64_t)exp_m1 * 700LL * (int64_t)fft_size) / (int64_t)sample_rate_hz);
    }
}

static uint64_t mfcc_integrate_band(const SYN_MFCC *mfcc, uint16_t num_bins, q16_t left,
                                    q16_t center, q16_t right)
{
    uint16_t k_start = (uint16_t)Q16_TO_INT(left);
    uint16_t k_right = (uint16_t)Q16_TO_INT(right);
    uint16_t k_end = (k_right < num_bins) ? (uint16_t)(k_right + 1U) : num_bins;

    uint64_t sum_power = 0ULL;
    bool hit_bin = false;
    for (uint16_t k = k_start; k < k_end; k++) {
        q16_t k_q16 = Q16_FROM_INT((int32_t)k);
        q16_t weight = 0;
        if ((k_q16 > left) && (k_q16 <= center) && (center > left)) {
            weight = (q16_t)(((int64_t)(k_q16 - left) << Q16_SHIFT) / (int64_t)(center - left));
        } else if ((k_q16 > center) && (k_q16 < right) && (right > center)) {
            weight = (q16_t)(((int64_t)(right - k_q16) << Q16_SHIFT) / (int64_t)(right - center));
        }
        if (weight > 0) {
            int64_t re = mfcc->fft_real[k];
            int64_t im = mfcc->fft_imag[k];
            uint64_t power = (uint64_t)(((re * re) + (im * im)) >> Q16_SHIFT);
            sum_power += (power * (uint64_t)weight) >> Q16_SHIFT;
            hit_bin = true;
        }
    }

    if (!hit_bin) {
        uint16_t k_round = (uint16_t)Q16_TO_INT_ROUND(center);
        uint16_t k_near = (k_round < num_bins) ? k_round : (uint16_t)(num_bins - 1U);
        int64_t re = mfcc->fft_real[k_near];
        int64_t im = mfcc->fft_imag[k_near];
        sum_power = (uint64_t)(((re * re) + (im * im)) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    }

    return sum_power;
}

SYN_Status syn_mfcc_process_frame(SYN_MFCC *mfcc, const int16_t *pcm_in,
                                  q7_t mfcc_out[SYN_MFCC_NUM_COEFFS])
{
    if ((mfcc == NULL) || (pcm_in == NULL) || (mfcc_out == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t N = mfcc->fft_size;

    /* 1. Windowing and Q16 conversion */
    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < N; i++) {
        mfcc->fft_real[i] = (q16_t)((int32_t)pcm_in[i] * 2);
        mfcc->fft_imag[i] = 0;
    }

    /* 2. In-place FFT */
    if (syn_dsp_fft(mfcc->fft_real, mfcc->fft_imag, N) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Mel-warped power spectrum integration & log2 compression */
    uint16_t num_bins = N >> 1;
    q16_t mel_edges[SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS + 2U];
    q7_t mel_input_q7[SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS];
    mfcc_compute_mel_edges(mfcc->sample_rate_hz, N, mel_edges);

    for (uint16_t m = 0U; m < SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS; m++) {
        uint64_t sum_power =
            mfcc_integrate_band(mfcc, num_bins, mel_edges[m], mel_edges[m + 1U], mel_edges[m + 2U]);
        q16_t log2_energy = mfcc_log2_u64_q16(1ULL + sum_power);
        mfcc->mel_energies[m] = log2_energy;

        int32_t log_val = (int32_t)(((int64_t)log2_energy * 9LL) >> 17);
        mel_input_q7[m] = (log_val > 127) ? (q7_t)127 : (q7_t)log_val;
    }

    /* 4. Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT-II) to extract 13 MFCC coefficients */
    if (syn_dsp_dct2_q7(mel_input_q7, SYN_MFCC_NUM_MEL_FILTERS, mfcc->mfcc_coeffs,
                        SYN_MFCC_NUM_COEFFS) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive DCT check */
    }

    memcpy(mfcc_out, mfcc->mfcc_coeffs, SYN_MFCC_NUM_COEFFS * sizeof(q7_t));
    return SYN_OK;
}
