docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides the mathematical transforms needed for BLDC/PMSM motor control:

  • Clarke transform: 3-phase (a, b, c) → 2-phase stationary (α, β)
  • Inverse Clarke: (α, β) → (a, b, c)
  • Park transform: Stationary (α, β) → rotating (d, q) using rotor angle θ
  • Inverse Park: Rotating (d, q) → stationary (α, β)

All values are Q16.16 fixed-point. No floating point, no heap allocation.

** **

SYN_FOC_AB  ab;
SYN_FOC_DQ  dq;
SYN_FOC_ABC phase_currents = { ia, ib, ic };  // measured currents
q16_t theta = electrical_angle;                // rotor angle

// Forward: ABC → αβ → dq
syn_foc_clarke(&phase_currents, &ab);
syn_foc_park(&ab, theta, &dq);

// Now dq.d and dq.q are the field-aligned currents.
// Run PID on dq, then inverse transform for PWM:
syn_foc_inv_park(&dq_cmd, theta, &ab);
syn_foc_inv_clarke(&ab, &phase_voltages);

#ifndef SYN_FOC_H
#define SYN_FOC_H

#include "../common/syn_defs.h"
#include "../util/syn_qmath.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    q16_t a; 
    q16_t b; 
    q16_t c; 
} SYN_FOC_ABC;

typedef struct {
    q16_t alpha; 
    q16_t beta;  
} SYN_FOC_AB;

typedef struct {
    q16_t d; 
    q16_t q; 
} SYN_FOC_DQ;

/* ── Clarke transform ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_foc_clarke(const SYN_FOC_ABC *abc, SYN_FOC_AB *ab);

void syn_foc_inv_clarke(const SYN_FOC_AB *ab, SYN_FOC_ABC *abc);

#include "syn_foc_encoder.h"

#include <string.h>

static const q16_t g_hall_angle_lut[8] = {
    0,                                 /* 000 Invalid */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(4.7123890f), /* 001: 270 deg */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(2.6179939f), /* 010: 150 deg */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(3.6651914f), /* 011: 210 deg */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(0.5235988f), /* 100: 30 deg  */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(5.7595865f), /* 101: 330 deg */
    (q16_t)Q16_FROM_FLOAT(1.5707963f), /* 110: 90 deg  */
    0                                  /* 111 Invalid */
};

static q16_t foc_enc_wrap_2pi(int64_t angle)
{
    int64_t wrapped = angle % (int64_t)Q16_2_PI;
    if (wrapped < 0) {
        wrapped += (int64_t)Q16_2_PI;
    }
    return (q16_t)wrapped;
}

SYN_Status syn_foc_encoder_init(SYN_FOCEncoder *enc, const SYN_FOCEncoderConfig *cfg)
{
    if (!enc || !cfg || cfg->pole_pairs == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(enc, 0, sizeof(*enc));
    enc->config = *cfg;
    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_foc_encoder_update_quadrature(SYN_FOCEncoder *enc, int32_t raw_count)
{
    if (!enc || enc->config.cpr == 0)
        return;

    int64_t delta = (int64_t)raw_count - (int64_t)enc->prev_count;
    enc->count = raw_count;
    enc->prev_count = raw_count;

    uint64_t cpr = (uint64_t)enc->config.cpr;
    int64_t mod_count = (int64_t)raw_count % (int64_t)cpr;
    if (mod_count < 0) {
        mod_count += (int64_t)cpr;
    }

    int64_t elec_cnt =
        (mod_count * (int64_t)enc->config.pole_pairs * (int64_t)Q16_2_PI) / (int64_t)cpr;
    enc->elec_angle_rad = foc_enc_wrap_2pi(elec_cnt + (int64_t)enc->config.zero_offset_rad);

    /* Speed calculation: (delta_count / cpr) * P * 2*PI * sample_rate_hz */
    if (enc->config.sample_rate_hz > 0U) {
        int64_t base = delta * (int64_t)enc->config.pole_pairs * (int64_t)Q16_2_PI;
        uint64_t ubase = (uint64_t)((base < 0) ? -base : base);
        uint64_t sr = (uint64_t)enc->config.sample_rate_hz;
        int64_t spd64;
        if (ubase == 0ULL || sr <= ((uint64_t)INT64_MAX / ubase)) {
            spd64 = (base * (int64_t)sr) / (int64_t)cpr;
        } else {
            spd64 = (base < 0) ? (int64_t)INT32_MIN : (int64_t)INT32_MAX;
        }
        if (spd64 > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
            spd64 = (int64_t)INT32_MAX;
        } else if (spd64 < (int64_t)INT32_MIN) {
            spd64 = (int64_t)INT32_MIN;
        }
        enc->elec_speed_rad_s = (q16_t)spd64;
    }
}

void syn_foc_encoder_update_hall(SYN_FOCEncoder *enc, bool hall_u, bool hall_v, bool hall_w)
{
    if (!enc)
        return;
    uint8_t state = (uint8_t)((hall_u ? 4 : 0) | (hall_v ? 2 : 0) | (hall_w ? 1 : 0));
    enc->hall_state = state;
    if (state >= 1 && state <= 6) {
        enc->elec_angle_rad = foc_enc_wrap_2pi((int64_t)g_hall_angle_lut[state] +
                                               (int64_t)enc->config.zero_offset_rad);
    }
}

void syn_foc_encoder_update_absolute(SYN_FOCEncoder *enc, uint16_t raw_angle_14bit)
{
    if (!enc)
        return;
    uint16_t angle_14 = raw_angle_14bit & 0x3FFFU;
    int64_t elec_abs =
        ((int64_t)angle_14 * (int64_t)enc->config.pole_pairs * (int64_t)Q16_2_PI) / 16384LL;
    enc->elec_angle_rad = foc_enc_wrap_2pi(elec_abs + (int64_t)enc->config.zero_offset_rad);
}

q16_t syn_foc_encoder_get_elec_angle(const SYN_FOCEncoder *enc)
{
    return enc ? enc->elec_angle_rad : 0;
}

q16_t syn_foc_encoder_get_elec_speed(const SYN_FOCEncoder *enc)
{
    return enc ? enc->elec_speed_rad_s : 0;
}

#include "syn_foc_observer.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_foc_observer_init(SYN_FOCObserver *obs, const SYN_FOCObserverConfig *cfg)
{
    if (obs == NULL || cfg == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (cfg->R <= 0 || cfg->L <= 0 || cfg->G <= 0 || cfg->dt <= 0)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    memset(obs, 0, sizeof(*obs));
    obs->cfg = *cfg;

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_foc_observer_reset(SYN_FOCObserver *obs)
{
    if (obs == NULL)
        return;

    obs->I_alpha_est = 0;
    obs->I_beta_est = 0;
    obs->E_alpha_est = 0;
    obs->E_beta_est = 0;
    obs->theta_e = 0;
    obs->omega_e = 0;
    obs->pll_i_accum = 0;
}

SYN_Status syn_foc_observer_update(SYN_FOCObserver *obs, q16_t V_alpha, q16_t V_beta, q16_t I_alpha,
                                   q16_t I_beta)
{
    if (obs == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t R = obs->cfg.R;
    q16_t L = obs->cfg.L;
    q16_t G = obs->cfg.G;
    q16_t dt = obs->cfg.dt;

    /* Current estimation error: I_est - I_meas */
    q16_t err_ia = q16_sub_sat(obs->I_alpha_est, I_alpha);
    q16_t err_ib = q16_sub_sat(obs->I_beta_est, I_beta);

    /* Sliding mode switching control with linear boundary layer */
    q16_t neg_G = q16_sub_sat(0, G);
    q16_t Z_alpha = q16_clamp(q16_mul_sat(G, err_ia), neg_G, G);
    q16_t Z_beta = q16_clamp(q16_mul_sat(G, err_ib), neg_G, G);

    /* Current estimator integration: dI = (V - R*I_est - Z) * (dt / L) */
    q16_t dt_over_L = q16_div(dt, L);

    q16_t v_net_a = q16_sub_sat(q16_sub_sat(V_alpha, q16_mul_sat(R, obs->I_alpha_est)), Z_alpha);
    q16_t v_net_b = q16_sub_sat(q16_sub_sat(V_beta, q16_mul_sat(R, obs->I_beta_est)), Z_beta);
    obs->I_alpha_est = q16_add_sat(obs->I_alpha_est, q16_mul_sat(v_net_a, dt_over_L));
    obs->I_beta_est = q16_add_sat(obs->I_beta_est, q16_mul_sat(v_net_b, dt_over_L));

    /* Lowpass filter sliding control output Z to extract estimated back-EMF */
    q16_t alpha_lpf = Q16_FROM_FLOAT(0.15); /* LPF smoothing factor */
    obs->E_alpha_est = q16_add_sat(obs->E_alpha_est,
                                   q16_mul_sat(alpha_lpf, q16_sub_sat(Z_alpha, obs->E_alpha_est)));
    obs->E_beta_est =
        q16_add_sat(obs->E_beta_est, q16_mul_sat(alpha_lpf, q16_sub_sat(Z_beta, obs->E_beta_est)));

    /* Software PLL Phase Detector with overflow-safe 64-bit back-EMF magnitude */
    q16_t pll_err = 0;
    q16_t E_mag = q16_hypot(obs->E_alpha_est, obs->E_beta_est);

    if (E_mag > Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 100)) {
        q16_t E_alpha_n = q16_div(obs->E_alpha_est, E_mag);
        q16_t E_beta_n = q16_div(obs->E_beta_est, E_mag);

        /* If starting up from zero speed, seed angle and initial speed estimate */
        if (obs->omega_e == 0 && obs->pll_i_accum == 0) {
            obs->theta_e = q16_atan2(q16_sub_sat(0, E_alpha_n), E_beta_n);
            obs->pll_i_accum = Q16_FROM_INT(80);
        }

        q16_t cos_th = q16_cos(obs->theta_e);
        q16_t sin_th = q16_sin(obs->theta_e);

        pll_err = q16_sub_sat(q16_sub_sat(0, q16_mul_sat(E_alpha_n, cos_th)),
                              q16_mul_sat(E_beta_n, sin_th));
    } else {
        /* Back-EMF below observable floor: bleed PLL speed integrator to zero */
        obs->pll_i_accum -= obs->pll_i_accum / 32;
        if (q16_abs(obs->pll_i_accum) < Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 10)) {
            obs->pll_i_accum = 0;
        }
    }

    /* PI loop filter with anti-windup clamp (64-bit to prevent Q16 underflow/overflow) */
    int64_t Ki_err = ((int64_t)obs->cfg.Ki_pll * (int64_t)pll_err) >> Q16_SHIFT;
    int64_t delta_i64 = (Ki_err * (int64_t)dt) >> Q16_SHIFT;
    q16_t max_speed = Q16_FROM_INT(2000);
    int64_t accum64 = (int64_t)obs->pll_i_accum + delta_i64;
    obs->pll_i_accum = (accum64 > (int64_t)max_speed)
                           ? max_speed
                           : ((accum64 < -(int64_t)max_speed) ? -max_speed : (q16_t)accum64);

    obs->omega_e = q16_clamp(q16_add_sat(obs->pll_i_accum, q16_mul_sat(obs->cfg.Kp_pll, pll_err)),
                             -max_speed, max_speed);

    /* Position integrator: theta = theta + omega * dt, wrapped to [0, 2pi) in O(1) */
    int64_t theta64 =
        ((int64_t)obs->theta_e + (((int64_t)obs->omega_e * (int64_t)dt) >> Q16_SHIFT)) %
        (int64_t)Q16_2_PI;
    if (theta64 < 0) {
        theta64 += (int64_t)Q16_2_PI;
    }
    obs->theta_e = (q16_t)theta64;

    return SYN_OK;
}

q16_t syn_foc_observer_get_angle(const SYN_FOCObserver *obs)
{
    if (obs == NULL)
        return 0;
    return obs->theta_e;
}

q16_t syn_foc_observer_get_speed(const SYN_FOCObserver *obs)
{
    if (obs == NULL)
        return 0;
    return obs->omega_e;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_GCODE) || SYN_USE_GCODE

#include "syn_gcode.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#define SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_FEEDRATE 100.0f
#define SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_ACCEL 500.0f
#define SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_JERK 2000.0f
#define SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_STEP_RES 0.001f
#define SYN_GCODE_SEC_PER_MIN 60.0f
#define SYN_GCODE_MM_PER_INCH 25.4f
#define SYN_GCODE_MAX_FRAC_DIGITS 9U
#define SYN_GCODE_MAX_U32_FLOAT 4294967040.0f

/* ── Fast ASCII Number Scanners ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

static const char *skip_whitespace(const char *p)
{
    while (*p != '\0' && (isspace((unsigned char)*p) || *p == '\r' || *p == '\n')) {
        p++;
    }
    return p;
}

static const char *parse_frac_part(const char *p, bool *has_digits, float *out_frac)
{
    float frac_part = 0.0f;
    float div = 1.0f;
    uint8_t frac_digits = 0U;

    if (*p == '.') {
        p++;
        while ((*p >= '0') && (*p <= '9')) {
            if (frac_digits < SYN_GCODE_MAX_FRAC_DIGITS) {
                frac_part = (frac_part * 10.0f) + (float)(*p - '0');
                div *= 10.0f;
                frac_digits++;
            }
            *has_digits = true;
            p++;
        }
    }

    *out_frac = frac_part / div;
    return p;
}

static const char *parse_float_val(const char *p, float *out_val)
{
    p = skip_whitespace(p);
    float sign = 1.0f;
    if (*p == '-') {
        sign = -1.0f;
        p++;
    } else if (*p == '+') {
        p++;
    }

    float int_part = 0.0f;
    bool has_digits = false;
    while ((*p >= '0') && (*p <= '9')) {
        int_part = (int_part * 10.0f) + (float)(*p - '0');
        has_digits = true;
        p++;
    }

    float frac_val = 0.0f;
    p = parse_frac_part(p, &has_digits, &frac_val);

    float res = sign * (int_part + frac_val);
    if (!has_digits || !isfinite(res)) {
        return NULL;
    }

    *out_val = res;
    return p;
}

static const char *parse_uint_val(const char *p, uint32_t *out_val)
{
    p = skip_whitespace(p);
    uint32_t val = 0U;
    bool has_digits = false;
    while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {
        uint32_t digit = (uint32_t)(*p - '0');
        if (val > (UINT32_MAX - digit) / 10U) {
            return NULL;
        }
        val = (val * 10U) + digit;
        has_digits = true;
        p++;
    }
    if (!has_digits) {
        return NULL;
    }
    *out_val = val;
    return p;
}

static bool gcode_classify_g_word(SYN_GCode_Block *block, uint32_t g_code)
{
    if (g_code <= 3U) {
        block->has_motion = true;
        block->motion_mode = (SYN_GCode_MotionMode)g_code;
        return true;
    }
    if (g_code >= 17U && g_code <= 19U) {
        block->has_plane = true;
        block->plane = (SYN_GCode_Plane)(g_code - 17U);
        return true;
    }
    if (g_code == 20U || g_code == 21U) {
        block->has_units = true;
        block->units = (g_code == 20U) ? SYN_GCODE_UNITS_INCH : SYN_GCODE_UNITS_MM;
        return true;
    }
    if (g_code == 90U || g_code == 91U) {
        block->has_dist_mode = true;
        block->dist_mode = (g_code == 91U) ? SYN_GCODE_DIST_INCREMENTAL : SYN_GCODE_DIST_ABSOLUTE;
        return true;
    }
    if (g_code == 4U || g_code == 28U || g_code == 92U) {
        block->has_non_modal = true;
        block->non_modal = (SYN_GCode_NonModal)g_code;
        return true;
    }
    return (g_code == 94U);
}

static bool gcode_is_valid_m_code(uint32_t m_code)
{
    return (m_code <= 9U) || (m_code == 30U);
}

static const char *gcode_parse_coord_word(char letter, const char *p, SYN_GCode_Block *block,
                                          bool *out_match)
{
    float *val_ptr = NULL;
    bool *flag_ptr = NULL;
    *out_match = true;

    switch (letter) {
    case 'X':
        val_ptr = &block->x;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_x;
        break;
    case 'Y':
        val_ptr = &block->y;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_y;
        break;
    case 'Z':
        val_ptr = &block->z;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_z;
        break;
    case 'I':
        val_ptr = &block->i;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_i;
        break;
    case 'J':
        val_ptr = &block->j;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_j;
        break;
    case 'K':
        val_ptr = &block->k;
        flag_ptr = &block->has_k;
        break;
    default:
        *out_match = false;
        return p;
    }

    p = parse_float_val(p, val_ptr);
    if (p != NULL) {
        *flag_ptr = true;
    }
    return p;
}

static const char *gcode_parse_param_word(char letter, const char *p, SYN_GCode_Block *block,
                                          bool *out_match)
{
    *out_match = true;
    if (letter == 'F') {
        p = parse_float_val(p, &block->f);
        if (p == NULL || block->f <= 0.0f) {
            return NULL;
        }
        block->has_f = true;
        return p;
    }
    if (letter == 'S') {
        p = parse_float_val(p, &block->s);
        if (p == NULL || block->s < 0.0f) {
            return NULL;
        }
        block->has_s = true;
        return p;
    }
    if (letter == 'P') {
        p = parse_float_val(p, &block->p);
        if (p == NULL || block->p < 0.0f) {
            return NULL;
        }
        block->has_p = true;
        return p;
    }
    *out_match = false;
    return p;
}

static const char *gcode_parse_cmd_word(char letter, const char *p, SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    bool matched = false;
    p = gcode_parse_param_word(letter, p, block, &matched);
    if (matched) {
        return p;
    }

    uint32_t uval = 0U;
    if (letter == 'G') {
        p = parse_uint_val(p, &uval);
        if (p == NULL || !gcode_classify_g_word(block, uval)) {
            return NULL;
        }
        block->has_g = true;
        block->g_code = uval;
        return p;
    }
    if (letter == 'M') {
        p = parse_uint_val(p, &uval);
        if (p == NULL || !gcode_is_valid_m_code(uval)) {
            return NULL;
        }
        block->has_m = true;
        block->m_code = uval;
        return p;
    }
    if (letter == 'T') {
        p = parse_uint_val(p, &uval);
        if (p != NULL) {
            block->has_t = true;
            block->t = uval;
        }
        return p;
    }
    if (letter == 'N') {
        return parse_uint_val(p, &uval);
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ── Public API Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_gcode_init(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Config *cfg)
{
    if (ctrl == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(ctrl, 0, sizeof(*ctrl));
    if (cfg != NULL) {
        ctrl->cfg = *cfg;
    }

    if (!isfinite(ctrl->cfg.default_feedrate) || (ctrl->cfg.default_feedrate <= 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->cfg.default_feedrate = SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_FEEDRATE / SYN_GCODE_SEC_PER_MIN;
    }
    if (!isfinite(ctrl->cfg.max_acceleration) || (ctrl->cfg.max_acceleration <= 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->cfg.max_acceleration = SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_ACCEL;
    }
    if (!isfinite(ctrl->cfg.max_jerk) || (ctrl->cfg.max_jerk <= 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->cfg.max_jerk = SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_JERK;
    }
    if (!isfinite(ctrl->cfg.step_resolution) || (ctrl->cfg.step_resolution <= 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->cfg.step_resolution = SYN_GCODE_DEFAULT_STEP_RES;
    }

    ctrl->feedrate = ctrl->cfg.default_feedrate;
    ctrl->motion_mode = SYN_GCODE_MOTION_RAPID;
    ctrl->dist_mode = SYN_GCODE_DIST_ABSOLUTE;
    ctrl->plane = SYN_GCODE_PLANE_XY;
    ctrl->units = SYN_GCODE_UNITS_MM;
    ctrl->spindle = SYN_GCODE_SPINDLE_OFF;
    ctrl->coolant = SYN_GCODE_COOLANT_OFF;

    if (ctrl->cfg.interpolator != NULL) {
        syn_interpolator_init(ctrl->cfg.interpolator);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_gcode_parse_line(const char *line, SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    if (line == NULL || block == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(block, 0, sizeof(*block));

    const char *p = line;
    while (*p != '\0') {
        p = skip_whitespace(p);
        if (*p == '\0' || *p == ';') {
            break; /* End of line or comment */
        }

        if (*p == '(') {
            /* Skip parenthesized comment */
            while (*p != '\0' && *p != ')') {
                p++;
            }
            if (*p == ')') {
                p++;
            }
            continue;
        }

        char letter = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
        p++;

        bool matched = false;
        p = gcode_parse_coord_word(letter, p, block, &matched);
        if (!matched) {
            p = gcode_parse_cmd_word(letter, p, block);
        }
        if (p == NULL) {
            return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void gcode_apply_m_code(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, uint32_t m_code)
{
    if (m_code >= 3U && m_code <= 5U) {
        SYN_GCode_SpindleMode mode = SYN_GCODE_SPINDLE_OFF;
        float rpm = 0.0f;
        if (m_code == 3U) {
            mode = SYN_GCODE_SPINDLE_CW;
            rpm = ctrl->spindle_speed;
        } else if (m_code == 4U) {
            mode = SYN_GCODE_SPINDLE_CCW;
            rpm = ctrl->spindle_speed;
        }
        ctrl->spindle = mode;
        if (ctrl->cfg.on_spindle != NULL) {
            ctrl->cfg.on_spindle(mode, rpm, ctrl->cfg.user_data);
        }
    } else if (m_code >= 7U && m_code <= 9U) {
        SYN_GCode_CoolantMode mode = SYN_GCODE_COOLANT_OFF;
        if (m_code == 7U) {
            mode = SYN_GCODE_COOLANT_MIST;
        } else if (m_code == 8U) {
            mode = SYN_GCODE_COOLANT_FLOOD;
        }
        ctrl->coolant = mode;
        if (ctrl->cfg.on_coolant != NULL) {
            ctrl->cfg.on_coolant(mode, ctrl->cfg.user_data);
        }
    }
}

static SYN_Status gcode_plan_or_jump_linear(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, SYN_Vector3F target)
{
    ctrl->dwell_steps = 0U;
    ctrl->dwell_ms = 0U;
    if (ctrl->cfg.interpolator != NULL) {
        SYN_Status st = syn_interpolator_plan_linear(
            ctrl->cfg.interpolator, ctrl->current_pos, target, ctrl->feedrate,
            ctrl->cfg.max_acceleration, ctrl->cfg.max_jerk, ctrl->cfg.step_resolution);
        ctrl->move_in_progress =
            (st == SYN_OK) && (ctrl->cfg.interpolator->mode != SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE);
        return st;
    }
    ctrl->current_pos = target;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status gcode_execute_home(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    SYN_Vector3F home = ctrl->current_pos;
    bool any_axis = block->has_x || block->has_y || block->has_z;
    if (!any_axis || block->has_x) {
        home.x = 0.0f;
    }
    if (!any_axis || block->has_y) {
        home.y = 0.0f;
    }
    if (!any_axis || block->has_z) {
        home.z = 0.0f;
    }
    return gcode_plan_or_jump_linear(ctrl, home);
}

static uint32_t gcode_round_pos_u32(float val)
{
    if (!isfinite(val) || (val >= SYN_GCODE_MAX_U32_FLOAT)) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    uint32_t rounded = (uint32_t)(val + 0.5f);
    return (rounded > 0U) ? rounded : 1U;
}

static void gcode_execute_dwell(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    float dwell_s = block->has_p ? block->p : 0.0f;
    if (!isfinite(dwell_s) || (dwell_s < 0.0f)) {
        dwell_s = 0.0f;
    }
    if (ctrl->cfg.on_dwell != NULL) {
        ctrl->cfg.on_dwell(dwell_s, ctrl->cfg.user_data);
    }
    if ((dwell_s > 0.0f) && isfinite(ctrl->cfg.step_resolution) &&
        (ctrl->cfg.step_resolution > 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->dwell_steps = gcode_round_pos_u32(dwell_s / ctrl->cfg.step_resolution);
        ctrl->dwell_ms = gcode_round_pos_u32(dwell_s * 1000.0f);
    } else {
        ctrl->dwell_steps = 0U;
        ctrl->dwell_ms = 0U;
    }
}

static bool gcode_execute_non_modal(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block,
                                    float scale, SYN_Status *out_status)
{
    *out_status = SYN_OK;
    if (!block->has_non_modal || block->non_modal == SYN_GCODE_NONMODAL_NONE) {
        return false;
    }
    if (block->non_modal == SYN_GCODE_NONMODAL_OFFSET) {
        float ox = block->has_x ? (ctrl->current_pos.x - (block->x * scale)) : ctrl->offset_pos.x;
        float oy = block->has_y ? (ctrl->current_pos.y - (block->y * scale)) : ctrl->offset_pos.y;
        float oz = block->has_z ? (ctrl->current_pos.z - (block->z * scale)) : ctrl->offset_pos.z;
        if (isfinite(ox) && isfinite(oy) && isfinite(oz)) {
            ctrl->offset_pos.x = ox;
            ctrl->offset_pos.y = oy;
            ctrl->offset_pos.z = oz;
        }
    } else if (block->non_modal == SYN_GCODE_NONMODAL_HOME) {
        *out_status = gcode_execute_home(ctrl, block);
    } else if (block->non_modal == SYN_GCODE_NONMODAL_DWELL) {
        gcode_execute_dwell(ctrl, block);
    }
    return true;
}

static SYN_Vector3F gcode_compute_target(const SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl,
                                         const SYN_GCode_Block *block, float scale)
{
    SYN_Vector3F target = ctrl->current_pos;
    if (ctrl->dist_mode == SYN_GCODE_DIST_ABSOLUTE) {
        if (block->has_x) {
            target.x = (block->x * scale) + ctrl->offset_pos.x;
        }
        if (block->has_y) {
            target.y = (block->y * scale) + ctrl->offset_pos.y;
        }
        if (block->has_z) {
            target.z = (block->z * scale) + ctrl->offset_pos.z;
        }
    } else {
        if (block->has_x) {
            target.x += block->x * scale;
        }
        if (block->has_y) {
            target.y += block->y * scale;
        }
        if (block->has_z) {
            target.z += block->z * scale;
        }
    }
    return target;
}

static bool gcode_has_motion_coords(const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    return block->has_x || block->has_y || block->has_z || block->has_i || block->has_j ||
           block->has_k;
}

static SYN_Status gcode_execute_motion(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block,
                                       float scale)
{
    if (!gcode_has_motion_coords(block)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    ctrl->dwell_steps = 0U;
    ctrl->dwell_ms = 0U;
    SYN_Vector3F target = gcode_compute_target(ctrl, block, scale);
    if (!isfinite(target.x) || !isfinite(target.y) || !isfinite(target.z)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (ctrl->cfg.interpolator == NULL) {
        ctrl->current_pos = target;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    SYN_Status st = SYN_OK;
    if (ctrl->motion_mode == SYN_GCODE_MOTION_RAPID ||
        ctrl->motion_mode == SYN_GCODE_MOTION_LINEAR) {
        st = gcode_plan_or_jump_linear(ctrl, target);
    } else if (ctrl->motion_mode == SYN_GCODE_MOTION_ARC_CW ||
               ctrl->motion_mode == SYN_GCODE_MOTION_ARC_CCW) {
        SYN_Vector3F center = {
            .x = block->has_i ? (block->i * scale) : 0.0f,
            .y = block->has_j ? (block->j * scale) : 0.0f,
            .z = block->has_k ? (block->k * scale) : 0.0f,
        };
        bool is_cw = (ctrl->motion_mode == SYN_GCODE_MOTION_ARC_CW);
        st = syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane(ctrl->cfg.interpolator, ctrl->current_pos, target,
                                                  center, (uint8_t)ctrl->plane, is_cw,
                                                  ctrl->feedrate, ctrl->cfg.max_acceleration,
                                                  ctrl->cfg.max_jerk, ctrl->cfg.step_resolution);
        ctrl->move_in_progress =
            (st == SYN_OK) && (ctrl->cfg.interpolator->mode != SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE);
    }
    return st;
}

static void gcode_apply_modal_groups(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    if (block->has_units) {
        ctrl->units = block->units;
    }
    if (block->has_plane) {
        ctrl->plane = block->plane;
    }
    if (block->has_dist_mode) {
        ctrl->dist_mode = block->dist_mode;
    }
    if (block->has_motion) {
        ctrl->motion_mode = block->motion_mode;
    }
}

static bool gcode_has_classified_group(const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    return block->has_motion || block->has_plane || block->has_dist_mode || block->has_units ||
           block->has_non_modal;
}

static void gcode_apply_aux_words(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block,
                                  float scale)
{
    if (block->has_f && isfinite(block->f) && (block->f > 0.0f)) {
        /* Convert G94 units/min feedrate to mm/sec */
        float feed_mm_s = (block->f * scale) / SYN_GCODE_SEC_PER_MIN;
        if (isfinite(feed_mm_s)) {
            ctrl->feedrate = feed_mm_s;
        }
    }
    if (block->has_s && isfinite(block->s) && (block->s >= 0.0f)) {
        ctrl->spindle_speed = block->s;
    }
    if (block->has_t) {
        ctrl->active_tool = block->t;
        if (ctrl->cfg.on_tool != NULL) {
            ctrl->cfg.on_tool(block->t, ctrl->cfg.user_data);
        }
    }
    if (block->has_m) {
        gcode_apply_m_code(ctrl, block->m_code);
    }
}

static bool gcode_block_coords_finite(const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    if ((block->has_x && !isfinite(block->x)) || (block->has_y && !isfinite(block->y)) ||
        (block->has_z && !isfinite(block->z))) {
        return false;
    }
    return (!block->has_i || isfinite(block->i)) && (!block->has_j || isfinite(block->j)) &&
           (!block->has_k || isfinite(block->k));
}

static bool gcode_modal_enums_valid(const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    if (block->has_motion && ((uint32_t)block->motion_mode > (uint32_t)SYN_GCODE_MOTION_ARC_CCW)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (block->has_plane && ((uint32_t)block->plane > (uint32_t)SYN_GCODE_PLANE_YZ)) {
        return false;
    }
    return (!block->has_dist_mode ||
            ((uint32_t)block->dist_mode <= (uint32_t)SYN_GCODE_DIST_INCREMENTAL)) &&
           (!block->has_units || ((uint32_t)block->units <= (uint32_t)SYN_GCODE_UNITS_INCH));
}

SYN_Status syn_gcode_execute_block(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const SYN_GCode_Block *block)
{
    if (ctrl == NULL || block == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_GCode_Block eff = *block;
    if (!gcode_block_coords_finite(&eff) || !gcode_modal_enums_valid(&eff)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (eff.has_g && !gcode_has_classified_group(&eff)) {
        if (!gcode_classify_g_word(&eff, eff.g_code)) {
            return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
        }
    }
    if (eff.has_m && !gcode_is_valid_m_code(eff.m_code)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* 1. Apply RS-274 modal groups (units/plane/distance/motion) before scaling F or axes */
    gcode_apply_modal_groups(ctrl, &eff);
    float scale = (ctrl->units == SYN_GCODE_UNITS_INCH) ? SYN_GCODE_MM_PER_INCH : 1.0f;

    /* 2. Process Feedrate, Spindle Speed, Tool & M-Codes */
    gcode_apply_aux_words(ctrl, &eff, scale);

    /* 3. Execute Group 0 non-modal commands (G4, G28, G92) or Group 1 motion */
    SYN_Status exec_st = SYN_OK;
    if (!gcode_execute_non_modal(ctrl, &eff, scale, &exec_st)) {
        exec_st = gcode_execute_motion(ctrl, &eff, scale);
    }

    return exec_st;
}

SYN_Status syn_gcode_execute_line(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, const char *line)
{
    if (ctrl == NULL || line == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    SYN_GCode_Block block;
    SYN_Status st = syn_gcode_parse_line(line, &block);
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }
    return syn_gcode_execute_block(ctrl, &block);
}

bool syn_gcode_step(SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl, SYN_Vector3F *out_pos)
{
    if (ctrl == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    if (ctrl->dwell_steps > 0U) {
        ctrl->dwell_steps--;
        if (ctrl->dwell_steps == 0U) {
            ctrl->dwell_ms = 0U;
        }
        if (out_pos != NULL) {
            *out_pos = ctrl->current_pos;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (ctrl->move_in_progress) {
        if (ctrl->cfg.interpolator == NULL) {
            ctrl->move_in_progress = false;
        } else {
            bool active = syn_interpolator_step(ctrl->cfg.interpolator, &ctrl->current_pos);
            if (out_pos != NULL) {
                *out_pos = ctrl->current_pos;
            }
            if (!active) {
                ctrl->move_in_progress = false;
            }
            return active;
        }
    }

    if (out_pos != NULL) {
        *out_pos = ctrl->current_pos;
    }
    return false;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_gcode_task_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_GCode_Controller *ctrl = (SYN_GCode_Controller *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        if (ctrl->dwell_ms > 0U) {
            uint32_t wait_ms = ctrl->dwell_ms;
            ctrl->dwell_ms = 0U;
            ctrl->dwell_steps = 0U;
            PT_DELAY_MS(pt, &task->delay_until, wait_ms);
        }
        SYN_Vector3F pos;
        if (syn_gcode_step(ctrl, &pos)) {
            PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        } else {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt); /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Infinite task loop end */
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_GCODE */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Provides a zero-heap streaming ASCII G-code parser and motion controller: * Word extraction (G, M, X, Y, Z, I, J, K, F, S, P, T). * Modal state tracking (G0..G4, G17..G19, G20/G21, G90/G91, G92, M3..M5, M7..M9). * Trajectory pipeline integration with SYN_Interpolator for coordinated multi-axis moves. * Non-blocking motion step execution and cooperative protothread runner.

docs.title: function syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane
docs.text:
Plan a Circular or Helical arc move in a selectable right-handed plane. 

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane (
    SYN_Interpolator * interp,
    SYN_Vector3F start,
    SYN_Vector3F target,
    SYN_Vector3F center_offset,
    uint8_t plane,
    bool is_cw,
    float feedrate,
    float max_accel,
    float max_jerk,
    float step_res
)

Plane axis mapping follows NIST RS-274 right-handed cyclic permutations: * 0 (G17 XY): primary (X, Y) with offsets (I, J), linear axis Z. * 1 (G18 ZX): primary ( Z , X) with offsets (K, I), linear axis Y. * 2 (G19 YZ): primary (Y, Z ) with offsets (J, K), linear axis X.

Parameters:

  • interp Pointer to interpolator struct.
  • start Start position (X, Y, Z).
  • target Target position (X, Y, Z).
  • center_offset Center offset relative to start (I, J, K).
  • plane Working plane selector (0 = XY, 1 = ZX, 2 = YZ).
  • is_cw true for Clockwise, false for Counter-Clockwise in the selected plane.
  • feedrate Desired tangential speed (units/sec).
  • max_accel Max acceleration (units/sec^2).
  • max_jerk Max jerk (units/sec^3).
  • step_res Spatial resolution per step (units per step).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM on invalid arguments.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_INTERPOLATOR) || SYN_USE_INTERPOLATOR


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_interpolator.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static SYN_Vector3F interp_eval_bezier_pos(SYN_Vector3F p0, SYN_Vector3F p1, SYN_Vector3F p2,
                                           SYN_Vector3F p3, float u)
{
    float u_inv = 1.0f - u;
    float b0 = u_inv * u_inv * u_inv;
    float b1 = 3.0f * u_inv * u_inv * u;
    float b2 = 3.0f * u_inv * u * u;
    float b3 = u * u * u;

    SYN_Vector3F pt = {
        .x = (b0 * p0.x) + (b1 * p1.x) + (b2 * p2.x) + (b3 * p3.x),
        .y = (b0 * p0.y) + (b1 * p1.y) + (b2 * p2.y) + (b3 * p3.y),
        .z = (b0 * p0.z) + (b1 * p1.z) + (b2 * p2.z) + (b3 * p3.z),
    };
    return pt;
}

static SYN_Vector3F interp_eval_bezier_deriv(SYN_Vector3F p0, SYN_Vector3F p1, SYN_Vector3F p2,
                                             SYN_Vector3F p3, float u)
{
    float u_inv = 1.0f - u;
    float c0 = 3.0f * u_inv * u_inv;
    float c1 = 6.0f * u_inv * u;
    float c2 = 3.0f * u * u;

    SYN_Vector3F d = {
        .x = (c0 * (p1.x - p0.x)) + (c1 * (p2.x - p1.x)) + (c2 * (p3.x - p2.x)),
        .y = (c0 * (p1.y - p0.y)) + (c1 * (p2.y - p1.y)) + (c2 * (p3.y - p2.y)),
        .z = (c0 * (p1.z - p0.z)) + (c1 * (p2.z - p1.z)) + (c2 * (p3.z - p2.z)),
    };
    return d;
}

#define SYN_INTERP_MAX_I32_FLOAT 2147483520.0f

static bool interp_vec_is_finite(SYN_Vector3F v)
{
    return isfinite(v.x) && isfinite(v.y) && isfinite(v.z);
}

static bool interp_scalars_valid(float feedrate, float max_accel, float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    return isfinite(feedrate) && (feedrate > 0.0f) && isfinite(max_accel) && (max_accel >= 0.0f) &&
           isfinite(max_jerk) && (max_jerk >= 0.0f) && isfinite(step_res) && (step_res > 0.0f);
}

static int32_t interp_clamp_rate_i32(float val)
{
    if (!isfinite(val) || (val >= SYN_INTERP_MAX_I32_FLOAT)) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    if (val <= 0.0f) {
        return 0;
    }
    return (int32_t)val;
}

static SYN_Status interp_configure_steps(SYN_Interpolator *interp, float total_len, float feedrate,
                                         float max_accel, float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    float raw_steps = total_len / step_res;
    if (!isfinite(total_len) || !isfinite(raw_steps) || (raw_steps > SYN_INTERP_MAX_I32_FLOAT)) {
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    interp->total_length = total_len;
    interp->total_steps = (uint32_t)raw_steps;
    if (interp->total_steps == 0U) {
        interp->total_steps = 1U;
    }
    interp->target_feedrate = feedrate;
    interp->step_res = step_res;

    syn_scurve_init(&interp->scurve, 0);
    syn_scurve_set_constraints(&interp->scurve, interp_clamp_rate_i32(feedrate / step_res),
                               interp_clamp_rate_i32(max_accel / step_res),
                               interp_clamp_rate_i32(max_jerk / step_res));
    syn_scurve_set_target(&interp->scurve, (int32_t)interp->total_steps);
    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_interpolator_init(SYN_Interpolator *interp)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(interp != NULL);
    memset(interp, 0, sizeof(SYN_Interpolator));
    interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
}

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_linear(SYN_Interpolator *interp, SYN_Vector3F start,
                                        SYN_Vector3F target, float feedrate, float max_accel,
                                        float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(interp != NULL);
    if (!interp_vec_is_finite(start) || !interp_vec_is_finite(target) ||
        !interp_scalars_valid(feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(interp, 0, sizeof(SYN_Interpolator));
    interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_LINEAR;
    interp->start_pos = start;
    interp->target_pos = target;
    interp->current_pos = start;

    float dx = target.x - start.x;
    float dy = target.y - start.y;
    float dz = target.z - start.z;

    float total_len = sqrtf((dx * dx) + (dy * dy) + (dz * dz));
    if (total_len < 1e-6f) {
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return interp_configure_steps(interp, total_len, feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res);
}

static void interp_vec_to_plane(SYN_Vector3F vec, uint8_t plane, float *out_u, float *out_v,
                                float *out_w)
{
    if (plane == 1U) {
        *out_u = vec.z;
        *out_v = vec.x;
        *out_w = vec.y;
    } else if (plane == 2U) {
        *out_u = vec.y;
        *out_v = vec.z;
        *out_w = vec.x;
    } else {
        *out_u = vec.x;
        *out_v = vec.y;
        *out_w = vec.z;
    }
}

static SYN_Vector3F interp_plane_to_vec(float u, float v, float w, uint8_t plane)
{
    SYN_Vector3F out;
    if (plane == 1U) {
        out.z = u;
        out.x = v;
        out.y = w;
    } else if (plane == 2U) {
        out.y = u;
        out.z = v;
        out.x = w;
    } else {
        out.x = u;
        out.y = v;
        out.z = w;
    }
    return out;
}

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane(SYN_Interpolator *interp, SYN_Vector3F start,
                                                SYN_Vector3F target, SYN_Vector3F center_offset,
                                                uint8_t plane, bool is_cw, float feedrate,
                                                float max_accel, float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(interp != NULL);
    if ((plane > 2U) || !interp_vec_is_finite(start) || !interp_vec_is_finite(target) ||
        !interp_vec_is_finite(center_offset) ||
        !interp_scalars_valid(feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    float su = 0.0f, sv = 0.0f, sw = 0.0f;
    float tu = 0.0f, tv = 0.0f, tw = 0.0f;
    float ou = 0.0f, ov = 0.0f, ow = 0.0f;
    interp_vec_to_plane(start, plane, &su, &sv, &sw);
    interp_vec_to_plane(target, plane, &tu, &tv, &tw);
    interp_vec_to_plane(center_offset, plane, &ou, &ov, &ow);
    (void)sw;
    (void)tw;
    (void)ow;

    /* Center (u, v) relative to start; normalize -0.0f to +0.0f for consistent atan2f branch cut */
    float cu = su + ou;
    float cv = sv + ov;
    float ru = 0.0f - ou;
    float rv = 0.0f - ov;
    float radius = sqrtf((ru * ru) + (rv * rv));
    if (!isfinite(radius) || (radius < 1e-6f)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(interp, 0, sizeof(SYN_Interpolator));
    interp->mode = is_cw ? SYN_INTERP_MODE_CIRCULAR_CW : SYN_INTERP_MODE_CIRCULAR_CCW;
    interp->arc_plane = plane;
    interp->start_pos = start;
    interp->target_pos = target;
    interp->center_offset = center_offset;
    interp->current_pos = start;
    interp->radius = radius;

    interp->start_angle = atan2f(rv, ru);
    float end_angle = atan2f((tv - cv) + 0.0f, (tu - cu) + 0.0f);

    float sweep = end_angle - interp->start_angle;

    if (is_cw) {
        if (sweep >= 0.0f) {
            sweep -= (float)(2.0 * M_PI);
        }
    } else {
        if (sweep <= 0.0f) {
            sweep += (float)(2.0 * M_PI);
        }
    }

    interp->sweep_angle = sweep;
    float total_len = fabsf(sweep) * interp->radius;

    return interp_configure_steps(interp, total_len, feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res);
}

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_circular(SYN_Interpolator *interp, SYN_Vector3F start,
                                          SYN_Vector3F target, SYN_Vector3F center_offset,
                                          bool is_cw, float feedrate, float max_accel,
                                          float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    return syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane(interp, start, target, center_offset, 0U, is_cw,
                                                feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res);
}

bool syn_interpolator_step(SYN_Interpolator *interp, SYN_Vector3F *out_pos)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(interp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(out_pos != NULL);

    if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE) {
        *out_pos = interp->current_pos;
        return false;
    }

    if (interp->step_index >= interp->total_steps) {
        interp->current_pos = interp->target_pos;
        *out_pos = interp->current_pos;
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
        return false;
    }

    interp->step_index++;
    float ratio = (float)interp->step_index / (float)interp->total_steps;
    float s = ratio * interp->total_length;
    interp->current_dist = s;

    if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_LINEAR) {
        interp->current_pos.x =
            interp->start_pos.x + (ratio * (interp->target_pos.x - interp->start_pos.x));
        interp->current_pos.y =
            interp->start_pos.y + (ratio * (interp->target_pos.y - interp->start_pos.y));
        interp->current_pos.z =
            interp->start_pos.z + (ratio * (interp->target_pos.z - interp->start_pos.z));
    } else if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_BEZIER) {
        interp->current_pos = interp_eval_bezier_pos(interp->start_pos, interp->bezier_p1,
                                                     interp->bezier_p2, interp->target_pos, ratio);
    } else {
        float su = 0.0f, sv = 0.0f, sw = 0.0f;
        float tu = 0.0f, tv = 0.0f, tw = 0.0f;
        float ou = 0.0f, ov = 0.0f, ow = 0.0f;
        interp_vec_to_plane(interp->start_pos, interp->arc_plane, &su, &sv, &sw);
        interp_vec_to_plane(interp->target_pos, interp->arc_plane, &tu, &tv, &tw);
        interp_vec_to_plane(interp->center_offset, interp->arc_plane, &ou, &ov, &ow);
        (void)tu;
        (void)tv;
        (void)ow;

        float angle = interp->start_angle + ratio * interp->sweep_angle;
        float pu = (su + ou) + interp->radius * cosf(angle);
        float pv = (sv + ov) + interp->radius * sinf(angle);
        float pw = sw + ratio * (tw - sw);
        interp->current_pos = interp_plane_to_vec(pu, pv, pw, interp->arc_plane);
    }

    *out_pos = interp->current_pos;

    if (interp->step_index >= interp->total_steps) {
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
    }

    return true;
}

static void interp_eval_linear_at(const SYN_Interpolator *interp, float ratio, float speed,
                                  SYN_Vector3F *out_pos, SYN_Vector3F *out_vel)
{
    float dx = interp->target_pos.x - interp->start_pos.x;
    float dy = interp->target_pos.y - interp->start_pos.y;
    float dz = interp->target_pos.z - interp->start_pos.z;
    out_pos->x = interp->start_pos.x + (ratio * dx);
    out_pos->y = interp->start_pos.y + (ratio * dy);
    out_pos->z = interp->start_pos.z + (ratio * dz);

    if (out_vel != NULL) {
        float scale = (interp->total_length > 1e-6f) ? (speed / interp->total_length) : 0.0f;
        out_vel->x = dx * scale;
        out_vel->y = dy * scale;
        out_vel->z = dz * scale;
    }
}

static void interp_eval_bezier_at(const SYN_Interpolator *interp, float ratio, float speed,
                                  SYN_Vector3F *out_pos, SYN_Vector3F *out_vel)
{
    *out_pos = interp_eval_bezier_pos(interp->start_pos, interp->bezier_p1, interp->bezier_p2,
                                      interp->target_pos, ratio);

    if (out_vel != NULL) {
        SYN_Vector3F tang = interp_eval_bezier_deriv(interp->start_pos, interp->bezier_p1,
                                                     interp->bezier_p2, interp->target_pos, ratio);
        float tang_norm = sqrtf((tang.x * tang.x) + (tang.y * tang.y) + (tang.z * tang.z));
        if (tang_norm > 1e-6f) {
            float scale = speed / tang_norm;
            out_vel->x = tang.x * scale;
            out_vel->y = tang.y * scale;
            out_vel->z = tang.z * scale;
        } else {
            memset(out_vel, 0, sizeof(SYN_Vector3F));
        }
    }
}

static void interp_eval_circular_at(const SYN_Interpolator *interp, float ratio, float speed,
                                    SYN_Vector3F *out_pos, SYN_Vector3F *out_vel)
{
    float su = 0.0f, sv = 0.0f, sw = 0.0f;
    float tu = 0.0f, tv = 0.0f, tw = 0.0f;
    float ou = 0.0f, ov = 0.0f, ow = 0.0f;
    interp_vec_to_plane(interp->start_pos, interp->arc_plane, &su, &sv, &sw);
    interp_vec_to_plane(interp->target_pos, interp->arc_plane, &tu, &tv, &tw);
    interp_vec_to_plane(interp->center_offset, interp->arc_plane, &ou, &ov, &ow);
    (void)tu;
    (void)tv;
    (void)ow;

    float angle = interp->start_angle + ratio * interp->sweep_angle;
    float pu = (su + ou) + interp->radius * cosf(angle);
    float pv = (sv + ov) + interp->radius * sinf(angle);
    float pw = sw + ratio * (tw - sw);
    *out_pos = interp_plane_to_vec(pu, pv, pw, interp->arc_plane);

    if (out_vel != NULL) {
        float tangent_angle =
            angle + (interp->sweep_angle >= 0.0f ? (float)(M_PI / 2.0) : -(float)(M_PI / 2.0));
        float vu = speed * cosf(tangent_angle);
        float vv = speed * sinf(tangent_angle);
        float vw =
            (interp->total_length > 1e-6f) ? ((tw - sw) * (speed / interp->total_length)) : 0.0f;
        *out_vel = interp_plane_to_vec(vu, vv, vw, interp->arc_plane);
    }
}

bool syn_interpolator_eval_at_time(SYN_Interpolator *interp, float t_sec, SYN_Vector3F *out_pos,
                                   SYN_Vector3F *out_vel)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(interp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(out_pos != NULL);

    if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE) {
        *out_pos = interp->current_pos;
        if (out_vel) {
            memset(out_vel, 0, sizeof(SYN_Vector3F));
        }
        return false;
    }

    /* Advance S-curve generator update and convert step/sec rate back to units/sec */
    int32_t scurve_pos = syn_scurve_update(&interp->scurve);
    int32_t scurve_vel = syn_scurve_velocity(&interp->scurve);
    float speed = (float)scurve_vel * interp->step_res;

    float ratio =
        (interp->total_steps > 0U) ? ((float)scurve_pos / (float)interp->total_steps) : 1.0f;
    if (ratio > 1.0f) {
        ratio = 1.0f;
    }
    if (ratio < 0.0f) {
        ratio = 0.0f; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
    }

    if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_LINEAR) {
        interp_eval_linear_at(interp, ratio, speed, out_pos, out_vel);
    } else if (interp->mode == SYN_INTERP_MODE_BEZIER) {
        interp_eval_bezier_at(interp, ratio, speed, out_pos, out_vel);
    } else {
        interp_eval_circular_at(interp, ratio, speed, out_pos, out_vel);
    }

    interp->current_pos = *out_pos;
    if (syn_scurve_done(&interp->scurve)) {
        interp->current_pos = interp->target_pos;
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
        (void)t_sec;
        return false;
    }

    (void)t_sec;
    return true;
}

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_bezier(SYN_Interpolator *interp, SYN_Vector3F p0, SYN_Vector3F p1,
                                        SYN_Vector3F p2, SYN_Vector3F p3, float feedrate,
                                        float max_accel, float max_jerk, float step_res)
{
    if ((interp == NULL) || !interp_vec_is_finite(p0) || !interp_vec_is_finite(p1) ||
        !interp_vec_is_finite(p2) || !interp_vec_is_finite(p3) ||
        !interp_scalars_valid(feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res) || (max_accel <= 0.0f) ||
        (max_jerk <= 0.0f)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Approximate cubic Bezier arc length across 32 chord subdivisions */
    float approx_len = 0.0f;
    SYN_Vector3F prev = p0;

    for (uint32_t i = 1U; i <= 32U; i++) {
        float u = (float)i * (1.0f / 32.0f);
        SYN_Vector3F pt = interp_eval_bezier_pos(p0, p1, p2, p3, u);
        float dx = pt.x - prev.x;
        float dy = pt.y - prev.y;
        float dz = pt.z - prev.z;
        approx_len += sqrtf((dx * dx) + (dy * dy) + (dz * dz));
        prev = pt;
    }

    memset(interp, 0, sizeof(SYN_Interpolator));
    interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_BEZIER;
    interp->start_pos = p0;
    interp->bezier_p1 = p1;
    interp->bezier_p2 = p2;
    interp->target_pos = p3;
    interp->current_pos = p0;
    interp->total_length = approx_len;

    if (approx_len < 1e-6f) {
        interp->mode = SYN_INTERP_MODE_IDLE;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return interp_configure_steps(interp, approx_len, feedrate, max_accel, max_jerk, step_res);
}

docs.text: Provides zero-allocation, fixed-step multi-axis DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) vector trajectory generation for coordinated motion control across 2D/3D linear segments and 2D circular arcs.

docs.title: function syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane
docs.text:
Plan a Circular or Helical arc move in a selectable right-handed plane. 

SYN_Status syn_interpolator_plan_circular_plane (
    SYN_Interpolator * interp,
    SYN_Vector3F start,
    SYN_Vector3F target,
    SYN_Vector3F center_offset,
    uint8_t plane,
    bool is_cw,
    float feedrate,
    float max_accel,
    float max_jerk,
    float step_res
)

Plane axis mapping follows NIST RS-274 right-handed cyclic permutations: * 0 (G17 XY): primary (X, Y) with offsets (I, J), linear axis Z. * 1 (G18 ZX): primary ( Z , X) with offsets (K, I), linear axis Y. * 2 (G19 YZ): primary (Y, Z ) with offsets (J, K), linear axis X.

Parameters:

  • interp Pointer to interpolator struct.
  • start Start position (X, Y, Z).
  • target Target position (X, Y, Z).
  • center_offset Center offset relative to start (I, J, K).
  • plane Working plane selector (0 = XY, 1 = ZX, 2 = YZ).
  • is_cw true for Clockwise, false for Counter-Clockwise in the selected plane.
  • feedrate Desired tangential speed (units/sec).
  • max_accel Max acceleration (units/sec^2).
  • max_jerk Max jerk (units/sec^3).
  • step_res Spatial resolution per step (units per step).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM on invalid arguments.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_KINEMATICS) || SYN_USE_KINEMATICS

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "syn_kinematics.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Internal Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define Q16_SQRT3_2 56756            
#define Q16_COS120 ((q16_t) - 32768) 
#define Q16_SIN120 56756             
#define Q16_COS240 ((q16_t) - 32768) 
#define Q16_SIN240 ((q16_t) - 56756) 

/* ── Matrix Helper Functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void rpy_to_rot_matrix(q16_t roll, q16_t pitch, q16_t yaw, q16_t r33[9])
{
    q16_t cr = q16_cos(roll);
    q16_t sr = q16_sin(roll);
    q16_t cp = q16_cos(pitch);
    q16_t sp = q16_sin(pitch);
    q16_t cy = q16_cos(yaw);
    q16_t sy = q16_sin(yaw);

    /* R = Rz(yaw) * Ry(pitch) * Rx(roll) */
    r33[0] = q16_mul(cy, cp);
    r33[1] = q16_mul(cy, q16_mul(sp, sr)) - q16_mul(sy, cr);
    r33[2] = q16_mul(cy, q16_mul(sp, cr)) + q16_mul(sy, sr);

    r33[3] = q16_mul(sy, cp);
    r33[4] = q16_mul(sy, q16_mul(sp, sr)) + q16_mul(cy, cr);
    r33[5] = q16_mul(sy, q16_mul(sp, cr)) - q16_mul(cy, sr);

    r33[6] = -sp;
    r33[7] = q16_mul(cp, sr);
    r33[8] = q16_mul(cp, cr);
}

static void rot_matrix_to_rpy(const q16_t r33[9], SYN_Orientation3D *out_ori)
{
    q16_t r20 = r33[6];

    if (q16_abs(r20) < Q16_ONE - Q16_FROM_FRAC(1, 1000)) {
        out_ori->pitch = q16_asin(-r20);
        out_ori->roll = q16_atan2(r33[7], r33[8]);
        out_ori->yaw = q16_atan2(r33[3], r33[0]);
    } else {
        /* Gimbal lock at pitch = +-90 deg */
        out_ori->roll = 0;
        out_ori->pitch = (r20 < 0) ? Q16_PI_2 : -Q16_PI_2;
        out_ori->yaw = q16_atan2(-r33[1], r33[4]);
    }
}

/* ── Denavit-Hartenberg Implementation ──────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_dh_matrix(const SYN_DH_Param *param, q16_t joint_val, SYN_DH_Convention conv,
                         SYN_Matrix *out_t44)
{
    if (param == NULL || out_t44 == NULL || out_t44->data == NULL || out_t44->rows != 4U ||
        out_t44->cols != 4U ||
        (conv != SYN_DH_CONVENTION_STANDARD && conv != SYN_DH_CONVENTION_MODIFIED)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t theta = param->is_prismatic ? param->theta : (param->theta + joint_val);
    q16_t d = param->is_prismatic ? (param->d + joint_val) : param->d;
    q16_t ct = q16_cos(theta);
    q16_t st = q16_sin(theta);
    q16_t ca = q16_cos(param->alpha);
    q16_t sa = q16_sin(param->alpha);

    (void)memset(out_t44->data, 0, 16U * sizeof(q16_t));

    if (conv == SYN_DH_CONVENTION_STANDARD) {
        /* Standard DH: Rz(theta) * Tz(d) * Tx(a) * Rx(alpha) */
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 0) = ct;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 1) = -q16_mul(st, ca);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 2) = q16_mul(st, sa);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 3) = q16_mul(param->a, ct);

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 0) = st;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 1) = q16_mul(ct, ca);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 2) = -q16_mul(ct, sa);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 3) = q16_mul(param->a, st);

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 0) = 0;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 1) = sa;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 2) = ca;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 3) = d;

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 3, 3) = Q16_ONE;
    } else {
        /* Modified DH (Craig): Rx(alpha_{i-1}) * Tx(a_{i-1}) * Rz(theta_i) * Tz(d_i) */
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 0) = ct;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 1) = -st;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 2) = 0;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 0, 3) = param->a;

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 0) = q16_mul(st, ca);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 1) = q16_mul(ct, ca);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 2) = -sa;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 1, 3) = -q16_mul(d, sa);

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 0) = q16_mul(st, sa);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 1) = q16_mul(ct, sa);
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 2) = ca;
        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 2, 3) = q16_mul(d, ca);

        SYN_MAT_AT(out_t44, 3, 3) = Q16_ONE;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool kin_out_mat44_valid(const SYN_Matrix *mat)
{
    return (mat == NULL) || ((mat->data != NULL) && (mat->rows == 4U) && (mat->cols == 4U));
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_forward(const SYN_DH_Param *chain, size_t num_joints,
                                  const q16_t *joint_vals, SYN_DH_Convention conv,
                                  SYN_Matrix *out_t44, SYN_Pose6D *out_pose)
{
    if (chain == NULL || joint_vals == NULL || num_joints == 0U ||
        num_joints > SYN_KINEMATICS_MAX_JOINTS || !kin_out_mat44_valid(out_t44)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_MAT_DECL(T_acc, 4, 4);
    SYN_MAT_DECL(T_link, 4, 4);
    SYN_MAT_DECL(T_next, 4, 4);

    syn_matrix_identity(&T_acc);

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < num_joints; i++) {
        if (syn_dh_matrix(&chain[i], joint_vals[i], conv, &T_link) != SYN_OK) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        syn_matrix_mul(&T_acc, &T_link, &T_next);
        (void)memcpy(T_acc.data, T_next.data, 16U * sizeof(q16_t));
    }

    if (out_t44 != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(out_t44->data, T_acc.data, 16U * sizeof(q16_t));
    }

    if (out_pose != NULL) {
        out_pose->position.x = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 0, 3);
        out_pose->position.y = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 1, 3);
        out_pose->position.z = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 2, 3);

        q16_t r33[9];
        r33[0] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 0, 0);
        r33[1] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 0, 1);
        r33[2] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 0, 2);
        r33[3] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 1, 0);
        r33[4] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 1, 1);
        r33[5] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 1, 2);
        r33[6] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 2, 0);
        r33[7] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 2, 1);
        r33[8] = SYN_MAT_AT(&T_acc, 2, 2);
        rot_matrix_to_rpy(r33, &out_pose->orientation);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_jacobian(const SYN_DH_Param *chain, size_t num_joints,
                                   const q16_t *joint_vals, SYN_DH_Convention conv,
                                   SYN_Matrix *out_j6xn)
{
    if (chain == NULL || joint_vals == NULL || out_j6xn == NULL || out_j6xn->data == NULL ||
        num_joints == 0U || num_joints > SYN_KINEMATICS_MAX_JOINTS || out_j6xn->rows != 6U ||
        out_j6xn->cols != (uint8_t)num_joints) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Compute cumulative transforms T_0^i for each link */
    q16_t t_chain[SYN_KINEMATICS_MAX_JOINTS + 1U][16];
    SYN_Matrix mats[SYN_KINEMATICS_MAX_JOINTS + 1U];

    for (size_t i = 0U; i <= num_joints; i++) {
        mats[i].data = t_chain[i];
        mats[i].rows = 4U;
        mats[i].cols = 4U;
    }
    syn_matrix_identity(&mats[0]);

    SYN_MAT_DECL(T_link, 4, 4);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < num_joints; i++) {
        if (syn_dh_matrix(&chain[i], joint_vals[i], conv, &T_link) != SYN_OK) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        syn_matrix_mul(&mats[i], &T_link, &mats[i + 1U]);
    }

    /* End-effector position p_e */
    q16_t pe_x = SYN_MAT_AT(&mats[num_joints], 0, 3);
    q16_t pe_y = SYN_MAT_AT(&mats[num_joints], 1, 3);
    q16_t pe_z = SYN_MAT_AT(&mats[num_joints], 2, 3);

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < num_joints; i++) {
        /* Standard DH actuates around frame i-1 (mats[i]); Modified DH applies Rx*Tx first so
         * joint i's axis and axis point reside in mats[i + 1] (Rz*Tz preserves the Z axis and
         * shifts the origin purely along Z, leaving z x (pe - pi) invariant). */
        const SYN_Matrix *joint_tf =
            (conv == SYN_DH_CONVENTION_MODIFIED) ? &mats[i + 1U] : &mats[i];
        q16_t pi_x = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 0, 3);
        q16_t pi_y = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 1, 3);
        q16_t pi_z = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 2, 3);

        q16_t zi_x = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 0, 2);
        q16_t zi_y = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 1, 2);
        q16_t zi_z = SYN_MAT_AT(joint_tf, 2, 2);

        if (chain[i].is_prismatic) {
            /* Prismatic joint: Jv = z_{i-1}, Jw = 0 */
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 0, i) = zi_x;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 1, i) = zi_y;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 2, i) = zi_z;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 3, i) = 0;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 4, i) = 0;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 5, i) = 0;
        } else {
            /* Revolute joint: Jv = z_{i-1} x (pe - pi), Jw = z_{i-1} */
            q16_t r_x = pe_x - pi_x;
            q16_t r_y = pe_y - pi_y;
            q16_t r_z = pe_z - pi_z;

            /* Cross product z x r */
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 0, i) = q16_mul(zi_y, r_z) - q16_mul(zi_z, r_y);
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 1, i) = q16_mul(zi_z, r_x) - q16_mul(zi_x, r_z);
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 2, i) = q16_mul(zi_x, r_y) - q16_mul(zi_y, r_x);

            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 3, i) = zi_x;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 4, i) = zi_y;
            SYN_MAT_AT(out_j6xn, 5, i) = zi_z;
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── 64-Bit Fixed-Point Geometry Helpers ────────────────────────────────── */

static q16_t hypot2d_q16(q16_t x, q16_t y)
{
    uint64_t sum = (uint64_t)((int64_t)x * (int64_t)x) + (uint64_t)((int64_t)y * (int64_t)y);
    uint64_t root = syn_isqrt64(sum);
    if (root > (uint64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    return (q16_t)root;
}

static SYN_Status solve_2link_planar(q16_t rx, q16_t ry, q16_t l1, q16_t l2, SYN_ArmElbow elbow,
                                     q16_t *out_q1, q16_t *out_q2)
{
    uint64_t r2_u64 = (uint64_t)((int64_t)rx * (int64_t)rx) + (uint64_t)((int64_t)ry * (int64_t)ry);
    int64_t r2 = (int64_t)(r2_u64 >> 16U);
    int64_t l1_sq = ((int64_t)l1 * (int64_t)l1) >> 16;
    int64_t l2_sq = ((int64_t)l2 * (int64_t)l2) >> 16;
    int64_t num = r2 - l1_sq - l2_sq;
    int64_t den = (2LL * (int64_t)l1 * (int64_t)l2) >> 16;

    if (den <= 0 || num > den || num < -den) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int64_t scale_num = num;
    int64_t scale_den = den;
    while (scale_den > (1LL << 45)) {
        scale_num >>= 2;
        scale_den >>= 2;
    }

    q16_t cos_q2 = (q16_t)((scale_num * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / scale_den);
    int64_t sin_sq = (int64_t)Q16_ONE - (((int64_t)cos_q2 * (int64_t)cos_q2) >> 16);
    q16_t sin_q2 = (q16_t)syn_isqrt64((uint64_t)sin_sq << 16U);
    if (elbow == SYN_ARM_ELBOW_DOWN) {
        sin_q2 = -sin_q2;
    }

    *out_q2 = q16_atan2(sin_q2, cos_q2);
    int64_t k1 = (int64_t)l1 + (((int64_t)l2 * (int64_t)cos_q2) >> 16);
    int64_t k2 = ((int64_t)l2 * (int64_t)sin_q2) >> 16;
    while ((k1 > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) || (k1 < -(int64_t)INT32_MAX)) {
        k1 >>= 1;
        k2 >>= 1;
    }
    *out_q1 = q16_sub_sat(q16_atan2(ry, rx), q16_atan2((q16_t)k2, (q16_t)k1));
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── 3-DOF Planar Arm ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_planar3_fk(const SYN_Kinematics_Planar3Config *cfg, q16_t q1, q16_t q2,
                                     q16_t q3, q16_t *out_x, q16_t *out_y, q16_t *out_phi)
{
    if (cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t q12 = q16_add_sat(q1, q2);
    q16_t q123 = q16_add_sat(q12, q3);

    q16_t x =
        q16_add_sat(q16_add_sat(q16_mul(cfg->l1, q16_cos(q1)), q16_mul(cfg->l2, q16_cos(q12))),
                    q16_mul(cfg->l3, q16_cos(q123)));
    q16_t y =
        q16_add_sat(q16_add_sat(q16_mul(cfg->l1, q16_sin(q1)), q16_mul(cfg->l2, q16_sin(q12))),
                    q16_mul(cfg->l3, q16_sin(q123)));

    if (out_x != NULL) {
        *out_x = x;
    }
    if (out_y != NULL) {
        *out_y = y;
    }
    if (out_phi != NULL) {
        *out_phi = q123;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_planar3_ik(const SYN_Kinematics_Planar3Config *cfg, q16_t x, q16_t y,
                                     q16_t phi, SYN_ArmElbow elbow, q16_t *out_q1, q16_t *out_q2,
                                     q16_t *out_q3)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || cfg->l1 <= 0 || cfg->l2 <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t xw = q16_sub_sat(x, q16_mul(cfg->l3, q16_cos(phi)));
    q16_t yw = q16_sub_sat(y, q16_mul(cfg->l3, q16_sin(phi)));

    q16_t q1 = 0;
    q16_t q2 = 0;
    if (solve_2link_planar(xw, yw, cfg->l1, cfg->l2, elbow, &q1, &q2) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    q16_t q3 = q16_sub_sat(q16_sub_sat(phi, q1), q2);

    if (out_q1 != NULL) {
        *out_q1 = q1;
    }
    if (out_q2 != NULL) {
        *out_q2 = q2;
    }
    if (out_q3 != NULL) {
        *out_q3 = q3;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── 4-DOF SCARA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_scara_fk(const SYN_Kinematics_SCARAConfig *cfg, q16_t q1, q16_t q2,
                                   q16_t d3, q16_t q4, SYN_Pose6D *out_pose)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || out_pose == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t q12 = q16_add_sat(q1, q2);
    out_pose->position.x =
        q16_add_sat(q16_mul(cfg->l1, q16_cos(q1)), q16_mul(cfg->l2, q16_cos(q12)));
    out_pose->position.y =
        q16_add_sat(q16_mul(cfg->l1, q16_sin(q1)), q16_mul(cfg->l2, q16_sin(q12)));
    out_pose->position.z = q16_sub_sat(cfg->z_home, d3);

    out_pose->orientation.roll = 0;
    out_pose->orientation.pitch = 0;
    out_pose->orientation.yaw = q16_add_sat(q12, q4);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_scara_ik(const SYN_Kinematics_SCARAConfig *cfg, const SYN_Pose6D *target,
                                   SYN_ArmElbow elbow, q16_t *out_q1, q16_t *out_q2, q16_t *out_d3,
                                   q16_t *out_q4)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || target == NULL || cfg->l1 <= 0 || cfg->l2 <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    int64_t d3_64 = (int64_t)cfg->z_home - (int64_t)target->position.z;
    if ((d3_64 < (int64_t)INT32_MIN) || (d3_64 > (int64_t)INT32_MAX)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    q16_t d3 = (q16_t)d3_64;
    if (cfg->d_max > 0 && (d3 < 0 || d3 > cfg->d_max)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    q16_t q1 = 0;
    q16_t q2 = 0;
    if (solve_2link_planar(target->position.x, target->position.y, cfg->l1, cfg->l2, elbow, &q1,
                           &q2) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    q16_t q4 = q16_sub_sat(q16_sub_sat(target->orientation.yaw, q1), q2);

    if (out_q1 != NULL) {
        *out_q1 = q1;
    }
    if (out_q2 != NULL) {
        *out_q2 = q2;
    }
    if (out_d3 != NULL) {
        *out_d3 = d3;
    }
    if (out_q4 != NULL) {
        *out_q4 = q4;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── 6-DOF Articulated Arm (Spherical Wrist) ─────────────────────────────── */

static void solve_spherical_wrist(const q16_t r03[9], const q16_t r06[9], bool wrist_flip,
                                  q16_t out_q[6])
{
    q16_t r36[9];
    for (uint8_t r = 0U; r < 3U; r++) {
        for (uint8_t c = 0U; c < 3U; c++) {
            r36[r * 3U + c] = q16_mul(r03[0U * 3U + r], r06[0U * 3U + c]) +
                              q16_mul(r03[1U * 3U + r], r06[1U * 3U + c]) +
                              q16_mul(r03[2U * 3U + r], r06[2U * 3U + c]);
        }
    }

    q16_t r36_22 = r36[8];
    q16_t sin_q5 = hypot2d_q16(r36[2], r36[5]);
    if (wrist_flip) {
        sin_q5 = -sin_q5;
    }
    q16_t q5 = q16_atan2(sin_q5, r36_22);

    q16_t q4 = 0;
    q16_t q6 = 0;
    if (q16_abs(sin_q5) > Q16_FROM_FRAC(5, 1000)) {
        if (!wrist_flip) {
            q4 = q16_atan2(r36[5], r36[2]);
            q6 = q16_atan2(r36[7], -r36[6]);
        } else {
            q4 = q16_atan2(-r36[5], -r36[2]);
            q6 = q16_atan2(-r36[7], r36[6]);
        }
    } else if (r36_22 >= 0) {
        q4 = 0;
        q6 = q16_atan2(-r36[1], r36[0]);
    } else {
        q4 = 0;
        q6 = q16_atan2(r36[1], -r36[0]);
    }

    out_q[3] = q4;
    out_q[4] = q5;
    out_q[5] = q6;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_6dof_fk(const SYN_Kinematics_6DOFConfig *cfg, const q16_t q[6],
                                  SYN_Pose6D *out_pose)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || q == NULL || out_pose == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_DH_Param dh[6] = {
        {.a = cfg->a1, .alpha = Q16_PI_2, .d = cfg->d1, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false},
        {.a = cfg->a2, .alpha = 0, .d = 0, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false},
        {.a = 0, .alpha = Q16_PI_2, .d = 0, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false},
        {.a = 0, .alpha = -Q16_PI_2, .d = cfg->d4, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false},
        {.a = 0, .alpha = Q16_PI_2, .d = 0, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false},
        {.a = 0, .alpha = 0, .d = cfg->d6, .theta = 0, .is_prismatic = false}};

    return syn_kinematics_forward(dh, 6U, q, SYN_DH_CONVENTION_STANDARD, NULL, out_pose);
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_6dof_ik(const SYN_Kinematics_6DOFConfig *cfg, const SYN_Pose6D *target,
                                  SYN_ArmElbow elbow, bool wrist_flip, q16_t out_q[6])
{
    if (cfg == NULL || target == NULL || out_q == NULL || cfg->a2 <= 0 || cfg->d4 <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t r06[9];
    rpy_to_rot_matrix(target->orientation.roll, target->orientation.pitch, target->orientation.yaw,
                      r06);

    /* Wrist center: Pw = P_06 - d6 * z6 */
    q16_t pw_x = target->position.x - q16_mul(cfg->d6, r06[2]);
    q16_t pw_y = target->position.y - q16_mul(cfg->d6, r06[5]);
    q16_t pw_z = target->position.z - q16_mul(cfg->d6, r06[8]);

    q16_t q1 = q16_atan2(pw_y, pw_x);
    q16_t r_xy = hypot2d_q16(pw_x, pw_y) - cfg->a1;
    q16_t s_z = pw_z - cfg->d1;

    /* Forearm d4 lies along z3 (rotated -90 deg from x2 when q3 = 0): phi3 = q3 - pi/2 */
    q16_t q2 = 0;
    q16_t phi3 = 0;
    if (solve_2link_planar(r_xy, s_z, cfg->a2, cfg->d4, elbow, &q2, &phi3) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    q16_t q3 = phi3 + Q16_PI_2;
    if (q3 > Q16_PI) {
        q3 -= Q16_2_PI;
    }

    /* R_03 for Standard DH alpha = [+pi/2, 0, +pi/2] */
    q16_t q23 = q2 + q3;
    q16_t c1 = q16_cos(q1);
    q16_t s1 = q16_sin(q1);
    q16_t c23 = q16_cos(q23);
    q16_t s23 = q16_sin(q23);

    q16_t r03[9];
    r03[0] = q16_mul(c1, c23);
    r03[1] = s1;
    r03[2] = q16_mul(c1, s23);
    r03[3] = q16_mul(s1, c23);
    r03[4] = -c1;
    r03[5] = q16_mul(s1, s23);
    r03[6] = s23;
    r03[7] = 0;
    r03[8] = -c23;

    out_q[0] = q1;
    out_q[1] = q2;
    out_q[2] = q3;
    solve_spherical_wrist(r03, r06, wrist_flip, out_q);
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── 3-Axis Delta Parallel Robot ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

static SYN_Status delta_calc_arm(q16_t x0, q16_t y0, q16_t z0, q16_t L, q16_t l, q16_t *out_theta)
{
    int64_t E =
        (((int64_t)x0 * (int64_t)x0) + ((int64_t)y0 * (int64_t)y0) + ((int64_t)z0 * (int64_t)z0) +
         ((int64_t)L * (int64_t)L) - ((int64_t)l * (int64_t)l)) >>
        16;
    int64_t two_L_y0 = (2LL * (int64_t)L * (int64_t)y0) >> 16;
    int64_t A = E - two_L_y0;
    int64_t B = (4LL * (int64_t)L * (int64_t)z0) >> 16;
    int64_t C = E + two_L_y0;

    int64_t max_a = (A < 0) ? -A : A;
    int64_t max_b = (B < 0) ? -B : B;
    int64_t max_c = (C < 0) ? -C : C;
    int64_t max_abc = (max_a > max_b) ? max_a : max_b;
    if (max_c > max_abc) {
        max_abc = max_c;
    }
    while (max_abc > (1LL << 29)) {
        A >>= 1;
        B >>= 1;
        C >>= 1;
        max_abc >>= 1;
    }

    int64_t disc_64 = (B * B) - (4LL * A * C);
    if (disc_64 < 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (A == 0) {
        if (B == 0) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        int64_t num_lin = -C;
        int64_t den_lin = B;
        if (den_lin < 0) {
            num_lin = -num_lin;
            den_lin = -den_lin;
        }
        *out_theta = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_atan2((q16_t)num_lin, (q16_t)den_lin));
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    int64_t sqrt_disc = (int64_t)syn_isqrt64((uint64_t)disc_64);
    int64_t num = -B - sqrt_disc;
    int64_t den = 2LL * A;
    if (den < 0) {
        num = -num;
        den = -den;
    }
    *out_theta = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_atan2((q16_t)num, (q16_t)den));
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_delta_ik(const SYN_Kinematics_DeltaConfig *cfg,
                                   const SYN_Position3D *target, q16_t *out_theta1,
                                   q16_t *out_theta2, q16_t *out_theta3)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || target == NULL || cfg->upper_arm_len <= 0 || cfg->lower_arm_len <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    q16_t x0 = target->x;
    q16_t y0 = target->y;
    q16_t z0 = target->z;

    q16_t wb = cfg->base_radius - cfg->effector_radius;

    /* Arm 1 (at angle 0 deg) */
    q16_t t1 = 0;
    if (delta_calc_arm(x0, y0 + wb, z0, cfg->upper_arm_len, cfg->lower_arm_len, &t1) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Arm 2 (rotated by 120 deg) */
    q16_t x2 = q16_mul(x0, Q16_COS120) + q16_mul(y0, Q16_SIN120);
    q16_t y2 = -q16_mul(x0, Q16_SIN120) + q16_mul(y0, Q16_COS120);
    q16_t t2 = 0;
    if (delta_calc_arm(x2, y2 + wb, z0, cfg->upper_arm_len, cfg->lower_arm_len, &t2) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Arm 3 (rotated by 240 deg) */
    q16_t x3 = q16_mul(x0, Q16_COS240) + q16_mul(y0, Q16_SIN240);
    q16_t y3 = -q16_mul(x0, Q16_SIN240) + q16_mul(y0, Q16_COS240);
    q16_t t3 = 0;
    if (delta_calc_arm(x3, y3 + wb, z0, cfg->upper_arm_len, cfg->lower_arm_len, &t3) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (out_theta1 != NULL) {
        *out_theta1 = t1;
    }
    if (out_theta2 != NULL) {
        *out_theta2 = t2;
    }
    if (out_theta3 != NULL) {
        *out_theta3 = t3;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool delta_q16_vec3_ok(int64_t u, int64_t v, int64_t w)
{
    return (u >= (int64_t)INT32_MIN) && (u <= (int64_t)INT32_MAX) && (v >= (int64_t)INT32_MIN) &&
           (v <= (int64_t)INT32_MAX) && (w >= (int64_t)INT32_MIN) && (w <= (int64_t)INT32_MAX);
}

static bool delta_slope_ok(int64_t c1, int64_t c2)
{
    return (c1 >= -(1LL << 29)) && (c1 <= (1LL << 29)) && (c2 >= -(1LL << 29)) &&
           (c2 <= (1LL << 29));
}

static void delta_prescale_dw(int64_t *dw21, int64_t *dw31, int64_t *dd_b)
{
    for (;;) {
        int64_t abs21 = (*dw21 < 0) ? -(*dw21) : *dw21;
        int64_t abs31 = (*dw31 < 0) ? -(*dw31) : *dw31;
        int64_t max_dw = (abs21 > abs31) ? abs21 : abs31;
        if (max_dw <= (1LL << 28)) {
            break;
        }
        *dw21 >>= 1;
        *dw31 >>= 1;
        *dd_b >>= 1;
    }
}

static SYN_Status delta_fk_solve_z(int64_t a, int64_t b, int64_t c, int64_t *out_z)
{
    /* Substitute z = (2^k) * u -> a*u^2 + (b >> k)*u + (c >> 2k) = 0 so a keeps full precision */
    int shift_k = 0;
    int64_t b_s = b;
    int64_t c_s = c;
    int64_t c_limit = (1LL << 58) / a;

    for (;;) {
        int64_t abs_b = (b_s < 0) ? -b_s : b_s;
        int64_t abs_c = (c_s < 0) ? -c_s : c_s;
        if ((abs_b <= (1LL << 29)) && (abs_c <= c_limit)) {
            break;
        }
        b_s >>= 1;
        c_s >>= 2;
        shift_k++;
    }

    int64_t disc_q32 = (b_s * b_s) - (4LL * a * c_s);
    if (disc_q32 < 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int64_t sqrt_disc = (int64_t)syn_isqrt64((uint64_t)disc_q32);
    int64_t u_q16 = ((-b_s - sqrt_disc) * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (2LL * a);
    *out_z = u_q16 * (int64_t)(1ULL << (uint32_t)shift_k);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kinematics_delta_fk(const SYN_Kinematics_DeltaConfig *cfg, q16_t theta1,
                                   q16_t theta2, q16_t theta3, SYN_Position3D *out_pos)
{
    if (cfg == NULL || out_pos == NULL || cfg->upper_arm_len <= 0 || cfg->lower_arm_len <= 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    int64_t wb = (int64_t)cfg->base_radius - (int64_t)cfg->effector_radius;
    int64_t L = (int64_t)cfg->upper_arm_len;
    int64_t l = (int64_t)cfg->lower_arm_len;

    /* 3 elbow joint positions J1, J2, J3 widened to 64-bit before validation */
    int64_t y1 = -(wb + ((L * (int64_t)q16_cos(theta1)) >> 16));
    int64_t z1 = -((L * (int64_t)q16_sin(theta1)) >> 16);

    int64_t y2_p = -(wb + ((L * (int64_t)q16_cos(theta2)) >> 16));
    int64_t z2 = -((L * (int64_t)q16_sin(theta2)) >> 16);
    int64_t y3_p = -(wb + ((L * (int64_t)q16_cos(theta3)) >> 16));
    int64_t z3 = -((L * (int64_t)q16_sin(theta3)) >> 16);
    if (!delta_q16_vec3_ok(y1, y2_p, y3_p)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int64_t x2 = (y2_p * -(int64_t)Q16_SIN120) >> 16;
    int64_t y2 = (y2_p * (int64_t)Q16_COS120) >> 16;
    int64_t x3 = (y3_p * -(int64_t)Q16_SIN240) >> 16;
    int64_t y3 = (y3_p * (int64_t)Q16_COS240) >> 16;

    /* 3-Sphere intersection in 64-bit Q48.16 */
    int64_t d_denom = (((y2 - y1) * x3) >> 16) - (((y3 - y1) * x2) >> 16);
    if (d_denom == 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int64_t w1 = ((y1 * y1) >> 16) + ((z1 * z1) >> 16);
    int64_t w2 = ((x2 * x2) >> 16) + ((y2 * y2) >> 16) + ((z2 * z2) >> 16);
    int64_t w3 = ((x3 * x3) >> 16) + ((y3 * y3) >> 16) + ((z3 * z3) >> 16);

    int64_t na1 = (((z2 - z1) >> 1) * ((y3 - y1) >> 1)) - (((z3 - z1) >> 1) * ((y2 - y1) >> 1));
    int64_t a1 = ((na1 <= (INT64_MAX / 4LL)) && (na1 >= (INT64_MIN / 4LL)))
                     ? ((na1 * 4LL) / d_denom)
                     : ((na1 / d_denom) * 4LL);
    int64_t na2 = -((((z2 - z1) >> 1) * (x3 >> 1)) - (((z3 - z1) >> 1) * (x2 >> 1)));
    int64_t a2_coeff = ((na2 <= (INT64_MAX / 4LL)) && (na2 >= (INT64_MIN / 4LL)))
                           ? ((na2 * 4LL) / d_denom)
                           : ((na2 / d_denom) * 4LL);

    int64_t dw21 = w2 - w1;
    int64_t dw31 = w3 - w1;
    int64_t dd_b = d_denom;
    delta_prescale_dw(&dw21, &dw31, &dd_b);

    int64_t b1 = (dd_b != 0) ? (-((dw21 * (y3 - y1)) - (dw31 * (y2 - y1))) / (2LL * dd_b)) : 0;
    int64_t b2_coeff = (dd_b != 0) ? (((dw21 * x3) - (dw31 * x2)) / (2LL * dd_b)) : 0;
    if ((dd_b == 0) || !delta_slope_ok(a1, a2_coeff) || !delta_slope_ok(b1 >> 1, b2_coeff >> 1)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int64_t a = ((a1 * a1) >> 16) + ((a2_coeff * a2_coeff) >> 16) + (int64_t)Q16_ONE;
    int64_t dy1 = b2_coeff - y1;
    int64_t b = 2LL * (((a1 * b1) >> 16) + ((a2_coeff * dy1) >> 16) - z1);
    int64_t c =
        ((b1 * b1) >> 16) + (((dy1 >> 1) * (dy1 >> 1)) >> 14) + ((z1 * z1) >> 16) - ((l * l) >> 16);

    int64_t z = 0;
    if (delta_fk_solve_z(a, b, c, &z) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    int64_t z_clamped = (z < (int64_t)INT32_MIN)
                            ? (int64_t)INT32_MIN
                            : ((z > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) ? (int64_t)INT32_MAX : z);
    int64_t x = ((a1 * z_clamped) >> 16) + b1;
    int64_t y = ((a2_coeff * z_clamped) >> 16) + b2_coeff;
    if (!delta_q16_vec3_ok(x, y, z)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    out_pos->x = (q16_t)x;
    out_pos->y = (q16_t)y;
    out_pos->z = (q16_t)z;
    return SYN_OK;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides a zero-heap robotics kinematics engine for embedded microcontrollers: * Standard & Modified Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) parameter chain transforms. * Multi-joint forward kinematics with position vector and orientation extraction. * Closed-form inverse kinematics solvers for: * 3-DOF Planar Articulated Arm. * 4-DOF SCARA Robot (X, Y, Z, Yaw) with elbow-left / elbow-right configurations. * 6-DOF Articulated Robot Arm with spherical wrist (Pieper's decoupling). * 3-Axis Delta Parallel Robot.

  • Geometric Jacobian computation (6 x N) for differential velocity kinematics.

docs.title: function syn_motor_ctrl_move_to
docs.text:
Move to position with a built-in trapezoidal velocity profile. 

void syn_motor_ctrl_move_to (
    SYN_MotorCtrl * ctrl,
    int32_t target,
    int32_t max_velocity,
    int32_t acceleration
)

This is the "batteries included" path — no external profile generator needed. The controller internally generates a trapezoidal ramp (accelerate → cruise → decelerate) and feeds it through the normal trajectory/feedforward path each update() call.

Equivalent to manually calling syn_ramp_set_target_trapezoid() and feeding the output into set_trajectory() each tick, but with zero user-side wiring.

Parameters:

  • ctrl Controller instance.
  • target Target position in feedback units.
  • max_velocity Maximum velocity (units/second).
  • acceleration Acceleration (units/second²).

docs.title: function syn_motor_ctrl_move_to_scurve
docs.text:
Move to position with a built-in jerk-limited S-curve profile. 

void syn_motor_ctrl_move_to_scurve (
    SYN_MotorCtrl * ctrl,
    int32_t target,
    int32_t max_velocity,
    int32_t max_accel,
    int32_t max_jerk
)

Like move_to(), but uses a 7-phase S-curve trajectory that bounds jerk for the smoothest possible motion. The S-curve natively provides position, velocity, and acceleration — all three are fed into the trajectory/feedforward path.

All kinematic limits are in per-second units: * max_velocity: units/second * max_accel: units/second² * max_jerk: units/second³

Parameters:

  • ctrl Controller instance.
  • target Target position in feedback units.
  • max_velocity Maximum velocity (units/second).
  • max_accel Maximum acceleration (units/second²).
  • max_jerk Maximum jerk (units/second³).
