#include "../util/syn_fmt.h"
#include "syn_http.h"

#include <string.h>

#define HTTP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS 10000 

/* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool prefix_icase(const char *str, const char *prefix)
{
    return syn_str_prefix_icase(str, prefix);
}

static uint32_t parse_uint(const char *s)
{
    return syn_fmt_parse_uint(s);
}

static bool sock_write_str(SYN_Socket sock, const char *str)
{
    size_t len = strlen(str);
    int sent = syn_port_sock_send_all(sock, str, len);
    return (sent == (int)len);
}

static bool send_content_headers(SYN_Socket sock, const char *content_type, size_t content_length)
{
    if (content_type != NULL) {
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, "Content-Type: ")) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, content_type)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, "\r\n")) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (content_length > 0U) {
        char len_str[16];
        int pos = 0;
        uint32_t cl = (uint32_t)content_length;
        char tmp[16];
        int tpos = 0;
        while (cl > 0U) {
            tmp[tpos++] = (char)('0' + (cl % 10U));
            cl /= 10U;
        }
        for (int i = tpos - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            len_str[pos++] = tmp[i];
        }
        len_str[pos] = '\0';

        if (!sock_write_str(sock, "Content-Length: ")) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, len_str)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, "\r\n")) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static bool send_custom_headers(SYN_Socket sock, const SYN_HttpHeader *headers,
                                uint8_t header_count)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < header_count; i++) {
        if (headers[i].name == NULL || headers[i].value == NULL) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, headers[i].name)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, ": ")) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, headers[i].value)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sock_write_str(sock, "\r\n")) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static bool send_request(SYN_Socket sock, const char *method, const char *host, const char *path,
                         const SYN_HttpHeader *headers, uint8_t header_count,
                         const char *content_type, size_t content_length)
{
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, method)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, " ")) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, path)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, " HTTP/1.1\r\n")) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, "Host: ")) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, host)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, "\r\n")) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!send_content_headers(sock, content_type, content_length)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, "Connection: close\r\n")) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!send_custom_headers(sock, headers, header_count)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!sock_write_str(sock, "\r\n")) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool http_parse_port(const char *p, uint16_t *port_out)
{
    uint32_t port = 0U;
    bool has_digit = false;
    while ((*p != '\0') && (*p != '/')) {
        if ((*p < '0') || (*p > '9')) {
            return false;
        }
        has_digit = true;
        port = (port * 10U) + (uint32_t)(*p - '0');
        if (port > 65535U) {
            return false;
        }
        p++;
    }
    if ((!has_digit) || (port == 0U)) {
        return false;
    }
    *port_out = (uint16_t)port;
    return true;
}

static bool parse_redirect_url(const char *url, const char *orig_host, uint16_t orig_port,
                               char *host_out, size_t host_sz, char *path_out, size_t path_sz,
                               uint16_t *port_out)
{
    if (prefix_icase(url, "http://")) {
        url += 7;
        const char *slash = strchr(url, '/');
        const char *colon = strchr(url, ':');
        if ((colon != NULL) && ((slash == NULL) || (colon < slash))) {
            if (!http_parse_port(colon + 1, port_out)) {
                return false;
            }
            size_t host_len = (size_t)(colon - url);
            if (host_len >= host_sz) {
                host_len = host_sz - 1U;
            }
            memcpy(host_out, url, host_len);
            host_out[host_len] = '\0';
        } else {
            size_t host_len = (slash != NULL) ? (size_t)(slash - url) : strlen(url);
            if (host_len >= host_sz) {
                host_len = host_sz - 1U;
            }
            memcpy(host_out, url, host_len);
            host_out[host_len] = '\0';
            *port_out = 80;
        }
        strncpy(path_out, (slash != NULL) ? slash : "/", path_sz - 1U);
        path_out[path_sz - 1U] = '\0';
        return true;
    }

    if (strstr(url, "://") != NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    if (url[0] == '/') {
        strncpy(host_out, orig_host, host_sz - 1U);
        host_out[host_sz - 1U] = '\0';
        *port_out = orig_port;
        strncpy(path_out, url, path_sz - 1U);
        path_out[path_sz - 1U] = '\0';
    } else {
        strncpy(host_out, orig_host, host_sz - 1U);
        host_out[host_sz - 1U] = '\0';
        *port_out = orig_port;
        path_out[0] = '/';
        strncpy(path_out + 1, url, path_sz - 2U);
        path_out[path_sz - 1U] = '\0';
    }
    return true;
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_http_client_init(SYN_HttpClient *client, const char *method, const char *host,
                                uint16_t port, const char *path, const char *content_type,
                                const uint8_t *body, size_t body_len, const SYN_HttpHeader *headers,
                                uint8_t header_count, SYN_HttpBodyCallback body_cb, void *cb_ctx,
                                uint8_t *work_buf, size_t work_buf_size)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(client != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(method != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(host != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(path != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(work_buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(work_buf_size >= 128);

    memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
    client->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_IDLE;
    client->sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    client->method = method;
    client->host = host;
    client->port = port;
    client->path = path;
    client->content_type = content_type;
    client->body = body;
    client->body_len = body_len;
    client->headers = headers;
    client->header_count = header_count;
    client->body_cb = body_cb;
    client->cb_ctx = cb_ctx;
    client->work_buf = work_buf;
    client->work_buf_size = work_buf_size;
    client->status = SYN_OK;

    strncpy(client->cur_host, host, sizeof(client->cur_host) - 1);
    client->cur_host[sizeof(client->cur_host) - 1] = '\0';
    strncpy(client->cur_path, path, sizeof(client->cur_path) - 1);
    client->cur_path[sizeof(client->cur_path) - 1] = '\0';
    client->cur_port = port;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void http_close_sock(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    if (c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(c->sock);
        c->sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }
}

static int http_fail(SYN_HttpClient *c, SYN_Status status)
{
    http_close_sock(c);
    c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_ERROR;
    c->status = status;
    return -1;
}

static bool http_task_args_valid(const SYN_PT *pt, const SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    const SYN_HttpClient *c = (const SYN_HttpClient *)task->user_data;
    return c->work_buf != NULL && c->work_buf_size >= 2U;
}

static bool http_sock_readable(const SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    return c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
}

static bool http_header_wake_ready(const SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    if (c->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID || syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock)) {
        return true;
    }
    return (syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->header_timeout_ms) >= HTTP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS;
}

static bool http_body_wake_ready(const SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    if (c->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID || syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock)) {
        return true;
    }
    return (syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->body_timeout_ms) >= HTTP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS;
}

static bool http_connect_and_send(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_CONNECTING;
    c->sock = syn_port_sock_connect_host(c->cur_host, c->cur_port);
    if (c->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        (void)http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        return false;
    }

    c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_SENDING_REQUEST;
    if (!send_request(c->sock, c->method, c->cur_host, c->cur_path, c->headers, c->header_count,
                      c->content_type, c->body_len)) {
        (void)http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        return false;
    }

    if (c->body != NULL && c->body_len > 0U) {
        int sent = syn_port_sock_send_all(c->sock, c->body, c->body_len);
        if (sent != (int)c->body_len) {
            (void)http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
            return false;
        }
    }

    c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_READING_HEADERS;
    c->buf_used = 0U;
    memset(&c->resp, 0, sizeof(c->resp));
    c->header_timeout_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    return true;
}

static int http_step_headers(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    size_t space = (c->work_buf_size - 1U) - c->buf_used;
    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(c->sock, c->work_buf + c->buf_used, space, 0);
    if (n > 0) {
        c->buf_used += (size_t)n;
        c->work_buf[c->buf_used] = '\0';
        c->header_timeout_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();

        const char *end = strstr((const char *)c->work_buf, "\r\n\r\n");
        if (end != NULL) {
            c->body_start = (size_t)(end - (const char *)c->work_buf) + 4U;
            return 1;
        }
        if (c->buf_used >= c->work_buf_size - 1U) {
            return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        }
        return http_sock_readable(c) ? 2 : 0;
    }
    if (n == 0 || was_readable) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    if ((syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->header_timeout_ms) >= HTTP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_TIMEOUT);
    }
    return 0;
}

static const char *http_skip_spaces(const char *s)
{
    while ((*s == ' ') || (*s == '\t')) {
        s++;
    }
    return s;
}

static void http_parse_header_line(SYN_HttpResponse *resp, const char *cur)
{
    if (prefix_icase(cur, "content-length:")) {
        resp->content_length = parse_uint(http_skip_spaces(cur + 15));
        resp->has_content_length = true;
    } else if (prefix_icase(cur, "transfer-encoding:")) {
        if (prefix_icase(http_skip_spaces(cur + 18), "chunked")) {
            resp->chunked = true;
        }
    } else if (prefix_icase(cur, "connection:")) {
        if (prefix_icase(http_skip_spaces(cur + 11), "close")) {
            resp->connection_close = true;
        }
    } else if (prefix_icase(cur, "location:")) {
        const char *val = http_skip_spaces(cur + 9);
        size_t len = 0U;
        while (val[len] != '\r' && val[len] != '\n' && len < sizeof(resp->location) - 1U) {
            resp->location[len] = val[len];
            len++;
        }
        resp->location[len] = '\0';
    }
}

static bool http_status_is_bodyless(int status_code)
{
    return status_code == 204 || status_code == 304 || (status_code >= 100 && status_code < 200);
}

static bool http_apply_redirect(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    http_close_sock(c);
    if (++c->hops >= 5) {
        return false;
    }

    char next_host[64];
    char next_path[128];
    uint16_t next_port = c->cur_port;
    if (!parse_redirect_url(c->resp.location, c->cur_host, c->cur_port, next_host,
                            sizeof(next_host), next_path, sizeof(next_path), &next_port)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (strcmp(next_host, c->cur_host) != 0 || next_port != c->cur_port) {
        c->headers = NULL;
        c->header_count = 0U;
    }

    if (c->resp.status_code == 303 || ((c->resp.status_code == 301 || c->resp.status_code == 302) &&
                                       strcmp(c->method, "POST") == 0)) {
        c->method = "GET";
        c->body = NULL;
        c->body_len = 0U;
        c->content_type = NULL;
    }

    strncpy(c->cur_host, next_host, sizeof(c->cur_host) - 1U);
    c->cur_host[sizeof(c->cur_host) - 1U] = '\0';
    strncpy(c->cur_path, next_path, sizeof(c->cur_path) - 1U);
    c->cur_path[sizeof(c->cur_path) - 1U] = '\0';
    c->cur_port = next_port;
    return true;
}

static bool http_response_is_bodyless(const char *method, int status_code)
{
    if (prefix_icase(method, "head") && (method[4] == '\0')) {
        return true;
    }
    return http_status_is_bodyless(status_code);
}

static int http_prepare_response(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    const char *line = (const char *)c->work_buf;
    const char *hdr_end = (const char *)c->work_buf + c->body_start - 2U;
    const char *sp = strchr(line, ' ');
    if (sp == NULL || sp > hdr_end) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    c->resp.status_code = (int)parse_uint(sp + 1);

    const char *cur = strchr(line, '\n') + 1;
    while (cur < hdr_end) {
        http_parse_header_line(&c->resp, cur);
        cur = strchr(cur, '\n') + 1;
    }

    if (c->resp.status_code >= 300 && c->resp.status_code < 400 && c->resp.location[0] != '\0') {
        if (!http_apply_redirect(c)) {
            return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        }
        return 2;
    }

    if (c->body_cb == NULL) {
        http_close_sock(c);
        c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_DONE;
        c->status = SYN_OK;
        return -1;
    }

    bool bodyless = http_response_is_bodyless(c->method, c->resp.status_code);
    if (bodyless) {
        c->resp.chunked = false;
    }
    c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_READING_BODY;
    c->buf_pos = c->body_start;
    c->body_timeout_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    c->chunk_state = 0U;
    c->chunk_line_pos = 0U;
    c->body_remaining = bodyless ? 0U : c->resp.content_length;
    c->known_length = c->resp.has_content_length || bodyless;
    return 1;
}

static int http_hex_nibble(char hc)
{
    if (hc >= '0' && hc <= '9') {
        return (int)(hc - '0');
    }
    if (hc >= 'a' && hc <= 'f') {
        return (int)(hc - 'a') + 10;
    }
    if (hc >= 'A' && hc <= 'F') {
        return (int)(hc - 'A') + 10;
    }
    return -1;
}

static bool http_parse_chunk_hex(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    c->chunk_remaining = 0U;
    size_t digits = 0U;
    const char *p = c->chunk_line;
    while (*p != '\0') {
        char hc = *p++;
        int nib = http_hex_nibble(hc);
        if (nib >= 0) {
            if (c->chunk_remaining > (UINT32_MAX >> 4U)) {
                return false;
            }
            c->chunk_remaining = (c->chunk_remaining << 4U) | (uint32_t)nib;
            digits++;
        } else if (hc == ';' || hc == '\r' || hc == '\n') {
            return (digits > 0U);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool http_feed_chunk_size_byte(SYN_HttpClient *c, uint8_t ch)
{
    if (c->chunk_line_pos < sizeof(c->chunk_line) - 1U) {
        c->chunk_line[c->chunk_line_pos++] = (char)ch;
    }
    if (ch == '\n') {
        c->chunk_line[c->chunk_line_pos] = '\0';
        if (!http_parse_chunk_hex(c)) {
            return false;
        }
        c->chunk_state = (c->chunk_remaining == 0U) ? 2U : 1U;
        c->chunk_line_pos = 0U;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool http_consume_chunk_crlf(SYN_HttpClient *c, uint8_t ch)
{
    if (c->chunk_state == 1U) {
        if (ch != '\r') {
            return false;
        }
        c->chunk_state = 3U;
        return true;
    }
    if (ch != '\n') {
        return false;
    }
    c->chunk_state = 0U;
    return true;
}

static int http_feed_trailer_byte(SYN_HttpClient *c, uint8_t ch)
{
    if (c->chunk_state == 2U) {
        if (ch == '\r') {
            c->chunk_state = 4U;
            return 0;
        }
        if (ch == '\n') {
            return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        }
        c->chunk_line_pos++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (ch != '\n') {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    if (c->chunk_line_pos == 0U) {
        return 1;
    }
    c->chunk_line_pos = 0U;
    c->chunk_state = 2U;
    return 0;
}

static int http_consume_chunked_buf(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    while (c->buf_pos < c->buf_used) {
        if (c->chunk_state == 0U) {
            if (!http_feed_chunk_size_byte(c, c->work_buf[c->buf_pos++])) {
                return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
            }
        } else if (c->chunk_state == 1U && c->chunk_remaining > 0U) {
            size_t avail = c->buf_used - c->buf_pos;
            size_t to_deliver = (avail > c->chunk_remaining) ? c->chunk_remaining : avail;
            if (!c->body_cb(c->work_buf + c->buf_pos, to_deliver, c->cb_ctx)) {
                return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
            }
            c->buf_pos += to_deliver;
            c->chunk_remaining -= (uint32_t)to_deliver;
        } else if (c->chunk_state == 1U || c->chunk_state == 3U) {
            if (!http_consume_chunk_crlf(c, c->work_buf[c->buf_pos++])) {
                return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
            }
        } else {
            int trc = http_feed_trailer_byte(c, c->work_buf[c->buf_pos++]);
            if (trc != 0) {
                return trc;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int http_handle_body_recv_neg(SYN_HttpClient *c, bool was_readable)
{
    if (was_readable) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    if ((syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->body_timeout_ms) >= HTTP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_TIMEOUT);
    }
    return 0;
}

static int http_step_chunked_body(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    int crc = http_consume_chunked_buf(c);
    if (crc != 0) {
        return crc;
    }

    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(c->sock, c->work_buf, c->work_buf_size, 0);
    if (n > 0) {
        c->buf_used = (size_t)n;
        c->buf_pos = 0U;
        c->body_timeout_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        return http_sock_readable(c) ? 2 : 3;
    }
    if (n == 0) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    return http_handle_body_recv_neg(c, was_readable);
}

static bool http_drain_initial_body(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    if (c->buf_pos < c->buf_used) {
        size_t to_deliver = c->buf_used - c->buf_pos;
        if (c->known_length && to_deliver > c->body_remaining) {
            to_deliver = c->body_remaining;
        }
        if (to_deliver > 0U && !c->body_cb(c->work_buf + c->buf_pos, to_deliver, c->cb_ctx)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (c->known_length) {
            c->body_remaining -= (uint32_t)to_deliver;
        }
        c->buf_pos = c->buf_used;
    }
    return true;
}

static int http_step_stream_body(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    if (!http_drain_initial_body(c)) {
        return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
    }
    if (c->known_length && c->body_remaining == 0U) {
        return 1;
    }

    size_t to_read = (c->known_length && c->work_buf_size > c->body_remaining) ? c->body_remaining
                                                                               : c->work_buf_size;
    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(c->sock, c->work_buf, to_read, 0);
    if (n > 0) {
        if (!c->body_cb(c->work_buf, (size_t)n, c->cb_ctx)) {
            return http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR);
        }
        c->body_timeout_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (c->known_length) {
            c->body_remaining -= (uint32_t)n;
            if (c->body_remaining == 0U) {
                return 1;
            }
        }
        return http_sock_readable(c) ? 2 : 3;
    }
    if (n == 0) {
        return c->known_length ? http_fail(c, SYN_ERROR) : 1;
    }
    return http_handle_body_recv_neg(c, was_readable);
}

static int http_step_body(SYN_HttpClient *c)
{
    return c->resp.chunked ? http_step_chunked_body(c) : http_step_stream_body(c);
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_http_client_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (!http_task_args_valid(pt, task)) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }
    SYN_HttpClient *c = (SYN_HttpClient *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    http_close_sock(c);

    for (;;) {
        if (!http_connect_and_send(c)) {
            PT_EXIT(pt);
        }

        int hrc;
        while ((hrc = http_step_headers(c)) != 1) {
            if (hrc < 0) {
                PT_EXIT(pt);
            }
            if (hrc == 0) {
                PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, http_header_wake_ready(c));
            } else {
                PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
            }
        }

        int rrc = http_prepare_response(c);
        if (rrc < 0) {
            PT_EXIT(pt);
        }
        if (rrc == 2) {
            continue;
        }

        int brc;
        while ((brc = http_step_body(c)) != 1) {
            if (brc < 0) {
                PT_EXIT(pt);
            }
            if (brc == 0) {
                PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, http_body_wake_ready(c));
            } else {
                PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
            }
        }

        http_close_sock(c);
        c->state = SYN_HTTP_STATE_DONE;
        c->status = SYN_OK;
        break;
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

true to continue reading body, false to abort.

States for the HTTP client cooperative state machine. 

enum SYN_HttpState {
    SYN_HTTP_STATE_IDLE,
    SYN_HTTP_STATE_CONNECTING,
    SYN_HTTP_STATE_SENDING_REQUEST,

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Designed around the cooperative scheduler: every call to syn_httpd_step() does a bounded amount of work and returns immediately. Socket I/O uses timeout=0 exclusively. Stale connections are timed out via the tick clock.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_HTTPD) || SYN_USE_HTTPD


#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../sched/syn_sched.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_httpd.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define HTTPD_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS 5000

/* ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#include "../util/syn_fmt.h"

static inline bool prefix_icase(const char *str, const char *prefix)
{
    return syn_str_prefix_icase(str, prefix);
}

static bool sock_write(SYN_Socket sock, const char *str)
{
    size_t len = strlen(str);
    return syn_port_sock_send_all(sock, str, len) == (int)len;
}

static SYN_HttpMethod parse_method(const char *str, size_t len)
{
    if (len == 3 && memcmp(str, "GET", 3) == 0)
        return SYN_HTTP_GET;
    if (len == 4 && memcmp(str, "POST", 4) == 0)
        return SYN_HTTP_POST;
    if (len == 3 && memcmp(str, "PUT", 3) == 0)
        return SYN_HTTP_PUT;
    if (len == 6 && memcmp(str, "DELETE", 6) == 0)
        return SYN_HTTP_DELETE;
    return (SYN_HttpMethod)0xFF; /* Unrecognised — will produce 404/405 */
}

static inline uint32_t parse_uint(const char *s)
{
    return syn_fmt_parse_uint(s);
}

static const char *httpd_skip_ows(const char *s)
{
    while ((*s == ' ') || (*s == '\t')) {
        s++;
    }
    return s;
}

static void httpd_parse_header_line(SYN_HttpdRequest *req, const char *hdr_start,
                                    const char *next_line)
{
    if (prefix_icase(hdr_start, "content-length:")) {
        req->content_length = parse_uint(httpd_skip_ows(hdr_start + 15));
    } else if (prefix_icase(hdr_start, "content-type:")) {
        const char *val = httpd_skip_ows(hdr_start + 13);
        size_t ct_len = (size_t)(next_line - val);
        if (ct_len >= sizeof(req->content_type_buf)) {
            ct_len = sizeof(req->content_type_buf) - 1U;
        }
        memcpy(req->content_type_buf, val, ct_len);
        req->content_type_buf[ct_len] = '\0';
        req->content_type = req->content_type_buf;
    }
}

static int parse_headers_from_buf(SYN_Socket sock, SYN_HttpdRequest *req, uint8_t *buf,
                                  size_t total)
{
    memset(req, 0, sizeof(*req));
    req->client_sock = sock;

    buf[total] = '\0';

    char *end_of_headers = strstr((const char *)buf, "\r\n\r\n");
    if (end_of_headers == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    /* Parse request line: "GET /path?query HTTP/1.1\r\n" */
    char *line = (char *)buf;
    char *line_end = strstr(line, "\r\n");
    char *sp1 = strchr(line, ' ');
    if (sp1 == NULL || sp1 >= line_end) {
        return -1;
    }

    req->method = parse_method(line, (size_t)(sp1 - line));

    char *path_start = sp1 + 1;
    char *sp2 = strchr(path_start, ' ');
    if (sp2 == NULL || sp2 >= line_end) {
        return -1;
    }
    *sp2 = '\0'; /* null-terminate the path+query */

    /* Split path and query */
    char *qmark = strchr(path_start, '?');
    if (qmark != NULL) {
        *qmark = '\0';
        req->query = qmark + 1;
    }
    req->path = path_start;

    /* Parse headers without mutating header lines in work_buf */
    char *hdr_start = line_end + 2;
    req->headers = hdr_start;

    while (hdr_start < end_of_headers) {
        char *next_line = strstr(hdr_start, "\r\n");
        httpd_parse_header_line(req, hdr_start, next_line);
        hdr_start = next_line + 2;
    }

    /* Calculate buffered body */
    size_t header_len = (size_t)(end_of_headers + 4 - (char *)buf);
    if (total > header_len) {
        req->body_buffered_offset = header_len;
        req->body_buffered_len = total - header_len;
    }

    return 0;
}

static const SYN_HttpdRoute *match_route(const SYN_Httpd *srv, const SYN_HttpdRequest *req)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < srv->route_count; i++) {
        const SYN_HttpdRoute *r = &srv->routes[i];

        if (r->method != req->method) {
            continue;
        }

        size_t plen = strlen(r->path);
        if (plen > 0U && r->path[plen - 1U] == '*') {
            if (strncmp(req->path, r->path, plen - 1U) == 0) {
                return r;
            }
        } else if (strcmp(req->path, r->path) == 0) {
            return r;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void send_error(SYN_Socket sock, int code, const char *reason)
{
    sock_write(sock, "HTTP/1.1 ");
    /* Simple int-to-string for status code */
    char code_str[4];
    code_str[0] = (char)('0' + (code / 100));
    code_str[1] = (char)('0' + ((code / 10) % 10));
    code_str[2] = (char)('0' + (code % 10));
    code_str[3] = '\0';
    sock_write(sock, code_str);
    sock_write(sock, " ");
    sock_write(sock, reason);
    sock_write(sock, "\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n");
}

static void drop_client(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    if (srv->client != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(srv->client);
        srv->client = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }
    srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_IDLE;
    srv->rx_total = 0U;
    srv->expected_total = 0U;
}

/* ── Server API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_httpd_init(SYN_Httpd *srv, uint16_t port, const SYN_HttpdRoute *routes,
                          size_t route_count, uint8_t *work_buf, size_t work_buf_size)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(srv != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(routes != NULL || route_count == 0);
    SYN_ASSERT(work_buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(work_buf_size >= 256);

    memset(srv, 0, sizeof(*srv));
    srv->routes = routes;
    srv->route_count = route_count;
    srv->work_buf = work_buf;
    srv->work_buf_size = work_buf_size;
    srv->port = port;
    srv->client = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_IDLE;

    srv->listener = syn_port_sock_listen(port, 2);
    if (srv->listener == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    srv->running = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void dispatch_request(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    /* Parse request from buffered data */
    SYN_HttpdRequest req;
    if (parse_headers_from_buf(srv->client, &req, srv->work_buf, srv->rx_total) != 0) {
        send_error(srv->client, 400, "Bad Request");
        drop_client(srv);
        return;
    }

    /* Match route */
    const SYN_HttpdRoute *route = match_route(srv, &req);
    if (route == NULL) {
        send_error(srv->client, 404, "Not Found");
        drop_client(srv);
        return;
    }

    /* Dispatch to handler */
    SYN_HttpdResponse resp;
    resp.sock = srv->client;
    resp.buf = srv->work_buf;
    resp.buf_size = srv->work_buf_size;
    resp.body_consumed = 0U;
    resp.headers_sent = false;
    resp.upgraded = false;

    route->handler(&req, &resp, route->ctx);

    /* If handler didn't send anything, send 204 */
    if (!resp.headers_sent && !resp.upgraded) {
        send_error(srv->client, 204, "No Content");
    }

    if (!resp.upgraded) {
        drop_client(srv);
    } else {
        /* Upgraded connection (e.g. WebSocket) — don't close, just reset state */
        srv->client = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
        srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_IDLE;
        srv->rx_total = 0U;
        srv->expected_total = 0U;
    }
}

static bool httpd_check_headers_complete(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    const char *buf = (const char *)srv->work_buf;
    const char *eoh = strstr(buf, "\r\n\r\n");
    if (eoh == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t hdr_len = (size_t)(eoh + 4 - buf);
    uint32_t clen = 0U;
    const char *line_end = strstr(buf, "\r\n");
    const char *hdr = line_end + 2;
    while (hdr < eoh) {
        const char *next = strstr(hdr, "\r\n");
        if (prefix_icase(hdr, "content-length:")) {
            clen = parse_uint(httpd_skip_ows(hdr + 15));
        }
        hdr = next + 2;
    }

    size_t max_body_in_buf = (srv->work_buf_size - 1U) - hdr_len;
    size_t buf_body = ((size_t)clen <= max_body_in_buf) ? (size_t)clen : 0U;
    srv->expected_total = hdr_len + buf_body;
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status httpd_step_reading(SYN_Httpd *srv, bool defer_dispatch)
{
    /* Check deadline — drop stale connections without blocking */
    if ((int32_t)(syn_port_get_tick_ms() - srv->recv_deadline) >= 0) {
        send_error(srv->client, 408, "Request Timeout");
        drop_client(srv);
        return SYN_TIMEOUT;
    }

    /* Non-blocking recv (timeout=0) */
    size_t space = srv->work_buf_size - 1U - srv->rx_total;
    if (space == 0U) {
        send_error(srv->client, 413, "Request Too Large");
        drop_client(srv);
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(srv->client);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(srv->client, srv->work_buf + srv->rx_total, space, 0);
    if (n < 0) {
        if (was_readable) {
            drop_client(srv);
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        return SYN_TIMEOUT;
    }
    if (n == 0) {
        send_error(srv->client, 400, "Bad Request");
        drop_client(srv);
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    srv->rx_total += (size_t)n;
    srv->work_buf[srv->rx_total] = '\0';

    if (srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_READING_HEADERS) {
        if (!httpd_check_headers_complete(srv)) {
            return SYN_TIMEOUT;
        }
        srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_READING_BODY;
    }

    if (srv->rx_total >= srv->expected_total) {
        srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_DISPATCHING;
        if (!defer_dispatch) {
            dispatch_request(srv);
        }
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return SYN_TIMEOUT;
}

static SYN_Status httpd_step_phase(SYN_Httpd *srv, bool defer_dispatch)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(srv != NULL);
    if (!srv->running) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    switch (srv->state) {
    case SYN_HTTPD_IDLE: {
        SYN_Socket client = syn_port_sock_accept(srv->listener, 0);
        if (client == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
            return SYN_TIMEOUT;
        }
        srv->client = client;
        srv->rx_total = 0U;
        srv->expected_total = 0U;
        srv->recv_deadline = syn_port_get_tick_ms() + HTTPD_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS;
        srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_READING_HEADERS;
        return httpd_step_reading(srv, defer_dispatch);
    }

    case SYN_HTTPD_READING_HEADERS:
    case SYN_HTTPD_READING_BODY:
        return httpd_step_reading(srv, defer_dispatch);

    case SYN_HTTPD_DISPATCHING:
        dispatch_request(srv);
        return SYN_OK;

    default:
        srv->state = SYN_HTTPD_IDLE;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_httpd_step(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    return httpd_step_phase(srv, false);
}

void syn_httpd_stop(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(srv != NULL);
    /* Drop any in-progress client */
    drop_client(srv);
    if (srv->listener != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(srv->listener);
        srv->listener = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }
    srv->running = false;
}

/* ── Response helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_httpd_status(const SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, int code, const char *reason)
{
    if (resp == NULL || reason == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(!resp->headers_sent);

    char code_str[4];
    code_str[0] = (char)('0' + (code / 100));
    code_str[1] = (char)('0' + ((code / 10) % 10));
    code_str[2] = (char)('0' + (code % 10));
    code_str[3] = '\0';

    sock_write(resp->sock, "HTTP/1.1 ");
    sock_write(resp->sock, code_str);
    sock_write(resp->sock, " ");
    sock_write(resp->sock, reason);
    sock_write(resp->sock, "\r\n");
    sock_write(resp->sock, "Connection: close\r\n");
}

void syn_httpd_header(const SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, const char *name, const char *value)
{
    if (resp == NULL || name == NULL || value == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(!resp->headers_sent);

    sock_write(resp->sock, name);
    sock_write(resp->sock, ": ");
    sock_write(resp->sock, value);
    sock_write(resp->sock, "\r\n");
}

static void finalize_headers(SYN_HttpdResponse *resp)
{
    if (!resp->headers_sent) {
        sock_write(resp->sock, "\r\n");
        resp->headers_sent = true;
    }
}

void syn_httpd_body(SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if (resp == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    finalize_headers(resp);
    if (data != NULL && len > 0) {
        syn_port_sock_send_all(resp->sock, data, len);
    }
}

void syn_httpd_body_str(SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, const char *str)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(str != NULL);
    syn_httpd_body(resp, str, strlen(str));
}

int syn_httpd_read_body(const SYN_HttpdRequest *req, SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, void *buf,
                        size_t max_len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(req != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    if ((buf == NULL) && (max_len > 0U)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (max_len == 0U) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t consumed =
        (resp->body_consumed >= req->body_consumed) ? resp->body_consumed : req->body_consumed;
    if (req->content_length == 0U || consumed >= (size_t)req->content_length) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t remaining = (size_t)req->content_length - consumed;
    size_t to_read = (max_len < remaining) ? max_len : remaining;

    if (consumed < req->body_buffered_len) {
        size_t buf_avail = req->body_buffered_len - consumed;
        size_t consume = (buf_avail < to_read) ? buf_avail : to_read;
        memcpy(buf, resp->buf + req->body_buffered_offset + consumed, consume);
        resp->body_consumed = consumed + consume;
        return (int)consume;
    }

    /* Non-blocking read — timeout=0, never stalls the scheduler */
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(resp->sock, buf, to_read, 0);
    if (n > 0) {
        resp->body_consumed = consumed + (size_t)n;
    }
    return n;
}

static bool httpd_has_work(const SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    if (srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_IDLE) {
        return srv->listener != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_sock_readable(srv->listener);
    }
    if (srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_READING_HEADERS || srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_READING_BODY) {
        if (srv->client != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_sock_readable(srv->client)) {
            return true;
        }
        return (int32_t)(syn_port_get_tick_ms() - srv->recv_deadline) >= 0;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool httpd_step_progressed(SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    SYN_HttpdState prev_state = srv->state;
    size_t prev_rx = srv->rx_total;
    SYN_Status st = httpd_step_phase(srv, true);
    return (st == SYN_OK) || (srv->state != prev_state) || (srv->rx_total != prev_rx);
}

static bool httpd_buffer_full_in_reading(const SYN_Httpd *srv)
{
    return (srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_READING_HEADERS || srv->state == SYN_HTTPD_READING_BODY) &&
           (srv->rx_total + 1U >= srv->work_buf_size);
}

/* ── Protothread task ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_PT_Status syn_httpd_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }
    SYN_Httpd *srv = (SYN_Httpd *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    while (srv->running) {
        PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, !srv->running || httpd_has_work(srv));
        if (!srv->running) {
            break;
        }
        if (!httpd_step_progressed(srv)) {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        } else if (srv->running && httpd_has_work(srv)) {
            if (httpd_buffer_full_in_reading(srv)) {
                PT_CONTINUE(pt);
            } else {
                PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
            }
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

bool syn_httpd_get_query_param(const char *query, const char *key, char *val_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    if (query == NULL || key == NULL || val_buf == NULL || max_len == 0) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t key_len = strlen(key);
    const char *p = query;

    while (*p != '\0') {
        /* Check if key matches at current position */
        if (strncmp(p, key, key_len) == 0 && p[key_len] == '=') {
            const char *val_start = p + key_len + 1;
            const char *val_end = strchr(val_start, '&');
            size_t val_len = val_end ? (size_t)(val_end - val_start) : strlen(val_start);

            if (val_len >= max_len) {
                return false; /* Buffer capacity exceeded */
            }

            memcpy(val_buf, val_start, val_len);
            val_buf[val_len] = '\0';
            return true;
        }

        /* Move to next param after '&' */
        p = strchr(p, '&');
        if (p == NULL) {
            break;
        }
        p++; /* Skip '&' */
    }

    return false;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_HTTPD */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Designed to run as a cooperative protothread task within the SyntropicOS scheduler. Yields between accepts so other tasks can run. Handles one request per scheduler tick.

** **

static void handle_status(const SYN_HttpdRequest *req,
                           SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, void *ctx) {
    syn_httpd_status(resp, 200, "OK");
    syn_httpd_header(resp, "Content-Type", "application/json");
    syn_httpd_body_str(resp, "{\"status\":\"ok\"}");
}

static const SYN_HttpdRoute routes[] = {
    { SYN_HTTP_GET, "/api/status", handle_status, NULL },
};

// In your task array:
static uint8_t httpd_buf[1024];
static SYN_Httpd httpd;
syn_httpd_init(&httpd, 80, routes, 1, httpd_buf, sizeof(httpd_buf));
syn_task_create(&tasks[N], "httpd", syn_httpd_task, SYN_PRIO_NORMAL, &httpd);

/* ── HTTP methods ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef enum {
    SYN_HTTP_GET = 0,    
    SYN_HTTP_POST = 1,   
    SYN_HTTP_PUT = 2,    
    SYN_HTTP_DELETE = 3, 
} SYN_HttpMethod;

/* ── Request (parsed, presented to handler) ────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    SYN_HttpMethod method;       
    const char *path;            
    const char *query;           
    uint32_t content_length;

#include "syntropic/net/syn_icmp.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_icmp_init(SYN_ICMP *icmp)
{
    if (!icmp) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(icmp, 0, sizeof(*icmp));
    return SYN_OK;
}

uint16_t syn_icmp_checksum(const void *buf, size_t len)
{
    return syn_ip_checksum(buf, len);
}

static bool icmp_echo_dst_unicast(const uint8_t *ip_pkt)
{
    if ((ip_pkt[0] & 0x01U) != 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t dst_ip = ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[30] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[31] << 16U) |
                      ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[32] << 8U) | (uint32_t)ip_pkt[33];
    return (dst_ip != 0xFFFFFFFFUL && (dst_ip & 0xF0000000UL) != 0xE0000000UL);
}

static void icmp_build_echo_reply(SYN_ICMP *icmp, const uint8_t *ip_pkt, size_t pkt_len,
                                  size_t icmp_offset, uint8_t *frame_tx, size_t *tx_len)
{
    if (frame_tx == NULL || tx_len == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memcpy(frame_tx, ip_pkt, pkt_len);

    /* Swap MAC addresses (offset 0 and 6) */
    memcpy(&frame_tx[0], &ip_pkt[6], 6U);
    memcpy(&frame_tx[6], &ip_pkt[0], 6U);

    /* Swap IP addresses (offset 26 and 30) */
    memcpy(&frame_tx[26], &ip_pkt[30], 4U);
    memcpy(&frame_tx[30], &ip_pkt[26], 4U);

    /* Modify ICMP Type: 8 (Request) -> 0 (Reply) */
    frame_tx[icmp_offset] = SYN_ICMP_TYPE_ECHO_REPLY;
    frame_tx[icmp_offset + 2U] = 0U;
    frame_tx[icmp_offset + 3U] = 0U;

    size_t icmp_len = pkt_len - icmp_offset;
    uint16_t csum = syn_icmp_checksum(&frame_tx[icmp_offset], icmp_len);
    frame_tx[icmp_offset + 2U] = (uint8_t)(csum >> 8U);
    frame_tx[icmp_offset + 3U] = (uint8_t)(csum & 0xFFU);

    /* Zero pad frame to minimum Ethernet length (60 bytes) */
    size_t wire_len = pkt_len;
    if (wire_len < SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN) {
        memset(&frame_tx[wire_len], 0, SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN - wire_len);
        wire_len = SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN;
    }

    icmp->echo_replies_tx++;
    *tx_len = wire_len;
}

static SYN_Status icmp_validate_bounds_and_csum(SYN_ICMP *icmp, const uint8_t *ip_pkt, size_t len,
                                                uint8_t ip_hl, size_t *pkt_len_out,
                                                size_t *icmp_off_out)
{
    uint16_t ip_total_len = ((uint16_t)ip_pkt[16] << 8U) | (uint16_t)ip_pkt[17];
    size_t pkt_len = 14U + (size_t)ip_total_len;
    if (ip_total_len < (uint16_t)ip_hl + SYN_ICMP_HEADER_LEN || pkt_len > len ||
        pkt_len > SYN_ETH_MAX_FRAME_LEN) {
        icmp->errors++;
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t icmp_offset = 14U + (size_t)ip_hl;
    size_t icmp_len = (size_t)ip_total_len - (size_t)ip_hl;
    if (syn_icmp_checksum(&ip_pkt[icmp_offset], icmp_len) != 0U) {
        icmp->errors++;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    *pkt_len_out = pkt_len;
    *icmp_off_out = icmp_offset;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_icmp_process_packet(SYN_ICMP *icmp, const uint8_t *ip_pkt, size_t len,
                                   uint8_t *frame_tx, size_t *tx_len)
{
    if (!icmp || !ip_pkt || len < 34U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (tx_len) {
        *tx_len = 0U;
    }

    /* Verify Ethernet EtherType == IPv4 (0x0800) */
    uint16_t ethertype = ((uint16_t)ip_pkt[12] << 8U) | (uint16_t)ip_pkt[13];
    if (ethertype != SYN_ETHTYPE_IPV4) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    /* IP Header begins at offset 14 */
    const uint8_t *ip_hdr = &ip_pkt[14];
    uint8_t ip_hl = (uint8_t)((ip_hdr[0] & 0x0FU) * 4U);
    if (ip_hl < 20U || (14U + (size_t)ip_hl) > len) {
        icmp->errors++;
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (ip_hdr[9] != 1U) { /* Protocol 1 = ICMP */
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    size_t pkt_len = 0U;
    size_t icmp_offset = 0U;
    SYN_Status st = icmp_validate_bounds_and_csum(icmp, ip_pkt, len, ip_hl, &pkt_len, &icmp_offset);
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }

    uint8_t type = ip_pkt[icmp_offset];
    if (type == SYN_ICMP_TYPE_ECHO_REQUEST) {
        if (!icmp_echo_dst_unicast(ip_pkt)) {
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        icmp->echo_requests_rx++;
        icmp_build_echo_reply(icmp, ip_pkt, pkt_len, icmp_offset, frame_tx, tx_len);
    } else if (type == SYN_ICMP_TYPE_ECHO_REPLY) {
        icmp->echo_replies_rx++;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_icmp_build_echo_request(SYN_ICMP *icmp, SYN_ETH *eth, uint32_t dst_ip,
                                       const uint8_t dst_mac[6], uint16_t id, uint16_t seq,
                                       const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                       uint8_t *frame_out, size_t *frame_len)
{
    if (!icmp || !eth || !dst_mac || !frame_out || !frame_len) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (payload_len > (65535U - 28U) || (!payload && payload_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t icmp_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_ICMP_HEADER_LEN + payload_len);
    size_t total_len = 14U + 20U + (size_t)icmp_len;
    if (total_len < SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN) {
        total_len = SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN;
    }
    if (total_len > SYN_ETH_MAX_FRAME_LEN) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(frame_out, 0, total_len);

    /* Ethernet II Header */
    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Unreachable parameter bounds check */
    if (syn_eth_pack_header(frame_out, total_len, dst_mac, eth->mac_addr, SYN_ETHTYPE_IPV4) == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* IPv4 Header */
    size_t ip_bytes =
        syn_ip_pack_header(&frame_out[14], total_len - 14, eth->ip_addr, dst_ip, 1, icmp_len, id);
    if (ip_bytes == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */

    /* ICMP Header */
    size_t icmp_off = 34;
    frame_out[icmp_off] = SYN_ICMP_TYPE_ECHO_REQUEST;
    frame_out[icmp_off + 1] = 0; /* Code */
    frame_out[icmp_off + 2] = 0;
    frame_out[icmp_off + 3] = 0; /* Checksum placeholder */
    frame_out[icmp_off + 4] = (uint8_t)(id >> 8);
    frame_out[icmp_off + 5] = (uint8_t)(id & 0xFF);
    frame_out[icmp_off + 6] = (uint8_t)(seq >> 8);
    frame_out[icmp_off + 7] = (uint8_t)(seq & 0xFF);

    if (payload && payload_len > 0) {
        memcpy(&frame_out[icmp_off + 8], payload, payload_len);
    }

    uint16_t icmp_csum = syn_icmp_checksum(&frame_out[icmp_off], icmp_len);
    frame_out[icmp_off + 2] = (uint8_t)(icmp_csum >> 8);
    frame_out[icmp_off + 3] = (uint8_t)(icmp_csum & 0xFF);

    icmp->echo_requests_tx++;
    *frame_len = total_len;

    return SYN_OK;
}

#include "syntropic/net/syn_igmp.h"

#include "syntropic/net/syn_icmp.h" /* For syn_icmp_checksum */

#include <string.h>

static void igmp_record_join(SYN_IGMP *igmp, uint32_t group_ip)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_IGMP_MAX_GROUPS; i++) {
        if (igmp->groups[i].joined && igmp->groups[i].group_ip == group_ip) {
            return;
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_IGMP_MAX_GROUPS; i++) {
        if (!igmp->groups[i].joined) {
            igmp->groups[i].group_ip = group_ip;
            igmp->groups[i].joined = true;
            return;
        }
    }
    igmp->groups[0].group_ip = group_ip;
    igmp->groups[0].joined = true;
}

static uint32_t igmp_select_query_group(const SYN_IGMP *igmp, uint32_t query_group)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_IGMP_MAX_GROUPS; i++) {
        if (igmp->groups[i].joined &&
            (query_group == 0U || igmp->groups[i].group_ip == query_group)) {
            return igmp->groups[i].group_ip;
        }
    }
    return 0U;
}

SYN_Status syn_igmp_init(SYN_IGMP *igmp)
{
    if (igmp == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(igmp, 0, sizeof(*igmp));
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_igmp_build_report(SYN_IGMP *igmp, SYN_ETH *eth, uint8_t type, uint32_t group_ip,
                                 uint8_t *frame_out, size_t *frame_len)
{
    if (igmp == NULL || eth == NULL || frame_out == NULL || frame_len == NULL || group_ip == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t ip_len = 20U + 8U; /* IP header (20) + IGMP payload (8) */
    size_t total_len = 14U + ip_len;
    if (total_len < SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN) {
        total_len = SYN_ETH_MIN_FRAME_LEN;
    }

    memset(frame_out, 0, total_len);

    /* RFC 2236 Section 3: Leave is sent to all-routers (224.0.0.2); Report to group_ip */
    uint32_t dst_ip = (type == SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_LEAVE) ? 0xE0000002UL : group_ip;
    uint32_t dst_low = dst_ip & 0x007FFFFFUL;
    uint8_t mcast_mac[6];
    mcast_mac[0] = 0x01U;
    mcast_mac[1] = 0x00U;
    mcast_mac[2] = 0x5EU;
    mcast_mac[3] = (uint8_t)(dst_low >> 16U);
    mcast_mac[4] = (uint8_t)(dst_low >> 8U);
    mcast_mac[5] = (uint8_t)(dst_low);

    /* Ethernet II Header */
    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Unreachable parameter bounds check */
    if (syn_eth_pack_header(frame_out, total_len, mcast_mac, eth->mac_addr, SYN_ETHTYPE_IPV4) ==
        0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* IPv4 Header (Protocol 2 = IGMP, TTL = 1) */
    size_t ip_bytes =
        syn_ip_pack_header(&frame_out[14], total_len - 14U, eth->ip_addr, dst_ip, 2U, 8U, 0x1234U);
    if (ip_bytes == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */
    frame_out[22] = 1U; /* Override TTL = 1 for IGMP multicast */
    frame_out[24] = 0U;
    frame_out[25] = 0U;

    /* Re-calculate IP checksum due to TTL override */
    uint16_t ip_csum = syn_ip_checksum(&frame_out[14], 20U);
    frame_out[24] = (uint8_t)(ip_csum >> 8U);
    frame_out[25] = (uint8_t)(ip_csum & 0xFFU);

    /* IGMP Header */
    size_t igmp_off = 34U;
    frame_out[igmp_off] = type;
    frame_out[igmp_off + 1U] = 0U; /* Max Resp Time */
    frame_out[igmp_off + 2U] = 0U;
    frame_out[igmp_off + 3U] = 0U;

    frame_out[igmp_off + 4U] = (uint8_t)(group_ip >> 24U);
    frame_out[igmp_off + 5U] = (uint8_t)(group_ip >> 16U);
    frame_out[igmp_off + 6U] = (uint8_t)(group_ip >> 8U);
    frame_out[igmp_off + 7U] = (uint8_t)(group_ip);

    uint16_t igmp_csum = syn_ip_checksum(&frame_out[igmp_off], 8U);
    frame_out[igmp_off + 2U] = (uint8_t)(igmp_csum >> 8U);
    frame_out[igmp_off + 3U] = (uint8_t)(igmp_csum & 0xFFU);

    if (type == SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_REPORT) {
        igmp->reports_sent++;
    } else if (type == SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_LEAVE) {
        igmp->leaves_sent++;
    }

    *frame_len = total_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_igmp_join_group(SYN_IGMP *igmp, SYN_ETH *eth, uint32_t group_ip, uint8_t *frame_out,
                               size_t *frame_len)
{
    if (igmp == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_Status status =
        syn_igmp_build_report(igmp, eth, SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_REPORT, group_ip, frame_out, frame_len);
    if (status == SYN_OK) {
        igmp_record_join(igmp, group_ip);
    }
    return status;
}

SYN_Status syn_igmp_leave_group(SYN_IGMP *igmp, SYN_ETH *eth, uint32_t group_ip, uint8_t *frame_out,
                                size_t *frame_len)
{
    if (igmp == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_IGMP_MAX_GROUPS; i++) {
        if (igmp->groups[i].joined && igmp->groups[i].group_ip == group_ip) {
            igmp->groups[i].joined = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    return syn_igmp_build_report(igmp, eth, SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_LEAVE, group_ip, frame_out, frame_len);
}

SYN_Status syn_igmp_process_packet(SYN_IGMP *igmp, SYN_ETH *eth, const uint8_t *ip_pkt, size_t len,
                                   uint8_t *frame_tx, size_t *tx_len)
{
    if (igmp == NULL || ip_pkt == NULL || len < 42U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (tx_len != NULL) {
        *tx_len = 0U;
    }

    /* Verify EtherType == IPv4 */
    uint16_t ethertype = ((uint16_t)ip_pkt[12] << 8U) | ip_pkt[13];
    if (ethertype != SYN_ETHTYPE_IPV4) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    size_t ihl = (size_t)(ip_pkt[14] & 0x0FU) * 4U;
    if (ihl < 20U || (14U + ihl + 8U) > len) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Verify Protocol == 2 (IGMP) */
    uint8_t proto = ip_pkt[23];
    if (proto != 2U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    size_t igmp_off = 14U + ihl;
    uint8_t type = ip_pkt[igmp_off];
    if (type == SYN_IGMP_TYPE_MEMBERSHIP_QUERY) {
        igmp->queries_received++;
        uint32_t query_group =
            ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[igmp_off + 4U] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[igmp_off + 5U] << 16U) |
            ((uint32_t)ip_pkt[igmp_off + 6U] << 8U) | (uint32_t)ip_pkt[igmp_off + 7U];
        uint32_t report_group = igmp_select_query_group(igmp, query_group);
        if (report_group != 0U && frame_tx != NULL && tx_len != NULL) {
            return syn_igmp_build_report(igmp, eth, SYN_IGMP_TYPE_V2_REPORT, report_group, frame_tx,
                                         tx_len);
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Remaining Length & Varint Helpers ──────────────────────────────────── */

size_t syn_mqtt_encode_varint(uint32_t val, uint8_t buf[4])
{
    if (buf == NULL || val > 268435455U) {
        return 0;
    }
    size_t bytes = 0;
    do {
        uint8_t d = (uint8_t)(val % 128U);
        val /= 128U;
        if (val > 0U) {
            d |= 0x80U;
        }
        buf[bytes++] = d;
    } while (val > 0U && bytes < 4U);
    return bytes;
}

bool syn_mqtt_decode_varint(const uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_len, uint32_t *val, size_t *bytes_read)
{
    if (buf == NULL || val == NULL || bytes_read == NULL || buf_len == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t multiplier = 1U;
    uint32_t value = 0U;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    uint8_t encoded_byte = 0U;

    do {
        if (pos >= buf_len || pos >= 4U) {
            return false;
        }
        encoded_byte = buf[pos++];
        value += (uint32_t)(encoded_byte & 0x7FU) * multiplier;
        if ((encoded_byte & 0x80U) != 0U) {
            multiplier *= 128U;
        }
    } while ((encoded_byte & 0x80U) != 0U);

    *val = value;
    *bytes_read = pos;
    return true;
}

size_t syn_mqtt5_encode_user_prop(const char *key, const char *val, uint8_t *buf,
                                  size_t max_buf_len)
{
    if (key == NULL || val == NULL || buf == NULL) {
        return 0U;
    }
    size_t klen = strlen(key);
    size_t vlen = strlen(val);
    if (klen > UINT16_MAX || vlen > UINT16_MAX) {
        return 0U;
    }
    size_t total = 5U + klen + vlen; /* Identifier (1) + Key (2+klen) + Val (2+vlen) */
    if (max_buf_len < total) {
        return 0U;
    }

    size_t pos = 0U;
    buf[pos++] = SYN_MQTT5_PROP_USER_PROPERTY;
    buf[pos++] = (uint8_t)(klen >> 8U);
    buf[pos++] = (uint8_t)(klen & 0xFFU);
    memcpy(&buf[pos], key, klen);
    pos += klen;

    buf[pos++] = (uint8_t)(vlen >> 8U);
    buf[pos++] = (uint8_t)(vlen & 0xFFU);
    memcpy(&buf[pos], val, vlen);
    pos += vlen;

    return pos;
}

static size_t encode_remaining_len(uint8_t *buf, uint32_t len)
{
    return syn_mqtt_encode_varint(len, buf);
}

static void mqtt_reset_session(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if (c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(c->sock);
        c->sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }
    c->state = SYN_MQTT_DISCONNECTED;
    c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;
    c->pending_puback_id = 0U;
    c->retransmit_len = 0U;
    c->ping_pending = false;
    c->ping_sent_ms = 0U;
}

static bool mqtt_send_tracked(SYN_MqttClient *c, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (syn_port_sock_send_all(c->sock, buf, len) != (int)len) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
        return false;
    }
    c->last_activity_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    return true;
}

static void mqtt_put_str(uint8_t *tx, size_t *pos, const char *str, uint16_t len)
{
    syn_poke_u16(len, tx, *pos);
    *pos += 2U;
    if (len > 0U) {
        memcpy(tx + *pos, str, len);
        *pos += len;
    }
}

/* ── Connection Packets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool mqtt_connect_creds_len(const SYN_MqttClient *c, bool *has_user, bool *has_pass,
                                   size_t *u_len, size_t *p_len)
{
    *has_user = (c->username != NULL);
    *has_pass = *has_user && (c->password != NULL);
    *u_len = *has_user ? strlen(c->username) : 0U;
    *p_len = *has_pass ? strlen(c->password) : 0U;
    return (*u_len <= UINT16_MAX) && (*p_len <= UINT16_MAX);
}

static bool send_mqtt_connect(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    size_t cid_len = strlen(c->client_id);
    bool has_user = false;
    bool has_pass = false;
    size_t u_len = 0U;
    size_t p_len = 0U;
    if (cid_len > UINT16_MAX || !mqtt_connect_creds_len(c, &has_user, &has_pass, &u_len, &p_len)) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t rem_len = (uint32_t)(12U + cid_len);
    if (has_user) {
        rem_len += (uint32_t)(2U + u_len);
    }
    if (has_pass) {
        rem_len += (uint32_t)(2U + p_len);
    }

    uint8_t varint_buf[4];
    size_t varint_len = encode_remaining_len(varint_buf, rem_len);
    if (c->tx_buf_size < 1U + varint_len || (size_t)rem_len > c->tx_buf_size - 1U - varint_len) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = c->tx_buf;
    tx[0] = 0x10U; /* CONNECT */
    memcpy(tx + 1U, varint_buf, varint_len);
    size_t pos = 1U + varint_len;

    mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, "MQTT", 4U);
    tx[pos++] = 0x04U; /* Level 3.1.1 */

    uint8_t flags = 0x02U; /* Clean session */
    if (has_user) {
        flags |= 0x80U;
    }
    if (has_pass) {
        flags |= 0x40U;
    }
    tx[pos++] = flags;

    syn_poke_u16(c->keep_alive_s, tx, pos);
    pos += 2U;

    mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, c->client_id, (uint16_t)cid_len);
    if (has_user) {
        mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, c->username, (uint16_t)u_len);
    }
    if (has_pass) {
        mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, c->password, (uint16_t)p_len);
    }

    return syn_port_sock_send_all(c->sock, tx, pos) == (int)pos;
}

static bool send_mqtt_ping(const SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    static const uint8_t ping[] = {0xC0, 0x00};
    return syn_port_sock_send_all(c->sock, ping, 2) == 2;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqtt_ping(SYN_MqttClient *client)
{
    if (client == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (client->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (send_mqtt_ping(client)) {
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        client->last_activity_ms = now;
        client->ping_pending = true;
        client->ping_sent_ms = now;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    return SYN_ERROR;
}

/* ── Main Task ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void handle_publish(SYN_MqttClient *c, const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t len,
                           uint8_t qos_bits)
{
    uint8_t qos = (qos_bits >> 1U) & 0x03U;
    if ((qos == 0U) && ((qos_bits & 0x08U) != 0U)) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
        return;
    }
    if (len < 2U) {
        return;
    }

    uint16_t topic_len = syn_peek_u16(payload, 0U);
    if ((2U + (uint32_t)topic_len) > len) {
        return;
    }

    /* Extract topic string dynamically */
    char topic[64];
    size_t to_copy = (topic_len < (sizeof(topic) - 1U)) ? topic_len : (sizeof(topic) - 1U);
    memcpy(topic, payload + 2U, to_copy);
    topic[to_copy] = '\0';

    size_t payload_offset = 2U + topic_len;
    uint16_t packet_id = 0U;

    if (qos > 0U) {
        if ((payload_offset + 2U) > len) {
            return;
        }
        packet_id = syn_peek_u16(payload, payload_offset);
        payload_offset += 2U;
    }

    if (c->on_message != NULL) {
        c->on_message(topic, payload + payload_offset, len - payload_offset, c->ctx);
    }

    /* QoS 1 ACK (PUBACK) */
    if (qos == 1U) {
        uint8_t puback[4];
        puback[0] = 0x40U;
        puback[1] = 0x02U;
        syn_poke_u16(packet_id, puback, 2U);
        (void)syn_port_sock_send_all(c->sock, puback, 4U);
    }
}

static bool mqtt_connack_valid(const SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if ((c->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTING) || (c->rx_header != 0x20U) || (c->rx_rem_len != 2U)) {
        return false;
    }
    return ((c->rx_buf[0] & 0xFEU) == 0U) && (c->rx_buf[1] == 0U);
}

static void process_packet(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    uint8_t type = c->rx_header & 0xF0U;
    uint32_t rem_len = c->rx_rem_len;

    if (type == 0x20U) {
        if (mqtt_connack_valid(c)) {
            c->state = SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED;
        } else {
            mqtt_reset_session(c);
        }
    } else if (type == 0x30U) {
        handle_publish(c, c->rx_buf, rem_len, c->rx_header & 0x0FU);
    } else if (type == 0x40U) {
        if (rem_len >= 2U) {
            uint16_t pid = syn_peek_u16(c->rx_buf, 0U);
            if (pid == c->pending_puback_id) {
                c->pending_puback_id = 0U;
                c->retransmit_len = 0U;
            }
        }
    } else if (type == 0x90U) {
        /* SUBACK */
    } else if (type == 0xD0U) {
        c->ping_pending = false;
    }
}

static int mqtt_recv_checked(SYN_MqttClient *c, uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(c->sock, buf, len, 0);
    if (n == 0 || (n < 0 && was_readable)) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
        return -1;
    }
    if (n > 0) {
        c->last_activity_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    }
    return n;
}

static bool mqtt_rx_idle(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    uint8_t hdr = 0U;
    if (mqtt_recv_checked(c, &hdr, 1U) <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    c->rx_header = hdr;
    c->rx_rem_len = 0U;
    c->rx_mult = 1U;
    c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_REMAINING_LEN;
    c->rx_deadline = syn_port_get_tick_ms() + MQTT_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS;
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_rx_rem_len(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    uint8_t b = 0U;
    if (mqtt_recv_checked(c, &b, 1U) <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    c->rx_rem_len += (uint32_t)(b & 0x7FU) * c->rx_mult;
    if ((b & 0x80U) != 0U) {
        if (c->rx_mult >= 2097152U) {
            mqtt_reset_session(c);
            return false;
        }
        c->rx_mult *= 128U;
        return true;
    }

    c->rx_pos = 0U;
    if (c->rx_rem_len == 0U) {
        process_packet(c);
        c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;
    } else if (c->rx_rem_len <= c->rx_buf_size) {
        c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_PAYLOAD;
    } else {
        c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_DISCARD;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_rx_payload(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    size_t space = (size_t)c->rx_rem_len - c->rx_pos;
    int n = mqtt_recv_checked(c, c->rx_buf + c->rx_pos, space);
    if (n <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    c->rx_pos += (size_t)n;
    if (c->rx_pos == c->rx_rem_len) {
        process_packet(c);
        c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_rx_discard(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    uint8_t drop_buf[64];
    size_t space = (size_t)c->rx_rem_len - c->rx_pos;
    if (space > sizeof(drop_buf)) {
        space = sizeof(drop_buf);
    }

    int n = mqtt_recv_checked(c, drop_buf, space);
    if (n <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    c->rx_pos += (size_t)n;
    if (c->rx_pos == c->rx_rem_len) {
        c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_rx_step(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE) {
        return mqtt_rx_idle(c);
    }
    if (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_REMAINING_LEN) {
        return mqtt_rx_rem_len(c);
    }
    if (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_PAYLOAD) {
        return mqtt_rx_payload(c);
    }
    return mqtt_rx_discard(c);
}

static bool poll_rx(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if (c->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        return false;
    }

    bool progressed = false;
    for (size_t steps = 0U; (steps < 32U) && (c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID); steps++) {
        if ((c->rx_phase != SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE) &&
            ((int32_t)(syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->rx_deadline) >= 0)) {
            mqtt_reset_session(c);
            return progressed;
        }

        bool was_payload_or_discard =
            (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_PAYLOAD) || (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_DISCARD);
        if (!mqtt_rx_step(c)) {
            break;
        }
        progressed = true;
        if (was_payload_or_discard && (c->rx_phase == SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE)) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return progressed;
}

static uint16_t mqtt_next_packet_id(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    c->next_packet_id++;
    if (c->next_packet_id == 0U) {
        c->next_packet_id = 1U;
    }
    return c->next_packet_id;
}

static void mqtt_store_retransmit(SYN_MqttClient *c, const uint8_t *tx, size_t len)
{
    memcpy(c->retransmit_buf, tx, len);
    c->retransmit_len = len;
}

/* ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_mqtt_init(SYN_MqttClient *client, const char *host, uint16_t port,
                         const char *client_id, const char *username, const char *password,
                         uint16_t keep_alive_s, uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t rx_buf_size,
                         uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t tx_buf_size)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(client != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(host != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(client_id != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(rx_buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(tx_buf != NULL);

    memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
    client->host = host;
    client->port = port;
    client->client_id = client_id;
    client->username = username;
    client->password = password;
    client->keep_alive_s = keep_alive_s;
    client->rx_buf = rx_buf;
    client->rx_buf_size = rx_buf_size;
    client->tx_buf = tx_buf;
    client->tx_buf_size = tx_buf_size;
    client->sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    client->state = SYN_MQTT_DISCONNECTED;
    client->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;

    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(mqtt_tx_msgs);
    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(mqtt_rx_msgs);
    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(mqtt_errors);

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool mqtt_publish_args_ok(const SYN_MqttClient *client, const char *topic,
                                 const void *payload, size_t len, uint8_t qos)
{
    if (client == NULL || topic == NULL || client->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED || qos > 1U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (qos == 1U && client->pending_puback_id != 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    return (len == 0U) || (payload != NULL);
}

SYN_Status syn_mqtt_publish(SYN_MqttClient *client, const char *topic, const void *payload,
                            size_t len, uint8_t qos, bool retain)
{
    if (!mqtt_publish_args_ok(client, topic, payload, len, qos)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t topic_len = strlen(topic);
    size_t hdr_rem = 2U + topic_len + ((qos > 0U) ? 2U : 0U);
    if (topic_len > UINT16_MAX || len > 268435455U - hdr_rem) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint32_t rem_len = (uint32_t)(hdr_rem + len);
    uint8_t varint_buf[4];
    size_t varint_len = encode_remaining_len(varint_buf, rem_len);
    size_t total_len = 1U + varint_len + (size_t)rem_len;
    if (client->tx_buf == NULL || total_len > client->tx_buf_size ||
        (qos > 0U && total_len > sizeof(client->retransmit_buf))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->tx_buf;
    tx[0] = (uint8_t)(0x30U | ((uint32_t)qos << 1U) | (retain ? 0x01U : 0U));
    memcpy(tx + 1U, varint_buf, varint_len);
    size_t pos = 1U + varint_len;

    mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, topic, (uint16_t)topic_len);
    uint16_t pkt_id = 0U;
    if (qos > 0U) {
        pkt_id = mqtt_next_packet_id(client);
        syn_poke_u16(pkt_id, tx, pos);
        pos += 2U;
    }
    if (len > 0U) {
        memcpy(tx + pos, payload, len);
        pos += len;
    }

    if (!mqtt_send_tracked(client, tx, pos)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (qos > 0U) {
        client->pending_puback_id = pkt_id;
        client->pending_puback_ms = client->last_activity_ms;
        mqtt_store_retransmit(client, tx, pos);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqtt_subscribe(SYN_MqttClient *client, const char *topic, uint8_t qos)
{
    if (client == NULL || topic == NULL || client->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (qos > 1U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t topic_len = strlen(topic);
    if (topic_len > UINT16_MAX) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint32_t rem_len = (uint32_t)(5U + topic_len);
    uint8_t varint_buf[4];
    size_t varint_len = encode_remaining_len(varint_buf, rem_len);
    size_t total_len = 1U + varint_len + (size_t)rem_len;
    if (client->tx_buf == NULL || total_len > client->tx_buf_size) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint16_t pkt_id = mqtt_next_packet_id(client);
    uint8_t *tx = client->tx_buf;
    tx[0] = 0x82U; /* SUBSCRIBE */
    memcpy(tx + 1U, varint_buf, varint_len);
    size_t pos = 1U + varint_len;

    syn_poke_u16(pkt_id, tx, pos);
    pos += 2U;
    mqtt_put_str(tx, &pos, topic, (uint16_t)topic_len);
    tx[pos++] = qos;

    return mqtt_send_tracked(client, tx, pos) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
}

void syn_mqtt_disconnect(SYN_MqttClient *client)
{
    if (client == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (client->state == SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED && client->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        static const uint8_t disc[] = {0xE0U, 0x00U};
        (void)syn_port_sock_send_all(client->sock, disc, 2U);
    }
    mqtt_reset_session(client);
}

static bool mqtt_connected_timers_due(const SYN_MqttClient *c, uint32_t now)
{
    if (c->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED) {
        return false;
    }
    if (c->ping_pending && (now - c->ping_sent_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        return true;
    }
    if (c->pending_puback_id != 0U && (now - c->pending_puback_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        return true;
    }
    if (!c->ping_pending && c->keep_alive_s > 0U &&
        (now - c->last_activity_ms) >= (uint32_t)c->keep_alive_s * 1000U) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool mqtt_has_work(const SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if (c->state == SYN_MQTT_DISCONNECTED) {
        return true;
    }
    if (c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock)) {
        return true;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if (c->rx_phase != SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE && (int32_t)(now - c->rx_deadline) >= 0) {
        return true;
    }
    if (c->state == SYN_MQTT_CONNECTING && (now - c->last_activity_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        return true;
    }
    return mqtt_connected_timers_due(c, now);
}

static bool mqtt_try_connect(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    mqtt_reset_session(c);
    c->sock = syn_port_sock_connect_host(c->host, c->port);
    if (c->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        return false;
    }
    c->state = SYN_MQTT_CONNECTING;
    c->rx_phase = SYN_MQTT_RX_IDLE;
    if (!send_mqtt_connect(c)) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
        return false;
    }
    c->last_activity_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_step_keepalive(SYN_MqttClient *c, uint32_t now)
{
    if (c->ping_pending) {
        if ((now - c->ping_sent_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            mqtt_reset_session(c);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (c->keep_alive_s > 0U && (now - c->last_activity_ms) >= (uint32_t)c->keep_alive_s * 1000U) {
        if (!send_mqtt_ping(c)) {
            mqtt_reset_session(c);
            return false;
        }
        c->last_activity_ms = now;
        c->ping_pending = true;
        c->ping_sent_ms = now;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool mqtt_step_active(SYN_MqttClient *c)
{
    if (c->state == SYN_MQTT_CONNECTING &&
        (syn_port_get_tick_ms() - c->last_activity_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
        return false;
    }

    bool progressed = poll_rx(c);
    if (c->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED) {
        return progressed;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if (!mqtt_step_keepalive(c, now)) {
        return false;
    }

    now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if ((c->pending_puback_id != 0U) && (c->retransmit_len > 0U) &&
        ((now - c->pending_puback_ms) >= MQTT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS)) {
        c->retransmit_buf[0] |= 0x08U;
        if (!mqtt_send_tracked(c, c->retransmit_buf, c->retransmit_len)) {
            return false;
        }
        c->pending_puback_ms = c->last_activity_ms;
    }
    return progressed;
}

static bool mqtt_more_rx_ready(const SYN_MqttClient *c, bool progressed)
{
    return progressed && (c->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) && syn_port_sock_readable(c->sock);
}

/* ── Protothread task ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_PT_Status syn_mqtt_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_MqttClient *c = (SYN_MqttClient *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    if (c->state != SYN_MQTT_CONNECTED) {
        mqtt_reset_session(c);
    }

    for (;;) {
        if (c->state == SYN_MQTT_DISCONNECTED) {
            if (!mqtt_try_connect(c)) {
                PT_TASK_DELAY_MS(pt, task, 5000);
                continue;
            }
        }

        bool progressed = mqtt_step_active(c);
        if (c->state == SYN_MQTT_DISCONNECTED) {
            PT_TASK_DELAY_MS(pt, task, 5000);
            continue;
        }

        if (mqtt_more_rx_ready(c, progressed)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
            continue;
        }

        PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, mqtt_has_work(c));
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_MQTT */

#include "syn_netbuf.h"

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_netbuf_pool_init(SYN_NetBufPool *pool, SYN_NetBuf *bufs, uint8_t *raw_mem,
                                size_t buf_count, size_t buf_size)
{
    if (!pool || !bufs || !raw_mem || buf_count == 0U || buf_size == 0U ||
        buf_count > (SIZE_MAX / buf_size)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    memset(pool, 0, sizeof(*pool));
    pool->bufs = bufs;
    pool->raw_mem = raw_mem;
    pool->buf_count = buf_count;
    pool->buf_size = buf_size;
    pool->free_count = buf_count;
    pool->free_list = NULL;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < buf_count; i++) {
        SYN_NetBuf *b = &bufs[i];
        uint8_t *mem = raw_mem + (i * buf_size);
        b->head = mem;
        b->data = mem;
        b->tail = mem;
        b->end = mem + buf_size;
        b->ref_count = 0U;
        b->flags = 0U;
        b->pool = pool;
        b->next_free = pool->free_list;
        pool->free_list = b;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_NetBuf *syn_netbuf_alloc(SYN_NetBufPool *pool, size_t headroom)
{
    if (pool == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (pool->free_list == NULL || pool->free_count == 0U) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return NULL;
    }

    SYN_NetBuf *b = pool->free_list;
    pool->free_list = b->next_free;
    b->next_free = NULL;

    if (headroom > pool->buf_size) {
        headroom = 0U;
    }

    b->data = b->head + headroom;
    b->tail = b->data;
    b->ref_count = 1U;
    b->flags = 0U;
    pool->free_count--;
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    return b;
}

void syn_netbuf_ref(SYN_NetBuf *buf)
{
    if (buf == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (buf->ref_count < UINT16_MAX) {
        buf->ref_count++;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_netbuf_free(SYN_NetBufPool *pool, SYN_NetBuf *buf)
{
    if (buf == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_NetBufPool *owner = (SYN_NetBufPool *)buf->pool;
    if (owner == NULL || (pool != NULL && pool != owner)) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (buf->ref_count > 0U) {
        buf->ref_count--;
        if (buf->ref_count == 0U) {
            buf->data = buf->head;
            buf->tail = buf->head;
            buf->flags = 0U;
            buf->next_free = owner->free_list;
            owner->free_list = buf;
            owner->free_count++;
        }
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

uint8_t *syn_netbuf_push(SYN_NetBuf *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!buf)
        return NULL;
    if ((size_t)(buf->data - buf->head) < len)
        return NULL;

    buf->data -= len;
    return buf->data;
}

uint8_t *syn_netbuf_pull(SYN_NetBuf *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!buf)
        return NULL;
    if ((size_t)(buf->tail - buf->data) < len)
        return NULL;

    buf->data += len;
    return buf->data;
}

uint8_t *syn_netbuf_put(SYN_NetBuf *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!buf)
        return NULL;
    if ((size_t)(buf->end - buf->tail) < len)
        return NULL;

    uint8_t *ret = buf->tail;
    buf->tail += len;
    return ret;
}

size_t syn_netbuf_len(const SYN_NetBuf *buf)
{
    if (!buf || buf->tail < buf->data)
        return 0;
    return (size_t)(buf->tail - buf->data);
}
