#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#ifndef SYN_UDP_MAX_SOCKETS
#define SYN_UDP_MAX_SOCKETS 4 
#endif

#ifndef SYN_UDP_BUF_SIZE
#define SYN_UDP_BUF_SIZE 256 
#endif

#ifndef SYN_UDP_MAX_DGRAMS
#define SYN_UDP_MAX_DGRAMS 8U 
#endif

typedef struct {
    uint16_t src_port; 
    uint16_t dst_port; 
    uint16_t length;   
    uint16_t checksum; 
} SYN_UdpHeader;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t src_ip;   
    uint16_t src_port; 
    uint16_t len;      
} SYN_UdpDatagram;

/* ── UDP Socket Slot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    bool is_bound;        
    uint16_t local_port;  
    uint32_t remote_ip;   
    uint16_t remote_port; 

    uint8_t rx_buf[SYN_UDP_BUF_SIZE];           
    uint16_t rx_len;                            
    uint16_t rx_total_len;                      
    SYN_UdpDatagram dgrams[SYN_UDP_MAX_DGRAMS]; 
    uint8_t dgram_head;                         
    uint8_t dgram_count;                        

    SYN_Task *blocked_task; 
} SYN_UdpSocket;

/* ── UDP Stack Container ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    SYN_ETH *eth;                               
    SYN_UdpSocket sockets[SYN_UDP_MAX_SOCKETS]; 
    uint16_t next_ephemeral_port;               
} SYN_UDP;

/* ── Functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_udp_init(SYN_UDP *udp, SYN_ETH *eth);

SYN_UdpSocket *syn_udp_bind(SYN_UDP *udp, uint16_t local_port);

void syn_udp_unbind(SYN_UdpSocket *sock);

SYN_Status syn_udp_process_packet(SYN_UDP *udp, const uint8_t *ip_packet, size_t len);

int syn_udp_sendto(SYN_UDP *udp, uint16_t src_port, uint32_t dst_ip, uint16_t dst_port,
                   const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t *tx_out, size_t *tx_len);

uint16_t syn_udp_checksum(uint32_t src_ip, uint32_t dst_ip, const uint8_t *udp_seg, size_t len);

SYN_Status syn_udp_recv(SYN_UdpSocket *sock, void *buf, size_t max_len, size_t *bytes_read,
                        uint32_t *src_ip, uint16_t *src_port);

static inline bool syn_udp_pt_args_valid(SYN_PT *pt, const SYN_Task *task,
                                         const SYN_UdpSocket *sock, const void *buf,
                                         const size_t *bytes_read)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || sock == NULL || buf == NULL || bytes_read == NULL) {
        if (pt != NULL) {
            PT_INIT(pt);
        }
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

/* ── Task Blocking Macros ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_UDP_BLOCK_READ(pt, task, sock, buf, max_len, bytes_read, src_ip, src_port)     \
    do {                                                                                  \
        while (1) {                                                                       \
            if (!syn_udp_pt_args_valid((pt), (task), (sock), (buf), (bytes_read))) {      \
                return PT_EXITED;                                                         \
            }                                                                             \
            (sock)->blocked_task = (task);                                                \
            syn_port_enter_critical();                                                    \
            if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {                               \
                (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED;                                \
                SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();                                                   \
            }                                                                             \
            syn_port_exit_critical();                                                     \
            if ((sock)->dgram_count > 0U || (sock)->rx_len > 0U || !(sock)->is_bound) {   \
                syn_port_enter_critical();                                                \
                if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) {                         \
                    (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;                              \
                }                                                                         \
                syn_port_exit_critical();                                                 \
                break;                                                                    \
            }                                                                             \
            PT_PASS(pt);                                                                  \
        }                                                                                 \
        (sock)->blocked_task = NULL;                                                      \
        (void)syn_udp_recv((sock), (buf), (max_len), (bytes_read), (src_ip), (src_port)); \
    } while (0)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SYN_UDP_H */

/* ── SHA-1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint32_t state[5];  
    uint32_t count[2];  
    uint8_t buffer[64]; 
} SYN_SHA1_Ctx;

#define SHA1_ROL(value, bits) (((value) << (bits)) | ((value) >> (32 - (bits))))

static void sha1_init(SYN_SHA1_Ctx *ctx)
{
    ctx->state[0] = 0x67452301;
    ctx->state[1] = 0xEFCDAB89;
    ctx->state[2] = 0x98BADCFE;
    ctx->state[3] = 0x10325476;
    ctx->state[4] = 0xC3D2E1F0;
    ctx->count[0] = ctx->count[1] = 0;
}

static void sha1_transform(uint32_t state[5], const uint8_t buffer[64])
{
    uint32_t w[80];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        w[i] = syn_peek_u32(buffer, i * 4);
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 80; i++) {
        w[i] = SHA1_ROL(w[i - 3] ^ w[i - 8] ^ w[i - 14] ^ w[i - 16], 1);
    }

    uint32_t a = state[0];
    uint32_t b = state[1];
    uint32_t c = state[2];
    uint32_t d = state[3];
    uint32_t e = state[4];

    for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
        uint32_t f, k;
        if (i < 20) {
            f = (b & c) | (~b & d);
            k = 0x5A827999;
        } else if (i < 40) {
            f = b ^ c ^ d;
            k = 0x6ED9EBA1;
        } else if (i < 60) {
            f = (b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d);
            k = 0x8F1BBCDC;
        } else {
            f = b ^ c ^ d;
            k = 0xCA62C1D6;
        }
        uint32_t temp = SHA1_ROL(a, 5) + f + e + k + w[i];
        e = d;
        d = c;
        c = SHA1_ROL(b, 30);
        b = a;
        a = temp;
    }

    state[0] += a;
    state[1] += b;
    state[2] += c;
    state[3] += d;
    state[4] += e;
}

static void sha1_update(SYN_SHA1_Ctx *ctx, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t j = (ctx->count[0] >> 3U) & 63U;
    uint64_t total_bits =
        (((uint64_t)ctx->count[1] << 32U) | (uint64_t)ctx->count[0]) + ((uint64_t)len << 3U);
    ctx->count[0] = (uint32_t)total_bits;
    ctx->count[1] = (uint32_t)(total_bits >> 32U);

    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        ctx->buffer[j++] = data[i];
        if (j == 64U) {
            sha1_transform(ctx->state, ctx->buffer);
            j = 0U;
        }
    }
}

static void sha1_final(SYN_SHA1_Ctx *ctx, uint8_t digest[20])
{
    uint8_t finalcount[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        finalcount[i] = (uint8_t)((ctx->count[(i >= 4 ? 0 : 1)] >> ((3 - (i & 3)) * 8)) & 255);
    }
    uint8_t c = 0200;
    sha1_update(ctx, &c, 1);
    while ((ctx->count[0] >> 3 & 63) != 56) {
        uint8_t z = 0;
        sha1_update(ctx, &z, 1);
    }
    sha1_update(ctx, finalcount, 8);
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        digest[i] = (uint8_t)((ctx->state[i >> 2] >> ((3 - (i & 3)) * 8)) & 255);
    }
}

/* ── Websocket Upgrading ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#include "../util/syn_base64.h"
#include "../util/syn_fmt.h"

static inline bool prefix_icase(const char *str, const char *prefix)
{
    return syn_str_prefix_icase(str, prefix);
}

static const char *ws_find_key_header(const char *headers)
{
    const char *cur = headers;
    while (cur != NULL && *cur != '\0' && *cur != '\r' && *cur != '\n') {
        if (prefix_icase(cur, "sec-websocket-key:")) {
            const char *key_hdr = cur + 18;
            while ((*key_hdr == ' ') || (*key_hdr == '\t')) {
                key_hdr++;
            }
            return key_hdr;
        }
        cur = strchr(cur, '\n');
        if (cur == NULL) {
            break;
        }
        cur++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static bool ws_copy_trimmed_key(const char *key_hdr, char *key_out, size_t key_sz)
{
    size_t raw_len = 0U;
    while ((key_hdr[raw_len] != '\0') && (key_hdr[raw_len] != '\r') && (key_hdr[raw_len] != '\n')) {
        raw_len++;
    }
    while ((raw_len > 0U) && ((key_hdr[raw_len - 1U] == ' ') || (key_hdr[raw_len - 1U] == '\t'))) {
        raw_len--;
    }
    if (raw_len == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (raw_len >= key_sz) {
        raw_len = key_sz - 1U;
    }
    memcpy(key_out, key_hdr, raw_len);
    key_out[raw_len] = '\0';
    return true;
}

SYN_Status syn_websocket_upgrade(
    const SYN_HttpdRequest *req, SYN_HttpdResponse *resp, SYN_WebsocketSession *ws,
    void (*on_message)(const uint8_t *payload, size_t len, uint8_t opcode, void *ctx), void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(req != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(resp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(ws != NULL);

    char key[64];
    const char *key_hdr = ws_find_key_header(req->headers);
    if ((key_hdr == NULL) || !ws_copy_trimmed_key(key_hdr, key, sizeof(key))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (req->body_buffered_len > sizeof(ws->pending_rx) ||
        (req->body_buffered_len > 0U &&
         (resp->buf == NULL ||
          req->body_buffered_offset + req->body_buffered_len > resp->buf_size))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    char accept_buf[128];
    (void)snprintf(accept_buf, sizeof(accept_buf), "%s258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11", key);

    SYN_SHA1_Ctx sha;
    uint8_t digest[20];
    sha1_init(&sha);
    sha1_update(&sha, (const uint8_t *)accept_buf, (uint32_t)strlen(accept_buf));
    sha1_final(&sha, digest);

    char accept_key[32];
    (void)syn_base64_encode(digest, 20U, accept_key, sizeof(accept_key), NULL);

    char resp_buf[160];
    int rlen = snprintf(resp_buf, sizeof(resp_buf),
                        "HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\n"
                        "Upgrade: websocket\r\n"
                        "Connection: Upgrade\r\n"
                        "Sec-WebSocket-Accept: %s\r\n\r\n",
                        accept_key);
    if (syn_port_sock_send_all(resp->sock, resp_buf, (size_t)rlen) != rlen) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    memset(ws, 0, sizeof(*ws));
    ws->sock = resp->sock;
    ws->state = SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED;
    ws->is_server = true;
    ws->on_message = on_message;
    ws->ctx = ctx;
    if (req->body_buffered_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(ws->pending_rx, resp->buf + req->body_buffered_offset, req->body_buffered_len);
        ws->pending_rx_len = (uint16_t)req->body_buffered_len;
    }

    resp->upgraded = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void ws_close_session(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    if (ws->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(ws->sock);
        ws->sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }
    ws->state = SYN_WS_STATE_CLOSED;
    ws->rx_state = 0U;
    ws->payload_len = 0U;
    ws->bytes_read = 0U;
    ws->pending_rx_len = 0U;
    ws->pending_rx_pos = 0U;
}

void syn_websocket_close(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    if (ws != NULL) {
        ws_close_session(ws);
    }
}

static void ws_fail_close(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint16_t status_code)
{
    uint8_t code_be[2];
    syn_poke_u16(status_code, code_be, 0U);
    (void)syn_websocket_send(ws, 0x08U, code_be, sizeof(code_be));
    ws_close_session(ws);
}

SYN_Status syn_websocket_send(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint8_t opcode, const void *data,
                              size_t len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ws != NULL);
    if (ws->state != SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED || ws->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t header[10];
    header[0] = (uint8_t)(0x80U | (opcode & 0x0FU));

    size_t header_len = 2U;
    if (len < 126U) {
        header[1] = (uint8_t)len;
    } else if (len <= 0xFFFFU) {
        header[1] = 126U;
        syn_poke_u16((uint16_t)len, header, 2U);
        header_len = 4U;
    } else {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if ((data == NULL) && (len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (syn_port_sock_send_all(ws->sock, header, header_len) != (int)header_len) {
        ws_close_session(ws);
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (len > 0U) {
        if (syn_port_sock_send_all(ws->sock, data, len) != (int)len) {
            ws_close_session(ws);
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool ws_has_work(const SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    if (ws->state != SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED) {
        return true;
    }
    if (ws->pending_rx_pos < ws->pending_rx_len) {
        return true;
    }
    return (ws->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) && syn_port_sock_readable(ws->sock);
}

static void dispatch_ws_frame(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    size_t act_len = (size_t)ws->payload_len;
    if (ws->opcode == 0x08U) {
        size_t echo_len = (act_len >= 2U) ? 2U : 0U;
        (void)syn_websocket_send(ws, 0x08U, ws->rx_buf, echo_len);
        ws_close_session(ws);
    } else if (ws->opcode == 0x09U) {
        (void)syn_websocket_send(ws, 0x0AU, ws->rx_buf, act_len);
    } else if (((ws->opcode == 0x01U) || (ws->opcode == 0x02U)) && (ws->on_message != NULL)) {
        ws->on_message(ws->rx_buf, act_len, ws->opcode, ws->ctx);
    }
}

static bool ws_header0_valid(uint8_t b0)
{
    if ((b0 & 0xF0U) != 0x80U) {
        return false;
    }
    uint8_t op = b0 & 0x0FU;
    return (op == 0x01U) || (op == 0x02U) || ((op >= 0x08U) && (op <= 0x0AU));
}

static void ws_begin_payload_phase(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    ws->bytes_read = 0U;
    if (ws->masked) {
        ws->rx_state = 2U;
    } else if (ws->payload_len == 0U) {
        dispatch_ws_frame(ws);
        ws->rx_state = 0U;
    } else {
        ws->rx_state = 3U;
    }
}

static void ws_feed_len_byte(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint8_t b)
{
    ws->masked = (b & 0x80U) != 0U;
    uint8_t l = b & 0x7FU;
    if (ws->is_server && !ws->masked) {
        ws_fail_close(ws, 1002U);
    } else if (((ws->opcode & 0x08U) != 0U) && (l >= 126U)) {
        ws_fail_close(ws, 1002U);
    } else if ((ws->opcode == 0x08U) && (l == 1U)) {
        ws_fail_close(ws, 1002U);
    } else if (l < 126U) {
        ws->payload_len = l;
        ws_begin_payload_phase(ws);
    } else if (l == 126U) {
        ws->payload_len = 0U;
        ws->rx_state = 4U;
    } else {
        ws_fail_close(ws, 1009U);
    }
}

static void ws_feed_mask_byte(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint8_t b)
{
    ws->mask_key[ws->bytes_read++] = b;
    if (ws->bytes_read == 4U) {
        ws->bytes_read = 0U;
        if (ws->payload_len == 0U) {
            dispatch_ws_frame(ws);
            ws->rx_state = 0U;
        } else {
            ws->rx_state = 3U;
        }
    }
}

static void ws_feed_payload_byte(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint8_t b)
{
    uint8_t out = ws->masked ? (uint8_t)(b ^ ws->mask_key[ws->bytes_read % 4U]) : b;
    ws->rx_buf[ws->bytes_read++] = out;
    if (ws->bytes_read == ws->payload_len) {
        dispatch_ws_frame(ws);
        ws->rx_state = 0U;
    }
}

static bool ws_feed_byte(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws, uint8_t b)
{
    if (ws->rx_state == 0U) {
        ws->opcode = b & 0x0FU;
        if (!ws_header0_valid(b)) {
            ws_fail_close(ws, 1002U);
        } else {
            ws->rx_state = 1U;
        }
    } else if (ws->rx_state == 1U) {
        ws_feed_len_byte(ws, b);
    } else if (ws->rx_state == 4U) {
        ws->payload_len = (uint32_t)b << 8U;
        ws->rx_state = 5U;
    } else if (ws->rx_state == 5U) {
        ws->payload_len |= b;
        if (ws->payload_len < 126U) {
            ws_fail_close(ws, 1002U);
        } else if (ws->payload_len > sizeof(ws->rx_buf)) {
            ws_fail_close(ws, 1009U);
        } else {
            ws_begin_payload_phase(ws);
        }
    } else if (ws->rx_state == 2U) {
        ws_feed_mask_byte(ws, b);
    } else {
        ws_feed_payload_byte(ws, b);
    }
    return (ws->state == SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED);
}

static bool ws_poll_chunk(SYN_WebsocketSession *ws)
{
    if (ws->pending_rx_pos < ws->pending_rx_len) {
        while (ws->pending_rx_pos < ws->pending_rx_len) {
            uint8_t b = ws->pending_rx[ws->pending_rx_pos++];
            if (!ws_feed_byte(ws, b)) {
                break;
            }
        }
        ws->pending_rx_pos = 0U;
        ws->pending_rx_len = 0U;
        return (ws->state == SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED);
    }

    uint8_t buf[64];
    bool was_readable = syn_port_sock_readable(ws->sock);
    int n = syn_port_sock_recv(ws->sock, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);
    if (n > 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!ws_feed_byte(ws, buf[i])) {
                break;
            }
        }
        return (ws->state == SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED);
    }
    if (n == 0 || (n < 0 && was_readable)) {
        ws_close_session(ws);
    }
    return false;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_websocket_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }
    SYN_WebsocketSession *ws = (SYN_WebsocketSession *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, ws->state == SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED);
        if (ws->sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
            ws_close_session(ws);
            continue;
        }

        bool progressed = ws_poll_chunk(ws);
        if (ws->state != SYN_WS_STATE_CONNECTED) {
            continue;
        }
        if (progressed && ws->sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_sock_readable(ws->sock)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
            continue;
        }
        PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, ws_has_work(ws));
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements the WireGuard protocol per the whitepaper: https://www.wireguard.com/papers/wireguard.pdf

Noise protocol pattern: IKpsk2 Initiator (us) knows responder's static public key. PSK mixed in at handshake step 2.

    WG_ACT_PASS,
    WG_ACT_DELAY
};

docs.title: function syn_wg_init
docs.text:
Initialize the WireGuard client. 

void syn_wg_init (
    SYN_WG * wg,
    const SYN_WgConfig * config,
    SYN_SNTP * sntp,
    uint8_t * rx_buf,
    size_t rx_buf_size,
    uint8_t * tx_buf,
    size_t tx_buf_size
)

Derives the public key from the private key and prepares state. Does NOT open a socket or start a handshake — that happens when the protothread task runs.

Parameters:

  • wg Client context.
  • config Peer configuration (copied).
  • sntp SNTP time source (must be initialized, may not be synced yet).
  • rx_buf Receive buffer (at least SYN_WG_MTU + SYN_WG_TRANSPORT_OVERHEAD).
  • rx_buf_size Receive buffer capacity.
  • tx_buf Transmit buffer (same sizing).
  • tx_buf_size Transmit buffer capacity.

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Construction constants (from WireGuard spec)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static const uint8_t WG_CONSTRUCTION[] =
    "Noise_IKpsk2_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2s"; 
static const uint8_t WG_IDENTIFIER[] =
    "WireGuard v1 zx2c4 Jason@zx2c4.com";                       
static const uint8_t WG_LABEL_MAC1[] = "mac1----";              
static const uint8_t WG_LABEL_COOKIE[] SYN_UNUSED = "cookie--"; 

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Helpers
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static inline void store32_le(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t)(v);
    p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8);
    p[2] = (uint8_t)(v >> 16);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)(v >> 24);
}

static inline uint32_t load32_le(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint32_t)p[0] | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) | ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
}

static inline void store64_le(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v)
{
    store32_le(p, (uint32_t)(v));
    store32_le(p + 4, (uint32_t)(v >> 32));
}

static inline uint64_t load64_le(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint64_t)load32_le(p) | ((uint64_t)load32_le(p + 4) << 32);
}

static inline void store32_be(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t)(v >> 24);
    p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 16);
    p[2] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8);
    p[3] = (uint8_t)(v);
}

static inline void store64_be(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v)
{
    store32_be(p, (uint32_t)(v >> 32));
    store32_be(p + 4, (uint32_t)(v));
}

static void syn_secure_zero(void *v, size_t n)
{
    volatile uint8_t *p = (volatile uint8_t *)v;
    while (n > 0U) {
        *p++ = 0U;
        n--;
    }
}

static bool syn_ct_memeq(const void *a, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    const uint8_t *pa = (const uint8_t *)a;
    const uint8_t *pb = (const uint8_t *)b;
    uint8_t diff = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
        diff |= (uint8_t)(pa[i] ^ pb[i]);
    }
    return diff == 0U;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  HKDF (HMAC-BLAKE2s based, per WireGuard spec)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static void wg_hkdf2(uint8_t out1[32], uint8_t out2[32], const uint8_t ck[32], const uint8_t *input,
                     size_t input_len)
{
    uint8_t prk[32];
    uint8_t tmp[33];

    /* Extract */
    syn_hmac_blake2s(ck, 32U, input, input_len, prk);

    /* Expand: T1 = HMAC(PRK, 0x01) */
    tmp[0] = 0x01U;
    syn_hmac_blake2s(prk, 32U, tmp, 1U, out1);

    /* Expand: T2 = HMAC(PRK, T1 || 0x02) */
    memcpy(tmp, out1, 32U);
    tmp[32] = 0x02U;
    syn_hmac_blake2s(prk, 32U, tmp, 33U, out2);

    syn_secure_zero(prk, sizeof(prk));
    syn_secure_zero(tmp, sizeof(tmp));
}

static void wg_hkdf3_step1(uint8_t prk[32], uint8_t out1[32], const uint8_t ck[32],
                           const uint8_t *input, size_t input_len)
{
    uint8_t one = 0x01U;
    syn_hmac_blake2s(ck, 32U, input, input_len, prk);
    syn_hmac_blake2s(prk, 32U, &one, 1U, out1);
}

static void wg_hkdf3_step2(uint8_t out2[32], uint8_t out3[32], uint8_t prk[32],
                           const uint8_t out1[32])
{
    uint8_t tmp[33];
    memcpy(tmp, out1, 32U);
    tmp[32] = 0x02U;
    syn_hmac_blake2s(prk, 32U, tmp, 33U, out2);
    memcpy(tmp, out2, 32U);
    tmp[32] = 0x03U;
    syn_hmac_blake2s(prk, 32U, tmp, 33U, out3);
    syn_secure_zero(prk, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(tmp, sizeof(tmp));
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Noise handshake helpers
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static void wg_mix_hash(uint8_t h[32], const void *data, size_t len)
{
    SYN_BLAKE2s ctx;
    syn_blake2s_init(&ctx, 32);
    syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, h, 32);
    syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, data, len);
    syn_blake2s_final(&ctx, h);
}

static void wg_mix_key(uint8_t ck[32], uint8_t k[32], const uint8_t *input, size_t len)
{
    wg_hkdf2(ck, k, ck, input, len);
}

static void wg_encrypt_and_hash(uint8_t h[32], const uint8_t k[32], const uint8_t *plain,
                                size_t plain_len, uint8_t *ct, uint8_t tag[16])
{
    uint8_t nonce[12];
    memset(nonce, 0, 12);

    syn_aead_encrypt(k, nonce, h, 32, plain, plain_len, ct, tag);

    /* Mix ciphertext + tag into hash as ONE operation:
     * H = HASH(H || ct || tag)  — NOT two separate calls! */
    {
        SYN_BLAKE2s ctx;
        syn_blake2s_init(&ctx, 32);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, h, 32);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, ct, plain_len);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, tag, 16);
        syn_blake2s_final(&ctx, h);
    }
}

static bool wg_decrypt_and_hash(uint8_t h[32], const uint8_t k[32], const uint8_t *ct,
                                size_t ct_len, const uint8_t tag[16], uint8_t *plain)
{
    uint8_t nonce[12];
    memset(nonce, 0, 12);

    if (!syn_aead_decrypt(k, nonce, h, 32, ct, ct_len, tag, plain)) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Mix ciphertext + tag into hash as ONE operation */
    {
        SYN_BLAKE2s ctx;
        syn_blake2s_init(&ctx, 32);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, h, 32);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, ct, ct_len);
        syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, tag, 16);
        syn_blake2s_final(&ctx, h);
    }

    return true;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  TAI64N timestamp
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static void wg_tai64n(uint8_t out[12], const SYN_SNTP *sntp)
{
    uint32_t epoch_s = syn_sntp_get_epoch_s(sntp);
    uint32_t epoch_ns = syn_sntp_get_epoch_ns(sntp);

    /* TAI64N: 8 bytes seconds (TAI epoch: add 2^62 + leap seconds offset),
     * 4 bytes nanoseconds. For WireGuard, the exact TAI offset doesn't
     * matter — only monotonicity. We use UTC + 2^62. */
    uint64_t tai_s = (uint64_t)epoch_s + 0x4000000000000000ULL;

    store64_be(out, tai_s);
    store32_be(out + 8, epoch_ns);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  MAC1 (for handshake messages)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static void wg_mac1(uint8_t mac[16], const uint8_t peer_pub[32], const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len)
{
    uint8_t key[32];
    SYN_BLAKE2s ctx;

    /* key = HASH("mac1----" || peer_public_key) */
    syn_blake2s_init(&ctx, 32);
    syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, WG_LABEL_MAC1, sizeof(WG_LABEL_MAC1) - 1);
    syn_blake2s_update(&ctx, peer_pub, 32);
    syn_blake2s_final(&ctx, key);

    /* mac1 = MAC(key, msg) — 16-byte keyed BLAKE2s */
    syn_blake2s_mac(key, 32, msg, msg_len, mac, 16);
    syn_secure_zero(key, sizeof(key));
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Handshake: Initiation (we are the initiator)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static uint8_t wg_dh_finish_mix_key(uint8_t ck[32], uint8_t k[32], uint8_t dh[32])
{
    uint8_t valid = syn_x25519_is_nonzero(dh) ? 1U : 0U;
    wg_mix_key(ck, k, dh, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(dh, 32U);
    return valid;
}

static void wg_hs_work_wipe(SYN_WgHsWork *w)
{
    syn_secure_zero(w, sizeof(*w));
}

static void wg_clear_handshake_state(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    wg->hs_valid = false;
    wg->hs_sender_index = 0U;
    syn_secure_zero(wg->hs_ephemeral_priv, sizeof(wg->hs_ephemeral_priv));
    syn_secure_zero(wg->hs_chaining_key, sizeof(wg->hs_chaining_key));
    syn_secure_zero(wg->hs_hash, sizeof(wg->hs_hash));
    wg_hs_work_wipe(&wg->hs_work);
}

static void wg_init_noise_state(uint8_t ck[32], uint8_t h[32], const uint8_t peer_pub[32])
{
    SYN_BLAKE2s tmp;
    syn_blake2s(WG_CONSTRUCTION, sizeof(WG_CONSTRUCTION) - 1U, ck, 32U);
    syn_blake2s_init(&tmp, 32U);
    syn_blake2s_update(&tmp, ck, 32U);
    syn_blake2s_update(&tmp, WG_IDENTIFIER, sizeof(WG_IDENTIFIER) - 1U);
    syn_blake2s_final(&tmp, h);
    wg_mix_hash(h, peer_pub, 32U);
}

static void wg_init_start(SYN_WG *wg, bool is_rekey)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_hs_work_wipe(w);
    PT_INIT(&w->hs_pt);
    w->active = true;
    w->is_resp = false;
    w->is_rekey = is_rekey;
}

static bool wg_init_prepare(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t rnd[36];
    if ((wg->tx_buf_size < SYN_WG_INITIATION_SIZE) ||
        (syn_random_fill(rnd, sizeof(rnd)) != SYN_OK)) {
        return false;
    }
    memcpy(w->eph_priv, rnd, 32U);
    syn_x25519_clamp(w->eph_priv);
    w->expected_idx = load32_le(rnd + 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(rnd, sizeof(rnd));
    return true;
}

static void wg_init_noise_and_eph(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_init_noise_state(w->ck, w->h, wg->config.peer_public_key);
    (void)syn_x25519_pubkey_init(&w->x25519, w->eph_priv);
}

static void wg_init_mix_eph_key(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    wg_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->eph_pub, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
}

static void wg_init_start_dh_es(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_mix_hash(w->h, w->eph_pub, 32U);
    (void)syn_x25519_init(&w->x25519, w->eph_priv, wg->config.peer_public_key);
}

static void wg_init_mix_es(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    w->dh_ok = wg_dh_finish_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->tmp_key);
    memcpy(w->tmp_key, k, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
}

static void wg_init_enc_static(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_encrypt_and_hash(w->h, w->tmp_key, wg->public_key, 32U, w->enc_static, w->enc_static + 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(w->tmp_key, 32U);
    (void)syn_x25519_init(&w->x25519, wg->config.private_key, wg->config.peer_public_key);
}

static void wg_init_mix_ss(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    w->dh_ok &= wg_dh_finish_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->tmp_key);
    memcpy(w->tmp_key, k, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
}

static void wg_init_enc_ts(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t timestamp[12];
    wg_tai64n(timestamp, wg->sntp);
    wg_encrypt_and_hash(w->h, w->tmp_key, timestamp, 12U, w->enc_ts, w->enc_ts + 12U);
    syn_secure_zero(w->tmp_key, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp));
}

static bool wg_init_mac_and_send(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t *msg = wg->tx_buf;
    uint32_t init_sender_idx = w->expected_idx;

    store32_le(msg + 0U, SYN_WG_MSG_INITIATION);
    store32_le(msg + 4U, init_sender_idx);
    memcpy(msg + 8U, w->eph_pub, 32U);
    memcpy(msg + 40U, w->enc_static, 48U);
    memcpy(msg + 88U, w->enc_ts, 28U);
    wg_mac1(msg + 116U, wg->config.peer_public_key, msg, 116U);
    memset(msg + 132U, 0, 16U);

    int sent = -1;
    if (w->dh_ok != 0U) {
        sent = syn_port_udp_sendto(wg->udp_sock, msg, SYN_WG_INITIATION_SIZE, &wg->config.endpoint);
    }
    bool sent_ok = (sent >= 0) && ((size_t)sent == SYN_WG_INITIATION_SIZE);
    if (sent_ok) {
        memcpy(wg->hs_ephemeral_priv, w->eph_priv, 32U);
        memcpy(wg->hs_chaining_key, w->ck, 32U);
        memcpy(wg->hs_hash, w->h, 32U);
        wg->hs_sender_index = init_sender_idx;
        wg->hs_valid = true;
        if (wg->state != SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) {
            wg->session.sender_index = init_sender_idx;
        }
        wg->last_sent_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        wg->last_handshake_ms = wg->last_sent_ms;
    } else {
        syn_secure_zero(msg, SYN_WG_INITIATION_SIZE);
    }
    return sent_ok;
}

static SYN_PT_Status wg_send_initiation_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    if (!wg_init_prepare(wg)) {
        wg_hs_work_wipe(w);
        w->ok = false;
        PT_EXIT(pt);
    }
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_noise_and_eph(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &w->crypto_pt, syn_x25519_pt(&w->crypto_pt, &w->x25519, w->eph_pub));
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_mix_eph_key(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_start_dh_es(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &w->crypto_pt, syn_x25519_pt(&w->crypto_pt, &w->x25519, w->tmp_key));
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_mix_es(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_enc_static(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &w->crypto_pt, syn_x25519_pt(&w->crypto_pt, &w->x25519, w->tmp_key));
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_mix_ss(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_init_enc_ts(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    {
        bool rekey = w->is_rekey;
        bool sent_ok = wg_init_mac_and_send(wg);
        wg_hs_work_wipe(w);
        if (!sent_ok) {
            w->ok = false;
            PT_EXIT(pt);
        }
        if (!rekey) {
            wg->state = SYN_WG_HANDSHAKE_INIT;
        }
        w->ok = true;
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Handshake: Consume Response
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static void wg_send_keepalive(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    /* A keepalive is just a transport message with zero-length payload */
    (void)syn_wg_send(wg, NULL, 0U);
}

static bool wg_verify_response_mac1(const SYN_WG *wg, const uint8_t *msg)
{
    uint8_t expected_mac[16];
    wg_mac1(expected_mac, wg->public_key, msg, 60U);
    bool ok = syn_ct_memeq(expected_mac, msg + 60U, 16U);
    syn_secure_zero(expected_mac, sizeof(expected_mac));
    return ok;
}

static bool wg_resp_start(SYN_WG *wg, const uint8_t *msg, size_t len)
{
    if ((len != SYN_WG_RESPONSE_SIZE) || (load32_le(msg) != SYN_WG_MSG_RESPONSE) || !wg->hs_valid ||
        wg->hs_work.active) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((load32_le(msg + 8U) != wg->hs_sender_index) || !wg_verify_response_mac1(wg, msg)) {
        return false;
    }

    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_hs_work_wipe(w);
    memcpy(w->h, wg->hs_hash, 32U);
    memcpy(w->ck, wg->hs_chaining_key, 32U);
    memcpy(w->eph_pub, msg + 12U, 32U);
    memcpy(w->enc_static, msg + 44U, 16U);
    w->expected_idx = wg->hs_sender_index;
    w->peer_idx = load32_le(msg + 4U);

    PT_INIT(&w->hs_pt);
    w->active = true;
    w->is_resp = true;
    return true;
}

static void wg_resp_mix_eph_key(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    wg_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->eph_pub, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
}

static void wg_resp_start_dh_ee(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_mix_hash(w->h, w->eph_pub, 32U);
    (void)syn_x25519_init(&w->x25519, wg->hs_ephemeral_priv, w->eph_pub);
}

static void wg_resp_after_dh_ee(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    w->dh_ok = wg_dh_finish_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->tmp_key);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
    (void)syn_x25519_init(&w->x25519, wg->config.private_key, w->eph_pub);
}

static void wg_resp_mix_se(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t k[32];
    w->dh_ok &= wg_dh_finish_mix_key(w->ck, k, w->tmp_key);
    syn_secure_zero(k, sizeof(k));
}

static void wg_resp_psk_step1(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_hkdf3_step1(w->eph_pub, w->ck, w->ck, wg->config.preshared_key, 32U);
}

static void wg_resp_psk_step2(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    uint8_t tau[32];
    wg_hkdf3_step2(tau, w->tmp_key, w->eph_pub, w->ck);
    wg_mix_hash(w->h, tau, 32U);
    syn_secure_zero(tau, sizeof(tau));
}

static bool wg_resp_verify_tag(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    bool ok =
        (w->dh_ok != 0U) && wg_decrypt_and_hash(w->h, w->tmp_key, NULL, 0U, w->enc_static, NULL);
    if (!ok) {
        wg_hs_work_wipe(w);
    }
    return ok;
}

static void wg_resp_derive_keys(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg_hkdf2(w->eph_priv, w->tmp_key, w->ck, (const uint8_t *)"", 0U);
}

static void wg_resp_commit_session(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    wg->session.sender_index = w->expected_idx;
    wg->session.receiver_index = w->peer_idx;
    memcpy(wg->session.send_key, w->eph_priv, 32U);
    memcpy(wg->session.recv_key, w->tmp_key, 32U);
    wg->session.send_counter = 0U;
    wg->session.recv_counter = 0U;
    wg->session.recv_bitmap = 0U;
    wg->session.established_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    wg->last_recv_ms = wg->session.established_ms;
    wg->rekey_in_progress = false;
    wg->state = SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED;
    SYN_METRIC_INC(wg_handshakes);
    wg_clear_handshake_state(wg);
    wg_send_keepalive(wg);
}

static SYN_PT_Status wg_consume_response_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    wg_resp_mix_eph_key(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_start_dh_ee(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &w->crypto_pt, syn_x25519_pt(&w->crypto_pt, &w->x25519, w->tmp_key));
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_after_dh_ee(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    PT_SPAWN(pt, &w->crypto_pt, syn_x25519_pt(&w->crypto_pt, &w->x25519, w->tmp_key));
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_mix_se(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_psk_step1(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_psk_step2(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    if ((w->dh_ok == 0U) || !wg_resp_verify_tag(wg)) {
        w->ok = false;
        PT_EXIT(pt);
    }
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_derive_keys(wg);
    PT_CONTINUE(pt);

    wg_resp_commit_session(wg);
    w->ok = true;

    PT_END(pt);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Transport: Encrypt + Send
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

SYN_Status syn_wg_send(SYN_WG *wg, const uint8_t *ip_packet, size_t len)
{
    if ((wg == NULL) || ((ip_packet == NULL) && (len > 0U)) || (len > SYN_WG_MTU)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if ((wg->state != SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) ||
        (wg->session.send_counter >= SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_MESSAGES) ||
        ((now - wg->session.established_ms) > ((uint32_t)SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_TIME * 1000U))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if ((wg->tx_buf_size < SYN_WG_TRANSPORT_OVERHEAD) ||
        (len > (wg->tx_buf_size - SYN_WG_TRANSPORT_OVERHEAD))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    size_t total = len + SYN_WG_TRANSPORT_OVERHEAD;

    uint8_t *msg = wg->tx_buf;
    uint8_t nonce[12];

    /* Header: type(4) + receiver_index(4) + counter(8) */
    store32_le(msg, SYN_WG_MSG_TRANSPORT);
    store32_le(msg + 4U, wg->session.receiver_index);
    store64_le(msg + 8U, wg->session.send_counter);

    /* Nonce: 4 zero bytes + 8-byte little-endian counter */
    memset(nonce, 0, 4U);
    store64_le(nonce + 4U, wg->session.send_counter);

    /* Encrypt payload */
    syn_aead_encrypt(wg->session.send_key, nonce, NULL, 0U, ip_packet, len, msg + 16U,
                     msg + 16U + len);

    wg->session.send_counter++;

    int sent = syn_port_udp_sendto(wg->udp_sock, msg, total, &wg->config.endpoint);
    if ((sent < 0) || ((size_t)sent != total)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    wg->tx_bytes += (uint64_t)len;
    SYN_METRIC_ADD(wg_tx_bytes, len);
    wg->last_sent_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Transport: Receive + Decrypt
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static bool wg_replay_test(const SYN_WgSession *s, uint64_t counter)
{
    if (counter >= SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_MESSAGES) {
        return false;
    }
    if (counter > s->recv_counter) {
        return true;
    }

    uint64_t diff = s->recv_counter - counter;
    if (diff >= 64U) {
        return false; /* Too old */
    }

    uint64_t bit = 1ULL << (uint32_t)diff;
    if ((s->recv_bitmap & bit) != 0ULL) {
        return false; /* Already seen */
    }

    return true;
}

static void wg_replay_commit(SYN_WgSession *s, uint64_t counter)
{
    if (counter > s->recv_counter) {
        uint64_t diff = counter - s->recv_counter;
        if (diff < 64U) {
            s->recv_bitmap <<= (uint32_t)diff;
            s->recv_bitmap |= 1ULL;
        } else {
            s->recv_bitmap = 1ULL;
        }
        s->recv_counter = counter;
        return;
    }

    uint64_t diff = s->recv_counter - counter;
    if (diff < 64U) {
        s->recv_bitmap |= (1ULL << (uint32_t)diff);
    }
}

static size_t wg_unpad_ip_len(const uint8_t *plain, size_t ct_len)
{
    if (ct_len >= 20U && (plain[0] >> 4U) == 4U) {
        size_t ihl_bytes = (size_t)(plain[0] & 0x0FU) * 4U;
        size_t ip4_len = ((size_t)plain[2] << 8U) | (size_t)plain[3];
        if (ihl_bytes >= 20U && ip4_len >= ihl_bytes && ip4_len <= ct_len) {
            return ip4_len;
        }
    } else if (ct_len >= 40U && (plain[0] >> 4U) == 6U) {
        size_t ip6_len = 40U + (((size_t)plain[4] << 8U) | (size_t)plain[5]);
        if (ip6_len <= ct_len) {
            return ip6_len;
        }
    }
    return ct_len;
}

static bool wg_handle_transport(SYN_WG *wg, const uint8_t *msg, size_t len)
{
    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if ((len < 32U) ||
        ((now - wg->session.established_ms) > ((uint32_t)SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_TIME * 1000U))) {
        return false; /* Minimum: 16 header + 16 tag (empty), within session lifetime */
    }

    /* Verify receiver index */
    uint32_t receiver = load32_le(msg + 4U);
    if (receiver != wg->session.sender_index) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Extract counter */
    uint64_t counter = load64_le(msg + 8U);

    /* Anti-replay pre-check (non-mutating) */
    if (!wg_replay_test(&wg->session, counter)) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Build nonce */
    uint8_t nonce[12];
    memset(nonce, 0, 4U);
    store64_le(nonce + 4U, counter);

    /* Decrypt: payload starts at offset 16, tag is last 16 bytes */
    size_t ct_len = len - 32U; /* Subtract header(16) + tag(16) */
    const uint8_t *ct = msg + 16U;
    const uint8_t *tag = msg + 16U + ct_len;

    uint8_t *plain = wg->rx_buf; /* Reuse rx_buf for decrypted output */
    if (ct_len > wg->rx_buf_size) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!syn_aead_decrypt(wg->session.recv_key, nonce, NULL, 0U, ct, ct_len, tag, plain)) {
        SYN_METRIC_INC(wg_errors);
        return false;
    }

    size_t pkt_len = wg_unpad_ip_len(plain, ct_len);

    /* Only commit anti-replay counter after AEAD authentication succeeds */
    wg_replay_commit(&wg->session, counter);
    wg->rx_bytes += (uint64_t)pkt_len;
    SYN_METRIC_ADD(wg_rx_bytes, pkt_len);

    wg->last_recv_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();

    /* Deliver to user (pkt_len == 0 means keepalive — no callback) */
    if ((pkt_len > 0U) && (wg->on_recv != NULL)) {
        wg->on_recv(plain, pkt_len, wg->user_ctx);
    }

    return true;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Public API
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

void syn_wg_init(SYN_WG *wg, const SYN_WgConfig *config, SYN_SNTP *sntp, uint8_t *rx_buf,
                 size_t rx_buf_size, uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t tx_buf_size)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(wg != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(config != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(sntp != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(rx_buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(tx_buf != NULL);

    memset(wg, 0, sizeof(*wg));
    wg->config = *config;
    wg->sntp = sntp;
    wg->state = SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED;
    wg->udp_sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    wg->rx_buf = rx_buf;
    wg->rx_buf_size = rx_buf_size;
    wg->tx_buf = tx_buf;
    wg->tx_buf_size = tx_buf_size;

    /* Derive our public key */
    syn_x25519_pubkey(wg->public_key, wg->config.private_key);

    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(wg_handshakes);
    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(wg_tx_bytes);
    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(wg_rx_bytes);
    SYN_METRIC_REGISTER(wg_errors);
}

static bool wg_socket_readable(const SYN_WG *wg)
{
    return wg->udp_sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID && syn_port_udp_readable(wg->udp_sock);
}

static bool wg_handshake_timed_out(const SYN_WG *wg)
{
    return wg->state == SYN_WG_HANDSHAKE_INIT && (syn_port_get_tick_ms() - wg->last_handshake_ms) >
                                                     (uint32_t)SYN_WG_REKEY_TIMEOUT * 1000U;
}

static bool wg_rekey_due(const SYN_WG *wg, uint32_t now)
{
    uint32_t rekey_ms = (uint32_t)SYN_WG_REKEY_AFTER_TIME * 1000U;
    bool time_due = (now - wg->session.established_ms) > rekey_ms;
    bool msg_due = wg->session.send_counter >= SYN_WG_REKEY_AFTER_MESSAGES;
    if (!time_due && !msg_due) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!wg->rekey_in_progress) {
        return true;
    }
    return (now - wg->last_handshake_ms) > ((uint32_t)SYN_WG_REKEY_TIMEOUT * 1000U);
}

static bool wg_has_work(const SYN_WG *wg)
{
    if (wg == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    if (wg->hs_work.active || (wg->state == SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED) || wg_socket_readable(wg) ||
        wg_handshake_timed_out(wg)) {
        return true;
    }

    if (wg->state == SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) {
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (((now - wg->session.established_ms) > ((uint32_t)SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_TIME * 1000U)) ||
            wg_rekey_due(wg, now)) {
            return true;
        }
        if ((wg->config.keepalive_interval_s > 0U) &&
            ((now - wg->last_sent_ms) > ((uint32_t)wg->config.keepalive_interval_s * 1000U))) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool wg_task_valid(const SYN_PT *pt, const SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    const SYN_WG *wg = (const SYN_WG *)task->user_data;
    return wg->sntp != NULL;
}

static SYN_PT_Status wg_step_active_hs(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_WgHsWork *w = &wg->hs_work;
    SYN_PT_Status st;
    if (w->is_resp) {
        st = wg_consume_response_pt(&w->hs_pt, wg);
    } else {
        st = wg_send_initiation_pt(&w->hs_pt, wg);
    }
    if (st >= PT_EXITED) {
        w->active = false;
    }
    return st;
}

static bool wg_step_hs_or_init(SYN_WG *wg, bool *need_delay)
{
    *need_delay = false;
    if (!wg->hs_work.active) {
        if (wg->state != SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED) {
            return false;
        }
        wg_init_start(wg, false);
    }

    bool was_init_disc = (!wg->hs_work.is_resp) && (!wg->hs_work.is_rekey);
    SYN_PT_Status st = wg_step_active_hs(wg);
    if ((st >= PT_EXITED) && was_init_disc && !wg->hs_work.ok) {
        *need_delay = true;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool wg_step_established_timers(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    if (wg->state != SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if ((now - wg->session.established_ms) > ((uint32_t)SYN_WG_REJECT_AFTER_TIME * 1000U)) {
        syn_secure_zero(&wg->session, sizeof(wg->session));
        wg->rekey_in_progress = false;
        wg_clear_handshake_state(wg);
        wg->state = SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED;
        return true;
    }

    if (wg_rekey_due(wg, now)) {
        wg->last_handshake_ms = now;
        wg->rekey_in_progress = true;
        wg_init_start(wg, true);
        (void)wg_step_active_hs(wg);
        wg->rx_turn = 1U;
        return wg->hs_work.active;
    }

    if ((wg->config.keepalive_interval_s > 0U) &&
        ((now - wg->last_sent_ms) > ((uint32_t)wg->config.keepalive_interval_s * 1000U))) {
        wg_send_keepalive(wg);
    }
    return false;
}

static void wg_process_datagram(SYN_WG *wg, size_t len)
{
    uint32_t msg_type = (len >= 4U) ? load32_le(wg->rx_buf) : 0U;
    bool hs_waiting = (wg->state == SYN_WG_HANDSHAKE_INIT) ||
                      ((wg->state == SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) && wg->rekey_in_progress);
    bool accepting_resp = (!wg->hs_work.active) && wg->hs_valid && hs_waiting;

    if ((msg_type == SYN_WG_MSG_RESPONSE) && accepting_resp) {
        (void)wg_resp_start(wg, wg->rx_buf, len);
    } else if ((msg_type == SYN_WG_MSG_TRANSPORT) && (wg->state == SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED)) {
        (void)wg_handle_transport(wg, wg->rx_buf, len);
    }
}

typedef enum {
    WG_ACT_WAIT = 0, 
    WG_ACT_MORE,     
    WG_ACT_PASS,     
    WG_ACT_DELAY     
} WG_StepAct;

static bool wg_rekey_rx_due(const SYN_WG *wg)
{
    return (wg->state == SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED) && wg->hs_work.active && (wg->rx_turn != 0U) &&
           wg_socket_readable(wg);
}

static WG_StepAct wg_step_recv(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    SYN_SockAddr from;
    int n = syn_port_udp_recvfrom(wg->udp_sock, wg->rx_buf, wg->rx_buf_size, &from, 0U);
    if (n > 0) {
        wg_process_datagram(wg, (size_t)n);
        if (wg->hs_work.active || wg_socket_readable(wg)) {
            return WG_ACT_MORE;
        }
        return WG_ACT_WAIT;
    }
    if (wg_socket_readable(wg)) {
        return WG_ACT_PASS;
    }
    return WG_ACT_WAIT;
}

static WG_StepAct wg_task_step_once(SYN_WG *wg, uint32_t *delay_ms)
{
    *delay_ms = 0U;
    if (wg->udp_sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        wg->udp_sock = syn_port_udp_open(0U);
        if (wg->udp_sock == SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
            *delay_ms = 5000U;
            return WG_ACT_DELAY;
        }
    }

    if (wg_rekey_rx_due(wg)) {
        wg->rx_turn = 0U;
        return wg_step_recv(wg);
    }

    bool need_delay = false;
    if (wg_step_hs_or_init(wg, &need_delay)) {
        wg->rx_turn = 1U;
        if (need_delay) {
            *delay_ms = 5000U;
            return WG_ACT_DELAY;
        }
        if (wg->hs_work.active || wg_socket_readable(wg)) {
            return WG_ACT_MORE;
        }
        return WG_ACT_WAIT;
    }

    if (wg_handshake_timed_out(wg)) {
        wg_clear_handshake_state(wg);
        wg->state = SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED;
        *delay_ms = 500U;
        return WG_ACT_DELAY;
    }

    if (wg_step_established_timers(wg)) {
        return WG_ACT_MORE;
    }

    return wg_step_recv(wg);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *  Protothread task
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

SYN_PT_Status syn_wg_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (!wg_task_valid(pt, task)) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }
    SYN_WG *wg = (SYN_WG *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    /* ── Wait for NTP sync ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, syn_sntp_is_synced(wg->sntp));

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t delay_ms = 0U;
        WG_StepAct act = wg_task_step_once(wg, &delay_ms);
        if (act == WG_ACT_DELAY) {
            PT_TASK_DELAY_MS(pt, task, delay_ms);
        } else if (act == WG_ACT_MORE) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
        } else if (act == WG_ACT_PASS) {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        } else {
            PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, wg_has_work(wg));
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

void syn_wg_disconnect(SYN_WG *wg)
{
    if (wg == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (wg->udp_sock != SYN_SOCKET_INVALID) {
        syn_port_sock_close(wg->udp_sock);
        wg->udp_sock = SYN_SOCKET_INVALID;
    }

    wg->state = SYN_WG_DISCONNECTED;
    wg->rekey_in_progress = false;
    wg->rx_turn = 0U;
    wg->tx_bytes = 0U;
    wg->rx_bytes = 0U;
    syn_secure_zero(&wg->session, sizeof(wg->session));
    wg_clear_handshake_state(wg);
}

SYN_Status syn_wg_get_stats(const SYN_WG *wg, SYN_WgStats *stats)
{
    if ((wg == NULL) || (stats == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(stats, 0, sizeof(*stats));
    stats->is_established = (wg->state == SYN_WG_ESTABLISHED);

    if (stats->is_established) {
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        stats->handshake_age_sec = (now - wg->session.established_ms) / 1000U;
        stats->tx_bytes = wg->tx_bytes;
        stats->rx_bytes = wg->rx_bytes;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_WG */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements a WireGuard client as a cooperative protothread task. Handles the Noise_IKpsk2 handshake, ChaCha20-Poly1305 transport encryption, keepalive timers, and rekeying.

The client connects to a single WireGuard peer (server) over UDP. Decrypted IP packets are delivered to user code via a callback. User code sends packets into the tunnel via syn_wg_send().

No TUN device, no host routing — all traffic is handled in userspace. The host OS only sees a single UDP socket.

Requires: BLAKE2S, CHACHA20POLY1305, X25519, SNTP.

** **

static SYN_WG wg;
static uint8_t rx[1500], tx[1500];

SYN_WgConfig cfg = {
    .endpoint = { .ip = {1,2,3,4}, .port = 51820 },
    .keepalive_interval_s = 25,
};
memcpy(cfg.private_key, my_key, 32);
memcpy(cfg.peer_public_key, server_key, 32);

syn_wg_init(&wg, &cfg, &sntp, rx, sizeof(rx), tx, sizeof(tx));
wg.on_recv = my_handler;

syn_task_create(&tasks[1], "wg", syn_wg_task, SYN_PRIO_HIGH, &wg);

static void set_buzzer_state(SYN_Buzzer *buz, bool state)
{
    if (buz == NULL)
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Unreachable static helper guard; buz is verified non-NULL by
                   caller */
    bool pin_val = buz->active_high ? state : !state;
    syn_port_gpio_write(buz->pin, pin_val ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW);
}

SYN_Status syn_buzzer_init(SYN_Buzzer *buz, SYN_GPIO_Pin pin, bool active_high)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(buz != NULL);

    if (buz ==
        NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    memset(buz, 0, sizeof(*buz));
    buz->pin = pin;
    buz->active_high = active_high;

    syn_port_gpio_init(pin, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);
    set_buzzer_state(buz, false);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_buzzer_beep(SYN_Buzzer *buz, uint32_t freq_hz, uint32_t duration_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(buz != NULL);
    if (buz ==
        NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    buz->pattern_freqs = NULL;
    buz->pattern_durs = NULL;
    buz->pattern_count = 0;
    buz->pattern_index = 0;

    buz->freq_hz = freq_hz;
    buz->duration_ms = duration_ms;
    buz->elapsed_ms = 0;
    buz->is_playing = (duration_ms > 0);

    if (buz->is_playing && freq_hz > 0) {
        set_buzzer_state(buz, true);
    } else {
        set_buzzer_state(buz, false);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_buzzer_play_pattern(SYN_Buzzer *buz, const uint16_t *freqs, const uint16_t *durs,
                                   size_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(buz != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(freqs != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(durs != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(count > 0);

    if (buz == NULL || freqs == NULL || durs == NULL ||
        count ==
            0) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    buz->pattern_freqs = freqs;
    buz->pattern_durs = durs;
    buz->pattern_count = count;
    buz->pattern_index = 0;

    buz->freq_hz = freqs[0];
    buz->duration_ms = durs[0];
    buz->elapsed_ms = 0;
    buz->is_playing = (buz->duration_ms > 0);

    if (buz->is_playing && buz->freq_hz > 0) {
        set_buzzer_state(buz, true);
    } else {
        set_buzzer_state(buz, false);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_buzzer_stop(SYN_Buzzer *buz)
{
    if (buz == NULL)
        return;

    buz->is_playing = false;
    buz->pattern_count = 0;
    buz->pattern_index = 0;
    set_buzzer_state(buz, false);
}

void syn_buzzer_step(SYN_Buzzer *buz, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (buz == NULL || !buz->is_playing)
        return;

    buz->elapsed_ms += dt_ms;

    if (buz->elapsed_ms >= buz->duration_ms) {
        /* Check if playing a multi-note pattern */
        if (buz->pattern_count > 0) {
            buz->pattern_index++;
            if (buz->pattern_index < buz->pattern_count) {
                buz->freq_hz = buz->pattern_freqs[buz->pattern_index];
                buz->duration_ms = buz->pattern_durs[buz->pattern_index];
                buz->elapsed_ms = 0;

                if (buz->freq_hz > 0) {
                    set_buzzer_state(buz, true);
                } else {
                    set_buzzer_state(buz, false);
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        /* Pattern complete or single beep finished */
        syn_buzzer_stop(buz);
    }
}

bool syn_buzzer_is_playing(const SYN_Buzzer *buz)
{
    return buz != NULL && buz->is_playing;
}

#include "syntropic/output/syn_dshot.h"

uint8_t syn_dshot_calc_crc(uint16_t payload_12bit)
{
    /* DShot CRC = (payload ^ (payload >> 4) ^ (payload >> 8)) & 0x0F */
    uint32_t val = (uint32_t)payload_12bit;
    uint32_t crc = (val ^ (val >> 4U) ^ (val >> 8U)) & 0x0FU;
    return (uint8_t)crc;
}

SYN_Status syn_dshot_encode(uint16_t throttle, bool telemetry, SYN_DShot_Packet *packet)
{
    if (!packet) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (throttle > 2047U) {
        throttle = 2047U;
    }

    uint16_t payload_12bit = (uint16_t)((throttle << 1U) | (telemetry ? 1U : 0U));
    uint8_t crc = syn_dshot_calc_crc(payload_12bit);
    uint16_t raw_frame = (uint16_t)((payload_12bit << 4U) | crc);

    packet->throttle = throttle;
    packet->telemetry = telemetry;
    packet->crc = crc;
    packet->raw_frame = raw_frame;

    return SYN_OK;
}

uint16_t syn_dshot_us_to_throttle(uint16_t us)
{
    if (us <= 1048U) {
        return 0U; /* Disarmed / Stop */
    }
    if (us >= 2000U) {
        return 2047U; /* Full Throttle */
    }

    /*
     * Linear mapping:
     * us range: [1048, 2000] -> span = 952
     * throttle range: [48, 2047] -> span = 1999
     * throttle = 48 + ((us - 1048) * 1999) / 952
     */
    uint32_t val = (uint32_t)(us - 1048U);
    uint32_t throttle = 48U + ((val * 1999U) / 952U);
    return (uint16_t)throttle;
}

#include "syntropic/output/syn_dshot_telemetry.h"

#include "syntropic/output/syn_dshot.h"

static const int8_t gcr_to_nibble[32] = {-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 9,  10,
                                         11, -1, 13, 14, 15, -1, -1, 2,  3,  -1, 5,
                                         6,  7,  -1, 0,  8,  1,  -1, 4,  12, -1};

SYN_Status syn_dshot_decode_gcr_20bit(uint32_t gcr_20bit, uint16_t *payload_out)
{
    if (!payload_out) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t gcr0 = (uint8_t)((gcr_20bit >> 15U) & 0x1FU);
    uint8_t gcr1 = (uint8_t)((gcr_20bit >> 10U) & 0x1FU);
    uint8_t gcr2 = (uint8_t)((gcr_20bit >> 5U) & 0x1FU);
    uint8_t gcr3 = (uint8_t)(gcr_20bit & 0x1FU);

    int8_t n0 = gcr_to_nibble[gcr0];
    int8_t n1 = gcr_to_nibble[gcr1];
    int8_t n2 = gcr_to_nibble[gcr2];
    int8_t n3 = gcr_to_nibble[gcr3];

    if (n0 < 0 || n1 < 0 || n2 < 0 || n3 < 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    *payload_out =
        (uint16_t)(((uint8_t)n0 << 12U) | ((uint8_t)n1 << 8U) | ((uint8_t)n2 << 4U) | (uint8_t)n3);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_dshot_parse_telemetry(uint32_t gcr_20bit, uint8_t pole_pairs,
                                     SYN_DShot_Telemetry *telemetry)
{
    if (!telemetry) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    telemetry->valid = false;
    telemetry->period_us = 0;
    telemetry->erpm = 0;
    telemetry->rpm = 0;

    uint16_t payload = 0;
    if (syn_dshot_decode_gcr_20bit(gcr_20bit, &payload) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* CRC check over payload[15:4] */
    uint16_t data_12bit = (payload >> 4U);
    uint8_t crc_rx = (uint8_t)(payload & 0x0FU);
    uint8_t crc_calc = syn_dshot_calc_crc(data_12bit);

    if (crc_rx != crc_calc) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Unpack 12-bit eRPM period: 9-bit mantissa + 3-bit exponent */
    uint16_t mantissa = (data_12bit & 0x01FFU);
    uint8_t exponent = (uint8_t)((data_12bit >> 9U) & 0x07U);

    uint32_t period_us = ((uint32_t)mantissa) << exponent;
    telemetry->period_us = period_us;

    if (period_us > 0) {
        telemetry->erpm = 60000000U / period_us;
        uint8_t p = (pole_pairs == 0) ? 7U : pole_pairs;
        telemetry->rpm = telemetry->erpm / p;
    }

    telemetry->valid = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_LED) || SYN_USE_LED


#include "../drivers/syn_gpio.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_led.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Internal helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void led_set_output(SYN_LED *led, bool on)
{
    if (led == NULL)
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Unreachable static helper guard; led is verified non-NULL by
                   caller */
    led->lit = on;
    SYN_GPIO_State level;
    if (led->polarity == (uint8_t)SYN_LED_ACTIVE_LOW) {
        level = on ? SYN_GPIO_LOW : SYN_GPIO_HIGH;
    } else {
        level = on ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW;
    }
    syn_gpio_write(led->pin, level);
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_led_init(SYN_LED *led, SYN_GPIO_Pin pin, SYN_LEDPolarity polarity)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);

    memset(led, 0, sizeof(*led));
    led->pin = pin;
    led->polarity = (uint8_t)polarity;
    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_OFF;
    led->lit = false;
    syn_gpio_init(pin, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);
    led_set_output(led, false);
}

void syn_led_on(SYN_LED *led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);
    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_ON;
    led_set_output(led, true);
}

void syn_led_off(SYN_LED *led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);
    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_OFF;
    led_set_output(led, false);
}

void syn_led_toggle(SYN_LED *led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);
    if (led->lit) {
        syn_led_off(led);
    } else {
        syn_led_on(led);
    }
}

void syn_led_blink(SYN_LED *led, uint16_t on_ms, uint16_t off_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);

    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_BLINK;
    led->on_ms = on_ms;
    led->off_ms = off_ms;
    led->tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    led_set_output(led, true);
}

void syn_led_flash(SYN_LED *led, uint16_t on_ms, uint16_t off_ms, uint8_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(count > 0);

    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_FLASH;
    led->on_ms = on_ms;
    led->off_ms = off_ms;
    led->flash_remain = count;
    led->tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    led_set_output(led, true);
}

void syn_led_pattern(SYN_LED *led, const char *pattern, uint16_t unit_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);

    if (pattern == NULL || pattern[0] == '\0') {
        syn_led_off(led);
        return;
    }

    led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_PATTERN;
    led->pattern = pattern;
    led->pattern_idx = 0;
    led->pattern_unit = unit_ms;
    led->tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    led_set_output(led, false);
}

/* ── Update ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_led_update(SYN_LED *led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t elapsed = now - led->tick;

    switch ((SYN_LEDMode)led->mode) {
    case SYN_LED_MODE_OFF:
    case SYN_LED_MODE_ON:
        /* Static — nothing to do */
        break;

    case SYN_LED_MODE_BLINK:
        if (led->lit && elapsed >= led->on_ms) {
            led_set_output(led, false);
            led->tick = now;
        } else if (!led->lit && elapsed >= led->off_ms) {
            led_set_output(led, true);
            led->tick = now;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_LED_MODE_FLASH:
        if (led->lit && elapsed >= led->on_ms) {
            led_set_output(led, false);
            led->tick = now;
            led->flash_remain--;
            if (led->flash_remain == 0) {
                led->mode = (uint8_t)SYN_LED_MODE_OFF;
            }
        } else if (!led->lit && elapsed >= led->off_ms) {
            if (led->flash_remain > 0) {
                led_set_output(led, true);
                led->tick = now;
            }
        }
        break;

    case SYN_LED_MODE_PATTERN: {
        char ch = led->pattern[led->pattern_idx];
        uint16_t dur;

        switch (ch) {
        case '.': /* short on */
            if (!led->lit) {
                led_set_output(led, true);
                led->tick = now;
            } else if (elapsed >= led->pattern_unit) {
                led_set_output(led, false);
                led->tick = now;
                led->pattern_idx++;
            }
            break;
        case '-': /* long on */
            if (!led->lit) {
                led_set_output(led, true);
                led->tick = now;
            } else if (elapsed >= (uint32_t)(led->pattern_unit * 3u)) {
                led_set_output(led, false);
                led->tick = now;
                led->pattern_idx++;
            }
            break;
        case ' ': /* short pause */
            dur = led->pattern_unit;
            if (elapsed >= dur) {
                led->pattern_idx++;
                led->tick = now;
            }
            break;
        case '|': /* long pause */
            dur = (uint16_t)(led->pattern_unit * 3u);
            if (elapsed >= dur) {
                led->pattern_idx++;
                led->tick = now;
            }
            break;
        case '\0': /* end of pattern — loop */
            led->pattern_idx = 0;
            led->tick = now;
            break;
        default: /* unknown char — skip */
            led->pattern_idx++;
            break;
        }
        break;
    }
    }
}

void syn_led_service(SYN_LED *leds, size_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(leds != NULL || count == 0);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        syn_led_update(&leds[i]);
    }
}

uint32_t syn_led_next_ms(const SYN_LED *led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t elapsed = now - led->tick;
    uint32_t duration;

    switch ((SYN_LEDMode)led->mode) {
    case SYN_LED_MODE_OFF:
    case SYN_LED_MODE_ON:
        return UINT32_MAX; /* Static — no upcoming transition */

    case SYN_LED_MODE_BLINK:
    case SYN_LED_MODE_FLASH:
        duration = led->lit ? led->on_ms : led->off_ms;
        return (elapsed >= duration) ? 0 : (duration - elapsed);

    case SYN_LED_MODE_PATTERN: {
        char ch = led->pattern[led->pattern_idx];
        switch (ch) {
        case '.':
            duration = led->pattern_unit;
            break;
        case '-':
            duration = led->pattern_unit * 3u;
            break;
        case ' ':
            duration = led->pattern_unit;
            break;
        case '|':
            duration = led->pattern_unit * 3u;
            break;
        default:
            return 0; /* '\0' or unknown — immediate */
        }
        return (elapsed >= duration) ? 0 : (duration - elapsed);
    }
    }

    return 0;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_LED */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Drives LEDs through GPIO with non-blocking blink/flash/pattern sequencing. No timers or tasks required — just call syn_led_update() from your main loop.

** **

static SYN_LED led;
syn_led_init(&led, LED_PIN, SYN_LED_ACTIVE_HIGH);
syn_led_blink(&led, 500, 500);     // 500ms on, 500ms off
while (1) { syn_led_update(&led); }

#include "syn_smartled.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_smartled_init(SYN_SmartLED *led, SYN_GPIO_Pin data_pin, uint16_t num_leds,
                             SYN_SmartLEDColor *pixel_buf, SYN_SmartLEDOrder order)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(led != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(num_leds > 0);
    SYN_ASSERT(pixel_buf != NULL);

    memset(led, 0, sizeof(*led));
    led->data_pin = data_pin;
    led->num_leds = num_leds;
    led->pixel_buf = pixel_buf;
    led->order = order;
    led->brightness = 255; /* Default full brightness */

    memset(pixel_buf, 0, sizeof(SYN_SmartLEDColor) * num_leds);
    syn_port_gpio_init(data_pin, SYN_GPIO_OUTPUT);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_smartled_set_brightness(SYN_SmartLED *led, uint8_t brightness)
{
    if (led == NULL)
        return;
    led->brightness = brightness;
}

void syn_smartled_set_pixel_rgb(SYN_SmartLED *led, uint16_t index, uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b)
{
    if (led == NULL || led->pixel_buf == NULL || index >= led->num_leds)
        return;

    /* Scale by global brightness */
    uint16_t br = (uint16_t)led->brightness + 1;
    led->pixel_buf[index].r = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)r * br) >> 8);
    led->pixel_buf[index].g = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)g * br) >> 8);
    led->pixel_buf[index].b = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)b * br) >> 8);
    led->pixel_buf[index].w = 0;
}

void syn_smartled_set_pixel_hsv(SYN_SmartLED *led, uint16_t index, uint8_t h, uint8_t s, uint8_t v)
{
    if (led == NULL || led->pixel_buf == NULL || index >= led->num_leds)
        return;

    uint8_t r, g, b;
    if (s == 0) {
        r = g = b = v;
    } else {
        uint8_t region = h / 43;
        uint8_t remainder = (uint8_t)((h - (region * 43)) * 6);

        uint8_t p = (uint8_t)((v * (255 - s)) >> 8);
        uint8_t q = (uint8_t)((v * (255 - ((s * remainder) >> 8))) >> 8);
        uint8_t t = (uint8_t)((v * (255 - ((s * (255 - remainder)) >> 8))) >> 8);

        switch (region) {
        case 0:
            r = v;
            g = t;
            b = p;
            break;
        case 1:
            r = q;
            g = v;
            b = p;
            break;
        case 2:
            r = p;
            g = v;
            b = t;
            break;
        case 3:
            r = p;
            g = q;
            b = v;
            break;
        case 4:
            r = t;
            g = p;
            b = v;
            break;
        default:
            r = v;
            g = p;
            b = q;
            break;
        }
    }

    syn_smartled_set_pixel_rgb(led, index, r, g, b);
}

void syn_smartled_fill_rgb(SYN_SmartLED *led, uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b)
{
    if (led == NULL || led->pixel_buf == NULL)
        return;

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < led->num_leds; i++) {
        syn_smartled_set_pixel_rgb(led, i, r, g, b);
    }
}

void syn_smartled_clear(SYN_SmartLED *led)
{
    if (led == NULL || led->pixel_buf == NULL)
        return;
    syn_smartled_fill_rgb(led, 0, 0, 0);
}

#include "../drivers/syn_gpio.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_soft_pwm_init(SYN_SoftPWM *pwm, SYN_GPIO_Pin pin, uint16_t resolution)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(pwm != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(resolution > 0);

    if (pwm == NULL ||
        resolution ==
            0) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return;  /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    memset(pwm, 0, sizeof(*pwm));
    pwm->pin = pin;
    pwm->resolution = resolution;
    pwm->duty = 0;
    pwm->counter = 0;
    pwm->active_high = true;

    syn_gpio_write(pin, SYN_GPIO_LOW);
}

void syn_soft_pwm_set_duty(SYN_SoftPWM *pwm, uint16_t duty)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(pwm != NULL);
    if (pwm ==
        NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    if (duty > pwm->resolution) {
        duty = pwm->resolution;
    }
    pwm->duty = duty;
}

void syn_soft_pwm_set_percent(SYN_SoftPWM *pwm, uint8_t percent)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(pwm != NULL);
    if (pwm ==
        NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    if (percent > 100)
        percent = 100;
    uint16_t duty = (uint16_t)(((uint32_t)percent * pwm->resolution + 50u) / 100u);
    pwm->duty = duty;
}

void syn_soft_pwm_tick(SYN_SoftPWM *pwm)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(pwm != NULL);
    if (pwm == NULL || pwm->resolution == 0) {
        return;
    }

    bool on;

    if (pwm->duty == 0) {
        on = false;
    } else if (pwm->duty >= pwm->resolution) {
        on = true;
    } else {
        on = (pwm->counter < pwm->duty);
    }

    SYN_GPIO_State level;
    if (pwm->active_high) {
        level = on ? SYN_GPIO_HIGH : SYN_GPIO_LOW;
    } else {
        level = on ? SYN_GPIO_LOW : SYN_GPIO_HIGH;
    }
    syn_gpio_write(pwm->pin, level);

    pwm->counter++;
    if (pwm->counter >= pwm->resolution) {
        pwm->counter = 0;
    }
}

void syn_soft_pwm_service(SYN_SoftPWM *channels, size_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(channels != NULL || count == 0);
    if (channels == NULL || count == 0) {
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        syn_soft_pwm_tick(&channels[i]);
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SOFT_PWM */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
When hardware PWM isn't available or you've run out of channels, this module generates PWM by toggling GPIO in a high-frequency tick ISR.

** **

static SYN_SoftPWM pwm;
syn_soft_pwm_init(&pwm, LED_PIN, 100);  // 100 steps resolution
syn_soft_pwm_set_duty(&pwm, 75);         // 75% duty cycle

// Call from a timer ISR at (desired_freq * resolution) Hz:
void TIM_IRQHandler(void) {
    syn_soft_pwm_tick(&pwm);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implement these functions to offload AES block cipher and GHASH field multiplication to microcontroller hardware security / cryptographic accelerators (e.g. STM32 CRYP, ESP32 hardware AES).

Enable via SYN_USE_PORT_AES in syn_config.h. When disabled or returning SYN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, SyntropicOS automatically falls back to software calculation.

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides non-blocking, callback-based I2C transactions alongside the existing blocking API in syn_port_i2c.h. The callback fires from ISR context.

** **

static void on_i2c_done(uint8_t bus, SYN_Status result, void *ctx) {
    // Access rx_buf — data is ready
}

uint8_t reg = 0xD0;
uint8_t val;
SYN_I2C_Xfer xfer = {
    .bus       = 0,
    .addr      = 0x76,
    .tx_data   = &reg,
    .tx_len    = 1,
    .rx_data   = &val,
    .rx_len    = 1,
    .callback  = on_i2c_done,
    .user_data = NULL,
};
syn_port_i2c_xfer_async(&xfer);

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides the low-level byte I/O primitives for the system console. The console is a singleton — there is exactly one per project. It may be backed by a hardware UART, USB CDC, or any other byte stream.

The CLI and logging system use this interface directly — no callback wiring is needed in application code.

** **

  • write may briefly block for buffer space but must not spin indefinitely.
  • read is strictly non-blocking: returns 0 if nothing is available.

** **

For non-console UARTs (Modbus, GPS, sensors), use syn_port_uart.h which provides instance-based access to hardware UART peripherals.

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Minimal BSD-like socket abstraction for TCP client connections. Higher-level modules (HTTP client, MQTT, OTA) use this interface without knowing the underlying TCP/IP stack.

Implement these functions by wrapping your platform's socket API: * lwIP (raw or socket mode) * ESP-IDF (POSIX sockets via lwIP) * POSIX (Linux/macOS for development) * Vendor TCP/IP stack

** **

SYN_Socket sock = syn_port_sock_connect_host("example.com", 80);
if (sock < 0) { handle error }

syn_port_sock_send(sock, "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", 18);

uint8_t buf[256];
int n = syn_port_sock_recv(sock, buf, sizeof(buf), 5000);

syn_port_sock_close(sock);

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides non-blocking, callback-based SPI transfers alongside the existing blocking API in syn_port_spi.h. The callback fires from ISR context.

** **

static void on_spi_done(uint8_t bus, SYN_Status result, void *ctx) {
    syn_port_spi_cs_deassert(0, cs_pin);
    // Process rx_buf
}

syn_port_spi_cs_assert(0, cs_pin);
SYN_SPI_Xfer xfer = {
    .bus       = 0,
    .tx_buf    = tx_data,
    .rx_buf    = rx_data,
    .len       = 256,
    .callback  = on_spi_done,
    .user_data = NULL,
};
syn_port_spi_xfer_async(&xfer);

FileList > port > syn_port_spinlock.h

Go to the source code of this file

Multicore spinlock and core-identity port functions. More...

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implement these for your platform to enable AMP multicore support. On RP2040, map to the hardware spinlock peripheral. On other MCUs, implement using compare-and-swap (CAS) or test-and-set.

** **

  • acquire() MUST disable interrupts on the calling core before spinning. This prevents a deadlock where an ISR on the same core tries to acquire a lock held by the interrupted main context.
  • release() MUST restore the interrupt state to what it was before the matching acquire().
  • Spinlocks are NOT recursive. Acquiring a lock you already hold is undefined behavior (deadlock on most implementations).
  • Spinlocks should be held for the shortest possible time. They are intended for protecting hardware registers and short critical sections — NOT for guarding long computations.

** **

// Protect shared UART across two cores
syn_port_spinlock_acquire(SYN_SPINLOCK_UART);
syn_port_uart_transmit(0, data, len, 10);
syn_port_spinlock_release(SYN_SPINLOCK_UART);

docs.text: The hardware watchdog resets the MCU if not fed within the timeout window — even if the CPU is hard-locked (unlike the software watchdog in syn_watchdog.h which requires the scheduler to keep running).

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Compile this file into your project to catch unimplemented port functions at runtime. Each stub calls syn_assert_failed() with a descriptive message, making it immediately obvious which function you forgot to implement.

If you provide a strong definition of a function in your platform port file, the linker will silently discard the weak stub.

You can also omit this file entirely and rely on the linker to report unresolved symbols at link time — this is a perfectly valid approach.

SYN_WEAK  SYN_NORETURN void syn_assert_failed (
    const char * file,
    int line
)

This function is declared weak so you can provide your own implementation. The default (in syn_port_stubs.c) enters an infinite loop.

Parameters:

  • file Source file name where the assertion failed.
  • line Line number where the assertion failed.

    SYN_SleepMode mode

For Cortex-M: SYN_SLEEP_LIGHT → WFI, SYN_SLEEP_DEEP → STOP mode. Must return when an interrupt wakes the MCU.

Note:

The tickless scheduler calls this inside a critical section (interrupts masked). The implementation must use a sleep instruction that wakes on pending-but-masked interrupts (WFI on Cortex-M) and must NOT re-enable interrupts itself.

  • mode Requested sleep depth.

docs.title: function syn_port_spi_init
docs.text:
Initialize an SPI hardware instance. 

SYN_WEAK  SYN_Status syn_port_spi_init (
    uint8_t spi_id,
    uint32_t baudrate_hz,
    uint8_t mode,
    uint8_t role
)

Parameters:

  • spi_id Instance index (0 = SPI1, 1 = SPI2).
  • baudrate_hz Baudrate frequency in Hz (e.g. 1000000, 18000000).
  • mode SPI Mode: 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0), 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1), 2 (CPOL=1, CPHA=0), 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1).
  • role 0 = Master, 1 = Slave.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success.

docs.title: function syn_port_spi_transfer
docs.text:
Perform a full-duplex simultaneous SPI transfer. 

SYN_WEAK  SYN_Status syn_port_spi_transfer (

    const uint8_t * tx,
    uint8_t * rx,
    size_t len
)

Parameters:

  • spi_id Instance index.
  • tx TX data buffer (can be NULL, transmits 0xFF dummy bytes).
  • rx RX destination buffer (can be NULL).
  • len Transfer byte count.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success.

docs.title: function syn_port_uart_receive
docs.text:
Receive bytes into a buffer. 

SYN_WEAK  SYN_Status syn_port_uart_receive (
    SYN_UARTInstance instance,
    uint8_t * data,
    size_t len,
    size_t * received,
    uint32_t timeout_ms
)

Parameters:

  • instance UART instance.
  • data Buffer to receive into.
  • len Maximum number of bytes to receive.
  • received [out] Actual number of bytes received.
  • timeout_ms Timeout in milliseconds (0 = non-blocking poll).

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_TIMEOUT if the timeout elapsed with 0 bytes received.
