#include "syn_at_parser.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_at_parser_init(SYN_AtParser *parser, char *buf, size_t buf_size)
{
    if (parser == NULL || buf == NULL || buf_size == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    parser->line_buf = buf;
    parser->line_buf_size = buf_size;
    syn_at_parser_reset(parser);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_at_parser_reset(SYN_AtParser *parser)
{
    if (parser == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    parser->line_len = 0;
    parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
    parser->cme_error_code = -1;
    parser->prompt_detected = false;
    parser->skip_prompt_space = false;
    if (parser->line_buf != NULL && parser->line_buf_size > 0) {
        parser->line_buf[0] = '\0';
    }
}

static bool parse_at_int(const char *p, int *out_val);

static bool starts_with(const char *str, const char *prefix)
{
    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Defensive NULL check */
    if (str == NULL || prefix == NULL)
        return false;
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */
    while (*prefix) {
        if (*str != *prefix)
            return false;
        str++;
        prefix++;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool is_urc_line(const char *line)
{
    return starts_with(line, "+RECEIVE,") || starts_with(line, "+IPD,") ||
           starts_with(line, "CLOSED") || starts_with(line, "SHUT OK") ||
           starts_with(line, "RING") || starts_with(line, "+CMTI:");
}

static SYN_AtRespType classify_at_line(SYN_AtParser *parser, const char *line)
{
    if (strcmp(line, "OK") == 0) {
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_OK;
    } else if (strcmp(line, "ERROR") == 0) {
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_ERROR;
    } else if (starts_with(line, "+CME ERROR:") || starts_with(line, "+CMS ERROR:")) {
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_CME_ERROR;
        const char *colon = strchr(line, ':');
        int code = 0;
        parser->cme_error_code = parse_at_int(colon + 1, &code) ? code : 0;
    } else if (is_urc_line(line)) {
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_URC;
    } else {
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_LINE;
    }
    return parser->last_resp;
}

SYN_AtRespType syn_at_parser_feed_char(SYN_AtParser *parser, char c)
{
    if (parser == NULL || parser->line_buf == NULL) {
        return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
    }

    /* Ignore carriage return characters (\r) in CRLF sequences */
    if (c == '\r') {
        return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
    }

    /* Ignore a single space immediately following '>' prompt at start of line */
    if (parser->skip_prompt_space) {
        parser->skip_prompt_space = false;
        if ((c == ' ') && (parser->line_len == 0U)) {
            return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
        }
    }

    /* Prompt detection: '>' as first non-whitespace character */
    if (c == '>' && parser->line_len == 0) {
        parser->prompt_detected = true;
        parser->skip_prompt_space = true;
        parser->last_resp = SYN_AT_RESP_PROMPT;
        return SYN_AT_RESP_PROMPT;
    }

    if (c == '\n') {
        if (parser->line_len == 0) {
            return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
        }

        parser->line_buf[parser->line_len] = '\0';
        parser->line_len = 0;
        return classify_at_line(parser, parser->line_buf);
    }

    /* Accumulate character */
    if (parser->line_len < parser->line_buf_size - 1) {
        parser->line_buf[parser->line_len++] = c;
    }

    return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
}

SYN_AtRespType syn_at_parser_feed_stream(SYN_AtParser *parser, SYN_Stream *stream)
{
    if (parser == NULL || stream == NULL) {
        return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
    }

    uint8_t byte;
    while (syn_stream_read(stream, &byte, 1) == 1) {
        SYN_AtRespType resp = syn_at_parser_feed_char(parser, (char)byte);
        if (resp != SYN_AT_RESP_NONE) {
            return resp;
        }
    }

    return SYN_AT_RESP_NONE;
}

const char *syn_at_parser_get_line(const SYN_AtParser *parser)
{
    if (parser == NULL || parser->line_buf == NULL) {
        return "";
    }
    return parser->line_buf;
}

int syn_at_parser_get_cme_error(const SYN_AtParser *parser)
{
    if (parser == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    return parser->cme_error_code;
}

static bool is_param_delim(char c)
{
    return (c == '\0' || c == ',' || c == '\r' || c == '\n');
}

static bool parse_at_int(const char *p, int *out_val)
{
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') {
        p++;
    }
    if (is_param_delim(*p)) {
        return false;
    }

    errno = 0;
    char *endptr = NULL;
    long val = strtol(p, &endptr, 10);
    if (endptr == p || errno == ERANGE || val < (long)INT_MIN || val > (long)INT_MAX) {
        return false;
    }

    while (*endptr == ' ' || *endptr == '\t') {
        endptr++;
    }
    if (!is_param_delim(*endptr)) {
        return false;
    }

    *out_val = (int)val;
    return true;
}

static const char *skip_at_header(const char *line)
{
    bool in_quote = false;
    for (const char *s = line; *s != '\0'; s++) {
        if (*s == '"') {
            in_quote = !in_quote;
        } else if (!in_quote && *s == ',') {
            break;
        } else if (!in_quote && *s == ':') {
            return s + 1;
        }
    }
    return line;
}

static const char *next_unquoted_comma(const char *p)
{
    bool in_quote = false;
    while (*p != '\0') {
        if (*p == '"') {
            in_quote = !in_quote;
        } else if (!in_quote && *p == ',') {
            return p;
        }
        p++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static const char *find_param_start(const char *line, size_t param_idx)
{
    if (line == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    const char *p = skip_at_header(line);
    while (*p == ' ') {
        p++;
    }

    size_t curr_idx = 0U;
    while (curr_idx < param_idx) {
        p = next_unquoted_comma(p);
        if (p == NULL) {
            return NULL;
        }
        p++;
        while (*p == ' ') {
            p++;
        }
        curr_idx++;
    }

    return p;
}

bool syn_at_parser_get_param_int(const char *line, size_t param_idx, int *out_val)
{
    if (out_val == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    const char *p = find_param_start(line, param_idx);
    if (p == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    return parse_at_int(p, out_val);
}

static bool copy_param_token(const char *p, bool quoted, char *out_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    size_t out_idx = 0U;
    while ((*p != '\0') && (*p != '\r') && (*p != '\n')) {
        if (quoted && (*p == '"')) {
            break;
        }
        if (!quoted && (*p == ',')) {
            break;
        }
        if (out_idx >= (max_len - 1U)) {
            out_buf[out_idx] = '\0';
            return false;
        }
        out_buf[out_idx++] = *p++;
    }

    out_buf[out_idx] = '\0';
    if (quoted && (*p != '"')) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_at_parser_get_param_str(const char *line, size_t param_idx, char *out_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    if (out_buf == NULL || max_len == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    const char *p = find_param_start(line, param_idx);
    if (p == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    bool quoted = (*p == '"');
    if (quoted) {
        p++;
    }

    return copy_param_token(p, quoted, out_buf, max_len);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Lightweight, non-blocking line and prompt parser for modems (SIM800, Quectel, ESP-AT, etc.). Feeds from SYN_Stream or raw byte feeds, handles CRLF line framing, prompt '>' detection, CME ERROR decoding, URC filtering, and parameter extraction without dynamic memory allocation.

** **

static char line_buf[128];
static SYN_AtParser parser;
syn_at_parser_init(&parser, line_buf, sizeof(line_buf));

// In protothread or main loop:
SYN_AtRespType resp = syn_at_parser_feed_stream(&parser, &uart_rx_stream);
if (resp == SYN_AT_RESP_OK) {
    // Command succeeded
} else if (resp == SYN_AT_RESP_PROMPT) {
    // Modem sent '>' prompt, ready for data
}

#include "syn_bacnet.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── CRC Calculations (ISO 16484-5 Clause 9.3) ─────────────────────────── */

uint8_t syn_bacnet_crc8(const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    uint8_t crc = 0xFFU;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (uint8_t j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x01U) {
                crc = (uint8_t)((crc >> 1) ^ 0x91U);
            } else {
                crc = (uint8_t)(crc >> 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return (uint8_t)(~crc);
}

uint16_t syn_bacnet_crc16(const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    uint16_t crc = 0xFFFFU;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= (uint16_t)data[i];
        for (uint8_t j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x0001U) {
                crc = (uint16_t)((crc >> 1) ^ 0xA001U);
            } else {
                crc = (uint16_t)(crc >> 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return (uint16_t)(~crc);
}

/* ── MS/TP Framing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

size_t syn_bacnet_mstp_encode_frame(uint8_t frame_type, uint8_t dest_mac, uint8_t src_mac,
                                    const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t payload_len, uint8_t *out_buf)
{
    if (out_buf == NULL || (payload == NULL && payload_len > 0U)) {
        return 0U;
    }

    out_buf[0] = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_PREAMBLE_1;
    out_buf[1] = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_PREAMBLE_2;
    out_buf[2] = frame_type;
    out_buf[3] = dest_mac;
    out_buf[4] = src_mac;
    out_buf[5] = (uint8_t)((payload_len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[6] = (uint8_t)(payload_len & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[7] = syn_bacnet_crc8(&out_buf[2], 5U);

    size_t idx = 8U;
    if (payload_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(&out_buf[idx], payload, payload_len);
        idx += payload_len;

        uint16_t data_crc = syn_bacnet_crc16(payload, payload_len);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(data_crc & 0xFFU);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)((data_crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    }

    return idx;
}

bool syn_bacnet_mstp_decode_frame(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!buf || !frame || len < 8)
        return false;

    if (buf[0] != SYN_BACNET_MSTP_PREAMBLE_1 || buf[1] != SYN_BACNET_MSTP_PREAMBLE_2)
        return false;

    uint8_t header_crc = syn_bacnet_crc8(&buf[2], 5);
    if (header_crc != buf[7])
        return false;

    frame->frame_type = buf[2];
    frame->destination_mac = buf[3];
    frame->source_mac = buf[4];
    frame->data_len = ((uint16_t)buf[5] << 8) | (uint16_t)buf[6];

    if (frame->data_len > 501)
        return false;

    if (frame->data_len > 0) {
        if (len < (size_t)(8 + frame->data_len + 2))
            return false;

        memcpy(frame->payload, &buf[8], frame->data_len);

        uint16_t expected_crc = syn_bacnet_crc16(frame->payload, frame->data_len);
        uint16_t actual_crc =
            (uint16_t)buf[8 + frame->data_len] | ((uint16_t)buf[8 + frame->data_len + 1] << 8);

        if (expected_crc != actual_crc)
            return false;
    }

    return true;
}

/* ── Node & Object Management ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_bacnet_node_init(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, uint8_t mac_address, uint32_t device_id)
{
    if (!node)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    memset(node, 0, sizeof(SYN_BACnet_Node));
    node->mac_address = mac_address;
    node->device_id = device_id;
    node->max_master = 127;

    /* Automatically register Device Object */
    syn_bacnet_add_object(node, SYN_BACNET_OBJ_DEVICE, device_id, 0.0f,
                          "SyntropicOS-BACnet-Device");

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_bacnet_add_object(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, uint8_t object_type, uint32_t instance_id,
                                 float init_value, const char *name)
{
    if (!node || node->object_count >= SYN_BACNET_MAX_OBJECTS)
        return SYN_ERROR;

    SYN_BACnet_Object *obj = &node->objects[node->object_count++];
    obj->object_type = object_type;
    obj->instance_id = instance_id;
    obj->present_value = init_value;
    obj->name = name;

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Process Incoming APDU Requests ─────────────────────────────────────── */

static void bacnet_put_be_float(uint8_t out[4], float val)
{
    uint32_t bits = 0U;
    memcpy(&bits, &val, sizeof(bits));
    out[0] = (uint8_t)((bits >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    out[1] = (uint8_t)((bits >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    out[2] = (uint8_t)((bits >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    out[3] = (uint8_t)(bits & 0xFFU);
}

static float bacnet_get_be_float(const uint8_t in[4])
{
    uint32_t bits = ((uint32_t)in[0] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)in[1] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)in[2] << 8U) |
                    (uint32_t)in[3];
    float val = 0.0f;
    memcpy(&val, &bits, sizeof(val));
    return val;
}

static void bacnet_parse_obj_id(const SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *rx_frame, uint16_t *out_type,
                                uint32_t *out_instance)
{
    *out_type = (uint16_t)SYN_BACNET_OBJ_ANALOG_INPUT;
    *out_instance = 0U;
    if (rx_frame->data_len >= 9U && rx_frame->payload[4] == 0x0CU) {
        uint32_t obj_id = ((uint32_t)rx_frame->payload[5] << 24U) |
                          ((uint32_t)rx_frame->payload[6] << 16U) |
                          ((uint32_t)rx_frame->payload[7] << 8U) | (uint32_t)rx_frame->payload[8];
        *out_type = (uint16_t)((obj_id >> 22U) & 0x03FFU);
        *out_instance = obj_id & 0x003FFFFFU;
    }
}

static SYN_BACnet_Object *bacnet_find_object(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, uint16_t obj_type,
                                             uint32_t instance_id)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < node->object_count; i++) {
        if ((uint16_t)node->objects[i].object_type == obj_type &&
            node->objects[i].instance_id == instance_id) {
            return &node->objects[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void bacnet_handle_read_prop(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, const SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *rx_frame,
                                    uint8_t invoke_id, SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *tx_frame,
                                    bool *has_tx)
{
    uint16_t req_type = 0U;
    uint32_t req_instance = 0U;
    bacnet_parse_obj_id(rx_frame, &req_type, &req_instance);

    const SYN_BACnet_Object *obj = bacnet_find_object(node, req_type, req_instance);
    if (obj == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t payload[8];
    payload[0] = 0x30U; /* Complex-ACK APDU */
    payload[1] = invoke_id;
    payload[2] = SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_CONFIRMED_READ_PROPERTY;
    payload[3] = 0x44U; /* Application Tag 4 (Real), length 4 */
    bacnet_put_be_float(&payload[4], obj->present_value);

    tx_frame->frame_type = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_DATA_NOT_EXPECTING_REPLY;
    tx_frame->destination_mac = rx_frame->source_mac;
    tx_frame->source_mac = node->mac_address;
    tx_frame->data_len = 8U;
    memcpy(tx_frame->payload, payload, 8U);
    *has_tx = true;
}

static void bacnet_handle_write_prop(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, const SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *rx_frame,
                                     uint8_t invoke_id, SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *tx_frame,
                                     bool *has_tx)
{
    uint16_t req_type = 0U;
    uint32_t req_instance = 0U;
    bacnet_parse_obj_id(rx_frame, &req_type, &req_instance);

    float new_val = 0.0f;
    if (rx_frame->data_len >= 14U && rx_frame->payload[9] == 0x44U) {
        new_val = bacnet_get_be_float(&rx_frame->payload[10]);
    }

    SYN_BACnet_Object *obj = bacnet_find_object(node, req_type, req_instance);
    if (obj != NULL) {
        obj->present_value = new_val;
    }

    uint8_t payload[3];
    payload[0] = 0x20U; /* Simple-ACK APDU */
    payload[1] = invoke_id;
    payload[2] = SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_CONFIRMED_WRITE_PROPERTY;

    tx_frame->frame_type = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_DATA_NOT_EXPECTING_REPLY;
    tx_frame->destination_mac = rx_frame->source_mac;
    tx_frame->source_mac = node->mac_address;
    tx_frame->data_len = 3U;
    memcpy(tx_frame->payload, payload, 3U);
    *has_tx = true;
}

static void bacnet_encode_iam(const SYN_BACnet_Node *node, SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *tx_frame,
                              bool *has_tx)
{
    uint32_t obj_id = ((uint32_t)SYN_BACNET_OBJ_DEVICE << 22U) | (node->device_id & 0x003FFFFFUL);
    uint8_t payload[9];
    payload[0] = 0x10U;
    payload[1] = SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_UNCONFIRMED_I_AM;
    payload[2] = 0xC4U;
    payload[3] = (uint8_t)((obj_id >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    payload[4] = (uint8_t)((obj_id >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    payload[5] = (uint8_t)((obj_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    payload[6] = (uint8_t)(obj_id & 0xFFU);
    payload[7] = 0x21U;
    payload[8] = 0x05U;

    tx_frame->frame_type = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_DATA_NOT_EXPECTING_REPLY;
    tx_frame->destination_mac = SYN_BACNET_BROADCAST_MAC;
    tx_frame->source_mac = node->mac_address;
    tx_frame->data_len = 9U;
    memcpy(tx_frame->payload, payload, 9U);
    *has_tx = true;
}

static void bacnet_handle_confirmed_req(SYN_BACnet_Node *node,
                                        const SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *rx_frame,
                                        SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *tx_frame, bool *has_tx)
{
    if (rx_frame->destination_mac == SYN_BACNET_BROADCAST_MAC || rx_frame->data_len < 4U) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t invoke_id = rx_frame->payload[2];
    uint8_t service_choice = rx_frame->payload[3];
    if (service_choice == SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_CONFIRMED_READ_PROPERTY) {
        bacnet_handle_read_prop(node, rx_frame, invoke_id, tx_frame, has_tx);
    } else if (service_choice == SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_CONFIRMED_WRITE_PROPERTY) {
        bacnet_handle_write_prop(node, rx_frame, invoke_id, tx_frame, has_tx);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_bacnet_node_process(SYN_BACnet_Node *node, const SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *rx_frame,
                                   SYN_BACnet_MSTP_Frame *tx_frame, bool *has_tx)
{
    if (!node || !rx_frame || !tx_frame || !has_tx) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *has_tx = false;

    if (rx_frame->destination_mac != node->mac_address &&
        rx_frame->destination_mac != SYN_BACNET_BROADCAST_MAC) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (rx_frame->frame_type == SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_TOKEN) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (rx_frame->frame_type == SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_POLL_FOR_MASTER) {
        if (rx_frame->destination_mac == node->mac_address) {
            tx_frame->frame_type = SYN_BACNET_MSTP_FRAME_REPLY_TO_POLL_FOR_MASTER;
            tx_frame->destination_mac = rx_frame->source_mac;
            tx_frame->source_mac = node->mac_address;
            tx_frame->data_len = 0U;
            *has_tx = true;
        }
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (rx_frame->data_len < 2U) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    uint8_t pdu_type = rx_frame->payload[0] & 0xF0U;

    if (pdu_type == 0x10U && rx_frame->payload[1] == SYN_BACNET_SERVICE_UNCONFIRMED_WHO_IS) {
        bacnet_encode_iam(node, tx_frame, has_tx);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (pdu_type == 0x00U) {
        bacnet_handle_confirmed_req(node, rx_frame, tx_frame, has_tx);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#include "syn_cannm.h"

#include <string.h>

#if !defined(SYN_USE_CANNM) || SYN_USE_CANNM

void syn_cannm_init(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, const SYN_CanNM_Config *cfg)
{
    if (!session) {
        return;
    }

    memset(session, 0, sizeof(*session));

    if (cfg) {
        session->config = *cfg;
    } else {
        /* Default AUTOSAR CAN NM Timers & IDs */
        session->config.node_id = 0x01U;
        session->config.can_id_base = 0x400U;
        session->config.can_id_mask = 0x7F0U;
        session->config.msg_cycle_ms = 100U;
        session->config.nm_timeout_ms = 1000U;
        session->config.wait_bus_sleep_ms = 1500U;
        session->config.repeat_msg_time_ms = 1600U;
    }

    session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP;
    session->prev_state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP;
}

void syn_cannm_request_network(SYN_CanNM_Session *session)
{
    if (!session) {
        return;
    }
    session->node_comm_req = true;
    if (session->state == SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP ||
        session->state == SYN_CANNM_STATE_PRE_BUS_SLEEP) {
        session->active_wakeup = true;
    }
}

void syn_cannm_release_network(SYN_CanNM_Session *session)
{
    if (!session) {
        return;
    }
    session->node_comm_req = false;
}

void syn_cannm_request_repeat_msg(SYN_CanNM_Session *session)
{
    if (!session) {
        return;
    }
    session->repeat_msg_req = true;
}

void syn_cannm_set_user_data(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    if (!session) {
        return;
    }
    memset(session->user_data, 0, sizeof(session->user_data));
    if (data && len > 0) {
        size_t copy_len = len > 6U ? 6U : len;
        memcpy(session->user_data, data, copy_len);
    }
}

bool syn_cannm_process_rx_frame(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!session || !frame) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Verify Standard 11-bit frame, minimum DLC, and CAN ID matching */
    if ((frame->dlc < 2U) || frame->extended) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t mask = session->config.can_id_mask;
    if ((frame->id & mask) != (session->config.can_id_base & mask)) {
        return false;
    }

    session->rx_source_node_id = frame->data[0];
    session->rx_cbv = frame->data[1];
    memset(session->rx_user_data, 0, sizeof(session->rx_user_data));
    if (frame->dlc > 2U) {
        size_t user_len = (size_t)frame->dlc - 2U;
        if (user_len > sizeof(session->rx_user_data)) {
            user_len = sizeof(session->rx_user_data);
        }
        memcpy(session->rx_user_data, &frame->data[2], user_len);
    }

    /* Restart timeout timer on any valid CAN NM reception */
    session->timeout_timer = session->config.nm_timeout_ms;

    /* Handle state transitions triggered by Rx */
    switch (session->state) {
    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP:
    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_PRE_BUS_SLEEP:
        if (!session->node_comm_req) {
            session->active_wakeup = false;
        }
        session->prev_state = session->state;
        session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_REPEAT_MSG;
        session->repeat_msg_timer = session->config.repeat_msg_time_ms;
        session->msg_cycle_timer = 0U; /* Transmit immediately */
        break;

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_NORMAL_OP:
    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_READY_SLEEP:
        if ((session->rx_cbv & SYN_CANNM_CBV_REPEAT_MSG_REQ) != 0U) {
            session->prev_state = session->state;
            session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_REPEAT_MSG;
            session->repeat_msg_timer = session->config.repeat_msg_time_ms;
            session->msg_cycle_timer = 0U;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_REPEAT_MSG:
    default:
        break;
    }

    return true;
}

static void pack_nm_tx_pdu(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    tx_frame->id = session->config.can_id_base + session->config.node_id;
    tx_frame->extended = false;
    tx_frame->dlc = 8U;
    tx_frame->data[0] = session->config.node_id;

    uint8_t cbv = 0U;
    if (session->repeat_msg_req) {
        cbv |= SYN_CANNM_CBV_REPEAT_MSG_REQ;
    }
    if (session->active_wakeup) {
        cbv |= SYN_CANNM_CBV_ACTIVE_WAKEUP_REQ;
    }
    tx_frame->data[1] = cbv;

    memcpy(&tx_frame->data[2], session->user_data, 6U);
}

static bool cannm_emit_cycle_pdu(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    session->msg_cycle_timer = session->config.msg_cycle_ms;
    session->timeout_timer = session->config.nm_timeout_ms;
    if (tx_frame != NULL) {
        pack_nm_tx_pdu(session, tx_frame);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool cannm_enter_repeat_msg(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    session->prev_state = session->state;
    session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_REPEAT_MSG;
    session->repeat_msg_timer = session->config.repeat_msg_time_ms;
    return cannm_emit_cycle_pdu(session, tx_frame);
}

static bool cannm_step_repeat_msg(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, uint32_t delta_ms,
                                  SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->repeat_msg_timer <= delta_ms) {
        session->repeat_msg_timer = 0U;
        session->prev_state = session->state;
        session->repeat_msg_req = false;
        if (!session->node_comm_req) {
            session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_READY_SLEEP;
            return false;
        }
        session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_NORMAL_OP;
    } else {
        session->repeat_msg_timer -= delta_ms;
    }

    if (session->msg_cycle_timer <= delta_ms) {
        return cannm_emit_cycle_pdu(session, tx_frame);
    }
    session->msg_cycle_timer -= delta_ms;
    return false;
}

static bool cannm_step_normal_op(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, uint32_t delta_ms,
                                 SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->repeat_msg_req) {
        return cannm_enter_repeat_msg(session, tx_frame);
    }
    if (!session->node_comm_req) {
        session->prev_state = session->state;
        session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_READY_SLEEP;
        return false;
    }
    if (session->msg_cycle_timer <= delta_ms) {
        return cannm_emit_cycle_pdu(session, tx_frame);
    }
    session->msg_cycle_timer -= delta_ms;
    return false;
}

static bool cannm_step_ready_sleep(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, uint32_t delta_ms,
                                   SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->repeat_msg_req) {
        return cannm_enter_repeat_msg(session, tx_frame);
    }
    if (session->node_comm_req) {
        session->prev_state = session->state;
        session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_NORMAL_OP;
        session->msg_cycle_timer = 0U;
        return false;
    }
    if (session->timeout_timer <= delta_ms) {
        session->timeout_timer = 0U;
        session->prev_state = session->state;
        session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_PRE_BUS_SLEEP;
        session->wait_bus_sleep_timer = session->config.wait_bus_sleep_ms;
        return false;
    }
    session->timeout_timer -= delta_ms;
    return false;
}

bool syn_cannm_step(SYN_CanNM_Session *session, uint32_t delta_ms, SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (!session) {
        return false;
    }

    if ((session->state == SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP ||
         session->state == SYN_CANNM_STATE_PRE_BUS_SLEEP) &&
        session->node_comm_req) {
        session->active_wakeup = true;
        return cannm_enter_repeat_msg(session, tx_frame);
    }

    switch (session->state) {
    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_PRE_BUS_SLEEP:
        if (session->wait_bus_sleep_timer <= delta_ms) {
            session->wait_bus_sleep_timer = 0U;
            session->prev_state = session->state;
            session->state = SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP;
            session->active_wakeup = false;
            session->repeat_msg_req = false;
        } else {
            session->wait_bus_sleep_timer -= delta_ms;
        }
        return false;

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_REPEAT_MSG:
        return cannm_step_repeat_msg(session, delta_ms, tx_frame);

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_NORMAL_OP:
        return cannm_step_normal_op(session, delta_ms, tx_frame);

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_READY_SLEEP:
        return cannm_step_ready_sleep(session, delta_ms, tx_frame);

    case SYN_CANNM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP:
    default:
        session->active_wakeup = false;
        session->repeat_msg_req = false;
        return false;
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_CANNM */

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_CANOPEN) || SYN_USE_CANOPEN


#include "syntropic/proto/syn_canopen.h"
#include "syntropic/util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>

static bool canopen_queue_tx(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint32_t cob_id, const uint8_t *data,
                             uint8_t len)
{
    if (node->tx_count >= SYN_CANOPEN_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH) {
        return false;
    }

    SYN_CANOpenTxSlot *slot = &node->tx_queue[node->tx_tail];
    slot->cob_id = cob_id;
    slot->len = len;
    (void)memcpy(slot->data, data, len);

    node->tx_tail = (uint8_t)((node->tx_tail + 1U) % SYN_CANOPEN_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH);
    node->tx_count++;
    if (node->tx_count == 1U) {
        node->tx_cob_id = cob_id;
        (void)memcpy(node->tx_data, data, len);
        node->tx_len = len;
    }
    node->tx_pending = true;
    return true;
}

static const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *canopen_find_od(const SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index,
                                                 uint8_t subindex)
{
    if (node == NULL || node->od_table == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < node->od_count; i++) {
        if (node->od_table[i].index == index && node->od_table[i].subindex == subindex) {
            return &node->od_table[i];
        }
    }

    return NULL;
}

static void canopen_send_sdo_abort(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                                   uint32_t abort_code)
{
    uint8_t payload[8];
    size_t pos = 0;
    syn_pack_u8(payload, &pos, 0x80U);
    syn_pack_u16_le(payload, &pos, index);
    syn_pack_u8(payload, &pos, subindex);
    syn_pack_u32_le(payload, &pos, abort_code);

    canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, payload, 8);
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_init(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, const SYN_CANOpenNodeConfig *cfg,
                            const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *od_table, size_t od_count)
{
    if (node == NULL || cfg == NULL || od_table == NULL || od_count == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (cfg->node_id < 1U || cfg->node_id > 127U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(node, 0, sizeof(*node));
    node->node_id = cfg->node_id;
    node->cfg = *cfg;
    node->od_table = od_table;
    node->od_count = od_count;
    node->nmt_state = SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_PREOP;

    /* Queue Bootup Message: COB-ID = 0x700 + NodeID, payload = 0x00 */
    uint8_t boot_payload[1] = {0x00U};
    canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x700U + node->node_id, boot_payload, 1);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_od_read(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex, void *buf,
                               size_t buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (node == NULL || buf == NULL || out_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry = canopen_find_od(node, index, subindex);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (entry->access == SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_WO || entry->data_ptr == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (buf_size < entry->size) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memcpy(buf, entry->data_ptr, entry->size);
    *out_len = entry->size;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_od_write(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                                const void *data, size_t len)
{
    if (node == NULL || data == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry = canopen_find_od(node, index, subindex);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (entry->access == SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO || entry->data_ptr == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (len != entry->size) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memcpy(entry->data_ptr, data, len);

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void canopen_abort_missing_od(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < node->od_count; i++) {
        if (node->od_table[i].index == index) {
            canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_SUBINDEX_NOT_EXIST);
            return;
        }
    }
    canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_NOT_EXIST);
}

static void canopen_handle_nmt(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, const uint8_t *data)
{
    uint8_t target_node = data[1];
    if (target_node != 0U && target_node != node->node_id) {
        return;
    }

    switch (data[0]) {
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_CMD_START:
        node->nmt_state = SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_OPERATIONAL;
        break;
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_CMD_STOP:
        node->nmt_state = SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_STOPPED;
        break;
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_CMD_PREOP:
        node->nmt_state = SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_PREOP;
        break;
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_CMD_RESET_NODE:
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_CMD_RESET_COMM: {
        uint8_t boot_payload[1] = {0x00U};
        node->nmt_state = SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_PREOP;
        node->heartbeat_timer_ms = 0U;
        (void)memset(&node->sdo_session, 0, sizeof(node->sdo_session));
        (void)canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x700U + node->node_id, boot_payload, 1U);
        break;
    }
    default:
        break;
    }
}

static void canopen_sdo_download(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint8_t cmd, uint16_t index,
                                 uint8_t subindex, const uint8_t *data)
{
    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry = canopen_find_od(node, index, subindex);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        canopen_abort_missing_od(node, index, subindex);
        return;
    }
    if (entry->access == SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO) {
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_READ_ONLY);
        return;
    }
    if (entry->data_ptr == NULL) {
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_UNSUPPORTED_ACCESS);
        return;
    }
    if ((cmd & 0x02U) != 0U) {
        uint8_t n = (cmd >> 2U) & 0x03U;
        size_t write_len = (size_t)(4U - n);
        if (write_len != entry->size) {
            canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_TYPE_MISMATCH);
            return;
        }
        (void)syn_canopen_od_write(node, index, subindex, &data[4], write_len);
        uint8_t resp[8] = {0x60U, data[1], data[2], data[3], 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};
        canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
        return;
    }

    node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_SEG_DOWNLOAD;
    node->sdo_session.index = index;
    node->sdo_session.subindex = subindex;
    node->sdo_session.toggle = 0U;
    node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes = 0U;
    node->sdo_session.total_bytes =
        (size_t)((uint32_t)data[4] | ((uint32_t)data[5] << 8U) | ((uint32_t)data[6] << 16U) |
                 ((uint32_t)data[7] << 24U));
    uint8_t resp[8] = {0x60U, data[1], data[2], data[3], 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};
    canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
}

static void canopen_sdo_seg_download(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t *data)
{
    uint8_t t = (cmd >> 4U) & 0x01U;
    if (t != node->sdo_session.toggle) {
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex,
                               SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_TOGGLE_BIT);
        node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
        return;
    }

    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry =
        canopen_find_od(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex);
    uint8_t n = (cmd >> 1U) & 0x07U;
    size_t seg_len = 7U - n;

    if (entry != NULL && entry->data_ptr != NULL &&
        (node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes + seg_len) <= entry->size) {
        (void)memcpy((uint8_t *)entry->data_ptr + node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes, &data[1],
                     seg_len);
        node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes += seg_len;

        uint8_t resp[8] = {(uint8_t)((t << 4U) | 0x20U), 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};
        canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
        node->sdo_session.toggle ^= 1U;

        if ((cmd & 0x01U) != 0U) {
            node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
        }
        return;
    }

    canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex,
                           SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_TYPE_MISMATCH);
    node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
}

static void canopen_sdo_upload(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                               const uint8_t *data)
{
    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry = canopen_find_od(node, index, subindex);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        canopen_abort_missing_od(node, index, subindex);
        return;
    }
    if (entry->access == SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_WO) {
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_WRITE_ONLY);
        return;
    }
    if (entry->size <= 4U) {
        uint8_t read_buf[4] = {0};
        size_t read_len = 0U;
        if (syn_canopen_od_read(node, index, subindex, read_buf, sizeof(read_buf), &read_len) ==
                SYN_OK &&
            read_len <= 4U) {
            uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(4U - read_len);
            uint8_t resp[8] = {
                (uint8_t)(0x43U | (n << 2U)), data[1], data[2], data[3], 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U};
            (void)memcpy(&resp[4], read_buf, read_len);
            canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
            return;
        }
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, index, subindex, SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_TYPE_MISMATCH);
        return;
    }

    node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_SEG_UPLOAD;
    node->sdo_session.index = index;
    node->sdo_session.subindex = subindex;
    node->sdo_session.toggle = 0U;
    node->sdo_session.total_bytes = entry->size;
    node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes = 0U;

    uint32_t usize = (uint32_t)entry->size;
    uint8_t resp[8] = {0x41U,
                       data[1],
                       data[2],
                       data[3],
                       (uint8_t)(usize & 0xFFU),
                       (uint8_t)((usize >> 8U) & 0xFFU),
                       (uint8_t)((usize >> 16U) & 0xFFU),
                       (uint8_t)((usize >> 24U) & 0xFFU)};
    canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
}

static void canopen_sdo_seg_upload(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint8_t cmd)
{
    uint8_t t = (cmd >> 4U) & 0x01U;
    if (t != node->sdo_session.toggle) {
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex,
                               SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_TOGGLE_BIT);
        node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
        return;
    }

    const SYN_CANOpenODEntry *entry =
        canopen_find_od(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex);
    if (entry == NULL || entry->data_ptr == NULL) {
        uint32_t code = (entry == NULL) ? SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_NOT_EXIST
                                        : SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_ABORT_UNSUPPORTED_ACCESS;
        canopen_send_sdo_abort(node, node->sdo_session.index, node->sdo_session.subindex, code);
        node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
        return;
    }

    size_t rem = entry->size - node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes;
    size_t seg_len = (rem > 7U) ? 7U : rem;
    uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(7U - seg_len);
    uint8_t c = (rem <= 7U) ? 1U : 0U;

    uint8_t resp[8] = {0};
    resp[0] = (uint8_t)((t << 4U) | (n << 1U) | c);
    (void)memcpy(&resp[1], (const uint8_t *)entry->data_ptr + node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes,
                 seg_len);

    canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x580U + node->node_id, resp, 8U);
    node->sdo_session.transferred_bytes += seg_len;
    node->sdo_session.toggle ^= 1U;

    if (c != 0U) {
        node->sdo_session.state = SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_IDLE;
    }
}

static void canopen_handle_sdo(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, const uint8_t *data)
{
    size_t sdo_pos = 0U;
    uint8_t cmd = syn_unpack_u8(data, &sdo_pos);
    uint16_t index = syn_unpack_u16_le(data, &sdo_pos);
    uint8_t subindex = syn_unpack_u8(data, &sdo_pos);
    uint8_t ccs = cmd & 0xE0U;

    if (ccs == 0x80U) {
        (void)memset(&node->sdo_session, 0, sizeof(node->sdo_session));
    } else if (ccs == 0x20U) {
        canopen_sdo_download(node, cmd, index, subindex, data);
    } else if (ccs == 0x00U && node->sdo_session.state == SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_SEG_DOWNLOAD) {
        canopen_sdo_seg_download(node, cmd, data);
    } else if (ccs == 0x40U) {
        canopen_sdo_upload(node, index, subindex, data);
    } else if (ccs == 0x60U && node->sdo_session.state == SYN_CANOPEN_SDO_SEG_UPLOAD) {
        canopen_sdo_seg_upload(node, cmd);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_process_rx(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint32_t cob_id, const uint8_t *data,
                                  uint8_t len)
{
    if (node == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (cob_id == 0x000U && len >= 2U) {
        canopen_handle_nmt(node, data);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (cob_id == (0x600U + node->node_id) && len == 8U) {
        if (node->nmt_state == SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_STOPPED) {
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        if (node->tx_count >= SYN_CANOPEN_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH) {
            return SYN_BUSY;
        }
        canopen_handle_sdo(node, data);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (node->nmt_state == SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_OPERATIONAL) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (node->cfg.rpdo[i].enabled != 0U && node->cfg.rpdo[i].cob_id == cob_id) {
                (void)syn_canopen_od_write(node, node->cfg.rpdo[i].od_index,
                                           node->cfg.rpdo[i].od_subindex, data, len);
                return SYN_OK;
            }
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_update(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (node == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Periodic Heartbeat Producer */
    if (node->cfg.heartbeat_ms > 0U) {
        uint64_t elapsed = (uint64_t)node->heartbeat_timer_ms + (uint64_t)dt_ms;
        if (elapsed >= (uint64_t)node->cfg.heartbeat_ms) {
            node->heartbeat_timer_ms = 0U;

            uint8_t hb_payload[1] = {node->nmt_state};
            (void)canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x700U + node->node_id, hb_payload, 1U);
        } else {
            node->heartbeat_timer_ms = (uint16_t)elapsed;
        }
    }

    /* Periodic TPDO Transmission (Operational State Only; reserve 2 urgent slots for EMCY/SDO) */
    if (node->nmt_state == SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_OPERATIONAL) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (node->cfg.tpdo[i].enabled != 0U &&
                node->tx_count < (SYN_CANOPEN_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH - 2U)) {
                uint8_t tpdo_buf[8] = {0};
                size_t tpdo_len = 0U;
                if (syn_canopen_od_read(node, node->cfg.tpdo[i].od_index,
                                        node->cfg.tpdo[i].od_subindex, tpdo_buf, sizeof(tpdo_buf),
                                        &tpdo_len) == SYN_OK) {
                    (void)canopen_queue_tx(node, node->cfg.tpdo[i].cob_id, tpdo_buf,
                                           (uint8_t)tpdo_len);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_send_emcy(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint16_t err_code, uint8_t err_reg)
{
    if (node == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t payload[8] = {0};
    payload[0] = (uint8_t)(err_code & 0xFFU);
    payload[1] = (uint8_t)((err_code >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    payload[2] = err_reg;

    return canopen_queue_tx(node, 0x080U + node->node_id, payload, 8U) ? SYN_OK : SYN_BUSY;
}

bool syn_canopen_get_tx(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint32_t *out_cob_id, uint8_t *out_data,
                        uint8_t *out_len)
{
    if (node == NULL || node->tx_count == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    const SYN_CANOpenTxSlot *slot = &node->tx_queue[node->tx_head];
    if (out_cob_id != NULL) {
        *out_cob_id = slot->cob_id;
    }
    if (out_data != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(out_data, slot->data, slot->len);
    }
    if (out_len != NULL) {
        *out_len = slot->len;
    }

    node->tx_head = (uint8_t)((node->tx_head + 1U) % SYN_CANOPEN_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH);
    node->tx_count--;
    if (node->tx_count > 0U) {
        const SYN_CANOpenTxSlot *next = &node->tx_queue[node->tx_head];
        node->tx_cob_id = next->cob_id;
        (void)memcpy(node->tx_data, next->data, next->len);
        node->tx_len = next->len;
        node->tx_pending = true;
    } else {
        node->tx_pending = false;
    }

    return true;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_tpdo_trigger(SYN_CANOpenNode *node, uint8_t pdo_num)
{
    if (node == NULL || pdo_num < 1 || pdo_num > 4) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (node->nmt_state != SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STATE_OPERATIONAL) {
        return SYN_ERROR; /* TPDOs only transmitted in Operational state */
    }

    SYN_CANOpenPDOMap *map = &node->cfg.tpdo[pdo_num - 1];
    if (!map->enabled || map->cob_id == 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR; /* Unmapped */
    }

    uint8_t payload[8];
    size_t len = 0;
    SYN_Status st =
        syn_canopen_od_read(node, map->od_index, map->od_subindex, payload, sizeof(payload), &len);
    if (st == SYN_OK && len > 0) {
        return canopen_queue_tx(node, map->cob_id, payload, (uint8_t)len) ? SYN_OK : SYN_BUSY;
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_CANOPEN */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a lightweight, non-blocking, zero-malloc CANopen DS301 slave stack including Object Dictionary, SDO server, RPDO/TPDO engine, NMT state machine, Heartbeat producer, and Emergency (EMCY) alarms.

#include "syn_canopen_mgr.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_canopen_mgr_init(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(mgr != NULL);
    memset(mgr, 0, sizeof(*mgr));
}

void syn_canopen_mgr_build_nmt(SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint8_t target_node, uint8_t nmt_cmd)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(frame != NULL);
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = 0x000U; /* NMT COB-ID */
    frame->dlc = 2;
    frame->data[0] = nmt_cmd;
    frame->data[1] = target_node;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_mgr_sdo_read_init(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                         uint8_t node_id, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(mgr != NULL && frame != NULL);
    if (node_id < 1 || node_id > 127)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ ||
        mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    mgr->sdo_client.target_node = node_id;
    mgr->sdo_client.index = index;
    mgr->sdo_client.subindex = subindex;
    mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ;
    mgr->sdo_client.abort_code = 0;
    mgr->sdo_client.timeout_ms = 1000;

    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = 0x600U + node_id; /* SDO Request COB-ID */
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->data[0] = 0x40U; /* Initiate Upload Request */
    syn_poke_u16_le(index, frame->data, 1);
    frame->data[3] = subindex;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_canopen_mgr_sdo_write_init(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                          uint8_t node_id, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                                          const void *data, size_t len)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(mgr != NULL && frame != NULL && data != NULL);
    if (node_id < 1 || node_id > 127 || len == 0 || len > 4)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ ||
        mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    mgr->sdo_client.target_node = node_id;
    mgr->sdo_client.index = index;
    mgr->sdo_client.subindex = subindex;
    mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE;
    mgr->sdo_client.abort_code = 0;
    mgr->sdo_client.data_len = len;
    memcpy(mgr->sdo_client.data, data, len);
    mgr->sdo_client.timeout_ms = 1000;

    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = 0x600U + node_id; /* SDO Request COB-ID */
    frame->dlc = 8;
    /* Command byte for expedited download: CS=1 (0x20), e=1, s=1, n=(4-len) */
    uint8_t cs = 0x23U | ((uint8_t)(4 - len) << 2);
    frame->data[0] = cs;
    syn_poke_u16_le(index, frame->data, 1);
    frame->data[3] = subindex;
    memcpy(&frame->data[4], data, len);

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void canopen_mgr_handle_sdo_resp(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    uint8_t cs = frame->data[0];

    /* Check Abort Domain Transfer (0x80) */
    if (cs == 0x80U) {
        mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_ERROR;
        mgr->sdo_client.abort_code = syn_peek_u32_le(frame->data, 4U);
        return;
    }

    if (syn_peek_u16_le(frame->data, 1U) != mgr->sdo_client.index ||
        frame->data[3] != mgr->sdo_client.subindex) {
        return;
    }

    if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ && (cs & 0xE0U) == 0x40U) {
        if ((cs & 0x02U) == 0U) {
            mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_ERROR;
            mgr->sdo_client.abort_code = 0x06010000UL;
            return;
        }
        uint8_t n = (cs >> 2U) & 0x03U;
        size_t len = 4U - n;
        mgr->sdo_client.data_len = len;
        memcpy(mgr->sdo_client.data, &frame->data[4], len);
        mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_SUCCESS;
    } else if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE && (cs & 0xE0U) == 0x60U) {
        mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_SUCCESS;
    }
}

void syn_canopen_mgr_process_frame(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(mgr != NULL && frame != NULL);

    /* Check Heartbeat (COB-ID 0x700 + NodeID) */
    if (frame->id >= 0x701U && frame->id <= 0x77FU && frame->dlc >= 1U) {
        uint8_t node_id = (uint8_t)(frame->id - 0x700U);
        mgr->nodes[node_id].node_id = node_id;
        mgr->nodes[node_id].nmt_state = frame->data[0] & 0x7FU;
        mgr->nodes[node_id].timer_ms = 0U;
        mgr->nodes[node_id].online = true;
        return;
    }

    /* Check SDO Response (COB-ID 0x580 + NodeID, exact 8-byte DLC, active wait state) */
    if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ ||
        mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE) {
        uint32_t resp_cob = 0x580U + (uint32_t)mgr->sdo_client.target_node;
        if (frame->id == resp_cob && frame->dlc == 8U) {
            canopen_mgr_handle_sdo_resp(mgr, frame);
        }
    }
}

void syn_canopen_mgr_step(SYN_CANOpenManager *mgr, uint16_t delta_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(mgr != NULL);

    /* Advance node heartbeat timers without uint16_t wraparound */
    for (uint16_t i = 1U; i <= 127U; i++) {
        if (mgr->nodes[i].online) {
            uint32_t elapsed = (uint32_t)mgr->nodes[i].timer_ms + (uint32_t)delta_ms;
            if (elapsed > 3000U) {
                mgr->nodes[i].timer_ms = 3001U;
                mgr->nodes[i].online = false;
            } else {
                mgr->nodes[i].timer_ms = (uint16_t)elapsed;
            }
        }
    }

    /* Advance SDO client timeout */
    if (mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_READ ||
        mgr->sdo_client.state == SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_WAIT_WRITE) {
        if (mgr->sdo_client.timeout_ms <= delta_ms) {
            mgr->sdo_client.state = SYN_SDO_CLIENT_STATE_ERROR;
            mgr->sdo_client.abort_code = 0x05040000UL; /* SDO Protocol Timeout */
        } else {
            mgr->sdo_client.timeout_ms -= delta_ms;
        }
    }
}

#include "syn_ccp.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_ccp_init(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint16_t station_addr)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(slave != NULL);

    memset(slave, 0, sizeof(*slave));
    slave->station_addr = station_addr;
    slave->connected = false;
    slave->unlocked_resources = SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_CAL | SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_DAQ | SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_PGM;
}

bool syn_ccp_register_mem_region(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint32_t base_addr, void *host_ptr,
                                 uint32_t size, bool writable)
{
    if (slave == NULL || host_ptr == NULL || size == 0U ||
        slave->region_count >= SYN_CCP_MAX_MEM_REGIONS) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_CCP_MemRegion *reg = &slave->mem_regions[slave->region_count];
    reg->base_addr = base_addr;
    reg->size = size;
    reg->host_ptr = (uint8_t *)host_ptr;
    reg->writable = writable;
    slave->region_count++;
    return true;
}

void syn_ccp_set_mta(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t mta_num, uint8_t ext, uintptr_t addr)
{
    if (slave == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    if (mta_num == 0U) {
        slave->mta0_ext = ext;
        slave->mta0_addr = addr;
        slave->mta0_host_valid = (addr != 0U);
    } else if (mta_num == 1U) {
        slave->mta1_ext = ext;
        slave->mta1_addr = addr;
        slave->mta1_host_valid = (addr != 0U);
    }
}

static int ccp_match_region(const SYN_CCP_MemRegion *reg, uintptr_t addr, uint32_t size,
                            bool is_write, uint8_t **out_ptr)
{
    uint64_t addr64 = (uint64_t)addr;
    uint64_t proto_base = (uint64_t)reg->base_addr;
    uint64_t host_base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)reg->host_ptr;
    uint64_t reg_size = (uint64_t)reg->size;
    uint32_t offset = 0U;
    if ((addr64 >= proto_base) && ((addr64 - proto_base) < reg_size)) {
        offset = (uint32_t)(addr64 - proto_base);
    } else if ((addr64 >= host_base) && ((addr64 - host_base) < reg_size)) {
        offset = (uint32_t)(addr64 - host_base);
    } else {
        return 0;
    }

    if ((uint64_t)size > (reg_size - (uint64_t)offset)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (is_write && !reg->writable) {
        return -1;
    }
    *out_ptr = &reg->host_ptr[offset];
    return 1;
}

static bool ccp_resolve_mem(const SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uintptr_t addr, uint32_t size,
                            bool is_write, bool host_valid, uint8_t **out_ptr)
{
    if (size == 0U) {
        *out_ptr = NULL;
        return true;
    }
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < slave->region_count; i++) {
        int rc = ccp_match_region(&slave->mem_regions[i], addr, size, is_write, out_ptr);
        if (rc != 0) {
            return (rc > 0);
        }
    }
    if (slave->region_count == 0U && host_valid && addr != 0U) {
        *out_ptr = (uint8_t *)addr;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ccp_require_resource(const SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t mask, uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if ((slave->unlocked_resources & mask) == 0U) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_RESOURCE_LOCKED;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static void ccp_handle_disconnect(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, const uint8_t cro[8])
{
    uint8_t mode = cro[2];
    uint16_t target_addr = syn_peek_u16_le(cro, 3);
    if (((target_addr == slave->station_addr) || (target_addr == 0x0000U)) &&
        ((mode == 0x00U) || (mode == 0x01U))) {
        slave->connected = false;
        slave->daq_tick_drained = false;
        for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS; i++) {
            slave->daq_lists[i].running = false;
            slave->daq_lists[i].pending_tx = false;
            slave->daq_lists[i].cycle_counter = 0U;
            slave->daq_lists[i].current_odt_idx = 0U;
        }
    }
}

static void ccp_handle_session_sec(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                                   uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_DISCONNECT) {
        ccp_handle_disconnect(slave, cro);
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_CCP_VERSION) {
        dto_out[3] = 0x02U;
        dto_out[4] = 0x01U;
        return;
    }
    uint8_t avail = SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_CAL | SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_DAQ | SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_PGM;
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_EXCHANGE_ID) {
        dto_out[3] = 0x08U;
        dto_out[4] = 0x00U;
        dto_out[5] = avail;
        dto_out[6] = (uint8_t)(avail & (uint8_t)~slave->unlocked_resources);
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_SEED) {
        uint8_t req_resource = cro[2];
        bool is_unlocked = (slave->unlocked_resources & req_resource) != 0U;
        dto_out[3] = is_unlocked ? 0x00U : 0x01U;
        slave->pending_unlock_resource = req_resource;
        uint32_t seed =
            (slave->seed_cb != NULL) ? slave->seed_cb(req_resource, slave->seed_ctx) : 0x5A5A5A5AU;
        syn_poke_u32_le(seed, dto_out, 4);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t resource = (cro[2] != 0U) ? cro[2] : slave->pending_unlock_resource;
    uint32_t key = syn_peek_u32_le(cro, 4);
    bool valid =
        (slave->unlock_cb != NULL) ? slave->unlock_cb(resource, key, slave->unlock_ctx) : true;
    if (valid) {
        slave->unlocked_resources |= resource;
    } else {
        slave->unlocked_resources = (uint8_t)(slave->unlocked_resources & (uint8_t)~resource);
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_ACCESS_DENIED;
    }
    dto_out[3] = (uint8_t)(avail & (uint8_t)~slave->unlocked_resources);
}

static void ccp_handle_set_mta(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, const uint8_t cro[8])
{
    uint8_t mta_num = cro[2];
    uint8_t ext = cro[3];
    uint32_t addr = syn_peek_u32_le(cro, 4);
    if (mta_num == 0U) {
        slave->mta0_ext = ext;
        if (addr != 0U) {
            slave->mta0_addr = (uintptr_t)addr;
            slave->mta0_host_valid = false;
        }
    } else if (mta_num == 1U) {
        slave->mta1_ext = ext;
        if (addr != 0U) {
            slave->mta1_addr = (uintptr_t)addr;
            slave->mta1_host_valid = false;
        }
    }
}

static void ccp_handle_dnload(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                              uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (!ccp_require_resource(slave, SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_CAL, dto_out)) {
        return;
    }
    uint8_t size = 6U;
    uint8_t src_off = 2U;
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_DNLOAD) {
        size = cro[2];
        src_off = 3U;
        if (size > 5U) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
            return;
        }
    }
    uint8_t *ptr = NULL;
    if (!ccp_resolve_mem(slave, slave->mta0_addr, size, true, slave->mta0_host_valid, &ptr)) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        return;
    }
    if (ptr != NULL) {
        memcpy(ptr, &cro[src_off], size);
        slave->mta0_addr += size;
    }
    dto_out[3] = slave->mta0_ext;
    syn_poke_u32_le((uint32_t)slave->mta0_addr, dto_out, 4);
}

static void ccp_handle_upload(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                              uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    uint8_t size = cro[2];
    if (size > 5U) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_SHORT_UP) {
        uint32_t addr = syn_peek_u32_le(cro, 4);
        slave->mta0_ext = cro[3];
        if (addr != 0U) {
            slave->mta0_addr = (uintptr_t)addr;
            slave->mta0_host_valid = false;
        }
    }
    uint8_t *ptr = NULL;
    if (!ccp_resolve_mem(slave, slave->mta0_addr, size, false, slave->mta0_host_valid, &ptr)) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        return;
    }
    if (ptr != NULL) {
        memcpy(&dto_out[3], ptr, size);
        slave->mta0_addr += size;
    }
}

static void ccp_handle_cal_pgm(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                               uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_SET_CAL_PAGE) {
        if (!ccp_require_resource(slave, SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_CAL, dto_out)) {
            return;
        }
        slave->active_cal_page = (uint8_t)(syn_peek_u32_le(cro, 2) & 0xFFU);
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_ACTIVE_CAL_PAGE) {
        dto_out[3] = 0x00U;
        syn_poke_u32_le((uint32_t)slave->active_cal_page, dto_out, 4);
        return;
    }
    if (!ccp_require_resource(slave, SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_PGM, dto_out)) {
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_CLEAR_MEMORY) {
        uint32_t size = syn_peek_u32_le(cro, 2);
        if (slave->erase_cb != NULL &&
            !slave->erase_cb((uint32_t)slave->mta0_addr, size, slave->erase_ctx)) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        }
        return;
    }
    uint8_t size = cro[2];
    if (size > 5U) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
        return;
    }
    uint8_t *ptr = NULL;
    if (!ccp_resolve_mem(slave, slave->mta0_addr, size, true, slave->mta0_host_valid, &ptr)) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_ACCESS_DENIED;
        return;
    }
    if (ptr != NULL) {
        memcpy(ptr, &cro[3], size);
        slave->mta0_addr += size;
    }
    dto_out[3] = slave->mta0_ext;
    syn_poke_u32_le((uint32_t)slave->mta0_addr, dto_out, 4);
}

static void ccp_handle_daq_run(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                               uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_START_STOP) {
        uint8_t daq_num = cro[3];
        uint16_t prescaler = syn_peek_u16_le(cro, 6);
        if (daq_num >= SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
            return;
        }
        SYN_CCP_DAQList *daq = &slave->daq_lists[daq_num];
        daq->event_channel = cro[5];
        daq->prescaler = (prescaler == 0U) ? 1U : prescaler;
        daq->cycle_counter = 0U;
        daq->current_odt_idx = 0U;
        daq->pending_tx = false;
        daq->running = (cro[2] == 0x01U);
        slave->daq_tick_drained = false;
        return;
    }
    slave->daq_tick_drained = false;
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS; i++) {
        slave->daq_lists[i].running = (cro[2] == 0x01U);
        slave->daq_lists[i].pending_tx = false;
        slave->daq_lists[i].cycle_counter = 0U;
        slave->daq_lists[i].current_odt_idx = 0U;
    }
}

static void ccp_handle_daq_cmd(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                               uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (!ccp_require_resource(slave, SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_DAQ, dto_out)) {
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_DAQ_SIZE) {
        uint8_t daq_num = cro[2];
        if (daq_num >= SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
            return;
        }
        slave->selected_daq = daq_num;
        dto_out[3] = SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ;
        dto_out[4] = (uint8_t)(daq_num * SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ);
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_SET_DAQ_SIZE) {
        uint8_t daq_num = cro[2];
        uint8_t count = cro[4];
        if (daq_num >= SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS || count > SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
            return;
        }
        SYN_CCP_DAQList *daq = &slave->daq_lists[daq_num];
        memset(daq->odts, 0, sizeof(daq->odts));
        daq->odt_count = count;
        daq->current_odt_idx = 0U;
        daq->current_entry_idx = 0U;
        daq->cycle_counter = 0U;
        daq->running = false;
        daq->pending_tx = false;
        dto_out[3] = count;
        dto_out[4] = (uint8_t)(daq_num * SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ);
        return;
    }
    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_BUILD_PKT) {
        uint8_t daq_num = cro[2];
        uint8_t odt_num = cro[3];
        uint8_t elem_idx = cro[4];
        if (daq_num >= SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS || odt_num >= SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ ||
            elem_idx >= SYN_CCP_MAX_ENTRIES_PER_ODT) {
            dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE;
            return;
        }
        SYN_CCP_ODT *odt = &slave->daq_lists[daq_num].odts[odt_num];
        odt->entries[elem_idx].address = slave->mta0_addr;
        odt->entries[elem_idx].size = cro[5];
        odt->entries[elem_idx].host_valid = slave->mta0_host_valid;
        if ((uint8_t)(elem_idx + 1U) > odt->entry_count) {
            odt->entry_count = (uint8_t)(elem_idx + 1U);
        }
        return;
    }
    ccp_handle_daq_run(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
}

static bool ccp_dispatch_mem_cro(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                                 uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_SET_MTA:
        ccp_handle_set_mta(slave, cro);
        return true;
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_DNLOAD:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_DNLOAD_6:
        ccp_handle_dnload(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
        return true;
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_UPLOAD:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_SHORT_UP:
        ccp_handle_upload(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
        return true;
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_SET_CAL_PAGE:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_ACTIVE_CAL_PAGE:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_CLEAR_MEMORY:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_PROGRAM:
        ccp_handle_cal_pgm(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void ccp_dispatch_connected_cro(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t cro[8],
                                       uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (ccp_dispatch_mem_cro(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out)) {
        return;
    }

    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_DISCONNECT:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_CCP_VERSION:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_EXCHANGE_ID:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_SEED:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_UNLOCK:
        ccp_handle_session_sec(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
        break;
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_GET_DAQ_SIZE:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_SET_DAQ_SIZE:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_BUILD_PKT:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_START_STOP:
    case SYN_CCP_CMD_START_STOP_ALL:
        ccp_handle_daq_cmd(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
        break;
    default:
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_CMD_UNKNOWN;
        break;
    }
}

bool syn_ccp_process_cro(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, const uint8_t cro[8], uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    if (slave == NULL || cro == NULL || dto_out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t cmd = cro[0];
    memset(dto_out, 0, 8U);
    dto_out[0] = SYN_CCP_PID_CRM;
    dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_SUCCESS;
    dto_out[2] = cro[1];

    if (cmd == SYN_CCP_CMD_CONNECT) {
        uint16_t target_addr = syn_peek_u16_le(cro, 2);
        if (target_addr != slave->station_addr && target_addr != 0x0000U) {
            return false;
        }
        slave->connected = true;
        return true;
    }

    if (!slave->connected) {
        dto_out[1] = SYN_CCP_ERR_NOT_CONNECTED;
        return true;
    }

    ccp_dispatch_connected_cro(slave, cmd, cro, dto_out);
    return true;
}

static bool ccp_has_pending_event(const SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t event_channel)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS; i++) {
        const SYN_CCP_DAQList *daq = &slave->daq_lists[i];
        if (daq->running && daq->event_channel == event_channel && daq->pending_tx) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static void ccp_step_event_counters(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t event_channel)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS; i++) {
        SYN_CCP_DAQList *daq = &slave->daq_lists[i];
        if (!daq->running || daq->event_channel != event_channel || daq->odt_count == 0U) {
            continue;
        }
        uint16_t prescaler = (daq->prescaler == 0U) ? 1U : daq->prescaler;
        daq->cycle_counter++;
        if (daq->cycle_counter >= prescaler) {
            daq->cycle_counter = 0U;
            daq->pending_tx = true;
            if (daq->current_odt_idx >= daq->odt_count) {
                daq->current_odt_idx = 0U;
            }
        }
    }
}

static void ccp_pack_odt(const SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, const SYN_CCP_ODT *odt, uint8_t pid,
                         uint8_t dto_out[8])
{
    memset(dto_out, 0, 8U);
    dto_out[0] = pid;
    uint8_t payload_pos = 1U;
    for (uint8_t e = 0U; e < odt->entry_count; e++) {
        const SYN_CCP_ODTEntry *entry = &odt->entries[e];
        uint8_t avail = (uint8_t)(8U - payload_pos);
        if (entry->size > avail) {
            break;
        }
        uint8_t *src = NULL;
        if (entry->size > 0U &&
            ccp_resolve_mem(slave, entry->address, entry->size, false, entry->host_valid, &src) &&
            src != NULL) {
            memcpy(&dto_out[payload_pos], src, entry->size);
            payload_pos = (uint8_t)(payload_pos + entry->size);
        }
    }
}

void syn_ccp_daq_event(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t event_channel)
{
    if (slave == NULL || !slave->connected ||
        (slave->unlocked_resources & SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_DAQ) == 0U) {
        return;
    }
    ccp_step_event_counters(slave, event_channel);
    slave->daq_tick_drained = true;
    slave->daq_tick_ch = event_channel;
}

static void ccp_prepare_daq_event(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t event_channel)
{
    if (ccp_has_pending_event(slave, event_channel)) {
        return;
    }
    if (slave->daq_tick_drained && slave->daq_tick_ch == event_channel) {
        slave->daq_tick_drained = false;
        return;
    }
    slave->daq_tick_drained = false;
    ccp_step_event_counters(slave, event_channel);
}

bool syn_ccp_service_daq(SYN_CCP_Slave *slave, uint8_t event_channel, uint8_t dto_out[8],
                         uint8_t *list_idx, uint8_t *odt_idx)
{
    if (slave == NULL || dto_out == NULL || list_idx == NULL || odt_idx == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!slave->connected || (slave->unlocked_resources & SYN_CCP_RESOURCE_DAQ) == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    ccp_prepare_daq_event(slave, event_channel);

    for (uint8_t k = 0U; k < SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS; k++) {
        uint8_t i = (uint8_t)((slave->rr_daq_idx + k) % SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS);
        SYN_CCP_DAQList *daq = &slave->daq_lists[i];
        if (!daq->running || daq->event_channel != event_channel || !daq->pending_tx ||
            daq->odt_count == 0U) {
            continue;
        }

        uint8_t current_odt = daq->current_odt_idx;
        uint8_t pid = (uint8_t)(i * SYN_CCP_MAX_ODT_PER_DAQ + current_odt);
        ccp_pack_odt(slave, &daq->odts[current_odt], pid, dto_out);

        *list_idx = i;
        *odt_idx = current_odt;

        daq->current_odt_idx++;
        if (daq->current_odt_idx >= daq->odt_count) {
            daq->current_odt_idx = 0U;
            daq->pending_tx = false;
            if (!ccp_has_pending_event(slave, event_channel)) {
                slave->daq_tick_drained = true;
                slave->daq_tick_ch = event_channel;
            }
        }
        slave->rr_daq_idx = (uint8_t)((i + 1U) % SYN_CCP_MAX_DAQ_LISTS);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

docs.text: Provides a lightweight, zero-allocation CCP v2.1 slave protocol stack for ECU calibration, live parameter tuning, memory upload/download, and DAQ (Data Acquisition) list streaming over CAN 2.0B.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_CANOPEN) || SYN_USE_CANOPEN


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_cia303.h"

#include <string.h>

/* NMT State constants matching CiA 301 / syn_canopen_mgr */
#ifndef SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STOPPED
#define SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STOPPED 0x04U         
#define SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_OPERATIONAL 0x05U     
#define SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_PRE_OPERATIONAL 0x7FU 
#endif

void syn_cia303_init(SYN_CiA303_Indicator *ind, SYN_LED *run_led, SYN_LED *err_led)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ind != NULL);

    memset(ind, 0, sizeof(*ind));
    ind->run_led = run_led;
    ind->err_led = err_led;
    ind->run_state = SYN_CIA303_RUN_OFF;
    ind->err_state = SYN_CIA303_ERR_OFF;

    if (run_led != NULL)
        syn_led_off(run_led);
    if (err_led != NULL)
        syn_led_off(err_led);
}

void syn_cia303_set_nmt_state(SYN_CiA303_Indicator *ind, uint8_t nmt_state)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ind != NULL);

    switch (nmt_state) {
    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_OPERATIONAL:
        ind->run_state = SYN_CIA303_RUN_SOLID_ON;
        break;

    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_PRE_OPERATIONAL:
        ind->run_state = SYN_CIA303_RUN_BLINKING;
        break;

    case SYN_CANOPEN_NMT_STOPPED:
        ind->run_state = SYN_CIA303_RUN_SINGLE_FLASH;
        break;

    default:
        ind->run_state = SYN_CIA303_RUN_OFF;
        break;
    }

    if (ind->run_led == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    switch (ind->run_state) {
    case SYN_CIA303_RUN_SOLID_ON:
        syn_led_on(ind->run_led);
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_RUN_BLINKING:
        syn_led_blink(ind->run_led, 200U, 200U); /* 200ms ON, 200ms OFF */
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_RUN_SINGLE_FLASH:
        syn_led_blink(ind->run_led, 200U, 1000U); /* 200ms ON, 1000ms OFF */
        break;

    default:
        syn_led_off(ind->run_led);
        break;
    }
}

void syn_cia303_set_error_state(SYN_CiA303_Indicator *ind, SYN_CiA303_ErrState err_state)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ind != NULL);

    ind->err_state = err_state;

    if (ind->err_led == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    switch (err_state) {
    case SYN_CIA303_ERR_SOLID_ON:
        syn_led_on(ind->err_led);
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_ERR_SINGLE_FLASH:
        syn_led_blink(ind->err_led, 200, 1000); /* 200ms ON, 1000ms OFF */
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_ERR_DOUBLE_FLASH:
        /* 2x 200ms pulses (handled in step or repeated blink) */
        syn_led_blink(ind->err_led, 200, 400);
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_ERR_TRIPLE_FLASH:
        syn_led_blink(ind->err_led, 200, 300);
        break;

    case SYN_CIA303_ERR_OFF:
    default:
        syn_led_off(ind->err_led);
        break;
    }
}

void syn_cia303_step(SYN_CiA303_Indicator *ind)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ind != NULL);

    if (ind->run_led != NULL) {
        syn_led_update(ind->run_led);
    }
    if (ind->err_led != NULL) {
        syn_led_update(ind->err_led);
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_CANOPEN */

#include "syn_cia401.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_cia401_init(SYN_CiA401_Device *dev, uint8_t dig_in_bytes, uint8_t dig_out_bytes,
                     uint8_t analog_in_ch, uint8_t analog_out_ch)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(dev != NULL);
    memset(dev, 0, sizeof(*dev));

    dev->digital_in_count =
        (dig_in_bytes > SYN_CIA401_MAX_DIGITAL_8BIT) ? SYN_CIA401_MAX_DIGITAL_8BIT : dig_in_bytes;
    dev->digital_out_count =
        (dig_out_bytes > SYN_CIA401_MAX_DIGITAL_8BIT) ? SYN_CIA401_MAX_DIGITAL_8BIT : dig_out_bytes;
    dev->analog_in_count =
        (analog_in_ch > SYN_CIA401_MAX_ANALOG_16BIT) ? SYN_CIA401_MAX_ANALOG_16BIT : analog_in_ch;
    dev->analog_out_count =
        (analog_out_ch > SYN_CIA401_MAX_ANALOG_16BIT) ? SYN_CIA401_MAX_ANALOG_16BIT : analog_out_ch;
}

size_t syn_cia401_populate_od(SYN_CiA401_Device *dev, SYN_CANOpenODEntry *od_table,
                              size_t max_entries)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(dev != NULL && od_table != NULL);
    size_t count = 0;
    uint8_t i;

    /* 0x6000: Digital Inputs 8-bit */
    for (i = 0; i < dev->digital_in_count && count < max_entries; i++) {
        od_table[count].index = SYN_CIA401_OD_DIGITAL_INPUT_8BIT;
        od_table[count].subindex = i + 1;
        od_table[count].type = SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_U8;
        od_table[count].access = SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO;
        od_table[count].data_ptr = &dev->digital_in[i];
        od_table[count].size = sizeof(uint8_t);
        count++;
    }

    /* 0x6200: Digital Outputs 8-bit */
    for (i = 0; i < dev->digital_out_count && count < max_entries; i++) {
        od_table[count].index = SYN_CIA401_OD_DIGITAL_OUTPUT_8BIT;
        od_table[count].subindex = i + 1;
        od_table[count].type = SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_U8;
        od_table[count].access = SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW;
        od_table[count].data_ptr = &dev->digital_out[i];
        od_table[count].size = sizeof(uint8_t);
        count++;
    }

    /* 0x6401: Analog Inputs 16-bit */
    for (i = 0; i < dev->analog_in_count && count < max_entries; i++) {
        od_table[count].index = SYN_CIA401_OD_ANALOG_INPUT_16BIT;
        od_table[count].subindex = i + 1;
        od_table[count].type = SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I16;
        od_table[count].access = SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO;
        od_table[count].data_ptr = &dev->analog_in[i];
        od_table[count].size = sizeof(int16_t);
        count++;
    }

    /* 0x6411: Analog Outputs 16-bit */
    for (i = 0; i < dev->analog_out_count && count < max_entries; i++) {
        od_table[count].index = SYN_CIA401_OD_ANALOG_OUTPUT_16BIT;
        od_table[count].subindex = i + 1;
        od_table[count].type = SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I16;
        od_table[count].access = SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW;
        od_table[count].data_ptr = &dev->analog_out[i];
        od_table[count].size = sizeof(int16_t);
        count++;
    }

    /* 0x6421: Analog Input Interrupt Delta */
    for (i = 0; i < dev->analog_in_count && count < max_entries; i++) {
        od_table[count].index = SYN_CIA401_OD_ANALOG_INPUT_DELTA;
        od_table[count].subindex = i + 1;
        od_table[count].type = SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I16;
        od_table[count].access = SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW;
        od_table[count].data_ptr = &dev->analog_delta[i];
        od_table[count].size = sizeof(int16_t);
        count++;
    }

    return count;
}

bool syn_cia401_check_analog_delta(SYN_CiA401_Device *dev, uint8_t *channel)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(dev != NULL && channel != NULL);

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < dev->analog_in_count; i++) {
        int32_t diff = (int32_t)dev->analog_in[i] - (int32_t)dev->prev_analog_in[i];
        if (diff < 0) {
            diff = -diff;
        }

        if (dev->analog_delta[i] > 0 && diff >= (int32_t)dev->analog_delta[i]) {
            dev->prev_analog_in[i] = dev->analog_in[i];
            *channel = i;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
