static void cia402_sync_fxp(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis)
{
    if ((int32_t)(axis->current_pos_fxp / SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE) != axis->actual_position) {
        axis->current_pos_fxp = (int64_t)axis->actual_position * SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE;
    }
}

/* ── State Transition Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void cia402_fsm_switch_on_disabled(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, bool sw_on, bool en_volt,
                                          bool q_stop, bool en_op)
{
    if (!en_volt || !q_stop) {
        return;
    }
    if (!sw_on) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON;
        return;
    }
    axis->state = en_op ? SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED : SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCHED_ON;
}

static void cia402_fsm_ready_switched(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, bool sw_on, bool en_volt, bool q_stop,
                                      bool en_op)
{
    if (!en_volt || !q_stop) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
        return;
    }
    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON) {
        if (sw_on) {
            axis->state = en_op ? SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED : SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCHED_ON;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!sw_on) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON;
    } else if (en_op) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED;
    }
}

static void cia402_fsm_op_quickstop(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, bool sw_on, bool en_volt, bool q_stop,
                                    bool en_op)
{
    if (!en_volt) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
        return;
    }
    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_QUICK_STOP_ACTIVE) {
        if (q_stop && sw_on && en_op) {
            axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!q_stop) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_QUICK_STOP_ACTIVE;
    } else if (!sw_on) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON;
    } else if (!en_op) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCHED_ON;
    }
}

static void syn_cia402_eval_fsm(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis)
{
    uint16_t cw = axis->controlword;
    uint16_t prev_cw = axis->prev_controlword;

    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT) {
        if (((cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_FAULT_RESET) != 0U) &&
            ((prev_cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_FAULT_RESET) == 0U)) {
            axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
            axis->error_code = 0U;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT_REACTION_ACTIVE) {
        if (axis->actual_velocity == 0 && (int32_t)axis->current_speed == 0) {
            axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT;
        }
        return;
    }

    bool sw_on = (cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_SWITCH_ON) != 0U;
    bool en_volt = (cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_ENABLE_VOLTAGE) != 0U;
    bool q_stop = (cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_QUICK_STOP) != 0U;
    bool en_op = (cw & SYN_CIA402_CW_ENABLE_OPERATION) != 0U;

    switch (axis->state) {
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_NOT_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON:
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED:
        cia402_fsm_switch_on_disabled(axis, sw_on, en_volt, q_stop, en_op);
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON:
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCHED_ON:
        cia402_fsm_ready_switched(axis, sw_on, en_volt, q_stop, en_op);
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED:
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_QUICK_STOP_ACTIVE:
        cia402_fsm_op_quickstop(axis, sw_on, en_volt, q_stop, en_op);
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

/* ── Statusword Generation ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void syn_cia402_update_statusword(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis)
{
    uint16_t sw = 0U;

    switch (axis->state) {
    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_NOT_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON:
        sw = 0x0000U;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON | SYN_CIA402_SW_QUICK_STOP |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_VOLTAGE_ENABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCHED_ON:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON | SYN_CIA402_SW_SWITCHED_ON |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_QUICK_STOP | SYN_CIA402_SW_VOLTAGE_ENABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON | SYN_CIA402_SW_SWITCHED_ON |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_OPERATION_ENABLED | SYN_CIA402_SW_QUICK_STOP |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_VOLTAGE_ENABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_QUICK_STOP_ACTIVE:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON | SYN_CIA402_SW_SWITCHED_ON |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_OPERATION_ENABLED | SYN_CIA402_SW_VOLTAGE_ENABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT_REACTION_ACTIVE:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON | SYN_CIA402_SW_SWITCHED_ON |
             SYN_CIA402_SW_OPERATION_ENABLED | SYN_CIA402_SW_FAULT | SYN_CIA402_SW_VOLTAGE_ENABLED;
        break;

    case SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT:
        sw = SYN_CIA402_SW_FAULT;
        break;

    default:
        sw = 0x0000U;
        break;
    }

    if (axis->target_reached && axis->state != SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT &&
        axis->state != SYN_CIA402_STATE_NOT_READY_TO_SWITCH_ON &&
        axis->state <= SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT) {
        sw |= SYN_CIA402_SW_TARGET_REACHED;
    }

    if (axis->setpoint_ack) {
        sw |= SYN_CIA402_SW_SETPOINT_ACK;
    }

    axis->statusword = sw;
}

/* ── Public API Implementation ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_cia402_init(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, const SYN_CIA402_Config *cfg)
{
    if (axis == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(axis, 0, sizeof(*axis));
    axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
    axis->mode_of_operation = (int8_t)SYN_CIA402_MODE_NO_MODE;
    axis->mode_of_operation_disp = (int8_t)SYN_CIA402_MODE_NO_MODE;
    axis->target_reached = true;
    axis->quick_stop_option = 2;

    axis->sw_limits_enabled = cfg->sw_limits_enabled;
    axis->sw_limit_min = cfg->sw_limit_min;
    axis->sw_limit_max = cfg->sw_limit_max;
    axis->profile_vel = (cfg->max_profile_velocity > 0U) ? cfg->max_profile_velocity : 1000U;
    axis->profile_acc = (cfg->profile_acceleration > 0U) ? cfg->profile_acceleration : 5000U;
    axis->profile_dec = (cfg->profile_deceleration > 0U) ? cfg->profile_deceleration : 5000U;
    axis->quick_stop_dec =
        (cfg->quick_stop_deceleration > 0U) ? cfg->quick_stop_deceleration : 10000U;
    axis->following_err_win = cfg->following_err_window;
    axis->position_window = (cfg->position_window > 0U) ? cfg->position_window : 5U;
    axis->max_torque = (cfg->max_torque > 0U) ? cfg->max_torque : 1000U;
    axis->torque_slope = (cfg->torque_slope > 0U) ? cfg->torque_slope : 10000U;

    syn_cia402_update_statusword(axis);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_cia402_set_controlword(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint16_t cw)
{
    if (axis == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    syn_cia402_eval_fsm(axis);
    syn_cia402_update_statusword(axis);
    axis->prev_controlword = cw;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void cia402_step_quick_stop(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, float dt_s)
{
    float dec = (float)((axis->quick_stop_dec > 0U) ? axis->quick_stop_dec : 10000U);
    float delta_v = dec * dt_s;

    if (axis->current_speed > 0.0f) {
        axis->current_speed =
            (axis->current_speed > delta_v) ? (axis->current_speed - delta_v) : 0.0f;
    } else if (axis->current_speed < 0.0f) {
        axis->current_speed =
            (-axis->current_speed > delta_v) ? (axis->current_speed + delta_v) : 0.0f;
    }

    axis->actual_velocity = (int32_t)axis->current_speed;
    if (axis->actual_velocity == 0) {
        axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_SWITCH_ON_DISABLED;
        axis->target_reached = true;
    }
}

static void cia402_step_pp(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint32_t eff_dt_us)
{
    cia402_sync_fxp(axis);
    if ((axis->controlword & SYN_CIA402_CW_NEW_SETPOINT) != 0U) {
        axis->setpoint_ack = true;
        axis->target_reached = false;
    } else {
        axis->setpoint_ack = false;
    }

    uint64_t max_v = (axis->profile_vel > 0U) ? (uint64_t)axis->profile_vel : 1000ULL;
    uint64_t prod = max_v * (uint64_t)eff_dt_us;
    uint64_t step_fxp = ((prod / 1000000ULL) * (uint64_t)SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE) +
                        (((prod % 1000000ULL) * (uint64_t)SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE) / 1000000ULL);
    int64_t target_fxp = (int64_t)axis->target_position * SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE;
    uint64_t abs_diff = (target_fxp >= axis->current_pos_fxp)
                            ? ((uint64_t)target_fxp - (uint64_t)axis->current_pos_fxp)
                            : ((uint64_t)axis->current_pos_fxp - (uint64_t)target_fxp);

    if (abs_diff <= step_fxp) {
        axis->current_pos_fxp = target_fxp;
        axis->actual_position = axis->target_position;
        axis->actual_velocity = 0;
        axis->current_speed = 0.0f;
        axis->target_reached = true;
    } else if (target_fxp > axis->current_pos_fxp) {
        axis->current_pos_fxp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)axis->current_pos_fxp + step_fxp);
        axis->actual_position = (int32_t)(axis->current_pos_fxp / SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE);
        axis->actual_velocity = (int32_t)max_v;
        axis->current_speed = (float)max_v;
        axis->target_reached = false;
    } else {
        axis->current_pos_fxp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)axis->current_pos_fxp - step_fxp);
        axis->actual_position = (int32_t)(axis->current_pos_fxp / SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE);
        axis->actual_velocity = -(int32_t)max_v;
        axis->current_speed = -(float)max_v;
        axis->target_reached = false;
    }
}

static void cia402_step_pv(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, float dt_s)
{
    cia402_sync_fxp(axis);
    float target_v = (float)axis->target_velocity;
    float acc = (float)((axis->profile_acc > 0U) ? axis->profile_acc : 1000U);
    float dec = (float)((axis->profile_dec > 0U) ? axis->profile_dec : 1000U);

    if (axis->current_speed < target_v) {
        axis->current_speed += acc * dt_s;
        if (axis->current_speed > target_v) {
            axis->current_speed = target_v;
        }
    } else if (axis->current_speed > target_v) {
        axis->current_speed -= dec * dt_s;
        if (axis->current_speed < target_v) {
            axis->current_speed = target_v;
        }
    }

    axis->actual_velocity = (int32_t)axis->current_speed;
    int64_t delta_fxp = (int64_t)(axis->current_speed * dt_s * (float)SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE);
    axis->current_pos_fxp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)axis->current_pos_fxp + (uint64_t)delta_fxp);
    axis->actual_position = (int32_t)(axis->current_pos_fxp / SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE);
    axis->target_reached = (axis->current_speed == target_v);
}

static void cia402_step_op_enabled(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint32_t eff_dt_us, float dt_s)
{
    axis->mode_of_operation_disp = axis->mode_of_operation;

    switch (axis->mode_of_operation) {
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_PROFILE_POSITION:
        cia402_step_pp(axis, eff_dt_us);
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_PROFILE_VELOCITY:
        cia402_step_pv(axis, dt_s);
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_PROFILE_TORQUE:
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_CYCLIC_SYNC_TORQUE:
        axis->actual_torque = axis->target_torque;
        axis->target_reached = true;
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_CYCLIC_SYNC_POSITION:
        axis->actual_position = axis->target_position;
        axis->current_pos_fxp = (int64_t)axis->target_position * SYN_CIA402_FXP_ONE;
        axis->target_reached = true;
        break;
    case SYN_CIA402_MODE_CYCLIC_SYNC_VELOCITY:
        axis->actual_velocity = axis->target_velocity;
        axis->target_reached = true;
        break;
    default:
        axis->target_reached = true;
        break;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_cia402_step(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint32_t dt_us,
                           SYN_CIA402_Setpoints *out_setpoints)
{
    if (axis == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t eff_dt_us = (dt_us > 0U) ? dt_us : 1000U;
    float dt_s = (float)eff_dt_us / 1000000.0f;

    /* Evaluate FSM only if controlword changed or during fault reaction */
    if (axis->controlword != axis->prev_controlword ||
        axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT_REACTION_ACTIVE) {
        syn_cia402_eval_fsm(axis);
    }

    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_QUICK_STOP_ACTIVE) {
        cia402_step_quick_stop(axis, dt_s);
        syn_cia402_update_statusword(axis);
        axis->prev_controlword = axis->controlword;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED) {
        cia402_step_op_enabled(axis, eff_dt_us, dt_s);
    }

    syn_cia402_update_statusword(axis);
    axis->prev_controlword = axis->controlword;

    if (out_setpoints != NULL) {
        out_setpoints->power_enabled = (axis->state == SYN_CIA402_STATE_OPERATION_ENABLED);
        out_setpoints->brake_released = out_setpoints->power_enabled;
        out_setpoints->mode = (SYN_CIA402_Mode)axis->mode_of_operation_disp;
        out_setpoints->position_cmd = axis->actual_position;
        out_setpoints->velocity_cmd = axis->actual_velocity;
        out_setpoints->torque_cmd = axis->actual_torque;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_cia402_update(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (axis == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint64_t raw_us = (dt_ms > 0U) ? ((uint64_t)dt_ms * 1000ULL) : 1000ULL;
    uint32_t dt_us = (raw_us > (uint64_t)UINT32_MAX) ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)raw_us;
    return syn_cia402_step(axis, dt_us, NULL);
}

SYN_Status syn_cia402_trigger_fault(SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis, uint16_t error_code)
{
    if (axis == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    axis->error_code = error_code;
    axis->state = SYN_CIA402_STATE_FAULT;
    syn_cia402_update_statusword(axis);
    return SYN_OK;
}

size_t syn_cia402_populate_od(SYN_CANOpenODEntry *od_table, size_t max_entries,
                              SYN_CIA402_Axis *axis)
{
    if (od_table == NULL || axis == NULL || max_entries < 10U) {
        return 0U;
    }

    size_t count = 0;

    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_CONTROLWORD, 0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_U16,      SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW,
                                             &axis->controlword,        sizeof(axis->controlword)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_STATUSWORD, 0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_U16,     SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO,
                                             &axis->statusword,        sizeof(axis->statusword)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_MODES_OF_OPERATION,
                                             0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I8,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW,
                                             &axis->mode_of_operation,
                                             sizeof(axis->mode_of_operation)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_MODES_OF_OPERATION_DISPLAY,
                                             0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I8,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO,
                                             &axis->mode_of_operation_disp,
                                             sizeof(axis->mode_of_operation_disp)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_POSITION_ACTUAL_VALUE,
                                             0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I32,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO,
                                             &axis->actual_position,
                                             sizeof(axis->actual_position)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_VELOCITY_ACTUAL_VALUE,
                                             0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I32,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO,
                                             &axis->actual_velocity,
                                             sizeof(axis->actual_velocity)};
    od_table[count++] =
        (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_TARGET_TORQUE, 0x00U,
                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I16,        SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW,
                             &axis->target_torque,        sizeof(axis->target_torque)};
    od_table[count++] = (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_TORQUE_ACTUAL_VALUE,
                                             0x00U,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I16,
                                             SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RO,
                                             &axis->actual_torque,
                                             sizeof(axis->actual_torque)};
    od_table[count++] =
        (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_TARGET_POSITION, 0x00U,
                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I32,          SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW,
                             &axis->target_position,        sizeof(axis->target_position)};
    od_table[count++] =
        (SYN_CANOpenODEntry){SYN_CIA402_OD_TARGET_VELOCITY, 0x00U,
                             SYN_CANOPEN_TYPE_I32,          SYN_CANOPEN_ACCESS_RW,
                             &axis->target_velocity,        sizeof(axis->target_velocity)};

    return count;
}

#else
typedef int syn_cia402_dummy_t;
#endif /* SYN_USE_CIA402 */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic CiA 402 Drive Finite State Machine (Controlword 0x6040 / Statusword 0x6041), Motion Modes of Operation (PP, PV, PT, HM, CSP, CSV, CST), trapezoidal trajectory generation, following error supervision, and standard CANopen Object Dictionary binding.

#include "syn_cjt188.h"

#include "../util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>

uint8_t syn_cjt188_checksum(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!buf || len == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t sum = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        sum += buf[i];
    }
    return (uint8_t)(sum & 0xFFU);
}

size_t syn_cjt188_encode_read_req(uint8_t *out_buf, size_t buf_size, uint8_t meter_type,
                                  const uint8_t meter_id[5], const uint8_t vendor_id[2],
                                  uint16_t data_id, uint8_t seq)
{
    /*
     * Frame layout with 4-byte preamble:
     * [0..3]   FE FE FE FE
     * [4]      68 (Start)
     * [5]      Meter Type (T)
     * [6..10]  Meter ID (5 bytes)
     * [11..12] Vendor ID (2 bytes)
     * [13]     Control Code C (0x01)
     * [14]     Length L (0x03)
     * [15..16] Data ID DI (2 bytes: e.g. 0x1F, 0x90)
     * [17]     SER Sequence Number
     * [18]     CS Checksum (sum from byte 4 to 17)
     * [19]     16 (End)
     * Total length: 20 bytes
     */
    if (!out_buf || !meter_id || !vendor_id || buf_size < 20) {
        return 0;
    }

    /* Preamble */
    out_buf[0] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[1] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[2] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[3] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;

    /* Start of CJ/T 188 frame */
    size_t start_idx = 4;
    out_buf[start_idx] = SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE;
    out_buf[start_idx + 1] = meter_type;

    memcpy(&out_buf[start_idx + 2], meter_id, 5);
    memcpy(&out_buf[start_idx + 7], vendor_id, 2);

    out_buf[start_idx + 9] = SYN_CJT188_CTRL_READ_DATA;
    out_buf[start_idx + 10] = 0x03; /* Fixed length: Data ID (2) + SER (1) */

    /* Data ID in little-endian byte order as per CJ/T 188 standard */
    out_buf[start_idx + 11] = (uint8_t)(data_id & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[start_idx + 12] = (uint8_t)((data_id >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[start_idx + 13] = seq;

    /* Compute CS over [start_idx .. start_idx + 13] (14 bytes total) */
    uint8_t cs = syn_cjt188_checksum(&out_buf[start_idx], 14);
    out_buf[start_idx + 14] = cs;
    out_buf[start_idx + 15] = SYN_CJT188_END_BYTE;

    return 20;
}

size_t syn_cjt188_encode_valve_ctrl(uint8_t *out_buf, size_t buf_size, uint8_t meter_type,
                                    const uint8_t meter_id[5], const uint8_t vendor_id[2],
                                    bool open_valve, uint8_t seq)
{
    /*
     * Frame layout with 4-byte preamble:
     * [0..3]   FE FE FE FE
     * [4]      68 (Start)
     * [5]      Meter Type (T)
     * [6..10]  Meter ID (5 bytes)
     * [11..12] Vendor ID (2 bytes)
     * [13]     Control Code C (0x04)
     * [14]     Length L (0x04: DI(2) + SER(1) + Cmd(1))
     * [15..16] Data ID (0x17, 0xA0)
     * [17]     SER Sequence Number
     * [18]     Command byte (0x55 Open / 0x99 Close)
     * [19]     CS Checksum
     * [20]     16 (End)
     * Total length: 21 bytes
     */
    if (!out_buf || !meter_id || !vendor_id || buf_size < 21) {
        return 0;
    }

    out_buf[0] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[1] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[2] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;
    out_buf[3] = SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE;

    size_t start_idx = 4;
    out_buf[start_idx] = SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE;
    out_buf[start_idx + 1] = meter_type;

    memcpy(&out_buf[start_idx + 2], meter_id, 5);
    memcpy(&out_buf[start_idx + 7], vendor_id, 2);

    out_buf[start_idx + 9] = SYN_CJT188_CTRL_WRITE_DATA;
    out_buf[start_idx + 10] = 0x04; /* DI (2) + SER (1) + Cmd (1) */

    out_buf[start_idx + 11] = (uint8_t)(SYN_CJT188_DI_VALVE_CONTROL & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[start_idx + 12] = (uint8_t)((SYN_CJT188_DI_VALVE_CONTROL >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    out_buf[start_idx + 13] = seq;
    out_buf[start_idx + 14] = open_valve ? SYN_CJT188_VALVE_OPEN : SYN_CJT188_VALVE_CLOSE;

    uint8_t cs = syn_cjt188_checksum(&out_buf[start_idx], 15);
    out_buf[start_idx + 15] = cs;
    out_buf[start_idx + 16] = SYN_CJT188_END_BYTE;

    return 21;
}

bool syn_cjt188_parse_frame(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, SYN_CJT188_Frame *out_frame)
{
    if (!buf || !out_frame || len < SYN_CJT188_MIN_FRAME_SIZE) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Skip leading 0xFE preamble bytes if present */
    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < len && buf[offset] == SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE) {
        offset++;
    }

    if ((len - offset) < SYN_CJT188_MIN_FRAME_SIZE) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Verify Start Byte 0x68 */
    if (buf[offset] != SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t data_len = buf[offset + 10];
    size_t expected_total = 11 + data_len + 2; /* 11 header bytes + L + CS + 16 */

    if ((len - offset) < expected_total) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Verify End Byte 0x16 */
    if (buf[offset + expected_total - 1] != SYN_CJT188_END_BYTE) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Verify Checksum */
    uint8_t expected_cs = buf[offset + expected_total - 2];
    uint8_t actual_cs = syn_cjt188_checksum(&buf[offset], 11 + data_len);
    if (expected_cs != actual_cs) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Populate frame structure */
    out_frame->meter_type = buf[offset + 1];
    memcpy(out_frame->meter_id, &buf[offset + 2], 5);
    memcpy(out_frame->vendor_id, &buf[offset + 7], 2);
    out_frame->ctrl = buf[offset + 9];
    out_frame->len = (uint8_t)data_len;

    if (data_len >= 3) {
        out_frame->data_id = (uint16_t)buf[offset + 11] | ((uint16_t)buf[offset + 12] << 8);
        out_frame->seq = buf[offset + 13];
        out_frame->payload = &buf[offset + 14];
        out_frame->payload_len = data_len - 3;
    } else {
        out_frame->data_id = 0;
        out_frame->seq = 0;
        out_frame->payload = NULL;
        out_frame->payload_len = 0;
    }

    return true;
}

static void cjt188_reset_state(SYN_CJT188_Decoder *decoder)
{
    decoder->in_frame = false;
    decoder->index = 0U;
    decoder->expected_len = 0U;
}

static void cjt188_resync(SYN_CJT188_Decoder *decoder)
{
    while (decoder->index > 1U) {
        size_t next_sof = 0U;
        for (size_t i = 1U; i < decoder->index; i++) {
            if (decoder->buf[i] == SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE) {
                next_sof = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (next_sof == 0U) {
            break;
        }

        size_t rem = decoder->index - next_sof;
        (void)memmove(decoder->buf, &decoder->buf[next_sof], rem);
        decoder->index = rem;
        decoder->in_frame = true;

        if (decoder->index < 11U) {
            decoder->expected_len = 0U;
            return;
        }

        decoder->expected_len = 11U + (size_t)decoder->buf[10] + 2U;
        if (decoder->expected_len <= SYN_CJT188_MAX_FRAME_SIZE) {
            return;
        }
    }
    cjt188_reset_state(decoder);
}

void syn_cjt188_decoder_init(SYN_CJT188_Decoder *decoder)
{
    if (decoder != NULL) {
        memset(decoder, 0, sizeof(SYN_CJT188_Decoder));
    }
}

bool syn_cjt188_decoder_feed(SYN_CJT188_Decoder *decoder, uint8_t byte, SYN_CJT188_Frame *out_frame)
{
    if (!decoder || !out_frame) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Handle preamble bytes */
    if (!decoder->in_frame) {
        if (byte == SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE) {
            return false; /* Ignore preamble */
        }
        if (byte == SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE) {
            decoder->in_frame = true;
            decoder->index = 0U;
            decoder->buf[decoder->index++] = byte;
            decoder->expected_len = 0U;
            return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /* Collect frame bytes */
    if (decoder->index < SYN_CJT188_MAX_FRAME_SIZE) {
        decoder->buf[decoder->index++] = byte;
    } else {
        /* Buffer overflow, reset decoder state */
        cjt188_reset_state(decoder);
        return false;
    }

    /* Read length byte once offset 10 is reached */
    if (decoder->index == 11U) {
        uint8_t data_len = decoder->buf[10];
        decoder->expected_len = 11U + (size_t)data_len + 2U; /* 11 header + L + CS + 0x16 */
        if (decoder->expected_len > SYN_CJT188_MAX_FRAME_SIZE) {
            cjt188_resync(decoder);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /* Attempt parsing and resync across buffered 0x68 candidates on framing/checksum failure */
    while ((decoder->expected_len > 0U) && (decoder->index >= decoder->expected_len)) {
        if (syn_cjt188_parse_frame(decoder->buf, decoder->expected_len, out_frame)) {
            cjt188_reset_state(decoder);
            return true;
        }
        cjt188_resync(decoder);
    }

    return false;
}

docs.text: Implements non-blocking, zero-malloc CJ/T 188 protocol framing, data encoding, valve control commands, 8-bit checksum verification, and streaming UART decoding for cold water, hot water, heat, and gas meters.

#endif

#define SYN_CJT188_METER_HOT_WATER 0x11U       
#define SYN_CJT188_METER_DRINK_WATER 0x12U     
#define SYN_CJT188_METER_RECLAIMED_WATER 0x13U 
#define SYN_CJT188_METER_HEAT 0x20U

#define SYN_CJT188_METER_GAS 0x30U             
#define SYN_CJT188_METER_POWER 0x40U           

/* ── Control Codes (C) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_READ_DATA 0x01U       
#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_READ_DATA_RESP 0x81U  
#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_WRITE_DATA 0x04U      
#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_WRITE_DATA_RESP 0x84U 
#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_WRITE_ADDR 0x15U      
#define SYN_CJT188_CTRL_WRITE_ADDR_RESP 0x95U 

/* ── Data Identifiers (DI) ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_CJT188_DI_READ_METER_DATA 0x901FU 
#define SYN_CJT188_DI_READ_HIST_DATA 0xD120U  
#define SYN_CJT188_DI_VALVE_CONTROL 0xA017U   

/* ── Valve Control Function Codes ───────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_CJT188_VALVE_OPEN 0x55U  
#define SYN_CJT188_VALVE_CLOSE 0x99U 

/* ── Framing Delimiters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_CJT188_PREAMBLE_BYTE 0xFEU 
#define SYN_CJT188_START_BYTE 0x68U    
#define SYN_CJT188_END_BYTE 0x16U      
#define SYN_CJT188_MIN_FRAME_SIZE 13U  
#define SYN_CJT188_MAX_FRAME_SIZE 128U 

/* ── Data Structures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint8_t meter_type;     
    uint8_t meter_id[5];    
    uint8_t vendor_id[2];   
    uint8_t ctrl;           
    uint8_t len;

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_COBS) || SYN_USE_COBS


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_cobs.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── One-shot encode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

size_t syn_cobs_encode(const void *src, size_t src_len, void *dst)
{
    if (src == NULL || dst == NULL || src_len == 0)
        return 0;

    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;

    uint8_t *code_ptr = d++; /* pointer to the code byte */
    uint8_t code = 1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < src_len; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 0x00) {
            /* End of a run — write code byte */
            *code_ptr = code;
            code_ptr = d++;
            code = 1;
        } else {
            *d++ = s[i];
            code++;
            if (code == 0xFF) {
                /* Max run length — emit and start new run */
                *code_ptr = code;
                code_ptr = d++;
                code = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    *code_ptr = code;

    return (size_t)(d - (uint8_t *)dst);
}

/* ── One-shot decode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

size_t syn_cobs_decode(const void *src, size_t src_len, void *dst)
{
    if (src == NULL || dst == NULL || src_len == 0)
        return 0;

    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    size_t remaining = src_len;

    while (remaining > 0) {
        uint8_t code = *s++;
        remaining--;

        if (code == 0) {
            /* Invalid: 0x00 inside encoded data */
            return 0;
        }

        uint8_t run = (uint8_t)(code - 1);
        if (run > remaining) {
            return 0; /* malformed */
        }

        memmove(d, s, run);
        d += run;
        s += run;
        remaining -= run;

        if (code < 0xFF && remaining > 0) {
            *d++ = 0x00; /* restore the zero */
        }
    }

    return (size_t)(d - (uint8_t *)dst);
}

/* ── Streaming decoder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_cobs_decoder_init(SYN_COBS_Decoder *dec, uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_size,
                           SYN_COBS_PacketCallback callback, void *ctx)
{
    if (dec == NULL || buf == NULL || buf_size == 0) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(dec != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(buf_size > 0);

    dec->buf = buf;
    dec->buf_size = buf_size;
    dec->idx = 0;
    dec->overflow = false;
    dec->callback = callback;
    dec->ctx = ctx;
}

void syn_cobs_decoder_feed(SYN_COBS_Decoder *dec, uint8_t byte)
{
    if (dec == NULL || dec->buf == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(dec != NULL);

    if (byte == 0x00) {
        /* Delimiter — decode accumulated data if not in overflow state */
        if (!dec->overflow && dec->idx > 0 && dec->callback != NULL) {
            /* Decode in-place */
            size_t dec_len = syn_cobs_decode(dec->buf, dec->idx, dec->buf);
            if (dec_len > 0) {
                dec->callback(dec->buf, dec_len, dec->ctx);
            }
        }
        dec->idx = 0;
        dec->overflow = false;
    } else {
        /* Accumulate */
        if (!dec->overflow) {
            if (dec->idx < dec->buf_size) {
                dec->buf[dec->idx++] = byte;
            } else {
                /* Overflow — mark overflow and discard all bytes until next delimiter */
                dec->overflow = true;
                dec->idx = 0;
            }
        }
    }
}

void syn_cobs_decoder_reset(SYN_COBS_Decoder *dec)
{
    if (dec == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    SYN_ASSERT(dec != NULL);
    dec->idx = 0;
    dec->overflow = false;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_COBS */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Turns an arbitrary byte stream into framed packets separated by 0x00 delimiters, with zero bytes inside replaced by run-length codes. Overhead is exactly 1 byte per 254 data bytes.

Use this over UART, RS-485, or any byte-oriented link where you need reliable packet boundaries.

** **

// Encode a packet
uint8_t encoded[256];
size_t enc_len = syn_cobs_encode(data, data_len, encoded);

// Decode a packet
uint8_t decoded[256];
size_t dec_len = syn_cobs_decode(encoded, enc_len, decoded);

// Streaming decoder (byte-at-a-time from UART RX)
SYN_COBS_Decoder dec;
syn_cobs_decoder_init(&dec, rx_buf, sizeof(rx_buf), on_packet, NULL);
syn_cobs_decoder_feed(&dec, byte);

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_cose.h"

#if SYN_COSE_ENABLED

#include "syntropic/util/syn_random.h"

#include <string.h>


static void syn_secure_zero(void *v, size_t n)
{
    volatile uint8_t *p = (volatile uint8_t *)v;
    while (n-- > 0U) {
        *p++ = 0U;
    }
}

/* Parse protected CBOR header map and extract COSE algorithm label (1) */
static bool cose_parse_protected_alg(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, SYN_COSE_Algorithm *alg_out)
{
    *alg_out = SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN;
    if (len == 0U) {
        return true;
    }

    SYN_CborReader pr;
    syn_cbor_reader_init(&pr, buf, len);
    size_t pairs = syn_cbor_read_map_begin(&pr);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&pr)) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < pairs && syn_cbor_reader_ok(&pr); i++) {
        uint64_t label = syn_cbor_read_uint(&pr);
        if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&pr)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (label == SYN_COSE_HEADER_ALG) {
            *alg_out = (SYN_COSE_Algorithm)syn_cbor_read_int(&pr);
        } else {
            syn_cbor_skip(&pr);
        }
    }

    return syn_cbor_reader_ok(&pr);
}

/* Parse unprotected header map for Sign1 / Mac0 (extracting optional kid) */
static bool cose_parse_unprot_kid(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t kid[SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN],
                                  size_t *kid_len)
{
    *kid_len = 0U;
    size_t pairs = syn_cbor_read_map_begin(r);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r)) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < pairs && syn_cbor_reader_ok(r); i++) {
        uint64_t label = syn_cbor_read_uint(r);
        if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (label == SYN_COSE_HEADER_KID) {
            *kid_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, kid, SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN);
            if (*kid_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN) {
                return false;
            }
        } else {
            syn_cbor_skip(r);
        }
    }

    return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
}

/* Parse unprotected header map for Encrypt0 (extracting IV and optional kid) */
static bool cose_parse_unprot_enc0(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t iv[SYN_COSE_MAX_IV_LEN],
                                   size_t *iv_len, uint8_t kid[SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN],
                                   size_t *kid_len)
{
    *iv_len = 0U;
    *kid_len = 0U;
    size_t pairs = syn_cbor_read_map_begin(r);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r)) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < pairs && syn_cbor_reader_ok(r); i++) {
        uint64_t label = syn_cbor_read_uint(r);
        if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (label == SYN_COSE_HEADER_IV) {
            *iv_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, iv, SYN_COSE_MAX_IV_LEN);
            if (*iv_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_IV_LEN) {
                return false;
            }
        } else if (label == SYN_COSE_HEADER_KID) {
            *kid_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, kid, SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN);
            if (*kid_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN) {
                return false;
            }
        } else {
            syn_cbor_skip(r);
        }
    }

    return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
}

/* Resolve key length, tag length, and CCM flag for COSE_Encrypt0 algorithms */
static bool cose_enc0_alg_params(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, size_t *key_len, size_t *tag_len,
                                 bool *is_ccm)
{
    *tag_len = 16U;
    *is_ccm = false;

    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_CHACHA20_POLY1305) {
        *key_len = 32U;
        return true;
    }
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_A128GCM || alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_64_128 ||
        alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_128_128) {
        *key_len = 16U;
        *is_ccm = (alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_A128GCM);
        if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_64_128) {
            *tag_len = 8U;
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_A192GCM) {
        *key_len = 24U;
        return true;
    }
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_A256GCM || alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_64_256 ||
        alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_128_256) {
        *key_len = 32U;
        *is_ccm = (alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_A256GCM);
        if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_AES_CCM_16_64_256) {
            *tag_len = 8U;
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

/* Execute authenticated encryption for COSE_Encrypt0 (all bounds pre-validated by caller) */
static void cose_aead_encrypt(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, size_t key_len, size_t tag_len, bool is_ccm,
                              const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iv, size_t iv_len,
                              const uint8_t *aad, size_t aad_len, const uint8_t *pt, size_t pt_len,
                              uint8_t *ct_out, uint8_t tag[16])
{
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_CHACHA20_POLY1305) {
        if (pt_len > 0U && pt != NULL) {
            syn_aead_encrypt(key, iv, aad, aad_len, pt, pt_len, ct_out, tag);
        } else {
            syn_aead_encrypt(key, iv, aad, aad_len, NULL, 0U, NULL, tag);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (is_ccm) {
        SYN_AES_Context aes_ctx;
        (void)syn_aes_init(&aes_ctx, key, key_len);
        (void)syn_aes_ccm_encrypt(&aes_ctx, iv, iv_len, aad, aad_len, pt, pt_len, ct_out, tag,
                                  tag_len);
        syn_secure_zero(&aes_ctx, sizeof(aes_ctx));
        return;
    }
    SYN_AES_GCM_Context gcm_ctx;
    (void)syn_aes_gcm_init(&gcm_ctx, key, key_len);
    (void)syn_aes_gcm_encrypt(&gcm_ctx, iv, iv_len, aad, aad_len, pt, pt_len, ct_out, tag);
    syn_secure_zero(&gcm_ctx, sizeof(gcm_ctx));
}

/* Execute authenticated decryption for COSE_Encrypt0 */
static SYN_Status cose_aead_decrypt(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, size_t key_len, size_t tag_len,
                                    bool is_ccm, const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iv,
                                    size_t iv_len, const uint8_t *aad, size_t aad_len,
                                    const uint8_t *ct, size_t pt_len, const uint8_t *tag,
                                    uint8_t *pt_out)
{
    uint8_t dummy_pt = 0U;
    uint8_t *dst = (pt_out != NULL) ? pt_out : &dummy_pt;

    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_CHACHA20_POLY1305) {
        return syn_aead_decrypt(key, iv, aad, aad_len, ct, pt_len, tag, dst) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (is_ccm) {
        SYN_AES_Context aes_ctx;
        SYN_Status st = syn_aes_init(&aes_ctx, key, key_len);
        if (st == SYN_OK) {
            st = syn_aes_ccm_decrypt(&aes_ctx, iv, iv_len, aad, aad_len, ct, pt_len, tag, tag_len,
                                     dst);
        }
        syn_secure_zero(&aes_ctx, sizeof(aes_ctx));
        return (st == SYN_OK) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
    }
    SYN_AES_GCM_Context gcm_ctx;
    SYN_Status st = syn_aes_gcm_init(&gcm_ctx, key, key_len);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        st = syn_aes_gcm_decrypt(&gcm_ctx, iv, iv_len, aad, aad_len, ct, pt_len, dst, tag);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(&gcm_ctx, sizeof(gcm_ctx));
    return (st == SYN_OK) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
}

static bool cose_read_tagged_array(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t expected_tag, size_t expected_items)
{
    uint8_t b = r->buf[r->pos];
    if ((b >> 5U) == 6U) {
        uint8_t info = b & 0x1FU;
        uint8_t tag_val = 0U;
        if (info <= 23U) {
            tag_val = info;
            r->pos += 1U;
        } else if (info == 24U && (r->len - r->pos) >= 2U) {
            tag_val = r->buf[r->pos + 1U];
            r->pos += 2U;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
        if (tag_val != expected_tag) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    size_t array_items = syn_cbor_read_array_begin(r);
    return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r) && (array_items == expected_items);
}

/* Read bounded byte string field in COSE_Key map */
static bool cose_key_read_bounded(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t *dst, size_t cap, size_t *out_len)
{
    size_t n = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, dst, cap);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r) || n > cap) {
        return false;
    }
    *out_len = n;
    return true;
}

static bool cose_key_decode_neg1(SYN_CborReader *r, SYN_COSE_Key *key_out, uint8_t *neg1_kind)
{
    if (*neg1_kind != 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (syn_cbor_peek_type(r) == SYN_CBOR_BYTES) {
        *neg1_kind = 2U;
        return cose_key_read_bounded(r, key_out->priv_d, sizeof(key_out->priv_d),
                                     &key_out->priv_d_len);
    }
    *neg1_kind = 1U;
    key_out->crv = (SYN_COSE_Curve)syn_cbor_read_int(r);
    return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
}

/* Decode one label/value entry of a COSE_Key map */
static bool cose_key_decode_entry(SYN_CborReader *r, int64_t label, SYN_COSE_Key *key_out,
                                  uint8_t *neg1_kind)
{
    switch (label) {
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_KTY:
        key_out->kty = (SYN_COSE_KeyType)syn_cbor_read_int(r);
        return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_KID:
        return cose_key_read_bounded(r, key_out->kid, sizeof(key_out->kid), &key_out->kid_len);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_ALG:
        key_out->alg = (SYN_COSE_Algorithm)syn_cbor_read_int(r);
        return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_CRV:
        return cose_key_decode_neg1(r, key_out, neg1_kind);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_X:
        return cose_key_read_bounded(r, key_out->pub_x, sizeof(key_out->pub_x),
                                     &key_out->pub_x_len);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_Y:
        return cose_key_read_bounded(r, key_out->pub_y, sizeof(key_out->pub_y),
                                     &key_out->pub_y_len);
    case SYN_COSE_KEY_D:
        return cose_key_read_bounded(r, key_out->priv_d, sizeof(key_out->priv_d),
                                     &key_out->priv_d_len);
    default:
        syn_cbor_skip(r);
        return syn_cbor_reader_ok(r);
    }
}

/* Build serialized Sig_structure per RFC 9052 Section 4.4 */
static bool build_sig_structure(const uint8_t *body_protected, size_t body_protected_len,
                                const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len, uint8_t *out_buf,
                                size_t out_buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);

    /* Sig_structure is an array of 4 elements */
    syn_cbor_write_array_begin(&w, 4);
    syn_cbor_write_text_cstr(&w, "Signature1");
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, body_protected, body_protected_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (external_aad != NULL) ? external_aad : (const uint8_t *)"",
                         external_aad_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (payload != NULL) ? payload : (const uint8_t *)"", payload_len);

    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w)) {
        return false;
    }

    *out_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    return true;
}

/* Build serialized Enc_structure per RFC 9052 Section 5.3 */
static bool build_enc_structure(const uint8_t *body_protected, size_t body_protected_len,
                                const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);

    /* Enc_structure is an array of 3 elements */
    syn_cbor_write_array_begin(&w, 3);
    syn_cbor_write_text_cstr(&w, "Encrypt0");
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, body_protected, body_protected_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (external_aad != NULL) ? external_aad : (const uint8_t *)"",
                         external_aad_len);

    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w)) {
        return false;
    }

    *out_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    return true;
}

static bool build_mac_structure(const uint8_t *body_protected, size_t body_protected_len,
                                const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len, uint8_t *out_buf,
                                size_t out_buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);

    /* MAC_structure is an array of 4 elements */
    syn_cbor_write_array_begin(&w, 4);
    syn_cbor_write_text_cstr(&w, "MAC0");
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, body_protected, body_protected_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (external_aad != NULL) ? external_aad : (const uint8_t *)"",
                         external_aad_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (payload != NULL) ? payload : (const uint8_t *)"", payload_len);

    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w)) {
        return false;
    }

    *out_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status cose_verify_sign1_sig(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, const uint8_t *public_key,
                                        size_t public_key_len, const uint8_t *sig_ptr,
                                        const uint8_t *sig_structure, size_t sig_struct_len)
{
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_EDDSA) {
        if (public_key_len != SYN_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_SIZE ||
            !syn_ed25519_verify(sig_ptr, sig_structure, sig_struct_len, public_key)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    const uint8_t *px = public_key;
    const uint8_t *py = public_key + 32;
    if (public_key_len == 65U && public_key[0] == 0x04U) {
        px = public_key + 1;
        py = public_key + 33;
    } else if (public_key_len != 64U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE];
    syn_sha256(sig_structure, sig_struct_len, hash);
    return syn_p256_verify_ecdsa(hash, sig_ptr, sig_ptr + 32, px, py) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
}

static bool cose_parse_enc0_prot_and_unprot(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t *protected_buf,
                                            size_t *protected_len, SYN_COSE_Algorithm *parsed_alg,
                                            size_t *key_len, size_t *tag_len, bool *is_ccm,
                                            uint8_t *parsed_iv, size_t *parsed_iv_len,
                                            uint8_t *parsed_kid, size_t *parsed_kid_len)
{
    *protected_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, protected_buf, SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r) || *protected_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN ||
        !cose_parse_protected_alg(protected_buf, *protected_len, parsed_alg) ||
        !cose_enc0_alg_params(*parsed_alg, key_len, tag_len, is_ccm) ||
        !cose_parse_unprot_enc0(r, parsed_iv, parsed_iv_len, parsed_kid, parsed_kid_len)) {
        return false;
    }
    return *is_ccm ? (*parsed_iv_len == 13U) : (*parsed_iv_len == 12U);
}

static size_t cose_mac0_tag_len(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg)
{
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_HMAC_256_256) {
        return 32U;
    }
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_HMAC_256_64) {
        return 8U;
    }
    return 0U;
}

static bool cose_parse_prot_and_kid(SYN_CborReader *r, uint8_t *protected_buf,
                                    size_t *protected_len, SYN_COSE_Algorithm *parsed_alg,
                                    uint8_t *parsed_kid, size_t *parsed_kid_len)
{
    *protected_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(r, protected_buf, SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(r) || *protected_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN ||
        !cose_parse_protected_alg(protected_buf, *protected_len, parsed_alg) ||
        !cose_parse_unprot_kid(r, parsed_kid, parsed_kid_len)) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status cose_mac0_verify_tag(const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len,
                                       const uint8_t *mac_struct, size_t mac_struct_len,
                                       const uint8_t *tag_ptr, size_t exp_tag_len)
{
    uint8_t expected_tag[32];
    syn_hmac_sha256(key, key_len, mac_struct, mac_struct_len, expected_tag);

    uint8_t diff = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < exp_tag_len; i++) {
        diff |= (uint8_t)(tag_ptr[i] ^ expected_tag[i]);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(expected_tag, sizeof(expected_tag));
    return (diff == 0U) ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
}

static bool cose_sign1_compute_sig(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, const uint8_t *secret_key,
                                   const uint8_t *public_key, const uint8_t *sig_structure,
                                   size_t sig_struct_len, uint8_t signature[SYN_COSE_MAX_SIG_LEN])
{
    if (alg == SYN_COSE_ALGO_EDDSA) {
        if (public_key == NULL) {
            return false;
        }
        return syn_ed25519_sign(sig_structure, sig_struct_len, secret_key, public_key, signature);
    }

    uint8_t hash[SYN_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE];
    uint8_t nonce_k[32];
    bool sign_ok = false;
    syn_sha256(sig_structure, sig_struct_len, hash);
    if (syn_random_fill(nonce_k, sizeof(nonce_k)) == SYN_OK) {
        sign_ok = syn_p256_sign_ecdsa(secret_key, nonce_k, hash, signature, signature + 32);
    }
    syn_secure_zero(nonce_k, sizeof(nonce_k));
    return sign_ok;
}

static SYN_Status cose_encode_4elem_array(uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size,
                                          const uint8_t *prot_raw, size_t prot_len,
                                          const uint8_t *kid, size_t kid_len,
                                          const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                          const uint8_t *auth_bytes, size_t auth_len,
                                          size_t *out_len)
{
    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);
    syn_cbor_write_array_begin(&w, 4);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, prot_raw, prot_len);

    if (kid != NULL && kid_len > 0U) {
        syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&w, 1);
        syn_cbor_write_uint(&w, SYN_COSE_HEADER_KID);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, kid, kid_len);
    } else {
        syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&w, 0);
    }

    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, (payload != NULL) ? payload : (const uint8_t *)"", payload_len);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, auth_bytes, auth_len);

    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    *out_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool cose_key_lengths_valid(const SYN_COSE_Key *key)
{
    return (key->kid_len <= sizeof(key->kid)) && (key->pub_x_len <= sizeof(key->pub_x)) &&
           (key->pub_y_len <= sizeof(key->pub_y)) && (key->priv_d_len <= sizeof(key->priv_d));
}

static bool cose_key_count_entries(const SYN_COSE_Key *key, size_t *out_count)
{
    size_t count = 1U + (size_t)(key->kid_len > 0U) + (size_t)(key->alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN);
    if (key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_SYMMETRIC) {
        count += (size_t)(key->priv_d_len > 0U);
    } else if (key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_OKP || key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_EC2) {
        count += (size_t)(key->crv != SYN_COSE_CRV_RESERVED) + (size_t)(key->pub_x_len > 0U) +
                 (size_t)(key->priv_d_len > 0U);
        if (key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_EC2 && key->pub_y_len > 0U) {
            count++;
        }
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    *out_count = count;
    return true;
}

static void cose_key_write_params(SYN_CborWriter *w, const SYN_COSE_Key *key)
{
    if (key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_SYMMETRIC) {
        if (key->priv_d_len > 0U) {
            syn_cbor_write_int(w, SYN_COSE_KEY_K);
            syn_cbor_write_bytes(w, key->priv_d, key->priv_d_len);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (key->crv != SYN_COSE_CRV_RESERVED) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(w, SYN_COSE_KEY_CRV);
        syn_cbor_write_int(w, (int64_t)key->crv);
    }
    if (key->pub_x_len > 0U) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(w, SYN_COSE_KEY_X);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(w, key->pub_x, key->pub_x_len);
    }
    if (key->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_EC2 && key->pub_y_len > 0U) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(w, SYN_COSE_KEY_Y);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(w, key->pub_y, key->pub_y_len);
    }
    if (key->priv_d_len > 0U) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(w, SYN_COSE_KEY_D);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(w, key->priv_d, key->priv_d_len);
    }
}

static bool cose_encode_enc0_prefix(uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size, const uint8_t *prot_raw,
                                    size_t prot_len, const uint8_t *iv, size_t iv_len,
                                    const uint8_t *kid, size_t kid_len, size_t total_ct_len,
                                    size_t *out_ct_pos)
{
    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);
    syn_cbor_write_array_begin(&w, 3);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, prot_raw, prot_len);

    bool has_kid = (kid != NULL) && (kid_len > 0U);
    syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&w, has_kid ? 2U : 1U);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&w, SYN_COSE_HEADER_IV);
    syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, iv, iv_len);
    if (has_kid) {
        syn_cbor_write_uint(&w, SYN_COSE_HEADER_KID);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, kid, kid_len);
    }

    size_t bstr_hdr_pos = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&w, (uint64_t)total_ct_len);
    size_t ct_pos = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w) || total_ct_len > (out_buf_size - ct_pos)) {
        return false;
    }
    out_buf[bstr_hdr_pos] |= 0x40U; /* CBOR major type 2 (byte string) */
    *out_ct_pos = ct_pos;
    return true;
}

static bool cose_pt_buf_valid(size_t pt_len, const uint8_t *out_plaintext,
                              size_t out_plaintext_size)
{
    if (pt_len == 0U) {
        return true;
    }
    return (out_plaintext != NULL) && (pt_len <= out_plaintext_size);
}


SYN_Status syn_cose_sign1_create(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, const uint8_t *secret_key,
                                 const uint8_t *public_key, const uint8_t *kid, size_t kid_len,
                                 const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                 const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                 uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (secret_key == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL ||
        (payload == NULL && payload_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_EDDSA && alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_ES256) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 1. Build protected header: { 1: alg } */
    uint8_t protected_raw[16];
    SYN_CborWriter pw;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&pw, protected_raw, sizeof(protected_raw));
    syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&pw, 1);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&pw, SYN_COSE_HEADER_ALG);
    syn_cbor_write_int(&pw, (int64_t)alg);
    size_t protected_raw_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&pw);

    /* 2. Build Sig_structure for signature generation */
    uint8_t sig_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t sig_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_sig_structure(protected_raw, protected_raw_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             payload, payload_len, sig_structure, sizeof(sig_structure),
                             &sig_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Compute signature */
    uint8_t signature[SYN_COSE_MAX_SIG_LEN];
    if (!cose_sign1_compute_sig(alg, secret_key, public_key, sig_structure, sig_struct_len,
                                signature)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 4. Encode final COSE_Sign1 message */
    return cose_encode_4elem_array(out_buf, out_buf_size, protected_raw, protected_raw_len, kid,
                                   kid_len, payload, payload_len, signature, 64U, out_len);
}

SYN_Status syn_cose_sign1_verify(const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len, const uint8_t *public_key,
                                 size_t public_key_len, const uint8_t *external_aad,
                                 size_t external_aad_len, SYN_COSE_Sign1Message *parsed_out)
{
    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        (void)memset(parsed_out, 0, sizeof(*parsed_out));
    }
    if (msg == NULL || msg_len == 0U || public_key == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_CborReader r;
    syn_cbor_reader_init(&r, msg, msg_len);
    if (!cose_read_tagged_array(&r, 18U, 4U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 1 & 2. Read protected and unprotected headers */
    uint8_t protected_buf[SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN];
    size_t protected_len = 0U;
    SYN_COSE_Algorithm parsed_alg = SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN;
    uint8_t parsed_kid[SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN] = {0};
    size_t parsed_kid_len = 0;
    if (!cose_parse_prot_and_kid(&r, protected_buf, &protected_len, &parsed_alg, parsed_kid,
                                 &parsed_kid_len) ||
        (parsed_alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_EDDSA && parsed_alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_ES256)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Read payload (zero-copy view into msg) */
    size_t payload_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(&r, NULL, 0U);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    const uint8_t *payload_ptr = &r.buf[r.pos - payload_len];

    /* 4. Read signature (zero-copy view into msg) */
    size_t sig_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(&r, NULL, 0U);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r) || sig_len != 64U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    const uint8_t *sig_ptr = &r.buf[r.pos - sig_len];

    /* 5. Reconstruct Sig_structure */
    uint8_t sig_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t sig_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_sig_structure(protected_buf, protected_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             payload_ptr, payload_len, sig_structure, sizeof(sig_structure),
                             &sig_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 6. Verify signature before populating parsed_out (fail-closed) */
    if (cose_verify_sign1_sig(parsed_alg, public_key, public_key_len, sig_ptr, sig_structure,
                              sig_struct_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        parsed_out->alg = parsed_alg;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->kid, parsed_kid, parsed_kid_len);
        parsed_out->kid_len = parsed_kid_len;
        parsed_out->payload = payload_ptr;
        parsed_out->payload_len = payload_len;
        parsed_out->signature = sig_ptr;
        parsed_out->signature_len = sig_len;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->protected_hdr, protected_buf, protected_len);
        parsed_out->protected_hdr_len = protected_len;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_cose_encrypt0_create(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iv,
                                    size_t iv_len, const uint8_t *kid, size_t kid_len,
                                    const uint8_t *plaintext, size_t plaintext_len,
                                    const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                    uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (key == NULL || iv == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL ||
        (plaintext == NULL && plaintext_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t key_len = 0U;
    size_t tag_len = 16U;
    bool is_ccm = false;
    if (!cose_enc0_alg_params(alg, &key_len, &tag_len, &is_ccm)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    size_t expected_iv_len = is_ccm ? 13U : 12U;
    if (iv_len != expected_iv_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 1. Build protected header: { 1: alg } */
    uint8_t protected_raw[16];
    SYN_CborWriter pw;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&pw, protected_raw, sizeof(protected_raw));
    syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&pw, 1);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&pw, SYN_COSE_HEADER_ALG);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&pw, (uint64_t)alg);
    size_t protected_raw_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&pw);

    /* 2. Build Enc_structure for AAD */
    if (plaintext_len > SYN_COSE_MAX_ENCRYPT0_PAYLOAD) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    uint8_t enc_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_ENC_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t enc_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_enc_structure(protected_raw, protected_raw_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             enc_structure, sizeof(enc_structure), &enc_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Encode COSE_Encrypt0 header + bstr prefix directly into out_buf */
    size_t total_ct_len = plaintext_len + tag_len;
    size_t ct_pos = 0U;
    if (!cose_encode_enc0_prefix(out_buf, out_buf_size, protected_raw, protected_raw_len, iv,
                                 iv_len, kid, kid_len, total_ct_len, &ct_pos)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 4. Encrypt plaintext || tag directly into out_buf */
    uint8_t tag[16];
    cose_aead_encrypt(alg, key_len, tag_len, is_ccm, key, iv, iv_len, enc_structure, enc_struct_len,
                      plaintext, plaintext_len, out_buf + ct_pos, tag);
    (void)memcpy(out_buf + ct_pos + plaintext_len, tag, tag_len);

    *out_len = ct_pos + total_ct_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_cose_encrypt0_decrypt(const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len, const uint8_t *key,
                                     const uint8_t *external_aad, size_t external_aad_len,
                                     uint8_t *out_plaintext, size_t out_plaintext_size,
                                     size_t *out_plaintext_len,
                                     SYN_COSE_Encrypt0Message *parsed_out)
{
    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        (void)memset(parsed_out, 0, sizeof(*parsed_out));
    }
    if (msg == NULL || msg_len == 0U || key == NULL || out_plaintext_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_CborReader r;
    syn_cbor_reader_init(&r, msg, msg_len);
    if (!cose_read_tagged_array(&r, 16U, 3U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 1 & 2. Read protected + unprotected headers */
    uint8_t protected_buf[SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN];
    size_t protected_len = 0U;
    SYN_COSE_Algorithm parsed_alg = SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN;
    size_t key_len = 0U;
    size_t tag_len = 16U;
    bool is_ccm = false;
    uint8_t parsed_iv[SYN_COSE_MAX_IV_LEN] = {0};
    size_t parsed_iv_len = 0;
    uint8_t parsed_kid[SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN] = {0};
    size_t parsed_kid_len = 0;
    if (!cose_parse_enc0_prot_and_unprot(&r, protected_buf, &protected_len, &parsed_alg, &key_len,
                                         &tag_len, &is_ccm, parsed_iv, &parsed_iv_len, parsed_kid,
                                         &parsed_kid_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Read ciphertext + tag (zero-copy view into msg) */
    size_t ct_tag_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(&r, NULL, 0U);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r) || ct_tag_len < tag_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    const uint8_t *ct_tag_ptr = &r.buf[r.pos - ct_tag_len];

    size_t pt_len = ct_tag_len - tag_len;
    if (!cose_pt_buf_valid(pt_len, out_plaintext, out_plaintext_size)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 4. Reconstruct Enc_structure */
    uint8_t enc_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_ENC_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t enc_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_enc_structure(protected_buf, protected_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             enc_structure, sizeof(enc_structure), &enc_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 5. Decrypt and verify tag before populating parsed_out (fail-closed) */
    const uint8_t *tag = ct_tag_ptr + pt_len;
    if (cose_aead_decrypt(parsed_alg, key_len, tag_len, is_ccm, key, parsed_iv, parsed_iv_len,
                          enc_structure, enc_struct_len, ct_tag_ptr, pt_len, tag,
                          out_plaintext) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        parsed_out->alg = parsed_alg;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->iv, parsed_iv, parsed_iv_len);
        parsed_out->iv_len = parsed_iv_len;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->kid, parsed_kid, parsed_kid_len);
        parsed_out->kid_len = parsed_kid_len;
        parsed_out->ciphertext = ct_tag_ptr;
        parsed_out->ciphertext_len = ct_tag_len;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->protected_hdr, protected_buf, protected_len);
        parsed_out->protected_hdr_len = protected_len;
    }

    *out_plaintext_len = pt_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── COSE_Mac0 API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_cose_mac0_create(SYN_COSE_Algorithm alg, const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len,
                                const uint8_t *kid, size_t kid_len, const uint8_t *payload,
                                size_t payload_len, const uint8_t *external_aad,
                                size_t external_aad_len, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size,
                                size_t *out_len)
{
    if (key == NULL || key_len == 0U || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL ||
        (payload == NULL && payload_len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t tag_len = cose_mac0_tag_len(alg);
    if (tag_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 1. Build protected header: { 1: alg } */
    uint8_t protected_raw[16];
    SYN_CborWriter pw;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&pw, protected_raw, sizeof(protected_raw));
    syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&pw, 1);
    syn_cbor_write_uint(&pw, SYN_COSE_HEADER_ALG);
    syn_cbor_write_int(&pw, (int64_t)alg);
    size_t protected_raw_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&pw);

    /* 2. Build MAC_structure */
    uint8_t mac_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t mac_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_mac_structure(protected_raw, protected_raw_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             payload, payload_len, mac_structure, sizeof(mac_structure),
                             &mac_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 3. Compute HMAC, encode COSE_Mac0 array, and zeroize full_tag */
    uint8_t full_tag[32];
    syn_hmac_sha256(key, key_len, mac_structure, mac_struct_len, full_tag);
    SYN_Status st =
        cose_encode_4elem_array(out_buf, out_buf_size, protected_raw, protected_raw_len, kid,
                                kid_len, payload, payload_len, full_tag, tag_len, out_len);
    syn_secure_zero(full_tag, sizeof(full_tag));
    return st;
}

SYN_Status syn_cose_mac0_verify(const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len, const uint8_t *key,
                                size_t key_len, const uint8_t *external_aad,
                                size_t external_aad_len, SYN_COSE_Mac0Message *parsed_out)
{
    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        (void)memset(parsed_out, 0, sizeof(*parsed_out));
    }
    if (msg == NULL || msg_len == 0U || key == NULL || key_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_CborReader r;
    syn_cbor_reader_init(&r, msg, msg_len);
    if (!cose_read_tagged_array(&r, 17U, 4U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 0 & 1. Protected and unprotected headers */
    uint8_t protected_buf[SYN_COSE_MAX_PROTECTED_LEN];
    size_t protected_len = 0U;
    SYN_COSE_Algorithm parsed_alg = SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN;
    uint8_t parsed_kid[SYN_COSE_MAX_KID_LEN] = {0};
    size_t parsed_kid_len = 0;
    if (!cose_parse_prot_and_kid(&r, protected_buf, &protected_len, &parsed_alg, parsed_kid,
                                 &parsed_kid_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    size_t exp_tag_len = cose_mac0_tag_len(parsed_alg);
    if (exp_tag_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 2. Payload (zero-copy view into msg) */
    size_t payload_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(&r, NULL, 0U);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    const uint8_t *payload_ptr = &r.buf[r.pos - payload_len];

    /* 3. Tag (zero-copy view into msg) */
    size_t tag_len = syn_cbor_read_bytes(&r, NULL, 0U);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r) || tag_len != exp_tag_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    const uint8_t *tag_ptr = &r.buf[r.pos - tag_len];

    /* 4. Reconstruct MAC_structure */
    uint8_t mac_structure[SYN_COSE_MAX_STRUCT_LEN];
    size_t mac_struct_len = 0;
    if (!build_mac_structure(protected_buf, protected_len, external_aad, external_aad_len,
                             payload_ptr, payload_len, mac_structure, sizeof(mac_structure),
                             &mac_struct_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* 5. Compute HMAC and constant-time compare before populating parsed_out */
    if (cose_mac0_verify_tag(key, key_len, mac_structure, mac_struct_len, tag_ptr, exp_tag_len) !=
        SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (parsed_out != NULL) {
        parsed_out->alg = parsed_alg;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->kid, parsed_kid, parsed_kid_len);
        parsed_out->kid_len = parsed_kid_len;
        parsed_out->payload = payload_ptr;
        parsed_out->payload_len = payload_len;
        parsed_out->tag = tag_ptr;
        parsed_out->tag_len = tag_len;
        (void)memcpy(parsed_out->protected_hdr, protected_buf, protected_len);
        parsed_out->protected_hdr_len = protected_len;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── COSE_Key API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_cose_key_encode(const SYN_COSE_Key *key, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_buf_size,
                               size_t *out_len)
{
    size_t count = 0U;
    if (key == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL || !cose_key_lengths_valid(key) ||
        !cose_key_count_entries(key, &count)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_CborWriter w;
    syn_cbor_writer_init(&w, out_buf, out_buf_size);
    syn_cbor_write_map_begin(&w, count);

    /* 1: kty */
    syn_cbor_write_int(&w, SYN_COSE_KEY_KTY);
    syn_cbor_write_int(&w, (int64_t)key->kty);

    /* 2: kid */
    if (key->kid_len > 0U) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(&w, SYN_COSE_KEY_KID);
        syn_cbor_write_bytes(&w, key->kid, key->kid_len);
    }

    /* 3: alg */
    if (key->alg != SYN_COSE_ALGO_UNKNOWN) {
        syn_cbor_write_int(&w, SYN_COSE_KEY_ALG);
        syn_cbor_write_int(&w, (int64_t)key->alg);
    }

    cose_key_write_params(&w, key);

    if (!syn_cbor_writer_ok(&w)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    *out_len = syn_cbor_writer_len(&w);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_cose_key_decode(const uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_len, SYN_COSE_Key *key_out)
{
    if (buf == NULL || buf_len == 0U || key_out == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    memset(key_out, 0, sizeof(*key_out));

    SYN_CborReader r;
    syn_cbor_reader_init(&r, buf, buf_len);

    size_t map_sz = syn_cbor_read_map_begin(&r);
    if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t neg1_kind = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < map_sz && syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r); i++) {
        int64_t label = syn_cbor_read_int(&r);
        if (!syn_cbor_reader_ok(&r) || !cose_key_decode_entry(&r, label, key_out, &neg1_kind)) {
            syn_secure_zero(key_out, sizeof(*key_out));
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    bool valid_kty = false;
    if (key_out->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_SYMMETRIC) {
        valid_kty = (neg1_kind != 1U);
    } else if (key_out->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_OKP || key_out->kty == SYN_COSE_KTY_EC2) {
        valid_kty = (neg1_kind != 2U);
    }
    if (!valid_kty) {
        syn_secure_zero(key_out, sizeof(*key_out));
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_COSE_ENABLED */

Parameters:

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_crsf.h"

#include <string.h>

uint8_t syn_crsf_calc_crc(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (!buf) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint8_t crc = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= buf[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x80U) {
                crc = (uint8_t)((crc << 1U) ^ 0xD5U);
            } else {
                crc <<= 1U;
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

SYN_Status syn_crsf_init(SYN_CRSF_Parser *parser)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void parse_channels(const uint8_t *payload, SYN_CRSF_ChannelsFrame *channels)
{
    channels->channels[0] = (uint16_t)(((payload[0]) | (payload[1] << 8)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[1] = (uint16_t)(((payload[1] >> 3) | (payload[2] << 5)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[2] =
        (uint16_t)(((payload[2] >> 6) | (payload[3] << 2) | (payload[4] << 10)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[3] = (uint16_t)(((payload[4] >> 1) | (payload[5] << 7)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[4] = (uint16_t)(((payload[5] >> 4) | (payload[6] << 4)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[5] =
        (uint16_t)(((payload[6] >> 7) | (payload[7] << 1) | (payload[8] << 9)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[6] = (uint16_t)(((payload[8] >> 2) | (payload[9] << 6)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[7] = (uint16_t)(((payload[9] >> 5) | (payload[10] << 3)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[8] = (uint16_t)(((payload[11]) | (payload[12] << 8)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[9] = (uint16_t)(((payload[12] >> 3) | (payload[13] << 5)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[10] =
        (uint16_t)(((payload[13] >> 6) | (payload[14] << 2) | (payload[15] << 10)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[11] = (uint16_t)(((payload[15] >> 1) | (payload[16] << 7)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[12] = (uint16_t)(((payload[16] >> 4) | (payload[17] << 4)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[13] =
        (uint16_t)(((payload[17] >> 7) | (payload[18] << 1) | (payload[19] << 9)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[14] = (uint16_t)(((payload[19] >> 2) | (payload[20] << 6)) & 0x07FFU);
    channels->channels[15] = (uint16_t)(((payload[20] >> 5) | (payload[21] << 3)) & 0x07FFU);
}

static void parse_link_stats(const uint8_t *payload, SYN_CRSF_LinkStats *stats)
{
    stats->uplink_rssi1 = payload[0];
    stats->uplink_rssi2 = payload[1];
    stats->uplink_quality = payload[2];
    stats->uplink_snr = (int8_t)payload[3];
    stats->active_antenna = payload[4];
    stats->rf_mode = payload[5];
    stats->tx_power = payload[6];
    stats->downlink_rssi = payload[7];
    stats->downlink_quality = payload[8];
    stats->downlink_snr = (int8_t)payload[9];
}

static bool crsf_payload_len_valid(uint8_t type, uint8_t payload_len)
{
    if (type == SYN_CRSF_TYPE_RC_CHANNELS) {
        return payload_len >= 24U;
    }
    if (type == SYN_CRSF_TYPE_LINK_STATISTICS) {
        return payload_len >= 12U;
    }
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status crsf_dispatch_frame(SYN_CRSF_Parser *parser, SYN_CRSF_FrameType *type_out)
{
    uint8_t expected_crc = syn_crsf_calc_crc(&parser->buf[2], parser->payload_len - 1U);
    uint8_t rx_crc = parser->buf[1U + parser->payload_len];

    if (expected_crc != rx_crc) {
        parser->crc_errors++;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t type = parser->buf[2];
    if (!crsf_payload_len_valid(type, parser->payload_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    parser->packets_received++;

    if (type == SYN_CRSF_TYPE_RC_CHANNELS) {
        parse_channels(&parser->buf[3], &parser->last_channels);
    } else if (type == SYN_CRSF_TYPE_LINK_STATISTICS) {
        parse_link_stats(&parser->buf[3], &parser->last_link_stats);
    }

    if (type_out) {
        *type_out = (SYN_CRSF_FrameType)type;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_crsf_parse_byte(SYN_CRSF_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte, SYN_CRSF_FrameType *type_out)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (parser->idx == 0) {
        if (byte != SYN_CRSF_ADDR_FC) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    } else if (parser->idx == 1) {
        parser->payload_len = byte;
        if (byte < 2U || byte > (SYN_CRSF_MAX_PACKET_LEN - 2U)) {
            parser->idx = 0;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    parser->buf[parser->idx++] = byte;

    if (parser->idx >= 2U && parser->idx == (size_t)(2U + parser->payload_len)) {
        parser->idx = 0;
        return crsf_dispatch_frame(parser, type_out);
    }

    return SYN_BUSY;
}

uint16_t syn_crsf_raw_to_us(uint16_t raw_val)
{
    if (raw_val < 170U) {
        return 988U;
    }
    if (raw_val > 1908U) {
        return 2012U;
    }

    /*
     * Linear scaling:
     * raw range: [170, 1908] -> span = 1738
     * us range:  [988, 2012] -> span = 1024
     * us = 988 + ((raw_val - 170) * 1024) / 1738
     */
    uint32_t val = (uint32_t)(raw_val - 170U);
    uint32_t us = 988U + ((val * 1024U) / 1738U);
    return (uint16_t)us;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
CRSF Specifications: * Baud rate: 420,000 / 921,600 / 1,875,000 bps, 8N1. * Frame Format: [Device Addr] [Payload Length] [Frame Type] [Payload...] [CRC8] * Address: 0xC8 (Flight Controller), 0xEA (Radio Transmitter). * Types: * 0x16: RC Channels Frame (16 11-bit channels packed in 22 bytes, raw 170..1908 -> 988..2012 us). * 0x14: Link Statistics (RSSI 1 & 2, Link Quality, SNR). * 0x08: Battery Telemetry (Voltage, Current, Capacity, Remaining %). * 0x02: GPS Telemetry (Lat, Lon, Groundspeed, Heading, Altitude, Satellites).

  • CRC: CRC8 DVB-S2 (poly 0xD5) over Frame Type + Payload.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
