uint16_t syn_dali_encode_forward(uint8_t addr, uint8_t data_cmd)
{
    return (((uint16_t)addr) << 8) | (uint16_t)data_cmd;
}

bool syn_dali_decode_forward(uint16_t raw_16, SYN_DALI_ForwardFrame *frame)
{
    if (frame == NULL)
        return false;

    frame->raw = raw_16;
    uint8_t addr = (uint8_t)((raw_16 >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    frame->data_cmd = (uint8_t)(raw_16 & 0xFFU);

    /* Address decoding:
     * - Bit 7 = 0: Short Address (0a aaaa aS) -> short addr = a aaaa
     * - Bit 7..4 = 1000..1001: Group Address (100g gggS) -> group = g ggg
     * - Bit 7..1 = 1111 111: Broadcast (1111 111S)
     * - Otherwise: Special / Configuration
     */
    bool selector_bit = (addr & 0x01U) != 0U; /* Bit 0: 0 = Direct Arc Level, 1 = Command */
    frame->is_direct = !selector_bit;

    if ((addr & 0x80U) == 0x00U) {
        frame->addr_type = SYN_DALI_ADDR_SHORT;
        frame->address = (addr >> 1) & 0x3FU;
    } else if ((addr & 0xE0U) == 0x80U) {
        frame->addr_type = SYN_DALI_ADDR_GROUP;
        frame->address = (addr >> 1) & 0x0FU;
    } else if ((addr & 0xFEU) == 0xFEU) {
        frame->addr_type = SYN_DALI_ADDR_BROADCAST;
        frame->address = 0xFFU;
    } else {
        frame->addr_type = SYN_DALI_ADDR_SPECIAL;
        frame->address = addr;
    }

    return true;
}

uint8_t syn_dali_encode_backward(uint8_t data)
{
    return data;
}

bool syn_dali_decode_backward(uint8_t raw_8, SYN_DALI_BackwardFrame *frame)
{
    if (frame == NULL)
        return false;
    frame->data = raw_8;
    return true;
}

SYN_Status syn_dali_slave_init(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, const SYN_DALI_SlaveConfig *cfg)
{
    if (slave == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(slave, 0, sizeof(*slave));
    slave->cfg = *cfg;

    if (slave->cfg.min_level == 0)
        slave->cfg.min_level = 1;
    if (slave->cfg.max_level == 0)
        slave->cfg.max_level = 254;
    if (slave->cfg.power_on_level != SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL) {
        slave->actual_level = slave->cfg.power_on_level;
    } else {
        slave->actual_level = slave->cfg.max_level;
    }

    memset(slave->scenes, SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL, sizeof(slave->scenes));
    slave->lamp_on = (slave->actual_level > 0);

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool check_address_match(const SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, const SYN_DALI_ForwardFrame *req)
{
    if (req->addr_type == SYN_DALI_ADDR_BROADCAST) {
        return true;
    }
    if (req->addr_type == SYN_DALI_ADDR_SHORT) {
        return (slave->cfg.short_address != SYN_DALI_SHORT_ADDR_UNASSIGNED &&
                slave->cfg.short_address == req->address);
    }
    if (req->addr_type == SYN_DALI_ADDR_GROUP) {
        if (req->address < 16) {
            return ((slave->cfg.group_mask & (1U << req->address)) != 0U);
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static void dali_reset_state(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave)
{
    slave->actual_level = 254U;
    slave->lamp_on = true;
    slave->cfg.power_on_level = 254U;
    slave->cfg.system_failure_level = 254U;
    slave->cfg.min_level = 1U;
    slave->cfg.max_level = 254U;
    slave->cfg.fade_time = 0U;
    slave->cfg.fade_rate = 7U;
    slave->cfg.group_mask = 0U;
    memset(slave->scenes, SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL, sizeof(slave->scenes));
    slave->search_address = 0xFFFFFFU;
    slave->random_address = 0xFFFFFFU;
    slave->dtr0 = 0U;
    slave->dtr1 = 0U;
    slave->dtr2 = 0U;
    slave->dapc_sequence_active = false;
    slave->write_mem_enabled = false;
    slave->initialise_active = false;
    slave->withdrawn = false;
}

static void dali_exec_direct_arc(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t target_level)
{
    if (target_level == SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL) {
        return;
    }
    if (target_level == 0U) {
        slave->actual_level = 0U;
        slave->lamp_on = false;
        return;
    }
    if (target_level < slave->cfg.min_level) {
        target_level = slave->cfg.min_level;
    }
    if (target_level > slave->cfg.max_level) {
        target_level = slave->cfg.max_level;
    }
    slave->actual_level = target_level;
    slave->lamp_on = true;
}

static bool dali_exec_step_cmd(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_OFF:
        slave->actual_level = 0U;
        slave->lamp_on = false;
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_UP:
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STEP_UP:
        if (slave->lamp_on && slave->actual_level > 0U &&
            slave->actual_level < slave->cfg.max_level) {
            slave->actual_level++;
        }
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_DOWN:
        if (slave->actual_level > slave->cfg.min_level) {
            slave->actual_level--;
        }
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STEP_DOWN:
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STEP_DOWN_AND_OFF:
        if (slave->actual_level > slave->cfg.min_level) {
            slave->actual_level--;
        } else {
            slave->actual_level = 0U;
            slave->lamp_on = false;
        }
        return true;

    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool dali_exec_preset_cmd(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_RECALL_MAX:
        slave->actual_level = slave->cfg.max_level;
        slave->lamp_on = true;
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_RECALL_MIN:
        slave->actual_level = slave->cfg.min_level;
        slave->lamp_on = true;
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_ON_AND_STEP_UP:
        if (!slave->lamp_on || slave->actual_level == 0U) {
            slave->actual_level = slave->cfg.min_level;
            slave->lamp_on = true;
        } else if (slave->actual_level < slave->cfg.max_level) {
            slave->actual_level++;
        }
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_ENABLE_DAPC_SEQUENCE:
        slave->dapc_sequence_active = true;
        return true;

    case SYN_DALI_CMD_RESET:
        dali_reset_state(slave);
        return true;

    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static inline uint8_t dali_clamp_u8(uint8_t val, uint8_t lo, uint8_t hi)
{
    if (val < lo) {
        return lo;
    }
    if (val > hi) {
        return hi;
    }
    return val;
}

static inline uint8_t dali_decode_short_addr_arg(uint8_t raw)
{
    if (raw == 0xFFU) {
        return SYN_DALI_SHORT_ADDR_UNASSIGNED;
    }
    return (uint8_t)((raw >> 1U) & 0x3FU);
}

static bool dali_exec_dtr_store_cmd(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_ACTUAL_LEVEL_IN_DTR:
        slave->dtr0 = slave->actual_level;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_MAX_LEVEL:
        slave->cfg.max_level = dali_clamp_u8(slave->dtr0, slave->cfg.min_level, 254U);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_MIN_LEVEL:
        slave->cfg.min_level = dali_clamp_u8(slave->dtr0, 1U, slave->cfg.max_level);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_SYS_FAIL_LEVEL:
        slave->cfg.system_failure_level = slave->dtr0;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_POWER_ON_LEVEL:
        slave->cfg.power_on_level = slave->dtr0;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_FADE_TIME:
        slave->cfg.fade_time = slave->dtr0;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_FADE_RATE:
        slave->cfg.fade_rate = slave->dtr0;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_SHORT_ADDR:
        slave->cfg.short_address = dali_decode_short_addr_arg(slave->dtr0);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_ENABLE_WRITE_MEMORY:
        slave->write_mem_enabled = true;
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool dali_exec_query_basic(const SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd, uint8_t *resp_data)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_STATUS: {
        uint8_t status = 0U;
        if (slave->control_gear_failure) {
            status |= (1U << 0);
        }
        if (slave->lamp_failure) {
            status |= (1U << 1);
        }
        if (slave->lamp_on) {
            status |= (1U << 2);
        }
        if (slave->cfg.short_address == SYN_DALI_SHORT_ADDR_UNASSIGNED) {
            status |= (1U << 6);
        }
        *resp_data = status;
        return true;
    }
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_CONTENT_DTR:
        *resp_data = slave->dtr0;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_CONTENT_DTR1:
        *resp_data = slave->dtr1;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_CONTENT_DTR2:
        *resp_data = slave->dtr2;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_GROUPS_0_7:
        *resp_data = (uint8_t)(slave->cfg.group_mask & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_GROUPS_8_15:
        *resp_data = (uint8_t)((slave->cfg.group_mask >> 8) & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool dali_exec_query_addr_levels(const SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd,
                                        uint8_t *resp_data)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_RANDOM_ADDR_H:
        *resp_data = (uint8_t)((slave->random_address >> 16) & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_RANDOM_ADDR_M:
        *resp_data = (uint8_t)((slave->random_address >> 8) & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_RANDOM_ADDR_L:
        *resp_data = (uint8_t)(slave->random_address & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_ACTUAL_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = slave->actual_level;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_MAX_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = slave->cfg.max_level;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_MIN_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = slave->cfg.min_level;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_POWER_ON_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = slave->cfg.power_on_level;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_SYS_FAIL_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = slave->cfg.system_failure_level;
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void dali_exec_scene_group_cmd(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd)
{
    if (cmd >= SYN_DALI_CMD_GO_TO_SCENE_BASE && cmd <= (SYN_DALI_CMD_GO_TO_SCENE_BASE + 15U)) {
        uint8_t scene_lvl = slave->scenes[cmd - SYN_DALI_CMD_GO_TO_SCENE_BASE];
        if (scene_lvl != SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL) {
            slave->actual_level = scene_lvl;
            slave->lamp_on = (scene_lvl > 0U);
        }
    } else if (cmd >= SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_SCENE_BASE &&
               cmd <= (SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_SCENE_BASE + 15U)) {
        slave->scenes[cmd - SYN_DALI_CMD_STORE_DTR_AS_SCENE_BASE] = slave->dtr0;
    } else if (cmd >= SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_SCENE_BASE &&
               cmd <= (SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_SCENE_BASE + 15U)) {
        slave->scenes[cmd - SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_SCENE_BASE] = SYN_DALI_MASK_LEVEL;
    } else if (cmd >= SYN_DALI_CMD_ADD_TO_GROUP_BASE &&
               cmd <= (SYN_DALI_CMD_ADD_TO_GROUP_BASE + 15U)) {
        slave->cfg.group_mask |= (uint16_t)(1U << (cmd - SYN_DALI_CMD_ADD_TO_GROUP_BASE));
    } else if (cmd >= SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_GROUP_BASE &&
               cmd <= (SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_GROUP_BASE + 15U)) {
        slave->cfg.group_mask &= (uint16_t)(~(1U << (cmd - SYN_DALI_CMD_REMOVE_FROM_GROUP_BASE)));
    }
}

static bool dali_exec_query_capabilities(const SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd,
                                         uint8_t *resp_data, bool *has_resp)
{
    switch (cmd) {
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_CONTROL_GEAR:
        *resp_data = 0xFFU;
        *has_resp = true;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_LAMP_FAILURE:
        if (slave->lamp_failure) {
            *resp_data = 0xFFU;
            *has_resp = true;
        }
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_LAMP_POWER_ON:
        if (slave->lamp_on) {
            *resp_data = 0xFFU;
            *has_resp = true;
        }
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_DEVICE_TYPE:
        *resp_data = 0U;
        *has_resp = true;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_CMD_QUERY_PHYSICAL_MIN_LEVEL:
        *resp_data = 1U;
        *has_resp = true;
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void dali_exec_indirect_cmd(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t cmd, uint8_t *resp_data,
                                   bool *has_resp)
{
    if (dali_exec_step_cmd(slave, cmd) || dali_exec_preset_cmd(slave, cmd) ||
        dali_exec_dtr_store_cmd(slave, cmd)) {
        return;
    }
    if (dali_exec_query_basic(slave, cmd, resp_data) ||
        dali_exec_query_addr_levels(slave, cmd, resp_data)) {
        *has_resp = true;
        return;
    }
    if (dali_exec_query_capabilities(slave, cmd, resp_data, has_resp)) {
        return;
    }
    dali_exec_scene_group_cmd(slave, cmd);
}

static bool dali_exec_special_search(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t spec_code,
                                     uint8_t spec_data)
{
    switch (spec_code) {
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_TERMINATE:
        slave->initialise_active = false;
        slave->withdrawn = false;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_DTR0:
        slave->dtr0 = spec_data;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_DTR1:
        slave->dtr1 = spec_data;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_DTR2:
        slave->dtr2 = spec_data;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_INITIALISE:
        slave->initialise_active = true;
        slave->withdrawn = false;
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_RANDOMISE:
        if (slave->initialise_active) {
            slave->random_address = ((uint32_t)spec_data << 16) | 0x1234U;
        }
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_SEARCHADDRH:
        slave->search_address = (slave->search_address & 0x00FFFFU) | ((uint32_t)spec_data << 16);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_SEARCHADDRM:
        slave->search_address = (slave->search_address & 0xFF00FFU) | ((uint32_t)spec_data << 8);
        return true;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_SEARCHADDRL:
        slave->search_address = (slave->search_address & 0xFFFF00U) | (uint32_t)spec_data;
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void dali_exec_special_addr(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, uint8_t spec_code, uint8_t spec_data,
                                   uint8_t *resp_data, bool *has_resp)
{
    switch (spec_code) {
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_COMPARE:
        if (slave->initialise_active && !slave->withdrawn &&
            (slave->random_address <= slave->search_address)) {
            *resp_data = 0xFFU;
            *has_resp = true;
        }
        break;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_WITHDRAW:
        if (slave->initialise_active && (slave->random_address == slave->search_address)) {
            slave->withdrawn = true;
        }
        break;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_PROGRAM_SHORT_ADDR:
        if (slave->initialise_active) {
            slave->cfg.short_address = dali_decode_short_addr_arg(spec_data);
        }
        break;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_VERIFY_SHORT_ADDR:
        if ((slave->cfg.short_address != SYN_DALI_SHORT_ADDR_UNASSIGNED) && (spec_data != 0xFFU) &&
            (((spec_data >> 1U) & 0x3FU) == slave->cfg.short_address)) {
            *resp_data = 0xFFU;
            *has_resp = true;
        }
        break;
    case SYN_DALI_SPEC_QUERY_SHORT_ADDR:
        if (slave->cfg.short_address != SYN_DALI_SHORT_ADDR_UNASSIGNED) {
            *resp_data = (uint8_t)((slave->cfg.short_address << 1) | 0x01U);
        } else {
            *resp_data = 0xFFU;
        }
        *has_resp = true;
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_dali_slave_process(SYN_DALI_SlaveState *slave, const SYN_DALI_ForwardFrame *req,
                                  uint8_t *resp_data, bool *has_resp)
{
    if (slave == NULL || req == NULL || resp_data == NULL || has_resp == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *has_resp = false;
    *resp_data = 0U;

    if (check_address_match(slave, req)) {
        if (req->is_direct) {
            dali_exec_direct_arc(slave, req->data_cmd);
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        dali_exec_indirect_cmd(slave, req->data_cmd, resp_data, has_resp);
    }

    if (req->addr_type == SYN_DALI_ADDR_SPECIAL) {
        if (!dali_exec_special_search(slave, req->address, req->data_cmd)) {
            dali_exec_special_addr(slave, req->address, req->data_cmd, resp_data, has_resp);
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

size_t syn_dali_manchester_encode_byte(uint8_t val, uint8_t *bit_out)
{
    if (bit_out == NULL)
        return 0;

    size_t idx = 0;
    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
        bool bit = (val & (1U << i)) != 0U;
        if (bit) {
            /* Logical 1: Low -> High */
            bit_out[idx++] = 0;
            bit_out[idx++] = 1;
        } else {
            /* Logical 0: High -> Low */
            bit_out[idx++] = 1;
            bit_out[idx++] = 0;
        }
    }
    return idx;
}

bool syn_dali_manchester_decode_byte(const uint8_t *bit_in, uint8_t *val_out)
{
    if (bit_in == NULL || val_out == NULL)
        return false;

    uint8_t val = 0;
    size_t idx = 0;

    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
        uint8_t b0 = bit_in[idx++];
        uint8_t b1 = bit_in[idx++];

        if (b0 == 0 && b1 == 1) {
            val |= (1U << i); /* Logical 1 */
        } else if (b0 == 1 && b1 == 0) {
            /* Logical 0 */
        } else {
            return false; /* Invalid Manchester bi-phase transition */
        }
    }

    *val_out = val;
    return true;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements non-blocking, zero-malloc DALI (IEC 62386-101/102) Manchester bi-phase frame encoding/decoding, address matching (Short, Group, Broadcast), Direct Arc Power control ($0..254$), standard commands, configuration commands, and query responses.

** **

static SYN_DALI_SlaveState dali_slave;
SYN_DALI_SlaveConfig cfg = {
    .short_address = 5,
    .min_level = 10,
    .max_level = 254,
    .power_on_level = 254,
    .system_failure_level = 254
};
syn_dali_slave_init(&dali_slave, &cfg);

SYN_DALI_ForwardFrame req;
if (syn_dali_decode_forward(raw_16, &req)) {
    uint8_t resp = 0;
    bool has_resp = false;
    syn_dali_slave_process(&dali_slave, &req, &resp, &has_resp);
}

#include "syn_devicenet.h"

#include "../util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>


/* Group 2 CAN Message ID offsets */
#define GROUP2_EXPLICIT_RESP_MSG_ID 3U
#define GROUP2_EXPLICIT_REQ_MSG_ID 4U
#define GROUP2_POLLED_CMD_MSG_ID 5U
#define GROUP2_POLLED_RESP_MSG_ID 6U

/* Group 4 CAN Message IDs */
#define GROUP4_DUP_MAC_REQ_MSG_ID 5U
#define GROUP4_DUP_MAC_RESP_MSG_ID 6U

static uint32_t make_group2_can_id(uint8_t mac_id, uint8_t msg_id)
{
    return (uint32_t)0x400U | ((uint32_t)(mac_id & 0x3FU) << 3) | (uint32_t)(msg_id & 0x07U);
}

static uint32_t make_group4_can_id(uint8_t mac_id, uint8_t msg_id)
{
    return (uint32_t)0x7C0U | ((uint32_t)(mac_id & 0x3FU) << 3) | (uint32_t)(msg_id & 0x07U);
}


bool syn_devicenet_init(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t mac_id, SYN_DeviceNet_Baud baud)
{
    if ((node == NULL) || (mac_id > SYN_DEVICENET_MAX_MAC_ID)) {
        return false;
    }

    memset(node, 0, sizeof(*node));
    node->state = SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_DUP_MAC_CHECK;
    node->devicenet_obj.mac_id = mac_id;
    node->devicenet_obj.baud_rate = baud;
    node->devicenet_obj.bus_off_action = 0U;
    node->devicenet_obj.allocation_choice = 0x03U; /* Explicit + Polled I/O */

    /* CIP Identity defaults */
    node->identity.vendor_id = 0x005AU;   /* SyntropicOS Vendor ID */
    node->identity.device_type = 0x000CU; /* Generic Discrete I/O */
    node->identity.product_code = 0x0001U;
    node->identity.rev_major = 1U;
    node->identity.rev_minor = 0U;
    node->identity.status = 0x0000U;
    node->identity.serial_number = 0x12345678U;
    memcpy(node->identity.product_name, "Syntropic DeviceNet", 20);
    node->identity.quick_connect_enabled = false;

    node->dup_mac_timer_ms = SYN_DEVICENET_DUP_MAC_TIMEOUT_MS;
    node->dup_mac_failed = false;
    node->explicit_connected = false;
    node->polled_connected = false;

    return true;
}

void syn_devicenet_set_serial_number(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint32_t serial_number)
{
    if (node != NULL) {
        node->identity.serial_number = serial_number;
    }
}

bool syn_devicenet_set_assembly(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t *in_buf, uint8_t in_len,
                                uint8_t *out_buf, uint8_t out_len)
{
    if (node == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    if ((in_len > SYN_DEVICENET_MAX_PAYLOAD) || (out_len > SYN_DEVICENET_MAX_PAYLOAD)) {
        return false;
    }

    node->assembly.input_buf = in_buf;
    node->assembly.input_len = in_len;
    node->assembly.output_buf = out_buf;
    node->assembly.output_len = out_len;

    return true;
}

bool syn_devicenet_set_quickconnect(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, bool enable)
{
    if (node == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    node->identity.quick_connect_enabled = enable;
    if (enable && (node->state == SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_DUP_MAC_CHECK)) {
        /* QuickConnect shortens Dup MAC startup check to 100ms */
        node->dup_mac_timer_ms = 100U;
    }

    return true;
}

void syn_devicenet_poll(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if ((node == NULL) || (node->state != SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_DUP_MAC_CHECK)) {
        return;
    }

    if (dt_ms >= node->dup_mac_timer_ms) {
        node->dup_mac_timer_ms = 0U;
        if (!node->dup_mac_failed) {
            node->state = SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_ONLINE;
        }
    } else {
        node->dup_mac_timer_ms -= dt_ms;
    }
}

static bool dnet_get_identity_attr(const SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t attr_id,
                                   uint8_t *tx_data, uint8_t *out_idx)
{
    switch (attr_id) {
    case 1U:
        syn_poke_u16_le(node->identity.vendor_id, tx_data, *out_idx);
        *out_idx += 2U;
        return true;
    case 2U:
        syn_poke_u16_le(node->identity.device_type, tx_data, *out_idx);
        *out_idx += 2U;
        return true;
    case 3U:
        syn_poke_u16_le(node->identity.product_code, tx_data, *out_idx);
        *out_idx += 2U;
        return true;
    case 4U:
        tx_data[(*out_idx)++] = node->identity.rev_major;
        tx_data[(*out_idx)++] = node->identity.rev_minor;
        return true;
    case 6U:
        syn_poke_u32_le(node->identity.serial_number, tx_data, *out_idx);
        *out_idx += 4U;
        return true;
    case 9U:
        tx_data[(*out_idx)++] = node->identity.quick_connect_enabled ? 1U : 0U;
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void dnet_get_attr_single(const SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t class_id, uint8_t attr_id,
                                 uint8_t *tx_data, uint8_t *out_idx)
{
    if (class_id == 0x01U) {
        if (!dnet_get_identity_attr(node, attr_id, tx_data, out_idx)) {
            tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
            tx_data[2] = 0x14U;
            *out_idx = 3U;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (class_id == 0x03U) {
        if (attr_id == 1U) {
            tx_data[(*out_idx)++] = node->devicenet_obj.mac_id;
        } else if (attr_id == 2U) {
            tx_data[(*out_idx)++] = (uint8_t)node->devicenet_obj.baud_rate;
        } else {
            tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
            tx_data[2] = 0x14U;
            *out_idx = 3U;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (class_id == 0x04U) {
        if ((node->assembly.input_buf != NULL) && (node->assembly.input_len > 0U)) {
            uint8_t max_rem = (uint8_t)(8U - *out_idx);
            uint8_t copy_len =
                (node->assembly.input_len > max_rem) ? max_rem : node->assembly.input_len;
            memcpy(&tx_data[*out_idx], node->assembly.input_buf, copy_len);
            *out_idx += copy_len;
        }
        return;
    }
    tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
    tx_data[2] = 0x05U;
    *out_idx = 3U;
}

static void dnet_set_attr_single(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t class_id, uint8_t attr_id,
                                 const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len, uint8_t *tx_data,
                                 uint8_t *out_idx)
{
    if (len < 5U) {
        tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
        tx_data[2] = 0x13U;
        *out_idx = 3U;
        return;
    }
    if ((class_id == 0x01U) && (attr_id == 9U)) {
        node->identity.quick_connect_enabled = (data[4] != 0U);
        return;
    }
    if ((class_id == 0x03U) && (attr_id == 1U)) {
        if (data[4] <= SYN_DEVICENET_MAX_MAC_ID) {
            node->devicenet_obj.mac_id = data[4];
            return;
        }
        tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
        tx_data[2] = 0x09U;
        *out_idx = 3U;
        return;
    }
    tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
    tx_data[2] = ((class_id == 0x01U) || (class_id == 0x03U)) ? 0x14U : 0x05U;
    *out_idx = 3U;
}

static bool handle_explicit_message(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len,
                                    uint8_t *tx_data, uint8_t *tx_len)
{
    if ((len < 4U) || ((data[0] & 0x80U) != 0U)) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t service = data[1] & 0x7FU;
    uint8_t class_id = data[2];
    uint8_t attr_id = data[3];

    tx_data[0] = node->devicenet_obj.mac_id;
    tx_data[1] = service | 0x80U;

    uint8_t out_idx = 2U;

    if (service == 0x0EU) {
        dnet_get_attr_single(node, class_id, attr_id, tx_data, &out_idx);
    } else if (service == 0x10U) {
        dnet_set_attr_single(node, class_id, attr_id, data, len, tx_data, &out_idx);
    } else {
        tx_data[1] = 0x94U;
        tx_data[2] = 0x08U;
        out_idx = 3U;
    }

    *tx_len = out_idx;
    return true;
}

static bool dnet_handle_polled_io(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint8_t mac, const uint8_t *data,
                                  uint8_t len, uint32_t *tx_can_id, uint8_t *tx_data,
                                  uint8_t *tx_len)
{
    node->polled_connected = true;

    if ((node->assembly.output_buf != NULL) && (len > 0U)) {
        uint8_t copy_len = len > node->assembly.output_len ? node->assembly.output_len : len;
        memcpy(node->assembly.output_buf, data, copy_len);
    }

    *tx_can_id = make_group2_can_id(mac, GROUP2_POLLED_RESP_MSG_ID);
    if ((node->assembly.input_buf != NULL) && (node->assembly.input_len > 0U)) {
        memcpy(tx_data, node->assembly.input_buf, node->assembly.input_len);
        *tx_len = node->assembly.input_len;
    } else {
        *tx_len = 0U;
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_devicenet_on_can_rx(SYN_DeviceNet_Node *node, uint32_t can_id, const uint8_t *data,
                             uint8_t len, uint32_t *tx_can_id, uint8_t *tx_data, uint8_t *tx_len)
{
    if ((node == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (tx_can_id == NULL) || (tx_data == NULL) ||
        (tx_len == NULL)) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t mac = node->devicenet_obj.mac_id;

    /* 1. Group 4 Duplicate MAC ID Check Request & Response */
    uint32_t dup_req_id = make_group4_can_id(mac, GROUP4_DUP_MAC_REQ_MSG_ID);
    uint32_t dup_resp_id = make_group4_can_id(mac, GROUP4_DUP_MAC_RESP_MSG_ID);
    if (can_id == dup_resp_id) {
        node->dup_mac_failed = true;
        node->state = SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_OFFLINE;
        return false;
    }
    if (can_id == dup_req_id) {
        if (node->state == SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_ONLINE) {
            *tx_can_id = dup_resp_id;
            syn_poke_u32_le(node->identity.serial_number, tx_data, 0);
            *tx_len = 4U;
            return true;
        }
        if (node->state == SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_DUP_MAC_CHECK) {
            node->dup_mac_failed = true;
            node->state = SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_OFFLINE;
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (node->state != SYN_DEVICENET_STATE_ONLINE) {
        return false;
    }

    /* 2. Group 2 Explicit Request */
    uint32_t exp_req_id = make_group2_can_id(mac, GROUP2_EXPLICIT_REQ_MSG_ID);
    if (can_id == exp_req_id) {
        if (!handle_explicit_message(node, data, len, tx_data, tx_len)) {
            return false;
        }
        node->explicit_connected = true;
        *tx_can_id = make_group2_can_id(mac, GROUP2_EXPLICIT_RESP_MSG_ID);
        return true;
    }

    /* 3. Group 2 Polled I/O Command */
    if (can_id == make_group2_can_id(mac, GROUP2_POLLED_CMD_MSG_ID)) {
        return dnet_handle_polled_io(node, mac, data, len, tx_can_id, tx_data, tx_len);
    }

    return false;
}

#include "syn_dlt645.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Checksum Calculation ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

uint8_t syn_dlt645_calc_checksum(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (buf == NULL || len == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint32_t sum = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        sum += buf[i];
    }
    return (uint8_t)(sum & 0xFF);
}

static size_t dlt645_di_len(uint8_t control, SYN_DLT645_Ver version)
{
    if ((control & 0x40U) != 0U) {
        return 0U;
    }
    uint8_t fn = (uint8_t)(control & 0x1FU);
    if ((control & 0x80U) != 0U) {
        if (((fn & 0x0FU) != 0x01U) && ((fn & 0x0FU) != 0x02U)) {
            return 0U;
        }
    } else if ((control == 0x08U) || (fn == 0x13U) || (fn == 0x15U) || (fn == 0x16U) ||
               (fn == 0x17U)) {
        return 0U;
    }
    return (version == SYN_DLT645_VER_1997) ? 2U : 4U;
}

static uint32_t dlt645_decode_di(const uint8_t *p, size_t di_len)
{
    if (di_len == 2U) {
        uint8_t di0 = (uint8_t)(p[0] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        uint8_t di1 = (uint8_t)(p[1] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        return (uint32_t)di0 | ((uint32_t)di1 << 8U);
    }
    if (di_len == 4U) {
        uint8_t di0 = (uint8_t)(p[0] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        uint8_t di1 = (uint8_t)(p[1] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        uint8_t di2 = (uint8_t)(p[2] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        uint8_t di3 = (uint8_t)(p[3] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        return (uint32_t)di0 | ((uint32_t)di1 << 8U) | ((uint32_t)di2 << 16U) |
               ((uint32_t)di3 << 24U);
    }
    return 0U;
}

/* ── Encoder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

size_t syn_dlt645_encode(const SYN_DLT645_Frame *frame, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t out_capacity)
{
    if (frame == NULL || out_buf == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t di_len = dlt645_di_len(frame->control, frame->version);
    size_t data_len = di_len + frame->payload_len;
    size_t total_len = 10 + data_len + 2; /* 10 header + data_len + 1 CS + 1 EOF */

    if (out_capacity < total_len || data_len > 255 || frame->payload_len > sizeof(frame->payload)) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t idx = 0;
    out_buf[idx++] = SYN_DLT645_SOF;

    /* 6-byte address */
    memcpy(&out_buf[idx], frame->address, SYN_DLT645_ADDR_LEN);
    idx += SYN_DLT645_ADDR_LEN;

    out_buf[idx++] = SYN_DLT645_SOF;
    out_buf[idx++] = frame->control;
    out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)data_len;

    /* Encode Data Identifier (DI) with +0x33 offset (little-endian) */
    if (di_len == 2U) {
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)((frame->data_id & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(((frame->data_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
    } else if (di_len == 4U) {
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)((frame->data_id & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(((frame->data_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(((frame->data_id >> 16U) & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(((frame->data_id >> 24U) & 0xFFU) + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
    }

    /* Encode Payload with +0x33 offset */
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < frame->payload_len; i++) {
        out_buf[idx++] = (uint8_t)(frame->payload[i] + SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
    }

    /* Modulo-256 Checksum over bytes 0 to idx-1 */
    out_buf[idx] = syn_dlt645_calc_checksum(out_buf, idx);
    idx++;

    out_buf[idx++] = SYN_DLT645_EOF;

    return idx;
}

/* ── Parser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_dlt645_parse(const uint8_t *in_buf, size_t len, SYN_DLT645_Ver version,
                            SYN_DLT645_Frame *out_frame)
{
    if (in_buf == NULL || out_frame == NULL || len < 12) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Strip leading preambles (0xFE) */
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start < len && in_buf[start] == SYN_DLT645_PREAMBLE) {
        start++;
    }

    size_t rem = len - start;
    if (rem < 12) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const uint8_t *buf = &in_buf[start];

    /* Validate SOF1 and SOF2 */
    if (buf[0] != SYN_DLT645_SOF || buf[7] != SYN_DLT645_SOF) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t control = buf[8];
    uint8_t data_len = buf[9];
    size_t di_len = dlt645_di_len(control, version);

    if ((data_len < di_len) || (((size_t)data_len - di_len) > sizeof(out_frame->payload))) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t total_frame_len = 10U + (size_t)data_len + 2U;
    if (rem < total_frame_len) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Validate EOF */
    if (buf[total_frame_len - 1] != SYN_DLT645_EOF) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Validate Checksum */
    uint8_t calc_cs = syn_dlt645_calc_checksum(buf, total_frame_len - 2);
    uint8_t frame_cs = buf[total_frame_len - 2];
    if (calc_cs != frame_cs) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Populate output frame struct */
    memset(out_frame, 0, sizeof(*out_frame));
    out_frame->version = version;
    memcpy(out_frame->address, &buf[1], SYN_DLT645_ADDR_LEN);
    out_frame->control = control;
    out_frame->data_id = dlt645_decode_di(&buf[10], di_len);

    /* Decode Payload (subtract 0x33) */
    size_t payload_bytes = (size_t)data_len - di_len;
    out_frame->payload_len = (uint8_t)payload_bytes;
    size_t payload_offset = 10U + di_len;

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < out_frame->payload_len; i++) {
        out_frame->payload[i] = (uint8_t)(buf[payload_offset + i] - SYN_DLT645_OFFSET);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Streaming Decoder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_dlt645_decoder_init(SYN_DLT645_Decoder *dec, SYN_DLT645_Ver version,
                             SYN_DLT645_FrameCallback cb, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(dec != NULL);

    memset(dec, 0, sizeof(*dec));
    dec->version = version;
    dec->cb = cb;
    dec->cb_ctx = ctx;
}

static void dlt645_shift_to_next_sof(SYN_DLT645_Decoder *dec)
{
    for (size_t i = 1U; i < dec->rx_len; i++) {
        if (dec->rx_buf[i] == SYN_DLT645_SOF) {
            dec->rx_len -= i;
            memmove(dec->rx_buf, &dec->rx_buf[i], dec->rx_len);
            return;
        }
    }
    dec->rx_len = 0U;
}

void syn_dlt645_decoder_feed(SYN_DLT645_Decoder *dec, uint8_t rx_byte)
{
    if (dec == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    /* Ignore preambles if buffer is empty */
    if (dec->rx_len == 0U && rx_byte == SYN_DLT645_PREAMBLE) {
        return;
    }

    /* Must start with SOF (0x68) */
    if (dec->rx_len == 0U && rx_byte != SYN_DLT645_SOF) {
        return;
    }

    /* Prevent overflow */
    if (dec->rx_len >= sizeof(dec->rx_buf)) {
        dec->rx_len = 0U;
        return;
    }

    dec->rx_buf[dec->rx_len++] = rx_byte;

    /* Check potential frame completion or resync on EOF byte */
    if (rx_byte == SYN_DLT645_EOF) {
        while (dec->rx_len >= 12U) {
            SYN_DLT645_Frame frame;
            SYN_Status st = syn_dlt645_parse(dec->rx_buf, dec->rx_len, dec->version, &frame);
            if (st == SYN_OK) {
                if (dec->cb != NULL) {
                    dec->cb(&frame, dec->cb_ctx);
                }
                dec->rx_len = 0U;
                break;
            }
            if (st != SYN_ERROR) {
                break;
            }
            dlt645_shift_to_next_sof(dec);
        }
    }
}

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_dmx512_master_init(SYN_DMX512_Master *master, uint16_t num_channels)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(master != NULL);

    memset(master, 0, sizeof(*master));
    if (num_channels == 0 || num_channels > SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS) {
        num_channels = SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS;
    }
    master->num_channels = num_channels;
    master->start_code = SYN_DMX512_START_CODE_NULL;
}

SYN_Status syn_dmx512_master_set_channel(SYN_DMX512_Master *master, uint16_t channel, uint8_t value)
{
    if (master == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (channel < 1 || channel > master->num_channels) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    master->channels[channel - 1] = value;
    return SYN_OK;
}

uint8_t syn_dmx512_master_get_channel(const SYN_DMX512_Master *master, uint16_t channel)
{
    if (master == NULL || channel < 1 || channel > master->num_channels) {
        return 0;
    }
    return master->channels[channel - 1];
}

size_t syn_dmx512_master_build_frame(const SYN_DMX512_Master *master, uint8_t *out_buf,
                                     size_t max_len)
{
    if (master == NULL || out_buf == NULL || max_len < 1) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t needed = 1 + master->num_channels;
    if (max_len < needed) {
        return 0;
    }

    out_buf[0] = master->start_code;
    (void)memcpy(&out_buf[1], master->channels, master->num_channels);
    return needed;
}

void syn_dmx512_slave_init(SYN_DMX512_Slave *slave, uint16_t start_address, uint16_t footprint)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(slave != NULL);

    (void)memset(slave, 0, sizeof(*slave));
    uint16_t addr = start_address;
    if (addr < 1)
        addr = 1;
    if (addr > SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS)
        addr = SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS;

    uint16_t fp = footprint;
    if (fp < 1)
        fp = 1;
    if ((uint32_t)addr - 1U + fp > SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS) {
        fp = (uint16_t)(SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS - (addr - 1U));
    }

    slave->start_address = addr;
    slave->footprint = fp;
    slave->rx_state = SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_BREAK;
}

void syn_dmx512_slave_rx_break(SYN_DMX512_Slave *slave)
{
    if (slave == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint32_t end_slot = (uint32_t)slave->start_address + (uint32_t)slave->footprint;
    if (slave->rx_state == SYN_DMX512_STATE_READ_SLOTS && slave->start_address >= 1U &&
        slave->footprint >= 1U && end_slot - 1U <= SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS &&
        (uint32_t)slave->current_slot >= end_slot) {
        slave->frame_complete = true;
    }

    slave->rx_state = SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_START;
    slave->current_slot = 0U;
}

void syn_dmx512_slave_rx_byte(SYN_DMX512_Slave *slave, uint8_t byte)
{
    if (slave == NULL)
        return;

    switch (slave->rx_state) {
    case SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_START:
        slave->start_code = byte;
        if (byte == SYN_DMX512_START_CODE_NULL) {
            slave->rx_state = SYN_DMX512_STATE_READ_SLOTS;
            slave->current_slot = 1; /* Slot 1 is first channel after Start Code */
        } else {
            slave->rx_state = SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_BREAK;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_DMX512_STATE_READ_SLOTS:
        if (slave->current_slot >= slave->start_address &&
            slave->current_slot < slave->start_address + slave->footprint) {
            uint16_t idx = slave->current_slot - slave->start_address;
            slave->rx_channels[idx] = byte;
        }

        slave->current_slot++;
        if (slave->current_slot > SYN_DMX512_MAX_CHANNELS) {
            slave->frame_complete = true;
            slave->rx_state = SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_BREAK;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_DMX512_STATE_WAIT_BREAK:
    default:
        break;
    }
}

uint8_t syn_dmx512_slave_get_channel(const SYN_DMX512_Slave *slave, uint16_t offset)
{
    if (slave == NULL || offset >= slave->footprint) {
        return 0;
    }
    return slave->rx_channels[offset];
}

bool syn_dmx512_slave_is_updated(SYN_DMX512_Slave *slave)
{
    if (slave == NULL)
        return false;

    if (slave->frame_complete) {
        slave->frame_complete = false;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_DMX512 */

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_doip.h"

#if SYN_DOIP_ENABLED

#include <string.h>

static inline void poke_u16_be(uint16_t val, uint8_t *buf)
{
    buf[0] = (uint8_t)(val >> 8U);
    buf[1] = (uint8_t)(val & 0xFFU);
}

static inline uint16_t peek_u16_be(const uint8_t *buf)
{
    return (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)buf[0] << 8U) | (uint16_t)buf[1]);
}

static inline void poke_u32_be(uint32_t val, uint8_t *buf)
{
    buf[0] = (uint8_t)(val >> 24U);
    buf[1] = (uint8_t)(val >> 16U);
    buf[2] = (uint8_t)(val >> 8U);
    buf[3] = (uint8_t)(val & 0xFFU);
}

static inline uint32_t peek_u32_be(const uint8_t *buf)
{
    return ((uint32_t)buf[0] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)buf[1] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)buf[2] << 8U) |
           (uint32_t)buf[3];
}

bool syn_doip_init(SYN_DoIP_Server *server, uint16_t logical_address)
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    memset(server, 0, sizeof(SYN_DoIP_Server));
    server->logical_address = logical_address;
    server->routing_activated = false;
    return true;
}

bool syn_doip_set_identifiers(SYN_DoIP_Server *server, const uint8_t vin[17], const uint8_t eid[6],
                              const uint8_t gid[6])
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    if (vin != NULL) {
        memcpy(server->vin, vin, 17);
    }
    if (eid != NULL) {
        memcpy(server->eid, eid, 6);
    }
    if (gid != NULL) {
        memcpy(server->gid, gid, 6);
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_doip_parse_header(const uint8_t *buf, uint16_t len, SYN_DoIP_Header *hdr)
{
    if (buf == NULL || len < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE || hdr == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    hdr->protocol_version = buf[0];
    hdr->inverse_protocol_version = buf[1];
    hdr->payload_type = peek_u16_be(&buf[2]);
    hdr->payload_length = peek_u32_be(&buf[4]);

    if (hdr->protocol_version != SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION ||
        hdr->inverse_protocol_version != SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

uint16_t syn_doip_encode_header(const SYN_DoIP_Header *hdr, uint8_t *buf, uint16_t max_len)
{
    if (hdr == NULL || buf == NULL || max_len < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE) {
        return 0U;
    }
    buf[0] = hdr->protocol_version;
    buf[1] = hdr->inverse_protocol_version;
    poke_u16_be(hdr->payload_type, &buf[2]);
    poke_u32_be(hdr->payload_length, &buf[4]);
    return SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE;
}

static bool build_generic_nack(uint8_t nack_code, uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx,
                               uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (max_tx < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + 1U) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_DoIP_Header resp_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_GENERIC_NACK,
                                .payload_length = 1U};
    syn_doip_encode_header(&resp_hdr, tx_buf, max_tx);
    tx_buf[8] = nack_code;
    *tx_len = SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + 1U;
    return true;
}

static bool build_diag_nack(const SYN_DoIP_Server *server, uint16_t sa, uint8_t nack_code,
                            uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx_len, uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    uint32_t payload_len = 5U;
    if (max_tx_len < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_DoIP_Header resp_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG_NACK,
                                .payload_length = payload_len};
    syn_doip_encode_header(&resp_hdr, tx_buf, max_tx_len);
    uint8_t *p = &tx_buf[SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE];
    poke_u16_be(server->logical_address, &p[0]);
    poke_u16_be(sa, &p[2]);
    p[4] = nack_code;
    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len);
    return true;
}

static bool handle_vehicle_id_req(const SYN_DoIP_Server *server, const SYN_DoIP_Header *hdr,
                                  const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx_len,
                                  uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (hdr->payload_type == SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ID_REQ) {
        if (hdr->payload_length != 0U) {
            return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len,
                                      tx_len);
        }
    } else if (hdr->payload_type == SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ID_REQ_EID) {
        if (hdr->payload_length != 6U) {
            return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len,
                                      tx_len);
        }
        if (memcmp(payload, server->eid, 6U) != 0) {
            *tx_len = 0U;
            return true;
        }
    } else {
        if (hdr->payload_length != 17U) {
            return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len,
                                      tx_len);
        }
        if (memcmp(payload, server->vin, 17U) != 0) {
            *tx_len = 0U;
            return true;
        }
    }

    uint32_t payload_len = 33U;
    if (max_tx_len < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_DoIP_Header resp_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ANNOUNCEMENT,
                                .payload_length = payload_len};
    syn_doip_encode_header(&resp_hdr, tx_buf, max_tx_len);

    uint8_t *p = &tx_buf[SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE];
    memcpy(p, server->vin, 17U);
    poke_u16_be(server->logical_address, &p[17]);
    memcpy(&p[19], server->eid, 6U);
    memcpy(&p[25], server->gid, 6U);
    p[31] = 0x00U;
    p[32] = 0x00U;

    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len);
    return true;
}

static bool handle_routing_activation(SYN_DoIP_Server *server, const SYN_DoIP_Header *hdr,
                                      const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx_len,
                                      uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if ((hdr->payload_length != 7U) && (hdr->payload_length != 11U)) {
        return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    }
    uint16_t tester_addr = peek_u16_be(&payload[0]);
    uint8_t resp_code = SYN_DOIP_ROUTING_SUCCESS;
    if (server->routing_activated && (tester_addr != server->active_tester_address)) {
        resp_code = SYN_DOIP_ROUTING_DENIED_UNKNOWN_TESTER;
    } else {
        server->active_tester_address = tester_addr;
        server->routing_activated = true;
    }

    uint32_t payload_len = 9U;
    if (max_tx_len < SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len) {
        return false;
    }
    SYN_DoIP_Header resp_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_ROUTING_ACTIVATION_RESP,
                                .payload_length = payload_len};
    syn_doip_encode_header(&resp_hdr, tx_buf, max_tx_len);

    uint8_t *p = &tx_buf[SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE];
    poke_u16_be(tester_addr, &p[0]);
    poke_u16_be(server->logical_address, &p[2]);
    p[4] = resp_code;
    poke_u32_be(0x00000000U, &p[5]);

    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len);
    return true;
}

static bool handle_diagnostic_msg(SYN_DoIP_Server *server, SYN_UDS_Server *uds,
                                  const SYN_DoIP_Header *hdr, const uint8_t *payload,
                                  uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx_len, uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (hdr->payload_length < 4U) {
        return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    }
    uint16_t sa = peek_u16_be(&payload[0]);
    uint16_t ta = peek_u16_be(&payload[2]);

    if (!server->routing_activated || sa != server->active_tester_address) {
        return build_diag_nack(server, sa, SYN_DOIP_DIAG_NACK_INVALID_SA, tx_buf, max_tx_len,
                               tx_len);
    }
    if (ta != server->logical_address && ta != 0xFFFFU) {
        return build_diag_nack(server, sa, SYN_DOIP_DIAG_NACK_UNKNOWN_TA, tx_buf, max_tx_len,
                               tx_len);
    }

    uint32_t ack_frame_len = SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + 5U;
    if ((uint32_t)max_tx_len < ack_frame_len) {
        return false;
    }

    const uint8_t *uds_req = &payload[4];
    uint16_t uds_req_len = (uint16_t)(hdr->payload_length - 4U);
    uint16_t uds_resp_len = 0U;

    if ((uds != NULL) && (uds_req_len > 0U)) {
        uint8_t scratch_nrc[3];
        uint32_t diag_payload_off = ack_frame_len + SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + 4U;
        uint8_t *uds_out = scratch_nrc;
        uint16_t uds_cap = (uint16_t)sizeof(scratch_nrc);
        if ((uint32_t)max_tx_len >= (diag_payload_off + 3U)) {
            uds_out = &tx_buf[diag_payload_off];
            uds_cap = (uint16_t)(max_tx_len - (uint16_t)diag_payload_off);
        }
        SYN_UDS_AddrMode addr_type =
            (ta == 0xFFFFU) ? SYN_UDS_ADDR_FUNCTIONAL : SYN_UDS_ADDR_PHYSICAL;
        syn_uds_process_request(uds, uds_req, uds_req_len, uds_out, uds_cap, &uds_resp_len,
                                addr_type);
        if (uds_resp_len > 0U) {
            if ((uint32_t)max_tx_len < (diag_payload_off + (uint32_t)uds_resp_len)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (uds_out == scratch_nrc) {
                memcpy(&tx_buf[diag_payload_off], scratch_nrc, uds_resp_len);
            }
        }
    }

    SYN_DoIP_Header ack_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                               .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                               .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG_ACK,
                               .payload_length = 5U};
    syn_doip_encode_header(&ack_hdr, tx_buf, max_tx_len);
    poke_u16_be(server->logical_address, &tx_buf[8]);
    poke_u16_be(sa, &tx_buf[10]);
    tx_buf[12] = SYN_DOIP_DIAG_ACK_OK;

    uint32_t diag_frame_len = 0U;
    if (uds_resp_len > 0U) {
        diag_frame_len = (uint32_t)(SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE + 4U + uds_resp_len);
        uint8_t *diag_out = &tx_buf[ack_frame_len];
        SYN_DoIP_Header resp_hdr = {.protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                    .inverse_protocol_version = SYN_DOIP_INVERSE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                                    .payload_type = SYN_DOIP_TYPE_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG,
                                    .payload_length = 4U + (uint32_t)uds_resp_len};
        syn_doip_encode_header(&resp_hdr, diag_out, (uint16_t)(max_tx_len - ack_frame_len));
        poke_u16_be(server->logical_address, &diag_out[8]);
        poke_u16_be(sa, &diag_out[10]);
    }

    *tx_len = (uint16_t)(ack_frame_len + diag_frame_len);
    return true;
}

bool syn_doip_process_msg(SYN_DoIP_Server *server, SYN_UDS_Server *uds, const uint8_t *rx_buf,
                          uint16_t rx_len, uint8_t *tx_buf, uint16_t max_tx_len, uint16_t *tx_len)
{
    if (server == NULL || rx_buf == NULL || tx_buf == NULL || tx_len == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    *tx_len = 0U;

    SYN_DoIP_Header hdr;
    if (!syn_doip_parse_header(rx_buf, rx_len, &hdr)) {
        return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INCORRECT_PATTERN, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    }

    if ((size_t)hdr.payload_length > (size_t)(rx_len - SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE)) {
        return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_INVALID_PAYLOAD_LENGTH, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    }

    const uint8_t *payload = &rx_buf[SYN_DOIP_HEADER_SIZE];

    switch (hdr.payload_type) {
    case SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ID_REQ:
    case SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ID_REQ_EID:
    case SYN_DOIP_TYPE_VEHICLE_ID_REQ_VIN:
        return handle_vehicle_id_req(server, &hdr, payload, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    case SYN_DOIP_TYPE_ROUTING_ACTIVATION_REQ:
        return handle_routing_activation(server, &hdr, payload, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    case SYN_DOIP_TYPE_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG:
        return handle_diagnostic_msg(server, uds, &hdr, payload, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    default:
        return build_generic_nack(SYN_DOIP_NACK_UNKNOWN_PAYLOAD_TYPE, tx_buf, max_tx_len, tx_len);
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_DOIP_ENABLED */

docs.text: Implements lightweight, zero-malloc ISO 13400-2 DoIP header serialization, vehicle identification, routing activation, and UDS (ISO 14229-1) message routing over TCP/UDP.

SYN_Status syn_ecat_master_init (
    SYN_EcatMaster * m,
    uint8_t * tx_buf,
    uint16_t tx_buf_size,
    uint8_t * rx_buf,
    uint16_t rx_buf_size,

    uint8_t * input_image,

Cyclic and register-only masters require at least 64 bytes for tx_buf_size and rx_buf_size. Masters using CoE SDO mailbox operations require at least SYN_ECAT_COE_MIN_BUF_SIZE (142 bytes).

  • tx_buf_size Capacity of transmit frame buffer (>= 64 bytes; >= 142 bytes for CoE).
  • rx_buf Pointer to static receive frame buffer.
  • rx_buf_size Capacity of receive frame buffer (>= 64 bytes; >= 142 bytes for CoE).
  • output_image Output process image buffer pointer.
  • output_size Output process image byte size.
  • input_image Input process image buffer pointer.
  • input_size Input process image byte size.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM if parameters null/invalid.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
