void syn_gbt27930_init(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, SYN_GBT27930_Role role)
{
    if (session == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memset(session, 0, sizeof(*session));
    session->role = role;
    session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_IDLE;
    session->telemetry.charge_mode = 0x01U; /* Default CV */
}

SYN_Status syn_gbt27930_start_handshake(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session)
{
    if (session == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE;
    session->timer_ms = 0U;
    session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
    session->ready_for_charging = false;
    session->peer_ready_for_charging = false;
    session->crm00_received = false;
    session->brm_received = false;
    session->bcp_received = false;
    session->cml_sent = false;
    session->cml_received = false;
    session->cts_received = false;
    session->bro_received = false;
    session->crm_aa_retransmit = false;
    session->ready_tx_sent = false;
    session->stop_tx_sent = false;
    session->peer_stopped = false;
    session->stats_received = false;
    session->tx_substep = 0U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_gbt27930_stop_charging(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t reason)
{
    if (session == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING;
    session->stop_reason = reason;
    session->timer_ms = 0U;
    session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
    session->tx_substep = 0U;
    session->stop_tx_sent = false;
    session->peer_stopped = false;
    session->stats_received = false;
}

static void gbt_handle_stop_rx(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_IDLE || session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR ||
        session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END) {
        return;
    }

    if (frame->dlc >= 1U) {
        session->stop_reason = frame->data[0];
    }
    session->peer_stopped = true;
    session->timeout_ms = 0U;

    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING && session->stop_tx_sent) {
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END;
        session->timer_ms = 0U;
        session->tx_substep = 0U;
        return;
    }

    if (session->state != SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING) {
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING;
        session->stop_tx_sent = false;
        session->timer_ms = 0U;
        session->tx_substep = 0U;
    }
}

static void gbt_handle_error_rx(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_IDLE) {
        return;
    }

    session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR;
    session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    session->timer_ms = 0U;
    if (frame->dlc >= 1U) {
        session->fault_code = frame->data[0];
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_bms_handshake(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                                 const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRM && frame->dlc >= 1U) {
        if (frame->data[0] == 0x00U) {
            if (!session->crm00_received) {
                session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            }
            session->crm00_received = true;
        } else if (frame->data[0] == 0xAAU && session->crm00_received) {
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG;
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
            session->ready_for_charging = false;
            session->peer_ready_for_charging = false;
            session->ready_tx_sent = false;
        }
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_bms_config(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                              const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CTS && frame->dlc >= 7U) {
        memcpy(session->sync_time_bcd, frame->data, 7U);
        session->cts_received = true;
        return;
    }

    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CML && frame->dlc >= 8U) {
        session->charger_cfg.max_output_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->charger_cfg.min_output_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->charger_cfg.max_output_curr_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[4]);
        session->charger_cfg.min_output_curr_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[6]);
        if (!session->cml_received) {
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
        }
        session->cml_received = true;
        return;
    }

    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRO && frame->dlc >= 1U && frame->data[0] == 0xAAU) {
        session->peer_ready_for_charging = true;
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
        if (session->ready_for_charging && session->ready_tx_sent) {
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
            session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
        }
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_bms_runtime(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                               const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CCS && session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING &&
        frame->dlc >= 6U) {
        session->telemetry.measured_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->telemetry.measured_curr_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->telemetry.cumulative_time_min = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[4]);
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CST) {
        gbt_handle_stop_rx(session, frame);
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CSD &&
               (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING ||
                session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END) &&
               frame->dlc >= 4U) {
        session->telemetry.cumulative_time_min = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->telemetry.output_energy_kwh = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->stats_received = true;
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END;
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CEM) {
        gbt_handle_error_rx(session, frame);
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_bms(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE &&
        (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CHM || pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRM)) {
        gbt_rx_bms_handshake(session, pgn, frame);
    } else if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG &&
               (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CTS || pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CML ||
                pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRO)) {
        gbt_rx_bms_config(session, pgn, frame);
    } else {
        gbt_rx_bms_runtime(session, pgn, frame);
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_charger_handshake(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                                     const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BHM && frame->dlc >= 2U) {
        session->bms_cfg.max_charge_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRM && frame->dlc >= 8U) {
        session->bms_cfg.battery_type = frame->data[3];
        session->bms_cfg.rated_capacity_ah = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[4]);
        session->bms_cfg.rated_voltage_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[6]);
        session->brm_received = true;
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_charger_config(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                                  const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRM && !session->bcp_received && frame->dlc >= 8U) {
        session->crm_aa_retransmit = true;
        return;
    }

    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCP && frame->dlc >= 8U) {
        session->bms_cfg.max_charge_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->bms_cfg.max_charge_curr_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->bms_cfg.max_cell_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[4]);
        session->bms_cfg.max_temp_c = frame->data[6];
        session->telemetry.soc_percent = frame->data[7];
        if (!session->bcp_received) {
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
        }
        session->bcp_received = true;
        session->crm_aa_retransmit = false;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRO && frame->dlc >= 1U) {
        if (frame->data[0] == 0x00U) {
            if (!session->bro_received) {
                session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            }
            session->bro_received = true;
        } else if (frame->data[0] == 0xAAU) {
            session->bro_received = true;
            session->peer_ready_for_charging = true;
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            if (session->ready_for_charging && session->ready_tx_sent) {
                session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING;
                session->tx_substep = 0U;
                session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
            }
        }
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_charger_charging(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                                    const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCL && frame->dlc >= 5U) {
        session->telemetry.volt_demand_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->telemetry.curr_demand_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->telemetry.charge_mode = frame->data[4];
        session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCS && frame->dlc >= 8U) {
        session->telemetry.measured_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[0]);
        session->telemetry.measured_curr_a = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[2]);
        session->telemetry.max_cell_volt_v =
            (uint16_t)(gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[4]) & 0x0FFFU);
        session->telemetry.soc_percent = frame->data[6];
        session->telemetry.remaining_time_min = frame->data[7];
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BSM && frame->dlc >= 7U) {
        session->telemetry.max_cell_temp_c = frame->data[1];
        session->telemetry.min_cell_temp_c = frame->data[3];
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_charger_runtime(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn,
                                   const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BST) {
        gbt_handle_stop_rx(session, frame);
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BSD &&
               (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING ||
                session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END) &&
               frame->dlc >= 7U) {
        session->telemetry.soc_percent = frame->data[0];
        session->telemetry.max_cell_volt_v = gbt_unpack_u16_le(&frame->data[3]);
        session->telemetry.min_cell_temp_c = frame->data[5];
        session->telemetry.max_cell_temp_c = frame->data[6];
        session->stats_received = true;
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END;
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
    } else if (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BEM) {
        gbt_handle_error_rx(session, frame);
    }
}

static void gbt_rx_charger(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t pgn, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE &&
        (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BHM || pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRM)) {
        gbt_rx_charger_handshake(session, pgn, frame);
    } else if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG &&
               (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRM || pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCP ||
                pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRO)) {
        gbt_rx_charger_config(session, pgn, frame);
    } else if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING &&
               (pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCL || pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCS ||
                pgn == SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BSM)) {
        gbt_rx_charger_charging(session, pgn, frame);
    } else {
        gbt_rx_charger_runtime(session, pgn, frame);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_gbt27930_process_rx_frame(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (session == NULL || frame == NULL || !frame->extended) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_J1939_Header hdr;
    (void)syn_j1939_id_unpack(frame->id, &hdr);

    uint8_t local_sa = (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS) ? SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_BMS
                                                                : SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_CHARGER;
    uint8_t peer_sa = (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS) ? SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_CHARGER
                                                               : SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_BMS;
    if (hdr.sa != peer_sa || (hdr.da != local_sa && hdr.da != 0xFFU)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS) {
        gbt_rx_bms(session, hdr.pgn, frame);
    } else {
        gbt_rx_charger(session, hdr.pgn, frame);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool gbt_tx_bms_early(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da,
                             SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE) {
        if (!session->crm00_received) {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BHM, sa, da);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->bms_cfg.max_charge_volt_v);
        } else {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRM, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = 0x01U;
            tx_frame->data[1] = 0x01U;
            tx_frame->data[2] = 0x00U;
            tx_frame->data[3] = session->bms_cfg.battery_type;
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[4], session->bms_cfg.rated_capacity_ah);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[6], session->bms_cfg.rated_voltage_v);
        }
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;
    }

    if (!session->ready_for_charging) {
        if (session->cml_received && (session->tx_substep & 1U) == 0U) {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRO, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = 0x00U;
        } else {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCP, sa, da);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->bms_cfg.max_charge_volt_v);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->bms_cfg.max_charge_curr_a);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[4], session->bms_cfg.max_cell_volt_v);
            tx_frame->data[6] = (uint8_t)(session->bms_cfg.max_temp_c & 0xFFU);
            tx_frame->data[7] = session->telemetry.soc_percent;
        }
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;
    }

    tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BRO, sa, da);
    tx_frame->data[0] = 0xAAU;
    session->ready_tx_sent = true;
    if (session->peer_ready_for_charging) {
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING;
        session->tx_substep = 0U;
        session->timeout_ms = 0U;
        session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool gbt_tx_bms_charging(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da,
                                SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    uint8_t slot = (uint8_t)(session->tx_substep % 3U);
    if (slot == 0U) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCL, sa, da);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->telemetry.volt_demand_v);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->telemetry.curr_demand_a);
        tx_frame->data[4] = session->telemetry.charge_mode;
    } else if (slot == 1U) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BCS, sa, da);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->telemetry.measured_volt_v);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->telemetry.measured_curr_a);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[4], session->telemetry.max_cell_volt_v);
        tx_frame->data[6] = session->telemetry.soc_percent;
        tx_frame->data[7] = (uint8_t)(session->telemetry.remaining_time_min & 0xFFU);
    } else {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BSM, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = 0x01U;
        tx_frame->data[1] = session->telemetry.max_cell_temp_c;
        tx_frame->data[2] = 0x01U;
        tx_frame->data[3] = session->telemetry.min_cell_temp_c;
        tx_frame->data[4] = 0x01U;
        tx_frame->data[5] = 0x00U;
        tx_frame->data[6] = 0x10U;
    }
    session->tx_substep++;
    return true;
}

static bool gbt_tx_bms(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da,
                       SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE ||
        session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG) {
        return gbt_tx_bms_early(session, sa, da, tx_frame);
    }

    switch (session->state) {
    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING:
        return gbt_tx_bms_charging(session, sa, da, tx_frame);

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(4U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BST, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = session->stop_reason;
        session->stop_tx_sent = true;
        if (session->peer_stopped) {
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END;
            session->timer_ms = 0U;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
        }
        return true;

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BSD, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = session->telemetry.soc_percent;
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[3], session->telemetry.max_cell_volt_v);
        tx_frame->data[5] = session->telemetry.min_cell_temp_c;
        tx_frame->data[6] = session->telemetry.max_cell_temp_c;
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(2U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_BEM, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = session->fault_code;
        return true;

    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool gbt_tx_charger_early(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da,
                                 SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE) {
        if (session->brm_received) {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRM, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = 0xAAU;
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            session->ready_for_charging = false;
            session->peer_ready_for_charging = false;
            session->ready_tx_sent = false;
            return true;
        }
        if ((session->tx_substep & 1U) == 0U) {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CHM, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = 0x01U;
            tx_frame->data[1] = 0x01U;
            tx_frame->data[2] = 0x00U;
        } else {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRM, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = 0x00U;
        }
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;
    }

    if (session->crm_aa_retransmit) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRM, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = 0xAAU;
        session->crm_aa_retransmit = false;
        return true;
    }

    if (session->ready_for_charging) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRO, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = 0xAAU;
        session->ready_tx_sent = true;
        if (session->peer_ready_for_charging) {
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
            session->timeout_ms = 0U;
            session->bcl_timeout_ms = 0U;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (session->bcp_received && session->cml_sent && session->bro_received) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CRO, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = 0x00U;
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;
    }

    if ((session->tx_substep & 1U) == 0U) {
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CTS, sa, da);
        if (session->sync_time_bcd[6] != 0U) {
            memcpy(tx_frame->data, session->sync_time_bcd, 7U);
        } else {
            memset(tx_frame->data, 0xFF, 7U);
        }
        tx_frame->data[7] = 0xFFU;
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;
    }

    tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CML, sa, da);
    gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->charger_cfg.max_output_volt_v);
    gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->charger_cfg.min_output_volt_v);
    gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[4], session->charger_cfg.max_output_curr_a);
    gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[6], session->charger_cfg.min_output_curr_a);
    session->cml_sent = true;
    session->tx_substep++;
    return true;
}

static bool gbt_tx_charger(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da,
                           SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_HANDSHAKE ||
        session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_PARAM_CONFIG) {
        return gbt_tx_charger_early(session, sa, da, tx_frame);
    }

    switch (session->state) {
    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CCS, sa, da);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->telemetry.measured_volt_v);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->telemetry.measured_curr_a);
        gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[4], session->telemetry.cumulative_time_min);
        tx_frame->data[6] = 0x01U;
        return true;

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(4U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CST, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = session->stop_reason;
        session->stop_tx_sent = true;
        if (session->peer_stopped) {
            session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END;
            session->timer_ms = 0U;
            session->tx_substep = 0U;
        }
        return true;

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END:
        if (!session->stats_received && (session->tx_substep & 1U) == 1U) {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(4U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CST, sa, da);
            tx_frame->data[0] = session->stop_reason;
        } else {
            tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CSD, sa, da);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[0], session->telemetry.cumulative_time_min);
            gbt_pack_u16_le(&tx_frame->data[2], session->telemetry.output_energy_kwh);
        }
        session->tx_substep++;
        return true;

    case SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR:
        tx_frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(2U, SYN_GBT27930_PGN_CEM, sa, da);
        tx_frame->data[0] = session->fault_code;
        return true;

    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static uint32_t gbt_get_tx_interval_ms(const SYN_GBT27930_Session *session)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING) {
        return (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS) ? 25U : 50U;
    }
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_STOPPING) {
        return 10U;
    }
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR) {
        return 100U;
    }
    return 250U;
}

static bool gbt_check_phase_bounds(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session)
{
    if (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_END && session->stats_received &&
        session->tx_substep >= 2U) {
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_IDLE;
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t limit_ms =
        (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING && session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS)
            ? 1000U
            : 5000U;
    bool bcl_expired = (session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING) &&
                       (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_CHARGER) &&
                       (session->bcl_timeout_ms >= 1000U);
    if (session->state != SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR &&
        (session->timeout_ms >= limit_ms || bcl_expired)) {
        session->state = SYN_GBT27930_STATE_ERROR;
        session->fault_code = 0x01U;
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_gbt27930_step(SYN_GBT27930_Session *session, uint32_t dt_ms, SYN_CAN_Frame *tx_frame)
{
    if (session == NULL || tx_frame == NULL || session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_IDLE) {
        return false;
    }

    session->timer_ms = gbt_sat_add_u32(session->timer_ms, dt_ms);
    session->timeout_ms = gbt_sat_add_u32(session->timeout_ms, dt_ms);
    if (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_CHARGER &&
        session->state == SYN_GBT27930_STATE_CHARGING) {
        session->bcl_timeout_ms = gbt_sat_add_u32(session->bcl_timeout_ms, dt_ms);
    }
    if (!gbt_check_phase_bounds(session)) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t interval_ms = gbt_get_tx_interval_ms(session);
    if (session->timer_ms < interval_ms) {
        return false;
    }
    session->timer_ms = (dt_ms < interval_ms) ? (session->timer_ms - interval_ms) : 0U;

    memset(tx_frame, 0, sizeof(*tx_frame));
    tx_frame->extended = true;
    tx_frame->dlc = 8U;

    if (session->role == SYN_GBT27930_ROLE_BMS) {
        return gbt_tx_bms(session, SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_BMS, SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_CHARGER, tx_frame);
    }
    return gbt_tx_charger(session, SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_CHARGER, SYN_GBT27930_ADDR_BMS, tx_frame);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_GBT27930 */

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_ibus.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_ibus_init(SYN_IBUS_Parser *parser)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    return SYN_OK;
}

uint16_t syn_ibus_calc_checksum(const uint8_t buf[30])
{
    if (!buf) {
        return 0;
    }
    uint16_t sum = 0xFFFFU;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        sum -= buf[i];
    }
    return sum;
}

SYN_Status syn_ibus_parse_byte(SYN_IBUS_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte, SYN_IBUS_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (parser->idx == 0) {
        if (byte != SYN_IBUS_HEADER1) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    } else if (parser->idx == 1) {
        if (byte == SYN_IBUS_HEADER1) {
            parser->buf[0] = byte;
            return SYN_BUSY;
        }
        if (byte != SYN_IBUS_HEADER2) {
            parser->idx = 0;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    parser->buf[parser->idx++] = byte;

    if (parser->idx >= SYN_IBUS_FRAME_SIZE) {
        parser->idx = 0;

        uint16_t expected_sum = syn_ibus_calc_checksum(parser->buf);
        uint16_t rx_sum = (uint16_t)(parser->buf[30] | (parser->buf[31] << 8));

        if (expected_sum != rx_sum) {
            parser->checksum_errors++;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }

        /* Unpack 14 16-bit little-endian channels */
        for (size_t i = 0; i < SYN_IBUS_NUM_CHANNELS; i++) {
            uint16_t ch = (uint16_t)(parser->buf[2 + (i * 2)] | (parser->buf[3 + (i * 2)] << 8));
            parser->last_frame.channels[i] = ch;
        }

        parser->frames_received++;
        if (frame) {
            *frame = parser->last_frame;
        }

        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return SYN_BUSY;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_IOLINK) || SYN_USE_IOLINK

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../sched/syn_sched.h"
#include "syn_iolink.h"

#include <string.h>

#define SYN_IOLINK_DEFAULT_CYCLE_MS 5U
#define SYN_IOLINK_CRC6_POLY 0x3DU
#define SYN_IOLINK_CRC6_SEED 0x1FU

/* ── Checksum & CRC Calculation ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

uint8_t syn_iolink_calc_checksum(const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    if (data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return 0U;
    }

    uint8_t crc = SYN_IOLINK_CRC6_SEED;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (uint8_t bit = 0U; bit < 8U; bit++) {
            if ((crc & 0x80U) != 0U) {
                crc = (uint8_t)((crc << 1U) ^ SYN_IOLINK_CRC6_POLY);
            } else {
                crc = (uint8_t)(crc << 1U);
            }
        }
    }
    crc = (crc >> 2U) & 0x3FU; /* 6-bit CRC in bits 0..5 */

    /* Calculate parity bits: bit 7 = even parity, bit 6 = odd parity */
    uint8_t p0 = (crc ^ (crc >> 2U) ^ (crc >> 4U)) & 0x01U;
    uint8_t p1 = ~((crc >> 1U) ^ (crc >> 3U) ^ (crc >> 5U)) & 0x01U;

    return (uint8_t)(crc | (p1 << 6U) | (p0 << 7U));
}

/* ── Master Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_init(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, const SYN_IOLink_MasterConfig *cfg)
{
    if (master == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->transport == NULL || cfg->rx_buf == NULL || cfg->tx_buf == NULL ||
        cfg->rx_buf_size < 32U || cfg->tx_buf_size < 32U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(master, 0, sizeof(*master));
    master->cfg = *cfg;
    if (master->cfg.cycle_time_ms == 0U) {
        master->cfg.cycle_time_ms = SYN_IOLINK_DEFAULT_CYCLE_MS;
    }

    master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_INACTIVE;
    master->mseq_type = SYN_IOLINK_TYPE_0;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status master_read_direct_param(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint8_t addr,
                                           uint8_t *out_val)
{
    uint8_t tx[3];
    tx[0] = (uint8_t)(0x80U | (addr & 0x3FU)); /* Read direct parameter (Bit 7=1, Bit 6=0) */
    tx[1] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(&tx[0], 1U);

    if (!syn_transport_send(master->cfg.transport, tx, 2U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_transport_recv(master->cfg.transport, master->cfg.rx_buf, master->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                            &rx_len) ||
        rx_len < 2U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t expected_cks = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(master->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len - 1U);
    if (master->cfg.rx_buf[rx_len - 1U] != expected_cks) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    *out_val = master->cfg.rx_buf[0];
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_start(SYN_IOLink_Master *master)
{
    if (master == NULL || master->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_STARTUP;
    master->awaiting_rx = false;
    master->rx_deadline_ms = 0U;

    static const uint8_t k_startup_addrs[9] = {
        SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_MIN_CYCLE_TIME, SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_REVISION_ID, SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_VENDOR_ID_1,
        SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_VENDOR_ID_2,    SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_1, SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_2,
        SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_3,    SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_PD_IN_LEN,   SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_PD_OUT_LEN,
    };
    uint8_t vals[9] = {0};
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 9U; i++) {
        if (master_read_direct_param(master, k_startup_addrs[i], &vals[i]) != SYN_OK) {
            master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    master->dev_params.min_cycle_time = vals[0];
    master->dev_params.revision_id = vals[1];
    master->dev_params.vendor_id = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)vals[2] << 8U) | vals[3]);
    master->dev_params.device_id =
        ((uint32_t)vals[4] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)vals[5] << 8U) | (uint32_t)vals[6];
    master->dev_params.pd_in_len =
        (vals[7] > 0U && vals[7] <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) ? vals[7] : 1U;
    master->dev_params.pd_out_len = (vals[8] <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) ? vals[8] : 1U;

    master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_OPERATE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status iolink_send_pd_frame(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, const uint8_t *pd_out,
                                       size_t out_len)
{
    uint8_t tx[SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN + 4U];
    tx[0] = 0x00U; /* Process Data Mode (Bit 7=0, Bit 6=0) */
    size_t tx_pos = 1U;

    if (pd_out != NULL && out_len > 0U) {
        size_t copy_len = (out_len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) ? out_len : SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN;
        (void)memcpy(&tx[tx_pos], pd_out, copy_len);
        tx_pos += copy_len;
    }

    uint8_t ckt = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, tx_pos);
    tx[tx_pos++] = ckt;

    if (!syn_transport_send(master->cfg.transport, tx, tx_pos)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status iolink_recv_pd_frame(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint8_t *pd_in, size_t *in_len)
{
    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_transport_recv(master->cfg.transport, master->cfg.rx_buf, master->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                            &rx_len) ||
        rx_len < 2U || (rx_len - 1U) > SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t expected_cks = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(master->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len - 1U);
    if (master->cfg.rx_buf[rx_len - 1U] != expected_cks) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t pld_len = rx_len - 1U;
    if (pd_in != NULL && in_len != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(pd_in, master->cfg.rx_buf, pld_len);
        *in_len = pld_len;
    }

    (void)memcpy(master->current_pd_in, master->cfg.rx_buf, pld_len);
    master->current_pd_in_len = pld_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_exchange_pd(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, const uint8_t *pd_out,
                                         size_t out_len, uint8_t *pd_in, size_t *in_len)
{
    if (master == NULL || master->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (iolink_send_pd_frame(master, pd_out, out_len) != SYN_OK) {
        master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (iolink_recv_pd_frame(master, pd_in, in_len) != SYN_OK) {
        master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_read_isdu(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                                       uint8_t *data, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (master == NULL || master->cfg.transport == NULL || data == NULL || out_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t tx[8];
    tx[0] = 0xC0U; /* ISDU Read (Bit 7=1, Bit 6=1) */
    tx[1] = (uint8_t)((index >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[2] = (uint8_t)(index & 0xFFU);
    tx[3] = subindex;
    tx[4] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, 4U);

    if (!syn_transport_send(master->cfg.transport, tx, 5U)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_transport_recv(master->cfg.transport, master->cfg.rx_buf, master->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                            &rx_len) ||
        rx_len < 2U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t expected_cks = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(master->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len - 1U);
    if (master->cfg.rx_buf[rx_len - 1U] != expected_cks) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t pld_len = rx_len - 1U;
    size_t copy_len = (pld_len < max_len) ? pld_len : max_len;
    (void)memcpy(data, master->cfg.rx_buf, copy_len);
    *out_len = copy_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_write_isdu(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint16_t index, uint8_t subindex,
                                        const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    if (master == NULL || master->cfg.transport == NULL || (data == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t tx[SYN_IOLINK_MAX_ISDU_LEN + 8U];
    tx[0] = 0x40U; /* ISDU Write (Bit 7=0, Bit 6=1) */
    tx[1] = (uint8_t)((index >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[2] = (uint8_t)(index & 0xFFU);
    tx[3] = subindex;
    size_t tx_pos = 4U;

    if (len > 0U) {
        size_t copy_len = (len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_ISDU_LEN) ? len : SYN_IOLINK_MAX_ISDU_LEN;
        (void)memcpy(&tx[tx_pos], data, copy_len);
        tx_pos += copy_len;
    }

    tx[tx_pos] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, tx_pos);
    tx_pos++;

    if (!syn_transport_send(master->cfg.transport, tx, tx_pos)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_transport_recv(master->cfg.transport, master->cfg.rx_buf, master->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                            &rx_len) ||
        rx_len < 2U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t expected_cks = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(master->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len - 1U);
    if (master->cfg.rx_buf[rx_len - 1U] != expected_cks) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void iolink_step_awaiting_rx(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint32_t now_ms)
{
    if (master->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL && !syn_transport_has_data(master->cfg.transport)) {
        if ((int32_t)(now_ms - master->rx_deadline_ms) >= 0) {
            master->awaiting_rx = false;
            master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
        }
        return;
    }
    master->awaiting_rx = false;
    if (iolink_recv_pd_frame(master, NULL, NULL) != SYN_OK) {
        master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_master_step(SYN_IOLink_Master *master, uint32_t now_ms)
{
    if (master == NULL || master->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (master->state != SYN_IOLINK_PORT_OPERATE) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (master->awaiting_rx) {
        iolink_step_awaiting_rx(master, now_ms);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (now_ms - master->last_cycle_ms >= master->cfg.cycle_time_ms ||
        master->last_cycle_ms == 0U) {
        master->last_cycle_ms = now_ms;
        if (iolink_send_pd_frame(master, master->current_pd_out, master->current_pd_out_len) !=
            SYN_OK) {
            master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
            return SYN_OK;
        }

        if (master->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL &&
            !syn_transport_has_data(master->cfg.transport)) {
            uint32_t timeout = (master->cfg.cycle_time_ms > 0U) ? master->cfg.cycle_time_ms
                                                                : SYN_IOLINK_DEFAULT_CYCLE_MS;
            if (timeout > 0x7FFFFFFFU) {
                timeout = 0x7FFFFFFFU;
            }
            master->awaiting_rx = true;
            master->rx_deadline_ms = now_ms + timeout;
            return SYN_OK;
        }

        if (iolink_recv_pd_frame(master, NULL, NULL) != SYN_OK) {
            master->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_FAULT;
        }
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_iolink_master_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_IOLink_Master *master = (SYN_IOLink_Master *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (syn_iolink_master_step(master, now) != SYN_OK) {
            break;
        }
        if (master->awaiting_rx && master->cfg.transport != NULL &&
            master->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL &&
            syn_transport_has_data(master->cfg.transport)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
        } else {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

/* ── Device Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_iolink_device_init(SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, const SYN_IOLink_DeviceConfig *cfg)
{
    if (dev == NULL || cfg == NULL || cfg->params.pd_in_len > SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN ||
        cfg->params.pd_out_len > SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(dev, 0, sizeof(*dev));
    dev->cfg = *cfg;
    dev->state = SYN_IOLINK_PORT_OPERATE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_device_set_pd_in(SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    if (dev == NULL || (data == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    size_t copy_len = (len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) ? len : SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN;
    if (copy_len > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(dev->pd_in, data, copy_len);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_device_get_pd_out(const SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, uint8_t *out_buf,
                                        size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (dev == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    size_t pd_len = (dev->cfg.params.pd_out_len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN)
                        ? (size_t)dev->cfg.params.pd_out_len
                        : (size_t)SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN;
    size_t copy_len = (pd_len <= max_len) ? pd_len : max_len;
    (void)memcpy(out_buf, dev->pd_out, copy_len);
    *out_len = copy_len;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status iolink_dev_read_direct_param(const SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, uint8_t addr,
                                               uint8_t *tx, size_t *out_len)
{
    uint8_t param_val = 0U;
    switch (addr) {
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_MIN_CYCLE_TIME:
        param_val = dev->cfg.params.min_cycle_time;
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_REVISION_ID:
        param_val = dev->cfg.params.revision_id;
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_VENDOR_ID_1:
        param_val = (uint8_t)((dev->cfg.params.vendor_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_VENDOR_ID_2:
        param_val = (uint8_t)(dev->cfg.params.vendor_id & 0xFFU);
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_1:
        param_val = (uint8_t)((dev->cfg.params.device_id >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_2:
        param_val = (uint8_t)((dev->cfg.params.device_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_DEVICE_ID_3:
        param_val = (uint8_t)(dev->cfg.params.device_id & 0xFFU);
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_PD_IN_LEN:
        param_val = dev->cfg.params.pd_in_len;
        break;
    case SYN_IOLINK_PAGE_PD_OUT_LEN:
        param_val = dev->cfg.params.pd_out_len;
        break;
    default:
        param_val = 0U;
        break;
    }

    tx[0] = param_val;
    tx[1] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, 1U);
    *out_len = 2U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status iolink_dev_exchange_pd(SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, const uint8_t *rx, size_t rx_len,
                                         uint8_t *tx, size_t max_tx, size_t *out_len)
{
    size_t pd_out_len = rx_len - 2U;
    if (pd_out_len > 0U && pd_out_len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN) {
        (void)memcpy(dev->pd_out, &rx[1], pd_out_len);
    }

    size_t pd_in_len =
        (dev->cfg.params.pd_in_len > 0U && dev->cfg.params.pd_in_len <= SYN_IOLINK_MAX_PD_LEN)
            ? dev->cfg.params.pd_in_len
            : 1U;
    if (pd_in_len + 1U > max_tx) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    (void)memcpy(tx, dev->pd_in, pd_in_len);
    tx[pd_in_len] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, pd_in_len);
    *out_len = pd_in_len + 1U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status iolink_dev_handle_isdu(SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, bool is_read, const uint8_t *rx,
                                         size_t rx_len, uint8_t *tx, size_t max_tx, size_t *out_len)
{
    uint16_t index = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)rx[1] << 8U) | rx[2]);
    uint8_t subindex = rx[3];

    if (is_read && dev->cfg.on_read != NULL) {
        size_t pld_len = 0U;
        SYN_Status st =
            dev->cfg.on_read(index, subindex, tx, max_tx - 1U, &pld_len, dev->cfg.user_data);
        if (st == SYN_OK && pld_len < max_tx) {
            tx[pld_len] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, pld_len);
            *out_len = pld_len + 1U;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    if (!is_read && dev->cfg.on_write != NULL) {
        size_t pld_len = rx_len - 5U;
        if (dev->cfg.on_write(index, subindex, &rx[4], pld_len, dev->cfg.user_data) == SYN_OK) {
            tx[0] = 0x00U;
            tx[1] = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(tx, 1U);
            *out_len = 2U;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }
    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_iolink_device_process_frame(SYN_IOLink_Device *dev, const uint8_t *rx, size_t rx_len,
                                           uint8_t *tx, size_t max_tx, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (dev == NULL || rx == NULL || tx == NULL || out_len == NULL || rx_len < 2U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *out_len = 0U;
    if (max_tx < 2U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t expected_ckt = syn_iolink_calc_checksum(rx, rx_len - 1U);
    if (rx[rx_len - 1U] != expected_ckt) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t mc = rx[0];
    bool is_read = ((mc & 0x80U) != 0U);
    bool is_isdu = ((mc & 0x40U) != 0U);

    if (!is_isdu) {
        if (is_read) {
            return iolink_dev_read_direct_param(dev, (uint8_t)(mc & 0x3FU), tx, out_len);
        }
        return iolink_dev_exchange_pd(dev, rx, rx_len, tx, max_tx, out_len);
    }

    if (rx_len >= 5U) {
        return iolink_dev_handle_isdu(dev, is_read, rx, rx_len, tx, max_tx, out_len);
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_IOLINK */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic IO-Link protocol engine: * Physical transmission rate configuration (COM1: 4.8k, COM2: 38.4k, COM3: 230.4k baud). * M-Sequence frame encoding & parsing (Type 0, Type 1_1, Type 1_2, Type 2_1, Type 2_2, Type 2_V) with 6-bit CRC. * Direct Parameter Page 1 handling (Vendor ID, Device ID, Min Cycle Time, Revision ID, IO-Link profile). * Acyclic ISDU (Indexed Service Data Unit) parameter read/write transactions. * Non-blocking master polling step and cooperative protothread runner.

static bool timing_match(uint16_t actual, uint16_t expected, uint16_t tolerance)
{
    uint16_t diff = (actual > expected) ? (actual - expected) : (expected - actual);
    return (diff <= tolerance);
}

const char *syn_ir_protocol_name(SYN_IR_Protocol proto)
{
    if (proto >= SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT) {
        return "Unknown";
    }
    return proto_table[proto].name;
}

static void reset_decoder_state(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder)
{
    bool have_last = decoder->have_last;
    SYN_IR_Frame last_f = decoder->last_frame;

    memset(decoder, 0, sizeof(SYN_IR_Decoder));
    decoder->have_last = have_last;
    decoder->last_frame = last_f;
    decoder->state = SYN_IR_STATE_IDLE;
    decoder->active_proto = SYN_IR_PROTO_UNKNOWN;
}

SYN_Status syn_ir_decoder_init(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder)
{
    if (decoder == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(decoder, 0, sizeof(SYN_IR_Decoder));
    decoder->state = SYN_IR_STATE_IDLE;
    decoder->active_proto = SYN_IR_PROTO_UNKNOWN;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool unpack_nec_family(uint8_t bit_idx, uint64_t bits, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (bit_idx != 32U) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t addr = (uint8_t)(bits & 0xFFU);
    uint8_t addr_inv = (uint8_t)((bits >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)((bits >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    uint8_t cmd_inv = (uint8_t)((bits >> 24U) & 0xFFU);

    if ((bits & 0xFFFFU) == 0xEE87U) {
        frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_APPLE;
        frame_out->address = (uint16_t)(bits & 0xFFFFU);
        frame_out->command = cmd;
        return true;
    }
    if ((cmd ^ cmd_inv) == 0xFFU) {
        if ((addr ^ addr_inv) == 0xFFU) {
            frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC;
            frame_out->address = addr;
        } else {
            frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC_EXTENDED;
            frame_out->address = (uint16_t)(bits & 0xFFFFU);
        }
        frame_out->command = cmd;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool unpack_sony_family(uint8_t bit_idx, uint64_t bits, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (bit_idx == 12U) {
        frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_12;
        frame_out->command = (uint32_t)(bits & 0x7FU);
        frame_out->address = (uint32_t)((bits >> 7U) & 0x1FU);
        return true;
    }
    if (bit_idx == 15U) {
        frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_15;
        frame_out->command = (uint32_t)(bits & 0x7FU);
        frame_out->address = (uint32_t)((bits >> 7U) & 0xFFU);
        return true;
    }
    if (bit_idx == 20U) {
        frame_out->protocol = SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_20;
        frame_out->command = (uint32_t)(bits & 0x7FU);
        frame_out->address =
            (uint32_t)((bits >> 7U) & 0x1FU) | (((uint32_t)((bits >> 12U) & 0xFFU)) << 5U);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool unpack_rc5(uint8_t bit_idx, uint64_t bits, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (bit_idx != 14U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((bits >> 11U) & 0x01U) != 0U) {
        frame_out->flags |= SYN_IR_FLAG_TOGGLE;
    }
    frame_out->address = (uint32_t)((bits >> 6U) & 0x1FU);
    frame_out->command = (uint32_t)(bits & 0x3FU);
    return true;
}

static bool unpack_rc6(uint8_t bit_idx, uint64_t bits, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (bit_idx != 21U) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((((bits >> 20U) & 0x01U) != 1U) || (((bits >> 17U) & 0x07U) != 0U)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((bits >> 16U) & 0x01U) != 0U) {
        frame_out->flags |= SYN_IR_FLAG_TOGGLE;
    }
    frame_out->address = (uint32_t)((bits >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    frame_out->command = (uint32_t)(bits & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

static bool unpack_other_pdm(SYN_IR_Protocol proto, uint8_t bit_idx, uint64_t bits,
                             SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_SAMSUNG) {
        uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)((bits >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
        uint8_t cmd_inv = (uint8_t)((bits >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
        if ((bit_idx != 32U) || ((cmd ^ cmd_inv) != 0xFFU)) {
            return false;
        }
        frame_out->address = (uint16_t)(bits & 0xFFFFU);
        frame_out->command = cmd;
        return true;
    }

    if (proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_KASEIKYO) {
        if (bit_idx != 48U) {
            return false;
        }
        frame_out->address = (uint16_t)(bits & 0xFFFFU);
        frame_out->command = (uint32_t)((bits >> 16U) & 0xFFFFFFFFULL);
        return true;
    }

    /* SYN_IR_PROTO_DENON (15-bit) */
    if (bit_idx != 15U) {
        return false;
    }
    frame_out->address = (uint32_t)((bits >> 10U) & 0x1FU);
    frame_out->command = (uint32_t)((bits >> 2U) & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

static bool unpack_frame(const SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    SYN_IR_Protocol proto = decoder->active_proto;
    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[proto];

    frame_out->protocol = proto;
    frame_out->carrier_khz = desc->carrier_khz;
    frame_out->flags = SYN_IR_FLAG_NONE;
    frame_out->bit_count = decoder->bit_idx;

    uint64_t bits = decoder->bits;

    switch (proto) {
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC:
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC_EXTENDED:
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_APPLE:
        return unpack_nec_family(decoder->bit_idx, bits, frame_out);

    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_12:
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_15:
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_20:
        return unpack_sony_family(decoder->bit_idx, bits, frame_out);

    case SYN_IR_PROTO_RC5:
        return unpack_rc5(decoder->bit_idx, bits, frame_out);

    case SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6:
        return unpack_rc6(decoder->bit_idx, bits, frame_out);

    default:
        return unpack_other_pdm(proto, decoder->bit_idx, bits, frame_out);
    }
}

/* ── Decoder FSM ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool ir_finish_frame(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (unpack_frame(decoder, frame_out)) {
        decoder->last_frame = *frame_out;
        decoder->have_last = true;
        reset_decoder_state(decoder);
        return true;
    }
    reset_decoder_state(decoder);
    return false;
}

static bool ir_manchester_push_half(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, bool is_mark, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (!decoder->manchester_phase) {
        decoder->last_mark_us = is_mark ? 1U : 0U;
        decoder->manchester_phase = true;
        return false;
    }

    bool first_mark = (decoder->last_mark_us != 0U);
    if (first_mark == is_mark) {
        reset_decoder_state(decoder);
        return false;
    }

    bool bit_one = (decoder->active_proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6) ? first_mark : is_mark;
    uint8_t bit_val = bit_one ? 1U : 0U;
    decoder->bits = (decoder->bits << 1U) | (uint64_t)bit_val;
    decoder->bit_idx++;
    decoder->manchester_phase = false;

    if (decoder->bit_idx >= decoder->expected_bits) {
        return ir_finish_frame(decoder, frame_out);
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ir_manchester_push_quantum(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, bool is_mark,
                                       SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    /* RC6 Mode 0 bit 4 (Trailer/Toggle) uses 2T half-bit width */
    if (decoder->active_proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6 && decoder->bit_idx == 4U) {
        if (decoder->last_space_us == 0U) {
            decoder->last_space_us = is_mark ? 2U : 1U;
            return false;
        }
        bool prev_mark = (decoder->last_space_us == 2U);
        decoder->last_space_us = 0U;
        if (prev_mark != is_mark) {
            reset_decoder_state(decoder);
            return false;
        }
    }
    return ir_manchester_push_half(decoder, is_mark, frame_out);
}

static bool ir_decode_manchester(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, uint16_t duration_us, bool is_mark,
                                 SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[decoder->active_proto];
    uint16_t t_us = desc->half_bit_us;
    uint16_t tol = desc->tolerance_us;
    uint8_t quanta = 0U;

    if (timing_match(duration_us, t_us, tol)) {
        quanta = 1U;
    } else if (timing_match(duration_us, (uint16_t)(t_us * 2U), (uint16_t)(tol * 2U))) {
        quanta = 2U;
    } else if (decoder->active_proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6 &&
               timing_match(duration_us, (uint16_t)(t_us * 3U), (uint16_t)(tol * 2U))) {
        quanta = 3U;
    } else if (!is_mark && duration_us > (uint16_t)(t_us * 3U) && decoder->manchester_phase &&
               decoder->bit_idx + 1U == decoder->expected_bits) {
        quanta = 1U;
    } else {
        reset_decoder_state(decoder);
        return false;
    }

    for (uint8_t q = 0U; q < quanta; q++) {
        if (decoder->state != SYN_IR_STATE_DATA) {
            return false;
        }
        if (ir_manchester_push_quantum(decoder, is_mark, frame_out)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ir_decode_sony_pulse(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc,
                                 uint16_t duration_us, bool is_mark, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (is_mark) {
        uint8_t bit_val = 0U;
        if (timing_match(duration_us, desc->one_mark_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
            bit_val = 1U;
        } else if (!timing_match(duration_us, desc->bit_mark_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
            reset_decoder_state(decoder);
            return false;
        }

        decoder->bits |= ((uint64_t)bit_val << decoder->bit_idx);
        decoder->bit_idx++;
        if (decoder->bit_idx >= 20U) {
            return ir_finish_frame(decoder, frame_out);
        }
        return false;
    }

    /* Space in Sony PWM: 600us continues frame; inter-frame gap finalizes 12-bit or 15-bit */
    if (timing_match(duration_us, desc->zero_space_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (duration_us > (uint16_t)(desc->zero_space_us + desc->tolerance_us) &&
        (decoder->bit_idx == 12U || decoder->bit_idx == 15U)) {
        return ir_finish_frame(decoder, frame_out);
    }
    reset_decoder_state(decoder);
    return false;
}

static bool ir_decode_pdm_space(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc,
                                uint16_t mark_us, uint16_t space_us, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (!timing_match(mark_us, desc->bit_mark_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
        reset_decoder_state(decoder);
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t bit_val = 0U;
    if (timing_match(space_us, desc->one_space_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
        bit_val = 1U;
    } else if (!timing_match(space_us, desc->zero_space_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
        reset_decoder_state(decoder);
        return false;
    }

    decoder->bits |= ((uint64_t)bit_val << decoder->bit_idx);
    decoder->bit_idx++;

    if (decoder->bit_idx >= decoder->expected_bits) {
        return ir_finish_frame(decoder, frame_out);
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ir_is_nec_family(SYN_IR_Protocol proto)
{
    return (proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC) || (proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC_EXTENDED) ||
           (proto == SYN_IR_PROTO_APPLE);
}

static bool ir_try_nec_repeat(const SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, uint16_t mark_us, uint16_t space_us,
                              SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *nec = &proto_table[SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC];
    if (decoder->have_last && ir_is_nec_family(decoder->last_frame.protocol) &&
        timing_match(mark_us, nec->leader_mark_us, nec->tolerance_us) &&
        timing_match(space_us, nec->repeat_space_us, nec->tolerance_us)) {
        *frame_out = decoder->last_frame;
        frame_out->flags |= SYN_IR_FLAG_REPEAT;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ir_match_leader(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, uint16_t mark_us, uint16_t space_us)
{
    for (int p = 1; p < SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT; p++) {
        if ((p == SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_12) || (p == SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_15) ||
            (p == SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC_EXTENDED)) {
            continue;
        }

        const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[p];
        if ((desc->leader_mark_us > 0U) &&
            timing_match(mark_us, desc->leader_mark_us, desc->tolerance_us) &&
            timing_match(space_us, desc->leader_space_us, desc->tolerance_us)) {
            decoder->active_proto = (SYN_IR_Protocol)p;
            decoder->expected_bits = desc->total_bits;
            decoder->state = SYN_IR_STATE_DATA;
            decoder->bits = 0ULL;
            decoder->bit_idx = 0U;
            decoder->manchester_phase = false;
            decoder->last_space_us = 0U;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool ir_decode_idle_space(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, uint16_t mark_us, uint16_t space_us,
                                 SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (ir_try_nec_repeat(decoder, mark_us, space_us, frame_out)) {
        return true;
    }
    if (ir_match_leader(decoder, mark_us, space_us)) {
        return false;
    }

    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *denon = &proto_table[SYN_IR_PROTO_DENON];
    if (timing_match(mark_us, denon->bit_mark_us, denon->tolerance_us) &&
        (timing_match(space_us, denon->zero_space_us, denon->tolerance_us) ||
         timing_match(space_us, denon->one_space_us, denon->tolerance_us))) {
        decoder->active_proto = SYN_IR_PROTO_DENON;
        decoder->expected_bits = denon->total_bits;
        decoder->state = SYN_IR_STATE_DATA;
        uint8_t bit = timing_match(space_us, denon->one_space_us, denon->tolerance_us) ? 1U : 0U;
        decoder->bits = (uint64_t)bit;
        decoder->bit_idx = 1U;
        return false;
    }

    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *rc5 = &proto_table[SYN_IR_PROTO_RC5];
    uint16_t t_rc5 = rc5->half_bit_us;
    uint16_t tol_rc5 = rc5->tolerance_us;
    bool mark_ok = timing_match(mark_us, t_rc5, tol_rc5) ||
                   timing_match(mark_us, (uint16_t)(t_rc5 * 2U), (uint16_t)(tol_rc5 * 2U));
    bool space_ok = timing_match(space_us, t_rc5, tol_rc5) ||
                    timing_match(space_us, (uint16_t)(t_rc5 * 2U), (uint16_t)(tol_rc5 * 2U));
    if (mark_ok && space_ok) {
        decoder->active_proto = SYN_IR_PROTO_RC5;
        decoder->expected_bits = rc5->total_bits;
        decoder->state = SYN_IR_STATE_DATA;
        decoder->bits = 0ULL;
        decoder->bit_idx = 0U;
        decoder->manchester_phase = true; /* Leading S1 space elapsed in idle */
        decoder->last_mark_us = 0U;
        decoder->last_space_us = 0U;
        (void)ir_decode_manchester(decoder, mark_us, true, frame_out);
        return ir_decode_manchester(decoder, space_us, false, frame_out);
    }

    return false;
}

bool syn_ir_decode_pulse(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, uint16_t duration_us, bool is_mark,
                         SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (decoder == NULL || frame_out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    if (decoder->state == SYN_IR_STATE_DATA) {
        if ((int)decoder->active_proto <= 0 || decoder->active_proto >= SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT) {
            reset_decoder_state(decoder);
            return false;
        }
        const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[decoder->active_proto];
        if (desc->encoding == SYN_IR_ENC_MANCHESTER) {
            return ir_decode_manchester(decoder, duration_us, is_mark, frame_out);
        }
        if (desc->encoding == SYN_IR_ENC_PWM) {
            return ir_decode_sony_pulse(decoder, desc, duration_us, is_mark, frame_out);
        }
    }

    if (is_mark) {
        decoder->last_mark_us = duration_us;
        return false;
    }

    if (decoder->last_mark_us == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    uint16_t mark_us = decoder->last_mark_us;
    decoder->last_mark_us = 0U;
    decoder->last_space_us = duration_us;

    if (decoder->state == SYN_IR_STATE_IDLE) {
        return ir_decode_idle_space(decoder, mark_us, duration_us, frame_out);
    }

    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[decoder->active_proto];
    return ir_decode_pdm_space(decoder, desc, mark_us, duration_us, frame_out);
}

bool syn_ir_decode_timeout(SYN_IR_Decoder *decoder, SYN_IR_Frame *frame_out)
{
    if (decoder == NULL || frame_out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    if (decoder->state == SYN_IR_STATE_DATA && (int)decoder->active_proto > 0 &&
        decoder->active_proto < SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT) {
        const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[decoder->active_proto];
        if (desc->encoding == SYN_IR_ENC_MANCHESTER && decoder->manchester_phase &&
            decoder->bit_idx + 1U == decoder->expected_bits) {
            return ir_manchester_push_half(decoder, false, frame_out);
        }
        if (decoder->bit_idx > 0U) {
            return ir_finish_frame(decoder, frame_out);
        }
    }

    reset_decoder_state(decoder);
    return false;
}

/* ── Encoder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void ir_emit_pulse(SYN_IR_Pulse *buf, size_t *idx, uint16_t dur_us, bool is_mark)
{
    if (*idx == 0U && !is_mark) {
        return;
    }
    if (*idx > 0U && buf[*idx - 1U].is_mark == is_mark) {
        buf[*idx - 1U].duration_us = (uint16_t)(buf[*idx - 1U].duration_us + dur_us);
        return;
    }
    buf[*idx] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = dur_us, .is_mark = is_mark};
    (*idx)++;
}

static uint64_t ir_pack_raw_bits(const SYN_IR_Frame *frame)
{
    switch (frame->protocol) {
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC: {
        uint8_t addr = (uint8_t)(frame->address & 0xFFU);
        uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)(frame->command & 0xFFU);
        return ((uint64_t)addr) | (((uint64_t)(~addr & 0xFFU)) << 8U) | (((uint64_t)cmd) << 16U) |
               (((uint64_t)(~cmd & 0xFFU)) << 24U);
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_NEC_EXTENDED: {
        uint16_t addr = (uint16_t)(frame->address & 0xFFFFU);
        uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)(frame->command & 0xFFU);
        return ((uint64_t)addr) | (((uint64_t)cmd) << 16U) | (((uint64_t)(~cmd & 0xFFU)) << 24U);
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_APPLE: {
        uint16_t addr = (uint16_t)(frame->address & 0xFFFFU);
        uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)(frame->command & 0xFFU);
        return ((uint64_t)addr) | (((uint64_t)cmd) << 16U) | (((uint64_t)cmd) << 24U);
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_12:
        return (frame->command & 0x7FU) | ((frame->address & 0x1FU) << 7U);
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_15:
        return (frame->command & 0x7FU) | ((frame->address & 0xFFU) << 7U);
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SONY_20:
        return (frame->command & 0x7FU) | ((frame->address & 0x1FU) << 7U) |
               (((frame->address >> 5U) & 0xFFU) << 12U);
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_RC5: {
        uint64_t toggle = ((frame->flags & SYN_IR_FLAG_TOGGLE) != 0U) ? 1ULL : 0ULL;
        return (1ULL << 13U) | (1ULL << 12U) | (toggle << 11U) |
               (((uint64_t)(frame->address & 0x1FU)) << 6U) | ((uint64_t)(frame->command & 0x3FU));
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6: {
        uint64_t toggle = ((frame->flags & SYN_IR_FLAG_TOGGLE) != 0U) ? 1ULL : 0ULL;
        return (1ULL << 20U) | (toggle << 16U) | (((uint64_t)(frame->address & 0xFFU)) << 8U) |
               ((uint64_t)(frame->command & 0xFFU));
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_SAMSUNG: {
        uint16_t addr = (uint16_t)(frame->address & 0xFFFFU);
        uint8_t cmd = (uint8_t)(frame->command & 0xFFU);
        return ((uint64_t)addr) | (((uint64_t)cmd) << 16U) | (((uint64_t)(~cmd & 0xFFU)) << 24U);
    }
    case SYN_IR_PROTO_KASEIKYO:
        return (frame->address & 0xFFFFU) | (((uint64_t)frame->command) << 16U);
    default:
        /* SYN_IR_PROTO_DENON */
        return ((frame->address & 0x1FU) << 10U) | ((frame->command & 0xFFU) << 2U);
    }
}

static void ir_encode_manchester(const SYN_IR_Frame *frame, const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc,
                                 uint64_t raw_bits, SYN_IR_Pulse *pulse_buf, size_t *idx)
{
    bool is_rc6 = (frame->protocol == SYN_IR_PROTO_RC6);
    for (int b = (int)desc->total_bits - 1; b >= 0; b--) {
        uint8_t bit_val = (uint8_t)((raw_bits >> (uint8_t)b) & 0x01U);
        uint16_t half = desc->half_bit_us;
        if (is_rc6 && b == 16) {
            half = (uint16_t)(half * 2U); /* RC6 Mode 0 2T Trailer/Toggle bit */
        }
        bool first_mark = is_rc6 ? (bit_val == 1U) : (bit_val == 0U);
        ir_emit_pulse(pulse_buf, idx, half, first_mark);
        ir_emit_pulse(pulse_buf, idx, half, !first_mark);
    }
    if (*idx > 0U && pulse_buf[*idx - 1U].is_mark) {
        ir_emit_pulse(pulse_buf, idx, (uint16_t)(desc->half_bit_us * 4U), false);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_ir_encode_frame(const SYN_IR_Frame *frame, SYN_IR_Pulse *pulse_buf, size_t buf_len,
                               size_t *count_out)
{
    if (frame == NULL || pulse_buf == NULL || count_out == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if ((int)frame->protocol <= 0 || frame->protocol >= SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const SYN_IR_ProtoDesc *desc = &proto_table[frame->protocol];
    size_t required_pulses = (desc->leader_mark_us > 0U) ? 2U : 0U;
    required_pulses += ((size_t)desc->total_bits) * 2U + 1U;

    if (buf_len < required_pulses) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    size_t idx = 0U;
    if (desc->leader_mark_us > 0U) {
        pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = desc->leader_mark_us, .is_mark = true};
        pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = desc->leader_space_us, .is_mark = false};
    }

    uint64_t raw_bits = ir_pack_raw_bits(frame);

    if (desc->encoding == SYN_IR_ENC_MANCHESTER) {
        ir_encode_manchester(frame, desc, raw_bits, pulse_buf, &idx);
    } else if (desc->encoding == SYN_IR_ENC_PWM) {
        for (uint8_t b = 0U; b < desc->total_bits; b++) {
            uint8_t bit_val = (uint8_t)((raw_bits >> b) & 0x01U);
            uint16_t mark = (bit_val == 1U) ? desc->one_mark_us : desc->bit_mark_us;
            uint16_t space = (b + 1U < desc->total_bits) ? desc->zero_space_us : 10000U;
            pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = mark, .is_mark = true};
            pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = space, .is_mark = false};
        }
    } else {
        for (uint8_t b = 0U; b < desc->total_bits; b++) {
            uint8_t bit_val = (uint8_t)((raw_bits >> b) & 0x01U);
            uint16_t space = (bit_val == 1U) ? desc->one_space_us : desc->zero_space_us;
            pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = desc->bit_mark_us, .is_mark = true};
            pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = space, .is_mark = false};
        }
        pulse_buf[idx++] = (SYN_IR_Pulse){.duration_us = desc->bit_mark_us, .is_mark = true};
    }

    *count_out = idx;
    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_IR */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Implements non-blocking, zero-malloc IR pulse decoding and encoding for common consumer remote control protocols using microsecond pulse timing inputs.

** **

  • NEC (Standard & Extended 32-bit)
  • Sony SIRCS (12-bit, 15-bit, 20-bit)
  • Philips RC5 (14-bit Manchester)
  • Philips RC6 Mode 0 (21-bit Manchester)
  • Samsung (32-bit PDM)
  • Kaseikyo / Panasonic (48-bit PDM)
  • Denon / Sharp (15-bit PDM)
  • Apple (32-bit NEC variant)

** **

    SYN_IR_PROTO_KASEIKYO,     
    SYN_IR_PROTO_DENON,        
    SYN_IR_PROTO_APPLE,        
    SYN_IR_PROTO_COUNT
} SYN_IR_Protocol;

/* ── Frame Flags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define SYN_IR_FLAG_NONE 0x0000U     
#define SYN_IR_FLAG_REPEAT (1U << 0) 
#define SYN_IR_FLAG_TOGGLE (1U << 1) 

/* ── Decoded IR Frame ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    SYN_IR_Protocol protocol; 
    uint32_t address;

typedef struct {
    uint16_t duration_us; 
    bool is_mark;         
} SYN_IR_Pulse;

/* ── Decoder State Machine Handle ───────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef enum {
    SYN_IR_STATE_IDLE = 0, 
    SYN_IR_STATE_LEADER,   
    SYN_IR_STATE_DATA,     
    SYN_IR_STATE_TRAILER
} SYN_IR_FsmState;

typedef struct {
    SYN_IR_FsmState state;        
    SYN_IR_Protocol active_proto; 
    uint64_t bits;                
    uint8_t bit_idx;              
    uint8_t expected_bits;

    uint16_t last_space_us;       
    SYN_IR_Frame last_frame;      
    bool have_last;               
    bool manchester_phase;        
} SYN_IR_Decoder;

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
