#include <string.h>

#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
/* ── CAN FD length padding helper (ISO 11898-1 valid lengths) ───────────── */
static uint8_t syn_can_fd_pad_len(uint8_t len)
{
    if (len <= 8)
        return len;
    if (len <= 12)
        return 12;
    if (len <= 16)
        return 16;
    if (len <= 20)
        return 20;
    if (len <= 24)
        return 24;
    if (len <= 32)
        return 32;
    if (len <= 48)
        return 48;
    return 64;
}
#endif

static uint32_t syn_isotp_decode_stmin_us(uint8_t st_min)
{
    if (st_min <= 0x7F) {
        return (uint32_t)st_min * 1000U; /* 0..127 ms -> us */
    }
    if (st_min >= 0xF1 && st_min <= 0xF9) {
        return (uint32_t)(st_min - 0xF0) * 100U; /* 100..900 us */
    }
    return 127000U; /* Reserved values default to 127ms per ISO 15765-2:2016 Clause 9.6.6 */
}

static uint32_t isotp_ms_to_us(uint32_t ms)
{
    if (ms > (UINT32_MAX / 1000U)) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    return ms * 1000U;
}

void syn_isotp_set_timeouts(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint32_t n_bs_ms, uint32_t n_cr_ms)
{
    if (link == NULL)
        return;
    link->n_bs_timeout_us =
        (n_bs_ms > 0U) ? isotp_ms_to_us(n_bs_ms) : (SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_BS_MS * 1000U);
    link->n_cr_timeout_us =
        (n_cr_ms > 0U) ? isotp_ms_to_us(n_cr_ms) : (SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_CR_MS * 1000U);
}

void syn_isotp_init(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint32_t rx_id, uint32_t tx_id, uint8_t *rx_buf,
                    size_t rx_buf_size, uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t tx_buf_size)
{
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    syn_isotp_init_fd(link, rx_id, tx_id, rx_buf, rx_buf_size, tx_buf, tx_buf_size, false);
#else
    SYN_ASSERT(link != NULL);

    memset(link, 0, sizeof(*link));
    link->rx_id = rx_id;
    link->tx_id = tx_id;
    link->rx_buf = rx_buf;
    link->rx_buf_size = rx_buf_size;
    link->tx_buf = tx_buf;
    link->tx_buf_size = tx_buf_size;
    link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
    link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE;
    link->rx_fc_bs = 0;
    link->rx_fc_stmin = 0;
    link->padding_byte = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_PADDING;
    link->n_bs_timeout_us = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_BS_MS * 1000U;
    link->n_cr_timeout_us = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_CR_MS * 1000U;
#endif
}

void syn_isotp_set_fc_params(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint8_t bs, uint8_t stmin)
{
    if (link == NULL)
        return;
    link->rx_fc_bs = bs;
    link->rx_fc_stmin = stmin;
}

void syn_isotp_set_padding(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint8_t pad_byte)
{
    if (link != NULL) {
        link->padding_byte = pad_byte;
    }
}

#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
void syn_isotp_init_fd(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint32_t rx_id, uint32_t tx_id, uint8_t *rx_buf,
                       size_t rx_buf_size, uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t tx_buf_size, bool is_fd)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(link != NULL);

    memset(link, 0, sizeof(*link));
    link->rx_id = rx_id;
    link->tx_id = tx_id;
    link->is_fd = is_fd;
    link->rx_buf = rx_buf;
    link->rx_buf_size = rx_buf_size;
    link->tx_buf = tx_buf;
    link->tx_buf_size = tx_buf_size;
    link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
    link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE;
    link->rx_fc_bs = 0;
    link->rx_fc_stmin = 0;
    link->padding_byte = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_PADDING;
    link->n_bs_timeout_us = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_BS_MS * 1000U;
    link->n_cr_timeout_us = SYN_ISOTP_DEFAULT_N_CR_MS * 1000U;
}
#endif

SYN_Status syn_isotp_send(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len)
{
    if (link == NULL || payload == NULL || payload_len < 1) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (link->tx_state != SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if ((!link->is_fd) && (payload_len > 4095U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
#else
    if (payload_len > 4095U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
#endif
    if (payload_len > link->tx_buf_size) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memcpy(link->tx_buf, payload, payload_len);
    link->tx_len = payload_len;
    link->tx_offset = 0;
    link->tx_seq = 1;
    link->tx_bs_count = 0;

#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    size_t max_sf_len = link->is_fd ? 62 : 7;
#else
    size_t max_sf_len = 7;
#endif

    if (payload_len <= max_sf_len) {
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_SF;
    } else {
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_FF;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void isotp_tx_build_sf(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if (link->is_fd) {
        size_t sf_len = link->tx_len;
        if (sf_len <= 7U) {
            frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_SF | (uint8_t)sf_len;
            memcpy(&frame->data[1], link->tx_buf, sf_len);
            frame->dlc = syn_can_fd_pad_len((uint8_t)(sf_len + 1U));
        } else {
            frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_SF;
            frame->data[1] = (uint8_t)sf_len;
            memcpy(&frame->data[2], link->tx_buf, sf_len);
            frame->dlc = syn_can_fd_pad_len((uint8_t)(sf_len + 2U));
        }
    } else {
        frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_SF | (uint8_t)link->tx_len;
        memcpy(&frame->data[1], link->tx_buf, link->tx_len);
        frame->dlc = 8U;
    }
#else
    frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_SF | (uint8_t)link->tx_len;
    memcpy(&frame->data[1], link->tx_buf, link->tx_len);
    frame->dlc = 8U;
#endif
    link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
}

static void isotp_tx_build_ff(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    size_t payload_in_ff;
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if (link->is_fd) {
        if (link->tx_len <= 4095U) {
            frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FF | (uint8_t)((link->tx_len >> 8U) & 0x0FU);
            frame->data[1] = (uint8_t)(link->tx_len & 0xFFU);
            payload_in_ff = (link->tx_len > 62U) ? 62U : link->tx_len;
            memcpy(&frame->data[2], link->tx_buf, payload_in_ff);
            frame->dlc = syn_can_fd_pad_len((uint8_t)(payload_in_ff + 2U));
        } else {
            frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FF;
            frame->data[1] = 0U;
            syn_poke_u32((uint32_t)link->tx_len, frame->data, 2U);
            payload_in_ff = (link->tx_len > 58U) ? 58U : link->tx_len;
            memcpy(&frame->data[6], link->tx_buf, payload_in_ff);
            frame->dlc = syn_can_fd_pad_len((uint8_t)(payload_in_ff + 6U));
        }
    } else {
        frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FF | (uint8_t)((link->tx_len >> 8U) & 0x0FU);
        frame->data[1] = (uint8_t)(link->tx_len & 0xFFU);
        payload_in_ff = 6U;
        memcpy(&frame->data[2], link->tx_buf, payload_in_ff);
        frame->dlc = 8U;
    }
#else
    frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FF | (uint8_t)((link->tx_len >> 8U) & 0x0FU);
    frame->data[1] = (uint8_t)(link->tx_len & 0xFFU);
    payload_in_ff = 6U;
    memcpy(&frame->data[2], link->tx_buf, payload_in_ff);
    frame->dlc = 8U;
#endif
    link->tx_offset = payload_in_ff;
    link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_WAIT_FC;
    link->tx_timeout_timer_us = link->n_bs_timeout_us;
}

static bool isotp_tx_build_cf(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (link->tx_st_timer_us > 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t rem = link->tx_len - link->tx_offset;
    if (rem == 0U) {
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
        return false;
    }

    frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_CF | (link->tx_seq & 0x0FU);
    size_t payload_len;
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if (link->is_fd) {
        payload_len = (rem > 63U) ? 63U : rem;
        memcpy(&frame->data[1], &link->tx_buf[link->tx_offset], payload_len);
        frame->dlc = syn_can_fd_pad_len((uint8_t)(payload_len + 1U));
    } else {
        payload_len = (rem > 7U) ? 7U : rem;
        memcpy(&frame->data[1], &link->tx_buf[link->tx_offset], payload_len);
        frame->dlc = 8U;
    }
#else
    payload_len = (rem > 7U) ? 7U : rem;
    memcpy(&frame->data[1], &link->tx_buf[link->tx_offset], payload_len);
    frame->dlc = 8U;
#endif

    link->tx_offset += payload_len;
    link->tx_seq = (uint8_t)((link->tx_seq + 1U) & 0x0FU);
    link->tx_st_timer_us = syn_isotp_decode_stmin_us(link->tx_st_min);

    if (link->tx_bs > 0U) {
        link->tx_bs_count++;
        if ((link->tx_bs_count >= link->tx_bs) && (link->tx_offset < link->tx_len)) {
            link->tx_bs_count = 0U;
            link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_WAIT_FC;
            link->tx_timeout_timer_us = link->n_bs_timeout_us;
        }
    }

    if (link->tx_offset >= link->tx_len) {
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_isotp_get_tx_frame(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if ((link == NULL) || (frame == NULL)) {
        return false;
    }

    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    memset(frame->data, link->padding_byte, sizeof(frame->data));
    frame->id = link->tx_id;
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    frame->is_fd = link->is_fd;
#endif

    if (link->rx_fc_pending) {
        link->rx_fc_pending = false;
        frame->data[0] = SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FC | link->rx_fc_status;
        frame->data[1] = link->rx_fc_bs;
        frame->data[2] = link->rx_fc_stmin;
        frame->dlc = 8U;
        return true;
    }

    switch (link->tx_state) {
    case SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_SF:
        isotp_tx_build_sf(link, frame);
        return true;
    case SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_FF:
        isotp_tx_build_ff(link, frame);
        return true;
    case SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_CF:
        return isotp_tx_build_cf(link, frame);
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static void isotp_handle_sf(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    size_t sf_len = (size_t)(frame->data[0] & 0x0FU);
    size_t data_offset = 1U;

#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if (frame->dlc > 8U) {
        if (sf_len != 0U) {
            return;
        }
        sf_len = (size_t)frame->data[1];
        if (sf_len <= 7U) {
            return;
        }
        data_offset = 2U;
    }
#endif

    size_t avail_bytes = (size_t)frame->dlc - data_offset;
    if ((sf_len == 0U) || (sf_len > avail_bytes)) {
        return;
    }

    if ((sf_len <= link->rx_buf_size) && (link->rx_buf != NULL)) {
        memcpy(link->rx_buf, &frame->data[data_offset], sf_len);
        link->rx_len = sf_len;
        link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_COMPLETE;
        link->rx_fc_pending = false;
        link->rx_timeout_timer_us = 0U;
    }
}

static void isotp_handle_ff(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (frame->dlc < 8U) {
        return;
    }

    size_t ff_len;
    size_t data_offset;
    uint16_t len_12 = syn_peek_u16(frame->data, 0U) & 0x0FFFU;
    if (len_12 != 0U) {
        ff_len = (size_t)len_12;
        data_offset = 2U;
    } else {
        ff_len = (size_t)syn_peek_u32(frame->data, 2U);
        data_offset = 6U;
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
        if ((link->is_fd || frame->is_fd) && (ff_len <= 4095U)) {
            return;
        }
#endif
    }

    size_t max_sf = (frame->dlc > 8U) ? ((size_t)frame->dlc - 2U) : 7U;
    if ((ff_len <= max_sf) || (link->rx_buf == NULL)) {
        return;
    }
    if (ff_len > link->rx_buf_size) {
        link->rx_fc_pending = true;
        link->rx_fc_status = SYN_ISOTP_FC_OVERFLOW;
        link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE;
        return;
    }

    size_t payload_in_ff = (size_t)frame->dlc - data_offset;

    memcpy(link->rx_buf, &frame->data[data_offset], payload_in_ff);
    link->rx_len = payload_in_ff;
    link->rx_expected = ff_len;
    link->rx_seq = 1U;
    link->rx_bs_count = 0U;
    link->rx_fc_pending = true;
    link->rx_fc_status = SYN_ISOTP_FC_CTS;
    link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_WAIT_CF;
    link->rx_timeout_timer_us = link->n_cr_timeout_us;
}

static void isotp_handle_cf(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (link->rx_state != SYN_ISOTP_RX_WAIT_CF) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t seq = frame->data[0] & 0x0FU;
    if (seq != link->rx_seq) {
        link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE;
        link->rx_timeout_timer_us = 0U;
        return;
    }

    size_t rem = link->rx_expected - link->rx_len;
    size_t cf_payload = (size_t)frame->dlc - 1U;
    if (cf_payload > rem) {
        cf_payload = rem;
    }

    memcpy(&link->rx_buf[link->rx_len], &frame->data[1], cf_payload);
    link->rx_len += cf_payload;
    link->rx_seq = (uint8_t)((link->rx_seq + 1U) & 0x0FU);
    link->rx_bs_count++;

    if (link->rx_len >= link->rx_expected) {
        link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_COMPLETE;
        link->rx_timeout_timer_us = 0U;
    } else {
        link->rx_timeout_timer_us = link->n_cr_timeout_us;
        if ((link->rx_fc_bs > 0U) && (link->rx_bs_count >= link->rx_fc_bs)) {
            link->rx_bs_count = 0U;
            link->rx_fc_pending = true;
            link->rx_fc_status = SYN_ISOTP_FC_CTS;
        }
    }
}

static void isotp_handle_fc(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if ((link->tx_state != SYN_ISOTP_TX_WAIT_FC) || (frame->dlc < 3U)) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t fc_status = frame->data[0] & 0x0FU;
    if (fc_status == SYN_ISOTP_FC_CTS) {
        link->tx_bs = frame->data[1];
        link->tx_st_min = frame->data[2];
        link->tx_st_timer_us = 0U;
        link->tx_timeout_timer_us = 0U;
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_SEND_CF;
    } else if (fc_status == SYN_ISOTP_FC_WAIT) {
        link->tx_timeout_timer_us = link->n_bs_timeout_us;
    } else {
        link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
        link->tx_timeout_timer_us = 0U;
    }
}

static bool isotp_rx_frame_valid(const SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if ((link == NULL) || (frame == NULL) || frame->rtr || (frame->id != link->rx_id)) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((frame->dlc == 0U) || (frame->dlc > (uint8_t)sizeof(frame->data))) {
        return false;
    }
#if defined(SYN_USE_CAN_FD) && SYN_USE_CAN_FD
    if (!frame->is_fd && (frame->dlc > 8U)) {
        return false;
    }
#endif
    return true;
}

void syn_isotp_process_rx_frame(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!isotp_rx_frame_valid(link, frame)) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t pci_type = frame->data[0] & 0xF0U;
    switch (pci_type) {
    case SYN_ISOTP_PCI_SF:
        isotp_handle_sf(link, frame);
        break;
    case SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FF:
        isotp_handle_ff(link, frame);
        break;
    case SYN_ISOTP_PCI_CF:
        isotp_handle_cf(link, frame);
        break;
    case SYN_ISOTP_PCI_FC:
        isotp_handle_fc(link, frame);
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

ssize_t syn_isotp_receive(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    if (link == NULL || out_buf == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    if (link->rx_state == SYN_ISOTP_RX_COMPLETE) {
        size_t copy_len = (link->rx_len > max_len) ? max_len : link->rx_len;
        memcpy(out_buf, link->rx_buf, copy_len);
        link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE;
        if (copy_len > 32767U)
            copy_len = 32767U; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive 16-bit signed ssize_t cast clamp for
                                  32-bit CAN FD transfers >32KB */
        return (ssize_t)copy_len;
    }

    return -1;
}

void syn_isotp_step(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    syn_isotp_step_us(link, isotp_ms_to_us(dt_ms));
}

void syn_isotp_step_us(SYN_ISOTP_Link *link, uint32_t dt_us)
{
    if (link == NULL)
        return;

    if (link->tx_st_timer_us > 0) {
        if (dt_us >= link->tx_st_timer_us) {
            link->tx_st_timer_us = 0;
        } else {
            link->tx_st_timer_us -= dt_us;
        }
    }

    /* N_Bs timeout (waiting for Flow Control frame on sender side) */
    if (link->tx_state == SYN_ISOTP_TX_WAIT_FC && link->tx_timeout_timer_us > 0) {
        if (dt_us >= link->tx_timeout_timer_us) {
            link->tx_timeout_timer_us = 0;
            link->tx_state = SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE; /* Abort Tx on N_Bs timeout */
        } else {
            link->tx_timeout_timer_us -= dt_us;
        }
    }

    /* N_Cr timeout (waiting for Consecutive Frame on receiver side) */
    if (link->rx_state == SYN_ISOTP_RX_WAIT_CF && link->rx_timeout_timer_us > 0) {
        if (dt_us >= link->rx_timeout_timer_us) {
            link->rx_timeout_timer_us = 0;
            link->rx_state = SYN_ISOTP_RX_IDLE; /* Abort Rx on N_Cr timeout */
        } else {
            link->rx_timeout_timer_us -= dt_us;
        }
    }
}

bool syn_isotp_is_tx_idle(const SYN_ISOTP_Link *link)
{
    if (link == NULL) {
        return true;
    }
    return link->tx_state == SYN_ISOTP_TX_IDLE;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_ISOTP */

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_pack.h"
#include "syn_j1939.h"

#include <string.h>

uint32_t syn_j1939_calc_pgn(uint8_t dp, uint8_t pf, uint8_t ps)
{
    if (pf < 240U) {
        return (((uint32_t)dp & 0x01U) << 16) | (((uint32_t)pf) << 8);
    }
    return (((uint32_t)dp & 0x01U) << 16) | (((uint32_t)pf) << 8) | (uint32_t)ps;
}

uint32_t syn_j1939_id_pack(uint8_t priority, uint32_t pgn, uint8_t sa, uint8_t da)
{
    uint8_t dp = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16) & 0x01U);
    uint8_t pf = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    uint8_t ps = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);

    if (pf < 240U) {
        ps = da; /* Destination-specific PDU1 format */
    }

    uint32_t id = 0;
    id |= ((uint32_t)(priority & 0x07U)) << 26;
    id |= ((uint32_t)(dp & 0x01U)) << 24;
    id |= ((uint32_t)pf) << 16;
    id |= ((uint32_t)ps) << 8;
    id |= ((uint32_t)sa);

    return id;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_id_unpack(uint32_t can_id, SYN_J1939_Header *header)
{
    if (!header)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    header->priority = (uint8_t)((can_id >> 26) & 0x07U);
    header->dp = (uint8_t)((can_id >> 24) & 0x01U);
    header->pf = (uint8_t)((can_id >> 16) & 0xFFU);
    header->ps = (uint8_t)((can_id >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    header->sa = (uint8_t)(can_id & 0xFFU);
    header->is_pdu1 = (header->pf < 240U);

    if (header->is_pdu1) {
        header->da = header->ps;
        header->pgn = syn_j1939_calc_pgn(header->dp, header->pf, 0);
    } else {
        header->da = SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL;
        header->pgn = syn_j1939_calc_pgn(header->dp, header->pf, header->ps);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_j1939_name_encode(const SYN_J1939_Name *name, uint8_t buf[8])
{
    if (!name || !buf)
        return;
    memset(buf, 0, 8);

    uint64_t n = 0;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->identity_number & 0x1FFFFFU));
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->manufacturer_code & 0x7FFU)) << 21;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->ecu_instance & 0x07U)) << 32;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->function_instance & 0x1FU)) << 35;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->function)) << 40;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->vehicle_system & 0x7FU)) << 49;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->vehicle_system_inst & 0x0FU)) << 56;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->industry_group & 0x07U)) << 60;
    n |= ((uint64_t)(name->arbitrary_addr_cap ? 1U : 0U)) << 63;

    size_t pos = 0;
    syn_pack_u64_le(buf, &pos, n);
}

void syn_j1939_name_decode(const uint8_t buf[8], SYN_J1939_Name *name)
{
    if (!name || !buf)
        return;
    memset(name, 0, sizeof(*name));

    size_t pos = 0;
    uint64_t n = syn_unpack_u64_le(buf, &pos);

    name->identity_number = (uint32_t)(n & 0x1FFFFFU);
    name->manufacturer_code = (uint16_t)((n >> 21) & 0x7FFU);
    name->ecu_instance = (uint8_t)((n >> 32) & 0x07U);
    name->function_instance = (uint8_t)((n >> 35) & 0x1FU);
    name->function = (uint8_t)((n >> 40) & 0xFFU);
    name->vehicle_system = (uint8_t)((n >> 49) & 0x7FU);
    name->vehicle_system_inst = (uint8_t)((n >> 56) & 0x0FU);
    name->industry_group = (uint8_t)((n >> 60) & 0x07U);
    name->arbitrary_addr_cap = ((n >> 63) & 0x01U) != 0;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_node_init(SYN_J1939_Node *node, uint8_t sa, const SYN_J1939_Name *name)
{
    if (!node)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    memset(node, 0, sizeof(*node));
    node->sa = sa;
    if (name) {
        node->name = *name;
    }
    node->state = SYN_J1939_STATE_UNCLAIMED;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_address_claim(const SYN_J1939_Node *node, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!node || !frame)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6, SYN_J1939_PGN_ADDR_CLAIM, node->sa, SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL);
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->extended = true;
    syn_j1939_name_encode(&node->name, frame->data);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_request(uint8_t sa, uint8_t da, uint32_t requested_pgn,
                                   SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!frame)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6, SYN_J1939_PGN_REQUEST, sa, da);
    frame->dlc = 3;
    frame->extended = true;

    frame->data[0] = (uint8_t)(requested_pgn & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[1] = (uint8_t)((requested_pgn >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[2] = (uint8_t)((requested_pgn >> 16) & 0xFFU);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_tp_bam(uint8_t sa, uint32_t pgn, uint16_t total_bytes,
                                  SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!frame || total_bytes < 9 || total_bytes > 1785)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(6, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM, sa, SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL);
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->extended = true;

    uint8_t total_packets = (uint8_t)((total_bytes + 6U) / 7U);

    frame->data[0] = SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_BAM;
    syn_poke_u16_le(total_bytes, frame->data, 1);
    frame->data[3] = total_packets;
    frame->data[4] = 0xFFU; /* Reserved */
    frame->data[5] = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[6] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8) & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[7] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16) & 0xFFU);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_tp_rts(uint8_t sa, uint8_t da, uint32_t pgn, uint16_t total_bytes,
                                  uint8_t max_packets, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!frame || da >= SYN_J1939_ADDR_NULL || max_packets == 0U || total_bytes < 9U ||
        total_bytes > 1785U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(7U, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM, sa, da);
    frame->dlc = 8U;
    frame->extended = true;

    uint8_t total_packets = (uint8_t)((total_bytes + 6U) / 7U);
    frame->data[0] = SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_RTS;
    syn_poke_u16_le(total_bytes, frame->data, 1U);
    frame->data[3] = total_packets;
    frame->data[4] = max_packets;
    frame->data[5] = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[6] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    frame->data[7] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_tp_dt_da(uint8_t sa, uint8_t da, uint8_t sequence,
                                    const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len,
                                    SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!frame || !payload || sequence == 0U || payload_len == 0U || payload_len > 7U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    frame->id = syn_j1939_id_pack(7U, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_DT, sa, da);
    frame->dlc = 8U;
    frame->extended = true;

    frame->data[0] = sequence;
    memset(&frame->data[1], 0xFF, 7U);
    memcpy(&frame->data[1], payload, payload_len);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_build_tp_dt(uint8_t sa, uint8_t sequence, const uint8_t *payload,
                                 size_t payload_len, SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    return syn_j1939_build_tp_dt_da(sa, SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL, sequence, payload, payload_len,
                                    frame);
}

bool syn_j1939_get_tx(SYN_J1939_Node *node, SYN_CAN_Frame *out_frame)
{
    if (!node || !out_frame || !node->tx_pending) {
        return false;
    }
    memset(out_frame, 0, sizeof(*out_frame));
    out_frame->id = node->tx_id;
    out_frame->dlc = 8U;
    out_frame->extended = true;
    memcpy(out_frame->data, node->tx_data, 8U);
    node->tx_pending = false;
    return true;
}

size_t syn_j1939_encode_dm1(uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_size, const SYN_J1939_DTC *dtc_list,
                            size_t dtc_count, uint8_t mil_lamp_status)
{
    if (!buf || buf_size < 2)
        return 0;

    buf[0] = (uint8_t)(mil_lamp_status & 0xFFU);
    buf[1] = 0xFFU; /* Reserved / Flash Lamp status */

    if (dtc_count == 0 || !dtc_list) {
        if (buf_size >= 6) {
            memset(&buf[2], 0, 4);
            return 6;
        }
        return 2;
    }

    size_t offset = 2;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < dtc_count; i++) {
        if (offset + 4 > buf_size)
            break;

        uint32_t spn = dtc_list[i].spn & 0x7FFFFU;
        uint8_t fmi = dtc_list[i].fmi & 0x1FU;
        uint8_t oc = dtc_list[i].occurrence_count & 0x7FU;
        uint8_t cm = (uint8_t)(dtc_list[i].conversion_method & 0x01U);

        syn_poke_u16_le((uint16_t)spn, buf, offset);
        buf[offset + 2] = (uint8_t)(((spn >> 11) & 0xE0U) | fmi);
        buf[offset + 3] = (uint8_t)((cm << 7) | oc);

        offset += 4;
    }

    return offset;
}

static void j1939_queue_tp_cts(SYN_J1939_Node *node, uint8_t da, uint8_t num_pkts, uint8_t next_seq,
                               uint32_t pgn)
{
    node->tx_id = syn_j1939_id_pack(7U, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM, node->sa, da);
    node->tx_data[0] = SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_CTS;
    node->tx_data[1] = num_pkts;
    node->tx_data[2] = next_seq;
    node->tx_data[3] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[4] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[5] = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[6] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[7] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_pending = true;
}

static void j1939_queue_tp_ack(SYN_J1939_Node *node, uint8_t da, uint16_t total_bytes,
                               uint8_t total_pkts, uint32_t pgn)
{
    node->tx_id = syn_j1939_id_pack(7U, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM, node->sa, da);
    node->tx_data[0] = SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_ACK;
    syn_poke_u16_le(total_bytes, node->tx_data, 1U);
    node->tx_data[3] = total_pkts;
    node->tx_data[4] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[5] = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[6] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[7] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_pending = true;
}

static void j1939_queue_tp_abort(SYN_J1939_Node *node, uint8_t da, uint8_t reason, uint32_t pgn)
{
    node->tx_id = syn_j1939_id_pack(7U, SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM, node->sa, da);
    node->tx_data[0] = SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_ABORT;
    node->tx_data[1] = reason;
    node->tx_data[2] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[3] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[4] = 0xFFU;
    node->tx_data[5] = (uint8_t)(pgn & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[6] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_data[7] = (uint8_t)((pgn >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    node->tx_pending = true;
}

static void j1939_start_tp_rx(SYN_J1939_Node *node, const SYN_J1939_Header *hdr,
                              const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint32_t pgn, uint16_t total_bytes,
                              uint8_t total_packets)
{
    node->tp_rx.active = true;
    node->tp_rx.is_bam = (frame->data[0] == SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_BAM);
    node->tp_rx.sa = hdr->sa;
    node->tp_rx.da = hdr->da;
    node->tp_rx.pgn = pgn;
    node->tp_rx.total_bytes = total_bytes;
    node->tp_rx.total_packets = total_packets;
    node->tp_rx.next_seq = 1U;
    node->tp_rx.received_packets = 0U;

    if (!node->tp_rx.is_bam) {
        uint8_t max_cts = frame->data[4];
        uint8_t window = (max_cts < total_packets) ? max_cts : total_packets;
        node->tp_rx.cts_window = window;
        node->tp_rx.cts_remaining = window;
        j1939_queue_tp_cts(node, hdr->sa, window, 1U, pgn);
    }
}

static bool j1939_tp_cm_accept(const SYN_J1939_Node *node, const SYN_J1939_Header *hdr,
                               const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    uint8_t ctrl = frame->data[0];
    if (ctrl == SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_BAM) {
        return (hdr->da == SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL) && (!node->tp_rx.active);
    }
    if (ctrl == SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_RTS) {
        return (node->sa < SYN_J1939_ADDR_NULL) && (hdr->da == node->sa) && (frame->data[4] > 0U);
    }
    return false;
}

static SYN_Status j1939_handle_tp_cm(SYN_J1939_Node *node, const SYN_J1939_Header *hdr,
                                     const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    if (frame->dlc != 8U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t ctrl = frame->data[0];
    if (ctrl == SYN_J1939_TP_CTRL_ABORT) {
        if (node->tp_rx.active && hdr->sa == node->tp_rx.sa && hdr->da == node->tp_rx.da) {
            node->tp_rx.active = false;
            node->tx_pending = false;
        }
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    if (!j1939_tp_cm_accept(node, hdr, frame)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    uint32_t pgn = (uint32_t)syn_peek_u16_le(frame->data, 5U) | ((uint32_t)frame->data[7] << 16U);
    if (node->tp_rx.active) {
        if (hdr->sa == node->tp_rx.sa) {
            node->tp_rx.active = false;
            j1939_queue_tp_abort(node, hdr->sa, 1U, pgn);
        } else if (!node->tx_pending) {
            j1939_queue_tp_abort(node, hdr->sa, 1U, pgn);
        }
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    uint16_t total_bytes = syn_peek_u16_le(frame->data, 1U);
    uint8_t total_packets = frame->data[3];
    uint8_t expected_packets = (uint8_t)((total_bytes + 6U) / 7U);

    if (total_bytes >= 9U && total_bytes <= sizeof(node->tp_rx.data) &&
        total_packets == expected_packets) {
        j1939_start_tp_rx(node, hdr, frame, pgn, total_bytes, total_packets);
    }
    return SYN_BUSY;
}

static SYN_Status j1939_handle_tp_dt(SYN_J1939_Node *node, const SYN_J1939_Header *hdr,
                                     const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint32_t *out_pgn,
                                     const uint8_t **out_data, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (frame->dlc != 8U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (!node->tp_rx.active || hdr->sa != node->tp_rx.sa || hdr->da != node->tp_rx.da) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    uint8_t seq = frame->data[0];
    if (seq != node->tp_rx.next_seq) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    size_t offset = (size_t)(seq - 1U) * 7U;
    size_t rem = (size_t)node->tp_rx.total_bytes - offset;
    size_t copy_len = (rem < 7U) ? rem : 7U;

    memcpy(&node->tp_rx.data[offset], &frame->data[1], copy_len);
    node->tp_rx.next_seq++;
    node->tp_rx.received_packets++;

    if (node->tp_rx.received_packets >= node->tp_rx.total_packets) {
        if (!node->tp_rx.is_bam) {
            j1939_queue_tp_ack(node, node->tp_rx.sa, node->tp_rx.total_bytes,
                               node->tp_rx.total_packets, node->tp_rx.pgn);
        }
        *out_pgn = node->tp_rx.pgn;
        *out_data = node->tp_rx.data;
        *out_len = node->tp_rx.total_bytes;
        node->tp_rx.active = false;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (!node->tp_rx.is_bam) {
        node->tp_rx.cts_remaining--;
        if (node->tp_rx.cts_remaining == 0U) {
            uint8_t left = (uint8_t)(node->tp_rx.total_packets - node->tp_rx.received_packets);
            uint8_t next_win = (node->tp_rx.cts_window < left) ? node->tp_rx.cts_window : left;
            node->tp_rx.cts_remaining = next_win;
            j1939_queue_tp_cts(node, node->tp_rx.sa, next_win, node->tp_rx.next_seq,
                               node->tp_rx.pgn);
        }
    }

    return SYN_BUSY;
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_process_frame(SYN_J1939_Node *node, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                   uint32_t *out_pgn, const uint8_t **out_data, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (!node || !frame || !out_pgn || !out_data || !out_len || !frame->extended) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_J1939_Header hdr;
    (void)syn_j1939_id_unpack(frame->id, &hdr);

    if (hdr.pgn == SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_CM) {
        return j1939_handle_tp_cm(node, &hdr, frame);
    }

    if (hdr.pgn == SYN_J1939_PGN_TP_DT) {
        return j1939_handle_tp_dt(node, &hdr, frame, out_pgn, out_data, out_len);
    }

    /* Single-frame packet handling */
    *out_pgn = hdr.pgn;
    *out_data = frame->data;
    *out_len = frame->dlc;

    return SYN_OK;
}

size_t syn_j1939_encode_dm2(uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_size, const SYN_J1939_DTC *dtc_list,
                            size_t dtc_count, uint8_t mil_lamp_status)
{
    return syn_j1939_encode_dm1(buf, buf_size, dtc_list, dtc_count, mil_lamp_status);
}

void syn_j1939_dtc_log_init(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log)
{
    if (log != NULL) {
        (void)memset(log, 0, sizeof(*log));
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_dtc_add_active(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log, uint32_t spn, uint8_t fmi)
{
    if (log == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Check if already active */
    for (size_t i = 0; i < log->active_count; i++) {
        if (log->active_dtcs[i].spn == spn && log->active_dtcs[i].fmi == fmi) {
            if (log->active_dtcs[i].occurrence_count < 126U) {
                log->active_dtcs[i].occurrence_count++;
            }
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    if (log->active_count >= SYN_J1939_MAX_LOGGED_DTCS) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    log->active_dtcs[log->active_count].spn = spn;
    log->active_dtcs[log->active_count].fmi = fmi;
    log->active_dtcs[log->active_count].occurrence_count = 1;
    log->active_dtcs[log->active_count].conversion_method = 0;
    log->active_count++;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void j1939_dtc_record_prev(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log, const SYN_J1939_DTC *dtc)
{
    for (size_t k = 0U; k < log->prev_count; k++) {
        if ((log->prev_dtcs[k].spn == dtc->spn) && (log->prev_dtcs[k].fmi == dtc->fmi)) {
            uint16_t merged =
                (uint16_t)log->prev_dtcs[k].occurrence_count + (uint16_t)dtc->occurrence_count;
            log->prev_dtcs[k].occurrence_count = (merged > 126U) ? 126U : (uint8_t)merged;
            return;
        }
    }
    if (log->prev_count < SYN_J1939_MAX_LOGGED_DTCS) {
        log->prev_dtcs[log->prev_count] = *dtc;
        log->prev_count++;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_j1939_dtc_clear_active(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log, uint32_t spn, uint8_t fmi)
{
    if (log == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < log->active_count; i++) {
        if (log->active_dtcs[i].spn == spn && log->active_dtcs[i].fmi == fmi) {
            j1939_dtc_record_prev(log, &log->active_dtcs[i]);
            /* Remove from active_dtcs */
            for (size_t j = i; j + 1 < log->active_count; j++) {
                log->active_dtcs[j] = log->active_dtcs[j + 1];
            }
            log->active_count--;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

void syn_j1939_dtc_clear_dm3(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log)
{
    if (log != NULL) {
        log->prev_count = 0;
        (void)memset(log->prev_dtcs, 0, sizeof(log->prev_dtcs));
    }
}

void syn_j1939_dtc_clear_dm11(SYN_J1939_DTCLog *log)
{
    if (log != NULL) {
        log->active_count = 0;
        (void)memset(log->active_dtcs, 0, sizeof(log->active_dtcs));
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_kwp2000_init(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server)
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(server, 0, sizeof(*server));
    server->current_session = SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_DEFAULT;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_kwp2000_register_lid(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, uint8_t lid, void *data,
                                    uint16_t len, bool writable)
{
    if (server == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < server->lid_count; i++) {
        if (server->lids[i].lid == lid) {
            server->lids[i].data = data;
            server->lids[i].len = len;
            server->lids[i].writable = writable;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    if (server->lid_count >= SYN_KWP2000_MAX_LIDS) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    server->lids[server->lid_count].lid = lid;
    server->lids[server->lid_count].data = data;
    server->lids[server->lid_count].len = len;
    server->lids[server->lid_count].writable = writable;
    server->lid_count++;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static const SYN_KWP2000_LID *kwp_find_lid(const SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, uint8_t target_lid)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < server->lid_count; i++) {
        if (server->lids[i].lid == target_lid) {
            return &server->lids[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static const SYN_KWP2000_CID *kwp_find_cid(const SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, uint16_t target_cid)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < server->cid_count; i++) {
        if (server->cids[i].cid == target_cid) {
            return &server->cids[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void kwp_handle_session(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf, uint16_t req_len,
                               uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t target_session = req_buf[1];
    if (target_session != SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_DEFAULT &&
        target_session != SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_PROGRAMMING &&
        target_session != SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_EXTENDED) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SUBFUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if (server->session_cb != NULL &&
        !server->session_cb(server->current_session, target_session, server->session_ctx)) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    server->current_session = target_session;
    server->security_unlocked = false;
    server->security_level = 0U;
    server->is_downloading = false;
    server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = target_session;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_handle_reset(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf, uint16_t req_len,
                             uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t reset_type = req_buf[1];
    if (reset_type != 0x01U && reset_type != 0x02U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SUBFUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    server->pending_reset_type = reset_type;
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = reset_type;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_handle_read_lid(const SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len,
                                uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t target_lid = req_buf[1];
    const SYN_KWP2000_LID *found_lid = kwp_find_lid(server, target_lid);
    if (found_lid == NULL) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if ((uint32_t)found_lid->len + 2U > (uint32_t)max_resp_len) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = target_lid;
    memcpy(&resp_buf[2], found_lid->data, found_lid->len);
    *resp_len = (uint16_t)(2U + found_lid->len);
}

static void kwp_handle_read_cid(const SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len,
                                uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 3U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint16_t target_cid = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)req_buf[1] << 8U) | (uint16_t)req_buf[2]);
    const SYN_KWP2000_CID *found_cid = kwp_find_cid(server, target_cid);
    if (found_cid == NULL) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if ((uint32_t)found_cid->len + 3U > (uint32_t)max_resp_len) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = (uint8_t)(target_cid >> 8U);
    resp_buf[2] = (uint8_t)(target_cid & 0xFFU);
    memcpy(&resp_buf[3], found_cid->data, found_cid->len);
    *resp_len = (uint16_t)(3U + found_cid->len);
}

static void kwp_handle_write_lid(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                 uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 3U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t target_lid = req_buf[1];
    const SYN_KWP2000_LID *found_lid = kwp_find_lid(server, target_lid);
    if (found_lid == NULL || !found_lid->writable) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if ((uint16_t)(req_len - 2U) != found_lid->len) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if (!server->security_unlocked) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SECURITY_ACCESS_DENIED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(found_lid->data, &req_buf[2], found_lid->len);
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = target_lid;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_handle_write_cid(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                 uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 4U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    uint16_t target_cid = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)req_buf[1] << 8U) | (uint16_t)req_buf[2]);
    const SYN_KWP2000_CID *found_cid = kwp_find_cid(server, target_cid);
    if (found_cid == NULL || !found_cid->writable) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if ((uint16_t)(req_len - 3U) != found_cid->len) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if (!server->security_unlocked) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SECURITY_ACCESS_DENIED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(found_cid->data, &req_buf[3], found_cid->len);
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = req_buf[1];
    resp_buf[2] = req_buf[2];
    *resp_len = 3U;
}

static void kwp_handle_security_seed(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, uint8_t sid, uint8_t sub_func,
                                     uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t seed_buf[16];
    uint16_t seed_len = (uint16_t)sizeof(seed_buf);
    if (server->seed_cb != NULL) {
        if (!server->seed_cb(sub_func, seed_buf, &seed_len, server->security_ctx)) {
            make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
            return;
        }
    } else {
        seed_buf[0] = 0x36U;
        seed_buf[1] = 0x37U;
        seed_len = 2U;
    }

    if ((seed_len > (uint16_t)sizeof(seed_buf)) ||
        (((uint32_t)seed_len + 2U) > (uint32_t)max_resp_len)) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = sub_func;
    memcpy(&resp_buf[2], seed_buf, seed_len);
    *resp_len = (uint16_t)(2U + seed_len);
}

static void kwp_handle_security_key(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                    uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    uint8_t sub_func = req_buf[1];
    if (req_len < 3U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    const uint8_t *key = &req_buf[2];
    uint16_t key_len = (uint16_t)(req_len - 2U);

    bool key_ok = false;
    if (server->key_cb != NULL) {
        key_ok = server->key_cb(sub_func, key, key_len, server->security_ctx);
    } else {
        key_ok = (key_len >= 2U && key[0] == 0xC5U && key[1] == 0xC9U);
    }

    if (!key_ok) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INVALID_KEY, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    server->security_unlocked = true;
    server->security_level = sub_func;
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = sub_func;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_handle_routine(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf, uint16_t req_len,
                               uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    uint8_t routine_id = req_buf[1];
    const uint8_t *in_data = (req_len > 2U) ? &req_buf[2] : NULL;
    uint16_t in_len = (req_len > 2U) ? (uint16_t)(req_len - 2U) : 0U;

    uint8_t routine_out[64];
    uint16_t out_len = 0U;
    if (server->routine_cb != NULL &&
        !server->routine_cb(routine_id, in_data, in_len, routine_out, (uint16_t)sizeof(routine_out),
                            &out_len, server->routine_ctx)) {
        uint8_t nrc = server->security_unlocked ? SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT
                                                : SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SECURITY_ACCESS_DENIED;
        make_nrc(sid, nrc, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    if ((out_len > (uint16_t)sizeof(routine_out)) ||
        (((uint32_t)out_len + 2U) > (uint32_t)max_resp_len)) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = routine_id;
    if (out_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(&resp_buf[2], routine_out, out_len);
    }
    *resp_len = (uint16_t)(2U + out_len);
}

static void kwp_handle_download(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if ((req_len < 5U) || ((req_len > 5U) && (req_len < 9U))) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if (!server->security_unlocked) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SECURITY_ACCESS_DENIED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t addr = ((uint32_t)req_buf[1] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)req_buf[2] << 16U) |
                    ((uint32_t)req_buf[3] << 8U) | (uint32_t)req_buf[4];
    uint32_t size = (req_len >= 9U)
                        ? (((uint32_t)req_buf[5] << 24U) | ((uint32_t)req_buf[6] << 16U) |
                           ((uint32_t)req_buf[7] << 8U) | (uint32_t)req_buf[8])
                        : 0U;

    server->is_downloading = true;
    server->expected_block_seq = 1U;
    server->download_addr = addr;
    server->download_size = size;
    server->download_received = 0U;

    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = 0x20U;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_handle_transfer(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    if (!server->is_downloading || req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    uint8_t block_num = req_buf[1];
    uint16_t data_len = (uint16_t)(req_len - 2U);
    if (block_num != server->expected_block_seq) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }
    if (server->download_size > 0U &&
        (uint32_t)data_len > (server->download_size - server->download_received)) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_REQUEST_OUT_OF_RANGE, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    uint32_t target_addr = server->download_addr + server->download_received;
    if (server->memory_cb != NULL &&
        !server->memory_cb(true, target_addr, data_len, (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)&req_buf[2],
                           server->memory_ctx)) {
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return;
    }

    server->download_received += data_len;
    server->expected_block_seq = (uint8_t)(server->expected_block_seq + 1U);
    resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
    resp_buf[1] = block_num;
    *resp_len = 2U;
}

static void kwp_dispatch_transfer_or_misc(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                          uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf,
                                          uint16_t max_resp_len, uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    switch (sid) {
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_START_ROUTINE_BY_LOCAL_IDENTIFIER:
        kwp_handle_routine(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_REQUEST_DOWNLOAD:
        kwp_handle_download(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_TRANSFER_DATA:
        kwp_handle_transfer(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_REQUEST_TRANSFER_EXIT:
        if (!server->is_downloading) {
            make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_CONDITIONS_NOT_CORRECT, resp_buf, resp_len);
        } else {
            server->is_downloading = false;
            resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
            *resp_len = 1U;
        }
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_TESTER_PRESENT:
        server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
        resp_buf[0] = (uint8_t)(sid + 0x40U);
        *resp_len = 1U;
        break;
    default:
        make_nrc(sid, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SERVICE_NOT_SUPPORTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    }
}

static void kwp_handle_security(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len,
                                uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    if (req_len < 2U) {
        make_nrc(req_buf[0], SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
    } else if (req_buf[1] == 0x00U) {
        make_nrc(req_buf[0], SYN_KWP2000_NRC_SUBFUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, resp_buf, resp_len);
    } else if ((req_buf[1] % 2U) != 0U) {
        kwp_handle_security_seed(server, req_buf[0], req_buf[1], resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
    } else {
        kwp_handle_security_key(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_kwp2000_process_request(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, const uint8_t *req_buf,
                                       uint16_t req_len, uint8_t *resp_buf, uint16_t max_resp_len,
                                       uint16_t *resp_len)
{
    if (server == NULL || req_buf == NULL || resp_buf == NULL || resp_len == NULL ||
        max_resp_len < 3U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (req_len < 1U) {
        make_nrc(0x00U, SYN_KWP2000_NRC_INCORRECT_MESSAGE_LENGTH, resp_buf, resp_len);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (server->current_session != SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_DEFAULT) {
        server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
    }

    uint8_t sid = req_buf[0];
    switch (sid) {
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_START_DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION:
        kwp_handle_session(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_ECU_RESET:
        kwp_handle_reset(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_READ_DATA_BY_LOCAL_IDENTIFIER:
        kwp_handle_read_lid(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_READ_DATA_BY_COMMON_IDENTIFIER:
        kwp_handle_read_cid(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_SECURITY_ACCESS:
        kwp_handle_security(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_WRITE_DATA_BY_COMMON_IDENTIFIER:
        kwp_handle_write_cid(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    case SYN_KWP2000_SID_WRITE_DATA_BY_LOCAL_IDENTIFIER:
        kwp_handle_write_lid(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, resp_len);
        break;
    default:
        kwp_dispatch_transfer_or_misc(server, req_buf, req_len, resp_buf, max_resp_len, resp_len);
        break;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_kwp2000_tick(SYN_KWP2000_Server *server, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    if (dt_ms > (UINT32_MAX - server->s3_timer_ms)) {
        server->s3_timer_ms = UINT32_MAX;
    } else {
        server->s3_timer_ms += dt_ms;
    }

    /* S3 session inactivity timeout (ISO 14230-3 §5.3) */
    if (server->current_session != SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_DEFAULT) {
        if (server->s3_timer_ms >= SYN_KWP2000_S3_TIMEOUT_MS) {
            server->current_session = SYN_KWP2000_SESSION_DEFAULT;
            server->security_unlocked = false;
            server->security_level = 0U;
            server->is_downloading = false;
            server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
        }
    } else {
        server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
    }

    if (server->pending_reset_type != 0U) {
        if (server->reset_wait_ms > dt_ms) {
            server->reset_wait_ms -= dt_ms;
        } else {
            uint8_t rtype = server->pending_reset_type;
            server->pending_reset_type = 0U;
            if (server->reset_cb != NULL) {
                server->reset_cb(rtype, server->reset_ctx);
            }
        }
    }
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Provides a zero-allocation, lightweight KWP2000 server protocol stack over ISO 15765-2 ISO-TP for automotive diagnostic session management, Local/Common Identifier (LID/CID) read/write, security access seed/key unlocks, routine control, memory transfer, and ECU reset.

#include "syn_lin.h"

#if !defined(SYN_USE_LIN) || SYN_USE_LIN

/* ── PID Parity Calculation ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

uint8_t syn_lin_calc_pid(uint8_t id)
{
    uint8_t id_clean = id & SYN_LIN_ID_MAX;
    uint8_t id0 = (id_clean >> 0) & 0x01;
    uint8_t id1 = (id_clean >> 1) & 0x01;
    uint8_t id2 = (id_clean >> 2) & 0x01;
    uint8_t id3 = (id_clean >> 3) & 0x01;
    uint8_t id4 = (id_clean >> 4) & 0x01;
    uint8_t id5 = (id_clean >> 5) & 0x01;

    uint8_t p0 = id0 ^ id1 ^ id2 ^ id4;
    uint8_t p1 = !(id1 ^ id3 ^ id4 ^ id5);

    return (uint8_t)((p1 << 7) | (p0 << 6) | id_clean);
}

bool syn_lin_verify_pid(uint8_t pid)
{
    uint8_t expected_pid = syn_lin_calc_pid(pid & SYN_LIN_ID_MAX);
    return (pid == expected_pid);
}

/* ── LIN Checksum Calculation ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

uint8_t syn_lin_calc_checksum(uint8_t pid, const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len,
                              SYN_LIN_ChecksumMode mode)
{
    if (data == NULL || len == 0 || len > SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX) {
        return 0;
    }

    uint8_t id = pid & SYN_LIN_ID_MAX;
    /* Diagnostic frames 0x3C and 0x3D always use Classic checksum per LIN 2.1/ISO 17987 */
    if (id == SYN_LIN_ID_MASTER_REQ || id == SYN_LIN_ID_SLAVE_RESP) {
        mode = SYN_LIN_CHECKSUM_CLASSIC;
    }

    uint16_t sum = 0;

    if (mode == SYN_LIN_CHECKSUM_ENHANCED) {
        sum += pid;
    }

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        sum += data[i];
        if (sum > 0xFF) {
            sum -= 0xFF;
        }
    }

    return (uint8_t)(~sum & 0xFF);
}

/* ── LIN Master Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_lin_master_init(SYN_LIN_Master *master, const SYN_LIN_ScheduleSlot *slots,
                               size_t count)
{
    if (master == NULL || slots == NULL || count == 0) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    master->slots = slots;
    master->slot_count = count;
    master->current_slot = 0U;
    master->slot_timer = 0U;
    master->running = true;
    master->started = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_lin_master_step(SYN_LIN_Master *master, uint32_t dt_ms,
                         const SYN_LIN_ScheduleSlot **active_slot)
{
    if (master == NULL || !master->running || master->slots == NULL || master->slot_count == 0U) {
        if (active_slot != NULL) {
            *active_slot = NULL;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (!master->started) {
        master->started = true;
        master->slot_timer = 0U;
        if (active_slot != NULL) {
            *active_slot = &master->slots[master->current_slot];
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (dt_ms > (UINT32_MAX - master->slot_timer)) {
        master->slot_timer = UINT32_MAX;
    } else {
        master->slot_timer += dt_ms;
    }

    const SYN_LIN_ScheduleSlot *current = &master->slots[master->current_slot];

    if (master->slot_timer >= current->delay_ms) {
        master->slot_timer = 0U;
        master->current_slot = (master->current_slot + 1U) % master->slot_count;
        if (active_slot != NULL) {
            *active_slot = &master->slots[master->current_slot];
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (active_slot != NULL) {
        *active_slot = current;
    }
    return false;
}

/* ── LIN Slave Implementation ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_lin_slave_init(SYN_LIN_Slave *slave, uint8_t nad)
{
    if (slave == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    slave->nad = nad;
    slave->frame_count = 0;
    slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE;
    slave->rx_idx = 0;
    slave->expected_len = 0;
    slave->expected_checksum_mode = SYN_LIN_CHECKSUM_CLASSIC;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < SYN_LIN_SLAVE_MAX_FRAMES; i++) {
        slave->frames[i].active = false;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_lin_slave_add_frame(SYN_LIN_Slave *slave, uint8_t id, uint8_t len,
                                   SYN_LIN_SlotDirection dir, SYN_LIN_ChecksumMode mode)
{
    if (slave == NULL || id > SYN_LIN_ID_MAX || len == 0 || len > SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Check if frame ID is already registered */
    for (size_t i = 0; i < slave->frame_count; i++) {
        if (slave->frames[i].active && slave->frames[i].id == id) {
            slave->frames[i].len = len;
            slave->frames[i].dir = dir;
            slave->frames[i].checksum_mode = mode;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    if (slave->frame_count >= SYN_LIN_SLAVE_MAX_FRAMES) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_LIN_SlaveFrame *f = &slave->frames[slave->frame_count++];
    f->id = id;
    f->len = len;
    f->dir = dir;
    f->checksum_mode = mode;
    f->active = true;

    for (uint8_t j = 0; j < SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX; j++) {
        f->data[j] = 0x00;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_lin_slave_set_publish_data(SYN_LIN_Slave *slave, uint8_t id, const uint8_t *data,
                                          uint8_t len)
{
    if (slave == NULL || data == NULL || len == 0 || len > SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX ||
        id > SYN_LIN_ID_MAX) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < slave->frame_count; i++) {
        if (slave->frames[i].active && slave->frames[i].id == id &&
            slave->frames[i].dir == SYN_LIN_SLOT_PUBLISH) {
            if (len > slave->frames[i].len) {
                len = slave->frames[i].len;
            }
            for (uint8_t j = 0; j < len; j++) {
                slave->frames[i].data[j] = data[j];
            }
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

bool syn_lin_slave_process_byte(SYN_LIN_Slave *slave, uint8_t byte, SYN_LIN_Frame *out_frame)
{
    if (slave == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    switch (slave->state) {
    case SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE:
        if (byte == SYN_LIN_SYNC_BYTE) {
            slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_PID;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_LIN_STATE_SYNC:
        if (byte == SYN_LIN_SYNC_BYTE) {
            slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_PID;
        } else {
            slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_LIN_STATE_PID: {
        slave->rx_frame.pid = byte;
        slave->rx_frame.id = byte & SYN_LIN_ID_MAX;
        slave->rx_frame.valid_pid = syn_lin_verify_pid(byte);
        slave->rx_idx = 0;

        if (!slave->rx_frame.valid_pid) {
            slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE;
            break;
        }

        /* Look up expected frame in configuration table */
        bool found = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < slave->frame_count; i++) {
            if (slave->frames[i].active && slave->frames[i].id == slave->rx_frame.id) {
                slave->expected_len = slave->frames[i].len;
                slave->expected_checksum_mode = slave->frames[i].checksum_mode;
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!found) {
            /* Unknown frame ID; default to 8 bytes classic checksum */
            slave->expected_len = 8;
            slave->expected_checksum_mode = SYN_LIN_CHECKSUM_CLASSIC;
        }

        slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_DATA;
        break;
    }

    case SYN_LIN_STATE_DATA:
        if (slave->rx_idx < SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX) {
            slave->rx_frame.data[slave->rx_idx++] = byte;
        }
        if (slave->rx_idx >= slave->expected_len || slave->rx_idx >= SYN_LIN_DATA_MAX) {
            slave->rx_frame.len = slave->rx_idx;
            slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_CHECKSUM;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_LIN_STATE_CHECKSUM: {
        slave->rx_frame.checksum = byte;
        uint8_t calc_cs = syn_lin_calc_checksum(slave->rx_frame.pid, slave->rx_frame.data,
                                                slave->rx_frame.len, slave->expected_checksum_mode);
        slave->rx_frame.valid_checksum = (byte == calc_cs);
        slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE;

        if (out_frame != NULL) {
            *out_frame = slave->rx_frame;
        }
        return slave->rx_frame.valid_pid && slave->rx_frame.valid_checksum;
    }

    default:
        slave->state = SYN_LIN_STATE_IDLE;
        break;
    }

    return false;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_LIN */

#include "syn_lintp.h"

#if !defined(SYN_USE_LINTP) || SYN_USE_LINTP

#include <string.h>

void syn_lintp_init(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t nad, uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t rx_size,
                    uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t tx_size)
{
    if (link == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memset(link, 0, sizeof(*link));
    link->nad = nad;
    link->padding_byte = 0xFFU;
    link->rx_buf = rx_buf;
    link->rx_buf_size = rx_size;
    link->tx_buf = tx_buf;
    link->tx_size = tx_size;
    link->timer_n_as_ms = 1000U;
    link->timer_n_cr_ms = 1000U;
    link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
    link->tx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
}

void syn_lintp_set_timeouts(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint32_t n_as_ms, uint32_t n_cr_ms)
{
    if (link != NULL) {
        link->timer_n_as_ms = (n_as_ms > 0U) ? n_as_ms : 1000U;
        link->timer_n_cr_ms = (n_cr_ms > 0U) ? n_cr_ms : 1000U;
    }
}

void syn_lintp_set_padding(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t pad_byte)
{
    if (link != NULL) {
        link->padding_byte = pad_byte;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_lintp_send(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t nad, const uint8_t *payload, size_t len)
{
    if (link == NULL || payload == NULL || len == 0U || len > 4095U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (len > 6U && (link->tx_buf == NULL || len > link->tx_size)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (link->tx_state != SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE || link->tx_frame_pending) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    link->tx_nad = nad;
    link->tx_total_len = len;
    link->tx_offset = 0U;
    link->tx_sn = 1U;
    link->tx_timer_ms = 0U;

    memset(link->tx_frame, link->padding_byte, 8U);
    link->tx_frame[0] = nad;

    if (len <= 6U) {
        if (link->tx_buf != NULL && len <= link->tx_size) {
            memcpy(link->tx_buf, payload, len);
        }
        link->tx_frame[1] = (uint8_t)(SYN_LINTP_PCI_SF | (len & 0x0FU));
        memcpy(&link->tx_frame[2], payload, len);
        link->tx_offset = len;
        link->tx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
    } else {
        memcpy(link->tx_buf, payload, len);
        link->tx_frame[1] = (uint8_t)(0x10U | ((len >> 8U) & 0x0FU));
        link->tx_frame[2] = (uint8_t)(len & 0xFFU);
        memcpy(&link->tx_frame[3], link->tx_buf, 5U);
        link->tx_offset = 5U;
        link->tx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_TRANSMITTING_CF;
    }

    link->tx_frame_pending = true;
    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_lintp_get_tx_frame(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t out_frame[8])
{
    if (link == NULL || out_frame == NULL || !link->tx_frame_pending) {
        return false;
    }

    memcpy(out_frame, link->tx_frame, 8U);
    link->tx_frame_pending = false;
    link->tx_timer_ms = 0U;

    if (link->tx_state == SYN_LINTP_STATE_TRANSMITTING_CF) {
        if (link->tx_offset < link->tx_total_len) {
            memset(link->tx_frame, link->padding_byte, 8U);
            link->tx_frame[0] = link->tx_nad;
            link->tx_frame[1] = (uint8_t)(0x20U | (link->tx_sn & 0x0FU));

            size_t bytes_to_copy = link->tx_total_len - link->tx_offset;
            if (bytes_to_copy > 6U) {
                bytes_to_copy = 6U;
            }

            memcpy(&link->tx_frame[2], &link->tx_buf[link->tx_offset], bytes_to_copy);
            link->tx_offset += bytes_to_copy;
            link->tx_sn = (uint8_t)((link->tx_sn + 1U) & 0x0FU);
            link->tx_frame_pending = true;
        } else {
            link->tx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

static void lintp_rx_cf(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t frame_nad, const uint8_t frame[8])
{
    if (link->rx_state != SYN_LINTP_STATE_RECEIVING_CF || frame_nad != link->rx_nad) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t sn = (uint8_t)(frame[1] & 0x0FU);
    if (sn != link->rx_sn) {
        link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
        link->rx_offset = 0U;
        return;
    }

    size_t remaining = link->rx_total_len - link->rx_offset;
    size_t copy_bytes = (remaining > 6U) ? 6U : remaining;

    memcpy(&link->rx_buf[link->rx_offset], &frame[2], copy_bytes);
    link->rx_offset += copy_bytes;
    link->rx_sn = (uint8_t)((link->rx_sn + 1U) & 0x0FU);
    link->rx_timer_ms = 0U;

    if (link->rx_offset >= link->rx_total_len) {
        link->rx_completed = true;
        link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
    }
}

static void lintp_rx_sf(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t frame_nad, const uint8_t frame[8])
{
    size_t sf_len = (size_t)(frame[1] & 0x0FU);
    if (sf_len == 0U || sf_len > 6U || link->rx_buf == NULL || sf_len > link->rx_buf_size) {
        return;
    }
    memcpy(link->rx_buf, &frame[2], sf_len);
    link->rx_total_len = sf_len;
    link->rx_offset = sf_len;
    link->rx_nad = frame_nad;
    link->rx_completed = true;
    link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
}

static void lintp_rx_ff(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t frame_nad, const uint8_t frame[8])
{
    if (frame_nad == SYN_LINTP_NAD_FUNCTIONAL) {
        return;
    }
    size_t ff_len = (size_t)((((size_t)frame[1] & 0x0FU) << 8U) | (size_t)frame[2]);
    if (ff_len <= 6U || link->rx_buf == NULL || ff_len > link->rx_buf_size) {
        link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
        return;
    }
    memcpy(link->rx_buf, &frame[3], 5U);
    link->rx_total_len = ff_len;
    link->rx_offset = 5U;
    link->rx_sn = 1U;
    link->rx_nad = frame_nad;
    link->rx_completed = false;
    link->rx_timer_ms = 0U;
    link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_RECEIVING_CF;
}

void syn_lintp_process_rx_frame(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, const uint8_t frame[8])
{
    if (link == NULL || frame == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t frame_nad = frame[0];
    if (frame_nad != link->nad && frame_nad != SYN_LINTP_NAD_FUNCTIONAL &&
        frame_nad != SYN_LINTP_NAD_BROADCAST) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t pci_type = (uint8_t)((frame[1] >> 4U) & 0x0FU);

    switch (pci_type) {
    case SYN_LINTP_PCI_SF:
        lintp_rx_sf(link, frame_nad, frame);
        break;

    case SYN_LINTP_PCI_FF:
        lintp_rx_ff(link, frame_nad, frame);
        break;

    case SYN_LINTP_PCI_CF:
        lintp_rx_cf(link, frame_nad, frame);
        break;

    default:
        break;
    }
}

ssize_t syn_lintp_receive(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    if (link == NULL || out_buf == NULL || max_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (!link->rx_completed) {
        return 0;
    }

    size_t copy_len = (link->rx_total_len < max_len) ? link->rx_total_len : max_len;
    memcpy(out_buf, link->rx_buf, copy_len);

    link->rx_completed = false;
    link->rx_offset = 0U;
    link->rx_total_len = 0U;

    return (ssize_t)copy_len;
}

static uint32_t lintp_sat_add_u32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b)
{
    return (b > (UINT32_MAX - a)) ? UINT32_MAX : (a + b);
}

void syn_lintp_step(SYN_LINTP_Link *link, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (link == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (link->rx_state == SYN_LINTP_STATE_RECEIVING_CF) {
        link->rx_timer_ms = lintp_sat_add_u32(link->rx_timer_ms, dt_ms);
        if (link->rx_timer_ms >= link->timer_n_cr_ms) {
            link->rx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
            link->rx_offset = 0U;
            link->rx_completed = false;
        }
    }

    if (link->tx_state != SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE || link->tx_frame_pending) {
        link->tx_timer_ms = lintp_sat_add_u32(link->tx_timer_ms, dt_ms);
        if (link->tx_timer_ms >= link->timer_n_as_ms) {
            link->tx_state = SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE;
            link->tx_frame_pending = false;
            link->tx_offset = 0U;
        }
    }
}

bool syn_lintp_is_tx_idle(const SYN_LINTP_Link *link)
{
    if (link == NULL) {
        return true;
    }
    return (link->tx_state == SYN_LINTP_STATE_IDLE && !link->tx_frame_pending);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_LINTP */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides non-blocking, zero-allocation ISO 17987-2 LIN Transport Protocol segmentation and reassembly engine for multi-byte LIN payload transmission using Single Frame (SF), First Frame (FF), and Consecutive Frame (CF).

Operates without Flow Control (FC) frames per ISO 17987-2 & ISO 14229-7.

#include "syn_lss.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_pack.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_lss_slave_init(SYN_LSSSlave *slave, const SYN_LSSAddress *addr, uint8_t initial_node_id)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(slave != NULL && addr != NULL);
    memset(slave, 0, sizeof(*slave));
    slave->mode = SYN_LSS_MODE_OPERATION;
    slave->node_id = initial_node_id;
    slave->baud_table = SYN_LSS_BAUD_250K;
    slave->addr = *addr;
    slave->store_req = false;
}

static bool lss_handle_config_cmd(SYN_LSSSlave *slave, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                  SYN_CAN_Frame *resp)
{
    uint8_t cs = frame->data[0];

    if (cs == SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_NODE_ID) {
        uint8_t new_id = frame->data[1];
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_NODE_ID;
        if ((new_id >= 1U && new_id <= 127U) || new_id == 0xFFU) {
            slave->node_id = new_id;
            resp->data[1] = 0U;
            resp->data[2] = 0U;
        } else {
            resp->data[1] = 1U;
            resp->data[2] = 0xFFU;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (cs == SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_BIT_TIMING) {
        uint8_t table_selector = frame->data[1];
        uint8_t baud_idx = frame->data[2];
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_BIT_TIMING;
        if (table_selector == 0U && baud_idx <= SYN_LSS_BAUD_10K) {
            slave->baud_table = baud_idx;
            resp->data[1] = 0U;
            resp->data[2] = 0U;
        } else {
            resp->data[1] = 1U;
            resp->data[2] = 0xFFU;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (cs == SYN_LSS_CS_STORE_CONFIG) {
        slave->store_req = true;
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_STORE_CONFIG;
        resp->data[1] = 0U;
        resp->data[2] = 0U;
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool lss_handle_inquire(const SYN_LSSSlave *slave, uint8_t cs, SYN_CAN_Frame *resp)
{
    switch (cs) {
    case SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_VENDOR:
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_VENDOR;
        syn_poke_u32_le(slave->addr.vendor_id, resp->data, 1U);
        return true;

    case SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_PRODUCT:
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_PRODUCT;
        syn_poke_u32_le(slave->addr.product_code, resp->data, 1U);
        return true;

    case SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_REV:
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_REV;
        syn_poke_u32_le(slave->addr.revision_no, resp->data, 1U);
        return true;

    case SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_SERIAL:
        resp->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_INQUIRE_SERIAL;
        syn_poke_u32_le(slave->addr.serial_no, resp->data, 1U);
        return true;

    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool syn_lss_slave_process(SYN_LSSSlave *slave, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, SYN_CAN_Frame *resp)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(slave != NULL && frame != NULL && resp != NULL);

    /* LSS Requests must use COB-ID 0x7E5 and DLC 8 */
    if (frame->id != SYN_LSS_COB_ID_MASTER || frame->dlc < 8U) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t cs = frame->data[0];
    memset(resp, 0, sizeof(*resp));
    resp->id = SYN_LSS_COB_ID_SLAVE;
    resp->dlc = 8U;

    if (cs == SYN_LSS_CS_SWITCH_MODE_GLOBAL) {
        if (frame->data[1] <= SYN_LSS_MODE_CONFIGURATION) {
            slave->mode = frame->data[1];
        }
        return false; /* Global switch has no response */
    }

    if (slave->mode != SYN_LSS_MODE_CONFIGURATION) {
        return false;
    }

    if (lss_handle_config_cmd(slave, frame, resp)) {
        return true;
    }

    return lss_handle_inquire(slave, cs, resp);
}

void syn_lss_master_build_switch_mode(SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint8_t mode)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(frame != NULL);
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = SYN_LSS_COB_ID_MASTER;
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_SWITCH_MODE_GLOBAL;
    frame->data[1] = mode;
}

void syn_lss_master_build_config_node_id(SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint8_t new_node_id)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(frame != NULL);
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = SYN_LSS_COB_ID_MASTER;
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_NODE_ID;
    frame->data[1] = new_node_id;
}

void syn_lss_master_build_config_bit_timing(SYN_CAN_Frame *frame, uint8_t baud_table_idx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(frame != NULL);
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = SYN_LSS_COB_ID_MASTER;
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_CONFIGURE_BIT_TIMING;
    frame->data[1] = 0; /* Selector: 0 = Table, 1 = Bitrate */
    frame->data[2] = baud_table_idx;
}

void syn_lss_master_build_store_config(SYN_CAN_Frame *frame)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(frame != NULL);
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->id = SYN_LSS_COB_ID_MASTER;
    frame->dlc = 8;
    frame->data[0] = SYN_LSS_CS_STORE_CONFIG;
}
