#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_MQTTSN) || SYN_USE_MQTTSN

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../sched/syn_sched.h"
#include "syn_mqttsn.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Internal Framing Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static size_t mqttsn_encode_header(uint8_t *buf, size_t max_buf, uint8_t msg_type,
                                   size_t payload_len)
{
    if (payload_len < 254U) {
        size_t total_len = payload_len + 2U;
        if (max_buf < total_len) {
            return 0U;
        }
        buf[0] = (uint8_t)total_len;
        buf[1] = msg_type;
        return 2U;
    }

    if ((payload_len > 65531U) || (max_buf < (payload_len + 4U))) {
        return 0U;
    }
    size_t total_len = payload_len + 4U;
    buf[0] = 0x01U;
    buf[1] = (uint8_t)((total_len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    buf[2] = (uint8_t)(total_len & 0xFFU);
    buf[3] = msg_type;
    return 4U;
}

static bool mqttsn_decode_header(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, uint8_t *out_msg_type,
                                 size_t *out_payload_offset, size_t *out_payload_len)
{
    if (buf == NULL || len < 2U) {
        return false;
    }

    if (buf[0] != 0x01U) {
        size_t total_len = buf[0];
        if (total_len < 2U || total_len > len) {
            return false;
        }
        *out_msg_type = buf[1];
        *out_payload_offset = 2U;
        *out_payload_len = total_len - 2U;
        return true;
    }

    if (len < 4U) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t total_len = ((size_t)buf[1] << 8U) | buf[2];
    if (total_len < 4U || total_len > len) {
        return false;
    }
    *out_msg_type = buf[3];
    *out_payload_offset = 4U;
    *out_payload_len = total_len - 4U;
    return true;
}

static SYN_MQTTSN_TopicEntry *mqttsn_find_or_add_topic(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client,
                                                       const char *topic_name)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < client->topic_count; i++) {
        if (client->topics[i].active &&
            strncmp(client->topics[i].name, topic_name, SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_TOPIC_NAME) == 0) {
            return &client->topics[i];
        }
    }

    if (client->topic_count >= SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_REGISTRATIONS) {
        return NULL;
    }

    SYN_MQTTSN_TopicEntry *entry = &client->topics[client->topic_count++];
    (void)strncpy(entry->name, topic_name, sizeof(entry->name) - 1U);
    entry->name[sizeof(entry->name) - 1U] = '\0';
    entry->topic_id = 0U;
    entry->pending_msg_id = 0U;
    entry->active = true;
    return entry;
}

/* ── Public API Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_init(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const SYN_MQTTSN_Config *cfg)
{
    if (client == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->transport == NULL || cfg->rx_buf == NULL || cfg->tx_buf == NULL ||
        cfg->rx_buf_size < 128U || cfg->tx_buf_size < 128U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
    client->cfg = *cfg;
    if (client->cfg.duration_s == 0U) {
        client->cfg.duration_s = SYN_MQTTSN_DEFAULT_DURATION_S;
    }

    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
    client->next_msg_id = 1U;
    PT_INIT(&client->pt);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_searchgw(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint8_t radius)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t hdr_len = mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_SEARCHGW, 1U);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = radius;
    size_t total_len = hdr_len + 1U;

    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, total_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_SEARCHING_GW;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_connect(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const char *cid = (client->cfg.client_id != NULL) ? client->cfg.client_id : "SyntropicClient";
    size_t cid_len = strlen(cid);
    if (cid_len > SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_CLIENT_ID) {
        cid_len = SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_CLIENT_ID;
    }

    uint8_t flags = 0U;
    if (client->cfg.clean_session) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_CLEAN_SESSION;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 4U + cid_len;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_CONNECT, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = flags;
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = SYN_MQTTSN_PROTOCOL_ID;
    tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)((client->cfg.duration_s >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)(client->cfg.duration_s & 0xFFU);
    (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len + 4U], cid, cid_len);

    size_t total_len = hdr_len + payload_len;
    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, total_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_CONNECTING;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_register_topic(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const char *topic_name,
                                            uint16_t *out_msg_id)
{
    if (client == NULL || topic_name == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t name_len = strlen(topic_name);
    if (name_len == 0U || name_len >= SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_TOPIC_NAME) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_MQTTSN_TopicEntry *entry = mqttsn_find_or_add_topic(client, topic_name);
    if (entry == NULL) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint16_t msg_id = client->next_msg_id++;
    if (client->next_msg_id == 0U) {
        client->next_msg_id = 1U;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 4U + name_len;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_REGISTER, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = 0U; /* TopicId = 0 in request */
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = 0U;
    tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
    (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len + 4U], topic_name, name_len);

    size_t total_len = hdr_len + payload_len;
    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, total_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    entry->pending_msg_id = msg_id;
    if (out_msg_id != NULL) {
        *out_msg_id = msg_id;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool mqttsn_publish_args_valid(const SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, int8_t qos,
                                      const uint8_t *payload, size_t len)
{
    if ((client == NULL) || (client->cfg.transport == NULL)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((payload == NULL) && (len > 0U)) || (len > 65526U)) {
        return false;
    }
    return (qos >= -1) && (qos <= 1);
}

static bool mqttsn_topic_arg_valid(const char *topic_name)
{
    if (topic_name == NULL) {
        return true;
    }
    size_t len = strlen(topic_name);
    return (len > 0U) && (len < SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_TOPIC_NAME);
}

static SYN_Status mqttsn_publish_internal(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint16_t topic_id,
                                          uint8_t topic_type_flag, int8_t qos, bool retain,
                                          const uint8_t *payload, size_t len)
{
    if (!mqttsn_publish_args_valid(client, qos, payload, len)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t flags = topic_type_flag & SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_MASK;
    if (retain) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_RETAIN;
    }

    uint16_t msg_id = 0U;
    if (qos == 1) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_1;
        msg_id = client->next_msg_id++;
        if (client->next_msg_id == 0U) {
            client->next_msg_id = 1U;
        }
    } else if (qos == -1) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_NEG1;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 5U + len;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PUBLISH, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = flags;
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((topic_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)(topic_id & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 4U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
    if (len > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len + 5U], payload, len);
    }

    size_t total_len = hdr_len + payload_len;
    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, total_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_publish(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint16_t topic_id, int8_t qos,
                                     bool retain, const uint8_t *payload, size_t len)
{
    return mqttsn_publish_internal(client, topic_id, SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_NORMAL, qos, retain,
                                   payload, len);
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_publish_short(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const char short_topic[2],
                                           int8_t qos, bool retain, const uint8_t *payload,
                                           size_t len)
{
    if (short_topic == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    uint16_t topic_id = ((uint16_t)(uint8_t)short_topic[0] << 8U) | (uint8_t)short_topic[1];
    return mqttsn_publish_internal(client, topic_id, SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_SHORT, qos, retain,
                                   payload, len);
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_publish_predefined(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint16_t predef_id,
                                                int8_t qos, bool retain, const uint8_t *payload,
                                                size_t len)
{
    return mqttsn_publish_internal(client, predef_id, SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_PREDEF, qos, retain,
                                   payload, len);
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_subscribe(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const char *topic_name,
                                       uint16_t predef_id, int8_t qos)
{
    if ((client == NULL) || (client->cfg.transport == NULL) ||
        !mqttsn_topic_arg_valid(topic_name)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t flags = 0U;
    if (qos == 1) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_1;
    } else if (qos == -1) {
        flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_NEG1;
    }

    uint16_t msg_id = client->next_msg_id++;
    if (client->next_msg_id == 0U) {
        client->next_msg_id = 1U;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 0U;

    if (topic_name != NULL) {
        size_t name_len = strlen(topic_name);
        if (name_len == 2U) {
            flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_SHORT;
            payload_len = 5U;
        } else {
            flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_NORMAL;
            payload_len = 3U + name_len;
        }

        size_t hdr_len = mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_SUBSCRIBE,
                                              payload_len);
        if (hdr_len == 0U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx[hdr_len] = flags;
        tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
        tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
        (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len + 3U], topic_name, name_len);

        return syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + payload_len) ? SYN_OK
                                                                                    : SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Subscribing by Predefined ID */
    flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_PREDEF;
    payload_len = 5U;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_SUBSCRIBE, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = flags;
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)((predef_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 4U] = (uint8_t)(predef_id & 0xFFU);

    return syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + payload_len) ? SYN_OK
                                                                                : SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_unsubscribe(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const char *topic_name,
                                         uint16_t predef_id)
{
    if ((client == NULL) || (client->cfg.transport == NULL) ||
        !mqttsn_topic_arg_valid(topic_name)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t flags = 0U;
    uint16_t msg_id = client->next_msg_id++;
    if (client->next_msg_id == 0U) {
        client->next_msg_id = 1U;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 0U;

    if (topic_name != NULL) {
        size_t name_len = strlen(topic_name);
        if (name_len == 2U) {
            flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_SHORT;
            payload_len = 5U;
        } else {
            flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_NORMAL;
            payload_len = 3U + name_len;
        }

        size_t hdr_len = mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size,
                                              SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_UNSUBSCRIBE, payload_len);
        if (hdr_len == 0U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx[hdr_len] = flags;
        tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
        tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
        (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len + 3U], topic_name, name_len);

        return syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + payload_len) ? SYN_OK
                                                                                    : SYN_ERROR;
    }

    flags |= SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_PREDEF;
    payload_len = 5U;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_UNSUBSCRIBE, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = flags;
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)((predef_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 4U] = (uint8_t)(predef_id & 0xFFU);

    return syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + payload_len) ? SYN_OK
                                                                                : SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_sleep(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint16_t sleep_duration_s)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t payload_len = 2U;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_DISCONNECT, payload_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    tx[hdr_len] = (uint8_t)((sleep_duration_s >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)(sleep_duration_s & 0xFFU);

    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + payload_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_ASLEEP;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_wake(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    const char *cid = (client->cfg.client_id != NULL) ? client->cfg.client_id : "SyntropicClient";
    size_t cid_len = strlen(cid);
    if (cid_len > SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_CLIENT_ID) {
        cid_len = SYN_MQTTSN_MAX_CLIENT_ID;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PINGREQ, cid_len);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (cid_len > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(&tx[hdr_len], cid, cid_len);
    }

    if (!syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + cid_len)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_AWAKE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_disconnect(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
    size_t hdr_len =
        mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_DISCONNECT, 0U);
    if (hdr_len == 0U) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    (void)syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len);
    client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void mqttsn_handle_regack(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const uint8_t *payload,
                                 size_t payload_len)
{
    if (payload_len >= 5U && payload[4] == SYN_MQTTSN_RC_ACCEPTED) {
        uint16_t topic_id = ((uint16_t)payload[0] << 8U) | payload[1];
        uint16_t msg_id = ((uint16_t)payload[2] << 8U) | payload[3];
        if (msg_id != 0U) {
            for (size_t i = 0U; i < client->topic_count; i++) {
                if (client->topics[i].active && client->topics[i].pending_msg_id == msg_id) {
                    client->topics[i].topic_id = topic_id;
                    client->topics[i].pending_msg_id = 0U;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

static void mqttsn_handle_connack(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const uint8_t *payload,
                                  size_t payload_len)
{
    if (payload_len >= 1U) {
        if (payload[0] == SYN_MQTTSN_RC_ACCEPTED) {
            client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_CONNECTED;
        } else if (client->state == SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_CONNECTING) {
            client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
        }
    }
}

static void mqttsn_handle_rx_publish(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, const uint8_t *payload,
                                     size_t payload_len)
{
    if (payload_len < 5U) {
        return;
    }
    uint8_t flags = payload[0];
    uint8_t topic_type = flags & SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_TOPIC_MASK;
    uint16_t topic_id = ((uint16_t)payload[1] << 8U) | payload[2];
    uint16_t msg_id = ((uint16_t)payload[3] << 8U) | payload[4];

    if (client->cfg.on_message != NULL) {
        client->cfg.on_message(client, topic_id, topic_type, &payload[5], payload_len - 5U,
                               client->cfg.user_data);
    }

    if ((flags & SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_MASK) == SYN_MQTTSN_FLAG_QOS_1) {
        uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
        size_t hdr_len =
            mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PUBACK, 5U);
        if (hdr_len > 0U) {
            tx[hdr_len] = (uint8_t)((topic_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
            tx[hdr_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)(topic_id & 0xFFU);
            tx[hdr_len + 2U] = (uint8_t)((msg_id >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
            tx[hdr_len + 3U] = (uint8_t)(msg_id & 0xFFU);
            tx[hdr_len + 4U] = SYN_MQTTSN_RC_ACCEPTED;
            (void)syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len + 5U);
        }
    }
}

static void mqttsn_process_rx_frame(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint8_t msg_type,
                                    const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len)
{
    switch (msg_type) {
    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_ADVERTISE:
    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_GWINFO:
        if (payload_len >= 1U) {
            client->gateway_id = payload[0];
            if (client->state == SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_SEARCHING_GW) {
                (void)syn_mqttsn_client_connect(client);
            }
        }
        break;

    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_CONNACK:
        mqttsn_handle_connack(client, payload, payload_len);
        break;

    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_REGACK:
        mqttsn_handle_regack(client, payload, payload_len);
        break;

    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PUBLISH:
        mqttsn_handle_rx_publish(client, payload, payload_len);
        break;

    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PINGRESP:
        if (client->state == SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_AWAKE) {
            client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_ASLEEP;
        }
        break;

    case SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_DISCONNECT:
        client->state = SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
        break;

    default:
        break;
    }
}

static SYN_Status mqttsn_client_step_ex(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint32_t now_ms,
                                        bool *out_rx_consumed)
{
    if (out_rx_consumed != NULL) {
        *out_rx_consumed = false;
    }
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (syn_transport_recv(client->cfg.transport, client->cfg.rx_buf, client->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                           &rx_len) &&
        rx_len > 0U) {
        if (out_rx_consumed != NULL) {
            *out_rx_consumed = true;
        }
        client->last_activity_ms = now_ms;
        uint8_t msg_type = 0U;
        size_t payload_offset = 0U;
        size_t payload_len = 0U;

        if (mqttsn_decode_header(client->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len, &msg_type, &payload_offset,
                                 &payload_len)) {
            mqttsn_process_rx_frame(client, msg_type, &client->cfg.rx_buf[payload_offset],
                                    payload_len);
        }
    }

    /* Keep-alive ping */
    if (client->state == SYN_MQTTSN_STATE_CONNECTED) {
        uint32_t period_ms = (uint32_t)client->cfg.duration_s * 1000U;
        if (period_ms > 0U && (now_ms - client->last_activity_ms >= period_ms)) {
            client->last_activity_ms = now_ms;
            uint8_t *tx = client->cfg.tx_buf;
            size_t hdr_len =
                mqttsn_encode_header(tx, client->cfg.tx_buf_size, SYN_MQTTSN_MSG_PINGREQ, 0U);
            if (hdr_len > 0U) {
                (void)syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, tx, hdr_len);
            }
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mqttsn_client_step(SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client, uint32_t now_ms)
{
    return mqttsn_client_step_ex(client, now_ms, NULL);
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_mqttsn_client_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }
    SYN_MQTTSN_Client *client = (SYN_MQTTSN_Client *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        bool rx_consumed = false;
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (mqttsn_client_step_ex(client, now, &rx_consumed) != SYN_OK) {
            break;
        }
        if (rx_consumed && client->cfg.transport != NULL &&
            client->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL &&
            syn_transport_has_data(client->cfg.transport)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
        } else {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

#endif /* !defined(SYN_USE_MQTTSN) || SYN_USE_MQTTSN */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic MQTT-SN v1.2 client for low-power wireless networks: * Operates over datagram transports (UDP, Zigbee, 802.15.4, Sub-GHz, BLE, RS485). * Gateway Discovery (SEARCHGW, GWINFO, ADVERTISE). * Short (2-char), Predefined, and Dynamically Registered Topic IDs (REGISTER, REGACK). * Publish and Subscribe (QoS 0, QoS 1, QoS -1) with payload framing. * Low-power Sleep/Awake mode transitions (SLEEP, AWAKE queue flush). * Non-blocking poll step and cooperative protothread continuation for Scheduling.

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_msp.h"

#include <string.h>

enum {
    STATE_HEADER_START = 0,
    STATE_HEADER_M,
    STATE_HEADER_DIR,
    STATE_SIZE,
    STATE_CMD,
    STATE_PAYLOAD,
    STATE_CHECKSUM
};

SYN_Status syn_msp_init(SYN_MSP_Parser *parser)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool msp_is_dir_char(uint8_t byte)
{
    return (byte == SYN_MSP_REQ_CHAR) || (byte == SYN_MSP_RESP_CHAR) || (byte == SYN_MSP_ERR_CHAR);
}

static bool msp_parse_header(SYN_MSP_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte)
{
    if (parser->state == STATE_HEADER_START) {
        if (byte == SYN_MSP_HEADER_CHAR) {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_M;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (parser->state == STATE_HEADER_M) {
        if (byte == SYN_MSP_V1_CHAR) {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_DIR;
        } else if (byte != SYN_MSP_HEADER_CHAR) {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_START;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (parser->state == STATE_HEADER_DIR) {
        if (msp_is_dir_char(byte)) {
            parser->dir_char = byte;
            parser->state = STATE_SIZE;
        } else if (byte == SYN_MSP_HEADER_CHAR) {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_M;
        } else {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_START;
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

static SYN_Status msp_finish_checksum(SYN_MSP_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte, SYN_MSP_Frame *frame)
{
    parser->state = STATE_HEADER_START;
    if (parser->checksum != byte) {
        parser->checksum_errors++;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    parser->frames_received++;
    parser->last_frame.dir_char = parser->dir_char;
    parser->last_frame.cmd = parser->cmd;
    parser->last_frame.payload_len = parser->payload_len;
    if (parser->payload_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(parser->last_frame.payload, parser->payload, parser->payload_len);
    }
    if (frame) {
        *frame = parser->last_frame;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_msp_parse_byte(SYN_MSP_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte, SYN_MSP_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (msp_parse_header(parser, byte)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    switch (parser->state) {
    case STATE_SIZE:
        parser->payload_len = byte;
        parser->checksum = byte;
        parser->payload_idx = 0;
        parser->state = STATE_CMD;
        return SYN_BUSY;

    case STATE_CMD:
        parser->cmd = byte;
        parser->checksum ^= byte;
        if (parser->payload_len == 0) {
            parser->state = STATE_CHECKSUM;
        } else if (parser->payload_len > SYN_MSP_MAX_PAYLOAD) {
            parser->state = STATE_HEADER_START;
            return SYN_ERROR;
        } else {
            parser->state = STATE_PAYLOAD;
        }
        return SYN_BUSY;

    case STATE_PAYLOAD:
        if (parser->payload_idx < SYN_MSP_MAX_PAYLOAD) {
            parser->payload[parser->payload_idx++] = byte;
        }
        parser->checksum ^= byte;
        if (parser->payload_idx >= parser->payload_len) {
            parser->state = STATE_CHECKSUM;
        }
        return SYN_BUSY;

    case STATE_CHECKSUM:
        return msp_finish_checksum(parser, byte, frame);

    default:
        parser->state = STATE_HEADER_START;
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_msp_encode_response(uint8_t cmd, const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t len,
                                   uint8_t *buf_out, size_t buf_size, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (!buf_out || !out_len) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Minimum required: 5 header bytes + len payload bytes + 1 checksum */
    size_t required = (size_t)5 + len + 1;
    if (buf_size < required) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if ((payload == NULL) && (len > 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t idx = 0;
    buf_out[idx++] = SYN_MSP_HEADER_CHAR;
    buf_out[idx++] = SYN_MSP_V1_CHAR;
    buf_out[idx++] = SYN_MSP_RESP_CHAR;
    buf_out[idx++] = len;
    buf_out[idx++] = cmd;

    uint8_t checksum = len ^ cmd;

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        buf_out[idx++] = payload[i];
        checksum ^= payload[i];
    }

    buf_out[idx++] = checksum;
    *out_len = idx;

    return SYN_OK;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: MSP Specifications: * Frame Format: $ M + [Direction] + [Size] + [Command] + [Payload...] + [Checksum] * Direction: < (Inbound Request), > (Outbound Response), ! (Error Response). * Checksum: XOR sum over Size ^ Command ^ Payload[0] ^ ... ^ Payload[N-1]. * Common Commands: * 101: MSP_STATUS (Cycle time, I2C errors, sensors active, flight mode flags). * 102: MSP_RAW_IMU (Gyro X/Y/Z, Accel X/Y/Z, Mag X/Y/Z). * 108: MSP_ATTITUDE (Roll 10x deg, Pitch 10x deg, Yaw deg). * 109: MSP_ALTITUDE (Estimated altitude in cm & variometer rate). * 130: MSP_BATTERY_STATE (Cell count, capacity mAh, voltage 0.1V, current 0.01A).

SYN_Status syn_n2k_encode_dc_detailed_fastpacket(uint8_t sa, uint8_t seq_id,
                                                 const SYN_N2K_DcDetailedStatus *dc,
                                                 SYN_CAN_Frame frames_out[2])
{
    if (dc == NULL || frames_out == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t raw[11];
    size_t pos_idx = 0U;
    syn_pack_u8(raw, &pos_idx, dc->sid);
    syn_pack_u8(raw, &pos_idx, dc->instance);
    syn_pack_u8(raw, &pos_idx, dc->dc_type);
    syn_pack_u8(raw, &pos_idx, dc->state_of_charge);
    syn_pack_u8(raw, &pos_idx, dc->state_of_health);
    syn_pack_u16_le(raw, &pos_idx, dc->time_to_go_min);
    syn_pack_u16_le(raw, &pos_idx, dc->ripple_voltage);
    syn_pack_u16_le(raw, &pos_idx, dc->capacity_ah_1e1);

    uint32_t can_id =
        syn_j1939_id_pack(6U, SYN_N2K_PGN_DC_DETAILED_STATUS, sa, SYN_J1939_ADDR_GLOBAL);
    uint8_t seq_bits = (uint8_t)((seq_id & 0x07U) << 5U);

    memset(&frames_out[0], 0, sizeof(SYN_CAN_Frame));
    frames_out[0].id = can_id;
    frames_out[0].dlc = 8U;
    frames_out[0].extended = true;
    frames_out[0].data[0] = (uint8_t)(seq_bits | 0U);
    frames_out[0].data[1] = 11U;
    memcpy(&frames_out[0].data[2], &raw[0], 6U);

    memset(&frames_out[1], 0, sizeof(SYN_CAN_Frame));
    frames_out[1].id = can_id;
    frames_out[1].dlc = 8U;
    frames_out[1].extended = true;
    frames_out[1].data[0] = (uint8_t)(seq_bits | 1U);
    memcpy(&frames_out[1].data[1], &raw[6], 5U);
    frames_out[1].data[6] = 0xFFU;
    frames_out[1].data[7] = 0xFFU;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status n2k_fp_first_frame(SYN_N2K_FastPacketRx *rx, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                     uint8_t sa, uint32_t target_pgn, uint8_t seq_id,
                                     const uint8_t **out_payload, size_t *out_len)
{
    uint8_t total_bytes = frame->data[1];
    if (total_bytes > sizeof(rx->data)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    rx->active = true;
    rx->seq_id = seq_id;
    rx->expected_frame = 1U;
    rx->sa = sa;
    rx->pgn = target_pgn;
    rx->total_bytes = total_bytes;
    rx->received_bytes = 0U;

    size_t copy_len = (total_bytes > 6U) ? 6U : total_bytes;
    memcpy(&rx->data[0], &frame->data[2], copy_len);
    rx->received_bytes = (uint8_t)copy_len;

    if (rx->received_bytes >= rx->total_bytes) {
        *out_payload = rx->data;
        *out_len = rx->total_bytes;
        rx->active = false;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    return SYN_BUSY;
}

static SYN_Status n2k_fp_cont_frame(SYN_N2K_FastPacketRx *rx, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                    uint8_t sa, uint32_t pgn, uint8_t seq_id, uint8_t frame_idx,
                                    const uint8_t **out_payload, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (!rx->active || (rx->pgn != pgn) || (rx->seq_id != seq_id) ||
        (frame_idx != rx->expected_frame) || (sa != rx->sa)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    size_t offset = 6U + ((size_t)(frame_idx - 1U) * 7U);
    if (offset < rx->total_bytes) {
        size_t remaining = rx->total_bytes - offset;
        size_t copy_len = (remaining > 7U) ? 7U : remaining;
        memcpy(&rx->data[offset], &frame->data[1], copy_len);
        rx->received_bytes = (uint8_t)(offset + copy_len);
        rx->expected_frame++;

        if (rx->received_bytes >= rx->total_bytes) {
            *out_payload = rx->data;
            *out_len = rx->total_bytes;
            rx->active = false;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }
    return SYN_BUSY;
}

SYN_Status syn_n2k_fastpacket_process(SYN_N2K_FastPacketRx *rx, const SYN_CAN_Frame *frame,
                                      uint32_t target_pgn, const uint8_t **out_payload,
                                      size_t *out_len)
{
    if (!rx || !frame || !out_payload || !out_len || !frame->extended || frame->dlc < 8) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_J1939_Header hdr;
    (void)syn_j1939_id_unpack(frame->id, &hdr);
    if (hdr.pgn != target_pgn) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t seq_frame = frame->data[0];
    uint8_t seq_id = (seq_frame >> 5) & 0x07U;
    uint8_t frame_idx = seq_frame & 0x1FU;

    if (frame_idx == 0U) {
        return n2k_fp_first_frame(rx, frame, hdr.sa, target_pgn, seq_id, out_payload, out_len);
    }
    return n2k_fp_cont_frame(rx, frame, hdr.sa, hdr.pgn, seq_id, frame_idx, out_payload, out_len);
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_NMEA) || SYN_USE_NMEA


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_nmea.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline bool nmea_is_digit(char c)
{
    return (c >= '0') && (c <= '9');
}

static bool nmea_digits_span_valid(const char *s, size_t len)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        if (!nmea_is_digit(s[i])) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return len > 0U;
}

static bool nmea_parse_u32_bounded(const char *s, uint32_t min_val, uint32_t max_val, uint32_t *out)
{
    if (!nmea_digits_span_valid(s, strlen(s))) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t val = 0U;
    for (const char *p = s; *p != '\0'; p++) {
        val = (val * 10U) + (uint32_t)(*p - '0');
        if (val > max_val) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (val < min_val) {
        return false;
    }

    *out = val;
    return true;
}

static double syn_atof(const char *s)
{
    double res = 0.0;
    double sign = 1.0;
    if (*s == '-') {
        sign = -1.0;
        s++;
    } else if (*s == '+') {
        s++;
    }
    while ((*s >= '0') && (*s <= '9')) {
        res = (res * 10.0) + (double)(*s - '0');
        s++;
    }
    if (*s == '.') {
        s++;
        double frac = 0.1;
        while ((*s >= '0') && (*s <= '9')) {
            res += (double)(*s - '0') * frac;
            frac *= 0.1;
            s++;
        }
    }
    return res * sign;
}

static inline bool is_nmea_end(char c)
{
    return (c == '\0') || (c == '*') || (c == '\r') || (c == '\n');
}

static bool get_field(const char *sentence, uint8_t index, char *dest, size_t max_len)
{
    dest[0] = '\0';

    const char *p = sentence;
    if (*p == '$') {
        p++;
    }

    uint8_t current_field = 0U;
    while (!is_nmea_end(*p)) {
        if (*p == ',') {
            current_field++;
            p++;
            if (current_field > index) {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (current_field == index) {
            size_t len = 0U;
            while (!is_nmea_end(*p) && (*p != ',') && ((len + 1U) < max_len)) {
                dest[len++] = *p++;
            }
            dest[len] = '\0';
            return len > 0U;
        }

        p++;
    }

    return false;
}

static bool hex_nibble(char c, uint8_t *out)
{
    if ((c >= '0') && (c <= '9')) {
        *out = (uint8_t)(c - '0');
        return true;
    }
    if ((c >= 'A') && (c <= 'F')) {
        *out = (uint8_t)(10 + (c - 'A'));
        return true;
    }
    if ((c >= 'a') && (c <= 'f')) {
        *out = (uint8_t)(10 + (c - 'a'));
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void syn_nmea_parser_init(SYN_NMEA_Parser *parser)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(parser != NULL);
    parser->pos = 0U;
    parser->in_sentence = false;
    parser->buf[0] = '\0';
}

bool syn_nmea_parser_feed(SYN_NMEA_Parser *parser, char byte, char *out_sentence)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(parser != NULL);

    if (byte == '$') {
        parser->pos = 0U;
        parser->buf[parser->pos++] = '$';
        parser->in_sentence = true;
        return false;
    }

    if (!parser->in_sentence) {
        return false;
    }

    if ((byte == '\n') || (byte == '\r')) {
        if (parser->pos > 6U) {
            parser->buf[parser->pos] = '\0';
            if (syn_nmea_validate(parser->buf)) {
                if (out_sentence != NULL) {
                    size_t len = strlen(parser->buf);
                    memcpy(out_sentence, parser->buf, len + 1U);
                }
                parser->in_sentence = false;
                parser->pos = 0U;
                return true;
            }
        }
        parser->in_sentence = false;
        parser->pos = 0U;
        return false;
    }

    if (parser->pos < SYN_NMEA_MAX_SENTENCE_LEN) {
        parser->buf[parser->pos++] = byte;
    } else {
        parser->in_sentence = false;
        parser->pos = 0U;
    }

    return false;
}

uint8_t syn_nmea_checksum(const char *sentence)
{
    if (sentence == NULL) {
        return 0U;
    }
    const char *p = sentence;
    if (*p == '$') {
        p++;
    }

    uint8_t checksum = 0U;
    while (!is_nmea_end(*p)) {
        checksum ^= (uint8_t)(*p++);
    }

    return checksum;
}

static const char *nmea_find_valid_star(const char *sentence)
{
    const char *star = strchr(sentence + 1, '*');
    if (star == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }

    for (const char *p = sentence + 1; p < star; p++) {
        if ((*p == '\r') || (*p == '\n') || (*p == '$')) {
            return NULL;
        }
    }

    return star;
}

bool syn_nmea_validate(const char *sentence)
{
    if ((sentence == NULL) || (sentence[0] != '$')) {
        return false;
    }

    const char *star = nmea_find_valid_star(sentence);
    if (star == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    uint8_t hi = 0U;
    uint8_t lo = 0U;
    if (!hex_nibble(star[1], &hi) || !hex_nibble(star[2], &lo)) {
        return false;
    }

    for (const char *tail = star + 3; *tail != '\0'; tail++) {
        if ((*tail != '\r') && (*tail != '\n')) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    uint8_t expected_crc = (uint8_t)((hi << 4U) | lo);
    uint8_t calc_crc = syn_nmea_checksum(sentence);

    return expected_crc == calc_crc;
}

SYN_NMEA_SentenceType syn_nmea_get_type(const char *sentence)
{
    if (!syn_nmea_validate(sentence)) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_UNKNOWN;
    }

    char talker[10];
    if (!get_field(sentence, 0U, talker, sizeof(talker))) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_UNKNOWN;
    }

    size_t len = strlen(talker);
    if (len < 3U) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_UNKNOWN;
    }
    const char *type_str = &talker[len - 3U];

    if (strcmp(type_str, "GGA") == 0) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_GGA;
    }
    if (strcmp(type_str, "RMC") == 0) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_RMC;
    }
    if (strcmp(type_str, "VTG") == 0) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_VTG;
    }
    if (strcmp(type_str, "GSA") == 0) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_GSA;
    }
    if (strcmp(type_str, "ZDA") == 0) {
        return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_ZDA;
    }

    return SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_UNKNOWN;
}

static bool nmea_parse_coord_parts(const char *nmea_coord, int32_t *out_deg, int32_t *out_min_whole,
                                   const char **out_frac)
{
    if (nmea_coord == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    const char *s = nmea_coord;
    if (*s == '+') {
        s++;
    }

    const char *dot = strchr(s, '.');
    if (dot == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    ptrdiff_t pre_len = dot - s;
    if ((pre_len < 3) || (pre_len > 5)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!nmea_digits_span_valid(s, (size_t)pre_len) ||
        !nmea_digits_span_valid(dot + 1, strlen(dot + 1))) {
        return false;
    }

    ptrdiff_t deg_digits = pre_len - 2;
    int32_t deg = 0;
    for (ptrdiff_t i = 0; i < deg_digits; i++) {
        deg = (deg * 10) + (int32_t)(s[i] - '0');
    }

    int32_t min_whole = ((int32_t)(s[deg_digits] - '0') * 10) + (int32_t)(s[deg_digits + 1] - '0');
    if ((min_whole >= 60) || (deg > 180)) {
        return false;
    }

    *out_deg = deg;
    *out_min_whole = min_whole;
    *out_frac = dot + 1;
    return true;
}

double syn_nmea_parse_coord(const char *nmea_coord, char dir)
{
    int32_t deg = 0;
    int32_t min_whole = 0;
    const char *frac_str = NULL;
    if (!nmea_parse_coord_parts(nmea_coord, &deg, &min_whole, &frac_str)) {
        return 0.0;
    }

    double frac = 0.0;
    double scale = 0.1;
    for (const char *p = frac_str; *p != '\0'; p++) {
        frac += (double)(*p - '0') * scale;
        scale *= 0.1;
    }

    double decimal = (double)deg + (((double)min_whole + frac) / 60.0);
    if (decimal > 180.0) {
        return 0.0;
    }

    if ((dir == 'S') || (dir == 'W')) {
        decimal = -decimal;
    }

    return decimal;
}

#if SYN_NMEA_USE_FIXED_POINT
int32_t syn_nmea_parse_coord_udeg(const char *nmea_coord, char dir)
{
    int32_t deg = 0;
    int32_t min_int = 0;
    const char *p = NULL;
    if (!nmea_parse_coord_parts(nmea_coord, &deg, &min_int, &p)) {
        return 0;
    }

    int64_t min_frac = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (*p != '\0') {
            min_frac = (min_frac * 10LL) + (int64_t)(*p - '0');
            p++;
        } else {
            min_frac = min_frac * 10LL;
        }
    }

    int64_t total_min_scaled = ((int64_t)min_int * 10000LL) + min_frac;
    int64_t min_udeg = (total_min_scaled * 10000000LL) / (60LL * 10000LL);
    int64_t udeg64 = ((int64_t)deg * 10000000LL) + min_udeg;
    if (udeg64 > 1800000000LL) {
        return 0;
    }

    if ((dir == 'S') || (dir == 'W')) {
        udeg64 = -udeg64;
    }
    return (int32_t)udeg64;
}
#endif

static void parse_time(const char *field, uint8_t *h, uint8_t *m, uint8_t *s, uint16_t *ms)
{
    *h = 0U;
    *m = 0U;
    *s = 0U;
    *ms = 0U;

    size_t len = strlen(field);
    if ((len < 6U) || !nmea_digits_span_valid(field, 6U)) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t hh = (uint8_t)(((field[0] - '0') * 10) + (field[1] - '0'));
    uint8_t mm = (uint8_t)(((field[2] - '0') * 10) + (field[3] - '0'));
    uint8_t ss = (uint8_t)(((field[4] - '0') * 10) + (field[5] - '0'));
    if ((hh >= 24U) || (mm >= 60U) || (ss > 60U)) {
        return;
    }

    uint16_t msec = 0U;
    if (field[6] != '\0') {
        if ((field[6] != '.') || !nmea_digits_span_valid(&field[7], len - 7U)) {
            return;
        }
        uint16_t scale = 100U;
        for (size_t i = 7U; (i < len) && (scale > 0U); i++) {
            msec = (uint16_t)(msec + ((uint16_t)(field[i] - '0') * scale));
            scale /= 10U;
        }
    }

    *h = hh;
    *m = mm;
    *s = ss;
    *ms = msec;
}

static void parse_rmc_date(const char *f, SYN_NMEA_RMC *rmc)
{
    if ((strlen(f) != 6U) || !nmea_digits_span_valid(f, 6U)) {
        return;
    }

    uint8_t dd = (uint8_t)(((f[0] - '0') * 10) + (f[1] - '0'));
    uint8_t mm = (uint8_t)(((f[2] - '0') * 10) + (f[3] - '0'));
    uint16_t yr = (uint16_t)(((f[4] - '0') * 10) + (f[5] - '0'));
    if ((dd < 1U) || (dd > 31U) || (mm < 1U) || (mm > 12U)) {
        return;
    }

    rmc->day = dd;
    rmc->month = mm;
    rmc->year = (yr >= 70U) ? (uint16_t)(1900U + yr) : (uint16_t)(2000U + yr);
}

static void nmea_gga_parse_metrics(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_GGA *gga)
{
    char f[16] = {0};
    uint32_t val = 0U;

    if (get_field(sentence, 6U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 0U, 8U, &val)) {
        gga->fix_quality = (SYN_NMEA_FixQuality)val;
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 7U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 0U, 255U, &val)) {
        gga->num_satellites = (uint8_t)val;
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 8U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gga->hdop = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 9U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gga->altitude_m = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
}

bool syn_nmea_parse_gga(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_GGA *gga)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(gga != NULL);
    memset(gga, 0, sizeof(SYN_NMEA_GGA));

    if (syn_nmea_get_type(sentence) != SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_GGA) {
        return false;
    }

    char f[16] = {0};
    if (get_field(sentence, 1U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        parse_time(f, &gga->hours, &gga->minutes, &gga->seconds, &gga->milliseconds);
    }

    char lat_str[16] = {0}, lat_dir[4] = {0}, lon_str[16] = {0}, lon_dir[4] = {0};
    bool has_lat = get_field(sentence, 2U, lat_str, sizeof(lat_str)) &&
                   get_field(sentence, 3U, lat_dir, sizeof(lat_dir));
    bool has_lon = get_field(sentence, 4U, lon_str, sizeof(lon_str)) &&
                   get_field(sentence, 5U, lon_dir, sizeof(lon_dir));

#if SYN_NMEA_USE_FIXED_POINT
    if (has_lat) {
        gga->lat_udeg = syn_nmea_parse_coord_udeg(lat_str, lat_dir[0]);
    }
    if (has_lon) {
        gga->lon_udeg = syn_nmea_parse_coord_udeg(lon_str, lon_dir[0]);
    }
#else
    if (has_lat) {
        gga->latitude = syn_nmea_parse_coord(lat_str, lat_dir[0]);
    }
    if (has_lon) {
        gga->longitude = syn_nmea_parse_coord(lon_str, lon_dir[0]);
    }
#endif

    nmea_gga_parse_metrics(sentence, gga);

    gga->valid = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_nmea_parse_rmc(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_RMC *rmc)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(rmc != NULL);
    memset(rmc, 0, sizeof(SYN_NMEA_RMC));

    if (syn_nmea_get_type(sentence) != SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_RMC) {
        return false;
    }

    char f[16] = {0};
    if (get_field(sentence, 1U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        parse_time(f, &rmc->hours, &rmc->minutes, &rmc->seconds, &rmc->milliseconds);
    }

    if (get_field(sentence, 2U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        rmc->status_valid = (f[0] == 'A');
    }

    char lat_str[16] = {0}, lat_dir[4] = {0}, lon_str[16] = {0}, lon_dir[4] = {0};
    bool has_lat = get_field(sentence, 3U, lat_str, sizeof(lat_str)) &&
                   get_field(sentence, 4U, lat_dir, sizeof(lat_dir));
    bool has_lon = get_field(sentence, 5U, lon_str, sizeof(lon_str)) &&
                   get_field(sentence, 6U, lon_dir, sizeof(lon_dir));

#if SYN_NMEA_USE_FIXED_POINT
    if (has_lat) {
        rmc->lat_udeg = syn_nmea_parse_coord_udeg(lat_str, lat_dir[0]);
    }
    if (has_lon) {
        rmc->lon_udeg = syn_nmea_parse_coord_udeg(lon_str, lon_dir[0]);
    }
#else
    if (has_lat) {
        rmc->latitude = syn_nmea_parse_coord(lat_str, lat_dir[0]);
    }
    if (has_lon) {
        rmc->longitude = syn_nmea_parse_coord(lon_str, lon_dir[0]);
    }
#endif

    if (get_field(sentence, 7U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        rmc->speed_knots = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 8U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        rmc->course_deg = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 9U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        parse_rmc_date(f, rmc);
    }

    rmc->valid = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_nmea_parse_vtg(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_VTG *vtg)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(vtg != NULL);
    memset(vtg, 0, sizeof(SYN_NMEA_VTG));

    if (syn_nmea_get_type(sentence) != SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_VTG) {
        return false;
    }

    char f[16] = {0};
    if (get_field(sentence, 1U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        vtg->course_true_deg = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 5U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        vtg->speed_knots = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 7U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        vtg->speed_kph = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }

    vtg->valid = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_nmea_parse_gsa(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_GSA *gsa)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(gsa != NULL);
    memset(gsa, 0, sizeof(SYN_NMEA_GSA));

    if (syn_nmea_get_type(sentence) != SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_GSA) {
        return false;
    }

    char f[16] = {0};
    uint32_t val = 0U;
    if (get_field(sentence, 1U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gsa->mode = f[0];
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 2U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 1U, 3U, &val)) {
        gsa->fix_type = (uint8_t)val;
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 15U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gsa->pdop = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 16U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gsa->hdop = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 17U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        gsa->vdop = (float)syn_atof(f);
    }

    gsa->valid = true;
    return true;
}

bool syn_nmea_parse_zda(const char *sentence, SYN_NMEA_ZDA *zda)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(zda != NULL);
    memset(zda, 0, sizeof(SYN_NMEA_ZDA));

    if (syn_nmea_get_type(sentence) != SYN_NMEA_SENTENCE_ZDA) {
        return false;
    }

    char f[16] = {0};
    uint32_t val = 0U;
    if (get_field(sentence, 1U, f, sizeof(f))) {
        parse_time(f, &zda->hours, &zda->minutes, &zda->seconds, &zda->milliseconds);
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 2U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 1U, 31U, &val)) {
        zda->day = (uint8_t)val;
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 3U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 1U, 12U, &val)) {
        zda->month = (uint8_t)val;
    }
    if (get_field(sentence, 4U, f, sizeof(f)) && nmea_parse_u32_bounded(f, 1900U, 9999U, &val)) {
        zda->year = (uint16_t)val;
    }

    zda->valid = true;
    return true;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_NMEA */

static const char *ocpp_find_sub(const char *hay, size_t hay_len, const char *needle)
{
    size_t nlen = strlen(needle);
    if (hay_len < nlen) {
        return NULL;
    }
    size_t limit = hay_len - nlen;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i <= limit; i++) {
        if (memcmp(&hay[i], needle, nlen) == 0) {
            return &hay[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static bool ocpp_extract_msg_id(const char *buf, size_t len, char *out_id, size_t out_cap)
{
    out_id[0] = '\0';
    size_t pos = 0U;
    while (pos < len && buf[pos] != '"') {
        pos++;
    }
    if (pos >= len) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t start = pos + 1U;
    pos = start;
    while (pos < len && buf[pos] != '"') {
        pos++;
    }
    size_t id_len = pos - start;
    if (pos >= len || id_len == 0U || id_len >= out_cap) {
        return false;
    }
    memcpy(out_id, &buf[start], id_len);
    out_id[id_len] = '\0';
    return true;
}

static bool ocpp_seek_json_value(const char *buf, size_t len, const char *key, size_t *out_pos)
{
    const char *hit = ocpp_find_sub(buf, len, key);
    if (hit == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t pos = (size_t)(hit - buf) + strlen(key);
    while ((pos < len) && (buf[pos] != ':')) {
        pos++;
    }
    pos++;
    while ((pos < len) && (buf[pos] == ' ')) {
        pos++;
    }
    *out_pos = pos;
    return true;
}

static bool ocpp_extract_json_str(const char *buf, size_t len, const char *key, char *out_val,
                                  size_t out_cap)
{
    out_val[0] = '\0';
    size_t pos = 0U;
    if (!ocpp_seek_json_value(buf, len, key, &pos)) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((pos >= len) || (buf[pos] != '"')) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t start = pos + 1U;
    pos = start;
    while ((pos < len) && (buf[pos] != '"')) {
        pos++;
    }
    if (pos >= len) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t copy_len = pos - start;
    if (copy_len >= out_cap) {
        copy_len = out_cap - 1U;
    }
    memcpy(out_val, &buf[start], copy_len);
    out_val[copy_len] = '\0';
    return true;
}

static bool ocpp_extract_json_i32(const char *buf, size_t len, const char *key, int32_t *out_val)
{
    size_t pos = 0U;
    if (!ocpp_seek_json_value(buf, len, key, &pos)) {
        return false;
    }
    bool neg = false;
    if ((pos < len) && (buf[pos] == '-')) {
        neg = true;
        pos++;
    }
    uint64_t acc = 0ULL;
    size_t digits = 0U;
    const uint64_t limit = neg ? 2147483648ULL : 2147483647ULL;
    while ((pos < len) && (buf[pos] >= '0') && (buf[pos] <= '9')) {
        acc = (acc * 10ULL) + (uint64_t)(uint8_t)(buf[pos] - '0');
        if (acc > limit) {
            return false;
        }
        pos++;
        digits++;
    }
    if (digits == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    *out_val = neg ? (int32_t)(0LL - (int64_t)acc) : (int32_t)acc;
    return true;
}

static size_t ocpp_escape_char(uint8_t ch, char out_seq[6])
{
    static const char hex[16] = "0123456789abcdef";
    if ((ch == (uint8_t)'"') || (ch == (uint8_t)'\\')) {
        out_seq[0] = '\\';
        out_seq[1] = (char)ch;
        return 2U;
    }
    if (ch == (uint8_t)'\n') {
        out_seq[0] = '\\';
        out_seq[1] = 'n';
        return 2U;
    }
    if (ch == (uint8_t)'\r') {
        out_seq[0] = '\\';
        out_seq[1] = 'r';
        return 2U;
    }
    if (ch == (uint8_t)'\t') {
        out_seq[0] = '\\';
        out_seq[1] = 't';
        return 2U;
    }
    if (ch < 0x20U) {
        out_seq[0] = '\\';
        out_seq[1] = 'u';
        out_seq[2] = '0';
        out_seq[3] = '0';
        out_seq[4] = hex[(ch >> 4U) & 0x0FU];
        out_seq[5] = hex[ch & 0x0FU];
        return 6U;
    }
    out_seq[0] = (char)ch;
    return 1U;
}

static bool ocpp_json_escape(const char *src, const char *fallback, char *dst, size_t dst_cap)
{
    const char *in = (src != NULL) ? src : fallback;
    size_t pos = 0U;
    while (*in != '\0') {
        char seq[6];
        size_t seq_len = ocpp_escape_char((uint8_t)*in, seq);
        if (seq_len >= (dst_cap - pos)) {
            dst[pos] = '\0';
            return false;
        }
        (void)memcpy(&dst[pos], seq, seq_len);
        pos += seq_len;
        in++;
    }
    dst[pos] = '\0';
    return true;
}

static uint32_t ocpp_sec_to_ms_sat(uint32_t sec)
{
    uint64_t ms = (uint64_t)sec * 1000ULL;
    return (ms > (uint64_t)UINT32_MAX) ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)ms;
}

static SYN_OCPP_RegistrationStatus ocpp_parse_reg_status(const char *s)
{
    if (strcmp(s, "Accepted") == 0) {
        return SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_ACCEPTED;
    }
    if (strcmp(s, "Pending") == 0) {
        return SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_PENDING;
    }
    return SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_REJECTED;
}

static const char *ocpp_reg_status_str(SYN_OCPP_RegistrationStatus st)
{
    if (st == SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_ACCEPTED) {
        return "Accepted";

    if (st == SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_PENDING) {
        return "Pending";
    }
    return "Rejected";
}

static SYN_OCPP_AuthorizationStatus ocpp_parse_auth_status(const char *s)
{
    if (strcmp(s, "Accepted") == 0) {
        return SYN_OCPP_AUTH_ACCEPTED;
    }
    if (strcmp(s, "Blocked") == 0) {
        return SYN_OCPP_AUTH_BLOCKED;

    if (strcmp(s, "Expired") == 0) {
        return SYN_OCPP_AUTH_EXPIRED;

    return SYN_OCPP_AUTH_INVALID;

static void ocpp_set_pending(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, SYN_OCPP_PendingAction action)
{
    size_t slot = (size_t)(client->message_counter % SYN_OCPP_MAX_PENDING);
    client->pending_action = action;
    client->pending_calls[slot].action = action;
    (void)snprintf(client->pending_calls[slot].unique_id,
                   sizeof(client->pending_calls[slot].unique_id), "%u",
                   (unsigned int)client->message_counter);
    (void)snprintf(client->pending_unique_id, sizeof(client->pending_unique_id), "%s",
                   client->pending_calls[slot].unique_id);
}

static SYN_Status ocpp_finish_write(int written, size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (written < 0 || (size_t)written >= max_len) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    *out_len = (size_t)written;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_init(SYN_OCPP_Client *client)
{
    if (client == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
    client->registration_status = SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_PENDING;
    client->heartbeat_interval_sec = 60U;
    client->heartbeat_timer_ms = 60000U;
    client->connector_id = 1U;
    client->connector_status = SYN_OCPP_STATUS_AVAILABLE;
    client->active_transaction_id = -1;
    client->pending_action = SYN_OCPP_ACTION_NONE;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_set_callbacks(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, SYN_OCPP_RegistrationHandler reg_cb,
                                  SYN_OCPP_AuthorizationHandler auth_cb,
                                  SYN_OCPP_StartTxHandler start_tx_cb,
                                  SYN_OCPP_RemoteStartHandler remote_start_cb,
                                  SYN_OCPP_RemoteStopHandler remote_stop_cb, void *user_ctx)
{
    if (client == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    client->reg_cb = reg_cb;
    client->auth_cb = auth_cb;
    client->start_tx_cb = start_tx_cb;
    client->remote_start_cb = remote_start_cb;
    client->remote_stop_cb = remote_stop_cb;
    client->user_ctx = user_ctx;

static void ocpp_dispatch_call_result(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, SYN_OCPP_PendingAction action,
                                      const char *in_buf, size_t in_len)
{
    char status_str[24];
    (void)ocpp_extract_json_str(in_buf, in_len, "\"status\"", status_str, sizeof(status_str));

    if (action == SYN_OCPP_ACTION_BOOT_NOTIFICATION) {
        SYN_OCPP_RegistrationStatus reg_st = ocpp_parse_reg_status(status_str);
        int32_t iv = 0;
        if (ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"interval\"", &iv) && iv > 0) {
            client->heartbeat_interval_sec = (uint32_t)iv;
            client->heartbeat_timer_ms = ocpp_sec_to_ms_sat((uint32_t)iv);
        }
        client->registration_status = reg_st;
        if (client->reg_cb != NULL) {
            client->reg_cb(reg_st, client->heartbeat_interval_sec, client->user_ctx);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (action == SYN_OCPP_ACTION_AUTHORIZE) {
        SYN_OCPP_AuthorizationStatus auth_st = ocpp_parse_auth_status(status_str);
        if (client->auth_cb != NULL) {
            client->auth_cb(client->active_id_tag, auth_st, client->user_ctx);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (action == SYN_OCPP_ACTION_START_TRANSACTION) {
        SYN_OCPP_AuthorizationStatus auth_st = ocpp_parse_auth_status(status_str);
        int32_t tx_id = -1;
        (void)ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"transactionId\"", &tx_id);
        if (auth_st == SYN_OCPP_AUTH_ACCEPTED && tx_id > 0) {
            client->active_transaction_id = tx_id;
        }
        if (client->start_tx_cb != NULL) {
            client->start_tx_cb(tx_id, auth_st, client->user_ctx);
        }
    }
}

static SYN_Status ocpp_client_handle_call(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, const char *in_buf,
                                          size_t in_len, char *out_resp, size_t max_resp_len,
                                          size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    char msg_id[32];
    if (!ocpp_extract_msg_id(in_buf, in_len, msg_id, sizeof(msg_id))) {
        (void)snprintf(msg_id, sizeof(msg_id), "1");
    }
    char id_esc[192];
    (void)ocpp_json_escape(msg_id, "1", id_esc, sizeof(id_esc));

    if (ocpp_find_sub(in_buf, in_len, "\"RemoteStartTransaction\"") != NULL) {
        char id_tag[32];
        bool has_tag = ocpp_extract_json_str(in_buf, in_len, "\"idTag\"", id_tag, sizeof(id_tag));
        int32_t conn_id = (int32_t)client->connector_id;
        (void)ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"connectorId\"", &conn_id);

        bool ok = false;
        if (has_tag && id_tag[0] != '\0' && conn_id >= 0) {
            ok = (client->remote_start_cb != NULL)
                     ? client->remote_start_cb((uint32_t)conn_id, id_tag, client->user_ctx)
                     : true;
        }
        int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len, "[3,\"%s\",{\"status\":\"%s\"}]", id_esc,
                               ok ? "Accepted" : "Rejected");
        return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
    }

    if (ocpp_find_sub(in_buf, in_len, "\"RemoteStopTransaction\"") != NULL) {
        int32_t req_tx_id = -1;
        bool has_tx = ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"transactionId\"", &req_tx_id);
        bool ok = false;
        if (has_tx) {
            ok = (client->remote_stop_cb != NULL)
                     ? client->remote_stop_cb(req_tx_id, client->user_ctx)
                     : true;
        }
        int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len, "[3,\"%s\",{\"status\":\"%s\"}]", id_esc,
                               ok ? "Accepted" : "Rejected");
        return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
    }

    int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len, "[3,\"%s\",{}]", id_esc);
    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
}

static void ocpp_sync_pending_summary(SYN_OCPP_Client *client)
{
    client->pending_action = SYN_OCPP_ACTION_NONE;
    client->pending_unique_id[0] = '\0';
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_OCPP_MAX_PENDING; i++) {
        if (client->pending_calls[i].action != SYN_OCPP_ACTION_NONE) {
            client->pending_action = client->pending_calls[i].action;
            (void)snprintf(client->pending_unique_id, sizeof(client->pending_unique_id), "%s",
                           client->pending_calls[i].unique_id);
            return;
        }
    }
}

static void ocpp_client_handle_result(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, uint8_t msg_type, const char *in_buf,
                                      size_t in_len)
{
    char msg_id[32];
    if (!ocpp_extract_msg_id(in_buf, in_len, msg_id, sizeof(msg_id))) {
        return;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_OCPP_MAX_PENDING; i++) {
        if (client->pending_calls[i].action != SYN_OCPP_ACTION_NONE &&
            strcmp(msg_id, client->pending_calls[i].unique_id) == 0) {
            SYN_OCPP_PendingAction action = client->pending_calls[i].action;
            client->pending_calls[i].action = SYN_OCPP_ACTION_NONE;
            client->pending_calls[i].unique_id[0] = '\0';
            if (strcmp(msg_id, client->pending_unique_id) == 0) {
                ocpp_sync_pending_summary(client);
            }
            if (msg_type == SYN_OCPP_MSG_TYPE_CALLRESULT) {
                ocpp_dispatch_call_result(client, action, in_buf, in_len);
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_process_message(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, const char *in_buf, size_t in_len,
                                    char *out_resp, size_t max_resp_len, size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    if (client == NULL || in_buf == NULL || in_len < 5U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (out_resp_len != NULL) {
        *out_resp_len = 0U;
    }
    if (in_buf[0] != '[') {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t msg_type = (uint8_t)(in_buf[1] - '0');

    if (msg_type == SYN_OCPP_MSG_TYPE_CALLRESULT || msg_type == SYN_OCPP_MSG_TYPE_CALLERROR) {
        ocpp_client_handle_result(client, msg_type, in_buf, in_len);
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (msg_type == SYN_OCPP_MSG_TYPE_CALL && out_resp != NULL && out_resp_len != NULL &&
        max_resp_len >= 32U) {
        return ocpp_client_handle_call(client, in_buf, in_len, out_resp, max_resp_len,
                                       out_resp_len);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_ocpp_tick(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, uint32_t dt_ms, char *out_hb_buf, size_t max_len,
                   size_t *out_len)
{
    if (client == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    if (out_len != NULL) {
        *out_len = 0U;
    }

    if (client->heartbeat_timer_ms > dt_ms) {
        client->heartbeat_timer_ms -= dt_ms;
    } else {
        client->heartbeat_timer_ms = (client->heartbeat_interval_sec > 0U)
                                         ? ocpp_sec_to_ms_sat(client->heartbeat_interval_sec)
                                         : 60000U;

        if (out_hb_buf != NULL && out_len != NULL && max_len >= 32U) {
            (void)syn_ocpp_format_heartbeat(client, out_hb_buf, max_len, out_len);
        }
    }
}

static SYN_Status ocpp_server_handle_boot(SYN_OCPP_Server *server, const char *msg_id,
                                          const char *in_buf, size_t in_len, char *out_resp,
                                          size_t max_resp_len, size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    char vendor[32];
    char model[32];
    char serial[32];
    char fw[32];
    (void)ocpp_extract_json_str(in_buf, in_len, "\"chargePointVendor\"", vendor, sizeof(vendor));

                                sizeof(serial));
    (void)ocpp_extract_json_str(in_buf, in_len, "\"firmwareVersion\"", fw, sizeof(fw));

    SYN_OCPP_RegistrationStatus st = SYN_OCPP_REGISTRATION_ACCEPTED;
    uint32_t interval = 60U;
    if (server->boot_cb != NULL) {
        SYN_OCPP_ChargePointInfo info = {vendor, model, serial, fw};
        st = server->boot_cb(&info, &interval, server->user_ctx);
    }
    int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len,
                           "[3,\"%s\",{"
                           "\"status\":\"%s\","
                           "\"currentTime\":\"2026-08-06T12:00:00Z\","
                           "\"interval\":%u}]",
                           msg_id, ocpp_reg_status_str(st), (unsigned int)interval);
    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
}

static SYN_Status ocpp_server_handle_start_tx(SYN_OCPP_Server *server, const char *msg_id,
                                              const char *in_buf, size_t in_len, char *out_resp,
                                              size_t max_resp_len, size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    char id_tag[32];
    bool has_tag = ocpp_extract_json_str(in_buf, in_len, "\"idTag\"", id_tag, sizeof(id_tag));
    int32_t conn_id = 1;
    int32_t meter_start = 0;
    (void)ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"connectorId\"", &conn_id);
    (void)ocpp_extract_json_i32(in_buf, in_len, "\"meterStart\"", &meter_start);

    if (!has_tag || id_tag[0] == '\0' || conn_id < 0 || meter_start < 0) {
        int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len,
                               "[3,\"%s\",{\"transactionId\":0,"
                               "\"idTagInfo\":{\"status\":\"Invalid\"}}]",
                               msg_id);
        return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
    }

    int32_t tx_id = server->next_transaction_id++;
    if (server->start_tx_cb != NULL) {
        int32_t user_tx =
            server->start_tx_cb((uint32_t)conn_id, id_tag, (uint32_t)meter_start, server->user_ctx);
        if (user_tx > 0) {
            tx_id = user_tx;
        }
    }
    int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len,
                           "[3,\"%s\",{"
                           "\"transactionId\":%d,"
                           "\"idTagInfo\":{\"status\":\"Accepted\"}}]",
                           msg_id, (int)tx_id);
    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
}

    SYN_OCPP_AuthorizationStatus auth_st = SYN_OCPP_AUTH_INVALID;
    if (has_tag && id_tag[0] != '\0') {

    int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len, "[3,\"%s\",{\"idTagInfo\":{\"status\":\"%s\"}}]",

    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
}

                                           size_t *out_resp_len)
{
    if (server == NULL || in_buf == NULL || out_resp == NULL || out_resp_len == NULL ||
        in_len < 5U || max_resp_len < 64U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *out_resp_len = 0U;
    if (in_buf[0] != '[') {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t msg_type = (uint8_t)(in_buf[1] - '0');
    if (msg_type != SYN_OCPP_MSG_TYPE_CALL) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    char msg_id[32];
    if (!ocpp_extract_msg_id(in_buf, in_len, msg_id, sizeof(msg_id))) {
        (void)snprintf(msg_id, sizeof(msg_id), "1");
    }
    char id_esc[192];
    (void)ocpp_json_escape(msg_id, "1", id_esc, sizeof(id_esc));

    if (ocpp_find_sub(in_buf, in_len, "\"BootNotification\"") != NULL) {
        return ocpp_server_handle_boot(server, id_esc, in_buf, in_len, out_resp, max_resp_len,
                                       out_resp_len);
    }

    if (ocpp_find_sub(in_buf, in_len, "\"Authorize\"") != NULL) {
        return ocpp_server_handle_auth(server, id_esc, in_buf, in_len, out_resp, max_resp_len,
                                       out_resp_len);
    }

    if (ocpp_find_sub(in_buf, in_len, "\"StartTransaction\"") != NULL) {
        return ocpp_server_handle_start_tx(server, id_esc, in_buf, in_len, out_resp, max_resp_len,
                                           out_resp_len);
    }

    int written = snprintf(out_resp, max_resp_len, "[3,\"%s\",{}]", id_esc);
    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_resp_len, out_resp_len);
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_format_display_message(SYN_OCPP_Client *client,
                                           const SYN_OCPP_DisplayMessage *msg, char *out_buf,
                                           size_t max_len, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (client == NULL || msg == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL || max_len < 32U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t msg_id = ++client->message_counter;
    char hdr_esc[192];
    char cnt_esc[192];
    bool esc_ok = ocpp_json_escape(msg->header, "", hdr_esc, sizeof(hdr_esc)) &&
                  ocpp_json_escape(msg->content, "", cnt_esc, sizeof(cnt_esc));
    int written =
        esc_ok ? snprintf(out_buf, max_len,
                          "[2,\"%u\",\"DisplayMessage\",{\"message\":{\"id\":%u,\"header\":\"%s\","
                          "\"content\":\"%s\",\"displayTimeSec\":%u}}]",
                          (unsigned int)msg_id, (unsigned int)msg->message_id, hdr_esc, cnt_esc,
                          (unsigned int)msg->display_time_s)
               : -1;

    if (ocpp_finish_write(written, max_len, out_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    ocpp_set_pending(client, SYN_OCPP_ACTION_DISPLAY_MESSAGE);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_format_v2g_energy_transfer(SYN_OCPP_Client *client, SYN_OCPP_V2GMode mode,
                                               int32_t power_limit_w, char *out_buf, size_t max_len,
                                               size_t *out_len)
{
    if (client == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL || max_len < 32U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    client->v2g_mode = mode;
    uint32_t msg_id = ++client->message_counter;
    const char *mode_str = (mode == SYN_OCPP_V2G_SCHEDULED) ? "Scheduled" : "Dynamic";

    int written = snprintf(out_buf, max_len,
                           "[2,\"%u\",\"V2GEnergyTransfer\",{\"v2gMode\":\"%s\","
                           "\"powerLimitW\":%d}]",
                           (unsigned int)msg_id, mode_str, (int)power_limit_w);

    if (ocpp_finish_write(written, max_len, out_len) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    ocpp_set_pending(client, SYN_OCPP_ACTION_V2G_TRANSFER);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_format_call_error(const char *msg_id, const char *error_code,
                                      const char *error_description, char *out_buf, size_t max_len,
                                      size_t *out_len)
{
    if (msg_id == NULL || error_code == NULL || out_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL ||
        max_len < 32U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    char id_esc[128];
    char code_esc[128];
    char desc_esc[192];
    bool esc_ok = ocpp_json_escape(msg_id, "", id_esc, sizeof(id_esc)) &&
                  ocpp_json_escape(error_code, "", code_esc, sizeof(code_esc)) &&
                  ocpp_json_escape(error_description, "", desc_esc, sizeof(desc_esc));
    int written = esc_ok ? snprintf(out_buf, max_len, "[4,\"%s\",\"%s\",\"%s\",{}]", id_esc,
                                    code_esc, desc_esc)
                         : -1;

    return ocpp_finish_write(written, max_len, out_len);
}

docs.title: function syn_ocpp_server_process_message
docs.text:
Process incoming station request frame on CSMS server and generate response CallResult. 

SYN_Status syn_ocpp_server_process_message (
    SYN_OCPP_Server * server,
    const char * in_buf,
    size_t in_len,
    char * out_resp,
    size_t max_resp_len,
    size_t * out_resp_len
)

Parameters:

  • server Pointer to server instance.
  • in_buf Incoming JSON frame from station.
  • in_len Length of incoming JSON frame.
  • out_resp Output buffer for CallResult response frame.
  • max_resp_len Capacity of output response buffer.
  • out_resp_len Pointer to store response byte count.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM or SYN_ERROR on failure.

)

Parameters:

  • server Pointer to server instance.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM if server is NULL.

docs.text:

  • user_ctx User context pointer.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_INVALID_PARAM if client is NULL.

/* ── Byte Writer Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint8_t *data; 
    size_t size;   
    size_t pos;    
    bool error;    
} OPCUA_Writer;

static void opcua_writer_init(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint8_t *buf, size_t size)
{
    w->data = buf;
    w->size = size;
    w->pos = 0U;
    w->error = (buf == NULL || size == 0U);
}

static bool opcua_write_u8(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint8_t v)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos + 1U > w->size) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = v;
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_write_u16(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint16_t v)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos + 2U > w->size) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_write_u32(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint32_t v)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos + 4U > w->size) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_write_u64(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint64_t v)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos + 8U > w->size) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 8U; i++) {
        w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> (i * 8U)) & 0xFFU);
    }
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_write_bytes(OPCUA_Writer *w, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos + len > w->size) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    if (len > 0U && buf != NULL) {
        (void)memcpy(&w->data[w->pos], buf, len);
        w->pos += len;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_write_string(OPCUA_Writer *w, const char *str)
{
    if (str == NULL) {
        return opcua_write_u32(w, 0xFFFFFFFFU); /* Null string (-1) */
    }
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)strlen(str);
    if (!opcua_write_u32(w, len)) {
        return false;
    }
    return opcua_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)str, len);
}

static bool opcua_write_nodeid_num(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint16_t ns, uint32_t num)
{
    if (ns == 0U && num <= 0xFFU) {
        (void)opcua_write_u8(w, 0x00U); /* TwoByte NodeId */
        return opcua_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)num);
    }
    if (ns <= 0xFFU && num <= 0xFFFFU) {
        (void)opcua_write_u8(w, 0x01U); /* FourByte NodeId */
        (void)opcua_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)ns);
        return opcua_write_u16(w, (uint16_t)num);
    }
    (void)opcua_write_u8(w, 0x02U); /* Numeric NodeId */
    (void)opcua_write_u16(w, ns);
    return opcua_write_u32(w, num);
}

static bool opcua_write_variant_int(OPCUA_Writer *w, const SYN_OPCUA_Variant *var, bool *out_wrote)
{
    *out_wrote = true;
    switch (var->type) {
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_BOOLEAN:
        return opcua_write_u8(w, var->val.boolean ? 1U : 0U);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_SBYTE:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_BYTE:
        return opcua_write_u8(w, var->val.byte);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT16:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT16:
        return opcua_write_u16(w, var->val.uint16);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT32:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT32:
        return opcua_write_u32(w, var->val.uint32);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT64:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT64:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_DATETIME:
        return opcua_write_u64(w, var->val.uint64);
    default:
        *out_wrote = false;
        return false;
    }
}

static bool opcua_write_variant(OPCUA_Writer *w, const SYN_OPCUA_Variant *var)
{
    if (var == NULL || var->type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL) {
        return opcua_write_u8(w, 0x00U);
    }
    (void)opcua_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)var->type);
    bool wrote = false;
    bool ok = opcua_write_variant_int(w, var, &wrote);
    if (wrote) {
        return ok;
    }
    if (var->type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_FLOAT) {
        uint32_t u;
        (void)memcpy(&u, &var->val.float_val, sizeof(u));
        return opcua_write_u32(w, u);
    }
    if (var->type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_DOUBLE) {
        uint64_t u;
        (void)memcpy(&u, &var->val.double_val, sizeof(u));
        return opcua_write_u64(w, u);
    }
    if (var->type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_STRING) {
        return opcua_write_string(w, var->val.string);
    }
    return false;
}

static bool opcua_write_datavalue(OPCUA_Writer *w, const SYN_OPCUA_DataValue *dv)
{
    uint8_t mask = 0x01U; /* Has Value */
    if (dv->status_code != SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD) {
        mask |= 0x02U; /* Has Status */
    }
    if (dv->source_ts_ms != 0U) {
        mask |= 0x04U; /* Has SourceTimestamp */
    }
    (void)opcua_write_u8(w, mask);
    (void)opcua_write_variant(w, &dv->value);
    if ((mask & 0x02U) != 0U) {
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, dv->status_code);
    }
    if ((mask & 0x04U) != 0U) {
        (void)opcua_write_u64(w, dv->source_ts_ms);
    }
    return !w->error;
}

/* ── Byte Reader Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    const uint8_t *data; 
    size_t size;         
    size_t pos;          
    bool error;          
} OPCUA_Reader;

static void opcua_reader_init(OPCUA_Reader *r, const uint8_t *buf, size_t size)
{
    r->data = buf;
    r->size = size;
    r->pos = 0U;
    r->error = (buf == NULL || size == 0U);
}

static bool opcua_read_u8(OPCUA_Reader *r, uint8_t *out)
{
    if (r->error || r->pos + 1U > r->size) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    *out = r->data[r->pos++];
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_read_u16(OPCUA_Reader *r, uint16_t *out)
{
    if (r->error || r->pos + 2U > r->size) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    *out = (uint16_t)r->data[r->pos] | ((uint16_t)r->data[r->pos + 1U] << 8U);
    r->pos += 2U;
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_read_u32(OPCUA_Reader *r, uint32_t *out)
{
    if (r->error || r->pos + 4U > r->size) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    *out = (uint32_t)r->data[r->pos] | ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 1U] << 8U) |
           ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 2U] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 3U] << 24U);
    r->pos += 4U;
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_read_u64(OPCUA_Reader *r, uint64_t *out)
{
    uint32_t lo = 0U;
    uint32_t hi = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u32(r, &lo) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &hi)) {
        return false;
    }
    *out = (uint64_t)lo | ((uint64_t)hi << 32U);
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_skip(OPCUA_Reader *r, size_t count)
{
    if (r->error || count > r->size - r->pos) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    r->pos += count;
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_read_nodeid_num(OPCUA_Reader *r, uint16_t *out_ns, uint32_t *out_num)
{
    uint8_t enc = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &enc)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (enc == 0x00U) { /* TwoByte */
        uint8_t id = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &id)) {
            return false;
        }
        *out_ns = 0U;
        *out_num = id;
        return true;
    }
    if (enc == 0x01U) { /* FourByte */
        uint8_t ns = 0U;
        uint16_t id = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &ns) || !opcua_read_u16(r, &id)) {
            return false;
        }
        *out_ns = ns;
        *out_num = id;
        return true;
    }
    if (enc == 0x02U) { /* Numeric */
        uint16_t ns = 0U;
        uint32_t id = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u16(r, &ns) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &id)) {
            return false;
        }
        *out_ns = ns;
        *out_num = id;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

    SYN_OPCUA_Node server_node = {
        .node_id = {.ns_index = SYN_OPCUA_NS_STANDARD,
