        .parent_id = {.ns_index = SYN_OPCUA_NS_STANDARD,
                      .id_type = SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_NUMERIC,
                      .id = {.num = SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_OBJECTS_FOLDER}},
        .node_class = SYN_OPCUA_NODECLASS_OBJECT,

/* ── Public API Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_init(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, const SYN_OPCUA_Config *cfg)
{
    if (srv == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->rx_buf == NULL || cfg->tx_buf == NULL || cfg->rx_buf_size < 128U ||
        cfg->tx_buf_size < 128U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(srv, 0, sizeof(*srv));
    srv->cfg = *cfg;
    if (srv->cfg.endpoint_url == NULL) {
        srv->cfg.endpoint_url = "opc.tcp://0.0.0.0:4840";
    }
    if (srv->cfg.server_name == NULL) {
        srv->cfg.server_name = "SyntropicOS OPC UA Server";
    }

    srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_CLOSED;
    srv->secure_channel_id = 1U;
    srv->security_token_id = 1U;
    srv->sequence_number = 1U;

    opcua_populate_standard_nodes(srv);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_register_node(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, const SYN_OPCUA_Node *node)
{
    if (srv == NULL || node == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (srv->node_count >= SYN_OPCUA_MAX_NODES) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    SYN_OPCUA_Node *dst = &srv->nodes[srv->node_count++];
    *dst = *node;
    if ((dst->node_class == SYN_OPCUA_NODECLASS_VARIABLE) &&
        (dst->value.value.type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL) && (dst->data_type != SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL)) {
        dst->value.value.type = dst->data_type;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_OPCUA_Node *syn_opcua_server_find_node_num(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint16_t ns, uint32_t num_id)
{
    if (srv == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < srv->node_count; i++) {
        SYN_OPCUA_Node *n = &srv->nodes[i];
        if (n->node_id.ns_index == ns && n->node_id.id_type == SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_NUMERIC &&
            n->node_id.id.num == num_id) {
            return n;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_write_variable(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint16_t ns, uint32_t num_id,
                                           const SYN_OPCUA_Variant *val)
{
    if (srv == NULL || val == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    SYN_OPCUA_Node *node = syn_opcua_server_find_node_num(srv, ns, num_id);
    if (node == NULL || node->node_class != SYN_OPCUA_NODECLASS_VARIABLE) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    node->value.value = *val;
    node->value.status_code = SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD;
    node->value.source_ts_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms();

    if (node->on_write != NULL) {
        return node->on_write(srv, node, &node->value, node->user_data);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_read_variable(const SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint16_t ns, uint32_t num_id,
                                          SYN_OPCUA_Variant *out_val)
{
    if (srv == NULL || out_val == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < srv->node_count; i++) {
        const SYN_OPCUA_Node *n = &srv->nodes[i];
        if (n->node_id.ns_index == ns && n->node_id.id_type == SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_NUMERIC &&
            n->node_id.id.num == num_id) {
            *out_val = n->value.value;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }
    return SYN_ERROR;
}

/* ── Service Processing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void opcua_patch_u32_len(OPCUA_Writer *w, size_t len_pos)
{
    uint32_t total_len = (uint32_t)w->pos;
    w->data[len_pos] = (uint8_t)(total_len & 0xFFU);
    w->data[len_pos + 1U] = (uint8_t)((total_len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[len_pos + 2U] = (uint8_t)((total_len >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[len_pos + 3U] = (uint8_t)((total_len >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
}

static SYN_Status opcua_handle_hel(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Writer *w, size_t *out_len)
{
    (void)opcua_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)"ACKF", 4U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 28U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_PROTOCOL_VERSION);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, (uint32_t)srv->cfg.rx_buf_size);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, (uint32_t)srv->cfg.tx_buf_size);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 1U);

    if (w->error) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_HELLO_RECEIVED;
    *out_len = w->pos;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status opcua_handle_opn(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_Writer *w,
                                   size_t *out_len)
{
    uint32_t channel_id = 0U;
    (void)opcua_read_u32(r, &channel_id);

    (void)opcua_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)"OPNF", 4U);
    size_t len_pos = w->pos;
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 0U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->secure_channel_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->security_token_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->sequence_number++);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->request_id++);

    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, 446U);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 0U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);

    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_PROTOCOL_VERSION);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->secure_channel_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->security_token_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 3600000U);

    if (w->error) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    opcua_patch_u32_len(w, len_pos);
    srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SECURE_CHANNEL;
    *out_len = w->pos;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void opcua_service_read(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_Writer *w,
                               uint32_t req_id)
{
    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_READ);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);

    /* Skip RequestHeader / maxAge / timestampsToReturn with bounds check */
    (void)opcua_skip(r, 16U);

    uint32_t count = 0U;
    (void)opcua_read_u32(r, &count);
    if (count > 16U) {
        count = 16U;
    }

    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, count);
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        uint16_t ns = 0U;
        uint32_t num = 0U;
        (void)opcua_read_nodeid_num(r, &ns, &num);
        uint32_t attr_id = 0U;
        (void)opcua_read_u32(r, &attr_id);

        SYN_OPCUA_Node *node = syn_opcua_server_find_node_num(srv, ns, num);
        if (node != NULL) {
            if (node->on_read != NULL) {
                (void)node->on_read(srv, node, &node->value, node->user_data);
            }
            (void)opcua_write_datavalue(w, &node->value);
        } else {
            SYN_OPCUA_DataValue bad = {.value = {.type = SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL},
                                       .status_code = SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_NODE_ID_UNKNOWN};
            (void)opcua_write_datavalue(w, &bad);
        }
    }
}

typedef struct {
    uint16_t ns;                            
    uint32_t num;                           
    uint32_t attr_id;                       
    bool has_index_range;                   
    uint8_t dv_mask;                        
    SYN_OPCUA_Variant var;                  
    uint32_t status_code;                   
    uint64_t source_ts_ms;                  
    char str_buf[SYN_OPCUA_MAX_STRING_LEN]; 
    bool str_is_null;                       
} OPCUA_WriteItem;

static bool opcua_read_variant_int(OPCUA_Reader *r, SYN_OPCUA_DataType type, SYN_OPCUA_Variant *out,
                                   bool *out_handled)
{
    *out_handled = true;
    switch (type) {
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_BOOLEAN: {
        uint8_t b = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &b)) {
            return false;
        }
        out->val.boolean = (b != 0U);
        return true;
    }
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_SBYTE:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_BYTE:
        return opcua_read_u8(r, &out->val.byte);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT16:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT16:
        return opcua_read_u16(r, &out->val.uint16);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT32:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT32:
        return opcua_read_u32(r, &out->val.uint32);
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_INT64:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_UINT64:
    case SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_DATETIME:
        return opcua_read_u64(r, &out->val.uint64);
    default:
        *out_handled = false;
        return false;
    }
}

static bool opcua_read_string_buf(OPCUA_Reader *r, char buf[SYN_OPCUA_MAX_STRING_LEN],
                                  bool *out_is_null)
{
    uint32_t slen = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u32(r, &slen)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (slen == 0xFFFFFFFFU) {
        buf[0] = '\0';
        *out_is_null = true;
        return true;
    }
    *out_is_null = false;
    if ((slen >= SYN_OPCUA_MAX_STRING_LEN) || (slen > (r->size - r->pos))) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    if (slen > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(buf, &r->data[r->pos], slen);
        r->pos += slen;
    }
    buf[slen] = '\0';
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_read_variant(OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_WriteItem *item)
{
    uint8_t enc = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &enc) || ((enc & 0xC0U) != 0U)) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    SYN_OPCUA_DataType type = (SYN_OPCUA_DataType)(enc & 0x3FU);
    item->var.type = type;
    if (type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL) {
        return true;
    }
    bool handled = false;
    bool ok = opcua_read_variant_int(r, type, &item->var, &handled);
    if (handled) {
        return ok;
    }
    if (type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_FLOAT) {
        uint32_t raw = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u32(r, &raw)) {
            return false;
        }
        (void)memcpy(&item->var.val.float_val, &raw, sizeof(raw));
        return true;
    }
    if (type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_DOUBLE) {
        uint64_t raw = 0U;
        if (!opcua_read_u64(r, &raw)) {
            return false;
        }
        (void)memcpy(&item->var.val.double_val, &raw, sizeof(raw));
        return true;
    }
    if (type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_STRING) {
        return opcua_read_string_buf(r, item->str_buf, &item->str_is_null);
    }
    r->error = true;
    return false;
}

static bool opcua_decode_write_datavalue(OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_WriteItem *item)
{
    if (!opcua_read_u8(r, &item->dv_mask)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((item->dv_mask & 0x01U) != 0U) && !opcua_read_variant(r, item)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((item->dv_mask & 0x02U) != 0U) && !opcua_read_u32(r, &item->status_code)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (((item->dv_mask & 0x04U) != 0U) && !opcua_read_u64(r, &item->source_ts_ms)) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t extra_ts = 0U;
    if ((item->dv_mask & 0x10U) != 0U) {
        extra_ts += 2U;
    }
    if ((item->dv_mask & 0x08U) != 0U) {
        extra_ts += 8U;
    }
    if ((item->dv_mask & 0x20U) != 0U) {
        extra_ts += 2U;
    }
    return (extra_ts == 0U) || opcua_skip(r, extra_ts);
}

static bool opcua_decode_write_item(OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_WriteItem *item)
{
    (void)memset(item, 0, sizeof(*item));
    if (!opcua_read_nodeid_num(r, &item->ns, &item->num) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &item->attr_id)) {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t idx_len = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u32(r, &idx_len)) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((idx_len != 0xFFFFFFFFU) && (idx_len > 0U)) {
        item->has_index_range = true;
        if (!opcua_skip(r, idx_len)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return opcua_decode_write_datavalue(r, item);
}

static uint32_t opcua_commit_write_item(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, SYN_OPCUA_Node *node,
                                        const OPCUA_WriteItem *item)
{
    SYN_OPCUA_DataValue prev_dv = node->value;
    SYN_OPCUA_Variant committed = item->var;
    if (committed.type == SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_STRING) {
        if (item->str_is_null) {
            committed.val.string = NULL;
        } else {
            (void)memcpy(node->string_buf, item->str_buf, sizeof(node->string_buf));
            committed.val.string = node->string_buf;
        }
    }
    node->value.value = committed;
    node->value.status_code =
        ((item->dv_mask & 0x02U) != 0U) ? item->status_code : SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD;
    node->value.source_ts_ms =
        ((item->dv_mask & 0x04U) != 0U) ? item->source_ts_ms : syn_port_get_tick_ms();

    if ((node->on_write != NULL) &&
        (node->on_write(srv, node, &node->value, node->user_data) != SYN_OK)) {
        node->value = prev_dv;
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_INTERNAL_ERROR;
    }
    return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD;
}

static uint32_t opcua_apply_write_item(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, const OPCUA_WriteItem *item)
{
    SYN_OPCUA_Node *node = syn_opcua_server_find_node_num(srv, item->ns, item->num);
    if (node == NULL) {
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_NODE_ID_UNKNOWN;
    }
    if (item->attr_id != SYN_OPCUA_ATTR_VALUE) {
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_NOT_WRITABLE;
    }
    if (item->has_index_range) {
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_INDEX_RANGE_INVALID;
    }
    if ((node->node_class != SYN_OPCUA_NODECLASS_VARIABLE) ||
        ((node->access_level & 0x02U) == 0U)) {
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_NOT_WRITABLE;
    }
    SYN_OPCUA_DataType expected_type =
        (node->value.value.type != SYN_OPCUA_TYPE_NULL) ? node->value.value.type : node->data_type;
    if (((item->dv_mask & 0x01U) == 0U) || (item->var.type != expected_type)) {
        return SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_TYPE_MISMATCH;
    }
    return opcua_commit_write_item(srv, node, item);
}

static void opcua_write_service_fault(OPCUA_Writer *w, uint32_t req_id, uint32_t status_code)
{
    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_SERVICE_FAULT);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, status_code);
}

static void opcua_service_write(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_Writer *w,
                                uint32_t req_id)
{
    uint32_t count = 0U;
    if (!opcua_skip(r, 16U) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &count)) {
        opcua_write_service_fault(w, req_id, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_DECODING_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    if (count == 0xFFFFFFFFU) {
        count = 0U;
    } else if (count > 16U) {
        count = 16U;
    }

    OPCUA_Reader scan = *r;
    OPCUA_WriteItem item;
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        if (!opcua_decode_write_item(&scan, &item)) {
            opcua_write_service_fault(w, req_id, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_DECODING_ERROR);
            return;
        }
    }

    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_WRITE);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, count);

    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        (void)opcua_decode_write_item(r, &item);
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, opcua_apply_write_item(srv, &item));
    }
}

static bool opcua_write_nodeid(OPCUA_Writer *w, const SYN_OPCUA_NodeId *id)
{
    if (id->id_type == SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_STRING) {
        (void)opcua_write_u8(w, 0x03U);
        (void)opcua_write_u16(w, id->ns_index);
        return opcua_write_string(w, id->id.str);
    }
    return opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, id->ns_index, id->id.num);
}

static bool opcua_is_root_node(const SYN_OPCUA_NodeId *id)
{
    return (id->id_type == SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_NUMERIC) && (id->id.num == SYN_OPCUA_NODEID_ROOT);
}

static void opcua_service_browse(const SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Writer *w, uint32_t req_id)
{
    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_BROWSE);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);

    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 1U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);
    (void)opcua_write_string(w, NULL);

    uint32_t ref_count = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < srv->node_count; i++) {
        if (!opcua_is_root_node(&srv->nodes[i].node_id)) {
            ref_count++;
        }
    }
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, ref_count);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < srv->node_count; i++) {
        const SYN_OPCUA_Node *n = &srv->nodes[i];
        if (opcua_is_root_node(&n->node_id)) {
            continue;
        }
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, 47U);
        (void)opcua_write_u8(w, 0U);
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid(w, &n->node_id);
        (void)opcua_write_string(w, n->browse_name);
        (void)opcua_write_string(w, n->display_name);
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, (uint32_t)n->node_class);
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, 0U);
    }
}

static void opcua_dispatch_service(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint32_t req_type_id, uint32_t req_id,
                                   OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_Writer *w)
{
    if (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_CREATE_SESSION) {
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_CREATE_SESSION);
        (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 1U, 1001U);
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 1U, 1002U);
        (void)opcua_write_u64(w, 3600000U);
        srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SESSION_CREATED;
        return;
    }
    if (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_ACTIVATE_SESSION) {
        if (srv->state < SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SESSION_CREATED) {
            opcua_write_service_fault(w, req_id, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_SESSION_ID_INVALID);
            return;
        }
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_ACTIVATE_SESSION);
        (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);
        srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SESSION_ACTIVE;
        return;
    }
    if (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_CLOSE_SESSION) {
        if (srv->state < SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SESSION_CREATED) {
            opcua_write_service_fault(w, req_id, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_SESSION_ID_INVALID);
            return;
        }
        (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, SYN_OPCUA_RESP_CLOSE_SESSION);
        (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
        (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_GOOD);
        srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SECURE_CHANNEL;
        return;
    }
    if ((req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_READ) || (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_WRITE) ||
        (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_BROWSE)) {
        if (srv->state != SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            opcua_write_service_fault(w, req_id, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVATED);
            return;
        }
        if (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_READ) {
            opcua_service_read(srv, r, w, req_id);
        } else if (req_type_id == SYN_OPCUA_REQ_WRITE) {
            opcua_service_write(srv, r, w, req_id);
        } else {
            opcua_service_browse(srv, w, req_id);
        }
        return;
    }
    (void)opcua_write_nodeid_num(w, 0U, req_type_id + 3U);
    (void)opcua_write_u64(w, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, SYN_OPCUA_STATUS_BAD_SERVICE_UNSUPPORTED);
}

static SYN_Status opcua_handle_msg(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, OPCUA_Reader *r, OPCUA_Writer *w,
                                   size_t *out_len)
{
    uint32_t channel_id = 0U;
    uint32_t token_id = 0U;
    uint32_t seq_num = 0U;
    uint32_t req_id = 0U;
    uint16_t req_ns = 0U;
    uint32_t req_type_id = 0U;
    if (!opcua_read_u32(r, &channel_id) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &token_id) ||
        !opcua_read_u32(r, &seq_num) || !opcua_read_u32(r, &req_id) ||
        !opcua_read_nodeid_num(r, &req_ns, &req_type_id)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }
    (void)seq_num;
    (void)req_ns;

    if ((srv->state < SYN_OPCUA_STATE_SECURE_CHANNEL) || (channel_id != srv->secure_channel_id) ||
        (token_id != srv->security_token_id)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    (void)opcua_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)"MSGF", 4U);
    size_t len_pos = w->pos;
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, 0U);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->secure_channel_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->security_token_id);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, srv->sequence_number++);
    (void)opcua_write_u32(w, req_id);

    opcua_dispatch_service(srv, req_type_id, req_id, r, w);

    if (w->error) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    opcua_patch_u32_len(w, len_pos);
    *out_len = w->pos;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_process_message(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, const uint8_t *rx, size_t rx_len,
                                            uint8_t *tx, size_t max_tx, size_t *out_len)
{
    if (srv == NULL || rx == NULL || tx == NULL || out_len == NULL || rx_len < 8U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *out_len = 0U;
    OPCUA_Reader r;
    opcua_reader_init(&r, rx, rx_len);
    r.pos = 4U;

    uint32_t message_size = 0U;
    (void)opcua_read_u32(&r, &message_size);
    if (message_size < 8U || (size_t)message_size > rx_len) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    r.size = (size_t)message_size;

    OPCUA_Writer w;
    opcua_writer_init(&w, tx, max_tx);

    if (memcmp(rx, "HELF", 4U) == 0) {
        return opcua_handle_hel(srv, &w, out_len);
    }
    if (memcmp(rx, "OPNF", 4U) == 0) {
        return opcua_handle_opn(srv, &r, &w, out_len);
    }
    if (memcmp(rx, "MSGF", 4U) == 0) {
        return opcua_handle_msg(srv, &r, &w, out_len);
    }
    if (memcmp(rx, "CLOF", 4U) == 0) {
        srv->state = SYN_OPCUA_STATE_CLOSED;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

static bool opcua_drain_one_rx_frame(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv)
{
    if (srv->rx_pending < 8U) {
        return false;
    }

    const uint8_t *frame = srv->cfg.rx_buf;
    uint32_t msg_size = (uint32_t)frame[4] | ((uint32_t)frame[5] << 8U) |
                        ((uint32_t)frame[6] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)frame[7] << 24U);
    if ((msg_size < 8U) || ((size_t)msg_size > srv->cfg.rx_buf_size)) {
        srv->rx_pending = 0U;
        return false;
    }
    if ((size_t)msg_size > srv->rx_pending) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t tx_len = 0U;
    SYN_Status st = syn_opcua_server_process_message(srv, frame, (size_t)msg_size, srv->cfg.tx_buf,
                                                     srv->cfg.tx_buf_size, &tx_len);
    if ((st == SYN_OK) && (tx_len > 0U)) {
        (void)syn_transport_send(srv->cfg.transport, srv->cfg.tx_buf, tx_len);
    }

    size_t rem = srv->rx_pending - (size_t)msg_size;
    if (rem > 0U) {
        (void)memmove(srv->cfg.rx_buf, &srv->cfg.rx_buf[msg_size], rem);
    }
    srv->rx_pending = rem;
    return true;
}

static bool opcua_recv_rx_bytes(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv)
{
    size_t avail = srv->cfg.rx_buf_size - srv->rx_pending;
    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (syn_transport_recv(srv->cfg.transport, &srv->cfg.rx_buf[srv->rx_pending], avail, &rx_len) &&
        (rx_len > 0U)) {
        srv->rx_pending += rx_len;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static SYN_Status opcua_server_step_pt_once(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint32_t now_ms,
                                            bool *out_progressed)
{
    (void)now_ms;
    *out_progressed = false;
    if (srv->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (opcua_drain_one_rx_frame(srv)) {
        *out_progressed = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (opcua_recv_rx_bytes(srv)) {
        (void)opcua_drain_one_rx_frame(srv);
        *out_progressed = true;
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool opcua_pt_more_work(const SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, bool progressed)
{
    if (!progressed) {
        return false;
    }
    if (srv->rx_pending >= 8U) {
        return true;
    }
    return (srv->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL) && syn_transport_has_data(srv->cfg.transport);
}

SYN_Status syn_opcua_server_step(SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv, uint32_t now_ms)
{
    (void)now_ms;
    if ((srv == NULL) || (srv->cfg.transport == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)opcua_recv_rx_bytes(srv);
    while (opcua_drain_one_rx_frame(srv)) {
        /* Drain all buffered frames for synchronous callers */
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_opcua_server_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if ((pt == NULL) || (task == NULL) || (task->user_data == NULL)) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_OPCUA_Server *srv = (SYN_OPCUA_Server *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        bool progressed = false;
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (opcua_server_step_pt_once(srv, now, &progressed) != SYN_OK) {
            break;
        }
        if (opcua_pt_more_work(srv, progressed)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
        } else {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_OPCUA */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic OPC UA Binary protocol engine: * UACP (OPC UA Connection Protocol) framing (HEL, ACK, ERR). * UASC (OPC UA Secure Conversation) framing (OPN, CLO, MSG) with Security Policy None & Basic256Sha256. * Static In-Memory Address Space: Object, Variable, and Method nodes with numeric & string NodeIds. * Core Services: Read, Write, Browse, CreateSession, ActivateSession, CreateSubscription, Publish. * Non-blocking poll step API and cooperative protothread continuation for Scheduling.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#include "syn_pmbus.h"

#include <math.h>

#if !defined(SYN_USE_PMBUS) || SYN_USE_PMBUS

float syn_pmbus_linear11_to_float(uint16_t raw)
{
    int8_t exponent = (int8_t)((raw >> 11U) & 0x1FU);
    if ((exponent & 0x10) != 0) {
        exponent |= (int8_t)0xF0;
    }
    int16_t mantissa = (int16_t)(raw & 0x07FFU);
    if ((mantissa & 0x0400) != 0) {
        mantissa |= (int16_t)0xF800;
    }
    float f_mantissa = (float)mantissa;
    if (exponent >= 0) {
        return f_mantissa * (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)exponent);
    }
    return f_mantissa / (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)(-exponent));
}

uint16_t syn_pmbus_float_to_linear11(float val)
{
    if (isnan(val) || val == 0.0f) {
        return 0U;
    }
    if (isinf(val)) {
        return (val > 0.0f) ? 0x7BFFU : 0x7C00U;
    }

    int8_t exponent = 0;
    float temp = val;

    while (temp >= 1023.0f && exponent < 15) {
        temp /= 2.0f;
        exponent++;
    }
    while (temp <= -1024.0f && exponent < 15) {
        temp /= 2.0f;
        exponent++;
    }
    while (temp > -512.0f && temp < 512.0f && exponent > -16) {
        temp *= 2.0f;
        exponent--;
    }

    if (temp > 1023.0f) {
        temp = 1023.0f;
    } else if (temp < -1024.0f) {
        temp = -1024.0f;
    }

    int16_t mantissa = (int16_t)temp;
    uint16_t u_exp = (uint16_t)(((uint8_t)exponent) & 0x1FU);
    uint16_t u_mant = (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)mantissa) & 0x07FFU);
    return (uint16_t)((u_exp << 11U) | u_mant);
}

float syn_pmbus_linear16_to_float(uint16_t raw, uint8_t vout_mode)
{
    int8_t exponent = (int8_t)(vout_mode & 0x1FU);
    if ((exponent & 0x10) != 0) {
        exponent |= (int8_t)0xF0;
    }
    float f_mantissa = (float)raw;
    if (exponent >= 0) {
        return f_mantissa * (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)exponent);
    }
    return f_mantissa / (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)(-exponent));
}

uint16_t syn_pmbus_float_to_linear16(float val, uint8_t vout_mode)
{
    if (isnan(val)) {
        return 0U;
    }
    int8_t exponent = (int8_t)(vout_mode & 0x1FU);
    if ((exponent & 0x10) != 0) {
        exponent |= (int8_t)0xF0;
    }
    float scaled = val;
    if (exponent >= 0) {
        scaled /= (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)exponent);
    } else {
        scaled *= (float)((uint32_t)1U << (uint8_t)(-exponent));
    }
    if (scaled < 0.0f) {
        scaled = 0.0f;
    }
    if (scaled > 65535.0f) {
        scaled = 65535.0f;
    }
    return (uint16_t)(scaled + 0.5f);
}

void syn_pmbus_encode_read_cmd(SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, uint8_t slave_addr, uint8_t cmd, bool use_pec)
{
    if (pkt == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    pkt->slave_addr = slave_addr;
    pkt->command = cmd;
    pkt->proto = SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD;
    pkt->pec_enabled = use_pec;
    pkt->length = 0U;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_PMBUS */

#include "syntropic/proto/syn_sbus.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_sbus_init(SYN_SBUS_Parser *parser)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_sbus_decode_buffer(const uint8_t buf[SYN_SBUS_FRAME_SIZE], SYN_SBUS_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!buf || !frame) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    bool valid_footer = (buf[24] == 0x00U) || ((buf[24] & 0x0FU) == 0x04U);
    if ((buf[0] != SYN_SBUS_HEADER) || ((buf[23] & 0xF0U) != 0U) || !valid_footer) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    /* Unpack 16 11-bit channels from bytes 1..22 */
    frame->channels[0] = (uint16_t)(((buf[1]) | (buf[2] << 8)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[1] = (uint16_t)(((buf[2] >> 3) | (buf[3] << 5)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[2] = (uint16_t)(((buf[3] >> 6) | (buf[4] << 2) | (buf[5] << 10)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[3] = (uint16_t)(((buf[5] >> 1) | (buf[6] << 7)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[4] = (uint16_t)(((buf[6] >> 4) | (buf[7] << 4)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[5] = (uint16_t)(((buf[7] >> 7) | (buf[8] << 1) | (buf[9] << 9)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[6] = (uint16_t)(((buf[9] >> 2) | (buf[10] << 6)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[7] = (uint16_t)(((buf[10] >> 5) | (buf[11] << 3)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[8] = (uint16_t)(((buf[12]) | (buf[13] << 8)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[9] = (uint16_t)(((buf[13] >> 3) | (buf[14] << 5)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[10] = (uint16_t)(((buf[14] >> 6) | (buf[15] << 2) | (buf[16] << 10)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[11] = (uint16_t)(((buf[16] >> 1) | (buf[17] << 7)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[12] = (uint16_t)(((buf[17] >> 4) | (buf[18] << 4)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[13] = (uint16_t)(((buf[18] >> 7) | (buf[19] << 1) | (buf[20] << 9)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[14] = (uint16_t)(((buf[20] >> 2) | (buf[21] << 6)) & 0x07FFU);
    frame->channels[15] = (uint16_t)(((buf[21] >> 5) | (buf[22] << 3)) & 0x07FFU);

    /* Flags in byte 23 */
    uint8_t flags = buf[23];
    frame->ch17 = (flags & 0x01U) != 0;
    frame->ch18 = (flags & 0x02U) != 0;
    frame->frame_loss = (flags & 0x04U) != 0;
    frame->failsafe = (flags & 0x08U) != 0;

    return SYN_OK;
}

static void sbus_resync(SYN_SBUS_Parser *parser)
{
    for (size_t i = 1U; i < SYN_SBUS_FRAME_SIZE; i++) {
        if (parser->buf[i] == SYN_SBUS_HEADER) {
            size_t rem = SYN_SBUS_FRAME_SIZE - i;
            (void)memmove(parser->buf, &parser->buf[i], rem);
            parser->idx = (uint8_t)rem;
            return;
        }
    }
    parser->idx = 0U;
}

SYN_Status syn_sbus_parse_byte(SYN_SBUS_Parser *parser, uint8_t byte, SYN_SBUS_Frame *frame)
{
    if (!parser) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Start of new frame */
    if (parser->idx == 0) {
        if (byte != SYN_SBUS_HEADER) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    parser->buf[parser->idx++] = byte;

    if (parser->idx >= SYN_SBUS_FRAME_SIZE) {
        SYN_Status status = syn_sbus_decode_buffer(parser->buf, &parser->last_frame);
        if (status == SYN_OK) {
            parser->idx = 0U;
            parser->frames_received++;
            if (parser->last_frame.frame_loss) {
                parser->frame_loss_count++;
            }
            if (parser->last_frame.failsafe) {
                parser->failsafe_count++;
            }
            if (frame) {
                *frame = parser->last_frame;
            }
            return SYN_OK;
        }
        sbus_resync(parser);
        return status;
    }

    return SYN_BUSY;
}

uint16_t syn_sbus_raw_to_us(uint16_t raw_val)
{
    if (raw_val < 172U) {
        return 1000U;
    }
    if (raw_val > 1811U) {
        return 2000U;
    }

    /*
     * Linear interpolation:
     * raw range: [172, 1811] -> span = 1639
     * us range:  [1000, 2000] -> span = 1000
     * us = 1000 + ((raw_val - 172) * 1000) / 1639
     */
    uint32_t val = (uint32_t)(raw_val - 172U);
    uint32_t us = 1000U + ((val * 1000U) / 1639U);
    return (uint16_t)us;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: SBUS Protocol Specifications: * Baud rate: 100,000 bps, 8 data bits, Even parity, 2 stop bits (8E2), Inverted logic. * Frame length: 25 bytes. * Header byte: 0x0F * Channels: 16 11-bit channels (packed bitstream across bytes 1..22, raw range 172..1811, 1000..2000 us). * Flags (byte 23): Channel 17 (bit 0), Channel 18 (bit 1), Frame Loss (bit 2), Failsafe (bit 3). * Footer byte: 0x00 (or 0x04 for endbyte flags).

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#include "syn_smbus.h"

#include <string.h>

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SMBUS) || SYN_USE_SMBUS

uint8_t syn_smbus_calc_pec(uint8_t init_crc, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
{
    if (data == NULL) {
        return init_crc;
    }
    uint8_t crc = init_crc;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
            if ((crc & 0x80U) != 0U) {
                crc = (uint8_t)((crc << 1U) ^ 0x07U);
            } else {
                crc = (uint8_t)(crc << 1U);
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

static bool smbus_has_request_pec(SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto)
{
    return (proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_SEND_BYTE || proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BYTE ||
            proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_WORD || proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BLOCK);
}

static SYN_Status smbus_encode_write(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, uint8_t addr_w, uint8_t *tx_buf,
                                     size_t buf_size, size_t pec_extra, size_t *out_idx)
{
    size_t idx = 0U;

    switch (pkt->proto) {
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_SEND_BYTE:
        if (buf_size < (2U + pec_extra)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        break;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BYTE:
        if (buf_size < (3U + pec_extra)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        tx_buf[idx++] = (pkt->length > 0U) ? pkt->data[0] : 0U;
        break;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_WORD:
        if (buf_size < (4U + pec_extra)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        tx_buf[idx++] = (pkt->length >= 1U) ? pkt->data[0] : 0U;
        tx_buf[idx++] = (pkt->length >= 2U) ? pkt->data[1] : 0U;
        break;

    default: {
        uint8_t payload_len =
            (pkt->length > SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN) ? SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN : pkt->length;
        if (buf_size < (3U + (size_t)payload_len + pec_extra)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        tx_buf[idx++] = payload_len;
        if (payload_len > 0U) {
            memcpy(&tx_buf[idx], pkt->data, payload_len);
            idx += payload_len;
        }
        break;
    }
    }

    *out_idx = idx;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_encode_proc_call(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, uint8_t addr_w,
                                         uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t buf_size, size_t *out_idx)
{
    size_t idx = 0U;

    if (pkt->proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL) {
        if (buf_size < 4U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        tx_buf[idx++] = (pkt->length >= 1U) ? pkt->data[0] : 0U;
        tx_buf[idx++] = (pkt->length >= 2U) ? pkt->data[1] : 0U;
    } else {
        uint8_t payload_len =
            (pkt->length > SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN) ? SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN : pkt->length;
        if (buf_size < (3U + (size_t)payload_len)) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[idx++] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[idx++] = pkt->command;
        tx_buf[idx++] = payload_len;
        if (payload_len > 0U) {
            memcpy(&tx_buf[idx], pkt->data, payload_len);
            idx += payload_len;
        }
    }

    *out_idx = idx;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_encode_read_or_call(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, uint8_t addr_w,
                                            uint8_t addr_r, uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t buf_size,
                                            size_t *out_idx)
{
    switch (pkt->proto) {
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_QUICK_READ:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_QUICK_WRITE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_RECEIVE_BYTE:
        if (buf_size < 1U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[0] = (pkt->proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_QUICK_WRITE) ? addr_w : addr_r;
        *out_idx = 1U;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BLOCK:
        if (buf_size < 2U) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        tx_buf[0] = addr_w;
        tx_buf[1] = pkt->command;
        *out_idx = 2U;
        return SYN_OK;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_BLOCK_PROCESS_CALL:
        return smbus_encode_proc_call(pkt, addr_w, tx_buf, buf_size, out_idx);

    default:
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_smbus_encode_packet(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, uint8_t *tx_buf, size_t buf_size,
                                   size_t *out_len)
{
    if (pkt == NULL || tx_buf == NULL || out_len == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t addr_w = (uint8_t)(pkt->slave_addr << 1U);
    uint8_t addr_r = (uint8_t)((pkt->slave_addr << 1U) | 0x01U);
    bool append_pec = pkt->pec_enabled && smbus_has_request_pec(pkt->proto);
    size_t idx = 0U;
    SYN_Status st;

    if (smbus_has_request_pec(pkt->proto)) {
        st = smbus_encode_write(pkt, addr_w, tx_buf, buf_size, append_pec ? 1U : 0U, &idx);
    } else {
        st = smbus_encode_read_or_call(pkt, addr_w, addr_r, tx_buf, buf_size, &idx);
    }

    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }

    if (append_pec) {
        tx_buf[idx] = syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, tx_buf, idx);
        idx++;
    }

    *out_len = idx;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static uint8_t smbus_calc_call_pec(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *req_pkt, uint8_t addr_w, uint8_t addr_r)
{
    if (req_pkt->proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL) {
        uint8_t hdr[5] = {addr_w, req_pkt->command, (req_pkt->length >= 1U) ? req_pkt->data[0] : 0U,
                          (req_pkt->length >= 2U) ? req_pkt->data[1] : 0U, addr_r};
        return syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, hdr, sizeof(hdr));
    }

    uint8_t wlen =
        (req_pkt->length > SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN) ? SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN : req_pkt->length;
    uint8_t hdr[3] = {addr_w, req_pkt->command, wlen};
    uint8_t crc = syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, hdr, sizeof(hdr));
    if (wlen > 0U) {
        crc = syn_smbus_calc_pec(crc, req_pkt->data, wlen);
    }
    return syn_smbus_calc_pec(crc, &addr_r, 1U);
}

uint8_t syn_smbus_calc_transaction_pec(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *req_pkt, const uint8_t *rx_data,
                                       size_t rx_data_len)
{
    if (req_pkt == NULL || (rx_data == NULL && rx_data_len > 0U)) {
        return 0U;
    }

    uint8_t addr_w = (uint8_t)(req_pkt->slave_addr << 1U);
    uint8_t addr_r = (uint8_t)((req_pkt->slave_addr << 1U) | 0x01U);
    uint8_t crc = 0U;

    switch (req_pkt->proto) {
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_RECEIVE_BYTE:
        crc = syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, &addr_r, 1U);
        break;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BLOCK: {
        uint8_t hdr[3] = {addr_w, req_pkt->command, addr_r};
        crc = syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, hdr, sizeof(hdr));
        break;
    }

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_BLOCK_PROCESS_CALL:
        crc = smbus_calc_call_pec(req_pkt, addr_w, addr_r);
        break;

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_SEND_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_WORD:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BLOCK: {
        uint8_t hdr[2] = {addr_w, req_pkt->command};
        crc = syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, hdr, sizeof(hdr));
        break;
    }

    default:
        break;
    }

    return syn_smbus_calc_pec(crc, rx_data, rx_data_len);
}

static SYN_Status smbus_parse_u8(SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto, size_t data_len, bool has_pec,
                                 size_t *payload_off, uint8_t *payload_len, bool *is_full)
{
    *payload_len = 1U;
    if (data_len == 1U) {
        *payload_off = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_RECEIVE_BYTE) && (data_len == 2U)) {
        *payload_off = 1U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BYTE) && (data_len == 4U)) {
        *payload_off = 3U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BYTE) ||
         ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BYTE) && !has_pec)) &&
        (data_len == 3U)) {
        *payload_off = 2U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_parse_u16(SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto, size_t data_len, bool has_pec,
                                  size_t *payload_off, uint8_t *payload_len, bool *is_full)
{
    *payload_len = 2U;
    if (data_len == 2U) {
        *payload_off = 0U;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL) && (data_len == 7U)) {
        *payload_off = 5U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD) && (data_len == 5U)) {
        *payload_off = 3U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    if (((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_WORD) ||
         ((proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD) && !has_pec)) &&
        (data_len == 4U)) {
        *payload_off = 2U;
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }
    return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
}

static bool smbus_match_addr_w(uint8_t slave_addr, uint8_t wire_addr_w)
{
    if (slave_addr != 0U) {
        return wire_addr_w == (uint8_t)(slave_addr << 1U);
    }
    return (wire_addr_w & 1U) == 0U;
}

static bool smbus_parse_bpc_block(uint8_t slave_addr, const uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t data_len,
                                  size_t *payload_off, uint8_t *payload_len)
{
    if (data_len >= 5U && smbus_match_addr_w(slave_addr, rx_buf[0]) &&
        rx_buf[2] <= SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN && (4U + (size_t)rx_buf[2]) < data_len) {
        size_t addr_r_idx = 3U + (size_t)rx_buf[2];
        size_t cnt_idx = addr_r_idx + 1U;
        uint8_t rx_cnt = rx_buf[cnt_idx];
        if (rx_buf[addr_r_idx] == (uint8_t)(rx_buf[0] | 1U) && rx_cnt <= SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN &&
            (cnt_idx + 1U + (size_t)rx_cnt) == data_len) {
            *payload_off = cnt_idx + 1U;
            *payload_len = rx_cnt;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool smbus_parse_full_block(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf,
                                   size_t data_len, size_t *payload_off, uint8_t *payload_len)
{
    if (data_len < 3U || !smbus_match_addr_w(pkt->slave_addr, rx_buf[0])) {
        return false;
    }

    if (pkt->proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BLOCK) {
        if (data_len >= 4U && rx_buf[2] == (uint8_t)(rx_buf[0] | 1U) &&
            rx_buf[3] <= SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN && (4U + (size_t)rx_buf[3]) == data_len) {
            *payload_off = 4U;
            *payload_len = rx_buf[3];
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (pkt->proto == SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_BLOCK_PROCESS_CALL) {
        return smbus_parse_bpc_block(pkt->slave_addr, rx_buf, data_len, payload_off, payload_len);
    }

    if (rx_buf[2] <= SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN && (3U + (size_t)rx_buf[2]) == data_len) {
        *payload_off = 3U;
        *payload_len = rx_buf[2];
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_parse_block(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf,
                                    size_t data_len, size_t *payload_off, uint8_t *payload_len,
                                    bool *is_full)
{
    if (smbus_parse_full_block(pkt, rx_buf, data_len, payload_off, payload_len)) {
        *is_full = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (data_len >= 1U && rx_buf[0] <= SYN_SMBUS_BLOCK_MAX_LEN &&
        (1U + (size_t)rx_buf[0]) == data_len) {
        *payload_off = 1U;
        *payload_len = rx_buf[0];
        *is_full = false;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_verify_rx_pec(SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t rx_len,
                                      size_t data_len, bool has_pec, bool is_full)
{
    if (!has_pec) {
        pkt->pec = 0U;
        pkt->pec_valid = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    uint8_t calc_pec = is_full ? syn_smbus_calc_pec(0U, rx_buf, data_len)
                               : syn_smbus_calc_transaction_pec(pkt, rx_buf, data_len);
    pkt->pec = rx_buf[rx_len - 1U];
    pkt->pec_valid = (pkt->pec == calc_pec);
    return pkt->pec_valid ? SYN_OK : SYN_ERROR;
}

static SYN_Status smbus_parse_rx_payload(const SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf,
                                         size_t data_len, bool has_pec, size_t *payload_off,
                                         uint8_t *payload_len, bool *is_full)
{
    SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto = pkt->proto;
    switch (proto) {
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_RECEIVE_BYTE:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BYTE:
        return smbus_parse_u8(proto, data_len, has_pec, payload_off, payload_len, is_full);

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_WORD:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_WORD:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_PROCESS_CALL:
        return smbus_parse_u16(proto, data_len, has_pec, payload_off, payload_len, is_full);

    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_WRITE_BLOCK:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_READ_BLOCK:
    case SYN_SMBUS_PROTO_BLOCK_PROCESS_CALL:
        return smbus_parse_block(pkt, rx_buf, data_len, payload_off, payload_len, is_full);

    default:
        *is_full = true;
        *payload_len = (uint8_t)((data_len > 255U) ? 255U : data_len);
        return SYN_OK;
    }
}

SYN_Status syn_smbus_decode_packet(SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t rx_len,
                                   SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto, bool has_pec)
{
    if (pkt == NULL || rx_buf == NULL || (has_pec && rx_len < 1U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    pkt->proto = proto;
    pkt->pec_enabled = has_pec;
    size_t data_len = has_pec ? (rx_len - 1U) : rx_len;
    size_t payload_off = 0U;
    uint8_t payload_len = 0U;
    bool is_full = false;

    SYN_Status st = smbus_parse_rx_payload(pkt, rx_buf, data_len, has_pec, &payload_off,
                                           &payload_len, &is_full);
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }

    st = smbus_verify_rx_pec(pkt, rx_buf, rx_len, data_len, has_pec, is_full);
    if (st != SYN_OK) {
        return st;
    }

    pkt->length = payload_len;
    if (payload_len > 0U) {
        memcpy(pkt->data, &rx_buf[payload_off], payload_len);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SMBUS */

docs.title: function syn_uds_dtc_report_test_result
docs.text:
Report diagnostic test result for a registered DTC according to ISO 14229-1 state transitions. 

bool syn_uds_dtc_report_test_result (
    SYN_UDS_Server * server,
    uint32_t dtc,
    bool failed
)

Diagnostic monitors must invoke this function whenever a periodic or event-driven test completes: * When failed is true (qualified failure): * Sets testFailed (bit 0), testFailedThisOperationCycle (bit 1), pendingDTC (bit 2), confirmedDTC (bit 3), and testFailedSinceLastClear (bit 5). * Clears testNotCompletedSinceLastClear (bit 4) and testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle (bit 6). * Sets Fault Detection Counter (FDC) to +127.

  • When failed is false (qualified pass):
  • Clears testFailed (bit 0), testNotCompletedSinceLastClear (bit 4), and testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle (bit 6).
  • Sets Fault Detection Counter (FDC) to -128.

Parameters:

  • server Pointer to UDS server instance.
  • dtc 24-bit Diagnostic Trouble Code.
  • failed True if test qualified failed, false if test qualified passed.

Returns:

true if DTC found and updated, false otherwise.

docs.title: function syn_uds_dtc_start_operation_cycle
docs.text:
Advance server state to a new operation cycle. 

bool syn_uds_dtc_start_operation_cycle (
    SYN_UDS_Server * server
)

Must be invoked at ECU ignition ON / startup and upon completion/boundary of each driving or operation cycle: * If a registered DTC completed testing during the previous cycle without any failure (testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle == 0 and testFailedThisOperationCycle == 0), clears pendingDTC (bit 2) per ISO 14229-1 Table 242. * Clears testFailedThisOperationCycle (bit 1) to 0. * Sets testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle (bit 6) to 1.

Parameters:

  • server Pointer to UDS server instance.

Returns:

true on success, false if server is NULL.

bool syn_uds_init(SYN_UDS_Server *server)
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return false;
    }

    static const uint8_t default_seed_16[16] = {0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x78, 0x90, 0xAB, 0xCD, 0xEF,
                                                0xFE, 0xDC, 0xBA, 0x98, 0x76, 0x54, 0x32, 0x10};

    memset(server, 0, sizeof(*server));
    server->session = SYN_UDS_SESSION_DEFAULT;
    server->security_state = SYN_UDS_SECURITY_LOCKED;
    server->security_level = 0U;
    server->current_seed = 0x12345678U;
    server->active_seed = 0x12345678U;
    server->use_aes128_security = false;
    memcpy(server->current_seed_bytes, default_seed_16, 16);
    memcpy(server->active_seed_bytes, default_seed_16, 16);
    server->comm_control_state = SYN_UDS_COMM_ENABLE_RX_AND_TX;
    server->dtc_setting_enabled = true;
    server->p2_max_ms = 50U;
    server->p2_star_max_10ms = 500U;
    server->active_p2_max_ms = 50U;
    server->active_p2_star_max_10ms = 500U;
    server->transfer_state = SYN_UDS_TRANSFER_IDLE;
    server->expected_block_seq = 1U;
    server->reset_tx_wait_ms = SYN_UDS_DEFAULT_RESET_TX_WAIT_MS;

    return true;
}

static int find_did_index(const SYN_UDS_Server *server, uint16_t did)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < server->did_count; i++) {
        if (server->did_table[i].did == did) {

}

static int find_dtc_index(const SYN_UDS_Server *server, uint32_t dtc)

}

static void uds_reset_default_session_state(SYN_UDS_Server *server)
{
    server->session = SYN_UDS_SESSION_DEFAULT;
    server->security_state = SYN_UDS_SECURITY_LOCKED;
    server->security_level = 0U;
    server->comm_control_state = SYN_UDS_COMM_ENABLE_RX_AND_TX;
    server->dtc_setting_enabled = true;
    server->transfer_state = SYN_UDS_TRANSFER_IDLE;
    server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
}

void syn_uds_tick(SYN_UDS_Server *server, uint32_t dt_ms)
{
    if (server == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    if (server->security_delay_timer_ms > 0U) {
        if (dt_ms >= server->security_delay_timer_ms) {
            server->security_delay_timer_ms = 0U;
            if (server->security_error_count > 0U) {
                server->security_error_count--;
            }
        } else {
            server->security_delay_timer_ms -= dt_ms;
        }
    }

    if (server->session != SYN_UDS_SESSION_DEFAULT) {
        if (dt_ms >= server->s3_timer_ms) {
            uds_reset_default_session_state(server);
        } else {
            server->s3_timer_ms -= dt_ms;
        }
    } else {
        server->s3_timer_ms = 0U;
    }

    if (server->reset_type_requested > 0U) {
        if (dt_ms > (UINT32_MAX - server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms)) {
            server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms = UINT32_MAX;
        } else {
            server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms += dt_ms;
        }
        if (server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms >= (uint32_t)server->reset_tx_wait_ms) {
            uint8_t reset_type = server->reset_type_requested;
            server->reset_type_requested = 0U;
            server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms = 0U;
            if (server->reset_cb != NULL) {
                server->reset_cb(reset_type, server->reset_ctx);
            }
        }
    } else {
        server->reset_wait_elapsed_ms = 0U;
    }
}

bool syn_uds_register_did_ext(SYN_UDS_Server *server, uint16_t did, uint8_t *data, uint16_t len,
                              bool writable, uint8_t session_mask, uint16_t security_mask)
{
    if ((server == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (len == 0U)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (server->did_count >= SYN_UDS_MAX_DIDS) {
        return false;
    }

    SYN_UDS_DIDEntry *entry = &server->did_table[server->did_count];
    entry->did = did;
    entry->data = data;
    entry->len = len;
    entry->writable = writable;
    entry->session_mask = session_mask;
    entry->security_mask = security_mask;

    server->did_count++;
    return true;
}

static bool uds_nrc(UDS_ReqCtx *ctx, uint8_t nrc)
{
    if ((ctx->addr_mode == SYN_UDS_ADDR_FUNCTIONAL) &&
        ((nrc == SYN_UDS_NRC_SERVICE_NOT_SUPPORTED) ||
         (nrc == SYN_UDS_NRC_SUBFUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED) ||
         (nrc == SYN_UDS_NRC_SUBFUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_ACTIVE_SESSION))) {
        *ctx->resp_len = 0U;
        return true;
    }
    ctx->resp_buf[0] = SYN_UDS_RESPONSE_NEGATIVE;
    ctx->resp_buf[1] = ctx->sid;
    ctx->resp_buf[2] = nrc;
    *ctx->resp_len = 3U;
    return true;
}
