/* ── Internal Helper: CDR Alignment ──────────────────────────────────────── */

static size_t cdr_pad_writer(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, size_t align)
{
    size_t remainder = w->pos % align;
    if (remainder != 0U) {
        size_t pad = align - remainder;
        if (pad > (w->size - w->pos)) {
            w->error = true;
            return w->pos;
        }
        (void)memset(&w->data[w->pos], 0, pad);
        w->pos += pad;
    }
    return w->pos;
}

static size_t cdr_pad_reader(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, size_t align)
{
    size_t remainder = r->pos % align;
    if (remainder != 0U) {
        size_t pad = align - remainder;
        if (pad > (r->size - r->pos)) {
            r->error = true;
            return r->pos;
        }
        r->pos += pad;
    }
    return r->pos;
}

/* ── CDR Writer Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_cdr_writer_init(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint8_t *buf, size_t size)
{
    if (w == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    w->data = buf;
    w->size = size;
    w->pos = 0U;
    w->error = (buf == NULL || size == 0U);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_u8(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint8_t v)
{
    if (w == NULL || w->error || (w->size - w->pos) < 1U) {
        if (w != NULL) {
            w->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = v;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_write_u16(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint16_t v)
{
    if (w == NULL || w->error) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_writer(w, 2U);
    if (w->error || (w->size - w->pos) < 2U) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_write_u32(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint32_t v)
{
    if (w == NULL || w->error) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_writer(w, 4U);
    if (w->error || (w->size - w->pos) < 4U) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16U) & 0xFFU);
    w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24U) & 0xFFU);
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_write_u64(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint64_t v)
{
    if (w == NULL || w->error) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_writer(w, 8U);
    if (w->error || (w->size - w->pos) < 8U) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 8U; i++) {
        w->data[w->pos++] = (uint8_t)((v >> (i * 8U)) & 0xFFU);
    }
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_write_i8(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, int8_t v)
{
    return syn_cdr_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)v);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_i16(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, int16_t v)
{
    return syn_cdr_write_u16(w, (uint16_t)v);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_i32(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, int32_t v)
{
    return syn_cdr_write_u32(w, (uint32_t)v);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_i64(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, int64_t v)
{
    return syn_cdr_write_u64(w, (uint64_t)v);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_float(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, float v)
{
    uint32_t u;
    (void)memcpy(&u, &v, sizeof(u));
    return syn_cdr_write_u32(w, u);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_double(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, double v)
{
    uint64_t u;
    (void)memcpy(&u, &v, sizeof(u));
    return syn_cdr_write_u64(w, u);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_bool(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, bool v)
{
    return syn_cdr_write_u8(w, v ? 1U : 0U);
}

bool syn_cdr_write_string(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, const char *str)
{
    if (w == NULL || str == NULL) {
        if (w != NULL) {
            w->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    size_t str_len = strlen(str) + 1U; /* Length including null terminator */
    if (!syn_cdr_write_u32(w, (uint32_t)str_len)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (str_len > (w->size - w->pos)) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    (void)memcpy(&w->data[w->pos], str, str_len);
    w->pos += str_len;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_write_bytes(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, const uint8_t *bytes, size_t len)
{
    if (w == NULL || w->error || (bytes == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        if (w != NULL) {
            w->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (len > (w->size - w->pos)) {
        w->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    if (len > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(&w->data[w->pos], bytes, len);
        w->pos += len;
    }
    return true;
}

/* ── CDR Reader Implementation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_cdr_reader_init(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, const uint8_t *buf, size_t size)
{
    if (r == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    r->data = buf;
    r->size = size;
    r->pos = 0U;
    r->error = (buf == NULL || size == 0U);
}

bool syn_cdr_read_u8(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint8_t *out)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || out == NULL || (r->size - r->pos) < 1U) {
        if (r != NULL) {
            r->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    *out = r->data[r->pos++];
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_u16(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint16_t *out)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_reader(r, 2U);
    if (r->error || (r->size - r->pos) < 2U) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    *out = (uint16_t)r->data[r->pos] | ((uint16_t)r->data[r->pos + 1U] << 8U);
    r->pos += 2U;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_u32(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint32_t *out)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_reader(r, 4U);
    if (r->error || (r->size - r->pos) < 4U) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    *out = (uint32_t)r->data[r->pos] | ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 1U] << 8U) |
           ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 2U] << 16U) | ((uint32_t)r->data[r->pos + 3U] << 24U);
    r->pos += 4U;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_u64(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint64_t *out)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)cdr_pad_reader(r, 8U);
    if (r->error || (r->size - r->pos) < 8U) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    uint64_t v = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 8U; i++) {
        v |= ((uint64_t)r->data[r->pos + i] << (i * 8U));
    }
    *out = v;
    r->pos += 8U;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_i8(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, int8_t *out)
{
    return syn_cdr_read_u8(r, (uint8_t *)out);
}

bool syn_cdr_read_i16(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, int16_t *out)
{
    return syn_cdr_read_u16(r, (uint16_t *)out);
}

bool syn_cdr_read_i32(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, int32_t *out)
{
    return syn_cdr_read_u32(r, (uint32_t *)out);
}

bool syn_cdr_read_i64(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, int64_t *out)
{
    return syn_cdr_read_u64(r, (uint64_t *)out);
}

bool syn_cdr_read_float(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, float *out)
{
    uint32_t u;
    if (!syn_cdr_read_u32(r, &u) || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)memcpy(out, &u, sizeof(u));
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_double(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, double *out)
{
    uint64_t u;
    if (!syn_cdr_read_u64(r, &u) || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    (void)memcpy(out, &u, sizeof(u));
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_bool(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, bool *out)
{
    uint8_t u;
    if (!syn_cdr_read_u8(r, &u) || out == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    *out = (u != 0U);
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_string(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, char *out_buf, size_t max_len)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || out_buf == NULL || max_len == 0U) {
        if (r != NULL) {
            r->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t str_len = 0U;
    if (!syn_cdr_read_u32(r, &str_len)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (str_len == 0U || (size_t)str_len > (r->size - r->pos) || (size_t)str_len > max_len ||
        r->data[r->pos + (size_t)str_len - 1U] != '\0') {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    (void)memcpy(out_buf, &r->data[r->pos], (size_t)str_len);
    r->pos += (size_t)str_len;
    return true;
}

bool syn_cdr_read_bytes(SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint8_t *out_buf, size_t len)
{
    if (r == NULL || r->error || (out_buf == NULL && len > 0U)) {
        if (r != NULL) {
            r->error = true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (len > (r->size - r->pos)) {
        r->error = true;
        return false;
    }
    if (len > 0U) {
        (void)memcpy(out_buf, &r->data[r->pos], len);
        r->pos += len;
    }
    return true;
}

/* ── Internal Framing Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void xrce_write_header(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint8_t session_id, uint8_t stream_id,
                              uint16_t seq_num, uint32_t client_key)
{
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(w, session_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(w, stream_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u16(w, seq_num);
    if (session_id < 0x80U) {
        (void)syn_cdr_write_u32(w, client_key);
    }
}

static size_t xrce_start_submessage(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, uint8_t submsg_id, uint8_t flags)
{
    (void)cdr_pad_writer(w, 4U);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(w, submsg_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(w, flags | SYN_XRCE_FLAG_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
    size_t len_pos = w->pos;
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u16(w, 0U); /* Placeholder for submessage payload length */
    return len_pos;
}

static void xrce_finish_submessage(SYN_CDR_Writer *w, size_t len_pos)
{
    if (w->error || w->pos < 2U || len_pos > (w->pos - 2U)) {
        return;
    }
    size_t payload_len = (w->pos - 2U) - len_pos;
    if (payload_len > UINT16_MAX) {
        w->error = true;
        return;
    }
    uint16_t submsg_len = (uint16_t)payload_len;
    w->data[len_pos] = (uint8_t)(submsg_len & 0xFFU);
    w->data[len_pos + 1U] = (uint8_t)((submsg_len >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
}

SYN_Status syn_xrce_client_init(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, const SYN_XRCE_Config *cfg)
{
    if (client == NULL || cfg == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->transport == NULL || cfg->rx_buf == NULL || cfg->tx_buf == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (cfg->rx_buf_size < 128U || cfg->tx_buf_size < 128U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    (void)memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
    client->cfg = *cfg;
    if (client->cfg.client_key == 0U) {
        client->cfg.client_key = SYN_XRCE_CLIENT_KEY_DEFAULT;
    }
    if (client->cfg.session_id == 0U) {
        client->cfg.session_id = SYN_XRCE_SESSION_ID_DEFAULT;
    }
    if (client->cfg.heartbeat_period_ms == 0U) {
        client->cfg.heartbeat_period_ms = SYN_XRCE_DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_MS;
    }

    client->state = SYN_XRCE_STATE_DISCONNECTED;
    client->next_req_id = 1U;
    client->stream_seq_num = 1U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_xrce_client_create_session(SYN_XRCE_Client *client)
{
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_CDR_Writer w;
    syn_cdr_writer_init(&w, client->cfg.tx_buf, client->cfg.tx_buf_size);

    /* Sessionless Header */
    xrce_write_header(&w, 0x00U, 0x00U, 0U, client->cfg.client_key);

    /* CREATE_CLIENT Submessage */
    size_t len_pos = xrce_start_submessage(&w, SYN_XRCE_SUBMSG_CREATE_CLIENT, 0U);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u32(&w, client->cfg.client_key);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(&w, client->cfg.session_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_write_u16(&w, (uint16_t)client->cfg.tx_buf_size);
    xrce_finish_submessage(&w, len_pos);

    if (w.error || !syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, w.data, w.pos)) {
        client->state = SYN_XRCE_STATE_ERROR;
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    client->state = SYN_XRCE_STATE_CONNECTING;
    client->heartbeat_sent = false;
    client->last_heartbeat_ms = 0U;
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void xrce_register_local_object(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, uint16_t id, uint8_t kind,

static void xrce_handle_status(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, uint16_t req_id, uint16_t obj_id,
                               uint8_t status)
{
    bool is_ok = (status == SYN_XRCE_STATUS_OK) || (status == SYN_XRCE_STATUS_OK_MATCHED);
    if (is_ok) {
        if (client->state == SYN_XRCE_STATE_CONNECTING) {
            client->state = SYN_XRCE_STATE_CONNECTED;
        }
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < client->object_count; i++) {
            if (client->objects[i].id == obj_id) {
                client->objects[i].configured = true;
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (client->state == SYN_XRCE_STATE_CONNECTING && obj_id == 0U) {
            client->state = SYN_XRCE_STATE_ERROR;
        }
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < client->object_count; i++) {
            if (client->objects[i].id == obj_id) {
                client->object_count--;
                for (size_t j = i; j < client->object_count; j++) {
                    client->objects[j] = client->objects[j + 1U];
                }
                (void)memset(&client->objects[client->object_count], 0, sizeof(SYN_XRCE_Object));
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (client->cfg.on_status != NULL) {
        client->cfg.on_status(req_id, status, client->cfg.user_data);
    }
}

static void xrce_dispatch_submessage(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, SYN_CDR_Reader *r, uint8_t submsg_id,
                                     size_t submsg_end)
{
    if (submsg_id == SYN_XRCE_SUBMSG_STATUS) {
        uint16_t req_id = 0U;
        uint16_t obj_id = 0U;
        uint8_t status = 0U;
        uint8_t impl_status = 0U;
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(r, &req_id);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(r, &obj_id);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(r, &status);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(r, &impl_status);

        if (!r->error && r->pos <= submsg_end) {
            xrce_handle_status(client, req_id, obj_id, status);
        }
    } else if (submsg_id == SYN_XRCE_SUBMSG_DATA) {
        uint16_t req_id = 0U;
        uint16_t obj_id = 0U;
        uint8_t data_fmt = 0U;
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(r, &req_id);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(r, &obj_id);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(r, &data_fmt);

        if (!r->error && r->pos <= submsg_end) {
            size_t pld_len = submsg_end - r->pos;
            if (client->cfg.on_data != NULL && pld_len > 0U) {
                client->cfg.on_data(obj_id, &r->data[r->pos], pld_len, client->cfg.user_data);
            }
        }
    } else {
        /* Skip other submessages */
    }
}

static void xrce_parse_rx_frame(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, size_t rx_len)
{
    SYN_CDR_Reader r;
    syn_cdr_reader_init(&r, client->cfg.rx_buf, rx_len);

    uint8_t session_id = 0U;
    uint8_t stream_id = 0U;
    uint16_t seq_num = 0U;
    (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(&r, &session_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(&r, &stream_id);
    (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(&r, &seq_num);

    if (session_id < 0x80U) {
        uint32_t client_key = 0U;
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u32(&r, &client_key);
    }

    while (!r.error && r.pos <= r.size && (r.size - r.pos) >= 4U) {
        uint8_t submsg_id = 0U;
        uint8_t flags = 0U;
        uint16_t submsg_len = 0U;
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(&r, &submsg_id);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u8(&r, &flags);
        (void)syn_cdr_read_u16(&r, &submsg_len);

        size_t submsg_start = r.pos;
        if ((size_t)submsg_len > r.size - submsg_start) {
            break;
        }

        size_t submsg_end = submsg_start + (size_t)submsg_len;
        r.size = submsg_end;
        xrce_dispatch_submessage(client, &r, submsg_id, submsg_end);
        r.size = rx_len;
        r.error = false;
        size_t next_pos = (submsg_end < r.size) ? ((submsg_end + 3U) & ~(size_t)3U) : submsg_end;
        r.pos = (next_pos <= r.size) ? next_pos : r.size;
    }
}

static SYN_Status xrce_client_step_ex(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, uint32_t now_ms,
                                      bool *out_rx_consumed)
{
    if (out_rx_consumed != NULL) {
        *out_rx_consumed = false;
    }
    if (client == NULL || client->cfg.transport == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* 1. Receive incoming frame from transport */
    size_t rx_len = 0U;
    if (syn_transport_recv(client->cfg.transport, client->cfg.rx_buf, client->cfg.rx_buf_size,
                           &rx_len) &&
        rx_len > 0U) {
        if (out_rx_consumed != NULL) {
            *out_rx_consumed = true;
        }
        if (rx_len >= 4U) {
            xrce_parse_rx_frame(client, rx_len);
        }
    }

    /* 2. Check periodic heartbeat / keep-alive */
    if (client->state == SYN_XRCE_STATE_CONNECTED &&
        (!client->heartbeat_sent ||
         (now_ms - client->last_heartbeat_ms) >= client->cfg.heartbeat_period_ms)) {
        SYN_CDR_Writer w;
        syn_cdr_writer_init(&w, client->cfg.tx_buf, client->cfg.tx_buf_size);

        xrce_write_header(&w, client->cfg.session_id, SYN_XRCE_STREAM_RELIABLE,
                          client->stream_seq_num++, client->cfg.client_key);

        size_t len_pos = xrce_start_submessage(&w, SYN_XRCE_SUBMSG_HEARTBEAT, 0U);
        (void)syn_cdr_write_u16(&w, 1U);
        (void)syn_cdr_write_u16(&w, client->stream_seq_num);
        (void)syn_cdr_write_u8(&w, SYN_XRCE_STREAM_RELIABLE);
        xrce_finish_submessage(&w, len_pos);

        if (!w.error) {
            (void)syn_transport_send(client->cfg.transport, w.data, w.pos);
            client->last_heartbeat_ms = now_ms;
            client->heartbeat_sent = true;
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_xrce_client_step(SYN_XRCE_Client *client, uint32_t now_ms)
{
    return xrce_client_step_ex(client, now_ms, NULL);
}

SYN_PT_Status syn_xrce_client_pt(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_XRCE_Client *client = (SYN_XRCE_Client *)task->user_data;

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        bool rx_consumed = false;
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        if (xrce_client_step_ex(client, now, &rx_consumed) != SYN_OK) {
            break;
        }
        if (rx_consumed && client->cfg.transport != NULL &&
            client->cfg.transport->has_data != NULL &&
            syn_transport_has_data(client->cfg.transport)) {
            PT_CONTINUE_IF_NEEDED(pt, task);
        } else {
            PT_PASS(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic Micro XRCE-DDS client for ROS 2: * Common Data Representation (CDR) serializer and deserializer with strict alignment. * XRCE-DDS submessage framing (CREATE_CLIENT, CREATE, WRITE_DATA, READ_DATA, DATA, STATUS). * Full ROS 2 entity tree management (Participant, Topic, Publisher, Subscriber, DataWriter, DataReader). * Non-blocking poll ticks and cooperative protothread continuation for Scheduling.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_YMODEM) || SYN_USE_YMODEM


#include "../util/syn_crc.h"
#include "syn_ymodem.h"

#include <string.h>

#define SYN_YMODEM_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS 1000U

static void ymodem_send_byte(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, uint8_t b)
{
    rx->putchar_fn(b, rx->ctx);
}

static void ymodem_abort(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx)
{
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_CAN);
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_CAN);
}

static int ymodem_recv_byte(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    return rx->getchar_fn(timeout_ms, rx->ctx);
}

static void ymodem_parse_block0(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, const uint8_t *payload, size_t payload_len)
{
    rx->filename[0] = '\0';
    rx->filesize = 0U;
    rx->has_file_size = false;

    const uint8_t *nul_ptr = (const uint8_t *)memchr(payload, '\0', payload_len);
    size_t true_fn_len = (nul_ptr != NULL) ? (size_t)(nul_ptr - payload) : payload_len;
    size_t copy_len = (true_fn_len < (SYN_YMODEM_MAX_FILENAME - 1U))
                          ? true_fn_len
                          : (SYN_YMODEM_MAX_FILENAME - 1U);

    memcpy(rx->filename, payload, copy_len);
    rx->filename[copy_len] = '\0';

    if (nul_ptr == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    size_t pos = true_fn_len + 1U;
    while ((pos < payload_len) && (payload[pos] == (uint8_t)' ')) {
        pos++;
    }

    uint32_t parsed = 0U;
    while ((pos < payload_len) && (payload[pos] >= (uint8_t)'0') &&
           (payload[pos] <= (uint8_t)'9')) {
        rx->has_file_size = true;
        uint32_t digit = (uint32_t)(payload[pos] - (uint8_t)'0');
        if (parsed > ((UINT32_MAX - digit) / 10U)) {
            parsed = UINT32_MAX;
        } else {
            parsed = (parsed * 10U) + digit;
        }
        pos++;
    }
    rx->filesize = parsed;
}

static int ymodem_read_packet(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, uint8_t header_byte, size_t *out_payload_len)
{
    size_t payload_len = (header_byte == SYN_YMODEM_STX) ? 1024U : 128U;
    size_t total_len = payload_len + 5U;

    rx->pkt_buf[0] = header_byte;

    for (size_t i = 1U; i < total_len; i++) {
        int b = ymodem_recv_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS);
        if (b < 0) {
            return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_TIMEOUT;
        }
        rx->pkt_buf[i] = (uint8_t)b;
    }

    uint8_t seq = rx->pkt_buf[1];
    uint8_t seq_inv = rx->pkt_buf[2];
    if ((uint8_t)(seq + seq_inv) != 0xFFU) {
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_SEQUENCE;
    }

    uint16_t computed_crc = syn_crc16_ccitt_update(0x0000U, &rx->pkt_buf[3], payload_len);
    uint16_t rx_crc =
        (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)rx->pkt_buf[3U + payload_len] << 8) | rx->pkt_buf[4U + payload_len]);
    if (computed_crc != rx_crc) {
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CRC;
    }

    *out_payload_len = payload_len;
    return (int)seq;
}

static SYN_YMODEM_Status ymodem_handshake_block0(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, bool *session_done)
{
    uint8_t retries = 0U;
    int first_byte = -1;

    while (retries < SYN_YMODEM_MAX_RETRIES) {
        ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_CRC);
        first_byte = ymodem_recv_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS);
        if (first_byte >= 0) {
            break;
        }
        retries++;
    }

    if (first_byte < 0) {
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_TIMEOUT;
    }
    if (first_byte == (int)SYN_YMODEM_CAN) {
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CANCEL;
    }
    if ((first_byte != (int)SYN_YMODEM_SOH) && (first_byte != (int)SYN_YMODEM_STX)) {
        ymodem_abort(rx);
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_SEQUENCE;
    }

    size_t payload_len = 0U;
    int seq_or_err = ymodem_read_packet(rx, (uint8_t)first_byte, &payload_len);
    if (seq_or_err < 0) {
        ymodem_abort(rx);
        return (SYN_YMODEM_Status)seq_or_err;
    }
    if (seq_or_err != 0) {
        ymodem_abort(rx);
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_SEQUENCE;
    }

    if (rx->pkt_buf[3] == (uint8_t)'\0') {
        ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_ACK);
        if (rx->event_fn != NULL) {
            (void)rx->event_fn(SYN_YMODEM_EVENT_SESSION_END, NULL, 0U, rx->ctx);
        }
        *session_done = true;
        return SYN_YMODEM_OK;
    }

    ymodem_parse_block0(rx, &rx->pkt_buf[3], payload_len);
    if (rx->event_fn != NULL) {
        int cb_res = rx->event_fn(SYN_YMODEM_EVENT_FILE_START, (const uint8_t *)rx->filename,
                                  strlen(rx->filename), rx->ctx);
        if (cb_res != 0) {
            ymodem_abort(rx);
            return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CANCEL;
        }
    }

    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_ACK);
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_CRC);
    *session_done = false;
    return SYN_YMODEM_OK;
}

static void ymodem_finish_eot(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx)
{
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_NAK);
    (void)ymodem_recv_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS);
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_ACK);

    if (rx->event_fn != NULL) {
        (void)rx->event_fn(SYN_YMODEM_EVENT_FILE_END, NULL, 0U, rx->ctx);
    }
}

static SYN_YMODEM_Status ymodem_process_data_block(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, size_t data_payload_len)
{
    size_t chunk_len = data_payload_len;
    if (rx->has_file_size) {
        uint32_t remaining =
            (rx->bytes_received < rx->filesize) ? (rx->filesize - rx->bytes_received) : 0U;
        if (remaining < chunk_len) {
            chunk_len = (size_t)remaining;
        }
    }

    if ((rx->event_fn != NULL) && (chunk_len > 0U)) {
        int cb_res = rx->event_fn(SYN_YMODEM_EVENT_DATA, &rx->pkt_buf[3], chunk_len, rx->ctx);
        if (cb_res != 0) {
            ymodem_abort(rx);
            return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CANCEL;
        }
    }

    uint32_t add_len = (uint32_t)chunk_len;
    uint32_t max_add = UINT32_MAX - rx->bytes_received;
    rx->bytes_received += (add_len > max_add) ? max_add : add_len;
    rx->expected_seq++;
    ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_ACK);
    return SYN_YMODEM_OK;
}

static SYN_YMODEM_Status ymodem_receive_file_data(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx)
{
    rx->expected_seq = 1U;
    rx->bytes_received = 0U;
    uint8_t retries = 0U;

    for (;;) {
        int header_byte = ymodem_recv_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS);
        if (header_byte < 0) {
            ymodem_abort(rx);
            return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_TIMEOUT;
        }

        if (header_byte == (int)SYN_YMODEM_CAN) {
            if (ymodem_recv_byte(rx, 100U) == (int)SYN_YMODEM_CAN) {
                return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CANCEL;
            }
        }

        if (header_byte == (int)SYN_YMODEM_EOT) {
            ymodem_finish_eot(rx);
            return SYN_YMODEM_OK;
        }

        int block_seq = -1;
        size_t data_payload_len = 0U;
        if ((header_byte == (int)SYN_YMODEM_SOH) || (header_byte == (int)SYN_YMODEM_STX)) {
            block_seq = ymodem_read_packet(rx, (uint8_t)header_byte, &data_payload_len);
            if (block_seq == SYN_YMODEM_ERR_TIMEOUT) {
                ymodem_abort(rx);
                return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_TIMEOUT;
            }
        }

        if (block_seq < 0) {
            retries++;
            if (retries >= SYN_YMODEM_MAX_RETRIES) {
                ymodem_abort(rx);
                return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_CRC;
            }
            ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_NAK);
            continue;
        }

        retries = 0U;
        if ((uint8_t)block_seq == (uint8_t)(rx->expected_seq - 1U)) {
            ymodem_send_byte(rx, SYN_YMODEM_ACK);
            continue;
        }
        if ((uint8_t)block_seq != rx->expected_seq) {
            ymodem_abort(rx);
            return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_SEQUENCE;
        }

        SYN_YMODEM_Status st = ymodem_process_data_block(rx, data_payload_len);
        if (st != SYN_YMODEM_OK) {
            return st;
        }
    }
}

void syn_ymodem_receiver_init(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx, SYN_YMODEM_PutChar putchar_fn,
                              SYN_YMODEM_GetChar getchar_fn, SYN_YMODEM_EventCallback event_fn,
                              void *ctx)
{
    if (rx == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    memset(rx, 0, sizeof(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver));
    rx->putchar_fn = putchar_fn;
    rx->getchar_fn = getchar_fn;
    rx->event_fn = event_fn;
    rx->ctx = ctx;
}

SYN_YMODEM_Status syn_ymodem_receive(SYN_YMODEM_Receiver *rx)
{
    if ((rx == NULL) || (rx->putchar_fn == NULL) || (rx->getchar_fn == NULL)) {
        return SYN_YMODEM_ERR_PARAM;
    }

    for (;;) {
        bool session_done = false;
        SYN_YMODEM_Status st = ymodem_handshake_block0(rx, &session_done);
        if (st != SYN_YMODEM_OK) {
            return st;
        }
        if (session_done) {
            return SYN_YMODEM_OK;
        }

        st = ymodem_receive_file_data(rx);
        if (st != SYN_YMODEM_OK) {
            return st;
        }
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_YMODEM */

docs.text:
Implements a lightweight, zero-allocation YMODEM (and XMODEM-1K compatible) batch file transfer receiver state machine for microcontroller bootloaders. docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Protothreads provide lightweight, cooperative multitasking without requiring a separate stack per thread. Each protothread is a normal C function that uses macros to save and restore its execution position via the switch/__LINE__ continuation trick (Duff's device).

A protothread costs 2 bytes of RAM (the continuation variable).

** **

  • You cannot use a bare switch statement inside a protothread body (use if/else if chains instead).
  • Local variables are NOT preserved across yield/wait points. Store persistent state in static variables, globals, or a struct passed via the task's user_data pointer.
  • A protothread must reside entirely within a single function.

** **

static SYN_PT pt;
PT_INIT(&pt);

while (1) {
    my_protothread(&pt);
    // ... poll other protothreads ...
}

** **

// See syn_sched.h for the full pattern.
static SYN_PT_Status my_task(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task) {
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    // ...
    PT_END(pt);
}

** **

// High-level C code
SYN_PT_Status my_task(SYN_PT *pt) {
    PT_BEGIN(pt);
    PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, flag == 1);
    PT_END(pt);
}

// Expands preprocessor output to:
SYN_PT_Status my_task(SYN_PT *pt) {
    char _pt_yield_flag = 1;
    switch (pt->lc) {
    case 0:
        // On resume, switch(pt->lc) jumps directly to case 12:
        pt->lc = 12; case 12:
        if (!(flag == 1)) return PT_IDLE;
    }
    _pt_yield_flag = 0;
    PT_INIT(pt);
    return PT_ENDED;
}

docs.title: define PT_BLOCK_CONDITION
docs.text:
Sleep task (SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) until explicitly resumed. 

#define PT_BLOCK_CONDITION (
    pt,
    task,
    cond
) `/* multi line expression */`

Warning:

This macro does NOT poll cond on each scheduler tick. Once the task yields as BLOCKED, the scheduler skips it entirely. The condition is only re-evaluated when the task is explicitly woken by an ISR or driver calling syn_task_resume(task).

For polled condition blocking, use PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, cond) instead. For event-flag-driven blocking, use PT_BLOCK_EVENT(pt, task, grp, mask).

Parameters:

  • pt Protothread.
  • task Pointer to the SYN_Task struct.
  • cond Boolean condition expression to evaluate.

docs.title: define PT_BLOCK_EVENT
docs.text:
Block until ANY bit in mask is set in the event group. 

#define PT_BLOCK_EVENT (
    pt,
    task,
    grp,
    mask
) `/* multi line expression */`

Unlike PT_WAIT_EVENT (which polls every scheduler pass), this macro sets the task state to BLOCKED. The scheduler skips the task entirely until the event fires, saving CPU and enabling proper tickless sleep.

Matched flags are atomically captured and auto-cleared when the scheduler dispatches the woken task.

Parameters:

  • pt Protothread.
  • task Pointer to the SYN_Task struct.
  • grp Pointer to SYN_EventGroup.
  • mask Bitmask of event flags to wait for (any of them).

docs.text:
Block task execution (SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) until ANY bit in mask is set ORtimeout_ms milliseconds elapse. 

#define PT_BLOCK_EVENT_WITH_TIMEOUT (
    pt,
    task,
    grp,
    mask,
    timeout_ms,
    out_flags
) `/* multi line expression */`

Combines event-flag blocking with millisecond deadline tracking. The task is skipped by the scheduler until either the event fires or the timeout deadline passes.

Matched event flags are captured into out_flags (if non-NULL) and auto-cleared ONLY if the event actually fired before the timeout. Check *out_flags != 0 to determine if the event fired vs timed out.

  • grp Pointer to SYN_EventFlags.
  • mask Bitmask of event flags to wait for.
  • timeout_ms Timeout duration in milliseconds.
  • out_flags Pointer to uint32_t receiving matched flags (or 0 on timeout).

docs.title: define PT_DELAY_MS
docs.text:
Non-blocking delay for ms milliseconds. 

#define PT_DELAY_MS (
    pt,
    target,
    ms
) `/* multi line expression */`

Requires a uint32_t variable to store the deadline. When used with the scheduler, pass &(task)->delay_until. For standalone use, pass any persistent uint32_t *.

Note:

The target is reset to 0 (the scheduler's "no deadline pending" sentinel) once the delay completes. A deadline left in place would read as "in the future" again after the tick counter advances 2^31 ms (~24.8 days) past it, freezing the task. A computed deadline of exactly 0 (tick wrap) is nudged to 1 (or 0xFFFFFFFF when clamped == INT32_MAX) so it cannot alias the sentinel while keeping (int32_t)(dl - now) > 0. Durations exceeding INT32_MAX ms are clamped to INT32_MAX ms, and ms is evaluated exactly once.

Parameters:

  • target Pointer to a uint32_t that will hold the deadline tick.

#ifndef SYN_PT_H
#define SYN_PT_H

#include "../common/syn_barrier.h"
#include "../common/syn_compiler.h"
#include "../common/syn_defs.h"
#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
#define SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER()     \
    do {                           \
        SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();    \
        syn_port_memory_barrier(); \
    } while (0)
#else
#define SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER() SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER()
#endif

/* ── Protothread continuation ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint16_t lc; 
} SYN_PT;

/* ── Return status ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef enum {
    PT_IDLE = 0,   
    PT_MORE = 1,   
    PT_EXITED = 2, 
    PT_ENDED = 3,  
} SYN_PT_Status;

/* ── Core macros ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_INIT(pt) ((pt)->lc = 0)

#define PT_BEGIN(pt)             \
    do {                         \
        char _pt_yield_flag = 1; \
        (void)_pt_yield_flag;    \
        switch ((pt)->lc) {      \
        case 0:

#define PT_END(pt)      \
    }                   \
    _pt_yield_flag = 0; \
    PT_INIT(pt);        \
    return PT_ENDED;    \
    }                   \
    while (0)

#define PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, cond)                          \
    do {                                                 \
        (pt)->lc = __LINE__;                             \
        SYN_FALLTHROUGH; /* intentional Duff's device */ \
    case __LINE__:                                       \
        if (!(cond)) {                                   \
            return PT_IDLE;                              \
        }                                                \
    } while (0)

#define PT_WAIT_WHILE(pt, cond) PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, !(cond))

#define PT_PASS(pt)                \
    do {                           \
        _pt_yield_flag = 0;        \
        (pt)->lc = __LINE__;       \
        SYN_FALLTHROUGH;           \
    case __LINE__:                 \
        if (_pt_yield_flag == 0) { \
            return PT_IDLE;        \
        }                          \
    } while (0)

#define PT_CONTINUE(pt)            \
    do {                           \
        _pt_yield_flag = 0;        \
        (pt)->lc = __LINE__;       \
        SYN_FALLTHROUGH;           \
    case __LINE__:                 \
        if (_pt_yield_flag == 0) { \
            return PT_MORE;        \
        }                          \
    } while (0)

#define PT_EXIT(pt)       \
    do {                  \
        PT_INIT(pt);      \
        return PT_EXITED; \
    } while (0)

#define PT_RESTART(pt)  \
    do {                \
        PT_INIT(pt);    \
        return PT_IDLE; \
    } while (0)

/* ── Child / sub-protothread ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_SPAWN(pt, child, func)            \
    do {                                     \
        PT_INIT(child);                      \
        (pt)->lc = __LINE__;                 \
        SYN_FALLTHROUGH;                     \
    case __LINE__: {                         \
        SYN_PT_Status _pt_child_st = (func); \
        if (_pt_child_st < PT_EXITED) {      \
            return _pt_child_st;             \
        }                                    \
    }                                        \
    } while (0)

/* ── Timer-aware delay (requires task descriptor) ───────────────────────── */

/*
 * PT_DELAY_MS needs access to both the tick source and a place to store
 * the delay target. When used with the scheduler (syn_task.h), the
 * SYN_Task struct provides `delay_until`. For standalone use, provide
 * your own uint32_t target variable.
 */

static inline bool syn_pt_arm_ms_deadline(uint32_t *target, uint32_t now, uint32_t ms)
{
    if (ms == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t clamped = (ms > 0x7FFFFFFFU) ? 0x7FFFFFFFU : ms;
    uint32_t dl = now + clamped;
    if (dl == 0U) {
        /* Avoid 0 sentinel; nudge backward at INT32_MAX so (dl - now) stays positive */
        dl = (clamped == 0x7FFFFFFFU) ? 0xFFFFFFFFU : 1U;
    }
    *target = dl;
    return true;
}

static inline bool syn_pt_arm_us_deadline(uint32_t *target, uint32_t now, uint32_t us)
{
    if (us == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t clamped = (us > 0x7FFFFFFFU) ? 0x7FFFFFFFU : us;
    *target = now + clamped;
    return true;
}

#define PT_DELAY_MS(pt, target, ms)                                                     \
    do {                                                                                \
        if (syn_pt_arm_ms_deadline((target), syn_port_get_tick_ms(), (uint32_t)(ms))) { \
            PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, (int32_t)(syn_port_get_tick_ms() - *(target)) >= 0);      \
            *(target) = 0U; /* consume — stale deadlines wrap to "future" */            \
        }                                                                               \
    } while (0)

#define PT_TASK_DELAY_MS(pt, task, ms) PT_DELAY_MS(pt, &(task)->delay_until, ms)

#define PT_DELAY_US(pt, target, us)                                                     \
    do {                                                                                \
        if (syn_pt_arm_us_deadline((target), syn_port_get_tick_us(), (uint32_t)(us))) { \
            PT_WAIT_UNTIL(pt, (int32_t)(syn_port_get_tick_us() - *(target)) >= 0);      \
        }                                                                               \
    } while (0)

#define PT_BLOCK_EVENT(pt, task, grp, mask)                                                      \
    do {                                                                                         \
        if (syn_task_arm_event_wait((task), (SYN_EventFlags *)(grp), (mask), false, 0U, NULL)) { \
            while ((task)->wait_event != NULL) {                                                 \
                syn_task_park_blocked((task));                                                   \
                PT_PASS(pt);                                                                     \
            }                                                                                    \
            (task)->wait_mask = 0U;                                                              \
        }                                                                                        \
    } while (0)

#define PT_BLOCK_EVENT_WITH_TIMEOUT(pt, task, grp, mask, timeout_ms, out_flags)    \
    do {                                                                           \
        uint32_t *_syn_ef_out = (out_flags);                                       \
        if (syn_task_arm_event_wait((task), (SYN_EventFlags *)(grp), (mask), true, \
                                    (uint32_t)(timeout_ms), _syn_ef_out)) {        \
            while ((task)->wait_event != NULL) {                                   \
                syn_task_park_blocked((task));                                     \
                PT_PASS(pt);                                                       \
            }                                                                      \
            (task)->delay_until = 0U;                                              \
            {                                                                      \
                uint32_t *_syn_ef_post = (out_flags);                              \
                if (_syn_ef_post != NULL) {                                        \
                    *_syn_ef_post = (task)->wait_mask;                             \
                }                                                                  \
            }                                                                      \
            (task)->wait_mask = 0U;                                                \
        }                                                                          \
    } while (0)

#define PT_BLOCK_CONDITION(pt, task, cond)                        \
    do {                                                          \
        while (1) {                                               \
            syn_port_enter_critical();                            \
            if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {       \
                (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED;        \
                SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();                           \
            }                                                     \
            syn_port_exit_critical();                             \
            if (cond) {                                           \
                syn_port_enter_critical();                        \
                if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) { \
                    (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;      \
                }                                                 \
                syn_port_exit_critical();                         \
                break;                                            \
            }                                                     \
            PT_PASS(pt);                                          \
        }                                                         \
    } while (0)

/* ── Query macros ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_IS_RUNNING(pt) ((pt)->lc != 0)

#define PT_IS_IDLE(pt) ((pt)->lc == 0)

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Provides inter-protothread synchronization with zero RAM overhead beyond the 2-byte counter itself. All operations are macro/inline — no .c file is needed.

** **

static SYN_PT_Sem data_ready;
PT_SEM_INIT(&data_ready, 0);

// Producer (can be called from ISR):
PT_SEM_SIGNAL(&data_ready);

// Consumer (inside a protothread):
PT_SEM_WAIT(pt, &data_ready);
// ... data is now available ...

#ifndef SYN_PT_SEM_H
#define SYN_PT_SEM_H

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "syn_pt.h"

#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Semaphore structure ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    volatile int16_t count; 
} SYN_PT_Sem;

/* ── Initialization ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_SEM_INIT(sem, initial) ((sem)->count = (int16_t)(initial))

/* ── Blocking wait (protothread context) ────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_SEM_WAIT(pt, sem) PT_WAIT_UNTIL((pt), pt_sem_trywait(sem) != 0)

#define PT_SEM_BLOCK(pt, task, sem) PT_BLOCK_CONDITION((pt), (task), pt_sem_trywait(sem) != 0)

/* ── Signal (any context) ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static inline void pt_sem_signal(SYN_PT_Sem *sem)
{
    if (sem == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    int16_t cur = sem->count;
    if (cur < INT16_MAX) {
        sem->count = (int16_t)(cur + 1);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

#define PT_SEM_SIGNAL(sem) pt_sem_signal(sem)

/* ── Non-blocking try ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static inline int pt_sem_trywait(SYN_PT_Sem *sem)
{
    if (sem == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    int acquired = 0;

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (sem->count > 0) {
        sem->count = (int16_t)(sem->count - 1);
        acquired = 1;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    return acquired;
}

#define PT_SEM_TRYWAIT(sem) pt_sem_trywait(sem)

/* ── Query ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define PT_SEM_COUNT(sem) ((sem)->count)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SYN_PT_SEM_H */

#endif


#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../sched/syn_sched.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_ao.h"

static bool ao_dispatch_event(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_ActiveObject *ao, SYN_AO_Event ev)
{
    bool was_idle = PT_IS_IDLE(pt);
    if (was_idle) {
        pt->lc = 1U;
    }
    ao->last_event = ev;
    syn_fsm_dispatch(&ao->fsm, (SYN_FSM_Event)ev.sig);
    if (PT_IS_IDLE(pt)) {
        return true;
    }
    if (was_idle) {
        PT_INIT(pt);
    }
    return false;
}

static SYN_PT_Status syn_ao_pt_run(SYN_PT *pt, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (pt == NULL || task == NULL || task->user_data == NULL) {
        return PT_EXITED;
    }

    SYN_ActiveObject *ao = (SYN_ActiveObject *)task->user_data;
    size_t burst_budget = syn_mailbox_pending(&ao->mailbox);
    if (burst_budget == 0U) {
        burst_budget = 1U;
    }

    PT_BEGIN(pt);

    for (;;) {
        /* Block task until mailbox is not empty */
        PT_BLOCK_CONDITION(pt, task, !syn_mailbox_empty(&ao->mailbox));

        SYN_AO_Event ev;
        while (burst_budget > 0U && syn_mailbox_receive(&ao->mailbox, &ev)) {
            if (ao_dispatch_event(pt, ao, ev)) {
                return PT_MORE;
            }
            burst_budget--;
            if (task->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {
                PT_PASS(pt);
            }
            if (!syn_mailbox_empty(&ao->mailbox) && syn_task_should_share(task)) {
                PT_CONTINUE(pt);
            }
        }
        if (!syn_mailbox_empty(&ao->mailbox)) {
            PT_CONTINUE(pt);
        }
    }

    PT_END(pt); /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
}

void syn_ao_init(SYN_ActiveObject *ao, SYN_Task *task, const char *name, SYN_Prio priority,
                 const SYN_FSM_Transition *transitions, SYN_FSM_State initial_state,
                 void *mailbox_buf, size_t mailbox_cap)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ao != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(mailbox_buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(mailbox_cap >= 2U);

    /* LCOV_EXCL_START: Defensive NULL/bounds check */
    if (ao == NULL || task == NULL || mailbox_buf == NULL || mailbox_cap < 2U) {
        return;
    }
    /* LCOV_EXCL_STOP */

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    memset(&ao->last_event, 0, sizeof(ao->last_event));
    ao->task = NULL;
    ao->mailbox.buf = NULL;
    ao->mailbox.capacity = 0U;

    /* Initialize FSM and bound scheduler task before publishing mailbox/task */
    syn_fsm_init(&ao->fsm, transitions, initial_state, name);
    syn_fsm_set_context(&ao->fsm, ao);
    syn_task_create(task, name, syn_ao_pt_run, priority, ao);

    /* Publish mailbox and bound task atomically */
    syn_mailbox_init(&ao->mailbox, mailbox_buf, sizeof(SYN_AO_Event), mailbox_cap);
    ao->task = task;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

bool syn_ao_post(SYN_ActiveObject *ao, uint16_t sig, void *data)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(ao != NULL);
    if (ao == NULL) {
        return false; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check */
    }

    SYN_AO_Event ev;
    memset(&ev, 0, sizeof(ev));
    ev.sig = sig;
    ev.data = data;

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool success = syn_mailbox_post(&ao->mailbox, &ev);
    if (success && ao->task != NULL && ao->task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) {
        syn_task_resume(ao->task);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    return success;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_AO */

#include "syn_event_flags.h"

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"

SYN_Status syn_event_flags_init(SYN_EventFlags *ef)
{
    if (!ef)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    ef->flags = 0;
    return SYN_OK;
}

/*
 * set/clear/wait are callable from both ISR and task context. `volatile`
 * alone does not make |= / &= atomic (LDR+ORR/BIC+STR on Cortex-M), so a
 * preempting ISR's flag update can be lost to a stale read-modify-write.
 * Critical sections make the RMW atomic; syn_port_enter_critical() nests.
 */
SYN_Status syn_event_flags_set(SYN_EventFlags *ef, uint32_t flags_mask)
{
    if (!ef)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    ef->flags |= flags_mask;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_event_flags_clear(SYN_EventFlags *ef, uint32_t flags_mask)
{
    if (!ef)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    ef->flags &= ~flags_mask;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return SYN_OK;
}

uint32_t syn_event_flags_get(const SYN_EventFlags *ef)
{
    if (!ef)
        return 0;
    return ef->flags;
}

SYN_Status syn_event_flags_wait(SYN_EventFlags *ef, uint32_t wait_mask, uint32_t mode,
                                uint32_t *out_flags)
{
    if (!ef || wait_mask == 0)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    /* Read and auto-clear must be one atomic unit: an ISR setting an
     * unrelated bit between them would be clobbered by the stale RMW. */
    syn_port_enter_critical();

    uint32_t current = ef->flags;
    uint32_t matched = current & wait_mask;
    bool satisfied = false;

    if (mode & SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_WAIT_ALL) {
        satisfied = (matched == wait_mask);
    } else {
        /* Default to WAIT_ANY */
        satisfied = (matched != 0);
    }

    if (!satisfied) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return SYN_BUSY; /* Condition not yet satisfied */
    }

    if (mode & SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_AUTO_CLEAR) {
        ef->flags &= ~matched;
    }

    syn_port_exit_critical();

    if (out_flags) {
        *out_flags = matched;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Passes fixed-size messages between producer (ISR or task) and consumer (task). Lock-free single-producer single-consumer design.

When SYN_USE_MULTICORE is enabled, acquire/release memory barriers are inserted at every index access, making the mailbox safe for cross-core communication (core A posts, core B receives). When multicore is disabled (the default), these compile to plain volatile reads and writes — zero overhead.

** **

The mailbox has exactly two indices: * head — written ONLY by the producer * tail — written ONLY by the consumer

Producer syn_mailbox_post(): * Read tail (LOAD_ACQUIRE) — observe consumer's latest progress * If full, return false * memcpy message data into buf[head * msg_size] * Write head = next (STORE_RELEASE) — data committed before index

Consumer syn_mailbox_receive(): * Read head (LOAD_ACQUIRE) — observe producer's latest index * If empty, return false * memcpy message from buf[tail * msg_size] — safe: data visible * Write tail = next (STORE_RELEASE) — slot freed for producer

** **

typedef struct { uint16_t id; int32_t value; } SensorMsg;

// Static allocation
SYN_MAILBOX_DEFINE(sensor_mbox, SensorMsg, 8);

// Producer (ISR or other core):
SensorMsg msg = { .id = 1, .value = 2345 };
syn_mailbox_post(&sensor_mbox, &msg);

// Consumer (main loop or other core):
SensorMsg rx;
while (syn_mailbox_receive(&sensor_mbox, &rx)) {
    process(rx.id, rx.value);
}

/* ── Mailbox instance ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint8_t *buf;               
    size_t msg_size;            
    size_t capacity;            
    volatile size_t head;       
    volatile size_t tail;       
    volatile uint32_t overflow; 
#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
    volatile uint8_t notify; 
#endif
} SYN_Mailbox;

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
#define SYN_MAILBOX_DEFINE(name, type, count) \
    static type name##_buf[(count) + 1U];     \
    static SYN_Mailbox name = {               \
        .buf = (uint8_t *)name##_buf,         \
        .msg_size = sizeof(type),             \
        .capacity = ((count) + 1U),           \
        .head = 0,                            \
        .tail = 0,                            \
        .overflow = 0,                        \
        .notify = 0U,                         \
    }
#else

    static type name##_buf[(count) + 1U];     \
    static SYN_Mailbox name = {               \
        .buf = (uint8_t *)name##_buf,         \
        .msg_size = sizeof(type),             \
        .capacity = ((count) + 1U),           \
        .head = 0,                            \
        .tail = 0,                            \

#endif

static inline void syn_mailbox_set_overflow(SYN_Mailbox *mb, uint32_t val)
{
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    __atomic_store_n(&mb->overflow, val, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
#else
    mb->overflow = val;
#endif
}

static inline void syn_mailbox_inc_overflow(SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    uint32_t cur = __atomic_load_n(&mb->overflow, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&mb->overflow, cur + 1U, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
#else
    mb->overflow = mb->overflow + 1U;
#endif
}

static inline void syn_mailbox_init(SYN_Mailbox *mb, void *buf, size_t msg_size, size_t capacity)
{
    bool bad_cap = (msg_size > 0U) && (capacity > (SIZE_MAX / msg_size));
    mb->buf = bad_cap ? NULL : (uint8_t *)buf;
    mb->msg_size = msg_size;
    mb->capacity = bad_cap ? 0U : capacity;
    mb->head = 0;
    mb->tail = 0;
    syn_mailbox_set_overflow(mb, 0U);
#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    __atomic_store_n(&mb->notify, 0U, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
#else
    mb->notify = 0U;
#endif
#endif
}

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
static inline void syn_mailbox_set_notify(SYN_Mailbox *mb, bool enable)
{
    uint8_t val = enable ? 1U : 0U;
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    __atomic_store_n(&mb->notify, val, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    __atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
#else
    mb->notify = val;
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
#endif
}
#endif

#if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__clang__) && (__GNUC__ >= 10)
#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wanalyzer-use-of-uninitialized-value"
#endif
static inline bool syn_mailbox_post(SYN_Mailbox *mb, const void *msg)
{
    if (mb->msg_size == 0U || mb->buf == NULL || msg == NULL ||
        mb->capacity > (SIZE_MAX / mb->msg_size)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (mb->capacity <= 1U) {
        syn_mailbox_inc_overflow(mb);
        return false;
    }

    size_t head = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head);
    size_t next = head + 1U;
    if (next >= mb->capacity)
        next = 0U;

    if (next == SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail)) {
        syn_mailbox_inc_overflow(mb);
        return false;
    }

    memcpy(&mb->buf[head * mb->msg_size], msg, mb->msg_size);
    SYN_STORE_RELEASE(&mb->head, next);

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    __atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    if (__atomic_load_n(&mb->notify, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) != 0U) {
        syn_port_ipc_notify();
    }
#else
    SYN_COMPILER_BARRIER();
    syn_port_memory_barrier();
    if (mb->notify != 0U) {
        syn_port_ipc_notify();
    }
#endif
#endif

    return true;
}
#if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__clang__) && (__GNUC__ >= 10)
#pragma GCC diagnostic pop
#endif

static inline bool syn_mailbox_receive(SYN_Mailbox *mb, void *msg)
{
    if (mb->msg_size == 0U || mb->buf == NULL || msg == NULL ||
        mb->capacity > (SIZE_MAX / mb->msg_size))
        return false;

    size_t head = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head);
    size_t tail = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail);

    if (tail == head)
        return false;

    memcpy(msg, &mb->buf[tail * mb->msg_size], mb->msg_size);

    size_t next = tail + 1U;
    if (next >= mb->capacity)
        next = 0U;
    SYN_STORE_RELEASE(&mb->tail, next);

    return true;
}

static inline const void *syn_mailbox_peek(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    size_t head = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head);
    size_t tail = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail);
    if (head == tail || mb->buf == NULL || mb->msg_size == 0U ||
        mb->capacity > (SIZE_MAX / mb->msg_size))
        return NULL;
    return &mb->buf[tail * mb->msg_size];
}

static inline bool syn_mailbox_empty(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    return SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head) == SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail);
}

static inline bool syn_mailbox_full(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    if (mb->capacity <= 1U)
        return true;
    size_t next = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head) + 1U;
    if (next >= mb->capacity)
        next = 0U;
    return next == SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail);
}

static inline size_t syn_mailbox_pending(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    if (mb->capacity <= 1U)
        return 0U;
    size_t h = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head);
    size_t t = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->tail);
    return (h >= t) ? (h - t) : (mb->capacity - t + h);
}

static inline size_t syn_mailbox_free(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    /* One slot is always reserved as sentinel */
    if (mb->capacity <= 1U)
        return 0U;
    size_t pending = syn_mailbox_pending(mb);
    size_t usable = mb->capacity - 1U;
    return (usable > pending) ? (usable - pending) : 0U;
}

static inline uint32_t syn_mailbox_overflows(const SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
#if defined(SYN_BARRIER_TSAN)
    return __atomic_load_n(&mb->overflow, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
#else
    return mb->overflow;
#endif
}

static inline void syn_mailbox_flush(SYN_Mailbox *mb)
{
    size_t head = SYN_LOAD_ACQUIRE(&mb->head);
    SYN_STORE_RELEASE(&mb->tail, head);
}

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SYN_MAILBOX_H */

docs.text:
Probe and acquire the mutex without registering as a contended waiter. 

SYN_Status syn_mutex_probe (
    SYN_Mutex * mutex,
    SYN_Task * task
)

Acquires an unlocked or recursively-held mutex like syn_mutex_try_lock(), but on contention returns SYN_BUSY without adding task to the waiter list or boosting the current owner.

Note:

Single-scheduler (AMP) scope: returns SYN_INVALID_PARAM if contended against a different SYN_Sched instance.

Parameters:

  • mutex Pointer to mutex structure.
  • task Pointer to acquiring task (optional, NULL for standalone lock).

Returns:

SYN_OK if acquired, SYN_BUSY if held by another task, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

docs.title: function syn_mutex_try_lock
docs.text:
Attempt to acquire the mutex without blocking. 

SYN_Status syn_mutex_try_lock (
    SYN_Mutex * mutex,
    SYN_Task * task
)

If the mutex is already locked by another task and task has higher priority (numerically lower value) than the owner, the owner's priority is automatically boosted.

Note:

Single-scheduler (AMP) scope: all scheduled tasks (task->sched != NULL) acquiring or contending on a mutex must belong to the same SYN_Sched instance (SYN_INVALID_PARAM otherwise). Use syn_port_spinlock.h or SPSC syn_mailbox across AMP cores.

Parameters:

  • mutex Pointer to mutex structure.
  • task Pointer to acquiring task (optional, NULL for standalone lock).

Returns:

SYN_OK if acquired, SYN_BUSY if held by another task, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

docs.title: function syn_mutex_unlock
docs.text:
Release a previously acquired mutex. 

SYN_Status syn_mutex_unlock (
    SYN_Mutex * mutex,
    SYN_Task * task
)

Decrements the recursion count. When the count reaches zero, the owner's priority is restored to its base priority and ownership is cleared.

Parameters:

  • mutex Pointer to mutex structure.
  • task Pointer to owner task releasing the lock.

Returns:

SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERROR if not locked or wrong owner, or SYN_INVALID_PARAM.

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"

#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX

#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_mutex.h"
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
#include "syn_sched.h"
#endif

static bool mutex_waiter_is_active(const SYN_Task *w)
{
    return (w != NULL) && ((w->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U) &&
           (w->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) && (w->delay_until == 0U);
}

static void mutex_recompute_owner_prio(SYN_Task *owner)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    syn_sched_recompute_task_prio(owner);
#else
    uint8_t target = owner->base_priority;
    if (owner->manual_priority < target) {
        target = owner->manual_priority;
    }
    for (SYN_Mutex *m = owner->held_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_held) {
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
            const SYN_Task *w = m->waiters[i];
            if (mutex_waiter_is_active(w) && w->priority < target) {
                target = w->priority;
            }
        }
    }
    owner->priority = target;
#endif
}

static void mutex_boost_owner_prio(SYN_Task *owner)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    syn_sched_boost_task_prio(owner);
#else
    mutex_recompute_owner_prio(owner);
#endif
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
static bool mutex_has_waiter(const SYN_Mutex *m, const SYN_Task *task)
{
    for (size_t j = 0U; j < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; j++) {
        if (m->waiters[j] == task) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool mutex_is_tracked_in_sched(const SYN_Sched *sched, const SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (sched == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    for (const SYN_Mutex *m = sched->standalone_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_contended) {
        if (mutex_has_waiter(m, task)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        for (const SYN_Mutex *m = sched->tasks[i].held_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_held) {
            if (mutex_has_waiter(m, task)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static void mutex_wake_evicted_waiters(const SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    if (sched == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    uint8_t clr = (uint8_t)~(SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        SYN_Task *t = &sched->tasks[i];
        if (mutex_waiter_is_active(t) && !mutex_is_tracked_in_sched(sched, t)) {
            t->sched_flags = (uint8_t)((t->sched_flags & clr) | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE);
        }
    }
}
#endif

static void mutex_clear_task_wait(SYN_Task *task)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    syn_sched_clear_mutex_wait(task);
#else
    task->sched_flags &= (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT;
#endif
}

static void mutex_bind_wait_sched(SYN_Mutex *mutex, const SYN_Task *task)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    struct SYN_Sched *owner_sched = (mutex->owner != NULL) ? mutex->owner->sched : NULL;
    if (mutex->wait_sched == NULL && task->sched != NULL && task->sched != owner_sched) {
        mutex->wait_sched = task->sched;
        mutex->next_contended = task->sched->standalone_mutexes;
        task->sched->standalone_mutexes = mutex;
    }
#else
    (void)mutex;
    (void)task;
#endif
}

static void mutex_record_waiter(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task)
{
    size_t free_idx = SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS;
    size_t worst_idx = SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS;
    bool present = false;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
        SYN_Task *w = mutex->waiters[i];
        if (!mutex_waiter_is_active(w)) {
            mutex->waiters[i] = NULL;
            if (free_idx == SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS) {
                free_idx = i;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (w == task) {
            present = true;
        }
        if (worst_idx == SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS ||
            w->priority > mutex->waiters[worst_idx]->priority) {
            worst_idx = i;
        }
    }

    if (task->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY || task->delay_until != 0U) {
        return;
    }
    mutex_bind_wait_sched(mutex, task);
    task->sched_flags |= SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT;
    if (present) {
        return;
    }
    if (free_idx < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS) {
        mutex->waiters[free_idx] = task;
    } else {
        mutex->has_evicted = true;
        if (task->priority < mutex->waiters[worst_idx]->priority) {
            mutex->waiters[worst_idx] = task;
        }
    }
}

static void mutex_unlink_held(SYN_Mutex **pp, const SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    while (*pp != NULL) {
        if (*pp == mutex) {
            *pp = (*pp)->next_held;
            return;
        }
        pp = &(*pp)->next_held;
    }
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
static void mutex_unlink_contended(SYN_Mutex **pp, const SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    while (*pp != NULL) {
        if (*pp == mutex) {
            *pp = (*pp)->next_contended;
            return;
        }
        pp = &(*pp)->next_contended;
    }
}
#endif

static void mutex_contend_waiter(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (task != NULL) {
        mutex_record_waiter(mutex, task);
        if (mutex->owner != NULL) {
            mutex_boost_owner_prio(mutex->owner);
        }
    }
}

static bool mutex_has_sched_conflict(const SYN_Mutex *mutex, const SYN_Task *task)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    if (task == NULL || task->sched == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    struct SYN_Sched *active_sched = (mutex->owner != NULL && mutex->owner->sched != NULL)
                                         ? mutex->owner->sched
                                         : mutex->wait_sched;
    return (active_sched != NULL) && (active_sched != task->sched);
#else
    (void)mutex;
    (void)task;
    return false;
#endif
}

static SYN_Status mutex_acquire_impl(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task, bool wait_on_busy)
{
    if (mutex == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();

    /* Case 1: Mutex is currently unlocked */
    if (mutex->owner == NULL && mutex->lock_count == 0U) {
        mutex->owner = task;
        mutex->next_contended = NULL;
        mutex->wait_sched = NULL;
        mutex->lock_count = 1U;
        mutex->has_evicted = false;
        if (task != NULL) {
            mutex_clear_task_wait(task);
            mutex->next_held = task->held_mutexes;
            task->held_mutexes = mutex;
        } else {
            mutex->next_held = NULL;
        }
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    /* Case 2: Recursive acquisition by the current owner */
    if (task != NULL && mutex->owner == task) {
        if (mutex->lock_count == UINT16_MAX) {
            syn_port_exit_critical();
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        mutex->lock_count++;
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    if (mutex_has_sched_conflict(mutex, task)) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* Case 3: Contended by another task */
    if (wait_on_busy) {
        mutex_contend_waiter(mutex, task);
    }

    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return SYN_BUSY;
}

static void mutex_wake_direct_waiters(SYN_Task *const woken[SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS])
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
        SYN_Task *w = woken[i];
        if (mutex_waiter_is_active(w)) {
            uint8_t clr = (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED;
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
            if (!mutex_is_tracked_in_sched(w->sched, w)) {
                clr = (uint8_t)(clr & (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT);
            }
#else
            clr = (uint8_t)(clr & (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT);
#endif
            w->sched_flags = (uint8_t)((w->sched_flags & clr) | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE);
        }
    }
}

static void mutex_finish_unlock(SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    SYN_Task *prev_owner = mutex->owner;
    struct SYN_Sched *owner_sched = (prev_owner != NULL) ? prev_owner->sched : NULL;
    struct SYN_Sched *ext_sched = mutex->wait_sched;
    SYN_Task *woken[SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS];

    mutex->owner = NULL;
    mutex->wait_sched = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
        woken[i] = mutex->waiters[i];
        mutex->waiters[i] = NULL;
    }

    if (prev_owner != NULL) {
        mutex_unlink_held(&prev_owner->held_mutexes, mutex);
    }
    mutex->next_held = NULL;
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    if (ext_sched != NULL) {
        mutex_unlink_contended(&ext_sched->standalone_mutexes, mutex);
    }
#else
    (void)owner_sched;
    (void)ext_sched;
#endif
    mutex->next_contended = NULL;

    mutex_wake_direct_waiters(woken);

    if (mutex->has_evicted) {
        mutex->has_evicted = false;
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
        mutex_wake_evicted_waiters(owner_sched);
        mutex_wake_evicted_waiters(ext_sched);
#endif
    }
    if (prev_owner != NULL) {
        mutex_recompute_owner_prio(prev_owner);
    }
#if !defined(SYN_USE_SCHED) || SYN_USE_SCHED
    if (ext_sched != NULL) {
        syn_sched_refresh_share(ext_sched);
    }
#endif
}

SYN_Status syn_mutex_init(SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    if (mutex == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    mutex->owner = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
        mutex->waiters[i] = NULL;
    }
    mutex->next_held = NULL;
    mutex->next_contended = NULL;
    mutex->wait_sched = NULL;
    mutex->lock_count = 0U;
    mutex->has_evicted = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_mutex_try_lock(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task)
{
    return mutex_acquire_impl(mutex, task, true);
}

SYN_Status syn_mutex_probe(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task)
{
    return mutex_acquire_impl(mutex, task, false);
}

SYN_Status syn_mutex_unlock(SYN_Mutex *mutex, SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (mutex == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();

    if (mutex->lock_count == 0U || mutex->owner != task) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    mutex->lock_count--;
    if (mutex->lock_count == 0U) {
        mutex_finish_unlock(mutex);
    }

    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return SYN_OK;
}

bool syn_mutex_is_locked(const SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    if (mutex == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    return (mutex->lock_count > 0U);
}

SYN_Task *syn_mutex_get_owner(const SYN_Mutex *mutex)
{
    if (mutex == NULL) {
        return NULL;
    }
    return mutex->owner;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_MUTEX */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text: Provides recursive mutual exclusion with priority inheritance to prevent unbounded priority inversion. If a higher-priority task attempts to acquire a mutex held by a lower-priority task, the owner's priority is temporarily boosted to match the waiting task until the mutex is released.

Probe and acquire the mutex without registering as a contended waiter. 

SYN_Status syn_mutex_probe (
    SYN_Mutex * mutex,

Acquires an unlocked or recursively-held mutex like syn_mutex_try_lock(), but on contention returns SYN_BUSY without adding task to the waiter list or boosting the current owner.

    SYN_Task * task

If the mutex is already locked by another task and task has higher priority (numerically lower value) than the owner, the owner's priority is automatically boosted.

docs.title: function syn_task_boost_priority
docs.text:
Temporarily boost a task's execution priority. 

void syn_task_boost_priority (
    SYN_Task * task,
    SYN_Prio temp_prio
)

Monotonically ratchets task->priority upward when temp_prio < task->priority (SYN_PRIO_CRITICAL = 0 is highest); calls with temp_prio >= task->priority are ignored so active higher boosts are never lowered. Promotes the task to Work rank and tightens due_ms to the boosted priority's starvation window when bound to a scheduler.

Note:

Main-loop / task context only (not ISR-safe).

Parameters:

  • task Task to boost.
  • temp_prio Temporary elevated priority.

    SYN_ASSERT(func != NULL);

    task->base_priority = (uint8_t)priority;
    task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;
    task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE;
    task->delay_until = 0U;
    task->due_ms = 0U;
    task->sched = NULL;
    task->held_mutexes = NULL;
    task->user_data = user_data;
    task->wait_event = NULL;
    task->wait_mask = 0U;

    syn_port_exit_critical();
