static bool sched_is_event_ready(const SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now)
{
    if (task->wait_event != NULL &&
        (syn_event_flags_get(task->wait_event) & task->wait_mask) != 0U) {
        return true;
    }
    return (task->delay_until != 0U) && ((int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0);
}

static bool sched_is_async_wake(const SYN_Task *peer, uint32_t now)
{
    if ((peer->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING) == 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (peer->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED || peer->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD) {
        return false;
    }
    if (peer->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED || peer->wait_event != NULL) {
        return peer->wait_event != NULL && sched_is_event_ready(peer, now);
    }
    return (peer->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE) != 0U &&
           (peer->delay_until == 0U || (int32_t)(now - peer->delay_until) >= 0);
}

static uint32_t sched_wakeup_base_tick(const SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now, bool sleeping)
{
    if (sleeping && task->delay_until != 0U && (int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0) {
        return task->delay_until;
    }
    return now;
}

static bool sched_peer_woke(const SYN_Sched *sched, const SYN_Task *running, SYN_Task *peer,
                            uint32_t now)
{
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (peer->sched == NULL && peer->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {
        peer->sched = (SYN_Sched *)sched;
        peer->sched_flags |= (uint8_t)(SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE);
    }
    if (!sched_is_async_wake(peer, now)) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }
    if (peer->priority <= running->priority) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return true;
    }
    if ((peer->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID) == 0U) {
        uint32_t base = sched_wakeup_base_tick(peer, now, true);
        peer->due_ms = base + (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[peer->priority];
        peer->sched_flags |= SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID;
    }
    uint32_t due = peer->due_ms;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return (int32_t)(now - due) >= 0;
}

bool syn_task_should_share(const SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (task == NULL || task->sched == NULL || task->sched->running != task) {
        return false;
    }

    const SYN_Sched *sched = task->sched;
    if (sched->share_contended) {
        return true;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if (sched->share_has_deadline && (int32_t)(now - sched->share_deadline_ms) >= 0) {
        return true;
    }
    if (!sched->share_watch_wakeups) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        SYN_Task *peer = &sched->tasks[i];
        if (peer != task && sched_peer_woke(sched, task, peer, now)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

/* ── Ranked dispatch helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void sched_stamp_awake_if_needed(const SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now)
{
    uint8_t flags = task->sched_flags;
    bool sleeping = (flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING) != 0U;
    bool had_due = (flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID) != 0U;
    if (sleeping || !had_due) {
        uint8_t keep = (uint8_t)(flags & (SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT));
        task->sched_flags = (uint8_t)(keep | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID);
        if (!had_due) {
            uint32_t base = sched_wakeup_base_tick(task, now, sleeping);
            task->due_ms = base + (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[task->priority];
        }
    }
}

static bool sched_prepare_task(SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now, bool *any_alive)
{
    task->sched = sched;
    if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD) {
        return false;
    }

    *any_alive = true;
    syn_port_enter_critical();

    if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED) {
        if (task->delay_until != 0U && (int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0) {
            task->delay_until = (now == 0U) ? 0xFFFFFFFFU : now;
        }
        task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }

    if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED || task->wait_event != NULL) {
        if (!sched_is_event_ready(task, now)) {
            task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED;
            task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
            syn_port_exit_critical();
            return false;
        }
        sched_stamp_awake_if_needed(sched, task, now);
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return true;
    }

    if (task->delay_until != 0U && (int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) < 0) {
        task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }

    sched_stamp_awake_if_needed(sched, task, now);
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return true;
}

static void sched_resolve_event_wait(SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now)
{
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint32_t matched = 0U;
    (void)syn_event_flags_wait(
        task->wait_event, task->wait_mask,
        (uint32_t)SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_WAIT_ANY | (uint32_t)SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_AUTO_CLEAR, &matched);
    bool timed_out = (task->delay_until != 0U) && ((int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0);
    if (matched != 0U || timed_out) {
        task->wait_mask = matched;
        task->wait_event = NULL;
        task->delay_until = 0U;
        if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) {
            task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;
        }
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static uint8_t sched_task_rank(const SYN_Task *task, uint32_t now)
{
    if ((int32_t)(now - task->due_ms) >= 0) {
        return SCHED_RANK_OVERDUE;
    }
    if ((task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE) != 0U) {
        return SCHED_RANK_WORK;
    }
    if ((task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED) == 0U) {
        return SCHED_RANK_POLL;
    }
    return SCHED_RANK_PASSED;
}

static bool sched_is_better_candidate(uint8_t rank, uint8_t prio, size_t dist, uint8_t best_rank,
                                      uint8_t best_prio, size_t best_dist)
{
    if (rank != best_rank) {
        return rank < best_rank;
    }
    if (prio != best_prio) {
        return prio < best_prio;
    }
    return dist < best_dist;
}

static SYN_Task *sched_select_best(SYN_Sched *sched, uint32_t now, bool *any_alive,
                                   uint8_t *out_rank, size_t *out_idx)
{
    const size_t n = sched->task_count;
    SYN_Task *best_task = NULL;
    size_t best_idx = 0U;
    uint8_t best_rank = SCHED_RANK_NONE;
    uint8_t best_prio = 255U;
    size_t best_dist = n;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
        SYN_Task *task = &sched->tasks[i];
        if (!sched_prepare_task(sched, task, now, any_alive)) {
            continue;
        }

        const uint8_t rank = sched_task_rank(task, now);
        const uint8_t prio = task->priority;
        size_t rr_start = sched->rr_per_prio[prio];
        if (rr_start >= n) {
            rr_start = 0U;
        }
        const size_t dist = (i >= rr_start) ? (i - rr_start) : (n - rr_start + i);

        if (sched_is_better_candidate(rank, prio, dist, best_rank, best_prio, best_dist)) {
            best_rank = rank;
            best_prio = prio;
            best_dist = dist;
            best_task = task;
            best_idx = i;
        }
    }

    *out_rank = best_rank;
    *out_idx = best_idx;
    return best_task;
}

static void sched_fold_deadline(uint32_t candidate, uint32_t *earliest, bool *has_deadline)
{
    if (!(*has_deadline) || (int32_t)(candidate - *earliest) < 0) {
        *earliest = candidate;
        *has_deadline = true;
    }
}

static bool sched_is_peer_runnable_now(const SYN_Task *t, uint32_t now)
{
    if (t->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED) {
        return false;
    }
    if (t->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED || t->wait_event != NULL) {
        return sched_is_event_ready(t, now);
    }
    return t->delay_until == 0U || (int32_t)(now - t->delay_until) >= 0;
}

static void sched_inspect_ready_peer(const SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *t, uint8_t run_prio,
                                     uint32_t now, bool *contended, uint32_t *earliest_due,
                                     bool *has_deadline)
{
    uint8_t flags = t->sched_flags;
    bool sleeping = (flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING) != 0U;
    if ((sleeping || (flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE) != 0U) && t->priority <= run_prio) {
        *contended = true;
    }
    uint32_t due;
    if ((flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID) != 0U) {
        due = t->due_ms;
    } else {
        uint32_t base = sched_wakeup_base_tick(t, now, sleeping);
        due = base + (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[t->priority];
        t->due_ms = due;
        t->sched_flags = (uint8_t)(flags | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID);
    }

    if ((int32_t)(now - due) > 0) {
        due = now;
    }
    sched_fold_deadline(due, earliest_due, has_deadline);
}

static void sched_fold_sleeping_delay(const SYN_Sched *sched, const SYN_Task *t, uint8_t run_prio,
                                      uint32_t now, uint32_t *earliest_due, bool *has_deadline)
{
    uint32_t rem = ((int32_t)(now - t->delay_until) >= 0) ? 0U : (t->delay_until - now);
    uint32_t extra = (t->priority > run_prio) ? (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[t->priority] : 0U;
    uint32_t max_rem = (uint32_t)INT32_MAX;
    uint32_t clamped = (rem > (max_rem - extra)) ? max_rem : (rem + extra);
    sched_fold_deadline(now + clamped, earliest_due, has_deadline);
}

static void sched_inspect_sleeping_peer(const SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *t, uint8_t run_prio,
                                        uint32_t now, uint32_t *earliest_due, bool *has_deadline,
                                        bool *watch_wakeups)
{
    if (t->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED) {
        if (t->delay_until != 0U) {
            sched_fold_sleeping_delay(sched, t, run_prio, now, earliest_due, has_deadline);
        }
        if (t->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED || t->wait_event != NULL) {
            t->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED;
            t->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
        }
    }
    if (t->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {
        *watch_wakeups = true;
    }
}

static void sched_update_share_state(SYN_Sched *sched, const SYN_Task *running, uint32_t now)
{
    const uint8_t run_prio = running->priority;
    bool contended = false;
    bool has_deadline = false;
    bool watch_wakeups = false;
    uint32_t earliest_due = 0U;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        SYN_Task *t = &sched->tasks[i];
        t->sched = sched;
        if (t == running) {
            continue;
        }
        if (t->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD) {
            watch_wakeups = true;
            continue;
        }

        syn_port_enter_critical();
        if (sched_is_peer_runnable_now(t, now)) {
            sched_inspect_ready_peer(sched, t, run_prio, now, &contended, &earliest_due,
                                     &has_deadline);
        } else {
            sched_inspect_sleeping_peer(sched, t, run_prio, now, &earliest_due, &has_deadline,
                                        &watch_wakeups);
        }
        syn_port_exit_critical();
    }

    sched->share_contended = contended;
    sched->share_has_deadline = has_deadline;
    sched->share_watch_wakeups = watch_wakeups;
    sched->share_deadline_ms = earliest_due;
}

static void sched_refresh_share_locked(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    if (sched != NULL && sched->running != NULL) {
        sched_update_share_state(sched, sched->running, syn_port_get_tick_ms());
    }
}

static bool sched_should_advance_rr(const SYN_Sched *sched, size_t idx, uint8_t dispatch_prio,
                                    uint8_t best_rank)
{
    if (best_rank != SCHED_RANK_OVERDUE) {
        return true;
    }
    const size_t n = sched->task_count;
    size_t pos = sched->rr_per_prio[dispatch_prio];
    if (pos >= n) {
        pos = 0U;
    }
    while (pos != idx) {
        const SYN_Task *p = &sched->tasks[pos];
        if (p->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY && p->priority == dispatch_prio &&
            (p->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE) != 0U &&
            (p->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING) == 0U) {
            return false;
        }
        pos = (pos + 1U >= n) ? 0U : (pos + 1U);
    }
    return true;
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
static bool sched_is_mutex_waiter_active(const SYN_Task *w)
{
    return (w != NULL) && ((w->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U) &&
           (w->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) && (w->delay_until == 0U);
}

static void sched_prune_mutex_slots(SYN_Mutex *m)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
        if (!sched_is_mutex_waiter_active(m->waiters[i])) {
            m->waiters[i] = NULL;
        }
    }
}

static void sched_prune_all_mutex_waiters(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    for (SYN_Mutex *m = sched->standalone_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_contended) {
        sched_prune_mutex_slots(m);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        for (SYN_Mutex *m = sched->tasks[i].held_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_held) {
            sched_prune_mutex_slots(m);
        }
    }
}

static void sched_release_held_mutexes(SYN_Task *task)
{
    for (;;) {
        syn_port_enter_critical();
        SYN_Mutex *m = task->held_mutexes;
        if (m != NULL) {
            m->lock_count = 1U;
        }
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        if (m == NULL) {
            break;
        }
        (void)syn_mutex_unlock(m, task);
    }
}
#endif

static uint8_t sched_intrinsic_prio(const SYN_Task *task)
{
    return (task->manual_priority < task->base_priority) ? task->manual_priority
                                                         : task->base_priority;
}

static uint8_t sched_effective_prio(const SYN_Task *task)
{
    uint8_t target = sched_intrinsic_prio(task);
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
    for (const SYN_Mutex *m = task->held_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_held) {
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < SYN_MUTEX_MAX_WAITERS; i++) {
            const SYN_Task *w = m->waiters[i];
            if (sched_is_mutex_waiter_active(w) && w->priority < target) {
                target = w->priority;
            }
        }
    }
#endif
    return target;
}

static void sched_apply_prio_target(SYN_Task *task, uint8_t target)
{
    if (target < task->priority) {
        uint8_t clr = (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED;
        task->sched_flags = (uint8_t)((task->sched_flags & clr) | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE);
        if (task->sched != NULL && (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID) != 0U) {
            uint32_t boosted_due =
                syn_port_get_tick_ms() + (uint32_t)task->sched->max_wait_ms[target];
            if ((int32_t)(boosted_due - task->due_ms) < 0) {
                task->due_ms = boosted_due;
            }
        }
    }
    task->priority = target;
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
static void sched_boost_local_owners(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    bool changed = true;
    for (size_t pass = 0U; pass < sched->task_count && changed; pass++) {
        changed = false;
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
            SYN_Task *t = &sched->tasks[i];
            if (t->held_mutexes != NULL) {
                uint8_t target = sched_effective_prio(t);
                if (target < t->priority) {
                    sched_apply_prio_target(t, target);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

static void sched_boost_mutex_owners_locked(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    sched_boost_local_owners(sched);
    for (SYN_Mutex *m = sched->standalone_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_contended) {
        SYN_Task *owner = m->owner;
        if (owner != NULL) {
            uint8_t target = sched_effective_prio(owner);
            if (target < owner->priority) {
                sched_apply_prio_target(owner, target);
            }
        }
    }
}

static void sched_propagate_local_prios(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        SYN_Task *t = &sched->tasks[i];
        if (t->held_mutexes != NULL) {
            t->priority = sched_intrinsic_prio(t);
        }
    }

    bool changed = true;
    for (size_t pass = 0U; pass < sched->task_count && changed; pass++) {
        changed = false;
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
            SYN_Task *t = &sched->tasks[i];
            if (t->held_mutexes != NULL) {
                uint8_t target = sched_effective_prio(t);
                if (target != t->priority) {
                    t->priority = target;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

static void sched_propagate_ext_owners(const SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    for (SYN_Mutex *m = sched->standalone_mutexes; m != NULL; m = m->next_contended) {
        if (m->owner != NULL) {
            m->owner->priority = sched_effective_prio(m->owner);
        }
    }
}
#endif

static void sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    if (sched == NULL) {
        return;
    }
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
    sched_prune_all_mutex_waiters(sched);
    sched_propagate_local_prios(sched);
    sched_propagate_ext_owners(sched);
#endif
    sched_refresh_share_locked(sched);
}

static void sched_advance_rr_if_needed(SYN_Sched *sched, size_t idx, uint8_t dispatch_prio,
                                       uint8_t best_rank)
{
    if (sched_should_advance_rr(sched, idx, dispatch_prio, best_rank)) {
        const size_t n = sched->task_count;
        const size_t next = idx + 1U;
        sched->rr_per_prio[dispatch_prio] = (next >= n) ? 0U : (uint16_t)next;
    }
}

static void sched_apply_post_status(const SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *task, SYN_PT_Status status)
{
    if ((task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED) != 0U) {
        bool stay_suspended = (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED);
        PT_INIT(&task->pt);
        task->manual_priority = SYN_TASK_NO_MANUAL_PRIO;
        task->priority = task->base_priority;
        task->delay_until = 0U;
        task->wait_event = NULL;
        task->wait_mask = 0U;
        if (stay_suspended) {
            task->due_ms = 0U;
            task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
        } else {
            task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;
            task->sched_flags = (uint8_t)(SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID);
            task->due_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms() + (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[task->priority];
        }
        return;
    }
    if (status >= PT_EXITED) {
        task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD;
        task->sched_flags = 0U;
        task->delay_until = 0U;
        task->wait_event = NULL;
        task->wait_mask = 0U;
        return;
    }
    if (task->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY || task->delay_until != 0U) {
        task->sched_flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING;
        return;
    }
    uint8_t keep_wait = (uint8_t)(task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT);
    bool more = (status == PT_MORE) || ((task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE) != 0U);
    uint8_t flag = more ? SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE : SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED;
    task->sched_flags = (uint8_t)(flag | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID | keep_wait);
    task->due_ms = syn_port_get_tick_ms() + (uint32_t)sched->max_wait_ms[task->priority];
}

static void sched_finish_dispatch(SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *task, size_t idx,
                                  uint8_t dispatch_prio, uint8_t best_rank, bool had_mutex_wait,
                                  SYN_PT_Status status)
{
    sched_advance_rr_if_needed(sched, idx, dispatch_prio, best_rank);

    if (status >= PT_EXITED || (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED) != 0U) {
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
        sched_release_held_mutexes(task);
#endif
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool mid_wait = (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U;
    sched_apply_post_status(sched, task, status);
    if (had_mutex_wait || (mid_wait && (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) == 0U)) {
        sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(sched);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static SYN_PT_Status sched_invoke_task(SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Task *best_task, size_t best_idx)
{
#if !defined(SYN_USE_PROFILER) || SYN_USE_PROFILER
    SYN_TaskProfileManager *prof = sched->profiler;
    if (prof != NULL) {
        syn_task_profile_step_start(prof, best_idx, best_task->name, syn_port_get_tick_us());
    }
    SYN_PT_Status status = best_task->func(&best_task->pt, best_task);
    if (prof != NULL && sched->profiler == prof) {
        syn_task_profile_step_end(prof, best_idx, syn_port_get_tick_us());
    }
    return status;
#else
    (void)sched;
    (void)best_idx;
    return best_task->func(&best_task->pt, best_task);
#endif
}

/* ── Scheduler tick ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

bool syn_sched_run(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sched != NULL);

    const size_t n = sched->task_count;
    if (n == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    bool any_alive = false;
    uint8_t best_rank = SCHED_RANK_NONE;
    size_t best_idx = 0U;

    SYN_METRIC_INC(sched_ticks);

    SYN_Task *best_task = sched_select_best(sched, now, &any_alive, &best_rank, &best_idx);
    if (best_task == NULL) {
        return any_alive;
    }

    if (best_rank == SCHED_RANK_PASSED) {
        syn_port_enter_critical();
        for (size_t i = 0U; i < n; i++) {
            sched->tasks[i].sched_flags &= (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED;
        }
        syn_port_exit_critical();
    }

    if (best_task->wait_event != NULL) {
        sched_resolve_event_wait(best_task, now);
    }

    sched_update_share_state(sched, best_task, now);

    const uint8_t dispatch_prio = best_task->priority;
    SYN_Task *prev_running = sched->running;
    best_task->sched = sched;
    sched->running = best_task;

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool had_mutex_wait = (best_task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U;
    best_task->sched_flags &=
        (uint8_t)~(SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED);
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
    if (had_mutex_wait) {
        sched_prune_all_mutex_waiters(sched);
    }
#endif
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    SYN_PT_Status status = sched_invoke_task(sched, best_task, best_idx);

    SYN_METRIC_INC(sched_switches);
    if (sched->running != best_task) {
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
        if (status >= PT_EXITED || (best_task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED) != 0U) {
            sched_release_held_mutexes(best_task);
        }
#endif
        return sched->task_count > 0U;
    }

    sched->running = prev_running;
    sched_finish_dispatch(sched, best_task, best_idx, dispatch_prio, best_rank, had_mutex_wait,
                          status);

    return any_alive;
}

SYN_NORETURN void syn_sched_run_forever(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    for (;;) {
        syn_sched_run(sched);
    }
}

#if defined(SYN_USE_TICKLESS) && SYN_USE_TICKLESS

static bool sched_next_wakeup_at(const SYN_Sched *sched, uint32_t now, uint32_t *out_earliest,
                                 bool *out_has_wake)
{
    uint32_t earliest = 0U;
    bool has_wake = false;
    bool any_ready_now = false;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        const SYN_Task *task = &sched->tasks[i];

        if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD || task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED) {
            continue;
        }

        if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED || task->wait_event != NULL) {
            if (sched_is_event_ready(task, now)) {
                any_ready_now = true;
            } else if (task->delay_until != 0U) {
                sched_fold_deadline(task->delay_until, &earliest, &has_wake);
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (task->delay_until == 0U || (int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0) {
            any_ready_now = true;
            continue;
        }

        sched_fold_deadline(task->delay_until, &earliest, &has_wake);
    }

    *out_earliest = earliest;
    *out_has_wake = has_wake;
    return any_ready_now;
}

static void sched_try_tickless_sleep(SYN_Sleep *sleep, bool ready_now, bool has_wake, uint32_t wake)
{
    if (ready_now) {
        return;
    }
    if (!sleep->enabled || sleep->max_depth == SYN_SLEEP_NONE || syn_sleep_any_locked(sleep)) {
        sleep->veto_count++;
        return;
    }
    sleep->enter_count++;
    if (!has_wake) {
        syn_port_sleep(sleep->max_depth);
        return;
    }
    syn_port_sleep_until(wake);
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_TIMER) || SYN_USE_TIMER
static bool sched_timer_wakeup_at(const SYN_Timer *timers, size_t count, uint32_t now,
                                  uint32_t *out_earliest, bool *out_has_wake)
{
    uint32_t earliest = 0U;
    bool has_wake = false;
    bool any_ready_now = false;

    if (timers == NULL) {
        *out_earliest = 0U;
        *out_has_wake = false;
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        if (!timers[i].active) {
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t target = timers[i].target_tick;
        if ((int32_t)(now - target) >= 0) {
            any_ready_now = true;
            continue;
        }
        sched_fold_deadline(target, &earliest, &has_wake);
    }

    *out_earliest = earliest;
    *out_has_wake = has_wake;
    return any_ready_now;
}
#endif

uint32_t syn_sched_next_wakeup(const SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sched != NULL);

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t earliest = 0U;
    bool has_wake = false;
    if (sched_next_wakeup_at(sched, now, &earliest, &has_wake)) {
        return now;
    }
    if (!has_wake) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    return (earliest == UINT32_MAX) ? (UINT32_MAX - 1U) : earliest;
}

SYN_NORETURN void syn_sched_run_tickless(SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Sleep *sleep)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sched != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(sleep != NULL);

    for (;;) {
        syn_sched_run(sched);

        uint32_t hint_wake = 0U;
        bool hint_has_wake = false;
        if (sched_next_wakeup_at(sched, syn_port_get_tick_ms(), &hint_wake, &hint_has_wake)) {
            continue;
        }

        /* Wakeup evaluation and sleep entry must be atomic with a single now sample. */
        syn_port_enter_critical();
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        uint32_t wake = 0U;
        bool has_wake = false;
        bool ready_now = sched_next_wakeup_at(sched, now, &wake, &has_wake);
        sched_try_tickless_sleep(sleep, ready_now, has_wake, wake);
        syn_port_exit_critical();
    }
}

#if !defined(SYN_USE_TIMER) || SYN_USE_TIMER

SYN_NORETURN void syn_sched_run_tickless_ex(SYN_Sched *sched, SYN_Sleep *sleep, SYN_Timer *timers,
                                            size_t timer_count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sched != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(sleep != NULL);

    for (;;) {
        syn_sched_run(sched);
        syn_timer_service(timers, timer_count);

        uint32_t hint_wake = 0U;
        bool hint_has_wake = false;
        if (sched_next_wakeup_at(sched, syn_port_get_tick_ms(), &hint_wake, &hint_has_wake)) {
            continue;
        }

        syn_port_enter_critical();
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        uint32_t wake = 0U;
        bool has_wake = false;
        uint32_t timer_wake = 0U;
        bool has_timer_wake = false;
        bool ready_now =
            sched_next_wakeup_at(sched, now, &wake, &has_wake) ||
            sched_timer_wakeup_at(timers, timer_count, now, &timer_wake, &has_timer_wake);
        if (has_timer_wake) {
            sched_fold_deadline(timer_wake, &wake, &has_wake);
        }
        sched_try_tickless_sleep(sleep, ready_now, has_wake, wake);
        syn_port_exit_critical();
    }
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_TIMER */

#endif /* SYN_USE_TICKLESS */

/* ── Task control ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_task_suspend(SYN_Task *task)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    if (task == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check */
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool had_mutex_wait = (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U;
    if (task->state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD) {
        uint8_t keep = (uint8_t)(task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED);
        task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED;
        task->sched_flags = (uint8_t)(SYN_SCHED_FLAG_SLEEPING | keep);
        SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();
    }
    if (had_mutex_wait) {
        sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(task->sched);
    } else {
        sched_refresh_share_locked(task->sched);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_task_resume(SYN_Task *task)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    if (task == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check */
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_SUSPENDED ||
        (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED && task->wait_event == NULL)) {
        uint8_t flags = (uint8_t)((task->sched_flags & (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_PASSED) |
                                  SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE | SYN_SCHED_FLAG_ISR_WAKE);
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        bool ready_now = (task->wait_event != NULL)
                             ? sched_is_event_ready(task, now)
                             : (task->delay_until == 0U || (int32_t)(now - task->delay_until) >= 0);
        if (task->sched != NULL && ready_now) {
            task->due_ms = now + (uint32_t)task->sched->max_wait_ms[task->priority];
            flags |= SYN_SCHED_FLAG_DUE_VALID;
        }
        task->sched_flags = flags;
        task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;
        SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_task_restart(SYN_Task *task)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(task->func != NULL);
    if (task == NULL || task->func == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check */
    }
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
    sched_release_held_mutexes(task);
#endif
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool had_mutex_wait = (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U;
    uint8_t flags = SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MORE;
    if (task->sched != NULL && task->sched->running == task) {
        flags |= SYN_SCHED_FLAG_RESTARTED;
    }
    PT_INIT(&task->pt);
    task->manual_priority = SYN_TASK_NO_MANUAL_PRIO;
    task->priority = task->base_priority;
    task->delay_until = 0U;
    task->due_ms = 0U;
    task->wait_event = NULL;
    task->wait_mask = 0U;
    task->sched_flags = flags;
    task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY;
    SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();
    if (had_mutex_wait) {
        sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(task->sched);
    } else {
        sched_refresh_share_locked(task->sched);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

size_t syn_sched_alive_count(const SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sched != NULL);

    size_t count = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sched->task_count; i++) {
        if (sched->tasks[i].state != (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_DEAD) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

static void sched_boost_from_task_locked(SYN_Task *task)
{
    uint8_t prev = task->priority;
    sched_apply_prio_target(task, sched_effective_prio(task));
#if !defined(SYN_USE_MUTEX) || SYN_USE_MUTEX
    if (task->sched != NULL && task->priority < prev &&
        (task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U) {
        sched_boost_mutex_owners_locked(task->sched);
    }
#else
    (void)prev;
#endif
    sched_refresh_share_locked(task->sched);
}

static void sched_demote_from_task_locked(SYN_Task *task)
{
    if (task->sched != NULL) {
        if (task->held_mutexes == NULL) {
            task->priority = sched_intrinsic_prio(task);
        }
        sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(task->sched);
    } else {
        task->priority = sched_effective_prio(task);
    }
}

void syn_sched_boost_task_prio(SYN_Task *task)
{
    sched_boost_from_task_locked(task);
}

void syn_sched_recompute_task_prio(SYN_Task *task)
{
    sched_demote_from_task_locked(task);
}

void syn_sched_clear_mutex_wait(SYN_Task *task)
{
    if ((task->sched_flags & SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT) != 0U) {
        task->sched_flags &= (uint8_t)~SYN_SCHED_FLAG_MUTEX_WAIT;
        sched_recompute_mutex_owners_locked(task->sched);
    }
}

void syn_sched_refresh_share(SYN_Sched *sched)
{
    sched_refresh_share_locked(sched);
}

void syn_task_boost_priority(SYN_Task *task, SYN_Prio temp_prio)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    if (task == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if ((uint32_t)temp_prio < (uint32_t)SYN_SCHED_PRIO_LEVELS &&
        (uint8_t)temp_prio < task->priority) {
        task->manual_priority = (uint8_t)temp_prio;
        sched_boost_from_task_locked(task);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_task_restore_priority(SYN_Task *task)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    if (task == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    task->manual_priority = SYN_TASK_NO_MANUAL_PRIO;
    sched_demote_from_task_locked(task);
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_task_set_base_priority(SYN_Task *task, SYN_Prio new_prio)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(task != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT((uint32_t)new_prio < (uint32_t)SYN_SCHED_PRIO_LEVELS);

    if (task == NULL || (uint32_t)new_prio >= (uint32_t)SYN_SCHED_PRIO_LEVELS) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint8_t old_base = task->base_priority;
    task->base_priority = (uint8_t)new_prio;
    if ((uint8_t)new_prio < old_base) {
        sched_boost_from_task_locked(task);
    } else {
        sched_demote_from_task_locked(task);
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SCHED */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
The scheduler manages an array of SYN_Task descriptors. Each call to syn_sched_run() dispatches one eligible task using a ranked policy: Overdue (starvation bound reached) -> Work (PT_MORE) -> Poll (unpolled this round) -> Round reset (all ready tasks passed). Within every rank, tasks are ordered by priority and then round-robin.

Every eligible task runs within max_wait_ms[prio] plus the duration of the currently executing cooperative chunk plus any higher-priority overdue tasks ahead of it (soft bound; hard latency belongs in ISRs).

** **

static SYN_Task tasks[3];
static SYN_Sched sched;

syn_task_create(&tasks[0], "blink",   blink_fn,   SYN_PRIO_HIGH,     NULL);
syn_task_create(&tasks[1], "serial",  serial_fn,  SYN_PRIO_CRITICAL, NULL);
syn_task_create(&tasks[2], "monitor", monitor_fn, SYN_PRIO_NORMAL,   NULL);

syn_sched_init(&sched, tasks, 3);
syn_sched_run_forever(&sched);

docs.title: function syn_task_boost_priority
docs.text:
Temporarily boost a task's execution priority. 

void syn_task_boost_priority (
    SYN_Task * task,
    SYN_Prio temp_prio
)

Monotonically ratchets task->priority upward when temp_prio < task->priority (SYN_PRIO_CRITICAL = 0 is highest); calls with temp_prio >= task->priority are ignored so active higher boosts are never lowered. Promotes the task to Work rank and tightens due_ms to the boosted priority's starvation window when bound to a scheduler.

Note:

Main-loop / task context only (not ISR-safe).

Parameters:

  • task Task to boost.
  • temp_prio Temporary elevated priority.

docs.title: define PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED
docs.text:
Spawn a child protothread, continuing across PT_MORE chunks until another task needs the CPU or the child yields PT_IDLE / exits. 

#define PT_SPAWN_IF_NEEDED (
    pt,
    task,
    child,
    func
) `/* multi line expression */`

When uncontended (!syn_task_should_share(task)), consecutive PT_MORE chunks from func execute back-to-back in a single scheduler dispatch without context-switch overhead. The moment a peer task requires CPU time, yields PT_MORE and resumes the child from its saved continuation on the next turn.

#include "../common/syn_defs.h"

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SEQUENCER) || SYN_USE_SEQUENCER


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_sequencer.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_seq_init(SYN_Sequencer *seq, const SYN_SeqStep *steps, uint16_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(seq != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(steps != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(count > 0);

    if (seq == NULL || steps == NULL ||
        count == 0) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
        return;       /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }

    memset(seq, 0, sizeof(*seq));
    seq->steps = steps;
    seq->step_count = count;
    seq->state = SYN_SEQ_IDLE;
}

void syn_seq_on_complete(SYN_Sequencer *seq, SYN_SeqCompleteCallback cb, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(seq != NULL);

    if (seq == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
        return;        /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    seq->on_complete = cb;
    seq->on_complete_ctx = ctx;
}

void syn_seq_set_loop(SYN_Sequencer *seq, bool loop)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(seq != NULL);

    if (seq == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
        return;        /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    seq->loop = loop;
}

void syn_seq_start(SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(seq != NULL);

    if (seq == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
        return;        /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    seq->current = 0;
    seq->cb_untouched = false;
    seq->state = SYN_SEQ_RUNNING;
}

void syn_seq_stop(SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(seq != NULL);

    if (seq == NULL) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive bounds check / hardware port fallback */
        return;        /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }
    seq->cb_untouched = false;
    seq->state = SYN_SEQ_IDLE;
}

static void execute_step(SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    const SYN_SeqStep *step = &seq->steps[seq->current];

    seq->cb_untouched = true;
    /* Execute action if present */
    if (step->action != NULL) {
        step->action(step->ctx);
    }
    bool untouched = seq->cb_untouched;
    seq->cb_untouched = false;
    seq->updating = true;

    /* Respect init/start/stop/nested-update changes requested inside action callback */
    if (!untouched) {
        return;
    }

    /* Start delay if present */
    if (step->delay_ms > 0) {
        seq->wait_start = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        seq->state = SYN_SEQ_WAITING;
    } else {
        /* No delay — advance immediately */
        seq->current++;
    }
}

static bool complete_sequence(SYN_Sequencer *seq, bool *out_done)
{
    uint16_t last_idx = (uint16_t)(seq->step_count - 1U);
    seq->loop_count++;
    if (seq->loop) {
        seq->current = 0;
        seq->state = SYN_SEQ_RUNNING;
    } else {
        seq->current = last_idx;
        seq->state = SYN_SEQ_DONE;
    }

    seq->cb_untouched = true;
    if (seq->on_complete != NULL) {
        seq->on_complete(seq, seq->on_complete_ctx);
    }
    bool untouched = seq->cb_untouched;
    seq->cb_untouched = false;
    seq->updating = true;

    if (untouched) {
        if (seq->loop) {
            seq->current = 0;
            seq->state = SYN_SEQ_RUNNING;
        } else {
            seq->current = last_idx;
            seq->state = SYN_SEQ_DONE;
        }
    }

    if (seq->state == SYN_SEQ_DONE) {
        *out_done = true;
        return true;
    }
    if (seq->state != SYN_SEQ_RUNNING) {
        *out_done = false;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool seq_is_runnable(const SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    return seq != NULL && seq->steps != NULL && !seq->updating && seq->state != SYN_SEQ_IDLE &&
           seq->state != SYN_SEQ_DONE;
}

static bool seq_advance_wait(SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    uint32_t raw_delay = seq->steps[seq->current].delay_ms;
    uint32_t target_delay = (raw_delay > 0x7FFFFFFFU) ? 0x7FFFFFFFU : raw_delay;
    uint32_t elapsed = syn_port_get_tick_ms() - seq->wait_start;
    if (elapsed < target_delay) {
        return false;
    }
    seq->current++;
    seq->state = SYN_SEQ_RUNNING;
    return true;
}

bool syn_seq_update(SYN_Sequencer *seq)
{
    if (!seq_is_runnable(seq)) {
        return false;
    }

    seq->updating = true;
    bool done = false;

    if (seq->state == SYN_SEQ_WAITING) {
        if (!seq_advance_wait(seq)) {
            seq->updating = false;
            return false;
        }
        if (seq->current >= seq->step_count && complete_sequence(seq, &done)) {
            seq->updating = false;
            return done;
        }
    }

    /* Execute steps (bounded per call; 0-delay loops complete 1 pass per update) */
    size_t executed = 0U;
    while (seq->state == SYN_SEQ_RUNNING && executed <= (size_t)seq->step_count) {
        execute_step(seq);
        executed++;

        if (seq->state == SYN_SEQ_RUNNING && seq->current >= seq->step_count) {
            if (complete_sequence(seq, &done)) {
                seq->updating = false;
                return done;
            }
            if (executed >= (size_t)seq->step_count) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    done = (seq->state == SYN_SEQ_DONE);
    seq->updating = false;
    return done;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SEQUENCER */

docs.text:
Execute a sequence of actions with configurable delays between them. Non-blocking — call update() from your main loop.

** **

void relay_on(void *ctx) { syn_gpio_write(RELAY_PIN, SYN_GPIO_HIGH); }
void relay_off(void *ctx) { syn_gpio_write(RELAY_PIN, SYN_GPIO_LOW); }
void read_sensor(void *ctx) { *(int*)ctx = adc_read(); }

static const SYN_SeqStep steps[] = {
    { relay_on,     NULL,  0 },      // step 0: relay on, no delay
    { NULL,         NULL,  200 },     // step 1: wait 200ms
    { read_sensor,  &val,  0 },      // step 2: read sensor
    { relay_off,    NULL,  100 },     // step 3: relay off, then wait 100ms
};

SYN_Sequencer seq;
syn_seq_init(&seq, steps, 4);
syn_seq_start(&seq);

while (!syn_seq_is_done(&seq)) {
    syn_seq_update(&seq);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Defines the task control block (SYN_Task) that pairs a protothread with scheduling metadata: priority, state, name, delay target, and optional event-wait fields for true blocking.

Tasks are caller-owned — you allocate them however you like (static array, global, on the stack). The scheduler just takes a pointer to your array.

** **

syn_task_restart() resets the protothread continuation (lc), delay deadlines, and event wait masks. It does NOT reset static local variables inside the task function. Place all state initialization after PT_BEGIN() or reset static state inside task-private user_data structs to ensure clean restarts.

struct SYN_Mutex;

typedef struct SYN_Task {
    SYN_PT pt;                      
    uint8_t manual_priority;        
    SYN_TaskFunc func;              
    const char *name;               
    uint8_t priority;               
    uint8_t base_priority;          
    volatile uint8_t state;         
    volatile uint8_t sched_flags;   
    uint32_t delay_until;           
    uint32_t due_ms;                
    struct SYN_Sched *sched;        
    struct SYN_Mutex *held_mutexes; 
    void *user_data;                
    SYN_EventFlags *wait_event;     
    uint32_t wait_mask;             
} SYN_Task;

void syn_sched_refresh_share(struct SYN_Sched *sched);

static inline bool syn_task_arm_event_wait(SYN_Task *task, SYN_EventFlags *grp, uint32_t mask,
                                           bool use_timeout, uint32_t timeout_ms,
                                           uint32_t *out_matched)
{
    if (out_matched != NULL) {
        *out_matched = 0U;
    }
    if ((task == NULL) || (grp == NULL) || (mask == 0U)) {
        return false;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (syn_event_flags_wait(
            grp, mask, (uint32_t)SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_WAIT_ANY | (uint32_t)SYN_EVENT_FLAGS_AUTO_CLEAR,
            out_matched) == SYN_OK) {
        syn_sched_refresh_share(task->sched);
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }

    task->delay_until = 0U;
    if (use_timeout &&
        !syn_pt_arm_ms_deadline(&task->delay_until, syn_port_get_tick_ms(), timeout_ms)) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }

    task->wait_event = grp;
    task->wait_mask = mask;
    SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return true;
}

static inline void syn_task_park_blocked(SYN_Task *task)
{
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (task->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) {
        task->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED;
        SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER();
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

}
#endif

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_TIMER) || SYN_USE_TIMER


#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "syn_timer.h"

static uint32_t timer_clamp_period(uint32_t period_ms)
{
    if (period_ms == 0U) {
        return 1U;
    }
    if (period_ms > 0x7FFFFFFFU) {
        return 0x7FFFFFFFU;
    }
    return period_ms;
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_timer_init(SYN_Timer *timer, uint32_t period_ms, bool periodic, SYN_TimerCallback callback,
                    void *user_data)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    uint32_t clamped = timer_clamp_period(period_ms);
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    timer->period_ms = clamped;
    timer->target_tick = 0U;
    timer->callback = callback;
    timer->user_data = user_data;
    timer->periodic = periodic;
    timer->active = false;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_timer_start(SYN_Timer *timer)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint32_t period = timer->period_ms;
    timer->target_tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms() + period;
    timer->active = true;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_timer_stop(SYN_Timer *timer)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    timer->active = false;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_timer_set_period(SYN_Timer *timer, uint32_t period_ms)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    uint32_t clamped = timer_clamp_period(period_ms);
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    timer->period_ms = clamped;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static bool timer_check_and_rearm(SYN_Timer *timer, SYN_TimerCallback *out_cb, void **out_ud)
{
    bool fired = false;
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (timer->active) {
        uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
        uint32_t target = timer->target_tick;
        if ((int32_t)(now - target) >= 0) {
            if (timer->periodic) {
                uint32_t period = timer->period_ms;
                target += period;
                if ((int32_t)(now - target) >= 0) {
                    target = now + period;
                }
                timer->target_tick = target;
            } else {
                timer->active = false;
            }
            if (out_cb != NULL) {
                *out_cb = timer->callback;
                *out_ud = timer->user_data;
            }
            fired = true;
        }
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return fired;
}

bool syn_timer_expired(SYN_Timer *timer)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return false;
    }
    return timer_check_and_rearm(timer, NULL, NULL);
}

void syn_timer_service(SYN_Timer *timers, size_t count)
{
    if (timers == NULL || count == 0U) {
        return;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        SYN_Timer *t = &timers[i];
        SYN_TimerCallback cb = NULL;
        void *ud = NULL;

        if (timer_check_and_rearm(t, &cb, &ud) && cb != NULL) {
            cb(t, ud);
        }
    }
}

uint32_t syn_timer_remaining(const SYN_Timer *timer)
{
    if (timer == NULL) {
        return 0U;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    bool is_active = timer->active;
    uint32_t target = timer->target_tick;
    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    if (!is_active) {
        return 0U;
    }

    int32_t diff = (int32_t)(target - now);

    return (diff > 0) ? (uint32_t)diff : 0U;
}

uint32_t syn_timer_next_expiry(const SYN_Timer *timers, size_t count)
{
    if (timers == NULL || count == 0U) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t earliest = 0U;
    bool has_earliest = false;
    bool any_ready_now = false;

    for (size_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) {
        if (!timers[i].active) {
            continue;
        }

        uint32_t raw_target = timers[i].target_tick;
        /* Check if this timer has already expired */
        if ((int32_t)(now - raw_target) >= 0) {
            any_ready_now = true;
            continue;
        }

        if (!has_earliest || (int32_t)(raw_target - earliest) < 0) {
            earliest = raw_target;
            has_earliest = true;
        }
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    /* If any timer is ready right now, return 'now' */
    if (any_ready_now) {
        return now;
    }
    if (!has_earliest) {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }

    return (earliest == UINT32_MAX) ? (UINT32_MAX - 1U) : earliest;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_TIMER */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Timers are caller-owned structs with a callback. They can be used with or without the scheduler. In a bare main loop, call syn_timer_service() each iteration. With the scheduler, run it from a high-priority task.

Timers are driven by syn_port_get_tick_ms() — resolution depends on how often you call syn_timer_service().

** **

static SYN_Timer heartbeat;

void on_heartbeat(SYN_Timer *t, void *ctx) {
    syn_gpio_toggle(LED_PIN);
}

syn_timer_init(&heartbeat, 1000, true, on_heartbeat, NULL);
syn_timer_start(&heartbeat);

while (1) {
    syn_timer_service(&heartbeat, 1);
}

#include "syn_timer_wheel.h"

#include "../port/syn_port_spinlock.h"
#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

typedef char syn_timer_wheel_buckets_pow2_check[((SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS > 0U) &&
                                                 ((SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS &
                                                   (SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS - 1U)) == 0U))
                                                    ? 1
                                                    : -1];

typedef struct TimerWheelFrame {
    SYN_TimerWheel *wheel;
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *head;
    struct TimerWheelFrame *prev;
    struct TimerWheelFrame *next;
    bool aborted;
} TimerWheelFrame;

#if defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE && defined(__GCC_HAVE_SYNC_COMPARE_AND_SWAP_1)
static volatile uint8_t s_frame_lock = 0U;
static TimerWheelFrame *s_step_frames = NULL;

static TimerWheelFrame **timer_wheel_frames_slot(void)
{
    return &s_step_frames;
}

static void timer_wheel_lock(void)
{
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    while (__atomic_test_and_set(&s_frame_lock, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
        /* spin */
    }
}

static void timer_wheel_unlock(void)
{
    __atomic_clear(&s_frame_lock, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}
#elif defined(SYN_USE_MULTICORE) && SYN_USE_MULTICORE

static void timer_wheel_push_frame(TimerWheelFrame *frame)
{
    TimerWheelFrame **slot = timer_wheel_frames_slot();
    frame->prev = NULL;
    frame->next = *slot;
    if (*slot != NULL) {
        (*slot)->prev = frame;
    }
    *slot = frame;
}

static void timer_wheel_unlink_frame(TimerWheelFrame *frame)
{
    TimerWheelFrame **slot = timer_wheel_frames_slot();
    if (frame->prev != NULL) {
        frame->prev->next = frame->next;
    } else {
        *slot = frame->next;
    }
    if (frame->next != NULL) {
        frame->next->prev = frame->prev;
    }
    frame->prev = NULL;
    frame->next = NULL;
}

static void timer_wheel_clear_list(SYN_TimerWheelNode *head)
{
    while (head != NULL) {
        SYN_TimerWheelNode *next = head->next;
        head->next = NULL;
        head->prev = NULL;
        head->active = false;
        head = next;
    }
}

static void timer_wheel_abort_active_steps(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel)
{
    bool was_stepping = false;
    for (TimerWheelFrame *f = *timer_wheel_frames_slot(); f != NULL; f = f->next) {
        if (f->wheel == wheel) {
            was_stepping = true;
            if (!f->aborted) {
                f->aborted = true;
                timer_wheel_clear_list(f->head);
                f->head = NULL;
            }
        }
    }
    if (was_stepping) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS; i++) {
            timer_wheel_clear_list(wheel->buckets[i]);
        }
    }
}

static TimerWheelFrame *timer_wheel_find_step_frame(const SYN_TimerWheel *wheel,
                                                    const SYN_TimerWheelNode *root)
{
    for (TimerWheelFrame *f = *timer_wheel_frames_slot(); f != NULL; f = f->next) {
        if (!f->aborted && f->wheel == wheel && f->head == root) {
            return f;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void timer_wheel_restore_expired_head(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel)
{
    for (TimerWheelFrame *f = *timer_wheel_frames_slot(); f != NULL; f = f->next) {
        if (!f->aborted && f->wheel == wheel) {
            wheel->expired_head = f->head;
            return;
        }
    }
    wheel->expired_head = NULL;
}

static SYN_Status timer_wheel_cancel_locked(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel, SYN_TimerWheelNode *node)
{
    if (!node->active) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t bucket_idx = node->expires_tick % SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS;
    const SYN_TimerWheelNode *root = node;
    while (root->prev != NULL) {
        root = root->prev;
    }

    TimerWheelFrame *owner_frame =
        (wheel->buckets[bucket_idx] == root) ? NULL : timer_wheel_find_step_frame(wheel, root);
    if (wheel->buckets[bucket_idx] != root && owner_frame == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (node->prev != NULL) {
        node->prev->next = node->next;
    } else if (owner_frame != NULL) {
        owner_frame->head = node->next;
        if (wheel->expired_head == node) {
            wheel->expired_head = node->next;
        }
    } else {
        wheel->buckets[bucket_idx] = node->next;
    }

    if (node->next != NULL) {
        node->next->prev = node->prev;
    }

    node->next = NULL;
    node->prev = NULL;
    node->active = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_timer_wheel_init(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel)
{
    if (!wheel)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    timer_wheel_lock();
    timer_wheel_abort_active_steps(wheel);
    memset(wheel, 0, sizeof(*wheel));
    timer_wheel_unlock();

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_timer_wheel_add(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel, SYN_TimerWheelNode *node,
                               uint32_t delay_ticks, SYN_TimerWheelCb cb, void *arg)
{
    if (!wheel || !node || !cb || delay_ticks == 0)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    timer_wheel_lock();
    if (node->active && timer_wheel_cancel_locked(wheel, node) != SYN_OK) {
        timer_wheel_unlock();
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t target_tick = wheel->current_tick + delay_ticks;
    uint32_t bucket_idx = target_tick % SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS;
    uint32_t rotations = (delay_ticks - 1U) / SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS;

    node->expires_tick = target_tick;
    node->rotation_count = rotations;
    node->cb = cb;
    node->arg = arg;
    node->active = true;
    node->next = wheel->buckets[bucket_idx];
    node->prev = NULL;

    if (wheel->buckets[bucket_idx]) {
        wheel->buckets[bucket_idx]->prev = node;
    }
    wheel->buckets[bucket_idx] = node;
    timer_wheel_unlock();

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_timer_wheel_cancel(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel, SYN_TimerWheelNode *node)
{
    if (!wheel || !node) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    timer_wheel_lock();
    SYN_Status st = timer_wheel_cancel_locked(wheel, node);
    timer_wheel_unlock();

    return st;
}

static void timer_wheel_partition_bucket(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel, uint32_t bucket_idx,
                                         SYN_TimerWheelNode **out_exp_head)
{
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *curr = wheel->buckets[bucket_idx];
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *keep_head = NULL;
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *keep_tail = NULL;
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *exp_head = NULL;
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *exp_tail = NULL;

    while (curr != NULL) {
        SYN_TimerWheelNode *next_node = curr->next;
        curr->prev = NULL;
        curr->next = NULL;

        if (curr->rotation_count > 0U) {
            curr->rotation_count--;
            if (keep_tail != NULL) {
                keep_tail->next = curr;
                curr->prev = keep_tail;
            } else {
                keep_head = curr;
            }
            keep_tail = curr;
        } else {
            if (exp_tail != NULL) {
                exp_tail->next = curr;
                curr->prev = exp_tail;
            } else {
                exp_head = curr;
            }
            exp_tail = curr;
        }
        curr = next_node;
    }

    wheel->buckets[bucket_idx] = keep_head;
    *out_exp_head = exp_head;
}

size_t syn_timer_wheel_step(SYN_TimerWheel *wheel)
{
    if (!wheel) {
        return 0U;
    }

    timer_wheel_lock();
    wheel->current_tick++;
    uint32_t bucket_idx = wheel->current_tick % SYN_TIMER_WHEEL_BUCKETS;
    SYN_TimerWheelNode *exp_head = NULL;

    timer_wheel_partition_bucket(wheel, bucket_idx, &exp_head);
    if (exp_head == NULL) {
        timer_wheel_unlock();
        return 0U;
    }

    TimerWheelFrame frame;
    frame.wheel = wheel;
    frame.head = exp_head;
    frame.aborted = false;
    timer_wheel_push_frame(&frame);
    wheel->expired_head = frame.head;

    size_t fired_count = 0U;
    while (!frame.aborted && frame.head != NULL) {
        SYN_TimerWheelNode *curr = frame.head;
        SYN_TimerWheelCb cb = curr->cb;
        void *arg = curr->arg;

        frame.head = curr->next;
        if (frame.head != NULL) {
            frame.head->prev = NULL;
        }
        wheel->expired_head = frame.head;

        curr->next = NULL;
        curr->prev = NULL;
        curr->active = false;
        timer_wheel_unlock();

        cb(arg);
        fired_count++;

        timer_wheel_lock();
    }

    timer_wheel_unlink_frame(&frame);
    if (!frame.aborted) {
        timer_wheel_restore_expired_head(wheel);
    }
    timer_wheel_unlock();

    return fired_count;
}

void syn_watchdog_init(SYN_Watchdog *wdt, SYN_WDT_Entry *entries, uint8_t capacity,
                       SYN_WDT_TimeoutCallback callback, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(wdt != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(entries != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(capacity > 0U);

    if (wdt == NULL || entries == NULL ||
        capacity == 0U) { /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL/zero check */
        return;           /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL/zero fallback */
    }
    if (capacity > SYN_WATCHDOG_MAX_CAPACITY) {
        capacity = SYN_WATCHDOG_MAX_CAPACITY;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    wdt->entries = NULL;
    wdt->capacity = 0U;
    wdt->count = 0U;
    wdt->in_update = false;
    memset(entries, 0, sizeof(*entries) * capacity);
    wdt->entries = entries;
    wdt->capacity = capacity;
    wdt->callback = callback;
    wdt->ctx = ctx;
    wdt->errlog = NULL;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

int8_t syn_watchdog_register(SYN_Watchdog *wdt, const char *name, uint32_t timeout_ms)
{
    if (wdt == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    if (timeout_ms == 0U) {
        timeout_ms = 1U;
    } else if (timeout_ms > 0x7FFFFFFFU) {
        timeout_ms = 0x7FFFFFFFU;
    }

    int8_t slot = -1;
    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (wdt->entries != NULL && wdt->count < wdt->capacity &&
        wdt->capacity <= SYN_WATCHDOG_MAX_CAPACITY) {
        for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < wdt->capacity; i++) {
            if (!wdt->entries[i].active) {
                wdt->entries[i].name = name;
                wdt->entries[i].timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
                wdt->entries[i].last_checkin = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
                wdt->entries[i].active = true;
                wdt->count++;
                slot = (int8_t)i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();

    return slot;
}

void syn_watchdog_checkin(SYN_Watchdog *wdt, int8_t id)
{
    if (wdt == NULL || id < 0) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (wdt->entries != NULL && (uint8_t)id < wdt->capacity && wdt->entries[id].active) {
        wdt->entries[id].last_checkin = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

void syn_watchdog_unregister(SYN_Watchdog *wdt, int8_t id)
{
    if (wdt == NULL || id < 0) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (wdt->entries != NULL && (uint8_t)id < wdt->capacity && wdt->entries[id].active) {
        wdt->entries[id].active = false;
        wdt->count--;
    }
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

static bool wdt_poll_slot_locked(SYN_Watchdog *wdt, uint8_t idx, SYN_WDT_Entry *out_snap,
                                 SYN_WDT_TimeoutCallback *out_cb, void **out_ctx,
                                 SYN_ErrLog **out_errlog)
{
    if (!wdt->entries[idx].active) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    uint32_t elapsed = now - wdt->entries[idx].last_checkin;
    if (elapsed < wdt->entries[idx].timeout_ms || elapsed > 0xEFFFFFFFU) {
        return false;
    }

    /* Reset check-in and snapshot slot/callback atomically before leaving critical section */
    wdt->entries[idx].last_checkin = now;
    *out_snap = wdt->entries[idx];
    *out_cb = wdt->callback;
    *out_ctx = wdt->ctx;
    *out_errlog = wdt->errlog;
    return true;
}

void syn_watchdog_update(SYN_Watchdog *wdt)
{
    if (wdt == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    if (wdt->entries == NULL || wdt->in_update) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return;
    }
    wdt->in_update = true;
    uint8_t cap = wdt->capacity;

    for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < cap; i++) {
        SYN_WDT_Entry snap;
        SYN_WDT_TimeoutCallback cb = NULL;
        void *cb_ctx = NULL;
        SYN_ErrLog *errlog = NULL;

        if (!wdt_poll_slot_locked(wdt, i, &snap, &cb, &cb_ctx, &errlog)) {
            continue;
        }
        syn_port_exit_critical();

#if !defined(SYN_USE_ERRLOG) || SYN_USE_ERRLOG
        if (errlog != NULL) {
            syn_errlog_record(errlog, SYN_WDT_ERR_TIMEOUT, SYN_ERR_ERROR, (uint32_t)i);
        }
#endif
        if (cb != NULL) {
            cb(wdt, &snap, cb_ctx);
        }

        syn_port_enter_critical();
        if (!wdt->in_update) {
            syn_port_exit_critical();
            return;
        }
    }

    wdt->in_update = false;
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_WATCHDOG */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Each registered task must "check in" periodically. If any task misses its deadline, the watchdog fires a callback (typically system reset).

This is distinct from a hardware watchdog — it monitors individual software tasks, not just the main loop.

** **

static SYN_Watchdog wdt;
static SYN_WDT_Entry entries[3];

syn_watchdog_init(&wdt, entries, 3, on_timeout, NULL);

int id0 = syn_watchdog_register(&wdt, "sensor", 5000);  // 5s timeout
int id1 = syn_watchdog_register(&wdt, "comms",  2000);

// In each task:
syn_watchdog_checkin(&wdt, id0);

// In main loop:
syn_watchdog_update(&wdt);

#include "../common/syn_defs.h"

#if !defined(SYN_USE_WORKQUEUE) || SYN_USE_WORKQUEUE


#include "../port/syn_port_system.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_workqueue.h"

#include <string.h>

void syn_workqueue_init(SYN_WorkQueue *wq, SYN_WorkItem *buf, size_t capacity)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(wq != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(buf != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(capacity > 1);

    if (wq == NULL || buf == NULL || capacity <= 1) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    wq->overflow = 0U;
    if (capacity > (SIZE_MAX / sizeof(SYN_WorkItem))) {
        memset(&wq->queue, 0, sizeof(wq->queue));
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return;
    }

    memset(buf, 0, sizeof(SYN_WorkItem) * capacity);
    (void)syn_spsc_queue_init(&wq->queue, buf, sizeof(SYN_WorkItem), capacity);
    syn_port_exit_critical();
}

bool syn_workqueue_post(SYN_WorkQueue *wq, SYN_WorkFunc func, void *ctx)
{
    if (!wq || !func)
        return false;

    syn_port_enter_critical();
    SYN_WorkItem item = {.func = func, .ctx = ctx};
    SYN_Status status = syn_spsc_queue_push(&wq->queue, &item);

    if (status == SYN_BUSY) {
        wq->overflow++;
    }
    if (status != SYN_OK) {
        syn_port_exit_critical();
        return false;
    }

    syn_port_exit_critical();
    return true;
}

size_t syn_workqueue_process(SYN_WorkQueue *wq)
{
    if (!wq)
        return 0;
    size_t budget = syn_spsc_queue_count(&wq->queue);
    size_t count = 0;
    SYN_WorkItem item;

    while (budget > 0U && syn_spsc_queue_pop(&wq->queue, &item) == SYN_OK) {
        budget--;
        if (item.func != NULL) {
            item.func(item.ctx);
            count++;
        }
    }

    return count;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_WORKQUEUE */

#include "syn_biometric.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_biometric_init(SYN_Biometric *bio, SYN_GPIO_Pin scl, SYN_GPIO_Pin sda,
                              uint8_t i2c_addr, SYN_BiometricType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(bio != NULL);
    if (bio == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    memset(bio, 0, sizeof(*bio));
    bio->type = type;
    bio->i2c_addr = i2c_addr;

    syn_soft_i2c_init(&bio->i2c, scl, sda, 10);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_biometric_feed_samples(SYN_Biometric *bio, uint32_t red_raw, uint32_t ir_raw)
{
    if (bio == NULL)
        return;

    /* Finger detection threshold */
    if (ir_raw < 50000) {
        bio->finger_detected = false;
        bio->heart_rate_bpm = 0;
        bio->spo2_pct = 0.0f;
        return;
    }

    bio->finger_detected = true;

    /* Estimate SpO2 ratio R = (AC_red/DC_red) / (AC_ir/DC_ir) */
    float r_ratio = ((float)red_raw / (float)ir_raw);
    float spo2 = 104.0f - (17.0f * r_ratio);
    if (spo2 > 100.0f)
        spo2 = 100.0f;
    if (spo2 < 70.0f)
        spo2 = 70.0f;

    bio->spo2_pct = spo2;
    bio->heart_rate_bpm = 72; /* Nominal default pulse */
}

uint16_t syn_biometric_get_bpm(const SYN_Biometric *bio)
{
    if (bio == NULL || !bio->finger_detected)
        return 0;
    return bio->heart_rate_bpm;
}

float syn_biometric_get_spo2(const SYN_Biometric *bio)
{
    if (bio == NULL || !bio->finger_detected)
        return 0.0f;
    return bio->spo2_pct;
}

bool syn_biometric_is_finger_detected(const SYN_Biometric *bio)
{
    if (bio == NULL)
        return false;
    return bio->finger_detected;
}

#include "syn_climate.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_climate_init(SYN_Climate *sensor, SYN_GPIO_Pin scl, SYN_GPIO_Pin sda,
                            uint8_t i2c_addr, SYN_ClimateType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    if (sensor == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    memset(sensor, 0, sizeof(*sensor));
    sensor->type = type;
    sensor->i2c_addr = i2c_addr;

    syn_soft_i2c_init(&sensor->i2c, scl, sda, 10);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_climate_feed_sample(SYN_Climate *sensor, float temp_c, float humidity_rh, float press_hpa)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return;

    sensor->temperature_c = temp_c;
    sensor->humidity_rh = humidity_rh;
    sensor->pressure_hpa = press_hpa;

    /* Calculate Dew Point using Magnus-Tetens Formula */
    float a = 17.27f;
    float b = 237.7f;
    if (humidity_rh > 0.0f && (b + temp_c) != 0.0f) {
        float alpha = ((a * temp_c) / (b + temp_c)) + logf(humidity_rh / 100.0f);
        if (a != alpha) {
            sensor->dew_point_c = (b * alpha) / (a - alpha);
        } else {
            sensor->dew_point_c = temp_c; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Singularity division-by-zero guard for
                                             Magnus-Tetens formula */
        }
    } else {
        sensor->dew_point_c = temp_c;
    }
}

float syn_climate_get_temp_c(const SYN_Climate *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return sensor->temperature_c;
}

float syn_climate_get_temp_f(const SYN_Climate *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 32.0f;
    return (sensor->temperature_c * 1.8f) + 32.0f;
}

float syn_climate_get_humidity(const SYN_Climate *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return sensor->humidity_rh;
}

float syn_climate_get_dew_point(const SYN_Climate *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return sensor->dew_point_c;
}

#include "syn_distance.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_distance_init(SYN_Distance *sensor, SYN_GPIO_Pin trig_pin, SYN_GPIO_Pin echo_pin,
                             uint32_t min_mm, uint32_t max_mm, SYN_DistanceType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(max_mm > min_mm);

    if (sensor == NULL || max_mm <= min_mm) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL and boundary check after
                                     SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    memset(sensor, 0, sizeof(*sensor));
    sensor->type = type;
    sensor->trig_pin = trig_pin;
    sensor->echo_pin = echo_pin;
    sensor->min_range_mm = min_mm;
    sensor->max_range_mm = max_mm;
    sensor->proximity_thresh_mm = 100; /* 100mm default */

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_distance_feed_pulse(SYN_Distance *sensor, uint32_t pulse_us)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return;

    uint32_t dist_mm = 0;
    if (sensor->type == SYN_DISTANCE_ULTRASONIC) {
        /* Speed of sound = 343 m/s -> dist = (pulse_us * 0.343) / 2 = pulse_us / 5.83 */
        dist_mm = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)pulse_us * 100u) / 583u);
    } else {
        /* TOF laser or pre-converted mm input */
        dist_mm = pulse_us;
    }

    if (dist_mm < sensor->min_range_mm)
        dist_mm = sensor->min_range_mm;
    if (dist_mm > sensor->max_range_mm)
        dist_mm = sensor->max_range_mm;

    sensor->last_distance_mm = dist_mm;
    sensor->obstacle_detected = (dist_mm <= sensor->proximity_thresh_mm);
}

void syn_distance_set_proximity_threshold(SYN_Distance *sensor, uint32_t thresh_mm)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return;
    sensor->proximity_thresh_mm = thresh_mm;
}

uint32_t syn_distance_get_mm(const SYN_Distance *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0;
    return sensor->last_distance_mm;
}

uint32_t syn_distance_get_cm(const SYN_Distance *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0;
    return sensor->last_distance_mm / 10u;
}

bool syn_distance_is_obstacle_detected(const SYN_Distance *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return false;
    return sensor->obstacle_detected;
}

#include "syn_lux.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_lux_init(SYN_Lux *sensor, SYN_GPIO_Pin scl, SYN_GPIO_Pin sda, uint8_t i2c_addr,
                        SYN_LuxType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    if (sensor == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    memset(sensor, 0, sizeof(*sensor));
    sensor->type = type;
    sensor->i2c_addr = i2c_addr;

    syn_soft_i2c_init(&sensor->i2c, scl, sda, 10);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_lux_feed_lux(SYN_Lux *sensor, float lux)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return;
    sensor->illuminance_lux = lux;
}

void syn_lux_feed_rgbc(SYN_Lux *sensor, uint16_t r, uint16_t g, uint16_t b, uint16_t c)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return;

    sensor->color_r = r;
    sensor->color_g = g;
    sensor->color_b = b;
    sensor->color_c = c;

    /* Calculate Lux from Clear channel */
    sensor->illuminance_lux = (float)c * 0.5f;

    /* Calculate Color Temperature in Kelvin (McCamy formula) */
    if (c > 0) {
        float rf = (float)r / (float)c;
        float gf = (float)g / (float)c;
        float bf = (float)b / (float)c;

        float x = (-0.14282f * rf) + (0.15492f * gf) + (-0.00000f * bf);
        float y = (-0.32466f * rf) + (1.57837f * gf) + (-0.73191f * bf);

        if (fabsf(0.1858f - y) > 0.0001f) {
            float n = (x - 0.3320f) / (0.1858f - y);
            float cct = (449.0f * n * n * n) + (3525.0f * n * n) + (6823.3f * n) + 5520.33f;
            if (cct < 1000.0f)
                cct = 1000.0f;
            if (cct > 20000.0f)
                cct = 20000.0f;
            sensor->color_temp_k = (uint16_t)cct;
        }
    }
}

float syn_lux_get_lux(const SYN_Lux *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return sensor->illuminance_lux;
}

uint16_t syn_lux_get_color_temp_k(const SYN_Lux *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL)
        return 0;
    return sensor->color_temp_k;
}

#include "syn_powermon.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_powermon_init(SYN_PowerMon *pm, SYN_GPIO_Pin scl, SYN_GPIO_Pin sda, uint8_t i2c_addr,
                             float shunt_resistor_ohms, SYN_PowerMonType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(pm != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(shunt_resistor_ohms > 0.0001f);

    if (pm == NULL || shunt_resistor_ohms <= 0.0001f) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL and boundary check after
                                     SYN_ASSERT macro in release mode */
    }

    memset(pm, 0, sizeof(*pm));
    pm->type = type;
    pm->i2c_addr = i2c_addr;
    pm->shunt_resistor_ohms = shunt_resistor_ohms;

    syn_soft_i2c_init(&pm->i2c, scl, sda, 10);

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_powermon_feed_raw(SYN_PowerMon *pm, uint16_t raw_bus_v, float raw_shunt_mv)
{
    if (pm == NULL)
        return;

    if (pm->type == SYN_POWERMON_INA219) {
        /* INA219 Bus Voltage LSB = 4mV (Shifted right by 3 bits) */
        pm->bus_voltage_v = (float)((raw_bus_v >> 3) * 4) / 1000.0f;
    } else {
        /* INA226 Bus Voltage LSB = 1.25mV */
        pm->bus_voltage_v = (float)(raw_bus_v * 1.25f) / 1000.0f;
    }

    /* Current I = V_shunt / R_shunt */
    if (pm->shunt_resistor_ohms > 0.0f) {
        pm->shunt_current_ma = (raw_shunt_mv / pm->shunt_resistor_ohms);
    } else {
        pm->shunt_current_ma = 0.0f;
    }

    /* Power P = V * I */
    pm->power_mw = pm->bus_voltage_v * pm->shunt_current_ma;
}

float syn_powermon_get_bus_voltage(const SYN_PowerMon *pm)
{
    if (pm == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return pm->bus_voltage_v;
}

float syn_powermon_get_current_ma(const SYN_PowerMon *pm)
{
    if (pm == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return pm->shunt_current_ma;
}

float syn_powermon_get_power_mw(const SYN_PowerMon *pm)
{
    if (pm == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return pm->power_mw;
}

#include "syn_scale.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

SYN_Status syn_scale_init(SYN_Scale *scale, SYN_GPIO_Pin dout_pin, SYN_GPIO_Pin sck_pin,
                          SYN_ScaleType type)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(scale != NULL);
    if (scale == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check after SYN_ASSERT macro in
                                     release mode */
    }

    memset(scale, 0, sizeof(*scale));
    scale->type = type;
    scale->dout_pin = dout_pin;
    scale->sck_pin = sck_pin;
    scale->scale_factor = 1.0f; /* 1.0 default */
    scale->is_stable = true;

    return SYN_OK;
}

void syn_scale_feed_adc(SYN_Scale *scale, int32_t raw_adc24)
{
    if (scale == NULL)
        return;

    int64_t delta = (int64_t)raw_adc24 - (int64_t)scale->tare_offset;
    if (scale->scale_factor != 0.0f) {
        scale->last_weight_grams = (float)delta / scale->scale_factor;
    } else {
        scale->last_weight_grams = 0.0f;
    }
}

void syn_scale_tare(SYN_Scale *scale, int32_t tare_offset)
{
    if (scale == NULL)
        return;
    scale->tare_offset = tare_offset;
}

void syn_scale_set_calibration_factor(SYN_Scale *scale, float factor)
{
    if (scale == NULL || !isfinite(factor) || factor == 0.0f)
        return;
    scale->scale_factor = factor;
}

float syn_scale_get_grams(const SYN_Scale *scale)
{
    if (scale == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return scale->last_weight_grams;
}

float syn_scale_get_kg(const SYN_Scale *scale)
{
    if (scale == NULL)
        return 0.0f;
    return scale->last_weight_grams / 1000.0f;
}
