#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SENSOR) || SYN_USE_SENSOR


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_sensor.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_sensor_init(SYN_Sensor *sensor, const char *name, SYN_SensorReadFunc read_func, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(read_func != NULL);

    memset(sensor, 0, sizeof(*sensor));
    sensor->name = name;
    sensor->read_func = read_func;
    sensor->read_ctx = ctx;
    sensor->enabled = true;
}

void syn_sensor_set_interval(SYN_Sensor *sensor, uint32_t interval_ms)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->interval_ms = interval_ms;
    sensor->last_poll_tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
}

void syn_sensor_enable(SYN_Sensor *sensor, bool enable)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->enabled = enable;
    if (enable) {
        sensor->last_poll_tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    }
}

/* ── Filter setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_sensor_set_filter_ma(SYN_Sensor *sensor, SYN_FilterMA *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->filter_type = (uint8_t)SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_MA;
    sensor->filter = f;
}

void syn_sensor_set_filter_ema(SYN_Sensor *sensor, SYN_FilterEMA *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->filter_type = (uint8_t)SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_EMA;
    sensor->filter = f;
}

void syn_sensor_set_filter_median(SYN_Sensor *sensor, SYN_FilterMedian *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->filter_type = (uint8_t)SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_MEDIAN;
    sensor->filter = f;
}

void syn_sensor_clear_filter(SYN_Sensor *sensor)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->filter_type = (uint8_t)SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_NONE;
    sensor->filter = NULL;
}

/* ── Threshold setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void syn_sensor_set_threshold(SYN_Sensor *sensor, int32_t threshold, int32_t band,
                              SYN_SensorThresholdCallback on_high,
                              SYN_SensorThresholdCallback on_low, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->threshold_enabled = true;
    syn_hyst_init(&sensor->hyst, threshold, band, false);
    sensor->on_high = on_high;
    sensor->on_low = on_low;
    sensor->threshold_ctx = ctx;
}

void syn_sensor_clear_threshold(SYN_Sensor *sensor)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->threshold_enabled = false;
}

static int16_t apply_filter(SYN_Sensor *sensor, int16_t raw)
{
    switch ((SYN_SensorFilterType)sensor->filter_type) {
    case SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_MA:
        return syn_filter_ma_update((SYN_FilterMA *)sensor->filter, raw);
    case SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_EMA:
        return syn_filter_ema_update((SYN_FilterEMA *)sensor->filter, raw);
    case SYN_SENSOR_FILTER_MEDIAN:
        return syn_filter_median_update((SYN_FilterMedian *)sensor->filter, raw);
    default:
        return raw;
    }
}

/* ── Update ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void do_read(SYN_Sensor *sensor)
{
    if (sensor == NULL || sensor->read_func == NULL)
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    sensor->raw = sensor->read_func(sensor->read_ctx);

    /* Filter */
    if (sensor->filter != NULL) {
        sensor->filtered = apply_filter(sensor, sensor->raw);
    } else {
        sensor->filtered = sensor->raw;
    }

    /* Push to statistics window (if attached) before firing threshold callbacks */
    if (sensor->stats != NULL) {
        syn_signal_push(sensor->stats, (int32_t)sensor->filtered);
    }

    /* Threshold check */
    if (sensor->threshold_enabled) {
        bool was_high = syn_hyst_state(&sensor->hyst);
        bool now_high = syn_hyst_update(&sensor->hyst, sensor->filtered);

        if (now_high && !was_high) {
            if (sensor->on_high != NULL) {
                sensor->on_high(sensor, sensor->filtered, sensor->threshold_ctx);
            }
        } else if (!now_high && was_high) {
            if (sensor->on_low != NULL) {
                sensor->on_low(sensor, sensor->filtered, sensor->threshold_ctx);
            }
        }
    }
}

bool syn_sensor_update(SYN_Sensor *sensor)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);

    if (!sensor->enabled)
        return false;

    uint32_t now = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    if ((now - sensor->last_poll_tick) < sensor->interval_ms) {
        return false;
    }

    sensor->last_poll_tick = now;
    do_read(sensor);
    return true;
}

int16_t syn_sensor_read_now(SYN_Sensor *sensor)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    do_read(sensor);
    sensor->last_poll_tick = syn_port_get_tick_ms();
    return sensor->filtered;
}

void syn_sensor_service(SYN_Sensor *sensors, size_t count)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensors != NULL || count == 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        syn_sensor_update(&sensors[i]);
    }
}

void syn_sensor_set_stats(SYN_Sensor *sensor, SYN_Signal *stats)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(sensor != NULL);
    sensor->stats = stats;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SENSOR */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Wires up the full sensor pipeline: poll at an interval, filter the reading, compare against thresholds (with hysteresis), and fire callbacks or set event flags.

** **

static SYN_Sensor temp_sensor;
static SYN_FilterEMA temp_filter;
syn_filter_ema_init(&temp_filter, 64);

syn_sensor_init(&temp_sensor, "temp", read_temperature, NULL);
syn_sensor_set_interval(&temp_sensor, 1000);      // poll every 1s
syn_sensor_set_filter_ema(&temp_sensor, &temp_filter);
syn_sensor_set_threshold(&temp_sensor, 8000, 500,  // 80.00°C ± 5°C
                           on_temp_high, on_temp_low, NULL);

// In main loop:
syn_sensor_update(&temp_sensor);

#include "syn_sensor_fusion.h"

#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_matrix.h"

#include <string.h>

static bool fusion_normalize_vec3(q16_t *vx, q16_t *vy, q16_t *vz)
{
    uint64_t ux = (uint64_t)((*vx < 0) ? -(int64_t)(*vx) : (int64_t)(*vx));
    uint64_t uy = (uint64_t)((*vy < 0) ? -(int64_t)(*vy) : (int64_t)(*vy));
    uint64_t uz = (uint64_t)((*vz < 0) ? -(int64_t)(*vz) : (int64_t)(*vz));
    uint32_t norm = syn_isqrt64((ux * ux) + (uy * uy) + (uz * uz));
    if (norm == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    *vx = (q16_t)(((int64_t)(*vx) * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)norm);
    *vy = (q16_t)(((int64_t)(*vy) * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)norm);
    *vz = (q16_t)(((int64_t)(*vz) * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)norm);
    return true;
}

static q16_t fusion_clamp_sym_q16(int64_t val)
{
    if (val > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return INT32_MAX;
    }
    if (val < -(int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return -INT32_MAX;
    }
    return (q16_t)val;
}

static void fusion_integrate_state(SYN_SensorFusion *f, q16_t gx, q16_t gy, q16_t gz,
                                   const q16_t err[3], bool apply_err)
{
    if (apply_err && f->Ki > 0) {
        f->e_int[0] = q16_add_sat(f->e_int[0], q16_mul_sat(err[0], f->dt));
        f->e_int[1] = q16_add_sat(f->e_int[1], q16_mul_sat(err[1], f->dt));
        f->e_int[2] = q16_add_sat(f->e_int[2], q16_mul_sat(err[2], f->dt));
        gx = q16_add_sat(gx, q16_mul_sat(f->Ki, f->e_int[0]));
        gy = q16_add_sat(gy, q16_mul_sat(f->Ki, f->e_int[1]));
        gz = q16_add_sat(gz, q16_mul_sat(f->Ki, f->e_int[2]));
    }

    if (apply_err && f->Kp > 0) {
        gx = q16_add_sat(gx, q16_mul_sat(f->Kp, err[0]));
        gy = q16_add_sat(gy, q16_mul_sat(f->Kp, err[1]));
        gz = q16_add_sat(gz, q16_mul_sat(f->Kp, err[2]));
    }

    q16_t qw = f->q.w;
    q16_t qx = f->q.x;
    q16_t qy = f->q.y;
    q16_t qz = f->q.z;
    q16_t half_dt = f->dt >> 1;

    q16_t rw = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(
        (-((int64_t)qx * gx) - ((int64_t)qy * gy) - ((int64_t)qz * gz)) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t rx = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(
        (((int64_t)qw * gx) + ((int64_t)qy * gz) - ((int64_t)qz * gy)) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t ry = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(
        (((int64_t)qw * gy) - ((int64_t)qx * gz) + ((int64_t)qz * gx)) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t rz = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(
        (((int64_t)qw * gz) + ((int64_t)qx * gy) - ((int64_t)qy * gx)) >> Q16_SHIFT);

    q16_t dqw = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(((int64_t)rw * (int64_t)half_dt) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t dqx = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(((int64_t)rx * (int64_t)half_dt) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t dqy = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(((int64_t)ry * (int64_t)half_dt) >> Q16_SHIFT);
    q16_t dqz = fusion_clamp_sym_q16(((int64_t)rz * (int64_t)half_dt) >> Q16_SHIFT);

    qw = fusion_clamp_sym_q16((int64_t)qw + (int64_t)dqw);
    qx = fusion_clamp_sym_q16((int64_t)qx + (int64_t)dqx);
    qy = fusion_clamp_sym_q16((int64_t)qy + (int64_t)dqy);
    qz = fusion_clamp_sym_q16((int64_t)qz + (int64_t)dqz);

    uint64_t uw = (uint64_t)((qw < 0) ? -(int64_t)qw : (int64_t)qw);
    uint64_t ux = (uint64_t)((qx < 0) ? -(int64_t)qx : (int64_t)qx);
    uint64_t uy = (uint64_t)((qy < 0) ? -(int64_t)qy : (int64_t)qy);
    uint64_t uz = (uint64_t)((qz < 0) ? -(int64_t)qz : (int64_t)qz);
    uint32_t q_norm = syn_isqrt64((uw * uw) + (ux * ux) + (uy * uy) + (uz * uz));
    if (q_norm > 0U) {
        f->q.w = (q16_t)(((int64_t)qw * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)q_norm);
        f->q.x = (q16_t)(((int64_t)qx * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)q_norm);
        f->q.y = (q16_t)(((int64_t)qy * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)q_norm);
        f->q.z = (q16_t)(((int64_t)qz * (int64_t)Q16_ONE) / (int64_t)q_norm);
    }
}

void syn_sensor_fusion_init(SYN_SensorFusion *f, q16_t Kp, q16_t Ki, q16_t dt)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    if (f == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }

    memset(f, 0, sizeof(*f));
    f->Kp = Kp;
    f->Ki = Ki;
    f->dt = (dt > 0) ? dt : Q16_FROM_FLOAT(0.01); /* Default 100 Hz */

    f->q.w = Q16_ONE;
    f->q.x = 0;
    f->q.y = 0;
    f->q.z = 0;
}

void syn_sensor_fusion_reset(SYN_SensorFusion *f)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(f != NULL);
    if (f == NULL) {
        return; /* LCOV_EXCL_LINE: Defensive NULL check or invalid parameter fallback */
    }

    f->q.w = Q16_ONE;
    f->q.x = 0;
    f->q.y = 0;
    f->q.z = 0;
    f->e_int[0] = 0;
    f->e_int[1] = 0;
    f->e_int[2] = 0;
}

SYN_Status syn_sensor_fusion_update(SYN_SensorFusion *f, q16_t gx, q16_t gy, q16_t gz, q16_t ax,
                                    q16_t ay, q16_t az)
{
    if (f == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t e_vec[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    bool has_acc = fusion_normalize_vec3(&ax, &ay, &az);
    if (has_acc) {
        q16_t qw = f->q.w;
        q16_t qx = f->q.x;
        q16_t qy = f->q.y;
        q16_t qz = f->q.z;

        q16_t vx = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qz) - q16_mul(qw, qy));
        q16_t vy = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qz));
        q16_t vz = q16_mul(qw, qw) - q16_mul(qx, qx) - q16_mul(qy, qy) + q16_mul(qz, qz);

        q16_t a_vec[3] = {ax, ay, az};
        q16_t v_vec[3] = {vx, vy, vz};
        syn_vec3_cross(a_vec, v_vec, e_vec);
    }

    fusion_integrate_state(f, gx, gy, gz, e_vec, has_acc);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_sensor_fusion_update_9dof(SYN_SensorFusion *f, q16_t gx, q16_t gy, q16_t gz,
                                         q16_t ax, q16_t ay, q16_t az, q16_t mx, q16_t my, q16_t mz)
{
    if (f == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    if (!fusion_normalize_vec3(&mx, &my, &mz)) {
        /* Fallback to 6-DOF update if magnetometer payload is zero/invalid */
        return syn_sensor_fusion_update(f, gx, gy, gz, ax, ay, az);
    }

    q16_t e_tot[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    bool has_acc = fusion_normalize_vec3(&ax, &ay, &az);
    if (has_acc) {
        q16_t qw = f->q.w;
        q16_t qx = f->q.x;
        q16_t qy = f->q.y;
        q16_t qz = f->q.z;

        q16_t vx = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qz) - q16_mul(qw, qy));
        q16_t vy = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qz));
        q16_t vz = q16_mul(qw, qw) - q16_mul(qx, qx) - q16_mul(qy, qy) + q16_mul(qz, qz);

        /* Rotate magnetometer vector to Earth reference frame: h = C(q) * m */
        q16_t hx =
            q16_mul(mx, Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qy, qy) + q16_mul(qz, qz))) +
            q16_mul(my, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qy) - q16_mul(qw, qz))) +
            q16_mul(mz, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qz) + q16_mul(qw, qy)));

        q16_t hy =
            q16_mul(mx, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qy) + q16_mul(qw, qz))) +
            q16_mul(my, Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qx) + q16_mul(qz, qz))) +
            q16_mul(mz, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qy, qz) - q16_mul(qw, qx)));

        q16_t hz =
            q16_mul(mx, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qz) - q16_mul(qw, qy))) +
            q16_mul(my, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qy, qz) + q16_mul(qw, qx))) +
            q16_mul(mz, Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qy)));

        /* Reference magnetic field vector: b = (bx, 0, bz) */
        uint64_t uhx = (uint64_t)((hx < 0) ? -(int64_t)hx : (int64_t)hx);
        uint64_t uhy = (uint64_t)((hy < 0) ? -(int64_t)hy : (int64_t)hy);
        q16_t bx = (q16_t)syn_isqrt64((uhx * uhx) + (uhy * uhy));
        q16_t bz = hz;

        /* Estimated direction of magnetic field vector in sensor frame: w = C(q)^T * b */
        q16_t wx =
            q16_mul(bx, Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qy, qy) + q16_mul(qz, qz))) +
            q16_mul(bz, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qz) - q16_mul(qw, qy)));

        q16_t wy = q16_mul(bx, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qy) - q16_mul(qw, qz))) +
                   q16_mul(bz, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qz)));

        q16_t wz =
            q16_mul(bx, q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qy) + q16_mul(qx, qz))) +
            q16_mul(bz, Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qy)));

        q16_t a_vec[3] = {ax, ay, az};
        q16_t v_vec[3] = {vx, vy, vz};
        q16_t e_acc[3];
        syn_vec3_cross(a_vec, v_vec, e_acc);

        q16_t m_vec[3] = {mx, my, mz};
        q16_t w_vec[3] = {wx, wy, wz};
        q16_t e_mag[3];
        syn_vec3_cross(m_vec, w_vec, e_mag);

        e_tot[0] = q16_add_sat(e_acc[0], e_mag[0]);
        e_tot[1] = q16_add_sat(e_acc[1], e_mag[1]);
        e_tot[2] = q16_add_sat(e_acc[2], e_mag[2]);
    }

    fusion_integrate_state(f, gx, gy, gz, e_tot, has_acc);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_sensor_fusion_get_quaternion(const SYN_SensorFusion *f, SYN_Quaternion *q)
{
    if (f == NULL || q == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    *q = f->q;
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_sensor_fusion_get_euler(const SYN_SensorFusion *f, SYN_EulerAngles *euler)
{
    if (f == NULL || euler == NULL)
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;

    q16_t qw = f->q.w;
    q16_t qx = f->q.x;
    q16_t qy = f->q.y;
    q16_t qz = f->q.z;

    /* Roll: atan2(2*(qw*qx + qy*qz), 1 - 2*(qx^2 + qy^2)) */
    q16_t roll_num = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qz));
    q16_t roll_den = Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qx, qx) + q16_mul(qy, qy));
    euler->roll_rad = q16_atan2(roll_num, roll_den);

    /* Pitch: asin(2*(qw*qy - qz*qx)) */
    q16_t pitch_sin = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qy) - q16_mul(qz, qx));
    euler->pitch_rad = q16_asin(pitch_sin);

    /* Yaw: atan2(2*(qw*qz + qx*qy), 1 - 2*(qy^2 + qz^2)) */
    q16_t yaw_num = q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qw, qz) + q16_mul(qx, qy));
    q16_t yaw_den = Q16_ONE - q16_mul(Q16_FROM_INT(2), q16_mul(qy, qy) + q16_mul(qz, qz));
    euler->yaw_rad = q16_atan2(yaw_num, yaw_den);

    return SYN_OK;
}

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_FAT) || SYN_USE_FAT

#if defined(SYN_USE_VFS) && !SYN_USE_VFS
#error "syn_fat requires SYN_USE_VFS=1"
#endif


#include "../log/syn_log.h"
#include "../util/syn_pack.h"
#include "syn_fat.h"

#include <limits.h>
#include <string.h>

#define TAG "syn_fat"

/* ── Custom FAT volume context ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    uint16_t bytes_per_sector;   
    uint8_t sectors_per_cluster; 
    uint16_t reserved_sectors;   
    uint8_t num_fats;            
    uint16_t fat16_root_entries; 
    uint32_t fat_sectors;        
    uint32_t root_cluster;       
    bool is_fat32;               

    /* Calculated offsets (in sectors) */
    uint32_t fat_start_sector;  
    uint32_t root_start_sector; 
    uint32_t root_sectors;      
    uint32_t data_start_sector; 
    uint32_t total_clusters;    
} FAT_Volume;

static FAT_Volume g_vol;

static SYN_SD g_sd;

/* ── Open file context pool ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    char name[11];          
    uint32_t start_cluster; 
    uint32_t size;          
    uint32_t offset;        
    uint32_t dir_sector;    
    uint32_t dir_offset;    
    int flags;              
    bool used;              
} SYN_FatFileCtx;

static SYN_FatFileCtx g_fat_files[SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES];

/* ── Helper Functions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool fat_is_name_open(const char fat_name[11])
{
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < (size_t)SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES; i++) {
        if (g_fat_files[i].used && memcmp(g_fat_files[i].name, fat_name, 11U) == 0) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool is_fat_partition_type(uint8_t type)
{
    static const uint8_t types[] = {0x04U, 0x06U, 0x0BU, 0x0CU, 0x0EU, 0x14U, 0x16U, 0x1BU, 0x1CU};
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < sizeof(types); i++) {
        if (type == types[i]) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static uint32_t find_partition_start(const uint8_t *sector0)
{
    if (sector0[510] != 0x55U || sector0[511] != 0xAAU) {
        return 0U;
    }

    /* Check MBR partition 0 entry at offset 446 (0x1BE) */
    const uint8_t *part = &sector0[446];
    if (is_fat_partition_type(part[4])) {
        return syn_peek_u32_le(part, 8);
    }
    return 0U;
}

static bool is_valid_cluster(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t cluster)
{
    uint32_t max_valid = vol->is_fat32 ? 0x0FFFFFF6U : 0xFFF6U;
    if ((cluster < 2U) || (cluster > max_valid)) {
        return false;
    }
    return ((cluster - 2U) < vol->total_clusters);
}

static bool fat_compute_layout(FAT_Volume *vol, const uint8_t *bpb, uint32_t volume_start)
{
    if ((vol->fat_sectors == 0U) || (vol->num_fats == 0U)) {
        return false;
    }

    uint64_t fat_start = (uint64_t)volume_start + (uint64_t)vol->reserved_sectors;
    uint64_t all_fats = (uint64_t)vol->num_fats * (uint64_t)vol->fat_sectors;
    uint64_t root_secs =
        vol->is_fat32 ? 0ULL : ((((uint64_t)vol->fat16_root_entries * 32ULL) + 511ULL) / 512ULL);
    uint64_t root_start = vol->is_fat32 ? 0ULL : (fat_start + all_fats);
    uint64_t data_start = fat_start + all_fats + root_secs;

    uint32_t total_sec = (uint32_t)syn_peek_u16_le(bpb, 19);
    if (total_sec == 0U) {
        total_sec = syn_peek_u32_le(bpb, 32);
    }

    uint64_t non_data_sec = (uint64_t)vol->reserved_sectors + all_fats + root_secs;
    uint64_t vol_end = (uint64_t)volume_start + (uint64_t)total_sec;
    if ((vol_end > (uint64_t)UINT32_MAX) || ((uint64_t)total_sec <= non_data_sec)) {
        return false;
    }

    vol->fat_start_sector = (uint32_t)fat_start;
    vol->root_start_sector = (uint32_t)root_start;
    vol->root_sectors = (uint32_t)root_secs;
    vol->data_start_sector = (uint32_t)data_start;

    uint64_t clusters = ((uint64_t)total_sec - non_data_sec) / (uint64_t)vol->sectors_per_cluster;
    uint64_t fat_cap = ((uint64_t)vol->fat_sectors * 512ULL) / (vol->is_fat32 ? 4ULL : 2ULL);
    uint64_t max_clusters = vol->is_fat32 ? 0x0FFFFFF5ULL : 0xFFF5ULL;
    if ((clusters == 0ULL) || (fat_cap <= 2ULL)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (clusters > (fat_cap - 2ULL)) {
        clusters = fat_cap - 2ULL;
    }
    if (clusters > max_clusters) {
        clusters = max_clusters;
    }

    vol->total_clusters = (uint32_t)clusters;
    return true;
}

static bool fat_valid_spc(uint8_t spc)
{
    return (spc >= 1U) && (spc <= 128U) && ((spc & (uint8_t)(spc - 1U)) == 0U);
}

static bool fat_parse_bpb(FAT_Volume *vol, const uint8_t *bpb, uint32_t volume_start)
{
    if (bpb[510] != 0x55U || bpb[511] != 0xAAU) {
        return false;
    }

    vol->bytes_per_sector = syn_peek_u16_le(bpb, 11);
    vol->sectors_per_cluster = bpb[13];
    vol->reserved_sectors = syn_peek_u16_le(bpb, 14);
    if (vol->bytes_per_sector != 512U || !fat_valid_spc(vol->sectors_per_cluster) ||
        vol->reserved_sectors == 0U) {
        return false;
    }

    vol->num_fats = bpb[16];
    vol->fat16_root_entries = syn_peek_u16_le(bpb, 17);

    uint16_t spf16 = syn_peek_u16_le(bpb, 22);
    if (spf16 != 0U) {
        if (vol->fat16_root_entries == 0U) {
            return false;
        }
        vol->fat_sectors = spf16;
        vol->is_fat32 = false;
        vol->root_cluster = 0U;
    } else {
        if (vol->fat16_root_entries != 0U) {
            return false;
        }
        vol->fat_sectors = syn_peek_u32_le(bpb, 36);
        vol->root_cluster = syn_peek_u32_le(bpb, 44);
        vol->is_fat32 = true;
    }

    if (!fat_compute_layout(vol, bpb, volume_start)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (vol->is_fat32 && !is_valid_cluster(vol, vol->root_cluster)) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static uint32_t cluster_to_sector(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t cluster)
{
    return vol->data_start_sector + ((cluster - 2U) * vol->sectors_per_cluster);
}

static void fat_entry_location(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t cluster, uint32_t *fat_sector,
                               uint32_t *offset)
{
    uint32_t byte_off = vol->is_fat32 ? (cluster * 4U) : (cluster * 2U);
    *fat_sector = vol->fat_start_sector + (byte_off / 512U);
    *offset = byte_off % 512U;
}

static bool read_fat_entry(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t cluster, uint32_t *out_entry)
{
    if (!is_valid_cluster(vol, cluster)) {
        *out_entry = 0x0FFFFFFFU;
        return true;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    uint32_t fat_sector = 0U;
    uint32_t offset = 0U;

    fat_entry_location(vol, cluster, &fat_sector, &offset);

    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, fat_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return false;
    }

    if (vol->is_fat32) {
        uint32_t entry = syn_peek_u32_le(sec_buf, offset);
        *out_entry = entry & 0x0FFFFFFFU;
        return true;
    }

    uint16_t entry16 = syn_peek_u16_le(sec_buf, offset);
    *out_entry = (entry16 >= 0xFFF8U) ? 0x0FFFFFFFU : (uint32_t)entry16;
    return true;
}

static SYN_Status write_fat_entry(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t cluster, uint32_t value)
{
    if (!is_valid_cluster(vol, cluster)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    uint32_t fat_sector = 0U;
    uint32_t offset = 0U;

    fat_entry_location(vol, cluster, &fat_sector, &offset);

    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, fat_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (vol->is_fat32) {
        uint32_t existing = syn_peek_u32_le(sec_buf, offset);
        uint32_t merged = (existing & 0xF0000000U) | (value & 0x0FFFFFFFU);
        syn_poke_u32_le(merged, sec_buf, offset);
    } else {
        syn_poke_u16_le((uint16_t)value, sec_buf, offset);
    }

    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, fat_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (vol->num_fats > 1U) {
        if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, fat_sector + vol->fat_sectors, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

static uint32_t find_free_cluster(const FAT_Volume *vol)
{
    uint32_t limit = vol->total_clusters + 2U;
    for (uint32_t c = 2U; c < limit; c++) {
        uint32_t entry = 0U;
        if (!read_fat_entry(vol, c, &entry)) {
            return 0U;
        }
        if (entry == 0U) {
            return c;
        }
    }
    return 0U;
}

static void free_cluster_chain(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t start_cluster)
{
    uint32_t cluster = start_cluster;
    uint32_t limit = vol->total_clusters;
    while (is_valid_cluster(vol, cluster) && limit > 0U) {
        uint32_t next = 0U;
        if (!read_fat_entry(vol, cluster, &next)) {
            break;
        }
        (void)write_fat_entry(vol, cluster, 0U);
        cluster = next;
        limit--;
    }
}

static char fat_toupper(char c)
{
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {
        return (char)(c - 'a' + 'A');
    }
    return c;
}

static void format_83_chars(const char *name, char fat_name[11])
{
    memset(fat_name, ' ', 11);

    int i = 0;
    while (name[i] != '\0' && name[i] != '.' && i < 8) {
        fat_name[i] = fat_toupper(name[i]);
        i++;
    }

    while (name[i] != '\0' && name[i] != '.') {
        i++;
    }

    if (name[i] == '.') {
        i++;
        int j = 0;
        while (name[i] != '\0' && j < 3) {
            fat_name[8 + j] = fat_toupper(name[i]);
            i++;
            j++;
        }
    }
}

static int path_to_fat_name(const char *path, char fat_name[11])
{
    if (path == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (path[0] == '/') {
        path++;
    }
    if (path[0] == '\0' || path[0] == '.' || (uint8_t)path[0] == 0xE5U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    for (size_t k = 0U; path[k] != '\0'; k++) {
        if (path[k] == '/') {
            return SYN_NOT_FOUND;
        }
        if ((uint8_t)path[k] <= 0x20U) {
            return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
        }
    }

    format_83_chars(path, fat_name);
    return SYN_OK;
}

static void fat_name_to_cstr(const char fat_name[11], char out[64])
{
    size_t pos = 0U;
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < 8U && fat_name[i] != ' '; i++) {
        out[pos++] = fat_name[i];
    }
    if (fat_name[8] != ' ') {
        out[pos++] = '.';
        for (size_t j = 0U; j < 3U && fat_name[8U + j] != ' '; j++) {
            out[pos++] = fat_name[8U + j];
        }
    }
    out[pos] = '\0';
}

typedef struct {
    uint32_t sector;        
    uint32_t offset;        
    uint32_t start_cluster; 
    uint32_t file_size;     
    uint8_t attr;           
    bool found;             
} DirEntryLoc;

typedef enum {
    DIR_SCAN_CONTINUE = 0, 
    DIR_SCAN_FOUND = 1,    
    DIR_SCAN_END = 2       
} DirScanResult;

static DirScanResult inspect_dir_sector(const FAT_Volume *vol, const uint8_t *sec_buf, uint32_t sec,
                                        const char *fat_name, DirEntryLoc *loc, bool empty)
{
    for (uint32_t off = 0U; off < 512U; off += 32U) {
        uint8_t first_char = sec_buf[off];
        if (first_char == 0x00U && !empty) {
            return DIR_SCAN_END;
        }

        if (empty) {
            if (first_char == 0x00U || first_char == 0xE5U) {
                loc->sector = sec;
                loc->offset = off;
                loc->found = true;
                return DIR_SCAN_FOUND;
            }
        } else if (first_char != 0xE5U && (sec_buf[off + 11U] & 0x08U) == 0U &&
                   memcmp(&sec_buf[off], fat_name, 11) == 0) {
            uint32_t hi = 0U;
            if (vol->is_fat32) {
                hi = (uint32_t)syn_peek_u16_le(&sec_buf[off], 20) << 16;
            }
            loc->sector = sec;
            loc->offset = off;
            loc->start_cluster = (uint32_t)syn_peek_u16_le(&sec_buf[off], 26) | hi;
            loc->file_size = syn_peek_u32_le(&sec_buf[off], 28);
            loc->attr = sec_buf[off + 11U];
            loc->found = true;
            return DIR_SCAN_FOUND;
        }
    }
    return DIR_SCAN_CONTINUE;
}

static bool scan_fat32_root(const FAT_Volume *vol, const char *fat_name, DirEntryLoc *loc,
                            bool empty)
{
    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    uint32_t cluster = vol->root_cluster;
    uint32_t limit = vol->total_clusters;

    while (is_valid_cluster(vol, cluster) && limit > 0U) {
        uint32_t start_sector = cluster_to_sector(vol, cluster);
        for (uint8_t s = 0U; s < vol->sectors_per_cluster; s++) {
            uint32_t sec = start_sector + s;
            if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, sec, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
                return false;
            }
            DirScanResult res = inspect_dir_sector(vol, sec_buf, sec, fat_name, loc, empty);
            if (res != DIR_SCAN_CONTINUE) {
                return (res == DIR_SCAN_FOUND);
            }
        }
        if (!read_fat_entry(vol, cluster, &cluster)) {
            return false;
        }
        limit--;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool scan_fat16_root(const FAT_Volume *vol, const char *fat_name, DirEntryLoc *loc,
                            bool empty)
{
    uint8_t sec_buf[512];

    for (uint32_t s = 0U; s < vol->root_sectors; s++) {
        uint32_t sec = vol->root_start_sector + s;
        if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, sec, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
            return false;
        }
        DirScanResult res = inspect_dir_sector(vol, sec_buf, sec, fat_name, loc, empty);
        if (res != DIR_SCAN_CONTINUE) {
            return (res == DIR_SCAN_FOUND);
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool scan_root_dir(const FAT_Volume *vol, const char *name, DirEntryLoc *loc, bool empty)
{
    loc->found = false;
    if (vol->is_fat32) {
        return scan_fat32_root(vol, name, loc, empty);
    }
    return scan_fat16_root(vol, name, loc, empty);
}

static bool get_cluster_for_offset(const FAT_Volume *vol, uint32_t start_cluster, uint32_t offset,
                                   uint32_t *out_cluster)
{
    uint32_t cluster_size = (uint32_t)vol->sectors_per_cluster * 512U;
    uint32_t target_idx = offset / cluster_size;

    uint32_t curr_cluster = start_cluster;
    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < target_idx; i++) {
        if (i >= vol->total_clusters) {
            return false;
        }
        uint32_t next = 0U;
        if (!read_fat_entry(vol, curr_cluster, &next) || !is_valid_cluster(vol, next)) {
            return false;
        }
        curr_cluster = next;
    }
    *out_cluster = curr_cluster;
    return true;
}

static int alloc_file_slot(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES; i++) {
        if (!g_fat_files[i].used) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

static int fat_create_file(const char *fat_name, DirEntryLoc *loc)
{
    DirEntryLoc empty_slot;
    if (!scan_root_dir(&g_vol, fat_name, &empty_slot, true)) {
        return -3;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, empty_slot.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -6;
    }

    uint8_t *entry = &sec_buf[empty_slot.offset];
    memcpy(entry, fat_name, 11);
    entry[11] = 0x20U;
    memset(entry + 12, 0, 20);

    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, empty_slot.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -7;
    }

    loc->sector = empty_slot.sector;
    loc->offset = empty_slot.offset;
    loc->start_cluster = 0U;
    loc->file_size = 0U;
    loc->attr = 0x20U;
    loc->found = true;
    return 0;
}

static int fat_truncate_file(SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx)
{
    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -6;
    }

    uint8_t *entry = &sec_buf[ctx->dir_offset];
    syn_poke_u16_le(0U, entry, 20U);
    syn_poke_u16_le(0U, entry, 26U);
    syn_poke_u32_le(0U, entry, 28U);

    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -7;
    }

    free_cluster_chain(&g_vol, ctx->start_cluster);
    ctx->start_cluster = 0U;
    ctx->size = 0U;
    ctx->offset = 0U;
    return 0;
}

static int fat_alloc_initial_cluster(SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx)
{
    uint32_t clus = find_free_cluster(&g_vol);
    if (clus == 0U) {
        return -2;
    }
    if (write_fat_entry(&g_vol, clus, 0x0FFFFFFFU) != SYN_OK) {
        return -3;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        (void)write_fat_entry(&g_vol, clus, 0U);
        return -5;
    }

    uint8_t *entry = &sec_buf[ctx->dir_offset];
    syn_poke_u16_le((uint16_t)(clus >> 16), entry, 20U);
    syn_poke_u16_le((uint16_t)(clus & 0xFFFFU), entry, 26U);
    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        (void)write_fat_entry(&g_vol, clus, 0U);
        return -6;
    }

    ctx->start_cluster = clus;
    return 0;
}

/* ── VFS Mappings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool fat_flags_wants_write(int flags)
{
    return (((uint32_t)flags & 0x03U) != (uint32_t)SYN_O_RDONLY);
}

static int fat_check_open_conflict(const char fat_name[11], int flags)
{
    uint32_t acc = (uint32_t)flags & 0x03U;
    if (acc == 0x03U ||
        (acc == (uint32_t)SYN_O_RDONLY && ((uint32_t)flags & (uint32_t)SYN_O_TRUNC) != 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    bool req_write = fat_flags_wants_write(flags);
    for (size_t i = 0U; i < (size_t)SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES; i++) {
        if (g_fat_files[i].used && memcmp(g_fat_files[i].name, fat_name, 11U) == 0) {
            if (req_write || fat_flags_wants_write(g_fat_files[i].flags)) {
                return SYN_BUSY;
            }
        }
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool fat_open_attr_allowed(uint8_t attr, int flags)
{
    if ((attr & 0x10U) != 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    if (fat_flags_wants_write(flags) && (attr & 0x01U) != 0U) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_open(SYN_VfsFile *file, const char *path, int flags, void *fs_data)
{
    (void)fs_data;
    if (file == NULL || path == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    char fat_name[11];
    int name_rc = path_to_fat_name(path, fat_name);
    if (name_rc != SYN_OK) {
        return name_rc;
    }
    int conf_rc = fat_check_open_conflict(fat_name, flags);
    if (conf_rc != SYN_OK) {
        return conf_rc;
    }

    int f_idx = alloc_file_slot();
    if (f_idx < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    DirEntryLoc loc;
    if (!scan_root_dir(&g_vol, fat_name, &loc, false)) {
        if ((flags & SYN_O_CREAT) == 0) {
            return -2;
        }
        int create_rc = fat_create_file(fat_name, &loc);
        if (create_rc < 0) {
            return create_rc;
        }
    } else if (!fat_open_attr_allowed(loc.attr, flags)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    g_fat_files[f_idx].used = true;
    memcpy(g_fat_files[f_idx].name, fat_name, 11);
    g_fat_files[f_idx].start_cluster = loc.start_cluster;
    g_fat_files[f_idx].size = loc.file_size;
    g_fat_files[f_idx].offset = 0U;
    g_fat_files[f_idx].dir_sector = loc.sector;
    g_fat_files[f_idx].dir_offset = loc.offset;
    g_fat_files[f_idx].flags = flags;

    file->fs_file = &g_fat_files[f_idx];

    if ((flags & SYN_O_TRUNC) != 0) {
        int trc = fat_truncate_file(&g_fat_files[f_idx]);
        if (trc < 0) {
            g_fat_files[f_idx].used = false;
            file->fs_file = NULL;
            return trc;
        }
    }

    if ((flags & SYN_O_APPEND) != 0) {
        g_fat_files[f_idx].offset = g_fat_files[f_idx].size;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_close(SYN_VfsFile *file)
{
    if (file == NULL || file->fs_file == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_FatFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    ctx->used = false;
    file->fs_file = NULL;
    return 0;
}

static size_t fat_clamp_io_len(size_t len, uint32_t max_rem)
{
    if (len > (size_t)INT_MAX) {
        len = (size_t)INT_MAX;
    }
    if (len > (size_t)max_rem) {
        len = (size_t)max_rem;
    }
    return len;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_read(SYN_VfsFile *file, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (file == NULL || file->fs_file == NULL || (len > 0U && buf == NULL)) {
        return -1;
    }
    SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_FatFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (((uint32_t)ctx->flags & 0x03U) == (uint32_t)SYN_O_WRONLY) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (len == 0U || ctx->offset >= ctx->size) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!is_valid_cluster(&g_vol, ctx->start_cluster)) {
        return -2;
    }
    len = fat_clamp_io_len(len, ctx->size - ctx->offset);

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    uint32_t bytes_read = 0U;
    uint8_t *dest = (uint8_t *)buf;
    uint32_t cluster_size = (uint32_t)g_vol.sectors_per_cluster * 512U;

    while (bytes_read < len) {
        uint32_t curr_cluster = 0U;
        if (!get_cluster_for_offset(&g_vol, ctx->start_cluster, ctx->offset, &curr_cluster)) {
            return -2;
        }
        uint32_t byte_in_cluster = ctx->offset % cluster_size;
        uint32_t sector_in_cluster = byte_in_cluster / 512U;
        uint32_t byte_in_sector = byte_in_cluster % 512U;

        uint32_t sector = cluster_to_sector(&g_vol, curr_cluster) + sector_in_cluster;
        if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
            return -2;
        }

        uint32_t to_copy = 512U - byte_in_sector;
        if (to_copy > (len - bytes_read)) {
            to_copy = (uint32_t)(len - bytes_read);
        }

        memcpy(dest + bytes_read, sec_buf + byte_in_sector, to_copy);
        bytes_read += to_copy;
        ctx->offset += to_copy;
    }

    return (int)bytes_read;
}

static int fat_resolve_write_cluster(uint32_t start_cluster, uint32_t target_idx,
                                     uint32_t *out_cluster)
{
    uint32_t curr_cluster = start_cluster;
    uint32_t eof_val = g_vol.is_fat32 ? 0x0FFFFFF8U : 0xFFF8U;

    for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < target_idx; i++) {
        if (i >= g_vol.total_clusters) {
            return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
        }
        uint32_t next = 0U;
        if (!read_fat_entry(&g_vol, curr_cluster, &next)) {
            return -5;
        }
        if (next >= eof_val) {
            uint32_t new_cluster = find_free_cluster(&g_vol);
            if (new_cluster == 0U) {
                return -2;
            }
            if (write_fat_entry(&g_vol, curr_cluster, new_cluster) != SYN_OK) {
                return -3;
            }
            if (write_fat_entry(&g_vol, new_cluster, 0x0FFFFFFFU) != SYN_OK) {
                return -4;
            }
            curr_cluster = new_cluster;
        } else {
            if (!is_valid_cluster(&g_vol, next)) {
                return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
            }
            curr_cluster = next;
        }
    }

    if (!is_valid_cluster(&g_vol, curr_cluster)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *out_cluster = curr_cluster;
    return 0;
}

static int fat_write_sector_step(SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx, const uint8_t *src, size_t rem,
                                 uint8_t sec_buf[512], uint32_t *out_chunk)
{
    uint32_t cluster_size = (uint32_t)g_vol.sectors_per_cluster * 512U;
    uint32_t curr_cluster = 0U;
    int rc =
        fat_resolve_write_cluster(ctx->start_cluster, ctx->offset / cluster_size, &curr_cluster);
    if (rc < 0) {
        return rc;
    }

    uint32_t byte_in_cluster = ctx->offset % cluster_size;
    uint32_t sector = cluster_to_sector(&g_vol, curr_cluster) + (byte_in_cluster / 512U);
    uint32_t byte_in_sector = byte_in_cluster % 512U;

    if (byte_in_sector != 0U || rem < 512U) {
        if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
            return -5;
        }
    }

    uint32_t to_write = 512U - byte_in_sector;
    if (to_write > rem) {
        to_write = (uint32_t)rem;
    }

    memcpy(sec_buf + byte_in_sector, src, to_write);
    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -6;
    }

    ctx->offset += to_write;
    if (ctx->offset > ctx->size) {
        ctx->size = ctx->offset;
    }
    *out_chunk = to_write;
    return 0;
}

static int fat_sync_dir_size(const SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx, uint8_t sec_buf[512])
{
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -7;
    }
    syn_poke_u32_le(ctx->size, sec_buf, ctx->dir_offset + 28U);
    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, ctx->dir_sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -7;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_write(SYN_VfsFile *file, const void *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (file == NULL || file->fs_file == NULL || (len > 0U && buf == NULL)) {
        return -1;
    }
    SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_FatFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (((uint32_t)ctx->flags & 0x03U) == (uint32_t)SYN_O_RDONLY) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (((uint32_t)ctx->flags & (uint32_t)SYN_O_APPEND) != 0U) {
        ctx->offset = ctx->size;
    }
    len = fat_clamp_io_len(len, UINT32_MAX - ctx->offset);
    if (len == 0U) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (ctx->start_cluster == 0U) {
        int alloc_rc = fat_alloc_initial_cluster(ctx);
        if (alloc_rc < 0) {
            return alloc_rc;
        }
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    uint32_t bytes_written = 0U;
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)buf;

    while (bytes_written < len) {
        uint32_t chunk = 0U;
        int rc =
            fat_write_sector_step(ctx, src + bytes_written, len - bytes_written, sec_buf, &chunk);
        if (rc < 0) {
            return rc;
        }
        bytes_written += chunk;
    }

    int sync_rc = fat_sync_dir_size(ctx, sec_buf);
    if (sync_rc < 0) {
        return sync_rc;
    }

    return (int)bytes_written;
}

static int32_t syn_fat_vfs_seek(SYN_VfsFile *file, int32_t offset, int whence)
{
    if (file == NULL || file->fs_file == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_FatFileCtx *)file->fs_file;

    int64_t target_offset = 0;
    if (whence == SYN_SEEK_SET) {
        target_offset = (int64_t)offset;
    } else if (whence == SYN_SEEK_CUR) {
        target_offset = (int64_t)ctx->offset + (int64_t)offset;
    } else if (whence == SYN_SEEK_END) {
        target_offset = (int64_t)ctx->size + (int64_t)offset;
    } else {
        return -2;
    }

    if (target_offset < 0) {
        target_offset = 0;
    }
    if (target_offset > (int64_t)ctx->size) {
        target_offset = (int64_t)ctx->size;
    }
    if (target_offset > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return -2;
    }

    ctx->offset = (uint32_t)target_offset;
    return (int32_t)ctx->offset;
}

static int32_t syn_fat_vfs_tell(SYN_VfsFile *file)
{
    if (file == NULL || file->fs_file == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }
    const SYN_FatFileCtx *ctx = (const SYN_FatFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (ctx->offset > (uint32_t)INT32_MAX) {
        return -2;
    }
    return (int32_t)ctx->offset;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_unlink(const char *path, void *fs_data)
{
    (void)fs_data;
    if (path == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    char fat_name[11];
    int name_rc = path_to_fat_name(path, fat_name);
    if (name_rc != SYN_OK) {
        return name_rc;
    }
    if (fat_is_name_open(fat_name)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    DirEntryLoc loc;
    if (!scan_root_dir(&g_vol, fat_name, &loc, false)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if ((loc.attr & 0x11U) != 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, loc.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -2;
    }
    sec_buf[loc.offset] = 0xE5U;
    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, loc.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -3;
    }

    free_cluster_chain(&g_vol, loc.start_cluster);
    return 0;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_stat(const char *path, SYN_VfsDirEnt *ent, void *fs_data)
{
    (void)fs_data;
    if (ent == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    char fat_name[11];
    int name_rc = path_to_fat_name(path, fat_name);
    if (name_rc != SYN_OK) {
        return name_rc;
    }

    DirEntryLoc loc;
    if (!scan_root_dir(&g_vol, fat_name, &loc, false)) {
        return SYN_NOT_FOUND;
    }

    memset(ent, 0, sizeof(*ent));
    fat_name_to_cstr(fat_name, ent->name);
    ent->size = loc.file_size;
    ent->is_dir = (loc.attr & 0x10U) != 0U;
    return 0;
}

static int syn_fat_vfs_rename(const char *old_path, const char *new_path, void *fs_data)
{
    char old_name[11];
    char new_name[11];
    int rc = path_to_fat_name(old_path, old_name);
    if (rc != SYN_OK) {
        return rc;
    }
    rc = path_to_fat_name(new_path, new_name);
    if (rc != SYN_OK) {
        return rc;
    }

    DirEntryLoc old_loc;
    if (!scan_root_dir(&g_vol, old_name, &old_loc, false)) {
        return SYN_NOT_FOUND;
    }
    if ((old_loc.attr & 0x11U) != 0U) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    if (memcmp(old_name, new_name, 11U) == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (fat_is_name_open(old_name) || fat_is_name_open(new_name)) {
        return SYN_BUSY;
    }

    DirEntryLoc dst_loc;
    if (scan_root_dir(&g_vol, new_name, &dst_loc, false)) {
        int urc = syn_fat_vfs_unlink(new_path, fs_data);
        if (urc != 0) {
            return urc;
        }
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, old_loc.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -2;
    }
    memcpy(&sec_buf[old_loc.offset], new_name, 11U);
    if (syn_sd_write(&g_sd, old_loc.sector, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        return -3;
    }

    return 0;
}

static const SYN_VfsOps g_fat_vfs_ops = {.open = syn_fat_vfs_open,
                                         .close = syn_fat_vfs_close,
                                         .read = syn_fat_vfs_read,
                                         .write = syn_fat_vfs_write,
                                         .seek = syn_fat_vfs_seek,
                                         .tell = syn_fat_vfs_tell,
                                         .stat = syn_fat_vfs_stat,
                                         .rename = syn_fat_vfs_rename,
                                         .unlink = syn_fat_vfs_unlink,
                                         .mkdir = NULL,
                                         .opendir = NULL,
                                         .readdir = NULL,
                                         .closedir = NULL};

const SYN_VfsOps *syn_fat_get_ops(void)
{
    return &g_fat_vfs_ops;
}

SYN_Status syn_fat_init(uint8_t spi_bus, SYN_GPIO_Pin cs)
{
    if (syn_sd_init(&g_sd, spi_bus, cs) != SYN_OK) {
        SYN_LOG_E(TAG, "%s", "syn_sd_init failed");
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint8_t sec_buf[512];
    if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, 0U, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
        SYN_LOG_E(TAG, "%s", "Failed to read Sector 0");
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    uint32_t part_start = find_partition_start(sec_buf);
    if (part_start != 0U) {
        SYN_LOG_I(TAG, "FAT partition found starting at sector %u", (unsigned)part_start);
        if (syn_sd_read(&g_sd, part_start, sec_buf) != SYN_OK) {
            SYN_LOG_E(TAG, "%s", "Failed to read partition Boot Sector");
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    }

    if (!fat_parse_bpb(&g_vol, sec_buf, part_start)) {
        SYN_LOG_E(TAG, "%s", "Invalid Boot Sector BPB format");
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    SYN_LOG_I(TAG, "Mounted %s filesystem: sectors/cluster=%u reserved=%u",
              g_vol.is_fat32 ? "FAT32" : "FAT16", (unsigned)g_vol.sectors_per_cluster,
              (unsigned)g_vol.reserved_sectors);

    memset(g_fat_files, 0, sizeof(g_fat_files));

    if (syn_vfs_mount("/sd", &g_fat_vfs_ops, NULL) != SYN_OK) {
        SYN_LOG_E(TAG, "%s", "VFS mount /sd failed");
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_FAT */

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_LFS) || SYN_USE_LFS

#if defined(SYN_USE_VFS) && !SYN_USE_VFS
#error "syn_lfs requires SYN_USE_VFS=1"
#endif


#include "../port/syn_port_flash.h"
#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "syn_lfs.h"

#if __has_include("lfs.h")
#include "lfs.h"

/* Context structs that pair lfs_t* with each file/dir — avoids relying on
 * internal lfs_file_t/lfs_dir_t back-pointers which are version-dependent. */
typedef struct {
    lfs_t *lfs;
    lfs_file_t file;
    bool used;
} SYN_LfsFileCtx;

typedef struct {
    lfs_t *lfs;
    lfs_dir_t dir;
    bool used;
} SYN_LfsDirCtx;

static SYN_LfsFileCtx g_lfs_files[SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES];
static SYN_LfsDirCtx g_lfs_dirs[SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_DIRS];

/* ── LittleFS block device callbacks ────────────────────────────────────── */

static int syn_lfs_bd_read(const struct lfs_config *c, lfs_block_t block, lfs_off_t off,
                           void *buffer, lfs_size_t size)
{
    const SYN_LfsConfig *cfg = (const SYN_LfsConfig *)c->context;
    uint32_t addr = cfg->start_addr + (block * cfg->block_size) + off;
    if (syn_port_flash_read(addr, buffer, size) != SYN_OK) {
        return LFS_ERR_IO;
    }
    return LFS_ERR_OK;
}

static int syn_lfs_bd_prog(const struct lfs_config *c, lfs_block_t block, lfs_off_t off,
                           const void *buffer, lfs_size_t size)
{
    const SYN_LfsConfig *cfg = (const SYN_LfsConfig *)c->context;
    uint32_t addr = cfg->start_addr + (block * cfg->block_size) + off;
    if (syn_port_flash_write(addr, buffer, size) != SYN_OK) {
        return LFS_ERR_IO;
    }
    return LFS_ERR_OK;
}

static int syn_lfs_bd_erase(const struct lfs_config *c, lfs_block_t block)
{
    const SYN_LfsConfig *cfg = (const SYN_LfsConfig *)c->context;
    uint32_t addr = cfg->start_addr + (block * cfg->block_size);
    if (syn_port_flash_erase(addr) != SYN_OK) {
        return LFS_ERR_IO;
    }
    return LFS_ERR_OK;
}

static int syn_lfs_bd_sync(const struct lfs_config *c)
{
    (void)c;
    return LFS_ERR_OK;
}

void syn_lfs_init_config(struct lfs_config *cfg, const SYN_LfsConfig *syn_cfg)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(cfg != NULL);
    SYN_ASSERT(syn_cfg != NULL);

    if (cfg == NULL || syn_cfg == NULL || syn_cfg->block_size == 0) {
        return;
    }

    cfg->context = (void *)syn_cfg;
    cfg->read = syn_lfs_bd_read;
    cfg->prog = syn_lfs_bd_prog;
    cfg->erase = syn_lfs_bd_erase;
    cfg->sync = syn_lfs_bd_sync;

    /* These values depend on the flash hardware limitations */
    cfg->read_size = 16;
    cfg->prog_size = 16;
    cfg->block_size = syn_cfg->block_size;
    cfg->block_count = syn_cfg->size / syn_cfg->block_size;
    cfg->cache_size = 64;
    cfg->lookahead_size = 16;
    cfg->block_cycles = 500;
}

/* ── VFS Mapping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static int syn_lfs_vfs_open(SYN_VfsFile *file, const char *path, int flags, void *fs_data)
{
    lfs_t *lfs = (lfs_t *)fs_data;
    SYN_ASSERT(lfs != NULL);

    /* Allocate a context slot from the static pool */
    int f_idx = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_FILES; i++) {
        if (!g_lfs_files[i].used) {
            f_idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (f_idx < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    g_lfs_files[f_idx].used = true;
    g_lfs_files[f_idx].lfs = lfs;
    file->fs_file = &g_lfs_files[f_idx];

    /* Map flags */
    int lfs_flags = 0;
    int mode = flags & 0x03;
    if (mode == SYN_O_RDONLY)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_RDONLY;
    else if (mode == SYN_O_WRONLY)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_WRONLY;
    else if (mode == SYN_O_RDWR)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_RDWR;

    if (flags & SYN_O_CREAT)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_CREAT;
    if (flags & SYN_O_APPEND)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_APPEND;
    if (flags & SYN_O_TRUNC)
        lfs_flags |= LFS_O_TRUNC;

    int ret = lfs_file_open(lfs, &g_lfs_files[f_idx].file, path, lfs_flags);
    if (ret < 0) {
        g_lfs_files[f_idx].used = false;
        file->fs_file = NULL;
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_close(SYN_VfsFile *file)
{
    SYN_LfsFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;

    int ret = lfs_file_close(ctx->lfs, &ctx->file);
    ctx->used = false;
    file->fs_file = NULL;
    return ret;
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_read(SYN_VfsFile *file, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    SYN_LfsFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;
    return (int)lfs_file_read(ctx->lfs, &ctx->file, buf, len);
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_write(SYN_VfsFile *file, const void *buf, size_t len)
{
    SYN_LfsFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;
    return (int)lfs_file_write(ctx->lfs, &ctx->file, buf, len);
}

static int32_t syn_lfs_vfs_seek(SYN_VfsFile *file, int32_t offset, int whence)
{
    SYN_LfsFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;

    int lfs_whence = LFS_SEEK_SET;
    if (whence == SYN_SEEK_CUR)
        lfs_whence = LFS_SEEK_CUR;
    else if (whence == SYN_SEEK_END)
        lfs_whence = LFS_SEEK_END;

    return (int32_t)lfs_file_seek(ctx->lfs, &ctx->file, offset, lfs_whence);
}

static int32_t syn_lfs_vfs_tell(SYN_VfsFile *file)
{
    SYN_LfsFileCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsFileCtx *)file->fs_file;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;
    return (int32_t)lfs_file_tell(ctx->lfs, &ctx->file);
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_unlink(const char *path, void *fs_data)
{
    lfs_t *lfs = (lfs_t *)fs_data;
    return lfs_remove(lfs, path);
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_mkdir(const char *path, void *fs_data)
{
    lfs_t *lfs = (lfs_t *)fs_data;
    return lfs_mkdir(lfs, path);
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_opendir(SYN_VfsDir *dir, const char *path, void *fs_data)
{
    lfs_t *lfs = (lfs_t *)fs_data;
    SYN_ASSERT(lfs != NULL);

    int d_idx = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < SYN_VFS_MAX_OPEN_DIRS; i++) {
        if (!g_lfs_dirs[i].used) {
            d_idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (d_idx < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    g_lfs_dirs[d_idx].used = true;
    g_lfs_dirs[d_idx].lfs = lfs;
    dir->fs_dir = &g_lfs_dirs[d_idx];

    int ret = lfs_dir_open(lfs, &g_lfs_dirs[d_idx].dir, path);
    if (ret < 0) {
        g_lfs_dirs[d_idx].used = false;
        dir->fs_dir = NULL;
        return ret;
    }

    return 0;
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_readdir(SYN_VfsDir *dir, SYN_VfsDirEnt *ent)
{
    if ((dir == NULL) || (ent == NULL)) {
        return -1;
    }

    SYN_LfsDirCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsDirCtx *)dir->fs_dir;
    if (ctx == NULL) {
        return -1;
    }

    struct lfs_info info;
    int ret = lfs_dir_read(ctx->lfs, &ctx->dir, &info);
    if (ret <= 0) {
        return ret; /* 0 for EOF, negative for error */
    }

    strncpy(ent->name, info.name, sizeof(ent->name) - 1);
    ent->name[sizeof(ent->name) - 1] = '\0';
    ent->size = info.size;
    ent->is_dir = (info.type == LFS_TYPE_DIR);

    return 1;
}

static int syn_lfs_vfs_closedir(SYN_VfsDir *dir)
{
    SYN_LfsDirCtx *ctx = (SYN_LfsDirCtx *)dir->fs_dir;
    if (!ctx)
        return -1;

    int ret = lfs_dir_close(ctx->lfs, &ctx->dir);
    ctx->used = false;
    dir->fs_dir = NULL;
    return ret;
}

static const SYN_VfsOps g_lfs_vfs_ops = {.open = syn_lfs_vfs_open,
                                         .close = syn_lfs_vfs_close,
                                         .read = syn_lfs_vfs_read,
                                         .write = syn_lfs_vfs_write,
                                         .seek = syn_lfs_vfs_seek,
                                         .tell = syn_lfs_vfs_tell,
                                         .unlink = syn_lfs_vfs_unlink,
                                         .mkdir = syn_lfs_vfs_mkdir,
                                         .opendir = syn_lfs_vfs_opendir,
                                         .readdir = syn_lfs_vfs_readdir,
                                         .closedir = syn_lfs_vfs_closedir};

const SYN_VfsOps *syn_lfs_get_ops(void)
{
    return &g_lfs_vfs_ops;
}

#else

/* Mock stubs if littlefs header is not present */
const SYN_VfsOps *syn_lfs_get_ops(void)
{
    return NULL;
}

#endif

#endif /* SYN_USE_LFS */

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_PARAM) || SYN_USE_PARAM


#include "../util/syn_crc.h"
#include "syn_param.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static uint32_t align16_u32(uint32_t size)
{
    return (size + 15U) & ~15U;
}

static uint32_t slot_addr(const SYN_ParamStore *store, uint8_t sector, uint16_t slot)
{
    return store->flash_base + ((uint32_t)sector * store->sector_size) +
           ((uint32_t)slot * store->slot_size);
}

static bool verify_slot_crc(const SYN_ParamStore *store, uint8_t sector, uint16_t slot,
                            uint16_t expected_crc)
{
    uint32_t addr = slot_addr(store, sector, slot) + (uint32_t)sizeof(SYN_ParamSlotHeader);
    uint16_t crc = SYN_CRC16_CCITT_INIT;
    uint16_t remaining = store->data_size;
    uint8_t chunk[32];

    while (remaining > 0U) {
        uint16_t len = (remaining > (uint16_t)sizeof(chunk)) ? (uint16_t)sizeof(chunk) : remaining;
        if (syn_port_flash_read(addr, chunk, len) != SYN_OK) {
            return false;
        }
        crc = syn_crc16_ccitt_update(crc, chunk, len);
        addr += len;
        remaining = (uint16_t)(remaining - len);
    }
    return crc == expected_crc;
}

static bool read_slot(const SYN_ParamStore *store, uint8_t sector, uint16_t slot,
                      SYN_ParamSlotHeader *hdr, void *data)
{
    uint32_t addr = slot_addr(store, sector, slot);

    if (syn_port_flash_read(addr, hdr, sizeof(*hdr)) != SYN_OK) {
        return false;
    }

    if ((hdr->magic != SYN_PARAM_MAGIC) || (hdr->data_size != store->data_size)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (data != NULL) {
        if (syn_port_flash_read(addr + (uint32_t)sizeof(*hdr), data, store->data_size) != SYN_OK) {
            return false;
        }
        return syn_crc16_ccitt(data, store->data_size) == hdr->crc;
    }

    return verify_slot_crc(store, sector, slot, hdr->crc);
}

static SYN_Status is_slot_erased(const SYN_ParamStore *store, uint8_t sector, uint16_t slot,
                                 bool *erased)
{
    uint32_t addr = slot_addr(store, sector, slot);
    uint16_t remaining = store->slot_size;
    uint8_t chunk[32];

    *erased = true;
    while (remaining > 0U) {
        uint16_t len = (remaining > (uint16_t)sizeof(chunk)) ? (uint16_t)sizeof(chunk) : remaining;
        if (syn_port_flash_read(addr, chunk, len) != SYN_OK) {
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
        for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) {
            if (chunk[i] != 0xFFU) {
                *erased = false;
                return SYN_OK;
            }
        }
        addr += len;
        remaining = (uint16_t)(remaining - len);
    }
    return SYN_OK;
}

static SYN_Status prepare_next_slot(const SYN_ParamStore *store, uint8_t *out_sec,
                                    uint16_t *out_slot)
{
    if (!store->has_active_slot) {
        *out_sec = 0U;
        *out_slot = 0U;
        return syn_port_flash_erase(store->flash_base);
    }

    uint8_t sec = store->active_sector;
    for (uint32_t sl = (uint32_t)store->active_slot + 1UL; sl < (uint32_t)store->slots_per_sector;
         sl++) {
        bool erased = false;
        SYN_Status st = is_slot_erased(store, sec, (uint16_t)sl, &erased);
        if (st != SYN_OK) {
            return st;
        }
        if (erased) {
            *out_sec = sec;
            *out_slot = (uint16_t)sl;
            return SYN_OK;
        }
    }

    sec = (uint8_t)((sec + 1U) % store->sector_count);
    *out_sec = sec;
    *out_slot = 0U;
    return syn_port_flash_erase(store->flash_base + ((uint32_t)sec * store->sector_size));
}

static bool scan_best_slot(SYN_ParamStore *store, uint16_t *best_out)
{
    uint16_t best_seq = 0U;
    bool found = false;
    SYN_ParamSlotHeader hdr;
    uint32_t total_slots = (uint32_t)store->sector_count * (uint32_t)store->slots_per_sector;

    for (uint32_t idx = 0U; idx < total_slots; idx++) {
        uint8_t sec = (uint8_t)(idx / (uint32_t)store->slots_per_sector);
        uint16_t sl = (uint16_t)(idx % (uint32_t)store->slots_per_sector);
        if (read_slot(store, sec, sl, &hdr, NULL)) {
            if (!found || ((int16_t)(hdr.seq - best_seq) > 0)) {
                best_seq = hdr.seq;
                store->active_sector = sec;
                store->active_slot = sl;
                found = true;
            }
        }
    }

    *best_out = best_seq;
    return found;
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_param_init(SYN_ParamStore *store, uint32_t flash_base, uint8_t sector_count,
                          uint16_t data_size)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || (sector_count == 0U) || (data_size == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(store, 0, sizeof(*store));
    store->flash_base = flash_base;
    store->sector_count = sector_count;
    store->data_size = data_size;
    store->sector_size = syn_port_flash_sector_size(flash_base);

    uint32_t raw_slot = (uint32_t)sizeof(SYN_ParamSlotHeader) + (uint32_t)data_size;
    uint32_t aligned_slot = align16_u32(raw_slot);
    if ((aligned_slot > store->sector_size) || (aligned_slot > 0xFFFFU)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint32_t max_slots = store->sector_size / aligned_slot;
    store->slot_size = (uint16_t)aligned_slot;
    store->slots_per_sector = (max_slots > 0xFFFFUL) ? 0xFFFFU : (uint16_t)max_slots;

    uint16_t best_seq = 0U;
    if (scan_best_slot(store, &best_seq)) {
        store->next_seq = (uint16_t)(best_seq + 1U);
        store->has_active_slot = true;
        store->initialized = true;
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    store->active_sector = 0U;
    store->active_slot = 0U;
    store->next_seq = 1U;
    store->has_active_slot = false;
    store->initialized = true;
    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_param_load(const SYN_ParamStore *store, void *data)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || !store->initialized || (data == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_ParamSlotHeader hdr;
    if (read_slot(store, store->active_sector, store->active_slot, &hdr, data)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    return SYN_ERROR;
}

SYN_Status syn_param_save(SYN_ParamStore *store, const void *data)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || !store->initialized || (data == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint8_t sec = 0U;
    uint16_t sl = 0U;
    SYN_Status err = prepare_next_slot(store, &sec, &sl);
    if (err != SYN_OK) {
        return err;
    }

    SYN_ParamSlotHeader hdr;
    memset(&hdr, 0, sizeof(hdr));
    hdr.magic = SYN_PARAM_MAGIC;
    hdr.seq = store->next_seq;
    hdr.data_size = store->data_size;
    hdr.crc = syn_crc16_ccitt(data, store->data_size);

    uint32_t addr = slot_addr(store, sec, sl);
    err = syn_port_flash_write(addr + (uint32_t)sizeof(hdr), data, store->data_size);
    if (err == SYN_OK) {
        err = syn_port_flash_write(addr, &hdr, sizeof(hdr));
    }
    if (err != SYN_OK) {
        return err;
    }

    store->active_sector = sec;
    store->active_slot = sl;
    store->next_seq++;
    store->has_active_slot = true;

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_param_erase_all(SYN_ParamStore *store)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || !store->initialized) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    for (uint8_t sec = 0U; sec < store->sector_count; sec++) {
        SYN_Status err =
            syn_port_flash_erase(store->flash_base + ((uint32_t)sec * store->sector_size));
        if (err != SYN_OK) {
            return err;
        }
    }

    store->active_sector = 0U;
    store->active_slot = 0U;
    store->next_seq = 1U;
    store->has_active_slot = false;

    return SYN_OK;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_PARAM */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Stores key-value parameters in flash with: * Wear leveling: Slot rotation across flash sectors * Integrity: CRC-16 on each slot * Atomic writes: Sequence numbers to identify the latest valid slot * No dynamic allocation: Fixed-size parameter block, caller-owned RAM

** **

The flash region is divided into sectors. Each sector contains N slots. Each slot stores the full parameter block + header (sequence, CRC). Writes go to the next free slot. When a sector is full, the next sector is erased and writing continues there.

Sector 0:  [slot0][slot1][slot2]...[slotN]
Sector 1:  [slot0][slot1]...
Sector 2:  ...

The highest sequence number with a valid CRC is the active slot.

** **

// Define your parameters as a struct
typedef struct {
    uint16_t brightness;
    int16_t  offset;
    uint8_t  mode;
} MyParams;

static SYN_ParamStore store;
static MyParams params;

syn_param_init(&store, FLASH_PARAM_START, 2, sizeof(MyParams));
syn_param_load(&store, &params);   // loads latest valid or defaults

params.brightness = 80;
syn_param_save(&store, &params);   // writes to next slot

#if __has_include("syn_config.h")
#include "syn_config.h"
#endif

#if !defined(SYN_USE_SETTINGS) || SYN_USE_SETTINGS


#include "../util/syn_assert.h"
#include "../util/syn_crc.h"
#include "syn_settings.h"
#include "syn_vfs.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static uint16_t compute_crc(const void *data, uint16_t size)
{
    return syn_crc16_ccitt((const uint8_t *)data, size);
}

static SYN_Status probe_bank(SYN_Settings *s, uint32_t flash_base, uint8_t sector_count, void *data,
                             uint16_t data_size, const void *defaults, bool *has_valid)
{
    s->data = data;
    s->data_size = data_size;
    s->defaults = defaults;
    s->on_change = NULL;
    s->on_change_ctx = NULL;

    SYN_Status st = syn_param_init(&s->store, flash_base, sector_count, data_size);
    if (st == SYN_INVALID_PARAM) {
        *has_valid = false;
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    *has_valid = (st == SYN_OK);
    return SYN_OK;
}

static bool try_activate_bank(SYN_DualBankSettings *db, uint8_t bank_idx, uint16_t seq, void *data)
{
    SYN_Settings *chosen = (bank_idx == 0U) ? &db->bank_a : &db->bank_b;
    if (syn_param_load(&chosen->store, data) != SYN_OK) {
        return false;
    }
    db->active_bank = bank_idx;
    db->bank_a.store.next_seq = (uint16_t)(seq + 1U);
    db->bank_b.store.next_seq = (uint16_t)(seq + 1U);
    return true;
}

static void select_dual_bank(SYN_DualBankSettings *db, bool valid_a, bool valid_b, void *data,
                             uint16_t data_size, const void *defaults)
{
    uint16_t seq_a = (uint16_t)(db->bank_a.store.next_seq - 1U);
    uint16_t seq_b = (uint16_t)(db->bank_b.store.next_seq - 1U);
    bool prefer_b = valid_b && (!valid_a || ((int16_t)(seq_b - seq_a) > 0));
    uint16_t max_seq = prefer_b ? seq_b : seq_a;

    if (prefer_b && try_activate_bank(db, 1U, max_seq, data)) {
        return;
    }
    if (valid_a && try_activate_bank(db, 0U, max_seq, data)) {
        return;
    }
    if (!prefer_b && valid_b && try_activate_bank(db, 1U, max_seq, data)) {
        return;
    }

    if (valid_a || valid_b) {
        db->bank_a.store.next_seq = (uint16_t)(max_seq + 1U);
    }
    memcpy(data, defaults, data_size);
    (void)syn_param_save(&db->bank_a.store, data);
    db->active_bank = 0U;
    db->bank_b.store.next_seq = db->bank_a.store.next_seq;
}

static void restore_settings_ram(SYN_Settings *s)
{
    if (syn_param_load(&s->store, s->data) != SYN_OK) {
        memcpy(s->data, s->defaults, s->data_size);
    }
    s->checksum = compute_crc(s->data, s->data_size);
}

/* ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_settings_init(SYN_Settings *s, uint32_t flash_base, uint8_t sector_count, void *data,
                             uint16_t data_size, const void *defaults)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (defaults == NULL) || (data_size == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    s->data = data;
    s->data_size = data_size;
    s->defaults = defaults;
    s->on_change = NULL;
    s->on_change_ctx = NULL;

    SYN_Status st = syn_param_init(&s->store, flash_base, sector_count, data_size);
    if (st == SYN_INVALID_PARAM) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        st = syn_param_load(&s->store, data);
        if (st != SYN_OK) {
            memcpy(data, defaults, data_size);
        }
    } else {
        memcpy(data, defaults, data_size);
        SYN_Status save_st = syn_param_save(&s->store, data);
        if (save_st != SYN_OK) {
            return save_st;
        }
    }

    s->checksum = compute_crc(data, data_size);
    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_save(SYN_Settings *s)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (s->data == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t new_crc = compute_crc(s->data, s->data_size);
    if (new_crc == s->checksum) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    SYN_Status st = syn_param_save(&s->store, s->data);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        s->checksum = new_crc;
        if (s->on_change != NULL) {
            s->on_change(s->data, s->on_change_ctx);
        }
    }

    return st;
}

bool syn_settings_changed(const SYN_Settings *s)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(s != NULL);
    uint16_t live_crc = compute_crc(s->data, s->data_size);
    return live_crc != s->checksum;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_reset(SYN_Settings *s)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(s != NULL);
    memcpy(s->data, s->defaults, s->data_size);
    return syn_settings_save(s);
}

void syn_settings_on_change(SYN_Settings *s, SYN_SettingsChangeCallback cb, void *ctx)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(s != NULL);
    s->on_change = cb;
    s->on_change_ctx = ctx;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_reload(SYN_Settings *s)
{
    SYN_ASSERT(s != NULL);
    SYN_Status st = syn_param_load(&s->store, s->data);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        s->checksum = compute_crc(s->data, s->data_size);
    }
    return st;
}

int syn_settings_export(const SYN_Settings *s, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (buf == NULL)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (len < s->data_size) {
        return -2;
    }

    memcpy(buf, s->data, s->data_size);
    return (int)s->data_size;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_import(SYN_Settings *s, const void *buf, size_t len, bool save)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (buf == NULL) || (len != s->data_size)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memcpy(s->data, buf, s->data_size);
    if (save) {
        return syn_settings_save(s);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_export_vfs(const SYN_Settings *s, const char *filepath)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (filepath == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    int fd = syn_vfs_open(filepath, SYN_O_WRONLY | SYN_O_CREAT | SYN_O_TRUNC);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int written = syn_vfs_write(fd, s->data, s->data_size);
    syn_vfs_close(fd);

    if ((written < 0) || ((size_t)written != s->data_size)) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_import_vfs(SYN_Settings *s, const char *filepath, bool save)
{
    if ((s == NULL) || (filepath == NULL)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    int fd = syn_vfs_open(filepath, SYN_O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int32_t end_pos = syn_vfs_seek(fd, 0, SYN_SEEK_END);
    if (end_pos >= 0) {
        if (((uint32_t)end_pos != (uint32_t)s->data_size) ||
            (syn_vfs_seek(fd, 0, SYN_SEEK_SET) != 0)) {
            (void)syn_vfs_close(fd);
            return SYN_ERROR;
        }
    } else if (syn_vfs_seek(fd, 0, SYN_SEEK_SET) >= 0) {
        (void)syn_vfs_close(fd);
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    int read_bytes = syn_vfs_read(fd, s->data, s->data_size);
    (void)syn_vfs_close(fd);

    if ((read_bytes < 0) || ((size_t)read_bytes != s->data_size)) {
        restore_settings_ram(s);
        return SYN_ERROR;
    }

    if (save) {
        return syn_settings_save(s);
    }

    return SYN_OK;
}

/* ── Dual-Bank Transactional Settings Implementation ─────────────────────── */

SYN_Status syn_settings_dual_bank_init(SYN_DualBankSettings *db, uint32_t flash_base_a,
                                       uint32_t flash_base_b, uint8_t sector_count, void *data,
                                       uint16_t data_size, const void *defaults)
{
    if ((db == NULL) || (data == NULL) || (defaults == NULL) || (data_size == 0U)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    memset(db, 0, sizeof(*db));

    bool valid_a = false;
    bool valid_b = false;
    if ((probe_bank(&db->bank_a, flash_base_a, sector_count, data, data_size, defaults, &valid_a) !=
         SYN_OK) ||
        (probe_bank(&db->bank_b, flash_base_b, sector_count, data, data_size, defaults, &valid_b) !=
         SYN_OK)) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    select_dual_bank(db, valid_a, valid_b, data, data_size, defaults);

    uint16_t crc16 = compute_crc(data, data_size);
    db->bank_a.checksum = crc16;
    db->bank_b.checksum = crc16;
    db->active_crc32 = syn_crc32((const uint8_t *)data, data_size);

    return SYN_OK;
}

SYN_Status syn_settings_dual_bank_save(SYN_DualBankSettings *db)
{
    if (db == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    SYN_Settings *active = (db->active_bank == 0U) ? &db->bank_a : &db->bank_b;
    SYN_Settings *inactive = (db->active_bank == 0U) ? &db->bank_b : &db->bank_a;

    if (active->data == NULL) {
        return SYN_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uint16_t new_crc16 = compute_crc(active->data, active->data_size);
    uint32_t new_crc32 = syn_crc32((const uint8_t *)active->data, active->data_size);
    if ((new_crc16 == active->checksum) && (new_crc32 == db->active_crc32)) {
        return SYN_OK;
    }

    SYN_Status st = syn_param_save(&inactive->store, inactive->data);
    if (st == SYN_OK) {
        inactive->checksum = new_crc16;
        active->checksum = new_crc16;
        active->store.next_seq = inactive->store.next_seq;
        db->active_bank = (db->active_bank == 0U) ? 1U : 0U;
        db->active_crc32 = new_crc32;
        if (inactive->on_change != NULL) {
            inactive->on_change(inactive->data, inactive->on_change_ctx);
        } else if (active->on_change != NULL) {
            active->on_change(active->data, active->on_change_ctx);
        }
    }

    return st;
}

#endif /* SYN_USE_SETTINGS */

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Wraps syn_param (wear-leveled flash storage) with: * Automatic CRC-16 checksum for change detection * Default values initialization * Load-or-default on init * Dirty tracking (has data changed since last save?) * Optional change callback

Eliminates the repetitive InitSettings / LoadSettings / SaveSettings / update_checksum boilerplate seen in every firmware module.

** **

typedef struct {
    int32_t velocity_max;
    int32_t acceleration;
    int32_t power_max;
} MoverSettings;

static const MoverSettings defaults = { 500, 200, 80 };
static MoverSettings settings;
static SYN_Settings store;

// Init — loads from flash or applies defaults:
syn_settings_init(&store, FLASH_MOVER_BASE, 2,
                  &settings, sizeof(settings), &defaults);

// Modify and save:
settings.velocity_max = 600;
syn_settings_save(&store);  // CRC updated, writes flash

// Remote sync — check if remote copy is stale:
if (remote_checksum != syn_settings_checksum(&store)) {
    send_settings_to_remote(&settings);
}

#ifndef SYN_SETTINGS_H
#define SYN_SETTINGS_H

#include "../common/syn_defs.h"
#include "../storage/syn_param.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Callback ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef void (*SYN_SettingsChangeCallback)(void *data, void *ctx);

/* ── Settings instance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
    SYN_ParamStore store; 
    void *data;           
    uint16_t data_size;   
    const void *defaults; 
    uint16_t checksum;    

    SYN_SettingsChangeCallback on_change; 
    void *on_change_ctx;
